e.en: A small window sat under the steep {gable} of the cottage.
e.zh: 村舍陡峭的山墙下有一扇小窗户。

e.en: Birds had built a nest just below the {gable}.
e.zh: 鸟儿在山墙下方筑了一个巢。

gabled.t: adj. 有山墙的；人字形屋顶的

e.en: The {gabled} roof gave the old house its charming character.
e.zh: 那座老房子的山墙屋顶让它别具魅力。

e.en: They bought a {gabled} cottage in a quiet village.
e.zh: 他们在一个宁静的村子里买了一栋带山墙的小屋。

e.en: {Gabon} is a small country on the west coast of Africa.
e.zh: 加蓬是非洲西海岸的一个小国。

e.en: The team flew to {Gabon} for the conservation project.
e.zh: 团队飞往加蓬开展环保项目。

gaborone.t: n. 哈博罗内（博茨瓦纳首都）

e.en: {Gaborone} is the capital city of Botswana.
e.zh: 哈博罗内是博茨瓦纳的首都。

e.en: We landed in {Gaborone} early Monday morning.
e.zh: 我们周一清晨抵达哈博罗内。

gabriel.t: n. 加布里埃尔（男子名）

e.en: {Gabriel} sent his résumé to three different startups.
e.zh: 加布里埃尔把简历投给了三家不同的初创公司。

e.en: The angel {Gabriel} appears in many religious texts.
e.zh: 天使加百列出现在许多宗教典籍中。

e.en: He likes to {gad} about town on weekends.
e.zh: 他喜欢周末在城里四处闲逛。

e.en: Stop trying to {gad} around and finish your homework.
e.zh: 别再到处乱跑了,把作业做完。

gadfly.t:
n. 牛虻
n. 讨厌的人；爱挑刺的人

e.en: The journalist became a {gadfly} to corrupt politicians.
e.zh: 这位记者成了腐败政客的眼中钉。

e.en: A {gadfly} kept buzzing around the horse's ears.
e.zh: 一只牛虻不停在马耳边嗡嗡作响。

e.en: He bought another kitchen {gadget} he doesn't really need.
e.zh: 他又买了个其实用不上的厨房小工具。

e.en: This {gadget} can charge three phones at once.
e.zh: 这个小装置能同时给三部手机充电。

e.en: His office is full of high-tech {gadgetry}.
e.zh: 他的办公室里满是高科技小玩意。

e.en: The new car comes loaded with electronic {gadgetry}.
e.zh: 这款新车配备了大量电子小装置。

gadgets.t: n. 小玩意；小装置（复数）

e.en: Tech reviewers love testing the latest {gadgets}.
e.zh: 科技评测员喜欢试用最新的小玩意。

e.en: She keeps all her travel {gadgets} in one bag.
e.zh: 她把所有旅行小工具都放在一个包里。

e.en: {Gadolinium} is used as a contrast agent in MRI scans.
e.zh: 钆被用作核磁共振扫描的造影剂。

e.en: The lab ordered a small sample of {gadolinium} oxide.
e.zh: 实验室订购了一小份氧化钆样品。

e.en: A {gadwall} swam quietly across the pond.
e.zh: 一只赤膀鸭安静地游过池塘。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a male {gadwall} near the reeds.
e.zh: 观鸟者在芦苇旁发现了一只雄性赤膀鸭。

gael.t: n. 盖尔人（苏格兰/爱尔兰）

e.en: Her grandfather was a {Gael} from the Scottish Highlands.
e.zh: 她的祖父是来自苏格兰高地的盖尔人。

e.en: The festival celebrated music and dance of the {Gael}.
e.zh: 这个节日庆祝盖尔人的音乐与舞蹈。

gaelic.t:
adj. 盖尔人的
n. 盖尔语

e.en: She learned a few {Gaelic} phrases before her trip to Ireland.
e.zh: 去爱尔兰旅行前她学了几句盖尔语。

e.en: The pub hosted a night of traditional {Gaelic} music.
e.zh: 这家酒吧举办了一场传统盖尔音乐之夜。

gaff.t:
n. 带钩鱼叉
n. (船) 斜桁

e.en: The fisherman used a {gaff} to lift the heavy salmon aboard.
e.zh: 渔夫用鱼钩把那条大三文鱼钩上船。

e.en: He hooked the tuna and reached for the {gaff}.
e.zh: 他钓到金枪鱼后伸手去拿鱼钩。

e.en: The minister made an embarrassing {gaffe} during the live interview.
e.zh: 部长在直播采访中犯了个尴尬的失言。

e.en: Her social media {gaffe} went viral within hours.
e.zh: 她在社交媒体上的失言几小时内就传遍网络。

gaffer.t:
n. (影视) 灯光师
n. 老头；工头

e.en: The {gaffer} adjusted the lights before the next take.
e.zh: 灯光师在下一条开拍前调整了灯光。

e.en: On set, the {gaffer} reports to the cinematographer.
e.zh: 在片场,灯光师向摄影指导汇报。

gag.t:
n. 笑料；噱头
v. 堵住嘴；作呕

e.en: The comedian opened with a {gag} about airline food.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员以一个关于飞机餐的笑话开场。

e.en: The kidnappers used a cloth to {gag} the hostage.
e.zh: 绑匪用布堵住人质的嘴。

gaga.t: adj. 着迷的；疯狂喜欢的

e.en: Fans went {gaga} over the surprise album release.
e.zh: 粉丝们对突然发行的专辑疯狂着迷。

e.en: He's completely {gaga} about his new puppy.
e.zh: 他对自己的新小狗简直爱得发狂。

e.en: The mechanic checked the pressure {gage} before refilling the tank.
e.zh: 机械师加油前先检查了压力表。

e.en: He threw down his glove as a {gage} of challenge.
e.zh: 他扔下手套作为挑战的信物。

gagging.t: v. 作呕；堵嘴（gag 现在分词）

e.en: The strong smell had everyone {gagging} at the door.
e.zh: 那股浓烈的味道让门口的人都直犯恶心。

e.en: She's been {gagging} to try that new ramen place.
e.zh: 她一直特别想去试试那家新开的拉面店。

e.en: A {gaggle} of tourists blocked the museum entrance.
e.zh: 一群游客堵在了博物馆入口。

e.en: A noisy {gaggle} of geese crossed the road.
e.zh: 一群吵闹的鹅穿过了马路。

gaia.t: n. 盖亚（希腊大地女神）

e.en: The {Gaia} hypothesis treats Earth as a self-regulating system.
e.zh: 盖亚假说把地球视为一个自我调节的系统。

e.en: In Greek mythology, {Gaia} is the personification of Earth.
e.zh: 在希腊神话中,盖亚是大地的化身。

gaieties.t: n. 欢乐活动；庆祝活动

e.en: She missed the {gaieties} of city nightlife.
e.zh: 她怀念都市夜生活的种种欢愉。

e.en: After the war, the village's old {gaieties} slowly returned.
e.zh: 战后,村里昔日的欢乐景象慢慢回来了。

e.en: The festival filled the streets with music and {gaiety}.
e.zh: 节日让街头充满了音乐和欢乐。

e.en: Her laugh added a touch of {gaiety} to the room.
e.zh: 她的笑声为房间增添了一丝欢快气息。

e.en: As a {gaijin} in Tokyo, he stood out on the train.
e.zh: 作为东京的外国人,他在地铁里很显眼。

e.en: Some old shops are still wary of {gaijin} customers.
e.zh: 一些老店仍对外国顾客有所戒备。

e.en: Children ran {gaily} through the autumn leaves.
e.zh: 孩子们欢快地在秋叶间奔跑。

e.en: The booth was {gaily} decorated with ribbons and lights.
e.zh: 那个摊位用丝带和彩灯装饰得很欢快。

gain.t:
v. 获得；增加
n. 收益；增长

e.en: You can {gain} a lot from listening to customer feedback.
e.zh: 倾听客户反馈能让你收获很多。

e.en: The startup posted a small {gain} this quarter.
e.zh: 这家初创公司本季度有小幅盈利。

gained.t: v. 获得；增加（gain 过去式）

e.en: She {gained} confidence after her first public talk.
e.zh: 第一次公开演讲后她变得更有自信了。

e.en: The stock {gained} three percent in afternoon trading.
e.zh: 该股票在下午交易中上涨了三个百分点。

gainer.t: n. 获益者；上涨的股票

e.en: Tesla was the biggest {gainer} on the index today.
e.zh: 特斯拉是今天指数中涨幅最大的股票。

e.en: The diver attempted a difficult reverse {gainer}.
e.zh: 那位跳水运动员尝试了一个高难度的反身翻腾。

gainful.t: adj. 有报酬的；有利可图的

e.en: He's looking for {gainful} employment after graduation.
e.zh: 他毕业后正在找一份有收入的工作。

e.en: The program helps refugees find {gainful} work locally.
e.zh: 该项目帮助难民在当地找到有酬劳的工作。

gainfully.t: adv. 有报酬地（常搭配 employed）

e.en: Most graduates were {gainfully} employed within six months.
e.zh: 大多数毕业生在六个月内都找到了有收入的工作。

e.en: He's been {gainfully} working as a freelance designer.
e.zh: 他一直作为自由设计师有偿工作。

gaining.t: v. 增加；获取（gain 进行式）

e.en: Electric vehicles are {gaining} popularity worldwide.
e.zh: 电动汽车正在全球范围内日益流行。

e.en: The runner was {gaining} on the leader fast.
e.zh: 那名选手正快速追近领跑者。

gains.t:
n. 收益；涨幅
v. 获得（第三人称单数）

e.en: He reported significant {gains} in muscle strength after training.
e.zh: 训练之后他的肌肉力量有了显著提升。

e.en: The fund's recent {gains} surprised even the analysts.
e.zh: 该基金近期的收益连分析师都感到意外。

gainsay.t: v. 否认；反驳（多用于否定句）

e.en: No one can {gainsay} the impact of the new policy.
e.zh: 没人能否认这项新政策的影响。

e.en: It's hard to {gainsay} the data she presented.
e.zh: 很难反驳她展示的数据。

gainsborough.t: n. 庚斯博罗（英国画家/地名）

e.en: The museum acquired a rare {Gainsborough} portrait last year.
e.zh: 博物馆去年收藏了一幅罕见的庚斯博罗肖像画。

e.en: She wore a wide-brimmed {Gainsborough} hat to the wedding.
e.zh: 她戴了一顶宽边的庚斯博罗式帽子去参加婚礼。

e.en: The doctor noticed an unsteady {gait} during the exam.
e.zh: 医生在检查时注意到他步态不稳。

e.en: You can recognize him from a distance by his {gait}.
e.zh: 从远处看他的走路姿势就能认出他。

e.en: He pulled a {gaiter} over his neck before skiing.
e.zh: 滑雪前他把脖套拉到脖子上。

e.en: Hikers wear a {gaiter} to keep snow out of their boots.
e.zh: 徒步者戴绑腿防止雪进入靴子。

gaa.t: n. 盖尔运动协会（Gaelic Athletic Association）

e.en: The {GAA} promotes Gaelic football and hurling across Ireland.
e.zh: 盖尔运动协会在全爱尔兰推广盖尔足球和板棍球。

e.en: He's been a {GAA} club member since he was a child.
e.zh: 他从小就是盖尔运动协会俱乐部的会员。

gab.t:
v. 闲聊，唠叨
n. 废话

e.en: My aunts can {gab} on the phone for hours.
e.zh: 我的几位姨妈能在电话里聊上好几个小时。

e.en: He really has the gift of {gab} at parties.
e.zh: 他在派对上真是能说会道。

gabardine.t: n. 华达呢（一种斜纹布料）

e.en: He wore a classic {gabardine} trench coat in the rain.
e.zh: 他在雨中穿着一件经典的华达呢风衣。

e.en: This suit is made from lightweight {gabardine} for summer.
e.zh: 这套西装由轻薄的华达呢制成,适合夏天穿。

gabble.t:
v. 急促而含糊地说
n. 快而乱的话

e.en: The kids {gabble} excitedly about their new video game.
e.zh: 孩子们叽叽喳喳兴奋地谈论着新电子游戏。

e.en: I couldn't follow the rapid {gabble} of the auctioneer.
e.zh: 我跟不上拍卖师那连珠炮似的快语。

e.en: My neighbor is so {gabby} I can never leave quickly.
e.zh: 我邻居话特别多,我从来都没法快点脱身。

e.en: He gets {gabby} after one or two glasses of wine.
e.zh: 他喝上一两杯酒就变得话多起来。

gaberdine.t: n. 华达呢；长罩衣（gabardine 的异体）

e.en: The detective wore a worn {gaberdine} coat in every scene.
e.zh: 那位侦探每一幕都穿着一件破旧的华达呢大衣。

e.en: Her vintage {gaberdine} jacket still looks elegant today.
e.zh: 她那件复古的华达呢外套至今依然优雅。

e.en: She's a smart {gal} who runs her own studio.
e.zh: 她是个聪明的姑娘,经营着自己的工作室。

e.en: The new {gal} in marketing has great ideas.
e.zh: 市场部新来的那位姑娘点子很棒。

gala.t:
n. 庆典；盛会
adj. 节日的

e.en: The charity {gala} raised over a million dollars.
e.zh: 这场慈善晚会筹集了超过一百万美元。

e.en: She wore a long red dress to the {gala}.
e.zh: 她穿了一条红色长裙参加晚宴。

e.en: Astronomers mapped the {galactic} center in unprecedented detail.
e.zh: 天文学家以前所未有的细节绘制了银河系中心。

e.en: The movie's {galactic} battles look stunning in 4K.
e.zh: 这部电影的星际战斗场面在 4K 下令人惊艳。

galactosemia.t: n. 半乳糖血症（遗传病）

e.en: Babies are screened for {galactosemia} shortly after birth.
e.zh: 婴儿出生后不久就要筛查半乳糖血症。

e.en: Children with {galactosemia} must avoid milk products.
e.zh: 患有半乳糖血症的儿童必须避免食用奶制品。

galahad.t: n. 加拉哈德（亚瑟王圆桌骑士）

e.en: Sir {Galahad} was known as the purest of King Arthur's knights.
e.zh: 加拉哈德爵士被誉为亚瑟王骑士中最纯洁的一位。

e.en: He plays the rescuer like some modern-day {Galahad}.
e.zh: 他像个现代版的加拉哈德一样扮演救人的角色。

e.en: The giant {galapago} can live for over a hundred years.
e.zh: 这种巨型加拉帕戈斯陆龟可以活一百多年。

e.en: Researchers tagged each {galapago} for long-term tracking.
e.zh: 研究人员给每只加拉帕戈斯陆龟做了标记以长期追踪。

e.en: Darwin developed his ideas after visiting the {Galapagos} Islands.
e.zh: 达尔文在造访加拉帕戈斯群岛后形成了他的理论。

e.en: We saw blue-footed boobies all over the {Galapagos}.
e.zh: 我们在加拉帕戈斯群岛到处都看到了蓝脚鲣鸟。

galatian.t:
n. 加拉太人
adj. 加拉太的

e.en: Paul wrote a famous letter to the {Galatian} church.
e.zh: 保罗写了一封著名的书信给加拉太教会。

e.en: The pastor preached on a passage from {Galatian} chapter five.
e.zh: 牧师讲了《加拉太书》第五章的一段经文。

galaxy.t:
n. 星系；银河
n. 一群杰出人物

e.en: Our solar system sits in the Milky Way {galaxy}.
e.zh: 我们的太阳系位于银河系之中。

e.en: She bought the latest Samsung {Galaxy} phone yesterday.
e.zh: 她昨天买了最新款的三星 Galaxy 手机。

gale.t:
n. 大风；强风
n. 一阵（笑声等）

e.en: A strong {gale} knocked down trees across the city.
e.zh: 一阵强风把全城的树木都吹倒了。

e.en: His joke set off a {gale} of laughter at dinner.
e.zh: 他的笑话在晚餐桌上引发了一阵大笑。

e.en: Miners extracted lead from {galena} for centuries.
e.zh: 几个世纪以来矿工都从方铅矿中提取铅。

e.en: The shiny gray crystal turned out to be {galena}.
e.zh: 那块闪亮的灰色晶体原来是方铅矿。

e.en: The {galerie} on Rue de Seine is showing new abstract works.
e.zh: 塞纳街上的那家画廊正在展出新的抽象作品。

e.en: We stopped by a small {galerie} in the old quarter.
e.zh: 我们顺路去了老城区的一家小画廊。

e.en: The coast was battered by autumn {gales} all week.
e.zh: 整周海岸都遭到秋季大风的猛烈袭击。

e.en: His stories sent the audience into {gales} of laughter.
e.zh: 他的故事让观众笑得前仰后合。

e.en: She baked a rustic apple {galette} for dessert.
e.zh: 她烤了一个朴实风味的苹果薄饼作甜点。

e.en: This café serves a savory mushroom {galette} for lunch.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆午餐供应咸味蘑菇薄饼。

e.en: {Galicia} is a green region in northwestern Spain.
e.zh: 加利西亚是西班牙西北部的一片绿色地区。

e.en: We tasted octopus dishes during our trip to {Galicia}.
e.zh: 我们在加利西亚旅行时品尝了章鱼料理。

galilean.t:
adj. 伽利略的
n. 加利利人

e.en: Jupiter has four large {Galilean} moons visible with binoculars.
e.zh: 木星有四颗大型伽利略卫星，用双筒望远镜就能看到。

e.en: The textbook explains {Galilean} relativity before introducing Einstein.
e.zh: 教科书在介绍爱因斯坦之前先讲伽利略相对性原理。

e.en: The Sea of {Galilee} is actually a freshwater lake.
e.zh: 加利利海其实是一个淡水湖。

e.en: Tourists hike the trails around {Galilee} every spring.
e.zh: 游客每年春天都会在加利利地区徒步。

e.en: {Galileo} improved the telescope and observed Jupiter's moons.
e.zh: 伽利略改进了望远镜，并观测到了木星的卫星。

e.en: Europe's {Galileo} satellite system rivals American GPS.
e.zh: 欧洲的伽利略卫星系统可与美国的GPS相媲美。

gall.t:
n. 胆汁；厚颜
v. 激怒

e.en: He had the {gall} to ask for a refund.
e.zh: 他居然厚颜无耻地要求退款。

e.en: Her constant complaining began to {gall} the whole team.
e.zh: 她不停的抱怨开始让整个团队感到恼火。

e.en: The {gallant} firefighter rushed back into the burning house.
e.zh: 那位英勇的消防员冲回燃烧的房子里。

e.en: He made a {gallant} attempt to finish the marathon.
e.zh: 他英勇地尝试完成那场马拉松。

e.en: She {gallantly} offered her seat to the elderly man.
e.zh: 她大方地把座位让给了那位老先生。

e.en: The soldiers fought {gallantly} despite being outnumbered.
e.zh: 士兵们尽管寡不敌众，仍英勇作战。

gallantry.t: n. 英勇；对女士的殷勤

e.en: He received a medal for his {gallantry} in battle.
e.zh: 他因在战斗中的英勇表现获得了一枚勋章。

e.en: Old-fashioned {gallantry} still impresses many people today.
e.zh: 老派的绅士风度至今仍打动许多人。

e.en: The doctor recommended removing his inflamed {gallbladder}.
e.zh: 医生建议切除他发炎的胆囊。

e.en: A healthy {gallbladder} stores bile produced by the liver.
e.zh: 健康的胆囊会储存肝脏产生的胆汁。

galle.t: n. 加勒（斯里兰卡城市）

e.en: The Dutch fort at {Galle} is a UNESCO heritage site.
e.zh: 加勒的荷兰古堡是联合国教科文组织的遗产地。

e.en: We watched the sunset from the ramparts of {Galle}.
e.zh: 我们从加勒的城墙上看了日落。

e.en: A Spanish {galleon} sank carrying gold from the colonies.
e.zh: 一艘西班牙大帆船沉没了，船上载着殖民地运来的黄金。

e.en: The museum displays a model of an old {galleon}.
e.zh: 博物馆里展示着一艘古老大帆船的模型。

e.en: We met for coffee inside the bright shopping {galleria}.
e.zh: 我们约在那座明亮的购物长廊里喝咖啡。

e.en: Milan's famous {galleria} is filled with luxury boutiques.
e.zh: 米兰著名的拱廊街里满是奢侈品店。

galleried.t: adj. 带回廊的；有画廊的

e.en: The {galleried} courtyard of the old inn looks charming.
e.zh: 那家老客栈带回廊的庭院看起来很迷人。

e.en: Tourists admired the {galleried} hall of the manor house.
e.zh: 游客们欣赏着那座庄园带回廊的大厅。

e.en: The city has dozens of small art {galleries} downtown.
e.zh: 市中心有几十家小型艺术画廊。

e.en: Online {galleries} let artists reach buyers around the world.
e.zh: 线上画廊让艺术家可以接触到全世界的买家。

gallery.t:
n. 画廊；美术馆
n. 楼座；走廊

e.en: I scrolled through the photo {gallery} on my phone.
e.zh: 我在手机里翻看了一下相册。

e.en: The new art {gallery} opens downtown next Friday.
e.zh: 新的美术馆下周五在市中心开张。

galley.t:
n. 船上厨房
n. 古代划桨船

e.en: The chef prepared dinner in the boat's tiny {galley}.
e.zh: 厨师在船上狭小的厨房里准备了晚餐。

e.en: Ancient Roman warriors rowed a {galley} into battle.
e.zh: 古罗马战士划着桨帆船投入战斗。

e.en: The bartender added a splash of {Galliano} to the cocktail.
e.zh: 调酒师在鸡尾酒里加了一点加利亚诺香甜酒。

e.en: Italian liqueur {Galliano} has a bright yellow color.
e.zh: 意大利的加利亚诺香甜酒呈鲜亮的黄色。

e.en: He shrugged with a typically {Gallic} indifference.
e.zh: 他耸了耸肩，带着典型的法式漠然。

e.en: The film captured a uniquely {Gallic} sense of humor.
e.zh: 这部电影捕捉到了一种独特的法式幽默。

e.en: It was {galling} to lose after working so hard.
e.zh: 努力了那么久还输掉，真让人窝火。

e.en: Her smug attitude was particularly {galling} to colleagues.
e.zh: 她那副自鸣得意的样子让同事们尤其反感。

e.en: The {Gallipoli} campaign cost thousands of Allied lives.
e.zh: 加里波利战役让协约国伤亡数千人。

e.en: Many Australians visit {Gallipoli} on Anzac Day.
e.zh: 许多澳大利亚人在澳新军团日前往加里波利。

e.en: {Gallium} melts in your hand because of its low melting point.
e.zh: 镓的熔点很低，放在手里就会融化。

e.en: Engineers use {gallium} arsenide in high-speed electronics.
e.zh: 工程师在高速电子器件中使用砷化镓。

e.en: They {gallivant} around Europe whenever they can afford it.
e.zh: 他们一有钱就跑到欧洲到处闲逛。

e.en: Stop trying to {gallivant} and finish your homework first.
e.zh: 别想着出去玩了，先把作业写完。

e.en: A {gallon} of milk costs almost five dollars now.
e.zh: 现在一加仑牛奶要将近五美元。

e.en: The car burns about a {gallon} every thirty miles.
e.zh: 这辆车大约每三十英里耗一加仑油。

e.en: The leaking pipe wasted hundreds of {gallons} overnight.
e.zh: 漏水的管子一夜之间浪费了好几百加仑水。

e.en: They drank {gallons} of iced tea during the heatwave.
e.zh: 热浪期间他们喝了一加仑又一加仑的冰茶。

gallop.t:
v. 疾驰；飞奔
n. 飞奔

e.en: The horses began to {gallop} across the open field.
e.zh: 马群开始在开阔的田野上飞驰起来。

e.en: He set off at a full {gallop} toward the gate.
e.zh: 他全速疾驰着朝大门奔去。

e.en: We heard hooves {galloping} down the dusty road.
e.zh: 我们听到马蹄声沿着尘土飞扬的路飞奔而来。

e.en: The country faces {galloping} inflation this year.
e.zh: 该国今年面临着飞速攀升的通货膨胀。

e.en: {Galloway} cattle are known for their shaggy black coats.
e.zh: 加洛韦牛以蓬松的黑色毛皮闻名。

e.en: We rented a cottage in {Galloway} for the weekend.
e.zh: 我们在加洛韦租了一间小屋过周末。

e.en: Doctors are known for their dark, {gallows} humor.
e.zh: 医生们以阴森的黑色幽默著称。

e.en: The condemned man walked steadily toward the {gallows}.
e.zh: 那名死刑犯稳步走向绞刑架。

galls.t:
v. 激怒
n. 虫瘿；胆汁

e.en: It {galls} me that he never says thank you.
e.zh: 他从来不说一声谢谢，真让我气不打一处来。

e.en: Oak {galls} were once used to make black ink.
e.zh: 橡树虫瘿曾被用来制作黑色墨水。

e.en: A small {gallstone} was causing his sharp abdominal pain.
e.zh: 一颗小胆结石引起了他剧烈的腹痛。

e.en: Surgery removed the {gallstone} and her symptoms vanished.
e.zh: 手术取出了胆结石，她的症状随之消失。

e.en: A {Gallup} poll showed support for the bill rising.
e.zh: 盖洛普民调显示对该法案的支持率正在上升。

e.en: We drove through {Gallup}, New Mexico, on Route 66.
e.zh: 我们沿66号公路开车经过新墨西哥州的盖洛普。

galore.t: adj. 大量的，丰富的（后置）

e.en: The buffet had desserts {galore} for the guests.
e.zh: 自助餐里为客人准备了大量的甜点。

e.en: This neighborhood has cafes {galore} on every corner.
e.zh: 这个街区每个街角都有许多咖啡馆。

e.en: He pulled on a single {galosh} over his shoe.
e.zh: 他在鞋外套上了一只胶鞋套。

e.en: A muddy {galosh} sat by the front door drying.
e.zh: 一只沾满泥的雨鞋套放在前门边晾着。

e.en: The puppies {galumph} clumsily across the slippery floor.
e.zh: 小狗们笨拙地在滑溜溜的地板上欢蹦着跑。

e.en: Watch the toddler {galumph} happily through the puddles.
e.zh: 看那个小孩开心地踩着水坑笨拙地跑过去。

galvanic.t:
adj. 电流的
adj. 令人震惊的

e.en: Her speech had a {galvanic} effect on the audience.
e.zh: 她的演讲对观众产生了激励性的震撼效果。

e.en: Scientists measured a small {galvanic} current in the wire.
e.zh: 科学家在电线中测到了一股微弱的原电池电流。

galvanise.t:
v. 激励，刺激
v. 镀锌

e.en: The scandal helped {galvanise} voters to demand reform.
e.zh: 那起丑闻促使选民积极要求改革。

e.en: Coaches try to {galvanise} the team before the final.
e.zh: 教练们试图在决赛前激励整支球队。

e.en: The tragedy {galvanised} the community into immediate action.
e.zh: 那场悲剧促使整个社区立即行动起来。

e.en: They installed a {galvanised} steel fence around the yard.
e.zh: 他们在院子周围安装了一圈镀锌钢围栏。

e.en: {Galvanization} protects the steel from rust for decades.
e.zh: 镀锌处理能让钢材几十年不生锈。

e.en: His speech caused a {galvanization} of public opinion.
e.zh: 他的演讲激起了公众舆论的强烈反响。

galvanize.t:
v. 激励，使振奋
v. 镀锌

e.en: The viral video helped {galvanize} support for the cause.
e.zh: 那段疯传的视频激发了人们对此事业的支持。

e.en: Factories {galvanize} steel to prevent it from rusting.
e.zh: 工厂会给钢材镀锌以防止生锈。

e.en: His resignation {galvanized} the rest of the staff.
e.zh: 他的辞职震动并激励了其他员工。

e.en: The roof is covered with {galvanized} metal sheets.
e.zh: 屋顶覆盖着一层镀锌金属板。

galvanizing.t: adj. 激励的，令人振奋的

e.en: Her speech was a {galvanizing} moment for the movement.
e.zh: 她的演讲对这场运动来说是一个鼓舞人心的时刻。

e.en: The factory specializes in {galvanizing} large steel beams.
e.zh: 这家工厂专门为大型钢梁做镀锌处理。

galway.t: n. 戈尔韦（爱尔兰城市）

e.en: {Galway} hosts a famous oyster festival every September.
e.zh: 高威每年九月都会举办著名的牡蛎节。

e.en: We listened to live music in a {Galway} pub.
e.zh: 我们在高威的一家酒吧听了现场音乐。

e.en: Old whaling crews would {gam} when their ships met at sea.
e.zh: 过去捕鲸船在海上相遇时，船员们会停下来叙旧。

e.en: A pod of dolphins, sometimes called a {gam}, swam alongside.
e.zh: 一群海豚（有时也称作gam）在船边游动。

e.en: {Gambia} is the smallest country on the African mainland.
e.zh: 冈比亚是非洲大陆面积最小的国家。

e.en: Tourists visit {Gambia} for its beaches and birdwatching.
e.zh: 游客们到冈比亚是为了海滩和观鸟。

gambian.t:
adj. 冈比亚的
n. 冈比亚人

e.en: The {Gambian} chef prepared a spicy peanut stew for us.
e.zh: 那位冈比亚厨师为我们做了一道香辣花生炖菜。

e.en: She has been studying {Gambian} folk music for years.
e.zh: 她研究冈比亚民间音乐已经好多年了。

e.en: His opening {gambit} in the negotiation surprised everyone.
e.zh: 他在谈判中的开场策略让所有人都感到意外。

e.en: The chess player tried a risky {gambit} to win.
e.zh: 那位棋手尝试了一招冒险的开局弃子来求胜。

e.en: Salespeople use various {gambits} to keep customers talking.
e.zh: 销售员会使用各种话术让顾客继续交谈。

e.en: Chess books list dozens of well-known opening {gambits}.
e.zh: 国际象棋书里列出了几十种著名的开局弃兵法。

gamble.t:
v. 赌博；冒险
n. 冒险之举

e.en: Quitting his job to travel was a big {gamble}.
e.zh: 辞掉工作去旅行是一次很大的冒险。

e.en: I never {gamble} more than I can afford to lose.
e.zh: 我赌钱从不超过自己能承受的损失。

e.en: The professional {gambler} kept a notebook of card patterns.
e.zh: 那位职业赌徒用笔记本记录牌型规律。

e.en: As an investor, she's more analyst than {gambler}.
e.zh: 作为投资人，她更像分析师而不是赌徒。

gambling.t:
n. 赌博
v. 赌博（现在分词）

e.en: Online {gambling} apps are now banned in several states.
e.zh: 线上博彩软件如今在好几个州被禁用。

e.en: He's {gambling} that the stock will recover next month.
e.zh: 他在赌这只股票下个月能反弹。

gamblings.t: n. 赌博行为（复数，罕用）

e.en: His late-night {gamblings} cost the family their savings.
e.zh: 他深夜的赌博让全家失去了积蓄。

e.en: Her risky {gamblings} on startups occasionally paid off big.
e.zh: 她在初创公司上的冒险投资偶尔能大赚一笔。

e.en: The artist mixed {gamboge} into her watercolor palette.
e.zh: 画家把藤黄调入她的水彩颜料中。

e.en: Monks' robes are often dyed a deep {gamboge} yellow.
e.zh: 僧侣的袍子常被染成深藤黄色。

e.en: Lambs {gambol} across the spring meadow at dawn.
e.zh: 羊羔在黎明的春日草地上欢快地跳跃。

e.en: Children {gambol} happily on the beach all afternoon.
e.zh: 孩子们整个下午都在沙滩上嬉戏玩耍。

game.t:
n. 游戏，比赛
adj. 愿意尝试的

e.en: We played a quick {game} of chess after dinner.
e.zh: 我们晚饭后下了一盘快棋。

e.en: She's always {game} for trying new restaurants downtown.
e.zh: 她总是乐意尝试市中心的新餐厅。

e.en: He still owns the original {gameboy} from his childhood.
e.zh: 他至今还保留着童年时的初代 Game Boy。

e.en: Pokemon Red on {gameboy} defined a whole generation.
e.zh: Game Boy 上的《宝可梦红》定义了整整一代人。

e.en: The breeder raised a prized {gamecock} for the fair.
e.zh: 养殖户为集市养了一只名贵的斗鸡。

e.en: Cockfighting with a {gamecock} is illegal in most countries.
e.zh: 用斗鸡进行斗鸡比赛在多数国家都是违法的。

e.en: The {gamekeeper} patrolled the estate looking for poachers.
e.zh: 猎场看守人在庄园里巡逻,寻找偷猎者。

e.en: A retired {gamekeeper} taught us how to track deer.
e.zh: 一位退休的猎场看守教我们如何追踪鹿。

gamelan.t: n. 加美兰（印尼传统乐队）

e.en: The {gamelan} ensemble performed traditional Balinese music last night.
e.zh: 昨晚甘美兰乐团演奏了传统的巴厘岛音乐。

e.en: She studied {gamelan} percussion during her year in Java.
e.zh: 她在爪哇的那一年学习了甘美兰打击乐。

e.en: He {gamely} attempted the karaoke song despite his cold.
e.zh: 尽管感冒了,他还是勇敢地尝试唱卡拉OK。

e.en: She {gamely} finished the marathon with a sprained ankle.
e.zh: 她带着扭伤的脚踝顽强地跑完了马拉松。

e.en: The new update vastly improved the {gameplay} balance.
e.zh: 新版本大幅改善了游戏的平衡性。

e.en: Reviewers praised the smooth {gameplay} and stunning graphics.
e.zh: 评测者称赞了流畅的游戏体验和惊艳的画面。

e.en: My brother is a hardcore {gamer} who streams nightly.
e.zh: 我哥是个硬核玩家,每晚都直播。

e.en: Pro {gamer} salaries can rival those of traditional athletes.
e.zh: 职业电竞选手的薪资可以媲美传统运动员。

e.en: Mobile {games} dominate the entertainment market these days.
e.zh: 如今手机游戏主导着娱乐市场。

e.en: The Olympic {games} bring athletes from around the world.
e.zh: 奥运会汇聚了来自世界各地的运动员。

gamesmanship.t: n. 为胜利耍手段的本事

e.en: His clever {gamesmanship} unsettled the opponent before serving.
e.zh: 他高明的心理战术在发球前让对手心神不宁。

e.en: Negotiators sometimes resort to {gamesmanship} to gain leverage.
e.zh: 谈判者有时会耍手段来争取筹码。

e.en: A sperm cell is the male {gamete} in humans.
e.zh: 精子是人类的雄性配子。

e.en: Each {gamete} carries half the parent's genetic material.
e.zh: 每个配子携带亲代一半的遗传物质。

e.en: In ferns, the {gametophyte} stage is small and independent.
e.zh: 在蕨类植物中,配子体阶段是细小且独立生长的。

e.en: Mosses spend most of their life as a {gametophyte}.
e.zh: 苔藓的一生大部分时间都以配子体形态存在。

gamine.t: n. 俏皮的假小子女孩

e.en: Audrey Hepburn perfected the {gamine} look with cropped hair.
e.zh: 奥黛丽·赫本以短发完美演绎了俏皮少女风。

e.en: The model had a charming {gamine} quality on camera.
e.zh: 那位模特在镜头前散发着迷人的俏皮男孩子气质。

e.en: My nephew built a {gaming} PC over the weekend.
e.zh: 我侄子周末攒了一台游戏电脑。

e.en: The {gaming} industry now earns more than Hollywood does.
e.zh: 游戏产业的收入如今已超过好莱坞。

gamings.t: n. 游戏活动（复数，罕用）

e.en: Various {gamings} of the system led to new regulations.
e.zh: 对系统的各种钻空子行为催生了新的监管规定。

e.en: Their late-night {gamings} kept the dorm awake every weekend.
e.zh: 他们深夜的电玩活动每个周末都吵得宿舍睡不着。

gamma.t: n. 希腊字母 γ；伽马（射线）

e.en: The detector picked up unusual {gamma} radiation from space.
e.zh: 探测器捕捉到了来自太空的异常伽马辐射。

e.en: Adjust the monitor's {gamma} setting for accurate color reproduction.
e.zh: 调整显示器的伽马值以获得准确的色彩还原。

e.en: Mom served roasted {gammon} with pineapple for Christmas dinner.
e.zh: 妈妈为圣诞晚餐做了菠萝烤火腿。

e.en: He won the backgammon match by scoring a {gammon}.
e.zh: 他通过得到一个加倍胜赢下了西洋双陆棋比赛。

e.en: Her emotions ran the {gamut} from joy to despair.
e.zh: 她的情感经历了从喜悦到绝望的全部范围。

e.en: The menu covers a wide {gamut} of Asian cuisines.
e.zh: 菜单涵盖了各种亚洲美食。

ganache.t: n. 甘纳许（巧克力奶油酱）

e.en: She poured warm chocolate {ganache} over the layer cake.
e.zh: 她把温热的巧克力甘纳许浇在夹层蛋糕上。

e.en: This bakery's truffles are filled with raspberry {ganache}.
e.zh: 这家烘焙店的松露巧克力夹有覆盆子甘纳许。

e.en: In the films, {gandalf} guides the fellowship through Moria.
e.zh: 在电影中,甘道夫带领远征队穿过摩瑞亚。

e.en: The kid dressed as {gandalf} for Halloween last year.
e.zh: 那孩子去年万圣节扮成了甘道夫。

gander.t:
n. 公鹅
n. 一瞥

e.en: Take a {gander} at this hilarious meme my friend sent.
e.zh: 瞧瞧我朋友发来的这张搞笑表情包。

e.en: The {gander} hissed loudly when we approached the pond.
e.zh: 我们走近池塘时,那只公鹅大声嘶叫起来。

e.en: The protesters embraced a {gandhian} approach of nonviolent resistance.
e.zh: 抗议者采取了甘地式的非暴力抵抗方式。

e.en: Her {gandhian} principles guided every campaign she led.
e.zh: 她的甘地式信念指导着她领导的每一场运动。

gardenings.t: n. 园艺活动（gardening 的复数，罕用）

e.en: Her weekend {gardenings} keep her happy and active.
e.zh: 她周末做的那些园艺活让她开心又有活力。

e.en: Frequent {gardenings} have transformed the small yard.
e.zh: 频繁的园艺打理让这个小院子焕然一新。

e.en: The botanical {gardens} are free to visit on Sundays.
e.zh: 植物园周日免费对外开放。

e.en: Many neighbors maintain beautiful flower {gardens} out front.
e.zh: 许多邻居在屋前打理着漂亮的花园。

e.en: We met at the {gare} before catching our train.
e.zh: 我们在火车站碰面,然后去赶火车。

e.en: The {gare} in Lyon is huge and very busy.
e.zh: 里昂的火车站非常大,人也很多。

e.en: My daughter loves the lazy orange cat {Garfield}.
e.zh: 我女儿很喜欢那只懒洋洋的橘猫加菲。

e.en: President {Garfield} was assassinated only months into his term.
e.zh: 加菲尔德总统在上任仅几个月后就遇刺身亡。

e.en: The startup faces a {gargantuan} task to catch up.
e.zh: 这家创业公司面临着追赶上去的艰巨任务。

e.en: He ordered a {gargantuan} burger with three patties.
e.zh: 他点了一个夹三层肉饼的超大汉堡。

gargle.t:
v. 漱口
n. 漱口液

e.en: Doctors suggest you {gargle} with salt water for sore throats.
e.zh: 医生建议嗓子疼时用盐水漱口。

e.en: Remember to {gargle} after brushing your teeth tonight.
e.zh: 今晚刷完牙后记得漱口。

gargoyle.t: n. (建筑上的) 滴水兽石像

e.en: A stone {gargoyle} stares down from the cathedral roof.
e.zh: 一只石雕滴水兽从大教堂屋顶上俯视下来。

e.en: The old building has a creepy {gargoyle} above the door.
e.zh: 那栋老建筑的门上方有一只阴森的滴水兽。

e.en: She bought a packet of {garibaldi} biscuits with her tea.
e.zh: 她买了一包葡萄干夹心饼配茶喝。

e.en: The square is named after the famous general {Garibaldi}.
e.zh: 这座广场以著名将军加里波第的名字命名。

e.en: The hotel lobby had a {garish} purple carpet.
e.zh: 那家酒店大堂铺着一块俗艳的紫色地毯。

e.en: He wore a {garish} shirt covered in neon flowers.
e.zh: 他穿了一件印满霓虹花朵的花哨衬衫。

e.en: The store was {garishly} decorated for the holiday sale.
e.zh: 那家店为节日促销装饰得花里胡哨。

e.en: She painted her nails {garishly} bright orange.
e.zh: 她把指甲涂成了刺眼的亮橙色。

e.en: They hung a flower {garland} above the front door.
e.zh: 他们在前门上方挂了一串鲜花花环。

e.en: The winner received a gold medal and a {garland}.
e.zh: 获胜者得到了一枚金牌和一个花环。

garlanded.t:
adj. 戴着花环的
v. 给…戴花环

e.en: The temple was {garlanded} with marigolds for the festival.
e.zh: 寺庙为节日挂满了万寿菊编成的花环。

e.en: Athletes were {garlanded} with flowers after winning gold.
e.zh: 运动员夺金后被戴上了鲜花花环。

e.en: Add some chopped {garlic} to the pasta sauce.
e.zh: 在意面酱里加点切碎的大蒜。

e.en: This bread tastes amazing with butter and {garlic}.
e.zh: 这种面包配黄油和大蒜超级好吃。

e.en: The shrimp had a strong {garlicky} flavor I loved.
e.zh: 那虾有股我很喜欢的浓郁蒜香味。

e.en: Her breath smelled {garlicky} after the Italian dinner.
e.zh: 吃完那顿意餐后,她嘴里有股蒜味。

e.en: This {garment} should be washed in cold water only.
e.zh: 这件衣服只能用冷水洗。

e.en: She designed a beautiful silk {garment} for the show.
e.zh: 她为这场秀设计了一件漂亮的丝绸礼服。

e.en: All {garments} on this rack are fifty percent off.
e.zh: 这一架上的所有衣服都打五折。

e.en: The factory produces {garments} for several major brands.
e.zh: 这家工厂为几个大牌生产服装。

garner.t: v. 获得、赢得（支持、关注等）

e.en: His new song quickly {garnered} millions of views online.
e.zh: 他的新歌很快在网上获得了数百万播放量。

e.en: The startup hopes to {garner} support from major investors.
e.zh: 这家创业公司希望获得主要投资人的支持。

e.en: She wore a deep red {garnet} ring on her finger.
e.zh: 她手指上戴着一枚深红色的石榴石戒指。

e.en: January's birthstone is the dark red {garnet}.
e.zh: 一月份的诞生石是深红色的石榴石。

garnish.t:
n. 配菜、装饰菜
v. 加装饰菜

e.en: The chef likes to {garnish} the soup with fresh parsley.
e.zh: 那位厨师喜欢用新鲜欧芹给汤做装饰。

e.en: A slice of lemon makes a nice {garnish} for fish.
e.zh: 一片柠檬给鱼做装饰非常好看。

e.en: The cocktail was {garnished} with a thin orange peel.
e.zh: 那杯鸡尾酒用一片薄橙皮做了装饰。

e.en: His wages were {garnished} to repay the unpaid loan.
e.zh: 他的工资被扣发以偿还未付的贷款。

garnishment.t: n. (法律) 工资扣押、第三人债务执行

e.en: The court ordered a wage {garnishment} for child support.
e.zh: 法院下令扣发工资以支付抚养费。

e.en: He received a notice of {garnishment} from his employer.
e.zh: 他收到了雇主发来的工资扣押通知。

e.en: The {Garonne} river flows through the city of Bordeaux.
e.zh: 加龙河从波尔多市穿城而过。

e.en: We took a boat ride along the calm {Garonne}.
e.zh: 我们沿着平静的加龙河乘船游览了一番。

e.en: The poet lived in a tiny {garret} above the bakery.
e.zh: 那位诗人住在面包店楼上一间狭小的阁楼里。

e.en: She converted the dusty {garret} into a cozy studio.
e.zh: 她把那间满是灰尘的阁楼改造成了温馨的工作室。

garrison.t:
n. 驻军、卫戍部队
v. 派兵驻守

e.en: A small {garrison} guarded the border town day and night.
e.zh: 一支小型驻军日夜守卫着这座边境小镇。

e.en: Troops were sent to {garrison} the mountain fortress.
e.zh: 部队被派去驻守那座山上的要塞。

garrote.t:
v. 用绳索勒死
n. 绞索

e.en: The villain tried to {garrote} the hero with a wire.
e.zh: 反派试图用钢丝勒死主角。

e.en: Police found a {garrote} hidden inside the suspect's bag.
e.zh: 警方在嫌疑人包里发现了一根藏起来的绞索。

e.en: His {garrulity} at meetings annoys most of his coworkers.
e.zh: 他在会上的喋喋不休让大多数同事都很烦。

e.en: The old man's {garrulity} made the bus ride feel longer.
e.zh: 那位老人的絮叨让坐公交的时间显得更长了。

e.en: My {garrulous} neighbor talks for hours about her cats.
e.zh: 我那位话痨邻居能就她的猫聊上好几个小时。

e.en: The {garrulous} taxi driver shared every detail of his life.
e.zh: 那位话多的出租车司机把自己的人生事无巨细全说了一遍。

e.en: She wore a lace {garter} under her wedding dress.
e.zh: 她在婚纱下穿了一条蕾丝吊袜带。

e.en: The old man used a {garter} to hold up his socks.
e.zh: 那位老人用吊袜带把袜子固定住。

gas.t:
n. 气体；汽油（美）
v. 加油

e.en: I need to stop for {gas} before the highway.
e.zh: 上高速前我得先去加点油。

e.en: Natural {gas} prices have risen sharply this winter.
e.zh: 今年冬天天然气价格大幅上涨。

e.en: That politician is a total {gasbag} who never says anything useful.
e.zh: 那个政客就是个废话连篇的家伙,从不说点有用的。

e.en: The airship's {gasbag} was filled with helium for safety.
e.zh: 飞艇的气囊里充的是氦气以确保安全。

gascon.t:
n. 加斯科涅人
adj. 加斯科涅的

e.en: D'Artagnan was a proud young {Gascon} from southwestern France.
e.zh: 达达尼昂是来自法国西南部的一位骄傲的加斯科涅青年。

e.en: Her grandfather spoke with a thick {Gascon} accent.
e.zh: 她祖父说话带着浓重的加斯科涅口音。

gascony.t: n. 加斯科涅（法国地区）

e.en: We spent a week touring vineyards in {Gascony}.
e.zh: 我们花了一周时间游览加斯科涅的葡萄园。

e.en: {Gascony} is famous for its Armagnac brandy and duck dishes.
e.zh: 加斯科涅以其雅文邑白兰地和鸭肉料理闻名。

e.en: Water turns into a {gaseous} state when it boils.
e.zh: 水沸腾时会变成气态。

e.en: The planet is mostly composed of {gaseous} hydrogen and helium.
e.zh: 这颗行星主要由气态氢和氦构成。

gang.t:
n. 帮派；团伙
v. 成群结伙

e.en: The whole {gang} is meeting at the bar tonight.
e.zh: 今晚一帮人都要在酒吧聚一聚。

e.en: Police arrested the {gang} responsible for the warehouse robberies.
e.zh: 警方逮捕了对仓库抢劫案负责的犯罪团伙。

gangbanger.t: n. 帮派成员（尤指美国街头黑帮）

e.en: The documentary interviewed a former {gangbanger} now mentoring kids.
e.zh: 纪录片采访了一位如今在辅导孩子的前帮派成员。

e.en: He grew up surrounded by {gangbanger} culture in the neighborhood.
e.zh: 他在街区里被帮派文化包围着长大。

gangbuster.t: n. 专打黑帮的警察；(形容)极为成功的

e.en: The startup's sales are going {gangbuster} this quarter.
e.zh: 这家初创公司本季度的销售火爆得不得了。

e.en: The new album opened to {gangbuster} reviews and streams.
e.zh: 新专辑一上线就收获了爆棚的好评和播放量。

e.en: Pilgrims bathe in the {ganges} during the holy festival.
e.zh: 朝圣者在圣节期间在恒河中沐浴。

e.en: The {ganges} flows over two thousand kilometers across India.
e.zh: 恒河流经印度,全长超过两千公里。

e.en: The film depicts {gangland} violence in 1930s Chicago.
e.zh: 这部电影描绘了1930年代芝加哥的黑帮暴力。

e.en: Police suspect the killing was a {gangland} execution.
e.zh: 警方怀疑这起命案是帮派的处决行动。

gangling.t: adj. 又高又瘦且笨拙的

e.en: The {gangling} teenager tripped over his own long legs.
e.zh: 那个瘦长的少年被自己的长腿绊了一跤。

e.en: A {gangling} basketball recruit walked onto the court.
e.zh: 一位瘦高的篮球新人走上了球场。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed a small {ganglion} cyst on her wrist.
e.zh: 医生诊断她的手腕上有个小腱鞘囊肿。

e.en: Each nerve {ganglion} acts as a relay for signals.
e.zh: 每个神经节都像是信号传递的中继站。

e.en: The {gangly} puppy hadn't grown into its huge paws yet.
e.zh: 那只瘦长的小狗还没长到能撑起它的大爪子。

e.en: He was a shy, {gangly} kid in middle school.
e.zh: 中学时他是个害羞又瘦高的孩子。

gangplank.t: n. (上下船的) 舷梯；跳板

e.en: Passengers walked the {gangplank} onto the cruise ship.
e.zh: 乘客们沿着跳板登上了游轮。

e.en: The pirate film showed prisoners forced down the {gangplank}.
e.zh: 那部海盗电影里囚犯被逼着走跳板。

e.en: Doctors amputated the toe to stop the {gangrene} spreading.
e.zh: 医生截除了脚趾以阻止坏疽蔓延。

e.en: Untreated frostbite can quickly lead to {gangrene}.
e.zh: 未经治疗的冻伤可能很快导致坏疽。

e.en: The wound had turned {gangrenous} by the time help arrived.
e.zh: 救援赶到时伤口已经坏疽化了。

e.en: Surgeons removed the {gangrenous} tissue during emergency surgery.
e.zh: 外科医生在紧急手术中切除了坏疽组织。

gangs.t: n. 帮派；团伙（gang 的复数）

e.en: Rival {gangs} clashed in the parking lot last night.
e.zh: 昨晚敌对帮派在停车场发生了冲突。

e.en: Construction {gangs} worked through the weekend to finish paving.
e.zh: 施工队整个周末都在赶工铺完路面。

gangsta.t: n. 匪帮；匪帮说唱（gangsta rap）

e.en: He listens to nineties {gangsta} rap on his commute.
e.zh: 他通勤时听九十年代的匪帮说唱。

e.en: The film references {gangsta} culture without glorifying it.
e.zh: 这部电影提及了匪帮文化,但并未美化它。

e.en: Al Capone was the most notorious {gangster} of his era.
e.zh: 阿尔·卡彭是那个时代最臭名昭著的黑帮分子。

e.en: The film follows a young {gangster} climbing the ranks.
e.zh: 这部电影讲述了一个年轻黑帮分子一路晋升的故事。

gangsterism.t: n. 黑帮作风；团伙犯罪

e.en: The mayor vowed to crack down on rampant {gangsterism}.
e.zh: 市长誓言要严厉打击猖獗的黑帮活动。

e.en: Decades of {gangsterism} have plagued the port city.
e.zh: 几十年的黑帮活动一直困扰着这座港口城市。

gangsters.t: n. 黑帮分子（gangster 的复数）

e.en: The {gangsters} ran an illegal gambling den downtown.
e.zh: 那些黑帮分子在市中心经营一家非法赌场。

e.en: Old Hollywood films often romanticized Italian-American {gangsters}.
e.zh: 旧好莱坞电影常常把意大利裔美国黑帮浪漫化。

gangway.t:
n. 过道；舷梯
int. 让开！

e.en: Crew members lowered the {gangway} as we docked.
e.zh: 我们靠岸时船员放下了舷梯。

e.en: "{Gangway}!" shouted the waiter carrying a tower of plates.
e.zh: "让一让!"端着一摞盘子的服务员喊道。

e.en: The reggae festival had a strong scent of {ganja}.
e.zh: 雷鬼音乐节上弥漫着浓浓的大麻味。

e.en: In Jamaica, {ganja} holds deep cultural and religious significance.
e.zh: 在牙买加,大麻具有深厚的文化和宗教意义。

e.en: A {gannet} dove headfirst into the waves chasing fish.
e.zh: 一只塘鹅头朝下扎进海浪中追捕鱼群。

e.en: Birdwatchers crowded the cliffs to photograph nesting {gannet} colonies.
e.zh: 观鸟者挤在悬崖上拍摄筑巢的塘鹅群。

gantlet.t: n. 夹道鞭笞的刑罚；严峻考验

e.en: New recruits had to run the {gantlet} of senior teasing.
e.zh: 新人必须经受老员工接连不断的戏弄考验。

e.en: The bill ran the {gantlet} of committee hearings before passing.
e.zh: 该法案在通过前历经了一系列委员会听证的考验。

e.en: The rocket stood beside the towering launch {gantry}.
e.zh: 火箭矗立在高耸的发射塔架旁。

e.en: A {gantry} crane lifted the shipping containers off the dock.
e.zh: 龙门吊将集装箱从码头吊起。

e.en: The Mali city of {gao} sits along the Niger River.
e.zh: 马里的加奥市坐落在尼日尔河沿岸。

e.en: Tourists once visited {gao} for its medieval Songhai history.
e.zh: 游客曾因加奥中世纪的桑海王国历史而前往参观。

gaol.t:
n. 监狱（英式拼法，等同 jail）
v. 监禁

e.en: He spent two years in {gaol} for petty theft.
e.zh: 他因盗窃罪在监狱里待了两年。

e.en: The old Victorian {gaol} is now a tourist museum.
e.zh: 那座维多利亚时代的旧监狱如今成了旅游博物馆。

gaoler.t: n. 狱卒；监狱看守（英式拼法）

e.en: The {gaoler} jangled his keys outside the cell door.
e.zh: 狱卒在牢房门外哗啦哗啦地摇着钥匙。

e.en: A kindly {gaoler} sneaked extra bread to the prisoners.
e.zh: 一位心善的狱卒偷偷给囚犯多送了些面包。

e.en: British {gaols} were notoriously overcrowded in the eighteenth century.
e.zh: 十八世纪的英国监狱以人满为患而臭名昭著。

e.en: Reformers campaigned to improve conditions in colonial {gaols}.
e.zh: 改革者发起运动要求改善殖民地监狱的条件。

e.en: There is a small {gap} between the two buildings.
e.zh: 两栋楼之间有一道小缝隙。

e.en: This course helps bridge the {gap} in your knowledge.
e.zh: 这门课能帮你弥补知识上的不足。

gape.t: v. 目瞪口呆地盯；张大嘴

e.en: Tourists often {gape} at the towering skyscrapers.
e.zh: 游客常常张大嘴盯着那些摩天大楼看。

e.en: Don't just {gape} at the screen and say nothing.
e.zh: 别只是呆呆盯着屏幕一句话也不说。

gaped.t: v. 目瞪口呆地盯（gape 的过去式）

e.en: The children {gaped} at the magician in amazement.
e.zh: 孩子们目瞪口呆地看着魔术师。

e.en: A deep canyon {gaped} below the narrow bridge.
e.zh: 窄桥下方裂开着一道深深的峡谷。

gapes.t: v. 目瞪口呆地盯（gape 第三人称单数）

e.en: He always {gapes} when he sees expensive cars.
e.zh: 他每次看到豪车都会惊得张大嘴。

e.en: A wide hole {gapes} in the old wooden floor.
e.zh: 那块旧木地板上张开着一个大洞。

gaping.t:
adj. 豁开的；大张的
v. 目瞪口呆地盯

e.en: There is a {gaping} hole in our security system.
e.zh: 我们的安保系统里有一个巨大的漏洞。

e.en: She stood {gaping} at the surprise birthday party.
e.zh: 她目瞪口呆地看着这场惊喜生日派对。

gaps.t: n. 缺口；差距（gap 的复数）

e.en: Please fill in the {gaps} on this form.
e.zh: 请把这张表格上的空白处填好。

e.en: Researchers found several {gaps} in the existing data.
e.zh: 研究人员在现有数据中发现了几处缺口。

gar.t: n. 雀鳝（一种长嘴淡水鱼）

e.en: The angler caught a long {gar} in the river.
e.zh: 那位钓鱼人在河里钓到一条长长的雀鳝。

e.en: A {gar} has a slim body and sharp teeth.
e.zh: 雀鳝身体细长,牙齿锋利。

e.en: I parked the car in the {garage} last night.
e.zh: 昨晚我把车停在车库里了。

e.en: The mechanic at the {garage} fixed my brakes quickly.
e.zh: 修车厂的师傅很快就修好了我的刹车。

e.en: Most houses on this street have two-car {garages}.
e.zh: 这条街上大多数房子都有双车位车库。

e.en: Several {garages} in town offer free oil changes.
e.zh: 镇上有几家修车行提供免费换机油服务。

e.en: The actors wore traditional medieval {garb} on stage.
e.zh: 演员们在台上穿着传统的中世纪服饰。

e.en: He showed up in casual {garb} for the meeting.
e.zh: 他穿着休闲装出现在会议上。

e.en: Please take the {garbage} out before bedtime.
e.zh: 请在睡觉前把垃圾拿出去。

e.en: Most of the comments online are pure {garbage}.
e.zh: 网上大多数评论纯粹是垃圾内容。

e.en: The {garbageman} comes to our street every Tuesday.
e.zh: 垃圾清运工每周二来我们这条街。

e.en: My uncle worked as a {garbageman} for thirty years.
e.zh: 我叔叔做了三十年的垃圾清运工。

e.en: This salad has roasted {garbanzo} beans on top.
e.zh: 这份沙拉上面放了烤鹰嘴豆。

e.en: Hummus is mainly made from {garbanzo} beans.
e.zh: 鹰嘴豆泥主要是用鹰嘴豆做的。

garble.t: v. 混淆；篡改；使（信息）失真

e.en: Bad reception can {garble} the audio in video calls.
e.zh: 信号差会让视频通话里的声音变得含糊不清。

e.en: Try not to {garble} your words during the speech.
e.zh: 演讲时尽量不要把话说得含糊不清。

garbled.t: adj. 含混不清的；被篡改的

e.en: The radio message was completely {garbled} by static.
e.zh: 无线电信息被静电干扰得完全听不清。

e.en: He gave a {garbled} explanation of what happened.
e.zh: 他对发生的事情做了一个含混不清的解释。

e.en: The {garbo} picks up our bins at dawn.
e.zh: 清洁工在天亮时来收我们的垃圾桶。

e.en: My neighbor tips the {garbo} every Christmas.
e.zh: 我邻居每年圣诞节都给清洁工小费。

garda.t: n. 爱尔兰警察（部队或警员）

e.en: A {garda} stopped the car for a routine check.
e.zh: 一名爱尔兰警察拦下那辆车做例行检查。

e.en: She joined the {garda} after finishing university.
e.zh: 她大学毕业后加入了爱尔兰警队。

garde.t: n. 卫队（法语借词，如 avant-garde 前卫）

e.en: The chef trained as a {garde} manger in Paris.
e.zh: 那位厨师在巴黎接受过冷餐主厨的训练。

e.en: Her paintings feel very avant-{garde} and bold.
e.zh: 她的画作显得非常前卫大胆。

garden.t:
n. 花园；菜园
v. 从事园艺

e.en: She grows tomatoes in her backyard {garden}.
e.zh: 她在后院的花园里种番茄。

e.en: The hotel has a beautiful Japanese {garden} outside.
e.zh: 那家酒店外面有一座漂亮的日式庭园。

e.en: Our {gardener} comes every Saturday to trim the hedges.
e.zh: 我们的园丁每周六都来修剪树篱。

e.en: She is a passionate {gardener} who loves growing roses.
e.zh: 她是个热爱种玫瑰的园艺爱好者。

e.en: Many {gardeners} share tips on Instagram and TikTok.
e.zh: 很多园艺爱好者在 Ins 和 抖音上分享心得。

e.en: The city hires {gardeners} to maintain the public parks.
e.zh: 市政府雇佣园丁来维护公共公园。

e.en: She wore a white {gardenia} pinned to her dress.
e.zh: 她把一朵白栀子花别在裙子上。

e.en: The {gardenia} bush smells wonderful at night.
e.zh: 那丛栀子花在夜里散发着浓郁的香味。

e.en: {Gardening} is a relaxing weekend hobby for many people.
e.zh: 对很多人来说,园艺是周末放松的爱好。

e.en: She spent the morning {gardening} in the backyard.
e.zh: 她整个上午都在后院做园艺。

gash.t:
n. 深长的伤口
v. 划出深口子

e.en: He got a deep {gash} on his knee from the fall.
e.zh: 他摔倒时膝盖被划开了一道深深的口子。

e.en: The earthquake left a long {gash} across the highway.
e.zh: 地震在高速公路上留下了一道长长的裂缝。

e.en: Coal {gasification} converts solid fuel into a usable gas.
e.zh: 煤炭气化将固体燃料转化为可用的气体。

e.en: The plant uses biomass {gasification} to generate clean electricity.
e.zh: 这家工厂利用生物质气化技术发电,既清洁又环保。

e.en: The farm built a small {gasifier} to recycle wood waste.
e.zh: 农场建了一台小型气化炉来回收利用木材废料。

e.en: Engineers installed a new {gasifier} at the power station.
e.zh: 工程师在发电站安装了一台新的气化炉。

e.en: The mechanic replaced the leaking head {gasket} on my car.
e.zh: 修车师傅给我换了漏油的汽缸盖垫片。

e.en: A worn {gasket} can cause serious engine damage over time.
e.zh: 垫片磨损久了可能会对发动机造成严重损害。

gaslight.t:
n. 煤气灯
v. 精神操控（使人怀疑自我）

e.en: He tried to {gaslight} her into doubting her own memory.
e.zh: 他试图用煤气灯效应让她怀疑自己的记忆。

e.en: Victorian London streets glowed under flickering {gaslight}.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的伦敦街道在摇曳的煤气灯下闪烁。

gaslit.t:
adj. 被精神操控的
adj. 煤气灯照明的

e.en: She realized her ex had {gaslit} her for years.
e.zh: 她意识到前任多年来一直在对她进行煤气灯式操控。

e.en: The cobblestone alley was dimly {gaslit} and atmospheric.
e.zh: 那条鹅卵石小巷在煤气灯下昏黄朦胧,氛围十足。

e.en: Many cars in Brazil run on {gasohol} blended with ethanol.
e.zh: 巴西许多汽车使用混有乙醇的酒精汽油。

e.en: The station now sells a cheaper {gasohol} alternative.
e.zh: 那家加油站现在出售一种更便宜的酒精汽油替代品。

e.en: {Gasoline} prices spiked after the pipeline shutdown.
e.zh: 输油管道停运后汽油价格飙升。

e.en: Don't store {gasoline} near any source of heat.
e.zh: 千万不要把汽油存放在热源附近。

gasp.t:
v. 倒吸一口气；喘息
n. 喘气声

e.en: The audience let out a {gasp} at the plot twist.
e.zh: 剧情反转时观众都倒吸了一口凉气。

e.en: She had to {gasp} for air after the long sprint.
e.zh: 长跑冲刺之后她只能大口大口地喘气。

gasping.t: v. 喘息；倒吸气（现在分词）

e.en: He was {gasping} for breath after climbing six flights.
e.zh: 爬了六层楼后他喘得上气不接下气。

e.en: The fish lay {gasping} on the deck of the boat.
e.zh: 那条鱼躺在船甲板上张着嘴喘气。

gasps.t: v./n. 喘息；倒吸气（复数/三单）

e.en: The magician's final trick drew loud {gasps} from the crowd.
e.zh: 魔术师的压轴戏引得观众大声惊叹。

e.en: She {gasps} every time she sees a spider.
e.zh: 她每次看见蜘蛛都会倒吸一口冷气。

gassed.t: v. 用毒气攻击；加油（过去式）

e.en: I {gassed} up the car before the road trip.
e.zh: 自驾出发前我把车加满了油。

e.en: The runners were totally {gassed} by the final lap.
e.zh: 跑到最后一圈时选手们都精疲力竭了。

gassing.t: n./v. 释放毒气；加油（动名词）

e.en: Stop {gassing} on and get to the point already.
e.zh: 别再废话连篇了,赶紧说重点。

e.en: He's {gassing} up the truck for tomorrow's delivery.
e.zh: 他正在给卡车加油,准备明天送货。

gassy.t: adj. 充满气体的；胀气的

e.en: Beans always make me feel a bit {gassy}.
e.zh: 豆类总是让我有点胀气。

e.en: The baby gets {gassy} after drinking formula too quickly.
e.zh: 宝宝喝奶粉太急就会胀气。

e.en: She takes medication to reduce {gastric} acid production.
e.zh: 她服药来减少胃酸分泌。

e.en: He underwent {gastric} bypass surgery to lose weight.
e.zh: 他做了胃旁路手术来减肥。

e.en: The hormone {gastrin} stimulates the stomach to release acid.
e.zh: 胃泌素这种激素会刺激胃部分泌胃酸。

e.en: Doctors measured his {gastrin} levels to diagnose the tumor.
e.zh: 医生检测了他的胃泌素水平以诊断肿瘤。

e.en: Spicy food often triggers his chronic {gastritis}.
e.zh: 辛辣食物经常引发他的慢性胃炎。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed her stomach pain as mild {gastritis}.
e.zh: 医生诊断她的胃痛是轻度胃炎。

e.en: She pulled her {gastrocnemius} muscle during the marathon.
e.zh: 她在马拉松比赛中拉伤了腓肠肌。

e.en: The {gastrocnemius} forms most of the bulge in your calf.
e.zh: 腓肠肌构成了小腿肚的大部分隆起。

e.en: Half the cruise passengers came down with {gastroenteritis}.
e.zh: 邮轮上一半的乘客都得了肠胃炎。

e.en: Viral {gastroenteritis} usually clears up within a few days.
e.zh: 病毒性肠胃炎通常几天内就会自行好转。

e.en: My {gastroenterologist} recommended a colonoscopy next month.
e.zh: 我的胃肠科医生建议下个月做一次结肠镜检查。

e.en: She referred me to a {gastroenterologist} for the chronic pain.
e.zh: 她把我转诊到了胃肠专科医生那里治疗慢性疼痛。

e.en: He specializes in {gastroenterology} at the university hospital.
e.zh: 他在大学附属医院专攻胃肠病学。

e.en: Recent advances in {gastroenterology} have improved cancer detection rates.
e.zh: 胃肠病学的最新进展提高了癌症检出率。

e.en: Many adults suffer from {gastroesophageal} reflux disease.
e.zh: 很多成年人都患有胃食管反流病。

e.en: The surgeon repaired the {gastroesophageal} junction laparoscopically.
e.zh: 外科医生通过腹腔镜修复了胃食管连接部。

e.en: Stress can cause a variety of {gastrointestinal} problems.
e.zh: 压力会引起各种各样的胃肠问题。

e.en: The drug has minor {gastrointestinal} side effects like nausea.
e.zh: 这种药有轻微的胃肠道副作用,比如恶心。

e.en: As a true {gastronome}, he travels the world for unique flavors.
e.zh: 作为一名真正的美食家,他周游世界寻找独特风味。

e.en: The restaurant attracts every serious {gastronome} in the city.
e.zh: 这家餐厅吸引了城里所有严肃的美食家。

e.en: Tokyo offers an incredible {gastronomic} experience for visitors.
e.zh: 东京为游客提供了令人惊叹的美食体验。

e.en: The festival celebrates the region's rich {gastronomic} traditions.
e.zh: 这个节日庆祝该地区丰富的美食传统。

e.en: Paris is famous for its {gastronomical} delights and fine dining.
e.zh: 巴黎以其美食享受和高级餐饮而闻名。

e.en: The tour focuses on the {gastronomical} heritage of Sicily.
e.zh: 这次旅行的重点是西西里岛的美食文化遗产。

e.en: French {gastronomy} is recognized by UNESCO as cultural heritage.
e.zh: 法国美食被联合国教科文组织列为文化遗产。

e.en: She's studying molecular {gastronomy} at a culinary institute.
e.zh: 她正在烹饪学院学习分子美食学。

gastropod.t: n. 腹足类动物（如蜗牛）

e.en: A snail is a common {gastropod} found in gardens.
e.zh: 蜗牛是花园里常见的腹足类动物。

e.en: Marine biologists discovered a new {gastropod} species near the reef.
e.zh: 海洋生物学家在珊瑚礁附近发现了一种新的腹足类生物。

e.en: The doctor scheduled a {gastroscopy} to check his ulcer.
e.zh: 医生安排了一次胃镜检查来查看他的溃疡。

e.en: You shouldn't eat for hours before a {gastroscopy}.
e.zh: 做胃镜检查前几个小时内不能进食。

e.en: The old {gasworks} has been converted into a trendy art space.
e.zh: 那座旧煤气厂已被改造成了时髦的艺术空间。

e.en: My grandfather worked at the local {gasworks} for forty years.
e.zh: 我祖父在当地的煤气厂工作了四十年。

gate.t:
n. 大门；闸门
n. 登机口

e.en: Please close the garden {gate} so the dog doesn't escape.
e.zh: 请把花园的门关好,免得狗跑出去。

e.en: Our flight is boarding at {gate} 23 in ten minutes.
e.zh: 我们的航班十分钟后在23号登机口开始登机。

e.en: She baked a chocolate {gateau} for her sister's birthday.
e.zh: 她为妹妹的生日烤了一个巧克力蛋糕。

e.en: The bakery's signature {gateau} is layered with raspberry cream.
e.zh: 那家面包店的招牌蛋糕夹着覆盆子奶油。

gateaux.t: n. gateau 的复数；奶油蛋糕

e.en: The patisserie displayed elegant {gateaux} in its glass cases.
e.zh: 那家糕点店的玻璃柜里陈列着精致的法式蛋糕。

e.en: French {gateaux} are typically richer than American layer cakes.
e.zh: 法式蛋糕通常比美式千层蛋糕更浓郁。

gatecrash.t: v. 不请自来；混入派对

e.en: Some uninvited friends tried to {gatecrash} the wedding reception.
e.zh: 几个没受邀请的朋友想混进婚礼酒会蹭吃蹭喝。

e.en: Don't {gatecrash} that party — you weren't invited.
e.zh: 别去那个派对蹭场了,你又没被邀请。

gated.t:
adj. 封闭式的（小区）
adj. 有门禁的

e.en: They live in a {gated} community with private security.
e.zh: 他们住在有私人保安的封闭式小区里。

e.en: Premium features are {gated} behind a monthly subscription.
e.zh: 高级功能需要付月费订阅才能解锁。

e.en: The guard waved us through at the estate's {gatehouse}.
e.zh: 门卫在庄园门房处挥手让我们通过。

e.en: They renovated the medieval {gatehouse} into a small museum.
e.zh: 他们把那座中世纪的门楼翻修成了一个小博物馆。

e.en: The editor acts as a {gatekeeper} for what gets published.
e.zh: 编辑充当着决定哪些内容能发表的把关人。

e.en: Don't be such a {gatekeeper} about who counts as a real fan.
e.zh: 别那么挑剔谁才算真正的粉丝。

gatekeeping.t: n. 把关；设置准入门槛

e.en: Online communities often engage in toxic {gatekeeping} of newcomers.
e.zh: 网络社区经常对新人进行令人反感的圈子排外行为。

e.en: Stop {gatekeeping} the hobby — anyone can enjoy it.
e.zh: 别再划圈子了,谁都可以享受这个爱好。

e.en: He leaned against the wooden {gatepost} watching the sunset.
e.zh: 他靠在木门柱上看着日落。

e.en: The old {gatepost} was carved with the family's initials.
e.zh: 那根古老的门柱上刻着这家人的名字缩写。

gates.t:
n. gate 的复数；大门
n. 盖茨（姓氏）

e.en: The stadium {gates} open two hours before kickoff.
e.zh: 体育场的大门会在开赛前两小时打开。

e.en: Bill {Gates} co-founded Microsoft back in 1975.
e.zh: 比尔·盖茨于1975年共同创立了微软公司。

gateshead.t: n. 盖茨黑德（英国城市）

e.en: The Angel of the North stands proudly outside {Gateshead}.
e.zh: 北方天使雕像矗立在盖茨黑德城外,十分壮观。

e.en: {Gateshead} sits across the River Tyne from Newcastle.
e.zh: 盖茨黑德与纽卡斯尔隔着泰恩河相望。

gateway.t:
n. 网关；入口
n. 途径；通道

e.en: This course is a {gateway} to a career in data science.
e.zh: 这门课程是通往数据科学职业的敲门砖。

e.en: Configure your default {gateway} in the network settings.
e.zh: 请在网络设置中配置你的默认网关。

gateways.t: n. gateway 的复数；网关；入口

e.en: Payment {gateways} encrypt your card details during checkout.
e.zh: 支付网关会在结账时加密你的卡片信息。

e.en: Internships often serve as {gateways} into competitive industries.
e.zh: 实习往往是进入热门行业的敲门砖。

gather.t:
v. 收集；聚集
v. 推断；得知

e.en: Let me {gather} my thoughts before answering that question.
e.zh: 让我整理一下思路再回答那个问题。

e.en: The family will {gather} at grandma's house for Thanksgiving.
e.zh: 全家人感恩节会聚到奶奶家团聚。

e.en: She {gathered} her notes before the big meeting started.
e.zh: 她在重要会议开始前整理好了笔记。

e.en: A crowd {gathered} outside the stadium after the concert.
e.zh: 演唱会结束后，体育场外聚集了一大群人。

e.en: Early humans lived as hunter-{gatherer} tribes for thousands of years.
e.zh: 早期人类以狩猎采集部落的形式生活了数千年。

e.en: She is a skilled {gatherer} of customer feedback online.
e.zh: 她善于在网上收集客户反馈。

gathering.t:
n. 聚会；集会
v. 聚集（gather 的现在分词）

e.en: The family {gathering} lasted well into the evening.
e.zh: 家庭聚会一直持续到傍晚。

e.en: Storm clouds were {gathering} over the distant mountains.
e.zh: 远处的群山上空乌云正在聚集。

e.en: Small {gatherings} of friends are allowed under the new rules.
e.zh: 按新规定，朋友间的小型聚会是被允许的。

e.en: She avoids large social {gatherings} whenever possible.
e.zh: 她尽可能避免参加大型社交聚会。

gathers.t: v. 聚集；收集（第三人称单数）

e.en: He {gathers} mushrooms in the forest every autumn.
e.zh: 他每年秋天都会去森林里采蘑菇。

e.en: The app {gathers} usage data to improve performance.
e.zh: 该应用收集使用数据以提升性能。

gator.t: n. 短吻鳄（alligator 的口语缩写）

e.en: A huge {gator} sunned itself on the riverbank.
e.zh: 一只巨大的鳄鱼在河岸上晒太阳。

e.en: Tourists snapped photos of the {gator} from the boat.
e.zh: 游客们从船上给那只短吻鳄拍照。

gatsby.t: n. 盖茨比（《了不起的盖茨比》主角）

e.en: The party felt straight out of The Great {Gatsby}.
e.zh: 那场派对感觉就像出自《了不起的盖茨比》。

e.en: She wore a {Gatsby}-style headband to the costume party.
e.zh: 她戴着盖茨比风格的发带去参加化装舞会。

gatt.t: n. 关税及贸易总协定（GATT）

e.en: The {GATT} agreement shaped global trade for decades.
e.zh: 关贸总协定在几十年间塑造了全球贸易格局。

e.en: Economists still study how {GATT} reduced postwar tariffs.
e.zh: 经济学家仍在研究关贸总协定如何降低战后关税。

gatting.t: n. 加廷（英国板球选手姓氏）

e.en: Mike {Gatting} captained England during the 1980s.
e.zh: 迈克·盖廷在20世纪80年代担任英格兰队队长。

e.en: The bowler dismissed {Gatting} with a famous spinning delivery.
e.zh: 投球手用一记著名的旋转球将盖廷淘汰出局。

gatwick.t: n. 盖特威克（伦敦机场）

e.en: Our flight to Madrid leaves from {Gatwick} tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 我们飞往马德里的航班明早从盖特威克机场起飞。

e.en: {Gatwick} handles millions of passengers each year.
e.zh: 盖特威克机场每年接待数百万旅客。

gauche.t: adj. 笨拙的；不善交际的

e.en: His {gauche} comment embarrassed everyone at the dinner table.
e.zh: 他笨拙失礼的话让餐桌上的每个人都很尴尬。

e.en: It feels {gauche} to ask how much someone earns.
e.zh: 打听别人挣多少钱显得很失礼。

gaucherie.t: n. 笨拙；不合时宜的举止

e.en: Her social {gaucherie} was charming rather than offensive.
e.zh: 她社交上的笨拙反倒讨人喜欢，并不冒犯。

e.en: The young diplomat soon outgrew his early {gaucherie}.
e.zh: 这位年轻外交官很快摆脱了早期的笨拙。

e.en: A skilled {gaucho} can ride for hours across the pampas.
e.zh: 技艺娴熟的高乔牧人能在潘帕斯草原上连续骑行数小时。

e.en: She bought wide {gaucho} pants while traveling in Argentina.
e.zh: 她在阿根廷旅行时买了一条宽松的高乔牧人裤。

gaudi.t: n. 高迪（西班牙建筑师）

e.en: Tourists flock to Barcelona to admire {Gaudí}'s curving architecture.
e.zh: 游客们涌向巴塞罗那欣赏高迪那充满曲线的建筑。

e.en: The unfinished cathedral remains {Gaudí}'s most famous masterpiece.
e.zh: 那座未完工的大教堂仍是高迪最著名的杰作。

e.en: The shop window was {gaudily} decorated for the holidays.
e.zh: 商店橱窗为节日布置得花里胡哨。

e.en: He dressed {gaudily} in bright purple and gold.
e.zh: 他穿得花哨俗气，亮紫与金色搭配在一起。

gaudy.t: adj. 俗丽的；花哨刺眼的

e.en: She refused to wear the {gaudy} necklace her aunt gave her.
e.zh: 她拒绝戴姨妈送的那条俗艳的项链。

e.en: The casino's {gaudy} lights flashed all night long.
e.zh: 赌场那些花俏的灯光彻夜闪烁。

gauge.t:
v. 测量；评估
n. 仪表；规格

e.en: Check the fuel {gauge} before starting a long drive.
e.zh: 长途驾驶前先看一下油表。

e.en: It's hard to {gauge} how the audience will react.
e.zh: 很难判断观众会作何反应。

e.en: {Gauguin} left Paris to paint in the South Pacific.
e.zh: 高更离开巴黎，前往南太平洋作画。

e.en: The museum acquired a rare {Gauguin} landscape last year.
e.zh: 博物馆去年收购了一幅罕见的高更风景画。

gaul.t: n. 高卢（古代地区）；高卢人

e.en: Caesar's armies eventually conquered all of {Gaul}.
e.zh: 凯撒的军队最终征服了整个高卢。

e.en: Ancient {Gaul} covered most of modern France and Belgium.
e.zh: 古代高卢涵盖了今天法国和比利时的大部分地区。

e.en: Charles de {Gaulle} led the Free French during the war.
e.zh: 夏尔·戴高乐在战争期间领导了自由法国运动。

e.en: We landed at Charles de {Gaulle} airport just after midnight.
e.zh: 我们刚过午夜就降落在戴高乐机场。

gaullist.t:
n. 戴高乐主义者
adj. 戴高乐派的

e.en: His grandfather was a loyal {Gaullist} throughout his life.
e.zh: 他的祖父一生都是忠实的戴高乐主义者。

e.en: The party still follows broadly {Gaullist} foreign policy ideas.
e.zh: 该党在外交政策上仍大致延续戴高乐主义路线。

gauloise.t: n. 高卢牌香烟（法国品牌）

e.en: He lit a {Gauloise} and stared out at the rain.
e.zh: 他点了一支高卢牌香烟，望着外面的雨发呆。

e.en: The café smelled of espresso and stale {Gauloise} smoke.
e.zh: 咖啡馆里弥漫着浓缩咖啡和高卢烟陈旧的烟味。

e.en: Geologists drilled through the {Gault} clay near the coast.
e.zh: 地质学家在沿海地带钻探了高尔特黏土层。

e.en: Fossils from the {Gault} formation reveal ancient marine life.
e.zh: 高尔特地层中的化石揭示了古代的海洋生物。

gaultier.t: n. 高缇耶（法国时装设计师）

e.en: Jean Paul {Gaultier} designed Madonna's iconic cone bra.
e.zh: 让·保罗·高缇耶设计了麦当娜标志性的尖锥胸衣。

e.en: The vintage {Gaultier} jacket sold for thousands at auction.
e.zh: 那件复古高缇耶外套在拍卖会上以数千美元成交。

e.en: He looked {gaunt} and tired after the long illness.
e.zh: 久病之后，他看上去消瘦憔悴。

e.en: The {gaunt} trees stood bare against the winter sky.
e.zh: 光秃秃的瘦树在冬日的天空下伫立着。

gauntlet.t:
n. 长手套；挑战
v. 冒险

e.en: New employees must run a {gauntlet} of tough interviews.
e.zh: 新员工必须经受一连串严苛面试的考验。

e.en: The knight pulled on a heavy steel {gauntlet}.
e.zh: 骑士戴上了一只沉重的钢制护手。

gauss.t: n. 高斯（磁感应强度单位/数学家）

e.en: {Gauss} made groundbreaking contributions to number theory and astronomy.
e.zh: 高斯在数论与天文学领域做出了开创性贡献。

e.en: The magnetic field strength is measured in {gauss}.
e.zh: 磁场强度以高斯为单位测量。

gaussian.t: adj. 高斯的（分布、函数等）

e.en: The data follows a roughly {Gaussian} distribution around the mean.
e.zh: 这些数据大致围绕均值呈高斯分布。

e.en: Apply a {Gaussian} blur to soften the photo's background.
e.zh: 对照片背景应用高斯模糊以使其柔化。

e.en: The nurse covered the wound with sterile {gauze}.
e.zh: 护士用无菌纱布盖住了伤口。

e.en: Morning mist hung like fine {gauze} over the lake.
e.zh: 晨雾如薄纱般笼罩在湖面上。

e.en: She wore a {gauzy} white dress to the beach wedding.
e.zh: 她穿着一条薄纱白裙参加海边婚礼。

e.en: A {gauzy} haze softened the city skyline at dusk.
e.zh: 一层薄雾在黄昏时柔化了城市的天际线。

e.en: She {gave} me a thoughtful gift for my birthday.
e.zh: 她在我生日时送了我一份很贴心的礼物。

e.en: The teacher {gave} the class a surprise quiz.
e.zh: 老师给全班来了一次突击测验。

e.en: The judge banged the {gavel} to restore order.
e.zh: 法官敲下木槌以恢复秩序。

e.en: A polished wooden {gavel} sat on the auctioneer's desk.
e.zh: 一柄光亮的木槌摆在拍卖师的桌上。

gavotte.t: n. 加沃特舞（法国古典舞曲）

e.en: The orchestra played a lively {gavotte} between movements.
e.zh: 乐团在乐章之间演奏了一段欢快的加沃特舞曲。

e.en: Couples danced a graceful {gavotte} at the costume ball.
e.zh: 宾客们在化装舞会上跳起了优雅的加沃特舞。

gawd.t: int. 天哪（God 的俚语拼写）

e.en: Oh {gawd}, I forgot to send that email again.
e.zh: 我的天，我又忘了发那封邮件。

e.en: "For {gawd}'s sake, hurry up!" she shouted from outside.
e.zh: "老天爷，快点啊！"她在外面喊道。

e.en: Tourists {gawk} at the giant skyscrapers in Manhattan.
e.zh: 游客们呆呆地仰望曼哈顿的摩天大楼。

e.en: It's rude to {gawk} at strangers on the train.
e.zh: 在火车上盯着陌生人看是很不礼貌的。

gawking.t: v. 呆看；傻瞪（现在分词）

e.en: Stop {gawking} and help me carry these boxes inside.
e.zh: 别傻看着了，帮我把这些箱子搬进去。

e.en: Drivers were {gawking} at the accident on the highway.
e.zh: 司机们都目瞪口呆地盯着高速公路上的事故现场。

gawky.t: adj. 笨拙的；举止不灵活的

e.en: He was a tall, {gawky} teenager with thick glasses.
e.zh: 他当时是个又高又笨拙、戴着厚眼镜的少年。

e.en: The puppy's {gawky} legs slipped on the polished floor.
e.zh: 小狗笨拙的腿在光滑的地板上直打滑。

gawp.t: v. 目瞪口呆地看（英式口语）

e.en: Don't just {gawp} at the menu—decide what you want.
e.zh: 别光盯着菜单发呆，快决定要点什么。

e.en: Passersby {gawp} at the street performer's daring stunt.
e.zh: 路人惊讶地盯着街头艺人大胆的表演。

gay.t:
adj. 同性恋的
n. 同性恋者

e.en: He came out as {gay} during his university years.
e.zh: 他在大学时期公开出柜。

e.en: The town hosts a colorful {gay} pride parade each June.
e.zh: 该镇每年六月举办一场色彩缤纷的同志骄傲游行。

gayness.t: n. 同性恋特质；同性恋倾向

e.en: He spoke openly about his {gayness} in the interview.
e.zh: 他在采访中坦然谈及自己的同性恋身份。

e.en: Her {gayness} is just one part of who she is.
e.zh: 她的同性恋身份只是她的一部分。

e.en: Persian {gaz} nougat is a sweet treat from Isfahan.
e.zh: 波斯加兹牛轧糖是来自伊斯法罕的一种甜点。

e.en: She bought a box of pistachio {gaz} as a souvenir.
e.zh: 她买了一盒开心果加兹糖作为伴手礼。

e.en: News reports focused on the humanitarian crisis in {Gaza}.
e.zh: 新闻报道聚焦于加沙的人道主义危机。

e.en: Aid trucks waited at the border crossing into {Gaza}.
e.zh: 救援卡车在通往加沙的边境口岸等候。

gazan.t:
n. 加沙人
adj. 加沙的

e.en: Many {Gazan} families have been displaced by the conflict.
e.zh: 许多加沙家庭因冲突而流离失所。

e.en: A young {Gazan} journalist reported live from the rubble.
e.zh: 一位年轻的加沙记者在废墟中进行现场报道。

gaze.t:
v. 凝视；注视
n. 凝视的目光

e.en: She lifted her {gaze} from the book and smiled.
e.zh: 她从书上抬起目光，微微一笑。

e.en: Tourists {gaze} at the mountains in stunned silence.
e.zh: 游客们在惊叹的沉默中凝望群山。

e.en: They got married under a wooden {gazebo} in the garden.
e.zh: 他们在花园里的木制凉亭下结了婚。

e.en: A small {gazebo} stood at the center of the park.
e.zh: 公园中央伫立着一座小凉亭。

gazed.t: v. 凝视（gaze 的过去式/过去分词）

e.en: She {gazed} out the window at the falling snow.
e.zh: 她望着窗外飘落的雪花出神。

e.en: He {gazed} into her eyes for a long moment.
e.zh: 他久久地凝视着她的眼睛。

e.en: A startled {gazelle} bounded across the dusty plain.
e.zh: 一只受惊的羚羊从尘土飞扬的平原上蹦跳而过。

e.en: She runs with the grace of a {gazelle}.
e.zh: 她奔跑起来像羚羊一样优雅。

e.en: A {gelid} wind blew across the empty winter beach.
e.zh: 一阵刺骨的寒风吹过冬日空荡的海滩。

e.en: Her hands turned numb in the {gelid} mountain stream.
e.zh: 她的手在冰冷刺骨的山溪里冻得发麻。

e.en: Murray {Gell}-Mann proposed the existence of quarks in 1964.
e.zh: 默里·盖尔曼于1964年提出了夸克的存在。

e.en: The young Welsh {gell} laughed at her grandfather's joke.
e.zh: 那个年轻的威尔士姑娘被祖父的玩笑逗笑了。

e.en: This little café is a real hidden {gem} downtown.
e.zh: 这家小咖啡馆真是市中心一处隐藏的宝藏。

e.en: The ring features a deep blue {gem} set in gold.
e.zh: 这枚戒指镶着一颗深蓝色的宝石,戒托是金的。

gemini.t: n. 双子座；Google 的 AI 模型

e.en: My sister is a {Gemini} and loves to talk to everyone.
e.zh: 我姐姐是双子座,喜欢跟所有人聊天。

e.en: Google's {Gemini} model competes with other large language models.
e.zh: 谷歌的 Gemini 模型与其他大语言模型相互竞争。

e.en: GPUs accelerate {GEMM} operations used heavily in deep learning.
e.zh: GPU 能加速深度学习中大量使用的通用矩阵乘法运算。

e.en: Optimizing {GEMM} kernels is crucial for fast neural network training.
e.zh: 优化通用矩阵乘法内核对神经网络的快速训练至关重要。

e.en: The album has a few hidden {gems} you'll discover on repeat listens.
e.zh: 这张专辑里藏着几首反复听才能发现的好歌。

e.en: She inherited a small box of precious {gems} from her grandmother.
e.zh: 她从祖母那里继承了一小盒珍贵的宝石。

e.en: The pendant features a rare green {gemstone} from Colombia.
e.zh: 这枚吊坠镶着一颗来自哥伦比亚的稀有绿色宝石。

e.en: Each {gemstone} is carefully cut and polished by hand.
e.zh: 每颗宝石都是手工精心切割和抛光的。

gen.t:
n. 世代（generation 缩写）
v. 生成（generate 缩写）

e.en: Give me the {gen} on the new project before the meeting.
e.zh: 开会前先把新项目的情况跟我说一下。

e.en: {Gen} Z spends more time on TikTok than on Facebook.
e.zh: Z世代花在抖音上的时间比脸书多。

e.en: A {gendarme} stopped our car at the border checkpoint.
e.zh: 一名宪兵在边境检查站拦下了我们的车。

e.en: The {gendarme} politely asked to see our passports.
e.zh: 那位宪兵很客气地要求查看我们的护照。

e.en: The French {gendarmerie} patrols rural areas and major highways.
e.zh: 法国宪兵队在乡村地区和主要高速公路上巡逻。

e.en: He served twenty years in the national {gendarmerie} before retiring.
e.zh: 他在国家宪兵队服役二十年后退休。

e.en: The form asks you to select your {gender} from three options.
e.zh: 这份表格要求你从三个选项中选择性别。

e.en: The company is working to close the {gender} pay gap.
e.zh: 该公司正在努力缩小性别薪酬差距。

e.en: The toy aisle is heavily {gendered} with pink and blue sections.
e.zh: 玩具货架按粉色和蓝色严重区分性别。

e.en: Many languages use {gendered} nouns that English speakers find confusing.
e.zh: 许多语言有性别化名词，英语使用者觉得很困惑。

e.en: The article criticizes the {gendering} of children's clothing.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评了童装的性别化倾向。

e.en: Researchers study how society starts {gendering} babies from birth.
e.zh: 研究人员探讨社会如何从出生起就给婴儿贴上性别标签。

e.en: Finnish is a {genderless} language with no he or she.
e.zh: 芬兰语是一种无性别语言，没有他和她之分。

e.en: The brand launched a {genderless} fragrance line last month.
e.zh: 该品牌上个月推出了一条无性别香水产品线。

e.en: The survey allows users to select from several {genders}.
e.zh: 这份问卷允许用户从多种性别中选择。

e.en: German nouns belong to one of three {genders}.
e.zh: 德语名词属于三种语法性别之一。

e.en: Scientists identified the {gene} responsible for red hair.
e.zh: 科学家发现了导致红发的那个基因。

e.en: A single {gene} mutation can cause serious disease.
e.zh: 单个基因突变就可能引发严重疾病。

e.en: She traced her family roots using {genealogical} records online.
e.zh: 她通过网上的家谱档案追溯家族根源。

e.en: The library has an excellent {genealogical} research section.
e.zh: 这家图书馆有出色的家谱研究专区。

genealogist.t: n. 家谱学家；系谱研究者

e.en: We hired a {genealogist} to find our ancestors in Ireland.
e.zh: 我们请了一位家谱研究员去寻找在爱尔兰的祖先。

e.en: The {genealogist} discovered a long-lost branch of the family.
e.zh: 那位家谱学家发现了一支失散已久的家族分支。

e.en: DNA testing has made {genealogy} a popular hobby worldwide.
e.zh: DNA检测让家谱研究成为全球流行的爱好。

e.en: He spent years researching his family {genealogy}.
e.zh: 他花了多年研究自家的家谱。

general.t:
adj. 总的；普遍的
n. 将军

e.en: In {general}, exercise improves both mood and sleep.
e.zh: 一般来说，运动能同时改善情绪和睡眠。

e.en: The {general} addressed the troops before the parade.
e.zh: 那位将军在阅兵前向部队讲话。

e.en: The menu featured chicken {generale} as the chef's special.
e.zh: 菜单上将左宗棠鸡列为厨师特色菜。

e.en: He ordered chicken {generale} with extra steamed broccoli.
e.zh: 他点了左宗棠鸡，并加了西兰花。

generalisable.t: adj. 可推广的；可一般化的

e.en: The findings are not easily {generalisable} to other populations.
e.zh: 这些发现不容易推广到其他人群。

e.en: Small sample sizes make results less {generalisable}.
e.zh: 样本量小会使结果更难推而广之。

e.en: That's a sweeping {generalisation} based on very little data.
e.zh: 那是基于极少数据的草率概括。

e.en: Avoid {generalisation} when describing a whole culture.
e.zh: 在描述一整种文化时要避免以偏概全。

e.en: Travel writers often make broad {generalisations} about local people.
e.zh: 旅行作家常对当地人做出笼统的概括。

e.en: His essay is full of unhelpful {generalisations}.
e.zh: 他的文章充斥着毫无帮助的泛泛之论。

e.en: It's risky to {generalise} from a single case study.
e.zh: 仅凭一个案例就一概而论是有风险的。

e.en: Don't {generalise} about an entire generation from one tweet.
e.zh: 别因为一条推文就给整代人下定论。

e.en: She suffers from {generalised} anxiety rather than specific phobias.
e.zh: 她患的是广泛性焦虑，而不是特定恐惧症。

e.en: The model {generalised} well to data it had never seen.
e.zh: 该模型对从未见过的数据也有良好的泛化能力。

generalises.t: v. 概括（第三人称单数）

e.en: This algorithm {generalises} surprisingly well across different languages.
e.zh: 这个算法在不同语言间的泛化表现出乎意料地好。

e.en: He always {generalises} from his own narrow experience.
e.zh: 他总是从自己狭隘的经验出发以偏概全。

e.en: Stop {generalising}—not all teenagers are addicted to phones.
e.zh: 别一概而论，不是所有青少年都沉迷手机。

e.en: The paper warns against {generalising} lab results to real users.
e.zh: 论文警告不要把实验室结果推广到真实用户身上。

e.en: The {generalissimo} ruled the country with absolute power for decades.
e.zh: 那位大元帅以绝对权力统治该国数十年。

e.en: History remembers the {generalissimo} as a controversial wartime leader.
e.zh: 历史将这位大元帅记作一位备受争议的战时领袖。

e.en: Startups often need a {generalist} who can wear many hats.
e.zh: 初创公司常常需要一个身兼多职的通才。

e.en: She's a {generalist} doctor rather than a specialist.
e.zh: 她是一名全科医生，而不是专科医生。

e.en: His answer had a {generality} that pleased no one.
e.zh: 他的回答太过笼统，谁都没满意。

e.en: Without loss of {generality}, assume the input is sorted.
e.zh: 不失一般性，可以假设输入已经排好序。

e.en: The study's {generalizability} is limited by its small sample.
e.zh: 该研究的可推广性因样本量小而受限。

e.en: Reviewers questioned the {generalizability} of the experiment's findings.
e.zh: 审稿人质疑该实验结果的普适性。

e.en: "Teenagers are lazy" is an unfair {generalization}.
e.zh: “青少年都很懒”是一种不公正的概括。

e.en: Good machine learning balances memorization and {generalization}.
e.zh: 好的机器学习要在记忆与泛化之间取得平衡。

e.en: Sweeping {generalizations} about gender rarely hold up under scrutiny.
e.zh: 关于性别的笼统概括经不起仔细推敲。

e.en: Try to back up your {generalizations} with concrete examples.
e.zh: 试着用具体的例子来支撑你的泛泛而谈。

e.en: It's unfair to {generalize} based on one bad experience.
e.zh: 仅凭一次糟糕的经历就一概而论并不公平。

e.en: This neural network can {generalize} to unseen examples.
e.zh: 这个神经网络能够泛化到未见过的样本上。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed him with {generalized} anxiety disorder last year.
e.zh: 医生去年诊断他患有广泛性焦虑障碍。

e.en: The protest later {generalized} into a nationwide movement.
e.zh: 抗议后来扩大成了一场全国性运动。

generalizes.t: v. 概括（第三人称单数）

e.en: The model {generalizes} poorly when training data lacks diversity.
e.zh: 训练数据缺乏多样性时，模型的泛化能力很差。

e.en: He often {generalizes} too quickly from a single anecdote.
e.zh: 他经常仅凭一则趣闻就过早地下结论。

e.en: You're {generalizing} from a tiny, biased sample of users.
e.zh: 你正基于一个极小且有偏的用户样本以偏概全。

e.en: The lecture focused on {generalizing} math concepts to higher dimensions.
e.zh: 讲座聚焦于把数学概念推广到更高维空间。

e.en: I {generally} drink coffee instead of tea in the morning.
e.zh: 我早上一般喝咖啡而不是茶。

e.en: The new policy was {generally} well received by employees.
e.zh: 新政策总体上受到了员工的好评。

e.en: The {generals} disagreed sharply about the next military move.
e.zh: 将军们对下一步军事行动意见分歧很大。

e.en: Two retired {generals} now host a popular podcast on strategy.
e.zh: 两位退役将军如今主持着一档人气策略播客。

e.en: His {generalship} during the campaign earned him widespread admiration.
e.zh: 他在这场战役中的统帅才能赢得了广泛赞赏。

e.en: The book analyzes the {generalship} of famous Civil War commanders.
e.zh: 这本书分析了南北战争名将的统帅艺术。

e.en: Solar panels {generate} electricity even on cloudy days.
e.zh: 太阳能板即使在阴天也能发电。

e.en: This tool can {generate} a password in seconds.
e.zh: 这个工具能在几秒内生成一个密码。

generated.t:
adj. 生成的
v. 已生成

e.en: The AI {generated} a surprisingly accurate summary of the document.
e.zh: 人工智能生成了一份意外准确的文档摘要。

e.en: Her video {generated} millions of views overnight.
e.zh: 她的视频一夜之间获得了数百万次观看。

generates.t: v. 生成（第三人称单数）

e.en: The wind farm {generates} enough power for the whole town.
e.zh: 这个风电场发的电足够整个城镇使用。

e.en: His blog {generates} steady income through ads and sponsorships.
e.zh: 他的博客通过广告和赞助带来稳定收入。

e.en: The model is {generating} sample images based on your prompt.
e.zh: 模型正在根据你的提示生成示例图片。

e.en: The film is {generating} huge buzz before its release.
e.zh: 这部电影上映前就引发了巨大的话题热度。

e.en: My {generation} grew up with smartphones and social media.
e.zh: 我们这一代是在智能手机和社交媒体陪伴下长大的。

e.en: The next {generation} of chips will be much faster.
e.zh: 下一代芯片的速度会快得多。

e.en: There's a clear {generational} gap in attitudes toward remote work.
e.zh: 对远程办公的态度存在明显的代际差异。

e.en: This investment could create {generational} wealth for the family.
e.zh: 这笔投资可能为这个家族创造代际财富。

generations.t: n. 世代，一代人（generation 复数）

e.en: The recipe has been passed down through five {generations}.
e.zh: 这道食谱已经传了五代人。

e.en: Future {generations} will judge how we handled climate change.
e.zh: 后代会评判我们如何应对了气候变化。

generative.t: adj. 生成式的（如生成式AI）

e.en: {Generative} AI tools can write code, art, and music.
e.zh: 生成式人工智能工具可以创作代码、艺术和音乐。

e.en: Her studio specializes in {generative} art made with algorithms.
e.zh: 她的工作室专注于用算法创作生成艺术。

e.en: We bought a backup {generator} in case the power fails.
e.zh: 我们买了一台备用发电机以防停电。

e.en: This password {generator} creates strong, unique strings instantly.
e.zh: 这个密码生成器能即时生成高强度、独一无二的字符串。

generic.t:
adj. 通用的，一般的
n. 非品牌药

e.en: I prefer {generic} medicines because they're much cheaper.
e.zh: 我更喜欢仿制药，因为价格便宜得多。

e.en: His apology felt {generic} and completely insincere.
e.zh: 他的道歉听起来千篇一律，毫无诚意。

e.en: The product is sold {generically} under several store brands.
e.zh: 这款产品以多个超市自有品牌作为通用版销售。

e.en: People often refer to all tissues {generically} as Kleenex.
e.zh: 人们常把所有面巾纸笼统地叫做舒洁。

generosities.t: n. 慷慨之举（generosity 复数）

e.en: She remembered the small {generosities} of her neighbors fondly.
e.zh: 她深情地回忆起邻居们点点滴滴的慷慨。

e.en: The town survived on the quiet {generosities} of strangers.
e.zh: 这个小镇靠陌生人默默的善意支撑了下来。

e.en: Her {generosity} toward strangers always amazes me.
e.zh: 她对陌生人的慷慨总让我惊叹。

e.en: The charity thrives thanks to the {generosity} of small donors.
e.zh: 这家慈善机构靠小额捐赠者的慷慨得以蓬勃发展。

e.en: The cafe serves {generous} portions at reasonable prices.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆分量很足，价格也合理。

e.en: My grandfather was a kind and {generous} man.
e.zh: 我祖父是一个善良慷慨的人。

e.en: He tipped the server {generously} after the great service.
e.zh: 享受了优质服务后，他给服务员留了丰厚的小费。

e.en: Sprinkle the cheese {generously} over the pasta before baking.
e.zh: 烘烤前在意大利面上慷慨地撒上奶酪。

e.en: My curly hair comes from my mother's {genes}.
e.zh: 我的卷发遗传自母亲的基因。

e.en: Researchers linked several {genes} to a higher risk of diabetes.
e.zh: 研究人员把若干基因与较高的糖尿病风险联系起来。

e.en: The {genesis} of the company began in a garage in 2010.
e.zh: 这家公司起源于2010年的一间车库。

e.en: That conversation was the {genesis} of our entire project.
e.zh: 那次谈话正是我们整个项目的起点。

genet.t: n. 麝香猫（一种小型哺乳动物）

e.en: A spotted {genet} darted across the trail at dusk.
e.zh: 一只斑点麝香猫在黄昏时分窜过小径。

e.en: The African {genet} has a long, ringed tail and pointed face.
e.zh: 非洲麝香猫长着环状长尾和尖尖的脸。

e.en: The disease has a strong {genetic} component in our family.
e.zh: 这种疾病在我们家族中有很强的遗传因素。

e.en: A {genetic} test revealed her ancestry was more diverse than expected.
e.zh: 一项基因检测显示她的血统比预想的更加多样。

e.en: Most corn in the United States is {genetically} modified.
e.zh: 美国大部分玉米都是转基因的。

e.en: Identical twins are {genetically} almost the same person.
e.zh: 同卵双胞胎在基因上几乎是同一个人。

e.en: The {geneticist} explained how DNA mutations cause certain diseases.
e.zh: 那位遗传学家解释了DNA突变如何导致某些疾病。

e.en: She became a {geneticist} after studying biology in college.
e.zh: 她大学读完生物学后成为了一名遗传学家。

e.en: Modern {genetics} has transformed our understanding of human disease.
e.zh: 现代遗传学彻底改变了我们对人类疾病的认识。

e.en: His tall height is mostly down to {genetics}.
e.zh: 他个子高主要是基因决定的。

e.en: The peace talks were held in {Geneva} last week.
e.zh: 和平谈判上周在日内瓦举行。

e.en: {Geneva} sits on the shore of a beautiful lake.
e.zh: 日内瓦坐落在一个美丽的湖畔。

e.en: Our host greeted us with a {genial} smile.
e.zh: 主人以亲切的微笑迎接我们。

e.en: He's a {genial} old man who loves telling stories.
e.zh: 他是位和蔼的老人,喜欢讲故事。

e.en: His natural {geniality} made everyone feel welcome at the party.
e.zh: 他天生的和蔼让派对上的每个人都感到宾至如归。

e.en: The manager's {geniality} hid a sharp business mind.
e.zh: 经理和善的外表下藏着精明的商业头脑。

e.en: He {genially} waved to the neighbors from his porch.
e.zh: 他从门廊上和蔼地向邻居们挥手。

e.en: The professor {genially} answered every student's question.
e.zh: 教授和蔼地回答了每个学生的问题。

genie.t: n. 精灵（神话中的灯神）

e.en: In the story, a {genie} grants three wishes to the boy.
e.zh: 故事里,一个精灵给那个男孩实现三个愿望。

e.en: Once released, the {genie} cannot be put back in the bottle.
e.zh: 精灵一旦放出来就再也收不回瓶子里了。

genistein.t: n. 染料木素（一种异黄酮）

e.en: Soybeans contain {genistein}, a compound studied for health benefits.
e.zh: 大豆含有染料木素,这是一种被研究其健康益处的化合物。

e.en: Researchers are exploring how {genistein} affects cancer cells.
e.zh: 研究人员正在探索染料木素如何影响癌细胞。

e.en: The clinic offers screening for {genital} infections.
e.zh: 该诊所提供生殖器感染的筛查服务。

e.en: Doctors warned about the spread of {genital} herpes.
e.zh: 医生们警告说生殖器疱疹正在蔓延。

e.en: Biology textbooks include diagrams of human {genitalia}.
e.zh: 生物教科书里有人类生殖器的图示。

e.en: The doctor examined the patient's {genitalia} during the checkup.
e.zh: 体检时医生检查了病人的生殖器。

e.en: Wash the {genitals} gently with mild soap and warm water.
e.zh: 用温和的肥皂和温水轻轻清洗外阴部。

e.en: The injury affected his {genitals} and required surgery.
e.zh: 这个伤势伤到了他的生殖器,需要做手术。

e.en: She specializes in {genitourinary} disorders at the hospital.
e.zh: 她在医院专门治疗泌尿生殖系统疾病。

e.en: The drug can cause mild {genitourinary} side effects.
e.zh: 这种药可能导致轻微的泌尿生殖系统副作用。

e.en: Einstein was a true mathematical {genius} of his era.
e.zh: 爱因斯坦是他那个时代真正的数学天才。

e.en: That marketing idea was absolute {genius}.
e.zh: 那个营销点子简直是天才之作。

e.en: History remembers a handful of {geniuses} like Newton and Darwin.
e.zh: 历史只记住了像牛顿和达尔文这样少数几个天才。

e.en: The startup hired ten coding {geniuses} from top universities.
e.zh: 那家初创公司从顶尖大学招聘了十位编程天才。

genoa.t: n. 热那亚（意大利城市）

e.en: {Genoa} is a major port city in northern Italy.
e.zh: 热那亚是意大利北部的主要港口城市。

e.en: Christopher Columbus was born in {Genoa} in 1451.
e.zh: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布于1451年出生在热那亚。

e.en: The court convicted him of {genocidal} acts during the war.
e.zh: 法庭判定他在战争中犯有种族灭绝行为。

e.en: The regime pursued a {genocidal} policy against the minority.
e.zh: 该政权对少数民族推行种族灭绝政策。

e.en: The UN convention defines what counts as {genocide}.
e.zh: 联合国公约界定了什么构成种族灭绝。

e.en: Schools teach students about the Rwandan {genocide} of 1994.
e.zh: 学校向学生讲授1994年的卢旺达种族大屠杀。

genocides.t: n. 种族灭绝事件（复数）

e.en: The twentieth century witnessed several horrific {genocides}.
e.zh: 二十世纪见证了好几起骇人听闻的种族灭绝。

e.en: Historians compare the causes of different {genocides}.
e.zh: 历史学家比较不同种族灭绝事件的成因。

genoese.t:
n. 热那亚人
adj. 热那亚的

e.en: The {Genoese} merchants dominated Mediterranean trade for centuries.
e.zh: 热那亚商人主导地中海贸易长达数百年。

e.en: She tried an authentic {Genoese} pesto sauce in Italy.
e.zh: 她在意大利尝了正宗的热那亚青酱。

e.en: Scientists finished mapping the human {genome} in 2003.
e.zh: 科学家于2003年完成了人类基因组的测序。

e.en: Each species has a unique {genome} encoded in its DNA.
e.zh: 每个物种都有编码在其DNA中独特的基因组。

e.en: Researchers compare the {genomes} of humans and chimpanzees.
e.zh: 研究人员比较人类和黑猩猩的基因组。

e.en: Modern sequencers can decode entire {genomes} within hours.
e.zh: 现代测序仪可以在几小时内解码整个基因组。

e.en: {Genomic} testing helps doctors choose the best cancer treatment.
e.zh: 基因组检测帮助医生选择最佳的癌症治疗方案。

e.en: The lab specializes in {genomic} research on rare diseases.
e.zh: 该实验室专门研究罕见疾病的基因组学。

e.en: The two species are {genomically} very similar despite looking different.
e.zh: 这两个物种虽然外观不同,但在基因组上非常相似。

e.en: Tumors are now classified {genomically} rather than just by tissue.
e.zh: 肿瘤现在按基因组而非仅按组织来分类。

e.en: Advances in {genomics} are revolutionizing personalized medicine.
e.zh: 基因组学的进步正在彻底改变个性化医疗。

e.en: She studies cancer {genomics} at a leading research institute.
e.zh: 她在一家顶尖研究所研究癌症基因组学。

e.en: Your {genotype} influences how your body responds to certain drugs.
e.zh: 你的基因型影响着身体对某些药物的反应。

e.en: Plants with this {genotype} grow taller and produce more fruit.
e.zh: 具有这种基因型的植物长得更高,结的果实更多。

e.en: The study found {genotypic} differences between the two populations.
e.zh: 研究发现两个种群之间存在基因型差异。

e.en: Scientists analyze {genotypic} variation to understand disease risk.
e.zh: 科学家分析基因型变异以了解疾病风险。

genovese.t:
adj. 热那亚的
n. 热那亚人（姓氏）

e.en: He ordered pasta with {Genovese} pesto for dinner.
e.zh: 他点了配热那亚青酱的意面作为晚餐。

e.en: The {Genovese} crime family was once a powerful mafia clan.
e.zh: 吉诺维斯家族曾是势力强大的黑手党帮派。

genre.t: n. 类型，体裁（影视、音乐等）

e.en: Horror is my favorite film {genre} to watch alone.
e.zh: 恐怖片是我最喜欢一个人看的电影类型。

e.en: This album blends jazz with the hip-hop {genre}.
e.zh: 这张专辑将爵士与嘻哈风格融为一体。

e.en: Streaming services let you browse hundreds of music {genres}.
e.zh: 流媒体服务让你可以浏览数百种音乐流派。

e.en: She writes novels across several different {genres}.
e.zh: 她创作的小说涵盖好几种不同的体裁。

gent.t: n. 先生（gentleman 的口语缩写）

e.en: A friendly {gent} held the door open for me.
e.zh: 一位友善的先生帮我扶着门。

e.en: The shop sells suits and shirts for the modern {gent}.
e.zh: 这家店为时尚男士销售西装和衬衫。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {gentamicin} to fight the bacterial infection.
e.zh: 医生开了庆大霉素来治疗细菌感染。

e.en: {Gentamicin} can damage hearing if used in high doses.
e.zh: 庆大霉素如大剂量使用会损害听力。

e.en: Her grandmother had a {genteel} manner from another era.
e.zh: 她奶奶举止优雅,带着另一个时代的气息。

e.en: The tea room offered a {genteel} atmosphere for afternoon chats.
e.zh: 那家茶室提供了优雅的氛围,适合下午闲聊。

gazes.t:
v. 凝视，注视
n. 凝视的目光

e.en: Their {gazes} met across the crowded coffee shop.
e.zh: 在拥挤的咖啡馆里，他们的目光相遇了。

e.en: He {gazes} at the stars every clear night.
e.zh: 每个晴朗的夜晚他都会凝望星空。

gazeta.t: n. 报纸（某些语言中的"gazette"）

e.en: The Russian {Gazeta} published a critical editorial today.
e.zh: 那家俄罗斯报纸《Gazeta》今天发表了一篇批评性社论。

e.en: She subscribes to a Polish {gazeta} for daily news.
e.zh: 她订了一份波兰报纸来阅读每日新闻。

e.en: The local {gazette} covers high school sports each week.
e.zh: 当地的报纸每周都会报道高中体育赛事。

e.en: Her promotion was announced in the official {gazette}.
e.zh: 她的晋升消息刊登在官方公报上。

gazetteer.t: n. 地名词典，地名索引

e.en: The {gazetteer} lists every village in the province alphabetically.
e.zh: 这本地名词典按字母顺序列出了该省的每一个村庄。

e.en: Editors checked the {gazetteer} to confirm the river's spelling.
e.zh: 编辑们查阅地名词典以确认这条河流的拼写。

gazillion.t: n. 无数，极大的数（夸张说法）

e.en: There are a {gazillion} cat videos on the internet.
e.zh: 网上有数不清的猫咪视频。

e.en: I've told you a {gazillion} times to lock the door.
e.zh: 我跟你说过无数次了,要锁门。

gazing.t: v. 凝视，注视（gaze 的现在分词）

e.en: She sat by the window, {gazing} at the falling snow.
e.zh: 她坐在窗边,凝视着飘落的雪花。

e.en: He kept {gazing} into her eyes during the entire conversation.
e.zh: 整段对话中他都一直深情地望着她的眼睛。

gazpacho.t: n. 加斯帕乔（西班牙蔬菜冷汤）

e.en: We ordered chilled {gazpacho} as a starter on the hot afternoon.
e.zh: 那个炎热的下午我们点了冷的西班牙冷汤当前菜。

e.en: Her {gazpacho} recipe uses ripe tomatoes, cucumber, and garlic.
e.zh: 她的西班牙冷汤食谱用熟番茄、黄瓜和大蒜。

gazump.t: v. (卖方) 临时抬价毁约

e.en: The seller tried to {gazump} us after we'd agreed a price.
e.zh: 我们已经谈好价格后,卖家却想临时抬价反悔。

e.en: Buyers fear sellers will {gazump} them in a hot housing market.
e.zh: 在火热的楼市里,买家担心卖家会临时抬价反悔。

gbh.t: n. 严重人身伤害罪（grievous bodily harm）

e.en: He was charged with {GBH} after the bar fight.
e.zh: 酒吧斗殴之后他被指控严重伤害罪。

e.en: The court sentenced her to four years for {GBH}.
e.zh: 法院以严重人身伤害罪判处她四年监禁。

e.en: Compile the program with {gcc} using the -O2 flag.
e.zh: 用 gcc 加上 -O2 选项编译这个程序。

e.en: The Linux kernel is built with the {GCC} compiler.
e.zh: Linux 内核是用 GCC 编译器构建的。

gce.t: n. 英国普通教育证书

e.en: He passed his {GCE} A-levels with three top grades.
e.zh: 他通过了普通教育证书高级考试,拿了三个最高等级。

e.en: The {GCE} O-level was replaced by the GCSE in 1988.
e.zh: 普通教育证书普通级在1988年被GCSE取代。

gcse.t: n. 英国中等教育普通证书

e.en: My daughter is revising for her {GCSE} exams next month.
e.zh: 我女儿正在为下个月的中学毕业考试复习。

e.en: She got an A in her {GCSE} English literature paper.
e.zh: 她在中学毕业考试英国文学卷上拿了A。

gdansk.t: n. 格但斯克（波兰港口城市）

e.en: The Solidarity movement began in {Gdansk} in 1980.
e.zh: 团结工会运动于1980年在格但斯克兴起。

e.en: We took the ferry from Stockholm to {Gdansk} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们坐渡轮从斯德哥尔摩去了格但斯克。

e.en: China's {GDP} grew by five percent last year.
e.zh: 中国的国内生产总值去年增长了百分之五。

e.en: Tourism contributes about ten percent of the country's {GDP}.
e.zh: 旅游业约占该国国内生产总值的百分之十。

gdr.t: n. 德意志民主共和国（东德）

e.en: The {GDR} existed from 1949 until German reunification in 1990.
e.zh: 民主德国从1949年存在到1990年两德统一。

e.en: His parents grew up behind the Berlin Wall in the {GDR}.
e.zh: 他的父母在民主德国柏林墙的另一边长大。

gdynia.t: n. 格丁尼亚（波兰港口城市）

e.en: {Gdynia} is a major port city on the Polish Baltic coast.
e.zh: 格丁尼亚是波兰波罗的海沿岸的一个主要港口城市。

e.en: The shipyard in {Gdynia} builds vessels for clients worldwide.
e.zh: 格丁尼亚的造船厂为全球客户建造船舶。

gear.t:
n. 齿轮；档位；装备
v. 调整，适应

e.en: Don't forget to bring your camping {gear} for the weekend.
e.zh: 别忘了带上你周末露营的装备。

e.en: Shift into a lower {gear} before the steep hill.
e.zh: 上陡坡前先换到低档。

e.en: The mechanic said the {gearbox} needs to be replaced.
e.zh: 修车师傅说变速箱需要更换。

e.en: Manual {gearbox} cars are becoming rare in the United States.
e.zh: 在美国手动变速箱的车越来越少见了。

gearhead.t: n. 机械迷，汽车发烧友

e.en: My uncle is a total {gearhead} who rebuilds engines on weekends.
e.zh: 我叔叔是个十足的车迷,周末就拆装发动机。

e.en: The forum is full of {gearheads} swapping turbo upgrade tips.
e.zh: 这个论坛里全是车迷在交流涡轮升级的窍门。

gearing.t: n. 传动装置；(财务) 杠杆比率

e.en: The bike's {gearing} makes climbing steep hills much easier.
e.zh: 这辆自行车的传动比让爬陡坡轻松多了。

e.en: The company is {gearing} up for a major product launch.
e.zh: 公司正在为一次重大的产品发布做准备。

e.en: He shifted {gears} smoothly as he merged onto the highway.
e.zh: 他汇入高速公路时换挡很顺畅。

e.en: The clock's tiny brass {gears} still work after a century.
e.zh: 这座钟里的黄铜小齿轮过了一个世纪还能用。

e.en: He rested his hand on the {gearshift} at the red light.
e.zh: 红灯时他把手搭在变速杆上。

e.en: The leather-wrapped {gearshift} gives the car a sporty feel.
e.zh: 包着真皮的变速杆让这辆车显得很有运动感。

gec.t: n. 英国通用电气公司

e.en: {GEC} was once one of Britain's largest electronics companies.
e.zh: 通用电气公司曾是英国最大的电子公司之一。

e.en: My grandfather worked at {GEC} in Coventry for thirty years.
e.zh: 我祖父在考文垂的通用电气公司工作了三十年。

e.en: A small {gecko} clung to the ceiling of our hotel room.
e.zh: 一只小壁虎贴在我们酒店房间的天花板上。

e.en: The {gecko} can climb glass thanks to microscopic hairs on its toes.
e.zh: 壁虎能爬玻璃是靠脚趾上的微小细毛。

ged.t: n. 美国高中同等学力证书

e.en: She earned her {GED} while working two jobs.
e.zh: 她一边做两份工一边考到了高中同等学力证书。

e.en: Many community colleges accept a {GED} for admission.
e.zh: 许多社区大学接受高中同等学力证书作为入学条件。

gedanken.t: adj. 思想实验的（德语借词）

e.en: Einstein famously used a {gedanken} experiment to explore relativity.
e.zh: 爱因斯坦著名地用思想实验来探索相对论。

e.en: The professor proposed a {gedanken} experiment involving a cat in a box.
e.zh: 教授提出了一个把猫装在盒子里的思想实验。

geddit.t: phr. 懂了吗（get it 的口语拼法）

e.en: He winked and said, "It's a pun about lawyers, {geddit}?"
