e.zh: 他眨眨眼说:"这是个关于律师的双关,懂了吧?"

e.en: She tapped her nose and whispered, "{Geddit}?"
e.zh: 她点了点鼻子,低声说:"明白了吗?"

gee.t: int. 哎呀，天哪（表示惊讶）

e.en: {Gee}, that movie was way better than I expected!
e.zh: 哎呀,那部电影比我想的好看多了!

e.en: {Gee}, I had no idea the tickets would be so expensive.
e.zh: 天哪,我完全没想到票会那么贵。

e.en: He's a total computer {geek} who builds his own PCs.
e.zh: 他是个十足的电脑迷,自己组装电脑。

e.en: I'm a huge {geek} when it comes to vintage sci-fi novels.
e.zh: 说到老科幻小说,我可是个超级迷。

geeky.t: adj. 极客范儿的，书呆子气的

e.en: She wore a {geeky} T-shirt covered in math equations.
e.zh: 她穿了一件印满数学公式的极客 T 恤。

e.en: Their conversation got pretty {geeky} once they started discussing compilers.
e.zh: 他们一聊到编译器,谈话就变得相当极客范儿。

gees.t: int. 哎呀（gee 的复数/变体）

e.en: The pilot pulled six {gees} during the steep banking turn.
e.zh: 飞行员在急转弯时承受了六个G的过载。

e.en: Fighter pilots train hard to withstand high {gees} in combat.
e.zh: 战斗机飞行员要刻苦训练才能在战斗中承受高过载。

e.en: A flock of wild {geese} flew south for the winter.
e.zh: 一群野鹅向南飞过冬。

e.en: The {geese} on the lawn hissed at anyone who came close.
e.zh: 草坪上的那些鹅会对任何靠近的人发出嘶嘶声。

geezer.t: n. 老头；(英俚) 家伙

e.en: Some old {geezer} on the bus kept telling us war stories.
e.zh: 公车上有个老头一直跟我们讲打仗的故事。

e.en: He's a friendly {geezer} who runs the corner shop.
e.zh: 他是个开街角小店的和气老头。

geiger.t: n. 盖革（盖革计数器的发明者）

e.en: The {Geiger} counter clicked rapidly near the abandoned reactor.
e.zh: 在废弃反应堆附近,盖革计数器响个不停。

e.en: Scientists used a {Geiger} counter to detect radiation in the soil.
e.zh: 科学家用盖革计数器检测土壤中的辐射。

e.en: A {geisha} performed a traditional dance for the guests in Kyoto.
e.zh: 一位艺伎在京都为客人表演了传统舞蹈。

e.en: Becoming a {geisha} requires years of training in music and dance.
e.zh: 成为艺伎需要多年的音乐和舞蹈训练。

gel.t:
n. 凝胶，啫喱
v. 定型；融洽配合

e.en: He puts way too much {gel} in his hair every morning.
e.zh: 他每天早上往头发上抹的发胶实在太多。

e.en: The team began to {gel} after a few weeks of practice.
e.zh: 经过几周训练后,这支队伍开始默契起来。

e.en: Marshmallows are usually made with sugar and {gelatin}.
e.zh: 棉花糖通常是用糖和明胶做的。

e.en: Vegetarians often avoid desserts that contain animal {gelatin}.
e.zh: 素食者通常不吃含有动物明胶的甜点。

gelatine.t: n. 明胶（gelatin 的英式拼法）

e.en: Soak the {gelatine} sheets in cold water before using.
e.zh: 使用前把吉利丁片放在冷水里浸泡。

e.en: The recipe calls for two teaspoons of powdered {gelatine}.
e.zh: 这道食谱需要两茶匙明胶粉。

e.en: The dessert had a wobbly, {gelatinous} texture on the plate.
e.zh: 那道甜点在盘子里颤巍巍的,有种果冻般的质感。

e.en: Strange {gelatinous} blobs washed up on the beach overnight.
e.zh: 一些奇怪的胶状团块一夜之间被冲上了海滩。

e.en: We stopped for {gelato} at a tiny shop in Florence.
e.zh: 我们在佛罗伦萨一家小店停下来吃了意式冰淇淋。

e.en: Pistachio is my favorite flavor of {gelato}.
e.zh: 开心果是我最喜欢的意式冰淇淋口味。

e.en: The horse {gelder} arrived at the ranch early in the morning.
e.zh: 阉马师一早就到了牧场。

e.en: An experienced {gelder} can perform the procedure in minutes.
e.zh: 一位有经验的阉马师几分钟就能完成手术。

gelding.t:
n. 阉割过的公马
v. 阉割

e.en: She rode a calm chestnut {gelding} on the trail.
e.zh: 她骑着一匹温顺的栗色阉马走在小径上。

e.en: The {gelding} won three races during the spring season.
e.zh: 那匹阉马在春季赛事中赢了三场比赛。

e.en: Blue {gentian} flowers bloom across the alpine meadow in summer.
e.zh: 夏天高山草甸上盛开着蓝色的龙胆花。

e.en: Bitter {gentian} root is used in many herbal liqueurs.
e.zh: 苦味的龙胆根被用于许多草本利口酒中。

gentile.t:
n. 非犹太人
adj. 异教徒的

e.en: The Jewish community welcomed {gentile} guests to the celebration.
e.zh: 犹太社区欢迎非犹太人客人参加庆祝活动。

e.en: In Mormon tradition, anyone outside the faith is called a {gentile}.
e.zh: 在摩门教传统中,信仰之外的人都被称为外邦人。

gentility.t: n. 上流社会身份；斯文有礼

e.en: The old hotel still preserves an air of faded {gentility}.
e.zh: 那座老酒店仍保留着一丝褪色的优雅气息。

e.en: Her family clung to the {gentility} of past generations.
e.zh: 她的家人坚守着先辈们的高雅举止。

e.en: Use a {gentle} shampoo if your scalp gets irritated easily.
e.zh: 如果头皮容易过敏,请使用温和的洗发水。

e.en: The teacher spoke in a {gentle} voice to calm the child.
e.zh: 老师用温柔的声音安抚那个孩子。

gentlefolk.t: n. 上流人士；有教养的人

e.en: The novel describes the lives of country {gentlefolk} in Victorian England.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了维多利亚时代英国乡绅的生活。

e.en: In her village, the {gentlefolk} hosted weekly tea gatherings.
e.zh: 在她的村子里,绅士淑女们每周举办茶会。

e.en: A real {gentleman} always opens the door for others.
e.zh: 真正的绅士总会为别人开门。

e.en: The elderly {gentleman} thanked me for giving up my seat.
e.zh: 那位年长的先生感谢我给他让座。

gentlemanliness.t: n. 绅士风度；君子之风

e.en: His old-fashioned {gentlemanliness} impressed everyone at the dinner.
e.zh: 他那种老派的绅士风度让晚宴上的每个人都印象深刻。

e.en: True {gentlemanliness} means treating everyone with respect.
e.zh: 真正的绅士风度意味着尊重每一个人。

e.en: He apologized in a quiet, {gentlemanly} manner.
e.zh: 他以一种平静而绅士的方式道了歉。

e.en: It wasn't very {gentlemanly} of him to leave her standing.
e.zh: 他让她一直站着,这可不太有绅士风度。

e.en: Ladies and {gentlemen}, please welcome our keynote speaker.
e.zh: 女士们,先生们,请欢迎我们的主讲嘉宾。

e.en: Two well-dressed {gentlemen} entered the lobby.
e.zh: 两位衣着考究的先生走进了大堂。

e.en: He handled the puppy with great {gentleness}.
e.zh: 他非常温柔地抱着小狗。

e.en: Her {gentleness} with the patients made her a wonderful nurse.
e.zh: 她对病人的温柔使她成为一位出色的护士。

e.en: The {gentlewoman} from California will now address the chamber.
e.zh: 现在请来自加利福尼亚的女议员发言。

e.en: In the novel, the {gentlewoman} ran a charity school for girls.
e.zh: 小说中,那位淑女经营着一所女子慈善学校。

e.en: Stir the sauce {gently} so it doesn't splash.
e.zh: 轻轻搅拌酱汁,以免溅出来。

e.en: She {gently} woke the sleeping baby for his feeding.
e.zh: 她轻轻地把熟睡的宝宝叫醒喂奶。

gentoo.t:
n. 巴布亚企鹅
n. Gentoo Linux 系统

e.en: {Gentoo} penguins are the fastest underwater swimmers among penguins.
e.zh: 巴布亚企鹅是企鹅中游得最快的水下游泳者。

e.en: He installed {Gentoo} Linux to learn how operating systems work.
e.zh: 他安装了Gentoo Linux来学习操作系统的工作原理。

gentrification.t: n. 城区绅士化（旧区改造致房价上涨）

e.en: {Gentrification} has pushed long-time residents out of the neighborhood.
e.zh: 中产阶级化让长期居民被迫搬出了这个社区。

e.en: Critics blame {gentrification} for rising rents downtown.
e.zh: 批评者将市中心房租上涨归咎于士绅化。

gentrified.t: adj. 经绅士化改造的（旧街区）

e.en: The once-rough district has been thoroughly {gentrified} in recent years.
e.zh: 那个曾经治安差的街区近年来已彻底中产化。

e.en: Trendy cafés sprouted across the newly {gentrified} neighborhood.
e.zh: 时髦咖啡馆在这个新晋绅士化的社区里如雨后春笋般出现。

gentrify.t: v. 对旧城区进行绅士化改造

e.en: Developers plan to {gentrify} the old warehouse district next year.
e.zh: 开发商计划明年改造翻新这片老仓库区。

e.en: Locals worry that new luxury condos will {gentrify} their street.
e.zh: 当地居民担心新建的豪华公寓会让他们这条街中产化。

gentry.t: n. 士绅阶层；上流人士

e.en: The English country {gentry} once dominated rural politics.
e.zh: 英国乡绅曾经主导着乡村政治。

e.en: Jane Austen's novels often portray the lives of the {gentry}.
e.zh: 简·奥斯汀的小说经常描绘乡绅阶层的生活。

genuflect.t: v. 屈膝下跪（尤指礼拜）

e.en: Catholics often {genuflect} when entering a church pew.
e.zh: 天主教徒进入教堂座位时通常会单膝下跪行礼。

e.en: He refused to {genuflect} to corporate pressure during the meeting.
e.zh: 会议中他拒绝向企业压力屈膝让步。

e.en: He made a brief {genuflection} before entering the pew.
e.zh: 他进入长椅前先简短地屈膝行礼。

e.en: The speech felt like a political {genuflection} to donors.
e.zh: 那场演讲就像是向金主们的政治屈服。

e.en: Make sure the leather bag is {genuine} before paying.
e.zh: 付款前先确认这只皮包是真品。

e.en: She showed {genuine} concern for her teammate's health.
e.zh: 她对队友的健康表现出真诚的关心。

e.en: I'm {genuinely} sorry about how the meeting went.
e.zh: 对于会议的进展,我真的很抱歉。

e.en: He {genuinely} believes the app will change daily life.
e.zh: 他真心相信这款应用会改变日常生活。

e.en: Experts verified the {genuineness} of the signed painting.
e.zh: 专家鉴定了这幅签名画作的真实性。

e.en: Her {genuineness} made strangers open up quickly.
e.zh: 她的真诚让陌生人很快敞开心扉。

e.en: The oak belongs to the {genus} Quercus.
e.zh: 橡树属于栎属。

e.en: Scientists discovered a new beetle {genus} in the rainforest.
e.zh: 科学家在雨林中发现了一个新的甲虫属。

geo.t: n. 地理位置（geography/geographic 缩写）

e.en: The app uses {geo} data to suggest nearby restaurants.
e.zh: 该应用利用地理数据推荐附近的餐厅。

e.en: Disable {geo} tracking in the privacy settings if you prefer.
e.zh: 如果你介意,可在隐私设置中关闭地理追踪。

e.en: Ancient astronomers held a {geocentric} view of the universe.
e.zh: 古代天文学家持地心说的宇宙观。

e.en: Copernicus replaced the {geocentric} model with a heliocentric one.
e.zh: 哥白尼用日心说取代了地心说模型。

e.en: They ran {geochemical} tests on the volcanic rock samples.
e.zh: 他们对火山岩样本进行了地球化学检测。

e.en: The {geochemical} signature suggests the water came from deep underground.
e.zh: 地球化学特征表明这水来自地下深处。

e.en: The {geochemist} analyzed isotopes in the meteorite fragments.
e.zh: 那位地球化学家分析了陨石碎片中的同位素。

e.en: She trained as a {geochemist} before joining the oil company.
e.zh: 她在加入石油公司前学的是地球化学。

e.en: He's pursuing a PhD in {geochemistry} at Stanford.
e.zh: 他正在斯坦福攻读地球化学博士学位。

e.en: {Geochemistry} explains how minerals form deep within the Earth.
e.zh: 地球化学解释了矿物如何在地球深处形成。

geode.t: n. 晶洞石；内含矿晶的空心岩石

e.en: She cracked open a {geode} and found purple crystals inside.
e.zh: 她敲开一块晶洞,里面是紫色的晶体。

e.en: The gift shop sold polished {geode} slices as bookends.
e.zh: 礼品店把抛光的晶洞切片当书挡卖。

geodesic.t:
adj. 测地线的
n. 测地线

e.en: The park's {geodesic} dome houses a small rainforest exhibit.
e.zh: 公园里的网格穹顶里展出着一个小型雨林。

e.en: Pilots fly along a {geodesic} path to save fuel.
e.zh: 飞行员沿大圆航线飞行以节省燃油。

e.en: Surveyors used {geodetic} satellites to map the coastline.
e.zh: 测量员用大地测量卫星绘制了海岸线地图。

e.en: The bridge's location was fixed using precise {geodetic} coordinates.
e.zh: 这座桥的位置是用精确的大地坐标确定的。

e.en: {Geoeconomics} studies how trade is used as political leverage.
e.zh: 地缘经济学研究贸易如何被用作政治筹码。

e.en: Sanctions have become a key tool of modern {geoeconomics}.
e.zh: 制裁已成为当代地缘经济学的重要工具。

geoengineering.t: n. 地球工程（气候干预技术）

e.en: Some scientists view {geoengineering} as a last-resort climate fix.
e.zh: 一些科学家把地球工程视为应对气候的最后手段。

e.en: Critics warn that {geoengineering} could trigger unforeseen side effects.
e.zh: 批评者警告地球工程可能引发意想不到的副作用。

e.en: The {geographer} mapped how cities expand into farmland.
e.zh: 这位地理学家绘制了城市向农田扩张的过程。

e.en: As a {geographer}, she studies migration patterns across borders.
e.zh: 作为地理学家,她研究跨境迁徙的模式。

e.en: The disease spread followed clear {geographic} patterns.
e.zh: 该疾病的传播呈现明显的地理分布特征。

e.en: Netflix licenses content based on {geographic} regions.
e.zh: 网飞按地理区域授权内容。

e.en: Mountains form a natural {geographical} barrier between the two countries.
e.zh: 群山形成了两国之间天然的地理屏障。

e.en: The dataset is filtered by {geographical} location.
e.zh: 数据集按地理位置进行了筛选。

geographically.t: adv. 从地理上；就地理而言

e.en: The two offices are {geographically} far apart but tightly coordinated.
e.zh: 两个办公室地理上相距甚远,但协作紧密。

e.en: Their customers are {geographically} concentrated in Southeast Asia.
e.zh: 他们的客户在地理上集中于东南亚。

geographies.t: n. 地理学；地理分布（geography 复数）

e.en: The company operates across diverse {geographies} and currencies.
e.zh: 公司在多个地区和币种之间开展业务。

e.en: Different {geographies} require different marketing strategies.
e.zh: 不同地区需要不同的营销策略。

e.en: She teaches {geography} at a small high school.
e.zh: 她在一所小型高中教地理。

e.en: Local {geography} makes building a railway here very expensive.
e.zh: 当地的地形使在这里修铁路成本很高。

e.en: The canyon reveals millions of years of {geologic} history.
e.zh: 这条峡谷展现了数百万年的地质历史。

e.en: Engineers studied the {geologic} conditions before drilling.
e.zh: 工程师在钻探前研究了地质条件。

e.en: The earthquake was caused by {geological} stress along the fault.
e.zh: 这次地震是由断层处的地质应力引起的。

e.en: She joined a {geological} survey of the Andes.
e.zh: 她加入了一支安第斯山脉的地质考察队。

e.en: Iceland is {geologically} very young and still active.
e.zh: 冰岛在地质上非常年轻,且仍在活跃中。

e.en: The region is {geologically} stable, ideal for the observatory.
e.zh: 该地区地质稳定,非常适合建天文台。

geologies.t: n. 地质情况（geology 复数）

e.en: The two islands have remarkably different {geologies}.
e.zh: 这两座岛屿的地质结构截然不同。

e.en: Mining engineers must adapt to local {geologies}.
e.zh: 采矿工程师必须适应当地的地质条件。

e.en: The {geologist} collected rock samples from the riverbed.
e.zh: 地质学家从河床采集了岩石样本。

e.en: A {geologist} warned that the cliff was unstable.
e.zh: 一位地质学家警告说那座悬崖不稳定。

e.en: He switched majors from biology to {geology}.
e.zh: 他把专业从生物学换成了地质学。

e.en: The region's {geology} makes it rich in copper deposits.
e.zh: 该地区的地质条件使其铜矿储量丰富。

e.en: A {geomagnetic} storm disrupted satellite communications overnight.
e.zh: 一场地磁暴在夜间扰乱了卫星通讯。

e.en: Birds use Earth's {geomagnetic} field to navigate during migration.
e.zh: 鸟类在迁徙时利用地球的地磁场导航。

geometric.t: adj. 几何的；几何图形的

e.en: The wallpaper has a bold {geometric} pattern of triangles.
e.zh: 那款壁纸有醒目的三角形几何图案。

e.en: Cases grew at a {geometric} rate during the outbreak.
e.zh: 疫情爆发期间病例以几何速度增长。

geometrical.t: adj. 几何的；几何图形的

e.en: He admires the {geometrical} precision of Islamic tile work.
e.zh: 他欣赏伊斯兰瓷砖工艺的几何精准。

e.en: The logo uses simple {geometrical} shapes for clarity.
e.zh: 该标志使用简单的几何形状以保持清晰。

geometrically.t: adv. 以几何方式；按几何级数地

e.en: The cells multiply {geometrically} in ideal conditions.
e.zh: 在理想条件下,这些细胞呈几何级数倍增。

e.en: The garden was laid out {geometrically}, with perfect symmetry.
e.zh: 花园按几何方式布置,完全对称。

e.en: Euclid is regarded as the founding {geometrician} of the West.
e.zh: 欧几里得被视为西方几何学的奠基人。

e.en: A skilled {geometrician} solved the puzzle in minutes.
e.zh: 一位熟练的几何学家几分钟就解开了这道难题。

geometrics.t: n. 几何图案；几何图形设计

e.en: The artist's {geometrics} fill an entire wall of the gallery.
e.zh: 这位艺术家的几何作品占满了画廊整面墙。

e.en: Modern fashion often borrows {geometrics} from Bauhaus design.
e.zh: 现代时尚常借鉴包豪斯设计中的几何元素。

geometry.t:
n. 几何学
n. 几何结构、形状

e.en: I struggled with {geometry} more than algebra in school.
e.zh: 上学时我比起代数更怵几何。

e.en: The car's aerodynamic {geometry} reduces fuel consumption.
e.zh: 这辆车的空气动力学外形降低了油耗。

e.en: Glaciers leave distinctive {geomorphic} features across the valley.
e.zh: 冰川在山谷中留下了独特的地貌特征。

e.en: The river's {geomorphic} changes were tracked over decades.
e.zh: 研究人员数十年来追踪着这条河的地貌变化。

e.en: They published a {geomorphological} map of the coastline.
e.zh: 他们发表了一份海岸线的地貌图。

e.en: {Geomorphological} surveys help predict landslide risks.
e.zh: 地貌调查有助于预测滑坡风险。

e.en: The {geomorphologist} studied how the dunes shift each year.
e.zh: 那位地貌学家研究沙丘每年如何移动。

e.en: As a {geomorphologist}, he reads landscapes like a history book.
e.zh: 作为地貌学家,他把地形当作史书来解读。

e.en: Her PhD focused on coastal {geomorphology} and erosion.
e.zh: 她的博士论文聚焦于海岸地貌与侵蚀。

e.en: {Geomorphology} explains why mountains weather into rolling hills.
e.zh: 地貌学解释了山脉如何风化成连绵丘陵。

e.en: The team conducted a {geophysical} survey before drilling.
e.zh: 团队在钻探前进行了地球物理勘测。

e.en: {Geophysical} sensors detected the deep underground tremor.
e.zh: 地球物理传感器探测到了地下深处的震动。

e.en: The {geophysicist} interpreted the seismic data overnight.
e.zh: 那位地球物理学家连夜解读了地震数据。

e.en: She works as a {geophysicist} for an offshore wind company.
e.zh: 她在一家海上风电公司担任地球物理学家。

e.en: Modern oil exploration relies heavily on {geophysics}.
e.zh: 现代石油勘探在很大程度上依赖地球物理学。

e.en: He took a {geophysics} elective and ended up changing majors.
e.zh: 他选修了一门地球物理学,结果转了专业。

e.en: Rising {geopolitical} tensions are pushing up energy prices.
e.zh: 地缘政治紧张加剧推高了能源价格。

e.en: The chip industry is caught in a {geopolitical} tug-of-war.
e.zh: 芯片产业被卷入了地缘政治的拉锯战。

e.en: Supply chains can no longer ignore {geopolitics}.
e.zh: 供应链再也无法忽视地缘政治了。

e.en: The podcast breaks down Asian {geopolitics} every week.
e.zh: 这档播客每周解读亚洲的地缘政治。

geordie.t: n. 英国泰恩赛德地区人及其方言

e.en: His thick {Geordie} accent made him hard to understand at first.
e.zh: 他浓重的纽卡斯尔口音让人一开始很难听懂。

e.en: She grew up a proud {Geordie} on the banks of the Tyne.
e.zh: 她在泰恩河畔长大,是个自豪的纽卡斯尔人。

e.en: {George} forgot his umbrella and got soaked on the way home.
e.zh: 乔治忘了带伞,回家路上被淋成了落汤鸡。

e.en: She named her cat {George} after her grandfather.
e.zh: 她以祖父的名字给猫取名乔治。

georges.t: n. 男子名（法语）；George 的复数

e.en: Both {Georges} in the team scored goals on Saturday.
e.zh: 队里两位叫乔治的球员周六都进了球。

e.en: Hurricane {Georges} caused widespread damage in the Caribbean.
e.zh: 飓风乔治在加勒比地区造成了大范围破坏。

e.en: She studied law at {Georgetown} University in Washington.
e.zh: 她在华盛顿的乔治城大学读法律。

e.en: We had brunch at a quiet café in {Georgetown}.
e.zh: 我们在乔治城一家安静的咖啡馆吃了早午餐。

georgette.t:
n. 乔其纱（一种薄绸）
n. 女子名

e.en: The bridesmaid dresses were made of pale pink {georgette}.
e.zh: 伴娘裙是用淡粉色乔其纱做的。

e.en: She wore a flowing {georgette} blouse to the summer wedding.
e.zh: 她穿了一件飘逸的乔其纱衬衫去参加夏日婚礼。

georgia.t: n. 美国佐治亚州；格鲁吉亚；女子名

e.en: Peaches from {Georgia} are famous across the United States.
e.zh: 佐治亚州的桃子在全美都很有名。

e.en: {Georgia} sits at the crossroads of Europe and Asia.
e.zh: 格鲁吉亚位于欧亚交界处。

georgian.t:
adj. 格鲁吉亚的；乔治王时代的
n. 格鲁吉亚人/语

e.en: They bought a beautiful {Georgian} townhouse in central Bath.
e.zh: 他们在巴斯市中心买了一栋漂亮的乔治王朝风格联排别墅。

e.en: The restaurant serves traditional {Georgian} dumplings called khinkali.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应传统的格鲁吉亚饺子,叫做欣卡利。

e.en: She majored in {geoscience} to study earthquakes and volcanoes.
e.zh: 她主修地球科学，研究地震和火山。

e.en: The {geoscience} department received new funding for climate research.
e.zh: 地球科学系获得了新的气候研究资金。

e.en: Weather satellites orbit in a {geostationary} position above the equator.
e.zh: 气象卫星在赤道上空保持地球同步轨道。

e.en: The {geostationary} satellite always appears fixed in the sky.
e.zh: 这颗地球静止卫星在天空中看起来始终不动。

e.en: The island holds {geostrategic} importance for trade routes.
e.zh: 该岛屿对贸易航线具有重大地缘战略意义。

e.en: Analysts debated the {geostrategic} implications of the new alliance.
e.zh: 分析人士讨论了新联盟的地缘战略影响。

e.en: The company launched a new {geosynchronous} communications satellite.
e.zh: 该公司发射了一颗新的地球同步通信卫星。

e.en: Engineers placed the probe in a {geosynchronous} orbit.
e.zh: 工程师把探测器送入了地球同步轨道。

e.en: Iceland generates much of its power from {geothermal} energy.
e.zh: 冰岛大部分电力来自地热能。

e.en: They installed a {geothermal} heat pump in the new house.
e.zh: 他们在新房里安装了地热热泵。

e.en: The nomadic family lives in a traditional Mongolian {ger}.
e.zh: 这个游牧家庭住在传统的蒙古包里。

e.en: Tourists can rent a {ger} on the open steppe.
e.zh: 游客可以在开阔的草原上租一座蒙古包。

e.en: She planted a red {geranium} in the window box.
e.zh: 她在窗台花箱里种了一株红色天竺葵。

e.en: The balcony was full of blooming {geranium} pots.
e.zh: 阳台上摆满了盛开的天竺葵盆栽。

gerbil.t: n. 沙鼠（宠物小型啮齿动物）

e.en: My daughter keeps a {gerbil} as her first pet.
e.zh: 我女儿养了一只沙鼠作为她的第一只宠物。

e.en: The {gerbil} ran tirelessly on its little wheel.
e.zh: 那只沙鼠在小转轮上不知疲倦地跑着。

geriatric.t:
adj. 老年的；老年医学的
n. 老年人

e.en: She specializes in {geriatric} care at the hospital.
e.zh: 她在医院专门从事老年护理工作。

e.en: Our old dog needs a {geriatric} checkup soon.
e.zh: 我们家的老狗很快需要做一次老年体检。

e.en: The {geriatrician} adjusted my grandmother's medication list.
e.zh: 那位老年病医生调整了我祖母的用药清单。

e.en: Finding a good {geriatrician} can be difficult in rural areas.
e.zh: 在农村地区，找到一位好的老年科医生并不容易。

germ.t:
n. 细菌、病菌
n. 萌芽、起源

e.en: Wash your hands to kill any lingering {germ}.
e.zh: 勤洗手以杀死残留的细菌。

e.en: The idea began as a tiny {germ} in his notebook.
e.zh: 这个想法最初只是他笔记本里的一点萌芽。

german.t:
adj. 德国的
n. 德国人；德语

e.en: She studied {german} for three years in college.
e.zh: 她在大学里学了三年德语。

e.en: The {german} engineer redesigned the entire factory line.
e.zh: 那位德国工程师重新设计了整条工厂生产线。

germane.t: adj. 密切相关的；贴切的

e.en: Please keep your comments {germane} to the topic.
e.zh: 请让你的评论与话题相关。

e.en: That detail is hardly {germane} to our decision.
e.zh: 那个细节与我们的决定关系不大。

gewgaws.t: n. 华而不实的小玩意；廉价饰品

e.en: The shop was full of cheap {gewgaws} aimed at tourists.
e.zh: 店里摆满了专门卖给游客的廉价小玩意儿。

e.en: She refused to clutter her desk with useless {gewgaws}.
e.zh: 她不愿在桌上堆放那些没用的小摆设。

geyser.t:
n. 间歇喷泉
n. (英) 热水器

e.en: Old Faithful is the most famous {geyser} in Yellowstone.
e.zh: 老忠实泉是黄石公园里最有名的间歇泉。

e.en: Hot water shot up like a {geyser} from the broken pipe.
e.zh: 热水从破裂的管道里像间歇泉一样喷涌而出。

e.en: My {ggf} emigrated from Italy in the early 1900s.
e.zh: 我的曾祖父在 1900 年代初从意大利移民过来。

e.en: Genealogy sites often abbreviate great-grandfather as {ggf} in family trees.
e.zh: 族谱网站常把曾祖父在家谱中缩写成 ggf。

e.en: {Ghana} is known for its rich cocoa industry and friendly people.
e.zh: 加纳以丰富的可可产业和热情友好的人民闻名。

e.en: She spent a summer teaching English in northern {Ghana}.
e.zh: 她在加纳北部度过了一个教英语的暑假。

ghanaian.t:
adj. 加纳的
n. 加纳人

e.en: The {Ghanaian} jollof rice was the best dish at the party.
e.zh: 加纳风味的炒饭是聚会上最好吃的一道菜。

e.en: Many {Ghanaian} students study engineering abroad each year.
e.zh: 每年都有许多加纳学生出国学习工程专业。

e.en: People often misspell Gandhi's name as {Ghandi} online.
e.zh: 网上人们常把甘地的名字错拼成 Ghandi。

e.en: The teacher corrected the student who wrote {Ghandi} on the test.
e.zh: 老师纠正了在试卷上把甘地写成 Ghandi 的学生。

ghastly.t: adj. 可怕的；惨白的；糟透的

e.en: She looked {ghastly} after staying up all night studying.
e.zh: 她熬了一整夜复习,看起来面色惨白。

e.en: The accident scene was absolutely {ghastly} to witness.
e.zh: 事故现场看起来实在是惨不忍睹。

ghat.t: n. (印度) 河边石阶；山道

e.en: Pilgrims gather at the {ghat} along the Ganges at dawn.
e.zh: 清晨时分,朝圣者聚集在恒河边的石阶上。

e.en: We watched the sunset from a riverside {ghat} in Varanasi.
e.zh: 我们在瓦拉纳西的河边石阶上看了日落。

ghee.t: n. 印度酥油；澄清黄油

e.en: Indian cooking often uses {ghee} instead of regular butter.
e.zh: 印度菜常常用酥油代替普通黄油。

e.en: She fried the spices in {ghee} until they smelled fragrant.
e.zh: 她用酥油煎香料,煎到香气四溢。

e.en: {Ghent} is a charming medieval city in Belgium.
e.zh: 根特是比利时一座迷人的中世纪城市。

e.en: We took a day trip from Brussels to {Ghent} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们从布鲁塞尔到根特做了一日游。

e.en: Add a sliced {gherkin} to the burger for some crunch.
e.zh: 在汉堡里加一片小酸黄瓜增加点脆感。

e.en: The Tower nicknamed The {Gherkin} dominates London's skyline.
e.zh: 被称为小黄瓜的那栋大楼是伦敦天际线的标志。

ghetto.t: n. 贫民区；少数族裔聚居区

e.en: He grew up in a poor {ghetto} on the city's edge.
e.zh: 他在城市边缘的贫民区长大。

e.en: The film documents life in the Warsaw {ghetto} during the war.
e.zh: 这部电影记录了战时华沙犹太区的生活。

e.en: Many immigrant communities once lived in crowded urban {ghettoes}.
e.zh: 许多移民群体曾生活在拥挤的城市贫民区里。

e.en: The book traces how {ghettoes} formed in industrial cities.
e.zh: 这本书追溯了贫民区在工业城市中形成的过程。

e.en: The report criticizes the {ghettoization} of low-income families.
e.zh: 这份报告批评了把低收入家庭隔离成贫民区的做法。

e.en: Urban planners want to prevent further {ghettoization} of minority neighborhoods.
e.zh: 城市规划者希望防止少数族裔社区进一步贫民区化。

ghettoize.t: v. 使沦为贫民区；使被隔离

e.en: Critics say streaming platforms {ghettoize} foreign films into niche categories.
e.zh: 批评者说流媒体平台把外国电影边缘化进了小众分类。

e.en: We shouldn't {ghettoize} women's writing as a separate genre.
e.zh: 我们不应把女性写作单独划成一个边缘类别。

ghia.t: n. 吉亚（福特高配车型名）

e.en: He restored a 1965 Volkswagen Karmann {Ghia} in his garage.
e.zh: 他在车库里修复了一辆 1965 年的大众卡曼吉亚。

e.en: The Karmann {Ghia} remains a beloved classic among collectors.
e.zh: 卡曼吉亚至今仍是收藏者钟爱的经典车型。

ghost.t:
n. 鬼魂
v. 突然断联（聊天中不回）

e.en: Children dressed as a {ghost} for the Halloween party.
e.zh: 孩子们打扮成幽灵参加万圣节派对。

e.en: He decided to {ghost} her after their third bad date.
e.zh: 第三次糟糕约会后,他决定不再回复她的消息。

e.en: My kids watch {Ghostbusters} every Halloween without fail.
e.zh: 我的孩子们每年万圣节都必看《捉鬼敢死队》。

e.en: The original {Ghostbusters} theme song is still incredibly catchy.
e.zh: 《捉鬼敢死队》最初的主题曲到现在还非常洗脑。

ghostlike.t: adj. 幽灵似的；鬼魅般的

e.en: A {ghostlike} fog rolled in over the silent harbor.
e.zh: 一层幽灵般的浓雾笼罩了寂静的港口。

e.en: Her {ghostlike} pale face startled everyone at the door.
e.zh: 她那张幽灵般苍白的脸把门口的所有人都吓了一跳。

e.en: A {ghostly} figure appeared briefly in the security footage.
e.zh: 监控录像中短暂出现了一个鬼魅般的身影。

e.en: The empty mansion had a {ghostly} silence about it.
e.zh: 那座空荡荡的宅邸里弥漫着幽灵般的寂静。

e.en: She doesn't believe in {ghosts}, but the house still scares her.
e.zh: 她不相信有鬼,但那房子还是让她害怕。

e.en: The old hotel is supposedly haunted by several {ghosts}.
e.zh: 那家老旅馆据说闹鬼,有好几只幽灵出没。

ghostwriter.t: n. 代笔作家；枪手写手

e.en: The celebrity hired a {ghostwriter} to finish her memoir.
e.zh: 那位明星雇了一位代笔作家完成她的回忆录。

e.en: Many bestsellers are actually written by an uncredited {ghostwriter}.
e.zh: 许多畅销书其实是由不署名的代笔人写成的。

e.en: The horror movie features a flesh-eating {ghoul} in the cemetery.
e.zh: 那部恐怖片里有个在墓地吃尸体的食尸鬼。

e.en: He dressed as a hideous {ghoul} for the costume contest.
e.zh: 他在服装比赛中扮成一个面目狰狞的食尸鬼。

ghoulish.t: adj. 食尸鬼般的；残忍猎奇的

e.en: The crowd showed a {ghoulish} fascination with the crash scene.
e.zh: 人群对车祸现场流露出一种病态的好奇。

e.en: She has a {ghoulish} sense of humor about death.
e.zh: 她对死亡这件事有种阴森的幽默感。

e.en: Orders came directly from {GHQ} to retreat to the coast.
e.zh: 撤往海岸的命令直接来自总司令部。

e.en: The general flew back to {GHQ} for an urgent briefing.
e.zh: 将军飞回总司令部参加一场紧急简报会。

ghs.t: abbr. 全球化学品统一分类标签制度

e.en: All chemical labels must comply with {GHS} hazard standards.
e.zh: 所有化学品标签都必须符合 GHS 危险品标准。

e.en: Our supplier updated its safety sheets to the latest {GHS} format.
e.zh: 我们的供应商把安全数据表更新到了最新的 GHS 格式。

e.en: We hiked up a narrow {ghyll} in the Lake District.
e.zh: 我们沿着湖区一条狭窄的山涧往上徒步。

e.en: A small stream tumbled through the rocky {ghyll}.
e.zh: 一条小溪从那条岩石嶙峋的山涧中奔流而下。

giacometti.t: n. 贾科梅蒂（瑞士雕塑家）

e.en: The museum acquired a tall, thin {Giacometti} sculpture last year.
e.zh: 博物馆去年收购了一件细长的贾科梅蒂雕塑。

e.en: {Giacometti}'s elongated figures are instantly recognizable.
e.zh: 贾科梅蒂笔下细长的人物形象一眼就能认出来。

giant.t:
adj. 巨大的
n. 巨人；巨头

e.en: Amazon has become a tech {giant} over the past decade.
e.zh: 过去十年里,亚马逊已经成长为一家科技巨头。

e.en: The kids stared up at the {giant} redwood in awe.
e.zh: 孩子们仰望着那棵巨大的红杉,惊叹不已。

e.en: In the fairy tale, a {giantess} guards the mountain pass.
e.zh: 童话里,一位女巨人守卫着那处山口。

e.en: She played a friendly {giantess} in the children's musical.
e.zh: 她在那部儿童音乐剧里扮演一位友善的女巨人。

e.en: The San Francisco {Giants} won the game in extra innings.
e.zh: 旧金山巨人队在加时局赢下了那场比赛。

e.en: Tech {giants} like Google dominate the search market.
e.zh: 像谷歌这样的科技巨头主宰着搜索市场。

giardia.t: n. 贾第鞭毛虫（寄生虫）

e.en: Hikers should filter water to avoid catching {giardia}.
e.zh: 徒步者应过滤饮用水,以免感染贾第虫。

e.en: The dog was treated for {giardia} after drinking from the pond.
e.zh: 那只狗喝了池塘水之后接受了贾第虫感染的治疗。

e.en: Symptoms of {giardiasis} include diarrhea and stomach cramps.
e.zh: 贾第虫病的症状包括腹泻和胃痉挛。

e.en: The clinic confirmed her illness was {giardiasis} from contaminated water.
e.zh: 诊所确认她的病是因喝了受污染的水患上的贾第虫病。

e.en: He wedged a small {gib} into the joint to hold it tight.
e.zh: 他把一块小楔片塞进接缝里,把它固定紧。

e.en: The old tomcat in the barn is a friendly {gib}.
e.zh: 谷仓里那只老公猫是只很亲人的阉公猫。

gibber.t: v. 语无伦次地说；急促乱语

e.en: The frightened toddler began to {gibber} incoherently.
e.zh: 受惊的小孩开始语无伦次地胡言乱语。

e.en: Don't just {gibber} when the interviewer asks tough questions.
e.zh: 面试官问难题时,可别只会语无伦次地乱讲。

gibbering.t: adj. 语无伦次的；乱语的

e.en: He was a {gibbering} wreck after pulling three all-nighters.
e.zh: 连熬三个通宵之后,他已经语无伦次,精神崩溃了。

e.en: The {gibbering} crowd outside the stadium grew louder.
e.zh: 体育馆外吵吵嚷嚷的人群声音越来越大。

gibberish.t: n. 胡言乱语；莫名其妙的话

e.en: The legal contract sounded like {gibberish} to most readers.
e.zh: 那份法律合同对大多数读者来说就像天书一样难懂。

e.en: My phone autocorrected my message into total {gibberish}.
e.zh: 我的手机把我的消息自动改成了一堆乱七八糟的废话。

gibbet.t:
n. 绞刑架
v. 处绞刑

e.en: In medieval times, criminals were hung on a public {gibbet}.
e.zh: 在中世纪,罪犯会被吊在公共绞刑架上示众。

e.en: A rusty old {gibbet} still stands at the crossroads.
e.zh: 一座生锈的老绞刑架至今仍立在那个十字路口。

e.en: A {gibbon} swung gracefully between the trees at the zoo.
e.zh: 动物园里一只长臂猿在树间优雅地荡来荡去。

e.en: The {gibbon} is an endangered ape native to Southeast Asia.
e.zh: 长臂猿是一种原产于东南亚的濒危猿类。

gibbons.t: n. 长臂猿（复数）；吉本斯（姓）

e.en: We saw several {gibbons} calling loudly in the rainforest canopy.
e.zh: 我们看到几只长臂猿在雨林树冠上大声鸣叫。

e.en: Edward {Gibbons} wrote a famous history of the Roman Empire.
e.zh: 爱德华·吉本斯写了一部著名的罗马帝国史。

germanic.t: adj. 日耳曼的；德意志的

e.en: English shares many {germanic} roots with Dutch and German.
e.zh: 英语和荷兰语、德语有许多共同的日耳曼语词根。

e.en: The architecture had a distinctly {germanic} feel.
e.zh: 这种建筑有一种鲜明的日耳曼风格。

germanium.t: n. 锗（化学元素，符号 Ge）

e.en: Early transistors were made from {germanium} crystals.
e.zh: 早期的晶体管是用锗晶体制成的。

e.en: Solar cells sometimes contain a thin {germanium} layer.
e.zh: 太阳能电池有时含有一层薄薄的锗。

e.en: They moved to {germany} for a research fellowship.
e.zh: 他们因一项研究奖学金搬到了德国。

e.en: {germany} is famous for its precision engineering.
e.zh: 德国以其精密工程闻名于世。

e.en: The hospital sprays a strong {germicide} on every surface.
e.zh: 医院在每个表面都喷洒强力杀菌剂。

e.en: Bleach is a cheap and effective {germicide}.
e.zh: 漂白剂是一种便宜有效的杀菌剂。

germinal.t:
adj. 萌芽的；初期的
adj. 胚的；生殖细胞的

e.en: His thesis is still in its {germinal} stage.
e.zh: 他的论文还处于萌芽阶段。

e.en: That paper became a {germinal} work in modern linguistics.
e.zh: 那篇论文成为现代语言学的开创性著作。

germinate.t: v. 发芽；萌发（想法、计划）

e.en: These seeds will {germinate} within about ten days.
e.zh: 这些种子会在大约十天内发芽。

e.en: New ideas often {germinate} during long walks.
e.zh: 新点子常常在长时间散步时萌发。

e.en: Warm soil speeds up {germination} for most vegetables.
e.zh: 温暖的土壤会加快大多数蔬菜的发芽。

e.en: The {germination} rate of these seeds was disappointingly low.
e.zh: 这些种子的发芽率低得令人失望。

e.en: Scientists debate the ethics of editing the human {germline}.
e.zh: 科学家们就编辑人类生殖系的伦理问题展开辩论。

e.en: This mutation was inherited through the {germline}.
e.zh: 这种突变是通过生殖细胞遗传下来的。

e.en: The vault preserves rare crop {germplasm} for future generations.
e.zh: 该库为后代保存了珍稀作物的种质资源。

e.en: Researchers exchanged {germplasm} samples between labs.
e.zh: 研究人员在实验室之间交换种质样本。

e.en: Cover your mouth so you don't spread {germs}.
e.zh: 咳嗽时捂住嘴，免得传播细菌。

e.en: Door handles are usually covered in {germs}.
e.zh: 门把手上通常布满了细菌。

gerontocracy.t: n. 老人统治；老人政治

e.en: Critics called the senate an outdated {gerontocracy}.
e.zh: 批评者称这个参议院是过时的老人统治。

e.en: The country slowly drifted toward a quiet {gerontocracy}.
e.zh: 这个国家悄然滑向一种老人政治。

e.en: She presented her {gerontological} research at the conference.
e.zh: 她在会议上介绍了她的老年学研究。

e.en: The university opened a new {gerontological} center.
e.zh: 该大学新设立了一个老年学研究中心。

gerontologist.t: n. 老年学家；老年医学专家

e.en: The {gerontologist} studies how memory changes with age.
e.zh: 那位老年学家研究记忆如何随年龄变化。

e.en: A leading {gerontologist} advised the city on aging policy.
e.zh: 一位顶尖老年学家就老龄化政策为该市提供建议。

e.en: She earned a master's degree in {gerontology}.
e.zh: 她获得了老年学硕士学位。

e.en: {gerontology} examines the social and biological side of aging.
e.zh: 老年学研究衰老的社会层面和生物层面。

gerrymander.t:
v. 不公正地划分选区
n. 选区划分舞弊

e.en: Lawmakers tried to {gerrymander} the district lines for advantage.
e.zh: 立法者试图通过划分选区来谋取优势。

e.en: Courts can strike down attempts to {gerrymander} maps.
e.zh: 法院可以驳回操纵选区地图的企图。

gerrymandered.t: adj. 被不公正划分的（选区）

e.en: The {gerrymandered} district stretched in a strange snake shape.
e.zh: 这个被操纵划分的选区呈奇怪的蛇形延伸。

e.en: Critics said the map was clearly {gerrymandered}.
e.zh: 批评者表示这张地图显然是被操纵划分的。

gerrymandering.t: n. 不公正划分选区的行为

e.en: Activists are fighting partisan {gerrymandering} in several states.
e.zh: 活动人士正在多个州反对党派化的选区操纵。

e.en: {gerrymandering} can make elections far less competitive.
e.zh: 选区操纵会让选举的竞争性大大降低。

gesellschaft.t: n. 法理社会（社会学术语，相对 Gemeinschaft）

e.en: Sociologists contrast {gesellschaft} with close-knit village life.
e.zh: 社会学家把法理社会与紧密的乡村生活相对比。

e.en: Modern cities largely operate as a {gesellschaft}.
e.zh: 现代城市大体上以法理社会的方式运作。

gesso.t: n. 石膏底料（绘画打底用）

e.en: She brushed white {gesso} onto the canvas before painting.
e.zh: 她在作画前给画布刷上一层白色石膏底料。

e.en: A smooth layer of {gesso} helps paint adhere properly.
e.zh: 平整的石膏底层有助于颜料牢固附着。

e.en: He bought a stack of pre-{gessoed} canvases for the workshop.
e.zh: 他为工作坊买了一摞涂好底料的画布。

e.en: The {gessoed} board felt smooth under her brush.
e.zh: 那块涂过石膏底料的板在画笔下感觉很光滑。

gestalt.t: n. 格式塔；完形（心理学整体概念）

e.en: The whole song's {gestalt} matters more than any single note.
e.zh: 整首歌的整体感比任何单个音符都重要。

e.en: Designers study {gestalt} principles to guide the eye.
e.zh: 设计师研究格式塔原理来引导视线。

gestapo.t: n. 盖世太保（纳粹秘密警察）

e.en: The novel describes families hiding from the {gestapo}.
e.zh: 小说描写了一些家庭躲避盖世太保的故事。

e.en: Documents reveal how the {gestapo} tracked dissenters.
e.zh: 档案揭示了盖世太保如何追踪异见者。

e.en: Elephants {gestate} for nearly two years before giving birth.
e.zh: 大象的妊娠期接近两年才会分娩。

e.en: Let the idea {gestate} a few weeks before deciding.
e.zh: 让这个想法酝酿几周再做决定。

gestation.t:
n. 妊娠期
n. 酝酿；孕育过程

e.en: Human {gestation} typically lasts about forty weeks.
e.zh: 人类的妊娠期通常约为四十周。

e.en: The project had a long {gestation} before launch.
e.zh: 这个项目在推出前经过了长时间的酝酿。

e.en: The doctor monitored her {gestational} diabetes carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细监控她的妊娠糖尿病。

e.en: Ultrasounds estimate the baby's {gestational} age.
e.zh: 超声波可以估算胎儿的孕周。

geste.t: n. 功绩；英勇事迹（罕用）

e.en: The medieval {geste} celebrated knights and their battles.
e.zh: 那部中世纪武功歌颂扬骑士及其战役。

e.en: Scholars analyzed the old French {geste} for historical clues.
e.zh: 学者们分析这部古法语武功歌以寻找历史线索。

e.en: He tends to {gesticulate} wildly when telling stories.
e.zh: 他讲故事时往往会激动地比手画脚。

e.en: Italian speakers often {gesticulate} to add emphasis.
e.zh: 意大利语使用者常常用手势来强调语气。

e.en: His lively {gesticulation} kept the audience engaged.
e.zh: 他生动的手势让观众一直专注。

e.en: She apologized with an exaggerated {gesticulation}.
e.zh: 她用夸张的手势表达了歉意。

e.en: Touchscreens rely on simple {gestural} controls.
e.zh: 触摸屏依赖于简单的手势操作。

e.en: Her painting style is loose and {gestural}.
e.zh: 她的绘画风格自由而富有手势感。

gesture.t:
n. 手势；姿态
n. 表示（友好、抗议等的举动）

e.en: He made a small {gesture} of thanks toward the driver.
e.zh: 他对司机做了个小小的感谢手势。

e.en: Sending flowers was a kind {gesture} after the loss.
e.zh: 在那次损失之后送花是个体贴的举动。

e.en: Her {gestures} made the explanation much easier to follow.
e.zh: 她的手势让解释变得容易理解多了。

e.en: Small {gestures} of kindness can change someone's day.
e.zh: 小小的善举就能改变某人的一天。

gesturing.t: v. 做手势；用动作示意

e.en: She kept {gesturing} toward the back of the room.
e.zh: 她不停地朝房间后部比划。

e.en: He was {gesturing} excitedly while sharing the news.
e.zh: 他兴奋地一边比划一边分享这个消息。

get.t:
v. 得到；获取
v. 变成；到达

e.en: I'll {get} some coffee on the way to work.
e.zh: 我上班路上去买点咖啡。

e.en: Did you {get} my message about tomorrow's meeting?
e.zh: 你收到我关于明天会议的消息了吗？

e.en: We booked a weekend {getaway} at a beach cabin.
e.zh: 我们订了一个周末的海边小屋度假。

e.en: The robbers used a black van as their {getaway}.
e.zh: 劫匪用一辆黑色面包车作为逃跑工具。

getaways.t: n. 逃跑；短途度假（复数）

e.en: Short weekend {getaways} help me recharge between projects.
e.zh: 短途的周末出游帮我在项目间充电。

e.en: The website lists romantic mountain {getaways} for couples.
e.zh: 该网站列出了适合情侣的浪漫山间度假地。

gethsemane.t: n. 客西马尼园（《圣经》地名）

e.en: The painting depicts Jesus praying in {gethsemane}.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘了耶稣在客西马尼园祷告的情景。

e.en: Pilgrims often visit the garden of {gethsemane} in Jerusalem.
e.zh: 朝圣者常常造访耶路撒冷的客西马尼园。

gets.t: v. 得到；变成（get 第三人称单数）

e.en: He always {gets} to the office before everyone else.
e.zh: 他总是比其他人都早到办公室。

e.en: The app {gets} smarter the more you use it.
e.zh: 这款应用用得越多就变得越智能。

getter.t: n. 取值方法；getter 函数

e.en: The class needs a {getter} method to access the private field.
e.zh: 这个类需要一个 getter 方法来访问私有字段。

e.en: He's a real {getter} when it comes to closing sales deals.
e.zh: 在搞定销售订单方面他真是个能手。

getting.t: v. 得到；变成（get 现在分词）

e.en: I'm {getting} tired of waiting for the bus.
e.zh: 我等公交车等得越来越不耐烦了。

e.en: She's {getting} better at speaking French every week.
e.zh: 她的法语口语每周都在进步。

getty.t: n. 盖蒂（姓氏，如盖蒂图片社）

e.en: We licensed the photo from {Getty} Images for the article.
e.zh: 我们从 Getty 图片社授权了这张照片用于文章。

e.en: The {Getty} museum houses an impressive collection of European art.
e.zh: 盖蒂博物馆收藏了大量令人惊叹的欧洲艺术品。

gettysburg.t: n. 葛底斯堡（美国地名，著名战役）

e.en: Lincoln delivered his famous address at {Gettysburg} in 1863.
e.zh: 林肯于 1863 年在葛底斯堡发表了著名演说。

e.en: Tourists visit {Gettysburg} to walk the historic Civil War battlefield.
e.zh: 游客来到葛底斯堡参观这座历史悠久的内战战场。

e.en: A bright {gibbous} moon lit up the camping ground.
e.zh: 一轮明亮的凸月把营地照得通亮。

e.en: Tonight's {gibbous} moon is almost full.
e.zh: 今晚的凸月已经接近满月了。

gibe.t:
v. 嘲弄，讥讽
n. 讥笑

e.en: He shrugged off the {gibe} from his rival without a word.
e.zh: 他对对手的嘲讽一笑置之,什么也没说。

e.en: Don't {gibe} at people who are just trying their best.
e.zh: 别去嘲笑那些只是在尽力而为的人。

giblet.t: n. 禽类内脏（通常用复数 giblets）

e.en: Save the {giblet} pieces to make a rich gravy.
e.zh: 把禽内脏留下,可以用来熬一锅浓郁的肉汁。

e.en: She tossed the {giblet} bag from inside the turkey.
e.zh: 她把火鸡肚子里的那袋内脏扔掉了。

e.en: The Rock of {Gibraltar} towers over the strait below.
e.zh: 直布罗陀巨岩高耸地俯视着下方的海峡。

e.en: We took a ferry from Spain to {Gibraltar} for the day.
e.zh: 我们从西班牙坐渡轮去直布罗陀玩了一天。

e.en: He plays a vintage {Gibson} guitar at every gig.
e.zh: 他每次演出都弹一把老式的吉布森吉他。

e.en: Mel {Gibson} directed and starred in the film Braveheart.
e.zh: 梅尔·吉布森执导并主演了电影《勇敢的心》。

e.en: The children laughed {giddily} as the carousel spun faster.
e.zh: 旋转木马越转越快,孩子们兴奋得咯咯直笑。

e.en: She giggled {giddily} when she heard the surprising news.
e.zh: 听到那个惊喜的消息,她兴奋得咯咯直笑。

e.en: The {giddiness} of new love made her smile constantly.
e.zh: 新恋情的兴奋让她不停地微笑。

e.en: A wave of {giddiness} hit him after spinning around.
e.zh: 转了几圈后他感到一阵头晕。

giddy.t: adj. 头晕目眩的；轻浮的

e.en: The kids felt {giddy} on the night before the trip.
e.zh: 孩子们在出发前一晚兴奋得不得了。

e.en: Standing at the edge made her feel {giddy} and faint.
e.zh: 站在边缘让她感到头晕目眩。

gideon.t: n. 基甸（人名，圣经人物）

e.en: {Gideon} led a small army to a famous victory.
e.zh: 基甸率领一支小军队取得了著名的胜利。

e.en: My new neighbor's son is named {Gideon}.
e.zh: 我新邻居的儿子名叫基甸。

e.en: The old Scots song says, "{gie} me your hand."
e.zh: 那首古老的苏格兰歌谣唱道:把你的手给我。

e.en: In dialect, "{gie}" simply means to give.
e.zh: 在方言中,gie 就是“给”的意思。

gift.t:
n. 礼物；天赋
v. 赠送

e.en: She wrapped the birthday {gift} in shiny blue paper.
e.zh: 她用闪亮的蓝色纸包好了生日礼物。

e.en: He has a real {gift} for explaining hard ideas.
e.zh: 他真有解释复杂概念的天赋。

e.en: She is a {gifted} pianist who started at age four.
e.zh: 她是位天才钢琴家,四岁就开始学琴。

e.en: My aunt {gifted} me a vintage camera last Christmas.
e.zh: 去年圣诞节姑妈送了我一台复古相机。

e.en: Schools struggle to identify {giftedness} in young students.
e.zh: 学校很难识别低龄学生的天赋。

e.en: Her musical {giftedness} was obvious from a very young age.
e.zh: 她的音乐天赋从小就显而易见。

e.en: They exchanged {gifts} under the Christmas tree.
e.zh: 他们在圣诞树下互换礼物。

e.en: She has many {gifts}, including writing and painting.
e.zh: 她有许多才能,包括写作和绘画。

gig.t:
n. 零工；演出
v. 打零工

e.en: The band has a {gig} at the downtown bar tonight.
e.zh: 乐队今晚在市中心的酒吧有一场演出。

e.en: He drives for a delivery app as a side {gig}.
e.zh: 他兼职给一个配送应用开车。

e.en: The prefix {giga} means one billion in the metric system.
e.zh: 前缀 giga 在公制中表示十亿。

e.en: This drive supports {giga}-speed data transfers.
e.zh: 这块硬盘支持千兆级的数据传输。

e.en: My new router supports full {gigabit} ethernet speeds.
e.zh: 我新买的路由器支持完整的千兆以太网速度。

e.en: The office upgraded to a {gigabit} internet connection.
e.zh: 办公室升级到了千兆网络。

e.en: The video file is over one {gigabyte} in size.
e.zh: 这个视频文件大小超过一个吉字节。

e.en: My phone plan only includes five {gigabyte} of data.
e.zh: 我的手机套餐只有五个 GB 的流量。

e.en: The new processor runs at three {gigahertz} per core.
e.zh: 新处理器每个核心运行频率为三吉赫。

e.en: Wi-Fi commonly uses the 5 {gigahertz} band today.
e.zh: 如今 Wi-Fi 普遍使用 5 吉赫频段。

e.en: A {gigantic} cruise ship docked in the harbor today.
e.zh: 一艘巨大的游轮今天停靠在港口。

e.en: They face a {gigantic} task rebuilding the bridge.
e.zh: 他们面临重建大桥的艰巨任务。

e.en: {Gigantism} is caused by excess growth hormone in childhood.
e.zh: 巨人症是由儿童期生长激素过多引起的。

e.en: Doctors diagnosed {gigantism} and began hormone treatment.
e.zh: 医生诊断为巨人症并开始进行激素治疗。

e.en: The new solar farm produces one {gigawatt} of power.
e.zh: 这座新太阳能发电场可产生一吉瓦的电力。

e.en: Data centers can consume a full {gigawatt} during peak hours.
e.zh: 数据中心在高峰时段可消耗整整一吉瓦的电力。

giggle.t:
v. 咯咯地笑
n. 傻笑

e.en: The children {giggle} every time the puppy sneezes.
e.zh: 每次小狗打喷嚏,孩子们都咯咯地笑。

e.en: She let out a soft {giggle} at his silly joke.
e.zh: 听到他的傻笑话,她轻轻地咯咯笑了一声。

e.en: The whole class got the {giggles} during the quiet test.
e.zh: 安静的考试中全班同学都忍不住咯咯笑起来。

e.en: She {giggles} whenever someone tickles her feet.
e.zh: 每次有人挠她的脚,她就咯咯地笑。

e.en: Two girls were {giggling} in the back of the classroom.
e.zh: 两个女孩在教室后面咯咯地笑。

e.en: Stop {giggling} and pay attention to the lesson.
e.zh: 别再笑了,认真听课。

e.en: She gets {giggly} after just one glass of wine.
e.zh: 她只喝一杯酒就会变得爱笑起来。

e.en: The {giggly} toddler couldn't sit still for the photo.
e.zh: 那个咯咯笑个不停的小孩拍照时坐不住。

e.en: My friend's cat is named {Gigi} after the movie.
e.zh: 我朋友的猫以那部电影命名,叫 Gigi。

e.en: {Gigi} won three Oscars back in 1959.
e.zh: 《琪琪》在 1959 年赢得了三项奥斯卡奖。

e.en: The novel's villain is a charming {gigolo} from Paris.
e.zh: 小说中的反派是个来自巴黎的迷人男妓。

e.en: He resented being treated like a {gigolo} by the press.
e.zh: 他厌恶媒体把他当作小白脸来对待。

e.en: The band has three {gigs} booked this weekend.
e.zh: 乐队这个周末预订了三场演出。

e.en: She juggles several freelance {gigs} to pay rent.
e.zh: 她同时做几份自由职业来付房租。

e.en: {Gilbert} and Sullivan wrote many famous comic operas.
e.zh: 吉尔伯特和沙利文创作了许多著名的喜剧歌剧。

e.en: My grandfather's name was {Gilbert} Edward Smith.
e.zh: 我祖父的名字叫吉尔伯特·爱德华·史密斯。

e.en: Craftsmen used to {gild} the picture frames with gold leaf.
e.zh: 工匠们过去常用金箔给画框镀金。

e.en: Don't try to {gild} the truth to make it sound better.
e.zh: 不要为了好听而粉饰事实。

e.en: The palace ceiling was covered in {gilded} carvings.
e.zh: 宫殿的天花板上布满了镀金的雕刻。

e.en: She grew up in a {gilded} cage of wealth and rules.
e.zh: 她在金丝笼般的财富与规矩中长大。

e.en: The {gilder} carefully applied gold leaf to the frame.
e.zh: 镀金工人小心地把金箔贴在画框上。

e.en: A skilled {gilder} can earn good money restoring antiques.
e.zh: 熟练的镀金师修复古董能赚不少钱。

e.en: The {gilding} on the old mirror has begun to flake.
e.zh: 那面旧镜子上的镀金已经开始剥落。

e.en: Restoring the {gilding} took the artisan several months.
e.zh: 修复那层镀金花了工匠好几个月。

e.en: A fish breathes through each {gill} on its head.
e.zh: 鱼通过头部两侧的每一个鳃来呼吸。

e.en: The shark's {gill} slits were clearly visible underwater.
e.zh: 鲨鱼的鳃裂在水下清晰可见。

e.en: He bought a new {Gillette} razor for his trip.
e.zh: 他为这次旅行买了一把新的吉列剃须刀。

e.en: {Gillette} ads have featured many famous athletes.
e.zh: 吉列的广告中出现过许多著名运动员。

gillingham.t: n. 吉林汉姆（英国地名）

e.en: {Gillingham} is a town located in the county of Kent.
e.zh: 吉灵厄姆是位于肯特郡的一个城镇。

e.en: The {Gillingham} football club plays in League Two.
e.zh: 吉灵厄姆足球俱乐部在英乙联赛踢球。

gilt.t:
adj. 镀金的
n. 金箔

e.en: The {gilt} frame around the painting glittered in the light.
e.zh: 画作周围的镀金画框在灯光下闪闪发光。

e.en: Investors moved money into safer {gilt} bonds.
e.zh: 投资者把资金转入更安全的金边债券。

e.en: "{Gim}" is a Korean word for dried edible seaweed.
e.zh: Gim 是韩语中“紫菜”的意思。

e.en: She wrapped rice in a sheet of crisp {gim}.
e.zh: 她用一张酥脆的紫菜把饭卷起来。

e.en: The camera {gimbal} keeps footage smooth while you walk.
e.zh: 相机稳定器能让你边走边拍出平稳的画面。

e.en: Drone pilots rely on a three-axis {gimbal} for stability.
e.zh: 无人机飞手依靠三轴稳定器来保持稳定。

gimcrack.t:
adj. 华而不实的
n. 中看不中用的小玩意

e.en: The shop sold cheap {gimcrack} souvenirs to tourists.
e.zh: 那家店向游客卖些廉价花哨的纪念品。

e.en: Her shelves were cluttered with {gimcrack} ornaments.
e.zh: 她的架子上堆满了华而不实的小摆设。

e.en: She ordered a vodka {gimlet} at the hotel bar.
e.zh: 她在酒店吧台点了一杯伏特加金蕾酒。

e.en: He fixed her with a {gimlet} stare across the room.
e.zh: 他从房间另一头用锐利的目光盯着她。

e.en: The free t-shirt was just a marketing {gimmick}.
e.zh: 免费 T 恤不过是个营销噱头。

e.en: Their new feature feels like a {gimmick}, not real value.
e.zh: 他们的新功能感觉像噱头,而非真正有用。

e.en: The presentation relied on flashy {gimmickry} instead of facts.
e.zh: 那场演示靠的是花哨的噱头,而不是事实。

e.en: Critics dismissed the show as cheap {gimmickry}.
e.zh: 评论家把这个节目斥为廉价的花招。

e.en: The app's animations feel a bit {gimmicky} after a while.
e.zh: 用久了,这个应用的动画就显得有点华而不实。

e.en: Reviewers called the new phone feature {gimmicky}.
e.zh: 评测人员说新手机的这个功能只是噱头。

gimp.t:
n. 瘸腿的人（贬义）
n. 饰带

e.en: I edit my photos with {GIMP} instead of Photoshop.
e.zh: 我用 GIMP 而不是 Photoshop 来修图。

e.en: He walked with a slight {gimp} after the knee surgery.
e.zh: 膝盖手术后他走路有些跛。

e.en: My {gimpy} old laptop barely runs modern software.
e.zh: 我那台破旧的老笔记本几乎跑不动现代软件。

e.en: The dog has a {gimpy} leg from an old injury.
e.zh: 那只狗因旧伤腿有点瘸。

gin.t:
n. 金酒（杜松子酒）
n. 轧棉机

e.en: She mixed a {gin} and tonic for her guest.
e.zh: 她为客人调了一杯金汤力。

e.en: My grandfather taught me how to play {gin} rummy.
e.zh: 我祖父教我玩金罗美纸牌。

ginger.t:
n. 姜
adj. 姜黄色的

e.en: Add fresh {ginger} to the soup for extra flavor.
e.zh: 在汤里加点新鲜生姜会更香。

e.en: The cat had soft {ginger} fur and bright green eyes.
e.zh: 那只猫有着柔软的姜黄色毛和明亮的绿眼睛。

e.en: We baked a {gingerbread} house for the holiday party.
e.zh: 我们为节日派对烤了一座姜饼屋。

e.en: The smell of warm {gingerbread} filled the kitchen.
e.zh: 温热的姜饼香气弥漫整个厨房。

e.en: She served {gingered} carrots alongside the roast chicken.
e.zh: 她把姜味胡萝卜和烤鸡一起端上桌。

e.en: The chef {gingered} the broth with fresh slices.
e.zh: 厨师用新鲜姜片给汤增添了姜味。

e.en: He stepped {gingerly} across the icy parking lot.
e.zh: 他小心翼翼地走过结冰的停车场。

e.en: She {gingerly} picked up the broken glass from the floor.
e.zh: 她小心地从地板上捡起碎玻璃。

e.en: Grate fresh {gingerroot} into the stir-fry just before serving.
e.zh: 出锅前把新鲜姜根擦丝放入炒菜中。

e.en: I keep {gingerroot} in the freezer for easy slicing.
e.zh: 我把姜根放在冷冻室,方便切片。

e.en: Both her {gingers} kids inherited their dad's red hair.
e.zh: 她那两个红发孩子都遗传了爸爸的红头发。

e.en: The bakery sells crystallized {gingers} by the pound.
e.zh: 那家面包店按磅出售糖渍姜块。

e.en: She dunked a crisp {gingersnap} into her hot tea.
e.zh: 她把一块酥脆的姜饼浸入热茶中。

e.en: Grandma's {gingersnap} cookies are the best in town.
e.zh: 奶奶做的姜饼是镇上最好吃的。

gingery.t: adj. 有姜味的；姜黄色的

e.en: The soup has a warm, {gingery} kick that I love.
e.zh: 这汤带着我喜欢的温暖姜味。

e.en: His {gingery} hair stood out in the family photo.
e.zh: 他那头姜黄色的头发在全家福里很显眼。

e.en: She wore a red {gingham} dress to the picnic.
e.zh: 她穿了一条红色格子布连衣裙去野餐。

e.en: The kitchen curtains were made of blue {gingham} fabric.
e.zh: 厨房窗帘是用蓝色格纹布做的。

e.en: Regular flossing helps prevent {gingivitis} and gum disease.
e.zh: 经常用牙线有助于预防牙龈炎和牙周疾病。

e.en: The dentist diagnosed mild {gingivitis} during her checkup.
e.zh: 牙医在她的检查中诊断出轻度牙龈炎。

e.en: Many people take {gingko} supplements to improve memory.
e.zh: 许多人服用银杏补充剂来改善记忆力。

e.en: The {gingko} tree turns bright yellow every autumn.
e.zh: 银杏树每年秋天都会变成鲜艳的黄色。

e.en: The {ginkgo} leaves carpeted the sidewalk in gold.
e.zh: 银杏叶把人行道铺成了金色。

e.en: She brewed tea from dried {ginkgo} leaves.
e.zh: 她用干银杏叶泡茶。

e.en: Korean {ginseng} is famous for its energy-boosting properties.
e.zh: 韩国人参以提神功效闻名。

e.en: He drinks {ginseng} tea every morning before work.
e.zh: 他每天上班前都喝一杯人参茶。

e.en: {Giotto} revolutionized painting in the early Renaissance period.
e.zh: 乔托在文艺复兴早期革新了绘画艺术。

e.en: The frescoes by {Giotto} still inspire artists today.
e.zh: 乔托的壁画至今仍激励着艺术家们。

gipper.t: n. 吉普（昵称，常指里根）

e.en: Reagan famously said, "Win one for the {Gipper}."
e.zh: 里根那句著名的话:"为了吉普赢一场吧。"

e.en: The coach urged the team to play for the {Gipper}.
e.zh: 教练激励球队为吉普而战。

gipsy.t: n. 吉普赛人（gypsy 异拼）

e.en: The old {gipsy} caravan rolled slowly through the village.
e.zh: 那辆古老的吉普赛大篷车缓缓驶过村庄。

e.en: She wore a colorful {gipsy} skirt to the festival.
e.zh: 她穿着一条色彩斑斓的吉普赛裙去参加节日。

e.en: The {giraffe} stretched its long neck to reach the leaves.
e.zh: 长颈鹿伸长脖子去够树叶。

e.en: Tourists photographed a baby {giraffe} at the wildlife park.
e.zh: 游客们在野生动物园拍到了一只小长颈鹿。

e.en: A herd of {giraffes} grazed peacefully on the savanna.
e.zh: 一群长颈鹿在大草原上悠闲地吃草。

e.en: {Giraffes} are the tallest land animals on Earth.
e.zh: 长颈鹿是地球上最高的陆地动物。

e.en: The team must {gird} themselves for a tough match.
e.zh: 球队必须做好准备应对一场硬仗。

e.en: Investors should {gird} for more market volatility ahead.
e.zh: 投资者应做好应对市场更大波动的准备。

e.en: A massive steel {girder} supports the bridge's main span.
e.zh: 一根巨大的钢梁支撑着桥的主跨。

e.en: Workers carefully lifted the {girder} into place.
e.zh: 工人们小心地把大梁吊装到位。

girdle.t:
n. 腰带；束腹
v. 环绕

e.en: Her grandmother still wore a {girdle} under formal dresses.
e.zh: 她奶奶穿正装时还会束上紧身腰带。

e.en: A {girdle} of mountains surrounds the ancient city.
e.zh: 一圈群山环绕着这座古城。

giri.t: n. 义理（日语借词，道义责任）

e.en: In Japanese culture, {giri} refers to a deep sense of duty.
e.zh: 在日本文化中,"义理"指一种深切的责任感。

e.en: He gave the chocolates out of {giri}, not affection.
e.zh: 他送巧克力是出于义理,而不是爱意。

e.en: The little {girl} laughed as she chased the puppy.
e.zh: 小女孩追着小狗咯咯地笑。

e.en: Every {girl} in the class voted for the new captain.
e.zh: 班里每个女孩都投票选了新队长。

e.en: He bought his {girlfriend} flowers for their anniversary.
e.zh: 他给女朋友买了花庆祝纪念日。

e.en: Her {girlfriend} surprised her with concert tickets.
e.zh: 她的女朋友给了她演唱会门票的惊喜。

e.en: She went to brunch with her {girlfriends} on Sunday.
e.zh: 周日她和闺蜜们一起去吃早午餐。

e.en: Both {girlfriends} flew in for the wedding ceremony.
e.zh: 两位女友都飞来参加婚礼。

e.en: She wrote a memoir about her {girlhood} in rural China.
e.zh: 她写了一本关于自己在中国农村少女时代的回忆录。

e.en: Memories of her {girlhood} came flooding back.
e.zh: 少女时代的记忆涌上心头。

girlie.t:
n. 小妞
adj. 少女风的

e.en: Her bedroom had a very pink, {girlie} aesthetic.
e.zh: 她的卧室充满了粉嫩的少女风格。

e.en: He flipped through an old {girlie} magazine at the barbershop.
e.zh: 他在理发店翻了翻一本旧的少女杂志。

girling.t: v. 像少女般打扮（罕用）

e.en: The boys were {girling} around at the mall on Saturday.
e.zh: 那群男孩星期六在商场里围着女孩转悠。

e.en: He spent his weekends {girling} instead of studying.
e.zh: 他周末都在追女孩,不学习。

e.en: She had a {girlish} laugh that lit up the room.
e.zh: 她那少女般的笑声让整个房间都明亮起来。

e.en: His {girlish} excitement about the gift was adorable.
e.zh: 他对礼物那种孩子气的兴奋很可爱。

e.en: She giggled {girlishly} at his silly joke.
e.zh: 她为他那愚蠢的笑话少女般地咯咯笑起来。

e.en: The actress smiled {girlishly} for the cameras.
e.zh: 那位女演员对着镜头露出少女般的笑容。

e.en: The {girls} on the soccer team won the championship.
e.zh: 足球队的女孩们赢得了冠军。

e.en: Three {girls} sat reading quietly in the library.
e.zh: 三个女孩在图书馆里安静地坐着看书。

e.en: She loves {girly} things like glitter and pink unicorns.
e.zh: 她喜欢闪粉和粉色独角兽这种少女风的东西。

e.en: The cafe had a cute, {girly} pastel decor.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆装修得很可爱,充满少女粉嫩风。

e.en: He collected his weekly {giro} from the post office.
e.zh: 他每周到邮局领取救济金支票。

e.en: Many pensioners still rely on a {giro} payment.
e.zh: 许多养老金领取者仍然依赖政府转账支票。

e.en: The ancient oak tree had a remarkable {girth}.
e.zh: 那棵古老的橡树树干周长惊人。

e.en: He tightened the saddle's {girth} before mounting the horse.
e.zh: 他上马前把鞍带勒紧了。

e.en: She studied mathematics at {Girton} College, Cambridge.
e.zh: 她在剑桥大学格顿学院学习数学。

e.en: {Girton} was the first women's college in Britain.
e.zh: 格顿是英国第一所女子学院。

girvan.t: n. 格尔文（苏格兰地名）

e.en: We took the train down to {Girvan} for the weekend.
e.zh: 我们坐火车去格文度周末。

e.en: The harbor at {Girvan} is popular with fishermen.
e.zh: 格文港很受渔民欢迎。

giselle.t: n. 吉赛尔（人名/芭蕾舞剧）

e.en: The ballet {Giselle} is a Romantic-era masterpiece.
e.zh: 芭蕾舞剧《吉赛尔》是浪漫主义时代的杰作。

e.en: She danced the lead role in {Giselle} last night.
e.zh: 她昨晚在《吉赛尔》中担任主角。

e.en: Just give me the {gist} of the meeting.
e.zh: 把会议要点简单告诉我就行。

e.en: I missed the lecture but got the {gist} from a friend.
e.zh: 我错过了讲座,但从朋友那里听了大致内容。

git.t: n. Git（版本控制工具）；讨厌鬼（英俚）

e.en: I use {git} to track changes in my code projects.
e.zh: 我用 git 来跟踪代码项目的修改。

e.en: That selfish {git} took the last slice of pizza.
e.zh: 那个自私的家伙拿走了最后一块披萨。

e.en: The Bhagavad {Gita} contains profound spiritual teachings.
e.zh: 《薄伽梵歌》蕴含着深刻的灵性教诲。

e.en: He reads a passage from the {Gita} every morning.
e.zh: 他每天早上都读一段《薄伽梵歌》。

e.en: We rented a charming {gite} in the French countryside.
e.zh: 我们在法国乡村租了一间迷人的度假小屋。

e.en: The {gite} had a stunning view of the vineyards.
e.zh: 这间度假屋有着葡萄园的美景。

e.en: Please {give} me a moment to think this over.
e.zh: 请给我一点时间考虑一下。

e.en: Don't forget to {give} the dog fresh water.
e.zh: 别忘了给狗换上新鲜的水。

giveaway.t: n. 赠品，免费送出；泄露

e.en: The store is hosting a free {giveaway} this weekend.
e.zh: 这家店本周末有免费赠品活动。

e.en: His nervous laugh was a dead {giveaway}.
e.zh: 他紧张的笑声彻底暴露了他。

e.en: Influencers often run {giveaways} to grow their followers.
e.zh: 网红经常通过赠品活动来增加粉丝。

e.en: The conference offered free t-shirt {giveaways} at the entrance.
e.zh: 会议在入口处发放免费T恤等赠品。

giveback.t: n. 劳资谈判中的让步

e.en: The union accepted a wage {giveback} to save jobs.
e.zh: 工会接受了减薪让步以保住工作岗位。

e.en: The company's annual {giveback} program supports local charities.
e.zh: 公司的年度回馈计划支持当地慈善机构。

given.t:
adj. 既定的，特定的
prep. 考虑到

e.en: {Given} the weather, we should cancel the picnic.
e.zh: 考虑到天气情况,我们应该取消野餐。

e.en: She has {given} her old clothes to charity.
e.zh: 她已经把旧衣服捐给了慈善机构。

givenchy.t: n. 纪梵希（法国奢侈品牌）

e.en: Audrey Hepburn often wore {Givenchy} in her famous films.
e.zh: 奥黛丽·赫本在她的经典电影中常穿纪梵希。

e.en: She splurged on a {Givenchy} handbag for her birthday.
e.zh: 她生日时奢侈了一把,买了个纪梵希包。

e.en: She is a generous {giver} who supports many causes.
e.zh: 她是个慷慨的捐助者,支持许多公益事业。

e.en: In any relationship, you need both a {giver} and receiver.
e.zh: 任何关系都需要付出者和接受者。

gives.t: v. give 的第三人称单数

e.en: Volunteering {gives} her a real sense of purpose.
e.zh: 做志愿者给了她真正的使命感。

e.en: My grandmother {gives} the best hugs in the world.
e.zh: 我奶奶的拥抱是世界上最棒的。

giving.t:
v. give 的现在分词
n. 捐赠

e.en: She enjoys {giving} gifts more than receiving them.
e.zh: 她比起收礼物更喜欢送礼物。

e.en: The teacher is {giving} a lecture on climate change.
e.zh: 老师正在讲一堂关于气候变化的课。

giza.t: n. 吉萨（埃及金字塔所在地）

e.en: The pyramids of {Giza} attract millions of tourists yearly.
e.zh: 吉萨金字塔每年吸引数百万游客。

e.en: We rode camels around the plateau of {Giza}.
e.zh: 我们骑着骆驼绕着吉萨高原游览。

e.en: He bought a new kitchen {gizmo} that peels apples automatically.
e.zh: 他买了一个能自动削苹果的新厨房小玩意儿。

e.en: This {gizmo} can charge three phones at once.
e.zh: 这个小装置可以同时给三部手机充电。

e.en: The chicken's {gizzard} grinds food using small stones.
e.zh: 鸡的砂囊用小石子来磨碎食物。

e.en: Fried {gizzard} is a popular snack in many cultures.
e.zh: 炸鸡胗在许多文化中都是受欢迎的小吃。

glacial.t: adj. 冰川的；极冷的，缓慢的

e.en: The lake has stunning {glacial} blue water year-round.
e.zh: 这个湖一年四季都有惊艳的冰川蓝色湖水。

e.en: Progress on the project has been painfully {glacial}.
e.zh: 项目进展慢得让人痛苦。

glacially.t: adv. 冰川般地，极缓慢地

e.en: The bureaucracy moves {glacially} slowly on permit applications.
e.zh: 官僚机构处理许可申请的速度慢得像冰川一样。

e.en: She responded {glacially}, with no warmth in her voice.
e.zh: 她回答得冷冰冰的,语气毫无暖意。

glaciated.t: adj. 被冰川侵蚀/覆盖的

e.en: The {glaciated} valley has steep walls and a flat floor.
e.zh: 这条经冰川侵蚀的山谷山壁陡峭、谷底平坦。

e.en: Norway's coast features deeply {glaciated} fjords.
e.zh: 挪威海岸有着冰川深度雕刻的峡湾。

e.en: The last {glaciation} ended about 11,700 years ago.
e.zh: 上一次冰期大约在11700年前结束。

e.en: Scientists study ancient {glaciation} to understand climate change.
e.zh: 科学家通过研究古代冰期来了解气候变化。

e.en: The {glacier} has retreated significantly due to climate change.
e.zh: 由于气候变化,这条冰川已大幅退缩。

e.en: We hiked across the {glacier} wearing crampons.
e.zh: 我们穿着冰爪徒步穿越了冰川。

e.en: The {glaciologist} measured how fast the ice sheet was retreating.
e.zh: 那位冰川学家测量了冰盖退缩的速度。

e.en: A {glaciologist} from Norway joined the Antarctic research team.
e.zh: 一位来自挪威的冰川学家加入了南极考察队。

e.en: Soldiers struggled to climb the steep {glacis} of the old fort.
e.zh: 士兵们艰难地爬上古堡陡峭的斜堤。

e.en: The castle's {glacis} gave defenders a clear line of fire.
e.zh: 城堡的斜堤为守军提供了清晰的射击视野。

e.en: I'm so {glad} you could make it to the party.
e.zh: 你能来参加聚会我真高兴。

e.en: She was {glad} to hear the test results were normal.
e.zh: 听说检测结果正常,她感到很欣慰。

e.en: Her surprise visit will surely {gladden} her grandmother's heart.
e.zh: 她的突然到访肯定会让奶奶心里乐开花。

e.en: News of the rescue helped {gladden} the worried community.
e.zh: 获救的消息让忧心忡忡的社区感到欣慰。

e.en: We picnicked in a sunny {glade} deep in the forest.
e.zh: 我们在森林深处一片阳光斑驳的林间空地上野餐。

e.en: A deer stepped quietly into the {glade} at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分,一只鹿悄然走进林间空地。

e.en: The hikers crossed a softly {gladed} stretch of woodland.
e.zh: 徒步者穿过一片散布着林间空地的柔和林地。

e.en: The {gladed} path made the long walk feel pleasant.
e.zh: 沿途散布的林间空地让漫长的步行变得惬意。

e.en: The {gladiator} raised his sword to the roaring crowd.
e.zh: 角斗士向欢呼的人群举起了他的剑。

e.en: Russell Crowe played a famous Roman {gladiator} on screen.
e.zh: 罗素·克劳在银幕上饰演了一位著名的罗马角斗士。

gladiatorial.t: adj. 角斗士的；激烈对抗的

e.en: The debate turned into a {gladiatorial} contest between the two senators.
e.zh: 那场辩论演变成两位参议员之间的角斗式对决。

e.en: Ancient Rome was famous for its brutal {gladiatorial} games.
e.zh: 古罗马以其残酷的角斗士比赛而闻名。

e.en: She arranged tall pink {gladioli} in a glass vase.
e.zh: 她把高高的粉色剑兰插进玻璃花瓶里。

e.en: The garden was full of {gladioli} blooming in late summer.
e.zh: 花园里满是夏末盛开的剑兰。

e.en: He planted a single red {gladiolus} by the front gate.
e.zh: 他在前门旁种了一株红色的剑兰。

e.en: Each {gladiolus} stem held a column of vivid blossoms.
e.zh: 每根剑兰花茎上都顶着一串鲜艳的花朵。

e.en: I'd {gladly} help you move this weekend if you need.
e.zh: 如果你需要,我这周末很乐意帮你搬家。

e.en: She {gladly} accepted the invitation to speak at the conference.
e.zh: 她欣然接受了在会议上发言的邀请。

e.en: There was real {gladness} in his voice when he answered.
e.zh: 他回答时声音里透着真切的喜悦。

e.en: The reunion filled the whole family with {gladness}.
e.zh: 那场团聚让全家人充满了欢喜。

gladstone.t:
n. 格拉德斯通旅行包
n. (人名) 格莱斯顿

e.en: He carried his clothes in an old leather {gladstone}.
e.zh: 他把衣服装在一只旧皮质旅行包里。

e.en: A doctor's {gladstone} sat open beside the patient's bed.
e.zh: 医生的开口旅行包敞开放在病人床边。

glam.t:
adj. 迷人的；华丽的
n. 魅力；华丽风格

e.en: She wore a {glam} sequined dress to the awards show.
e.zh: 她穿了一件亮片闪闪的华丽礼服去颁奖典礼。

e.en: The hotel lobby had a very {glam} 1920s vibe.
e.zh: 酒店大堂散发着浓浓的1920年代华丽风情。

glamis.t: n. 格拉姆斯（苏格兰地名）

e.en: Tourists love visiting {Glamis} Castle in eastern Scotland.
e.zh: 游客们很喜欢参观苏格兰东部的格拉米斯城堡。

e.en: Macbeth is famously called the Thane of {Glamis}.
e.zh: 麦克白以格拉米斯领主的称号而闻名。

e.en: Old Hollywood {glamor} still inspires today's red carpet looks.
e.zh: 老好莱坞的魅力风情至今仍在影响红毯造型。

e.en: The city loses its {glamor} once you live there.
e.zh: 一旦在那里生活,这座城市就失去了它的魅力。

glamorgan.t: n. 格拉摩根（威尔士郡名）

e.en: My grandfather grew up in a mining town in {Glamorgan}.
e.zh: 我祖父在格拉摩根的一个矿区小镇长大。

e.en: The {Glamorgan} coast has some of Wales's best beaches.
e.zh: 格拉摩根海岸拥有威尔士最美的一些海滩。

e.en: Critics say the film tries to {glamorise} street violence.
e.zh: 评论人士认为这部电影试图美化街头暴力。

e.en: Magazines often {glamorise} jobs that are actually quite dull.
e.zh: 杂志常常把其实相当枯燥的工作美化得光鲜亮丽。

e.en: The show was criticized for its {glamorization} of drug use.
e.zh: 该节目因美化吸毒行为而受到批评。

e.en: Social media's {glamorization} of wealth distorts young people's expectations.
e.zh: 社交媒体对财富的美化扭曲了年轻人的期望。

e.en: The series doesn't {glamorize} war; it shows the cost.
e.zh: 这部剧并没有美化战争,而是展现了它的代价。

e.en: Influencers often {glamorize} a lifestyle most can't afford.
e.zh: 网红们常常把多数人负担不起的生活方式包装得光鲜亮丽。

glamorous.t: adj. 迷人的；富有魅力的

e.en: Travel blogging looks {glamorous} but involves a lot of waiting.
e.zh: 旅游博主看起来很光鲜,实际上要花很多时间等待。

e.en: She wore a {glamorous} silk gown to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿了一件华丽的丝绸礼服出席晚宴。

e.en: The actress was {glamorously} dressed for the premiere.
e.zh: 那位女演员为首映式打扮得光彩照人。

e.en: She lived {glamorously} in Paris during the 1960s.
e.zh: 她在1960年代的巴黎过着光鲜亮丽的生活。

e.en: Behind the {glamour}, fashion week is exhausting work.
e.zh: 在光鲜亮丽的背后,时装周其实是累人的工作。

e.en: The old theater still holds the {glamour} of its heyday.
e.zh: 那座老剧院仍保留着它鼎盛时期的迷人风采。

e.en: She led a surprisingly un-{glamourous} life off camera.
e.zh: 她在镜头之外过着出人意料地不那么光鲜的生活。

e.en: The ad promised a {glamourous} weekend in Monaco.
e.zh: 广告承诺在摩纳哥度过一个光鲜耀眼的周末。

glance.t:
v. 瞥一眼；扫视
n. 一瞥

e.en: At first {glance}, the two paintings look almost identical.
e.zh: 乍一看,这两幅画几乎一模一样。

e.en: He took a quick {glance} at his phone under the table.
e.zh: 他在桌子下迅速瞥了一眼手机。

glanced.t: v. 瞥了一眼（glance 过去式）

e.en: She {glanced} nervously at the clock during the interview.
e.zh: 面试中她紧张地瞟了一眼时钟。

e.en: The driver {glanced} in the mirror before changing lanes.
e.zh: 司机变道前瞥了一眼后视镜。

glances.t: v./n. glance 的第三人称单数或复数

e.en: They exchanged knowing {glances} across the dinner table.
e.zh: 他们在餐桌对面交换了心照不宣的眼神。

e.en: He {glances} at the news headlines every morning.
e.zh: 他每天早上都会扫一眼新闻头条。

glancing.t:
adj. 掠过的；侧向的
v. 瞥（glance 的现在分词）

e.en: The boxer took only a {glancing} blow to the chin.
e.zh: 那位拳手下巴只挨了轻轻擦过的一拳。

e.en: She kept {glancing} at the door, expecting him to arrive.
e.zh: 她不停地瞟向门口,等着他到来。

e.en: The report mentions the issue only {glancingly} in a footnote.
e.zh: 报告只是在脚注里轻描淡写地提到这个问题。

e.en: He referred {glancingly} to his earlier failure during the speech.
e.zh: 演讲中他只是顺带提了一下早先的失败。

e.en: The thyroid {gland} controls how fast your body uses energy.
e.zh: 甲状腺控制着身体消耗能量的速度。

e.en: Doctors found a small lump in his salivary {gland}.
e.zh: 医生在他的唾液腺里发现了一个小肿块。

e.en: She missed two months of school with {glandular} fever.
e.zh: 她因腺热请假在家休学了两个月。

e.en: The doctor ordered tests to check for {glandular} problems.
e.zh: 医生开了检查以排查腺体方面的问题。

glare.t:
n. 刺眼的光；怒视
v. 怒目而视；发出刺眼光

e.en: The {glare} from the screen gave me a headache.
e.zh: 屏幕的强光让我头疼。

e.en: She shot him a furious {glare} across the room.
e.zh: 她从房间另一头狠狠瞪了他一眼。

glares.t: v./n. glare 的第三人称单数或复数

e.en: He {glares} at anyone who interrupts his presentation.
e.zh: 任何人打断他演讲,他都会怒目而视。

e.en: The teacher's icy {glares} silenced the noisy class.
e.zh: 老师冰冷的怒视让吵闹的班级安静了下来。

glaring.t: adj. 显眼的；明目张胆的；刺眼的

e.en: The report contains several {glaring} factual errors.
e.zh: 这份报告里有好几个明显的事实错误。

e.en: She walked outside into the {glaring} afternoon sun.
e.zh: 她走到外面刺眼的午后阳光下。

e.en: The proposal is {glaringly} short on real numbers.
e.zh: 这份提案明显缺乏真实的数据。

e.en: His name was {glaringly} absent from the guest list.
e.zh: 他的名字在嘉宾名单上明显缺席。

glasgow.t: n. 格拉斯哥（英国城市）

e.en: My cousin moved to {Glasgow} to study engineering.
e.zh: 我表弟搬到格拉斯哥去读工程专业了。

e.en: {Glasgow} has a thriving music and arts scene.
e.zh: 格拉斯哥有着蓬勃发展的音乐与艺术氛围。

glasnost.t: n. 公开性政策（苏联改革用语）

e.en: Gorbachev's policy of {glasnost} encouraged open public debate.
e.zh: 戈尔巴乔夫的开放政策鼓励了公开的公共讨论。

e.en: Many writers welcomed the new era of {glasnost}.
e.zh: 许多作家欢迎这个新的开放时代。

e.en: Could I have a {glass} of cold water, please?
e.zh: 能给我来一杯凉水吗?

e.en: The skyscraper is wrapped in mirrored {glass} panels.
e.zh: 那座摩天大楼外覆盖着镜面玻璃幕墙。

e.en: The {glassblower} shaped the molten ball into a delicate vase.
e.zh: 玻璃工匠把熔化的玻璃球吹塑成一只精致的花瓶。

e.en: We watched a {glassblower} demonstrate his craft in Murano.
e.zh: 我们在穆拉诺岛看了一位玻璃工匠现场展示手艺。

glassed.t:
adj. 装有玻璃的
v. 给……装玻璃

e.en: The cafe is {glassed} in on three sides for great views.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆三面都是玻璃幕墙,视野极佳。

e.en: His eyes {glassed} over as the lecture dragged on.
e.zh: 演讲拖得越久,他的眼神越发呆滞。

e.en: I can't read the menu without my {glasses}.
e.zh: 不戴眼镜我连菜单都看不清。

e.en: She raised her {glasses} and proposed a toast.
e.zh: 她举起酒杯提议干杯。

e.en: Pour yourself a {glassful} of juice from the fridge.
e.zh: 从冰箱里给自己倒一满杯果汁吧。

e.en: He drank a whole {glassful} of water in one go.
e.zh: 他一口气喝下了一整杯水。

e.en: They grow rare orchids in the heated {glasshouse}.
e.zh: 他们在恒温温室里培育珍稀兰花。

e.en: The botanical garden has a Victorian-era {glasshouse}.
e.zh: 那座植物园里有一座维多利亚时代的玻璃温室。

e.en: The stamps were stored in small {glassine} envelopes.
e.zh: 邮票被装在小小的半透明玻璃纸袋里。

e.en: Bakery cookies came wrapped in delicate {glassine} paper.
e.zh: 面包店的饼干用精致的半透明油光纸包着。

glasslike.t: adj. 像玻璃的；透明光滑的

e.en: The frozen lake had a smooth, {glasslike} surface.
e.zh: 结冰的湖面光滑得像一面玻璃。

e.en: The pottery was fired until it gained a {glasslike} sheen.
e.zh: 陶器经过烧制后呈现出玻璃般的光泽。

glassmaker.t: n. 玻璃制造工；玻璃厂商

e.en: Venice has been famous for its {glassmaker} families for centuries.
e.zh: 威尼斯几个世纪以来一直以其玻璃制造家族而闻名。

e.en: The {glassmaker} signed the bottom of every finished bowl.
e.zh: 那位玻璃匠在每只成品碗底都签了名。

glimmering.t:
adj. 闪烁微光的
n. 微光

e.en: City lights were {glimmering} far below the mountain peak.
e.zh: 城市灯火在山顶下方远处闪烁。

e.en: She caught a {glimmering} reflection on the wet street.
e.zh: 她瞥见湿漉漉的街道上闪烁的倒影。

glimpse.t:
n. 一瞥；匆匆一看
v. 瞥见

e.en: I caught a {glimpse} of the singer leaving the hotel.
e.zh: 我瞥见那位歌手正离开酒店。

e.en: The trailer offers a {glimpse} of next year's blockbuster.
e.zh: 预告片让人一窥明年的大片。

glimpsed.t: v. 瞥见（glimpse 的过去式）

e.en: She {glimpsed} her ex across the crowded café.
e.zh: 她在拥挤的咖啡馆里瞥见了她的前任。

e.en: Hikers {glimpsed} a deer through the morning mist.
e.zh: 徒步者透过晨雾瞥见了一只鹿。

glimpses.t:
n. 一瞥（复数）
v. 瞥见（第三人称单数）

e.en: The documentary offers rare {glimpses} into the artist's studio.
e.zh: 这部纪录片难得地让人窥见艺术家的工作室。

e.en: He {glimpses} his reflection in every shop window.
e.zh: 他在每扇店面橱窗里都瞥见自己的倒影。

glint.t:
n. 闪光；微光
v. 闪烁

e.en: There was a mischievous {glint} in the child's eye.
e.zh: 孩子的眼里闪着一丝调皮的光。

e.en: Sunlight caught the {glint} of the ring on her finger.
e.zh: 阳光照到她手指上的戒指,闪出一道光。

glinted.t: v. 闪烁（glint 的过去式）

e.en: The detective's badge {glinted} under the streetlamp.
e.zh: 侦探的警徽在路灯下闪闪发亮。

e.en: Tears {glinted} in her eyes as the music played.
e.zh: 音乐响起时,她眼里泛着泪光。

glinting.t: v. 闪烁（glint 的现在分词）

e.en: Sunlight was {glinting} off the skyscraper windows downtown.
e.zh: 阳光在市中心摩天楼的窗户上闪闪反光。

e.en: He noticed something {glinting} in the sand at his feet.
e.zh: 他注意到脚边沙子里有东西在闪光。

glints.t:
n. 闪光（复数）
v. 闪烁（第三人称单数）

e.en: The lake {glints} under the late afternoon sun.
e.zh: 湖面在午后阳光下闪闪发光。

e.en: There were tiny {glints} of gold in the river gravel.
e.zh: 河床砂石中有几点金子的微光。

e.en: {Glioblastoma} remains one of the most aggressive brain cancers.
e.zh: 胶质母细胞瘤仍是最具侵袭性的脑癌之一。

e.en: Researchers are testing a new immunotherapy for {glioblastoma} patients.
e.zh: 研究人员正在为胶质母细胞瘤患者测试一种新型免疫疗法。

e.en: The MRI revealed a small {glioma} in the frontal lobe.
e.zh: 核磁共振显示额叶里有一个小的胶质瘤。

e.en: Treatment for {glioma} often combines surgery and radiation.
e.zh: 胶质瘤的治疗通常结合手术与放疗。

glissade.t:
n. 滑降；滑步
v. 滑降

e.en: The skier executed a smooth {glissade} down the icy slope.
e.zh: 滑雪者在结冰的斜坡上优雅地滑下。

e.en: She performed a graceful {glissade} across the ballet stage.
e.zh: 她在芭蕾舞台上做了一个优雅的滑步。

e.en: The harpist ended the piece with a sweeping {glissando}.
e.zh: 竖琴手以一段流畅的滑音结束了乐曲。

e.en: He played a quick {glissando} on the piano keys.
e.zh: 他在钢琴键上飞快地滑奏了一下。

glisten.t: v. 闪亮；闪烁（湿润表面）

e.en: Dewdrops {glisten} on the grass at sunrise.
e.zh: 日出时露珠在草地上闪闪发亮。

e.en: Her eyes {glisten} with tears of joy.
e.zh: 她的眼睛里闪烁着喜悦的泪光。

e.en: The {glistening} lake reflected the morning sun.
e.zh: 波光粼粼的湖面映照着晨光。

e.en: Sweat formed {glistening} beads on the runner's forehead.
e.zh: 跑步者的额头上渗出晶莹的汗珠。

e.en: A software {glitch} crashed the entire payment system.
e.zh: 一个软件故障让整个支付系统瘫痪了。

e.en: The video has a weird {glitch} around the two-minute mark.
e.zh: 视频在两分钟处有个奇怪的卡顿。

glitter.t:
n. 闪光；亮片
v. 闪闪发光

e.en: The kids covered their craft project in pink {glitter}.
e.zh: 孩子们把手工作品涂满了粉色亮片。

e.en: Stars {glitter} in the desert sky at night.
e.zh: 夜晚的沙漠天空中星星闪闪发光。

glitterati.t: n. 上流社会人士；名流

e.en: The {glitterati} gathered at the Cannes film festival.
e.zh: 名流们齐聚戛纳电影节。

e.en: Her party attracted the city's {glitterati}.
e.zh: 她的派对吸引了城里的社交名流。

e.en: She wore a {glittering} gown to the awards ceremony.
e.zh: 她穿着一件闪闪发光的礼服出席颁奖典礼。

e.en: He had a {glittering} career in tech before retiring.
e.zh: 退休前他在科技界有过辉煌的事业。

glittery.t: adj. 闪亮的；亮片装饰的

e.en: The kids love {glittery} stickers on their notebooks.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢在笔记本上贴亮闪闪的贴纸。

e.en: She applied {glittery} eyeshadow for the party.
e.zh: 她为派对涂上了闪粉眼影。

e.en: Las Vegas is famous for its {glitz} and showmanship.
e.zh: 拉斯维加斯以其浮华和表演著称。

e.en: The wedding had all the {glitz} of a Hollywood premiere.
e.zh: 这场婚礼有着好莱坞首映式般的奢华。

e.en: Different {glitzs} of the fashion world distract from real craft.
e.zh: 时尚界的种种浮华掩盖了真正的工艺。

e.en: The show layered on {glitzs} that felt cheap and dated.
e.zh: 节目堆砌的浮华显得廉价又过时。

e.en: They had a {glitzy} wedding at a beachfront resort.
e.zh: 他们在海滨度假村举办了一场华丽的婚礼。

e.en: The {glitzy} hotel lobby was full of celebrities.
e.zh: 豪华的酒店大堂里挤满了名人。

e.en: Fireflies appeared in the {gloaming} just after sunset.
e.zh: 日落后的暮色中萤火虫出现了。

e.en: They walked home through the quiet {gloaming}.
e.zh: 他们在静谧的黄昏中走回家。

gloat.t: v. 幸灾乐祸；沾沾自喜

e.en: Don't {gloat} when your team finally beats theirs.
e.zh: 你的球队终于赢了别得意忘形。

e.en: He couldn't help but {gloat} over the promotion.
e.zh: 他对升职的事忍不住沾沾自喜。

gloating.t:
adj. 幸灾乐祸的
v. 洋洋得意

e.en: Her {gloating} after the win annoyed everyone.
e.zh: 她赢了之后的得意样让所有人都很烦。

e.en: Stop {gloating} and help me clean up the mess.
e.zh: 别幸灾乐祸了,过来帮我收拾。

e.en: A {glob} of toothpaste fell into the sink.
e.zh: 一团牙膏掉进了水池里。

e.en: The script uses a {glob} pattern to match all log files.
e.zh: 这个脚本用通配符匹配所有日志文件。

e.en: Climate change is a {global} problem requiring cooperation.
e.zh: 气候变化是需要各国合作的全球性问题。

e.en: The startup expanded to a {global} customer base last year.
e.zh: 这家初创公司去年扩展到了全球客户群。

e.en: {Globalisation} has reshaped manufacturing across continents.
e.zh: 全球化重塑了各大洲的制造业。

e.en: Critics argue {globalisation} widens income inequality.
e.zh: 批评者认为全球化加剧了收入不平等。

e.en: Some politicians blame {globalism} for local job losses.
e.zh: 一些政客把本地失业归咎于全球主义。

e.en: {Globalism} promotes interconnected economies and shared policies.
e.zh: 全球主义主张经济互联和政策共享。

e.en: {Globalization} made Asian electronics affordable everywhere.
e.zh: 全球化让亚洲电子产品在各地都买得起。

e.en: The pandemic exposed weaknesses in {globalization} supply chains.
e.zh: 疫情暴露了全球化供应链的脆弱。

e.en: Historians compare different {globalizations} across centuries.
e.zh: 历史学家比较了几个世纪以来不同阶段的全球化。

e.en: The book examines successive {globalizations} since 1500.
e.zh: 这本书考察了1500年以来历次全球化浪潮。

e.en: The company plans to {globalize} its design team next year.
e.zh: 公司计划明年将设计团队全球化。

e.en: Streaming services have {globalize}d entertainment overnight.
e.zh: 流媒体几乎一夜间让娱乐走向全球。

globalized.t:
adj. 已全球化的
v. 使全球化（过去式）

e.en: We live in a deeply {globalized} digital economy.
e.zh: 我们生活在一个高度全球化的数字经济中。

e.en: Korean pop has {globalized} faster than anyone predicted.
e.zh: 韩国流行音乐全球化的速度超出所有人预料。

e.en: The brand is {globalizing} by opening stores in Asia.
e.zh: 该品牌正通过在亚洲开店实现全球化。

e.en: {Globalizing} a product means adapting it to many cultures.
e.zh: 将产品全球化意味着适应多种文化。

e.en: The app has been downloaded over a billion times {globally}.
e.zh: 这款应用在全球下载量已超过十亿次。

e.en: We need to think {globally} but act locally.
e.zh: 我们要放眼全球,立足本地。

e.en: She traveled the {globe} as a documentary filmmaker.
e.zh: 她作为纪录片导演走遍了全球。

e.en: A wooden {globe} sat on the professor's desk.
e.zh: 教授桌上摆着一个木制地球仪。

e.en: The library displays antique {globes} from the 1800s.
e.zh: 图书馆陈列着1800年代的古董地球仪。

e.en: Glass {globes} hung from the ceiling like floating moons.
e.zh: 玻璃球灯从天花板垂下,像漂浮的月亮。

e.en: Hemoglobin contains a heme group attached to a {globin} protein.
e.zh: 血红蛋白由一个血红素与珠蛋白结合而成。

e.en: Researchers study how {globin} folds inside red blood cells.
e.zh: 研究人员研究珠蛋白在红细胞中的折叠方式。

e.en: Astronomers spotted a dense {globular} cluster of ancient stars.
e.zh: 天文学家发现了一个由古老恒星组成的密集球状星团。

e.en: Most enzymes have a compact {globular} shape.
e.zh: 大多数酶具有紧凑的球状结构。

e.en: A tiny {globule} of oil floated on the soup's surface.
e.zh: 一小滴油花漂浮在汤的表面。

e.en: The microscope revealed a fat {globule} in the sample.
e.zh: 显微镜下样本中可见一个脂肪小球。

e.en: Doctors measured her {globulin} levels during the blood test.
e.zh: 医生在血检中测量了她的球蛋白水平。

e.en: Immune {globulin} therapy helps patients fight infections.
e.zh: 免疫球蛋白疗法帮助患者抵抗感染。

e.en: The brand uses a {glocal} strategy to fit each market.
e.zh: 该品牌采用全球本土化策略以适应各地市场。

e.en: McDonald's menus are a classic {glocal} example.
e.zh: 麦当劳的菜单是全球本土化的经典案例。

e.en: The child plucked a cheerful tune on the {glockenspiel}.
e.zh: 那孩子在钟琴上敲出了一段欢快的曲调。

e.en: A {glockenspiel} added sparkle to the orchestra's finale.
e.zh: 钟琴为管弦乐的终曲增添了亮丽色彩。

e.en: Reporters {glom} onto any rumor about the celebrity couple.
e.zh: 记者们一听到那对明星情侣的传闻就紧追不放。

e.en: Don't let strangers {glom} on at networking events.
e.zh: 在社交活动中别让陌生人死缠不放。

e.en: The lab measured her {glomerular} filtration rate.
e.zh: 化验室测量了她的肾小球滤过率。

e.en: Diabetes can damage the kidney's {glomerular} structure.
e.zh: 糖尿病会损害肾脏的肾小球结构。

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with chronic {glomerulonephritis}.
e.zh: 患者被诊断为慢性肾小球肾炎。

e.en: Untreated {glomerulonephritis} can lead to kidney failure.
e.zh: 肾小球肾炎若不治疗会导致肾衰竭。

e.en: A heavy {gloom} settled over the team after the loss.
e.zh: 输球后,团队笼罩在一片沉重的低落情绪中。

e.en: The candle barely pierced the {gloom} of the cellar.
e.zh: 蜡烛几乎照不破地窖的昏暗。

e.en: He stared {gloomily} out the window at the rain.
e.zh: 他闷闷不乐地望着窗外的雨。

e.en: She {gloomily} predicted another quarter of losses.
e.zh: 她沮丧地预测又将是亏损的一个季度。

e.en: The {gloominess} of the office made everyone want to leave.
e.zh: 办公室的沉闷气氛让每个人都想离开。

e.en: Winter brought a familiar {gloominess} to the small town.
e.zh: 冬天给这座小镇带来了熟悉的阴郁感。

e.en: The forecast looks {gloomy} for this weekend's picnic.
e.zh: 这个周末野餐的天气预报看起来很糟糕。

e.en: He's been {gloomy} ever since losing his job.
e.zh: 自从失业以来他一直闷闷不乐。

glassware.t: n. 玻璃器皿；玻璃制品

e.en: Be careful unpacking the {glassware} from the moving boxes.
e.zh: 从搬家箱里拿玻璃器皿时要小心。

e.en: The shop sells handmade {glassware} from Eastern Europe.
e.zh: 那家店出售来自东欧的手工玻璃器皿。

e.en: The old {glassworks} has been converted into artist studios.
e.zh: 那家老玻璃厂如今已被改建成艺术家工作室。

e.en: My grandfather worked at the {glassworks} for forty years.
e.zh: 我祖父在那家玻璃厂干了四十年。

glassy.t: adj. 像玻璃的；（眼神）呆滞的

e.en: The pond was perfectly still and {glassy} at sunrise.
e.zh: 日出时池塘平静如镜,水面光滑如玻璃。

e.en: His {glassy} stare suggested he hadn't slept in days.
e.zh: 他呆滞的眼神显示他已经好几天没睡了。

glastonbury.t: n. 格拉斯顿伯里（英国小镇及音乐节）

e.en: They camped in the mud at {Glastonbury} all weekend.
e.zh: 他们整个周末都在格拉斯顿伯里音乐节的泥地里露营。

e.en: {Glastonbury} is one of the world's biggest music festivals.
e.zh: 格拉斯顿伯里是世界上规模最大的音乐节之一。

glaswegian.t:
n. 格拉斯哥人
adj. 格拉斯哥的

e.en: His thick {Glaswegian} accent was hard to follow at first.
e.zh: 他浓重的格拉斯哥口音一开始很难听懂。

e.en: She's a proud {Glaswegian} who loves her hometown.
e.zh: 她是个为家乡自豪的格拉斯哥人。

e.en: Regular eye exams can detect {glaucoma} before vision loss begins.
e.zh: 定期眼部检查能在视力受损前发现青光眼。

e.en: Her grandmother lost sight in one eye to {glaucoma}.
e.zh: 她外婆因青光眼一只眼睛失明了。

glaucous.t: adj. 灰绿色的；表面有白霜的

e.en: The leaves had a {glaucous} bluish coating typical of eucalyptus.
e.zh: 叶片覆有桉树特有的灰蓝色蜡层。

e.en: He admired the {glaucous} bloom on the ripe plums.
e.zh: 他欣赏成熟李子上那层灰白色的果粉。

glaxo.t: n. 葛兰素（英国制药公司）

e.en: She landed a research job at {Glaxo} after graduation.
e.zh: 她毕业后在葛兰素找到了一份研究工作。

e.en: {Glaxo} merged with SmithKline Beecham back in 2000.
e.zh: 葛兰素早在2000年就与史克必成合并了。

glaze.t:
n. 釉料；光滑涂层
v. 上釉；装玻璃

e.en: Brush a sweet {glaze} over the ham before baking.
e.zh: 烤火腿前刷上一层甜味釉汁。

e.en: The potter let the {glaze} dry before firing the bowl.
e.zh: 陶艺师让釉料干透后才烧制碗。

glazed.t: adj. 上釉的；（眼神）呆滞的

e.en: He stared at the screen with {glazed} eyes after hours of work.
e.zh: 工作几小时后他双眼呆滞地盯着屏幕。

e.en: She bought a dozen {glazed} donuts for the office.
e.zh: 她给办公室买了一打糖霜甜甜圈。

e.en: We called a {glazier} to replace the broken window pane.
e.zh: 我们叫来玻璃工更换破损的窗玻璃。

e.en: The {glazier} measured the frame before cutting the glass.
e.zh: 装玻璃工先量好窗框再裁切玻璃。

e.en: Double {glazing} keeps the apartment warm in winter.
e.zh: 双层玻璃让公寓在冬天保持温暖。

e.en: She's {glazing} the cake with chocolate before serving.
e.zh: 她正在给蛋糕淋上巧克力浆再上桌。

e.en: His eyes turned {glazy} as the speech dragged on.
e.zh: 演讲拖长后他双眼变得呆滞无神。

e.en: The pottery had a thin {glazy} finish that cracked easily.
e.zh: 那件陶器釉面很薄,容易开裂。

glc.t: n. 气液色谱法（gas-liquid chromatography 的缩写）

e.en: The lab uses {GLC} to separate volatile compounds in samples.
e.zh: 实验室用气液色谱法分离样品中的挥发性化合物。

e.en: Mercedes unveiled a refreshed {GLC} crossover this year.
e.zh: 梅赛德斯今年推出了改款GLC跨界车。

gleam.t:
v. 闪烁；发微光
n. 微光；一丝闪光

e.en: A faint {gleam} of hope returned to her eyes.
e.zh: 她眼中重新闪现出一丝微弱的希望。

e.en: The polished blade {gleamed} in the morning sun.
e.zh: 刀刃在晨光中闪闪发亮。

gleaming.t: adj. 闪闪发光的；锃亮的

e.en: He drove up in a {gleaming} new sports car.
e.zh: 他开着一辆锃亮的新跑车驶来。

e.en: The kitchen counters were {gleaming} after the deep clean.
e.zh: 大扫除后厨房台面光洁照人。

gleams.t: v./n. gleam 的第三人称单数或复数形式

e.en: Moonlight {gleams} off the surface of the lake.
e.zh: 月光在湖面上闪烁。

e.en: The chef's knife {gleams} under the kitchen lights.
e.zh: 厨师的刀在厨房灯光下闪闪发亮。

glean.t: v. 一点一点地搜集（信息）

e.en: Reporters tried to {glean} details from the brief statement.
e.zh: 记者们试图从简短声明中搜集细节。

e.en: You can {glean} a lot about a company from its reviews.
e.zh: 从评论中能了解到一家公司的许多情况。

gleaned.t: v. glean 的过去式；搜集到的

e.en: She {gleaned} useful tips from the online tutorial.
e.zh: 她从在线教程中收集到不少实用技巧。

e.en: Investigators {gleaned} clues from his recent emails.
e.zh: 调查人员从他近期的邮件中搜集到线索。

gleaner.t: n. 拾穗者；搜集资料者

e.en: He's a careful {gleaner} of facts from public records.
e.zh: 他善于从公开档案中细心搜集事实。

e.en: The {gleaner} walked the field after harvest collecting leftover grain.
e.zh: 拾穗者在收割后的田里捡拾剩余的谷物。

e.en: She spent the afternoon {gleaning} insights from customer feedback.
e.zh: 她整个下午都在从用户反馈中提炼见解。

e.en: Volunteers were {gleaning} apples left behind by pickers.
e.zh: 志愿者们在捡拾采摘工漏摘的苹果。

gleanings.t: n. 零星搜集的资料；拾得物

e.en: His blog shares {gleanings} from a week of reading.
e.zh: 他的博客分享一周阅读中的点滴心得。

e.en: The book collects {gleanings} from decades of field research.
e.zh: 这本书收录了数十年田野研究的零散收获。

gleans.t: v. glean 的第三人称单数形式

e.en: The app {gleans} useful habits from your daily activity.
e.zh: 这款应用从你的日常活动中提炼出有用的习惯。

e.en: She {gleans} story ideas from conversations on the bus.
e.zh: 她从公交车上的对话中获取写作灵感。

glebe.t: n. 教会属地；牧师俸田

e.en: The old {glebe} once supported the village priest's family.
e.zh: 那块教会地曾养活村里牧师一家。

e.en: They built the new school on former {glebe} land.
e.zh: 他们在原教会田地上建起了新学校。

e.en: The kids shrieked with {glee} when the puppy arrived.
e.zh: 小狗到来时孩子们高兴得尖叫起来。

e.en: She announced the news with obvious {glee}.
e.zh: 她宣布这消息时难掩喜悦。

gleeful.t: adj. 欢欣的；兴高采烈的

e.en: He wore a {gleeful} grin after winning the lottery.
e.zh: 中了彩票后他咧着嘴乐得合不拢。

e.en: The crowd let out a {gleeful} cheer at the goal.
e.zh: 进球时人群发出欢快的欢呼。

gleefully.t: adv. 欢欣地；兴高采烈地

e.en: The toddler {gleefully} splashed water all over the bathroom.
e.zh: 那个小孩高兴地把水溅得浴室到处都是。

e.en: Critics {gleefully} pointed out flaws in the new product.
e.zh: 评论家们幸灾乐祸地指出新产品的缺陷。

glees.t: n. 无伴奏合唱曲（复数）

e.en: The choir performed several traditional English {glees} at the concert.
e.zh: 合唱团在音乐会上演唱了几首传统的英国合唱曲。

e.en: His album revives forgotten {glees} from the eighteenth century.
e.zh: 他的专辑复兴了被遗忘的十八世纪合唱小品。

e.en: They hiked through a quiet {glen} surrounded by pine trees.
e.zh: 他们徒步穿过被松林环绕的幽静峡谷。

e.en: A small stream ran through the misty Scottish {glen}.
e.zh: 一条小溪流过雾气缭绕的苏格兰山谷。

glencoe.t: n. 格伦科（苏格兰地名）

e.en: We drove through {Glencoe} on our way to the Highlands.
e.zh: 我们前往高地的途中开车穿过了格伦科。

e.en: {Glencoe} is famous for both its scenery and its dark history.
e.zh: 格伦科以风景秀丽和黑暗历史闻名。

gleneagle.t: n. 格伦伊格（苏格兰地名）

e.en: The {Gleneagle} hotel offers stunning views of the surrounding hills.
e.zh: 格伦伊格尔酒店可远眺周围群山的壮丽景色。

e.en: He stayed at a {Gleneagle} resort during the conference.
e.zh: 会议期间他住在一家格伦伊格尔度假村。

gleneagles.t: n. 格伦伊格尔斯（苏格兰度假地）

e.en: The G8 summit was held at {Gleneagles} back in 2005.
e.zh: 八国集团峰会于2005年在格伦伊格尔斯举行。

e.en: They booked a golf weekend at {Gleneagles} in Scotland.
e.zh: 他们订了苏格兰格伦伊格尔斯的高尔夫周末游。

glenfiddich.t: n. 格兰菲迪（苏格兰威士忌品牌）

e.en: He poured a generous dram of {Glenfiddich} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐后他给自己斟了满满一杯格兰菲迪威士忌。

e.en: {Glenfiddich} is one of the best-selling single malts worldwide.
e.zh: 格兰菲迪是全球最畅销的单一麦芽威士忌之一。

glenrothes.t: n. 格伦罗西斯（苏格兰城镇）

e.en: The town of {Glenrothes} grew rapidly after the war.
e.zh: 格兰罗西斯镇在战后迅速发展起来。

e.en: She prefers {Glenrothes} whisky for its smooth, sherried finish.
e.zh: 她喜欢格兰路斯威士忌那柔顺的雪莉桶余韵。

gliadin.t: n. 麦醇溶蛋白（小麦蛋白成分）

e.en: People with celiac disease react strongly to {gliadin} in wheat.
e.zh: 乳糜泻患者对小麦中的麦醇溶蛋白反应强烈。

e.en: The test measures antibodies against {gliadin} in the blood.
e.zh: 该检测测量血液中针对麦醇溶蛋白的抗体。

e.en: {Glial} cells support and protect neurons in the brain.
e.zh: 神经胶质细胞在大脑中支持并保护神经元。

e.en: Scientists discovered new roles for {glial} cells in memory formation.
e.zh: 科学家发现胶质细胞在记忆形成中有新作用。

glib.t: adj. 油嘴滑舌的；轻率的

e.en: His {glib} answers failed to convince the skeptical jury.
e.zh: 他油嘴滑舌的回答没能说服心存疑虑的陪审团。

e.en: Don't give me a {glib} excuse for being late again.
e.zh: 别再给我编一个轻飘飘的迟到借口了。

glibly.t: adv. 油嘴滑舌地；轻率地

e.en: He {glibly} dismissed concerns about the project's safety.
e.zh: 他轻描淡写地打发掉对项目安全的担忧。

e.en: The salesman {glibly} promised features the product didn't have.
e.zh: 销售员油嘴滑舌地承诺一些产品没有的功能。

e.en: His {glibness} in interviews makes voters distrust him.
e.zh: 他在采访中的油滑让选民对他不信任。

e.en: There's a troubling {glibness} to her apology.
e.zh: 她的道歉中透着令人不安的轻浮。

glide.t:
v. 滑行；滑翔
n. 滑动

e.en: Swans {glide} gracefully across the still pond.
e.zh: 天鹅优雅地滑过平静的池塘。

e.en: The dancers {glide} effortlessly across the polished floor.
e.zh: 舞者们毫不费力地在光滑的地板上滑行。

e.en: The {glider} soared silently above the green valley.
e.zh: 滑翔机在绿色山谷上空无声地翱翔。

e.en: He built a model {glider} from balsa wood as a kid.
e.zh: 他小时候用轻木做过一架模型滑翔机。

glides.t: v. glide 的第三人称单数形式

e.en: The robot vacuum {glides} smoothly under the sofa.
e.zh: 扫地机器人平稳地滑入沙发底下。

e.en: She {glides} across the ice as if she's flying.
e.zh: 她在冰面上滑行,仿佛在飞翔。

gliding.t:
n. 滑翔运动
v. 滑行

e.en: An eagle was {gliding} on warm currents above the cliff.
e.zh: 一只鹰借着暖气流在悬崖上方滑翔。

e.en: He took up {gliding} as a hobby last summer.
e.zh: 他去年夏天把滑翔当作了一项爱好。

glimmer.t:
n. 微光；一丝迹象
v. 发微光

e.en: There's still a {glimmer} of hope for a peaceful solution.
e.zh: 和平解决仍有一丝希望。

e.en: A candle's {glimmer} lit up the dark hallway.
e.zh: 烛光微微闪烁,照亮了漆黑的走廊。

glutathione.t: n. 谷胱甘肽（抗氧化物）

e.en: {Glutathione} is a powerful antioxidant produced by the liver.
e.zh: 谷胱甘肽是肝脏产生的一种强力抗氧化剂。

e.en: Some skincare products claim to boost {glutathione} levels.
e.zh: 一些护肤品声称能提高谷胱甘肽水平。

e.en: Squats are great for strengthening the {gluteal} muscles.
e.zh: 深蹲非常适合锻炼臀部肌肉。

e.en: The runner pulled a {gluteal} muscle during training.
e.zh: 那名跑者在训练时拉伤了臀部肌肉。

e.en: Many bakeries now offer {gluten}-free bread options.
