e.zh: 她订阅了《格兰塔》杂志,因为喜欢上面的文学小说。

e.en: His short story appeared in the latest {Granta} issue.
e.zh: 他的短篇小说刊登在最新一期的《格兰塔》上。

granted.t:
v. 授予（过去式）
adv. 诚然；的确

e.en: She was finally {granted} permission to enter the country.
e.zh: 她终于获准入境该国。

e.en: Don't take your good health for {granted}.
e.zh: 不要把自己的健康视为理所当然。

e.en: The {grantee} must submit a progress report every quarter.
e.zh: 获资助方必须每季度提交一份进度报告。

e.en: Each {grantee} receives funding for two full years.
e.zh: 每位受资助者可获得为期两年的资金支持。

grantham.t: n. 格兰瑟姆（英国地名）

e.en: Margaret Thatcher was born in {Grantham}, Lincolnshire.
e.zh: 玛格丽特·撒切尔出生于林肯郡的格兰瑟姆。

e.en: The train stops briefly at {Grantham} on the way north.
e.zh: 列车北上途中会在格兰瑟姆短暂停靠。

granting.t:
v. 授予（现在分词）
conj. 假定；就算

e.en: The bank is {granting} loans to small businesses again.
e.zh: 银行又开始向小企业发放贷款了。

e.en: She thanked the committee for {granting} her request.
e.zh: 她感谢委员会批准了她的请求。

granton.t: n. 格兰顿（苏格兰地名）

e.en: The harbor at {Granton} is being redeveloped into apartments.
e.zh: 格兰顿的港口正被重新开发为公寓。

e.en: {Granton} sits on the northern edge of Edinburgh.
e.zh: 格兰顿位于爱丁堡的北缘。

e.en: The {grantor} signed the deed transferring the property.
e.zh: 授予人签署了转让该房产的契约。

e.en: A {grantor} must clearly state the terms of the trust.
e.zh: 授予人必须明确说明信托的条款。

grants.t:
n. 拨款；补助金（复数）
v. 授予

e.en: Several research {grants} are available for graduate students.
e.zh: 有几项研究资助可供研究生申请。

e.en: The foundation {grants} scholarships to talented young artists.
e.zh: 该基金会向有才华的年轻艺术家提供奖学金。

granular.t: adj. 颗粒状的；细粒度的

e.en: The report provides {granular} data on customer behavior.
e.zh: 这份报告提供了关于客户行为的详细数据。

e.en: Add the {granular} sugar slowly while mixing the batter.
e.zh: 在搅拌面糊时慢慢加入颗粒状的白糖。

granularity.t: n. 粒度；颗粒度（数据、权限等）

e.en: This dashboard offers great {granularity} for tracking sales.
e.zh: 这个仪表盘在追踪销售方面提供了很高的细致程度。

e.en: You can adjust the {granularity} of the search filters.
e.zh: 你可以调整搜索筛选条件的精细程度。

granulate.t: v. 使成颗粒；制成颗粒状

e.en: Machines {granulate} the raw sugar into uniform crystals.
e.zh: 机器将原糖加工成颗粒均匀的结晶。

e.en: Workers {granulate} the plastic before it is recycled.
e.zh: 工人们在回收塑料之前会先把它弄成颗粒状。

e.en: The recipe calls for one cup of {granulated} sugar.
e.zh: 这个食谱需要用一杯白砂糖。

e.en: Stir the {granulated} salt into the warm water.
e.zh: 把颗粒状的盐搅入温水中。

granulation.t: n. 制粒；造粒；肉芽形成

e.en: The wound showed healthy {granulation} during recovery.
e.zh: 伤口在恢复过程中长出了健康的肉芽组织。

e.en: Sugar {granulation} affects the texture of the cookies.
e.zh: 糖的颗粒度会影响饼干的口感。

e.en: Each tiny {granule} of coffee dissolves quickly in hot water.
e.zh: 每一颗咖啡颗粒在热水中都能迅速溶解。

e.en: A single {granule} of pollen can trigger her allergies.
e.zh: 一粒花粉就能引发她的过敏反应。

granulocyte.t: n. 粒细胞（白细胞的一种）

e.en: A high {granulocyte} count may indicate a bacterial infection.
e.zh: 粒细胞计数偏高可能意味着细菌感染。

e.en: The {granulocyte} plays a key role in fighting pathogens.
e.zh: 粒细胞在抵抗病原体方面起着关键作用。

e.en: The biopsy revealed a small {granuloma} in his lung.
e.zh: 活检在他的肺部发现了一个小的肉芽肿。

e.en: A {granuloma} can form around a foreign object in tissue.
e.zh: 组织中的异物周围可能会形成肉芽肿。

e.en: Doctors diagnosed her with a rare {granulomatous} disease.
e.zh: 医生诊断她患有一种罕见的肉芽肿性疾病。

e.en: The lung tissue showed clear {granulomatous} inflammation.
e.zh: 肺部组织显示出明显的肉芽肿性炎症。

e.en: She popped a juicy {grape} into her mouth.
e.zh: 她把一颗多汁的葡萄塞进了嘴里。

e.en: This wine is made from a single {grape} variety.
e.zh: 这款葡萄酒是用单一品种的葡萄酿造的。

e.en: I eat half a {grapefruit} for breakfast every day.
e.zh: 我每天早餐都吃半个西柚。

e.en: {Grapefruit} can interact with certain prescription medications.
e.zh: 西柚可能会与某些处方药产生相互作用。

e.en: The tree produced dozens of pink {grapefruits} this season.
e.zh: 这棵树这一季结了几十个粉红色的西柚。

e.en: She bought three {grapefruits} at the farmer's market.
e.zh: 她在农贸市场买了三个西柚。

e.en: She bought a bunch of green {grapes} at the market.
e.zh: 她在市场上买了一串青葡萄。

e.en: These {grapes} are too sour to eat raw.
e.zh: 这些葡萄太酸了，不能生吃。

grapeshot.t: n. 葡萄弹（旧式火炮霰弹）

e.en: The cannon was loaded with {grapeshot} before the battle.
e.zh: 战斗前大炮装填了葡萄弹。

e.en: Old warships often fired {grapeshot} at close range.
e.zh: 旧时战舰常在近距离发射葡萄弹。

grapevine.t:
n. 小道消息；传闻渠道
n. 葡萄藤

e.en: I heard through the {grapevine} that she got promoted.
e.zh: 我从小道消息听说她升职了。

e.en: The {grapevine} climbed up the wooden trellis quickly.
e.zh: 葡萄藤迅速爬上了木格架。

graph.t:
n. 图表；曲线图
n. 图（数据结构）

e.en: The {graph} shows sales rising sharply this quarter.
e.zh: 图表显示本季度销售额大幅上升。

e.en: Please plot the data on a bar {graph}.
e.zh: 请把数据画成柱状图。

grapheme.t: n. 字素；书写符号（语言学）

e.en: In English, the {grapheme} 'sh' represents a single sound.
e.zh: 在英语中，字位 'sh' 代表一个音。

e.en: Children learn each {grapheme} before reading full words.
e.zh: 孩子们先学每个字位再读整个单词。

graphic.t:
adj. 图形的；生动的
n. 图像；插图

e.en: The movie contains {graphic} violence not suitable for children.
e.zh: 这部电影包含不适合儿童的露骨暴力镜头。

e.en: She designed a striking {graphic} for the album cover.
e.zh: 她为专辑封面设计了一幅醒目的图案。

graphical.t: adj. 图形化的；图形界面的

e.en: The app has a clean {graphical} user interface.
e.zh: 这款应用拥有简洁的图形用户界面。

e.en: He prefers a {graphical} representation of the data.
e.zh: 他更喜欢用图形方式呈现数据。

e.en: The report {graphically} illustrates the company's growth trend.
e.zh: 报告以图形方式展示了公司的增长趋势。

e.en: She {graphically} described the accident in vivid detail.
e.zh: 她生动详尽地描述了那场事故。

graphics.t: n. 图形；图像（界面中的视觉元素）

e.en: This game has stunning 3D {graphics} and smooth gameplay.
e.zh: 这款游戏拥有惊艳的3D画面和流畅的玩法。

e.en: The new laptop handles heavy {graphics} work easily.
e.zh: 这台新笔记本能轻松处理繁重的图形工作。

graphing.t: v. 绘制图表（现在分词）

e.en: Students used a {graphing} calculator during the math exam.
e.zh: 学生们在数学考试中使用了图形计算器。

e.en: He spent hours {graphing} the experiment results.
e.zh: 他花了好几小时绘制实验结果的图表。

e.en: Pencil leads are made from a mixture of {graphite} and clay.
e.zh: 铅笔芯由石墨和黏土的混合物制成。

e.en: The tennis racket frame is reinforced with {graphite}.
e.zh: 这支网球拍的框架用石墨加固。

e.en: She studied {graphology} to analyze personality through handwriting.
e.zh: 她学习笔迹学，通过字迹分析性格。

e.en: Most scientists consider {graphology} to be unreliable.
e.zh: 大多数科学家认为笔迹学并不可靠。

graphs.t: n. 图表（复数）；图（数据结构）

e.en: The dashboard displays several {graphs} updated in real time.
e.zh: 仪表盘上显示了几张实时更新的图表。

e.en: He compared two {graphs} to find the trend.
e.zh: 他对比了两张图表以找出趋势。

grappa.t: n. 格拉帕酒（意大利葡萄渣白兰地）

e.en: After dinner, the host poured everyone a glass of {grappa}.
e.zh: 晚餐后，主人给每人倒了一杯格拉巴酒。

e.en: Italian {grappa} is distilled from leftover grape skins.
e.zh: 意大利格拉巴酒由剩余的葡萄皮蒸馏而成。

grapple.t:
v. 扭打；努力应对
n. 抓钩

e.en: Many parents {grapple} with how much screen time to allow.
e.zh: 许多家长都在纠结该允许多少屏幕时间。

e.en: The two wrestlers began to {grapple} on the mat.
e.zh: 两名摔跤手开始在垫子上扭打。

e.en: The young {grappler} won his first championship last weekend.
e.zh: 这位年轻的摔跤手上周末赢得了首个冠军。

e.en: A skilled {grappler} can control a much larger opponent.
e.zh: 熟练的摔跤手可以制服比自己大得多的对手。

grappling.t:
v. 扭打；设法解决
n. 抓钩

e.en: The country is still {grappling} with rising inflation.
e.zh: 该国仍在艰难应对不断上升的通胀。

e.en: He climbed the wall using a {grappling} hook.
e.zh: 他用抓钩爬上了那堵墙。

e.en: The fossil turned out to be a well-preserved {graptolite}.
e.zh: 那块化石原来是一只保存完好的笔石。

e.en: Geologists use {graptolite} fossils to date ancient rocks.
e.zh: 地质学家用笔石化石来测定古老岩层的年代。

grasmere.t: n. 格拉斯米尔（英国湖区地名）

e.en: We spent a quiet weekend hiking around {grasmere} in the Lake District.
e.zh: 我们在湖区的格拉斯米尔徒步度过了一个宁静的周末。

e.en: The poet Wordsworth lived near {grasmere} for many years.
e.zh: 诗人华兹华斯曾在格拉斯米尔附近住了多年。

grasp.t:
v. 抓住；理解
n. 掌握；把握

e.en: It took me a while to {grasp} the main idea.
e.zh: 我花了一会儿才理解其中的主要意思。

e.en: She tightened her {grasp} on the railing as the bus jolted.
e.zh: 公交车颠簸时，她抓紧了扶手。

graspable.t: adj. 可抓住的；可理解的

e.en: The teacher made the concept easily {graspable} for beginners.
e.zh: 老师把这个概念讲得让初学者也能轻松理解。

e.en: Design the handle so it is {graspable} by small hands.
e.zh: 把手柄设计得让小手也能握住。

e.en: She finally {grasped} why the code kept crashing.
e.zh: 她终于明白了代码为什么一直崩溃。

e.en: He {grasped} the rope tightly and pulled himself up.
e.zh: 他紧紧抓住绳子，把自己拉了上去。

grasping.t:
adj. 贪婪的
v. 抓住；理解（现在分词）

e.en: The toddler is just {grasping} the idea of sharing.
e.zh: 那个幼儿才刚刚开始理解分享的概念。

e.en: She is too {grasping} with money to be generous.
e.zh: 她对钱太贪婪，做不到慷慨。

grasps.t:
v. 抓住；理解（第三人称单数）
n. 掌握

e.en: He quickly {grasps} new programming concepts.
e.zh: 他能迅速掌握新的编程概念。

e.en: The baby firmly {grasps} her father's finger.
e.zh: 婴儿紧紧抓住父亲的手指。

grass.t:
n. 草；草地
v. 告密（俚）

e.en: The kids ran barefoot across the wet {grass}.
e.zh: 孩子们光着脚跑过湿漉漉的草地。

e.en: He needs to mow the {grass} before the rain.
e.zh: 下雨前他得把草坪割了。

grassed.t: v. 铺草；告密（grass 过去式）

e.en: The backyard was newly {grassed} and looked lush.
e.zh: 后院刚铺了草，看起来郁郁葱葱。

e.en: Half the football field is properly {grassed} now.
e.zh: 足球场现在有一半铺好了草皮。

e.en: A green {grasshopper} jumped suddenly out of the bushes.
e.zh: 一只绿色的蚱蜢突然从灌木丛中跳了出来。

e.en: The boy caught a {grasshopper} and put it in a jar.
e.zh: 男孩抓了一只蚱蜢放进罐子里。

e.en: Wild horses still roam freely across the open {grassland}.
e.zh: 野马仍在开阔的草原上自由奔跑。

e.en: This {grassland} supports a wide variety of birds.
e.zh: 这片草原孕育着种类繁多的鸟类。

e.en: The dry, {grassless} field looked abandoned and dusty.
e.zh: 那片干涸无草的田地看上去荒废又满是尘土。

e.en: They covered the {grassless} patch with fresh sod.
e.zh: 他们在那块没草的空地上铺了新鲜草皮。

e.en: The plant has thin, {grasslike} leaves and tiny flowers.
e.zh: 这种植物长着细长似草的叶子和小花。

e.en: Sedges are often mistaken for {grasslike} weeds.
e.zh: 莎草常被误认成像草的杂草。

grassroots.t:
adj. 草根的；基层的
n. 基层民众

e.en: The campaign began as a small {grassroots} movement.
e.zh: 这场运动最初只是一场小规模的草根运动。

e.en: Real change often starts at the {grassroots} level.
e.zh: 真正的变革往往始于基层。

e.en: They had a picnic on a sunny {grassy} hill.
e.zh: 他们在阳光明媚的青草山坡上野餐。

e.en: A {grassy} path led down to the lake.
e.zh: 一条长满青草的小路通向湖边。

grate.t:
v. 磨碎；发出刺耳声
n. 炉栅

e.en: Please {grate} some cheese over the pasta.
e.zh: 请在意面上磨一些奶酪。

e.en: Sparks flew up through the iron {grate} of the fireplace.
e.zh: 火花从壁炉的铁栅栏中飞了出来。

grated.t:
adj. 磨碎的
v. 磨碎（过去式）

e.en: She sprinkled freshly {grated} parmesan on the salad.
e.zh: 她在沙拉上撒了刚磨好的帕玛森芝士。

e.en: His constant whistling really {grated} on my nerves.
e.zh: 他不停地吹口哨，真让我心烦。

e.en: I'm really {grateful} for all your help this week.
e.zh: 非常感谢你这周给予的所有帮助。

e.en: She wrote a {grateful} note to her old teacher.
e.zh: 她给老师写了一封充满感激的便条。

e.en: He {gratefully} accepted the ride home in the rain.
e.zh: 他感激地接受了在雨中搭车回家的好意。

e.en: She {gratefully} thanked the stranger who returned her wallet.
e.zh: 她满怀感激地谢过那位归还钱包的陌生人。

e.en: Her eyes filled with {gratefulness} as she opened the gift.
e.zh: 她打开礼物时，眼里满是感激。

e.en: He expressed deep {gratefulness} for the community's support.
e.zh: 他对社区的支持表达了深深的感激。

e.en: Use a fine {grater} to zest the lemon peel.
e.zh: 用细擦丝器把柠檬皮擦成屑。

e.en: Be careful not to cut your fingers on the {grater}.
e.zh: 小心别在擦丝器上划到手指。

e.en: The map's {graticule} helps you read latitude and longitude.
e.zh: 地图上的经纬网格便于读出经纬度。

e.en: Look through the eyepiece and align the {graticule}.
e.zh: 通过目镜观察并对准刻度网格。

e.en: Social media offers instant {gratification} but little real joy.
e.zh: 社交媒体带来即时满足，却少有真正的快乐。

e.en: He felt deep {gratification} when his project finally succeeded.
e.zh: 项目最终成功时，他感到深深的满足。

gratified.t: adj. 满意的；感到欣慰的

e.en: She was {gratified} to see her students do well.
e.zh: 看到学生们表现出色，她感到很欣慰。

e.en: The author felt {gratified} by the warm reviews.
e.zh: 作者对热情的评论感到十分欣慰。

e.en: Nothing seems to {gratify} him for very long.
e.zh: 似乎没有什么能让他长时间感到满足。

e.en: The chef tries to {gratify} every customer's taste.
e.zh: 主厨努力满足每位顾客的口味。

gratifying.t: adj. 令人满意的；令人欣慰的

e.en: It is {gratifying} to see hard work finally pay off.
e.zh: 看到努力终有回报，真是令人欣慰。

e.en: Teaching can be a deeply {gratifying} career.
e.zh: 教书可以是一份非常令人有成就感的职业。

gratifyingly.t: adv. 令人欣慰地；令人满意地

e.en: The new policy was {gratifyingly} effective in reducing waste.
e.zh: 新政策在减少浪费方面成效显著，令人欣慰。

e.en: Her speech was {gratifyingly} short and to the point.
e.zh: 她的演讲简短中肯，让人很满意。

e.en: She baked a creamy potato {gratin} for the dinner party.
e.zh: 她为晚宴烤了一道奶香土豆焗菜。

e.en: The cauliflower {gratin} had a perfect golden crust.
e.zh: 这道焗花椰菜上面有一层完美的金黄脆皮。

grating.t:
n. 格栅；光栅
adj. 刺耳的

e.en: His loud, {grating} laugh annoyed everyone in the room.
e.zh: 他那刺耳的大笑声让屋里所有人都很烦。

e.en: Cold air came up through the metal {grating} in the floor.
e.zh: 冷空气从地板的金属格栅里冒了上来。

gratis.t:
adv. 免费地
adj. 免费的

e.en: The hotel provides breakfast {gratis} to all guests.
e.zh: 酒店为所有客人免费提供早餐。

e.en: He fixed my bike {gratis} as a favor.
e.zh: 他帮个忙，免费修好了我的自行车。

e.en: She expressed her sincere {gratitude} to the rescue team.
e.zh: 她向救援队表达了真诚的感激之情。

e.en: Keeping a {gratitude} journal can improve your mood.
e.zh: 写感恩日记可以改善心情。

e.en: The film was criticized for its {gratuitous} violence.
e.zh: 这部电影因毫无必要的暴力镜头而受到批评。

e.en: He made a {gratuitous} remark that hurt her feelings.
e.zh: 他说了一句毫无必要的话，伤了她的感情。

e.en: The character was {gratuitously} rude to the waiter.
e.zh: 那个角色对服务员无端地粗鲁。

e.en: He {gratuitously} insulted a stranger online.
e.zh: 他在网上无缘无故地侮辱一个陌生人。

e.en: The film's {gratuitousness} of violence turned away many viewers.
e.zh: 这部电影中无谓的暴力让许多观众望而却步。

e.en: Critics complained about the {gratuitousness} of the long sex scenes.
e.zh: 评论家抱怨那些冗长性爱场景毫无必要。

e.en: A fifteen percent {gratuity} is automatically added to large groups.
e.zh: 大型团体的账单会自动加收百分之十五的小费。

e.en: He left a generous {gratuity} on the restaurant table.
e.zh: 他在餐桌上留下了丰厚的小费。

grav.t: n. 重力单位（gravity 缩写）

e.en: The pilot endured nine {grav} during the sharp turn.
e.zh: 飞行员在急转弯时承受了九倍重力。

e.en: Roller coaster fans love the high {grav} on the loops.
e.zh: 过山车迷喜爱环形轨道上的高重力加速度。

grave.t:
n. 坟墓
adj. 严重的；严肃的

e.en: The doctor wore a {grave} expression as she entered.
e.zh: 医生走进来时神情凝重。

e.en: Visitors placed flowers on the soldier's {grave}.
e.zh: 来访者在那位士兵的墓前献上鲜花。

e.en: The old {gravedigger} leaned on his shovel and rested.
e.zh: 那位年迈的掘墓人靠在铁锹上休息。

e.en: A {gravedigger} works quietly at the edge of the cemetery.
e.zh: 一名掘墓人在墓园边缘默默地工作。

e.en: The driveway was covered with crunchy white {gravel}.
e.zh: 车道上铺满了嘎吱作响的白色碎石。

e.en: Tires kicked up dust as we drove on {gravel}.
e.zh: 我们开在碎石路上时,轮胎扬起了灰尘。

gravelled.t:
adj. 铺砾石的
v. 铺砾石（过去式）

e.en: They {gravelled} the path leading to the garden gate.
e.zh: 他们在通往花园门的小径上铺了碎石。

e.en: The newly {gravelled} road crunched under our boots.
e.zh: 新铺碎石的道路在我们靴下嘎吱作响。

gravelly.t: adj. 多砾石的；（嗓音）粗哑的

e.en: His {gravelly} voice made every story sound mysterious.
e.zh: 他粗哑低沉的嗓音让每个故事都听起来神秘。

e.en: We hiked along a {gravelly} riverbank for hours.
e.zh: 我们沿着布满砾石的河岸徒步了好几个小时。

e.en: She nodded {gravely} when he mentioned the diagnosis.
e.zh: 他提到诊断结果时,她郑重地点了点头。

e.en: Several passengers were {gravely} injured in the crash.
e.zh: 事故中有几名乘客身受重伤。

e.en: His face wore a {graven} look of disappointment.
e.zh: 他脸上刻着一副失望的表情。

e.en: The temple forbids any {graven} image of its deity.
e.zh: 该庙宇禁止为其神祇制作任何雕像。

e.en: Many soldiers' {graves} line the hill behind the chapel.
e.zh: 许多士兵的坟墓沿着教堂后面的山坡排列。

e.en: Volunteers clean the {graves} every spring before the holiday.
e.zh: 志愿者每年春季节日前都会清理墓地。

gravesend.t: n. 格雷夫森德（英国地名）

e.en: The ferry from {Gravesend} crosses the Thames every hour.
e.zh: 从格雷夫森德开出的渡轮每小时横渡泰晤士河一次。

e.en: She grew up in {Gravesend}, near the Kentish coast.
e.zh: 她在肯特海岸附近的格雷夫森德长大。

e.en: Family members gathered at the {graveside} for a brief service.
e.zh: 家人聚集在墓旁举行了简短的仪式。

e.en: He whispered a final goodbye at his mother's {graveside}.
e.zh: 他在母亲墓旁低声道了最后的别。

e.en: Tourists visit the poet's {gravesite} every autumn.
e.zh: 游客们每年秋天都会去那位诗人的墓地参观。

e.en: The historic {gravesite} has been preserved by the city.
e.zh: 这片具有历史意义的墓地由市政府保护。

e.en: Moss had crept across the old {gravestone} over decades.
e.zh: 几十年来青苔已悄悄爬满了那块旧墓碑。

e.en: The {gravestone} bore only her name and two dates.
e.zh: 墓碑上只刻着她的名字和两个日期。

e.en: Rows of weathered {gravestones} stretched across the quiet hill.
e.zh: 一排排饱经风霜的墓碑延伸到那座静谧的山上。

e.en: Many of the {gravestones} dated back to the 1800s.
e.zh: 其中许多墓碑可以追溯到十九世纪。

e.en: A black cat darted through the moonlit {graveyard}.
e.zh: 一只黑猫穿过洒满月光的墓地。

e.en: The old shipping route became a {graveyard} for vessels.
e.zh: 那条古老航线成了船只的葬身之地。

e.en: The {gravid} female shark sought warmer coastal waters.
e.zh: 那条怀孕的母鲨游向更温暖的近岸水域。

e.en: Her speech was {gravid} with implications for the campaign.
e.zh: 她的讲话对这场竞选意味深长。

e.en: The cookbook features rich {gravies} from across the South.
e.zh: 这本食谱介绍了美国南方各地的浓郁肉汁酱。

e.en: He compared mushroom and onion {gravies} side by side.
e.zh: 他把蘑菇酱汁和洋葱酱汁并排比较。

gravimetric.t: adj. 重量测定的；重力测量的

e.en: Engineers used {gravimetric} analysis to measure the soil density.
e.zh: 工程师采用重量分析法测量土壤密度。

e.en: The lab relies on {gravimetric} methods for precise weighing.
e.zh: 该实验室依靠重量法进行精确称量。

gravitate.t: v. 被吸引；受重力作用

e.en: Teenagers naturally {gravitate} toward apps their friends use.
e.zh: 青少年自然会被朋友们用的应用吸引过去。

e.en: Shoppers tend to {gravitate} toward brightly colored displays.
e.zh: 购物者往往会被色彩鲜艳的展示所吸引。

e.en: Over time he {gravitated} toward documentary photography.
e.zh: 随着时间推移,他逐渐被纪实摄影所吸引。

e.en: Most attendees {gravitated} to the buffet near the window.
e.zh: 大多数与会者都聚集到窗边的自助餐台旁。

gravitates.t: v. 被吸引（第三人称单数）

e.en: Our cat always {gravitates} toward the warmest spot in the room.
e.zh: 我们的猫总是被房间里最暖和的地方吸引。

e.en: She {gravitates} toward leadership roles in every team.
e.zh: 她在每个团队中总是倾向于担任领导角色。

gravitating.t:
v. 受吸引（趋向于）
v. 受重力作用

e.en: Investors are {gravitating} toward green energy stocks.
e.zh: 投资者纷纷把目光转向绿色能源股票。

e.en: Younger viewers are {gravitating} away from cable television.
e.zh: 年轻观众正逐渐远离有线电视。

gravitation.t: n. 万有引力；重力作用

e.en: Newton's law of {gravitation} explains why apples fall down.
e.zh: 牛顿的万有引力定律解释了苹果为什么会掉下来。

e.en: There's a clear {gravitation} of talent toward big tech firms.
e.zh: 人才明显倾向于流向大型科技公司。

e.en: The moon's {gravitational} pull causes ocean tides every day.
e.zh: 月球的引力每天引发海洋潮汐。

e.en: Scientists detected {gravitational} waves from a distant black hole.
e.zh: 科学家探测到来自遥远黑洞的引力波。

gravitationally.t: adv. 由于引力地；在重力作用下

e.en: The two stars are {gravitationally} bound in a tight orbit.
e.zh: 这两颗恒星因引力相互束缚,运行在紧密的轨道上。

e.en: Saturn's rings are {gravitationally} influenced by its many moons.
e.zh: 土星环受到其众多卫星引力的影响。

e.en: The textbook lists various {gravitations} between celestial bodies.
e.zh: 教科书列出了天体之间的各种引力。

e.en: Cultural {gravitations} shift slowly across generations.
e.zh: 文化倾向会随着代际缓慢变迁。

e.en: Different planets have very different surface {gravities}.
e.zh: 不同行星的表面重力差异很大。

e.en: Astronomers compared the {gravities} of several rocky exoplanets.
e.zh: 天文学家比较了几颗岩质系外行星的重力。

graviton.t: n. 引力子（物理学假想粒子）

e.en: Physicists still hope to detect a single {graviton} someday.
e.zh: 物理学家仍希望有一天能探测到单个引力子。

e.en: The {graviton} is a hypothetical particle that carries gravity.
e.zh: 引力子是一种假设中传递引力的粒子。

gravity.t:
n. 重力；地心引力
n. 严重性

e.en: Earth's {gravity} keeps the moon in its orbit.
e.zh: 地球的引力使月亮维持在轨道上。

e.en: He didn't grasp the {gravity} of the security breach.
e.zh: 他没有意识到这次安全漏洞的严重性。

e.en: She served thin slices of {gravlax} on dark rye bread.
e.zh: 她把薄薄的腌三文鱼片放在黑麦面包上端上。

e.en: Homemade {gravlax} requires only salt, sugar, and fresh dill.
e.zh: 自制腌三文鱼只需要盐、糖和新鲜莳萝。

gravy.t: n. 肉汁；浇肉汁的酱汁

e.en: He poured thick brown {gravy} over his mashed potatoes.
e.zh: 他把浓浓的棕色肉汁浇在土豆泥上。

e.en: After paying rent, the rest of his salary is {gravy}.
e.zh: 付完房租之后,他工资的其余部分都是额外收入。

gray.t:
adj. 灰色的
n. 灰色

e.en: The sky turned {gray} just before the storm arrived.
e.zh: 暴风雨来临前天空变成了灰色。

e.en: His hair started going {gray} in his early thirties.
e.zh: 他三十出头时头发就开始变白了。

e.en: A wise {graybeard} sat reading on the park bench.
e.zh: 一位睿智的白胡子老者坐在公园长椅上看书。

e.en: The startup hired a {graybeard} to mentor its young engineers.
e.zh: 那家创业公司请了一位资深老将来指导年轻工程师。

e.en: His temples had {grayed} considerably since their last meeting.
e.zh: 自他们上次见面以来,他的鬓角已显著斑白。

e.en: The disabled menu options are {grayed} out on the screen.
e.zh: 屏幕上禁用的菜单选项以灰色显示。

e.en: The {graying} professor adjusted his glasses before lecturing.
e.zh: 那位头发渐白的教授在讲课前扶了扶眼镜。

e.en: Japan faces challenges from its rapidly {graying} population.
e.zh: 日本正面临人口迅速老龄化带来的挑战。

e.en: The walls were painted a soft {grayish} blue.
e.zh: 墙壁被刷成了柔和的灰蓝色。

e.en: A {grayish} mist hung over the harbor at dawn.
e.zh: 清晨港口上空笼罩着一层灰蒙蒙的薄雾。

e.en: Anglers came from afar to fish for {grayling} here.
e.zh: 垂钓者从远处赶来在这里钓茴鱼。

e.en: A small {grayling} darted between the cold mountain stones.
e.zh: 一条小茴鱼在冰冷的山石之间快速穿梭。

e.en: The {grayness} of February makes everyone long for spring.
e.zh: 二月的阴沉灰暗让每个人都渴望春天。

e.en: A heavy {grayness} settled over the abandoned factory district.
e.zh: 一片沉重的灰暗笼罩着废弃的工厂区。

grays.t:
n. 灰色（复数）
v. 变灰

e.en: The painting uses subtle {grays} to suggest a foggy morning.
e.zh: 这幅画用微妙的灰色调表现雾蒙蒙的清晨。

e.en: Her hair shows a few {grays} but she looks young.
e.zh: 她头发里有几根白发,但看起来依然年轻。

e.en: The eco-house recycles {graywater} for irrigating the garden.
e.zh: 这座生态住宅将生活废水回收用于浇灌花园。

e.en: New regulations encourage homeowners to reuse {graywater} safely.
e.zh: 新法规鼓励房主安全地再利用生活废水。

graz.t: n. 格拉茨（奥地利城市）

e.en: We took a fast train from Vienna to {Graz}.
e.zh: 我们乘坐高速列车从维也纳前往格拉茨。

e.en: {Graz} is famous for its red rooftops and old town.
e.zh: 格拉茨以其红色屋顶和古老的市中心而闻名。

graze.t:
v. 吃草；放牧
v. 擦过；擦伤

e.en: Cows {graze} peacefully in the meadow all afternoon.
e.zh: 奶牛整个下午在草地上安静地吃草。

e.en: The bullet only managed to {graze} his left shoulder.
e.zh: 子弹只是擦伤了他的左肩。

e.en: Sheep {grazed} on the steep hills above the village.
e.zh: 羊群在村庄上方陡峭的山坡上吃草。

e.en: She fell off her bike and {grazed} her knee.
e.zh: 她从自行车上摔下来,擦伤了膝盖。

e.en: The bison is the largest {grazer} on the prairie.
e.zh: 野牛是大草原上体型最大的食草动物。

e.en: He's a {grazer} who prefers small snacks throughout the day.
e.zh: 他喜欢一整天吃零食,而不是正餐。

grazing.t:
v. 吃草；放牧
n. 牧草地

e.en: Cattle were {grazing} quietly along the riverbank at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时牛群在河岸边静静地吃草。

e.en: Local ranchers depend on public lands for {grazing}.
e.zh: 当地牧场主依靠公共土地放牧牲畜。

gre.t: n. 美国研究生入学考试

e.en: She studied for months before taking the {GRE} exam.
e.zh: 她为参加美国研究生入学考试备考了好几个月。

e.en: Most graduate programs no longer require {GRE} scores.
e.zh: 大多数研究生项目不再要求提交美国研究生入学考试成绩。

grease.t:
n. 油脂；润滑油
v. 涂油；润滑

e.en: Be sure to {grease} the pan before pouring the batter.
e.zh: 倒入面糊前一定要先在锅上抹油。

e.en: Mechanics often have {grease} stains on their uniforms.
e.zh: 机械师的工作服上经常沾着油污。

e.en: She {greased} the muffin tin with a thin layer of butter.
e.zh: 她在松饼烤盘上薄薄抹了一层黄油。

e.en: The deal was {greased} by a few well-placed donations.
e.zh: 这笔交易靠几笔精心安排的捐款打通了关节。

greaseless.t: adj. 不含油脂的；清爽的

e.en: She prefers a {greaseless} moisturizer for daytime wear.
e.zh: 她白天喜欢用不油腻的保湿霜。

e.en: This pan claims to deliver a {greaseless} fried egg.
e.zh: 这个平底锅号称能煎出不油腻的鸡蛋。

e.en: The actor wiped {greasepaint} from his face after the show.
e.zh: 演员在演出后擦掉脸上的油彩。

e.en: Old circus clowns wore thick layers of {greasepaint}.
e.zh: 昔日的马戏团小丑会涂厚厚的油彩。

e.en: Line the baking tray with {greaseproof} paper before use.
e.zh: 使用前先在烤盘上铺一层防油纸。

e.en: She wrapped the sandwiches in {greaseproof} paper.
e.zh: 她用防油纸把三明治包好。

e.en: The film portrays a 1950s {greaser} with slicked-back hair.
e.zh: 电影刻画了一个五十年代头发油亮的飞车党青年。

e.en: He dressed as a {greaser} for the costume party.
e.zh: 他打扮成飞车党的样子去参加化装派对。

e.en: {Greasewood} thrives in the dry desert basin.
e.zh: 油木灌丛在干燥的沙漠盆地中生长茂盛。

e.en: Cattle generally avoid eating the toxic {greasewood}.
e.zh: 牛通常会避开有毒的油木灌丛。

e.en: The diner served a {greasy} but delicious breakfast.
e.zh: 那家小餐馆提供油腻但美味的早餐。

e.en: My hair gets {greasy} if I skip washing it.
e.zh: 我不洗头的话头发就会变得油腻。

great.t:
adj. 很棒的；伟大的
adj. 巨大的

e.en: That movie was absolutely {great} from start to finish.
e.zh: 那部电影从头到尾都非常棒。

e.en: She did a {great} job on the presentation.
e.zh: 她在演讲中表现得非常出色。

e.en: The soldier wore a heavy wool {greatcoat} in winter.
e.zh: 那名士兵冬天穿着厚重的羊毛军大衣。

e.en: He buttoned up his {greatcoat} against the freezing wind.
e.zh: 他扣紧大衣抵御刺骨的寒风。

e.en: The new model offers {greater} battery life than before.
e.zh: 新款的电池续航比以前更长。

e.en: Tokyo lies in the {greater} metropolitan area of Kanto.
e.zh: 东京位于关东大都市圈内。

e.en: Many fans call him the {greatest} player of all time.
e.zh: 许多球迷称他为史上最伟大的球员。

e.en: Her {greatest} fear is public speaking.
e.zh: 她最大的恐惧是当众演讲。

e.en: The new policy {greatly} improved employee morale.
e.zh: 新政策大大提升了员工的士气。

e.en: I {greatly} appreciate your help with the project.
e.zh: 非常感谢你对这个项目的帮助。

e.en: True {greatness} comes from helping others succeed.
e.zh: 真正的伟大源于帮助他人成功。

e.en: The coach pushed the team toward {greatness}.
e.zh: 教练督促球队迈向卓越。

e.en: The book explores the small {greatnesses} of ordinary lives.
e.zh: 这本书探讨了平凡人生中的种种伟大之处。

e.en: History records the {greatnesses} of many forgotten figures.
e.zh: 历史记载了许多被遗忘人物的伟大成就。

e.en: The knight strapped on his {greaves} before the battle.
e.zh: 骑士在战斗前系好了护胫甲。

e.en: Roman soldiers wore bronze {greaves} to protect their shins.
e.zh: 罗马士兵穿戴青铜护胫甲以保护小腿。

e.en: A {grebe} dove beneath the lake's surface to catch fish.
e.zh: 一只䴙䴘潜入湖面下捕鱼。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a rare {grebe} near the marsh.
e.zh: 观鸟者在沼泽附近发现了一只罕见的䴙䴘。

e.en: The hotel lobby featured tall {Grecian} columns.
e.zh: 酒店大堂有高耸的希腊式立柱。

e.en: She styled her hair in a soft {Grecian} braid.
e.zh: 她把头发盘成柔美的希腊式发辫。

e.en: He won gold in {Greco}-Roman wrestling at the Olympics.
e.zh: 他在奥运会古典式摔跤项目中夺得金牌。

e.en: The museum displays {Greco}-Roman sculptures from the era.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了那个时代的希腊罗马雕塑。

e.en: We spent two weeks island-hopping in {Greece}.
e.zh: 我们在希腊跳岛游玩了两个星期。

e.en: {Greece} is famous for its ancient ruins and beaches.
e.zh: 希腊以古代遗迹和海滩闻名。

e.en: Corporate {greed} has driven up housing prices everywhere.
e.zh: 企业的贪婪推高了各地的房价。

e.en: His downfall was caused by sheer {greed}.
e.zh: 他的失败完全是由贪婪造成的。

e.en: The puppy ate the treats {greedily}.
e.zh: 小狗贪婪地吃掉了那些零食。

e.en: He {greedily} grabbed the last slice of pizza.
e.zh: 他贪婪地抢走了最后一块披萨。

e.en: Her {greediness} for power eventually cost her friendships.
e.zh: 她对权力的贪婪最终让她失去了友谊。

e.en: The child's {greediness} at the buffet embarrassed his parents.
e.zh: 孩子在自助餐上的贪吃让父母很尴尬。

e.en: Don't be {greedy} — leave some cake for others.
e.zh: 别太贪心,给别人留点蛋糕。

e.en: The {greedy} CEO awarded himself a massive bonus.
e.zh: 贪婪的首席执行官给自己发了一笔巨额奖金。

greek.t:
adj. 希腊的
n. 希腊人；希腊语

e.en: She studied ancient {Greek} philosophy at university.
e.zh: 她在大学攻读古希腊哲学。

e.en: This contract is all {Greek} to me.
e.zh: 这份合同我完全看不懂。

green.t:
adj. 绿色的；环保的
n. 绿色

e.en: The traffic light turned {green} and we drove off.
e.zh: 红绿灯变绿,我们就开走了。

e.en: The company is going {green} by switching to solar power.
e.zh: 公司正通过改用太阳能走向环保。

e.en: He pulled a crisp {greenback} from his wallet.
e.zh: 他从钱包里抽出一张崭新的美元钞票。

e.en: Investors flocked to the {greenback} during market turmoil.
e.zh: 市场动荡时投资者纷纷涌向美元。

greenbank.t: n. 格林班克（地名/姓氏）

e.en: The {Greenbank} radio telescope detects faint cosmic signals.
e.zh: 格林班克射电望远镜能探测到微弱的宇宙信号。

e.en: Astronomers gathered at {Greenbank} for the annual conference.
e.zh: 天文学家们在格林班克参加年度会议。

greenbelt.t: n. 绿化带；城市周边的绿地

e.en: The city protects its {greenbelt} from new construction.
e.zh: 该市保护其绿化带不受新建项目的侵占。

e.en: Families enjoy weekend picnics in the {greenbelt}.
e.zh: 家庭们喜欢在绿化带里享受周末野餐。

greenbrier.t: n. 菝葜（一种带刺藤本植物）

e.en: Thorny {greenbrier} vines covered the abandoned fence.
e.zh: 带刺的菝葜藤蔓爬满了废弃的栅栏。

e.en: Hikers struggled through dense {greenbrier} on the trail.
e.zh: 徒步者在小径上艰难地穿过茂密的菝葜丛。

greenery.t: n. 绿色植物；葱翠的草木

e.en: The balcony was decorated with lush {greenery}.
e.zh: 阳台上装饰着茂盛的绿色植物。

e.en: I love the {greenery} that surrounds our cabin.
e.zh: 我喜欢小屋周围的一片葱绿。

greenfield.t:
n. 未开发土地
adj. 全新项目的（无历史包袱）

e.en: The team is building a {greenfield} project from scratch.
e.zh: 团队正在从零开始构建一个全新的项目。

e.en: Developers prefer {greenfield} sites over crowded urban lots.
e.zh: 开发商更青睐未开发用地,而非拥挤的城市地块。

e.en: The roses are infested with {greenfly} again this summer.
e.zh: 今年夏天玫瑰又被蚜虫侵害了。

e.en: Ladybugs help control the {greenfly} in my garden.
e.zh: 瓢虫帮助控制我花园里的蚜虫。

greenford.t: n. 格林福德（伦敦地名）

e.en: She commutes from {Greenford} into central London daily.
e.zh: 她每天从格林福德通勤到伦敦市中心。

e.en: {Greenford} station is on the Central line.
e.zh: 格林福德站位于中央线上。

e.en: The local {greengrocer} sells fresh tomatoes every morning.
e.zh: 当地的果蔬店每天早上都卖新鲜番茄。

e.en: I bought apples from the {greengrocer} on the corner.
e.zh: 我在街角的果蔬店买了苹果。

e.en: She opened a small {greengrocery} on the high street.
e.zh: 她在大街上开了一家小型果蔬店。

e.en: The {greengrocery} stocks organic produce from local farms.
e.zh: 这家果蔬店出售来自当地农场的有机农产品。

greenham.t: n. 格林汉姆（英国地名）

e.en: The {Greenham} Common protests became a feminist landmark.
e.zh: 格林汉姆公地抗议成为女性主义运动的里程碑。

e.en: Women camped at {Greenham} for nearly two decades.
e.zh: 妇女们在格林汉姆扎营抗议了将近二十年。

greenhill.t: n. 格林希尔（地名/姓氏）

e.en: The {Greenhill} family has farmed this land for generations.
e.zh: 格林希尔家族世代在这片土地上耕作。

e.en: We hiked up to {Greenhill} for the sunset view.
e.zh: 我们徒步登上格林希尔欣赏日落景色。

greenhorn.t: n. 新手；生手；没经验的人

e.en: The veteran cowboys teased the {greenhorn} on his first roundup.
e.zh: 老牛仔们在新手第一次赶牛时取笑他。

e.en: Don't worry — every expert was once a {greenhorn}.
e.zh: 别担心,每个专家都曾是新手。

e.en: She grows tomatoes year-round in her backyard {greenhouse}.
e.zh: 她在后院的温室里全年种植番茄。

e.en: Cars contribute heavily to {greenhouse} gas emissions.
e.zh: 汽车大量排放温室气体。

e.en: The farm uses solar-powered {greenhouses} to grow lettuce.
e.zh: 这家农场用太阳能温室种植生菜。

e.en: Modern {greenhouses} can control temperature and humidity precisely.
e.zh: 现代温室能精确控制温度和湿度。

greening.t:
n. 绿化
v. 变绿；使环保

e.en: The city is {greening} its rooftops to reduce heat.
e.zh: 该市正在屋顶绿化以降低热度。

e.en: Spring brought a slow {greening} of the hillsides.
e.zh: 春天让山坡渐渐变绿。

greenish.t: adj. 略带绿色的；淡绿的

e.en: The water had a strange {greenish} tint after the storm.
e.zh: 暴雨过后,水呈现出奇怪的淡绿色。

e.en: She painted the walls a soft {greenish} blue.
e.zh: 她把墙壁刷成柔和的青绿色。

greenkeeper.t: n. 高尔夫球场草地管理员

e.en: The {greenkeeper} mows the fairways at dawn each day.
e.zh: 球场管理员每天清晨修剪球道草坪。

e.en: A skilled {greenkeeper} keeps the golf course in pristine condition.
e.zh: 经验丰富的球场管理员让高尔夫球场保持完美状态。

e.en: {Greenland}'s ice sheet is melting faster than expected.
e.zh: 格陵兰的冰盖融化速度比预期更快。

e.en: We took a cruise along the coast of {Greenland}.
e.zh: 我们沿着格陵兰海岸乘船游览。

e.en: The moss glowed {greenly} under the morning light.
e.zh: 苔藓在晨光下泛着绿莹莹的光。

e.en: The valley stretched {greenly} into the distance.
e.zh: 山谷绿意盎然地向远方延伸。

greenness.t: n. 翠绿；生涩；环保程度

e.en: The {greenness} of the spring meadow lifted my spirits.
e.zh: 春天草地的青翠让我心情舒畅。

e.en: Satellite images measure the {greenness} of forests over time.
e.zh: 卫星图像可以测量森林随时间变化的绿色程度。

greenock.t: n. 格里诺克（苏格兰港口）

e.en: {Greenock} is a coastal town on Scotland's west coast.
e.zh: 格里诺克是苏格兰西海岸的一座沿海小镇。

e.en: Ferries from {Greenock} once carried emigrants to America.
e.zh: 从格里诺克出发的渡船曾把移民送往美洲。

e.en: {Greenpeace} activists protested outside the oil company headquarters.
e.zh: 绿色和平的活动人士在石油公司总部外抗议。

e.en: She donates monthly to {Greenpeace} to support ocean conservation.
e.zh: 她每月向绿色和平捐款以支持海洋保护。

greenroom.t: n. 后台休息室；嘉宾候场室

e.en: The actors waited in the {greenroom} before going onstage.
e.zh: 演员们在演员休息室等候上台。

e.en: Snacks and coffee were laid out in the {greenroom}.
e.zh: 演员休息室里摆放了点心和咖啡。

greens.t:
n. 绿叶蔬菜
n. 绿党；环保人士

e.en: Eat your leafy {greens} for better health.
e.zh: 多吃绿叶蔬菜有益健康。

e.en: The {Greens} won several seats in the recent election.
e.zh: 绿党在最近的选举中赢得了几个席位。

greenskeeper.t: n. 高尔夫球场草地管理员

e.en: The {greenskeeper} repaired the divots after the tournament.
e.zh: 球场管理员在比赛后修补了草皮上的凹痕。

e.en: Our {greenskeeper} starts work before sunrise every morning.
e.zh: 我们的球场管理员每天天亮前就开始工作。

e.en: The Maori carved a pendant from polished {greenstone}.
e.zh: 毛利人用打磨过的绿石雕刻吊坠。

e.en: Hikers found a vein of {greenstone} in the cliff.
e.zh: 徒步者在悬崖中发现了一条绿岩矿脉。

e.en: Rabbits need plenty of fresh {greenstuff} every day.
e.zh: 兔子每天需要大量新鲜的绿叶蔬菜。

e.en: The chef tossed some {greenstuff} into the salad bowl.
e.zh: 厨师把一些青菜扔进沙拉碗里。

e.en: Children played on the wide {greensward} behind the manor.
e.zh: 孩子们在庄园后面宽阔的草地上玩耍。

e.en: A picnic was spread across the sunny {greensward}.
e.zh: 野餐铺展在阳光明媚的草坪上。

e.en: The city built a {greenway} along the old railway.
e.zh: 市政府沿着旧铁路修建了一条绿道。

e.en: Cyclists love riding the new river {greenway}.
e.zh: 骑行者喜欢在新建的河滨绿道上骑车。

greenwich.t: n. 格林尼治（伦敦地区）

e.en: The clock shows time in {Greenwich} Mean Time.
e.zh: 这个时钟显示的是格林尼治标准时间。

e.en: We visited the observatory in {Greenwich}, London.
e.zh: 我们参观了伦敦格林尼治的天文台。

e.en: Robin Hood lived deep in the {greenwood}.
e.zh: 罗宾汉住在茂密的绿林深处。

e.en: Birds nested all through the quiet {greenwood}.
e.zh: 鸟儿在静谧的绿林中四处筑巢。

e.en: The walls had a faint {greeny} tint in daylight.
e.zh: 墙壁在日光下泛着淡淡的绿色。

e.en: She wore a {greeny} blue scarf to work.
e.zh: 她戴着一条偏绿的蓝色围巾去上班。

e.en: The host came out to {greet} every guest personally.
e.zh: 主人亲自出来迎接每一位客人。

e.en: Dogs always {greet} their owners with wagging tails.
e.zh: 狗总是摇着尾巴迎接主人。

greeted.t: v. 问候（greet 的过去式）

e.en: She {greeted} her colleagues with a warm smile.
e.zh: 她以温暖的微笑问候同事们。

e.en: The crowd {greeted} the announcement with loud cheers.
e.zh: 人群以热烈的欢呼回应这个消息。

e.en: A friendly {greeter} stood at the store entrance.
e.zh: 一位友善的迎宾员站在店门口。

e.en: The hotel hired a {greeter} to welcome arriving guests.
e.zh: 酒店雇了一位迎宾员来欢迎到访客人。

greeting.t: n. 问候；打招呼；招呼语

e.en: He sent a warm {greeting} to his old teacher.
e.zh: 他向老师致以温暖的问候。

e.en: A simple {greeting} can brighten someone's whole day.
e.zh: 一句简单的问候就能照亮某人一整天。

e.en: Please pass my warmest {greetings} to your family.
e.zh: 请代我向你的家人致以最热烈的问候。

e.en: Holiday {greetings} flooded her inbox in December.
e.zh: 十二月里节日问候涌入了她的收件箱。

greets.t: v. 问候（greet 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The receptionist {greets} every visitor with a smile.
e.zh: 前台微笑着迎接每一位来访者。

e.en: My cat always {greets} me at the front door.
e.zh: 我的猫总在前门迎接我。

e.en: She's a {gregarious} person who loves big parties.
e.zh: 她是个爱热闹、喜欢大型聚会的人。

e.en: Dolphins are highly {gregarious} animals living in pods.
e.zh: 海豚是高度群居的动物,成群生活。

e.en: His natural {gregariousness} made him a great salesman.
e.zh: 他天生的合群性格让他成为出色的销售员。

e.en: The puppy's {gregariousness} won over everyone at the park.
e.zh: 小狗的亲人性格赢得了公园里所有人的喜爱。

gregorian.t:
adj. 格里高利的
n. 公历（格里历）

e.en: Most countries today follow the {Gregorian} calendar.
e.zh: 如今大多数国家都使用公历(格里高利历)。

e.en: The monks sang a beautiful {Gregorian} chant at dawn.
e.zh: 僧侣们在黎明时分唱起优美的格里高利圣咏。

gremlin.t: n. 小精怪；（机器的）故障小妖

e.en: Some {gremlin} keeps deleting my saved files.
e.zh: 有个小妖精老是删掉我保存的文件。

e.en: There's a {gremlin} in the printer again today.
e.zh: 打印机今天又出小毛病了。

e.en: {Grenada} is famous for its nutmeg and spices.
e.zh: 格林纳达以其肉豆蔻和香料而闻名。

e.en: We honeymooned on the beaches of {Grenada}.
e.zh: 我们在格林纳达的海滩上度蜜月。

e.en: The soldier carefully pulled the pin from the {grenade}.
e.zh: 士兵小心地拔掉了手榴弹的保险销。

e.en: Police found a smoke {grenade} in the abandoned car.
e.zh: 警方在废弃车辆中发现了一枚烟雾弹。

e.en: A tall {grenadier} stood guard outside the palace.
e.zh: 一名高大的掷弹兵在宫殿外站岗。

e.en: The {grenadier} regiment paraded in their bearskin hats.
e.zh: 掷弹兵团戴着熊皮帽列队行进。

e.en: The bartender added a splash of {grenadine} to the cocktail.
e.zh: 调酒师在鸡尾酒里加了一点石榴糖浆。

e.en: Kids love drinks made with {grenadine} and lemonade.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢用石榴糖浆和柠檬水调的饮料。

grenfell.t: n. 格伦费尔（姓氏/地名）

e.en: The {Grenfell} Tower fire shocked the entire nation.
e.zh: 格伦菲尔大楼火灾震惊了整个国家。

e.en: Survivors of {Grenfell} are still seeking justice today.
e.zh: 格伦菲尔事件的幸存者至今仍在寻求正义。

grenoble.t: n. 格勒诺布尔（法国城市）

e.en: {Grenoble} sits at the foot of the French Alps.
e.zh: 格勒诺布尔坐落在法国阿尔卑斯山脚下。

e.en: She studies engineering at a university in {Grenoble}.
e.zh: 她在格勒诺布尔的一所大学学习工程学。

e.en: {Gresham}'s law states that bad money drives out good.
e.zh: 格雷欣法则指出,劣币驱逐良币。

e.en: The lecture was held at {Gresham} College in London.
e.zh: 讲座在伦敦的格雷欣学院举行。

grew.t: v. grow 的过去式；生长、成长

e.en: The startup {grew} rapidly during the pandemic years.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在疫情期间迅速发展。

e.en: He {grew} tomatoes on his small balcony last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天他在小阳台上种了番茄。

grey.t:
adj. 灰色的
n. 灰色

e.en: The sky turned a heavy {grey} before the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨来临前,天空变得阴沉沉的。

e.en: He noticed his first {grey} hair this morning.
e.zh: 他今早发现了自己的第一根白头发。

greyhound.t: n. 灵缇犬；灰狗（美国灰狗巴士）

e.en: A {greyhound} can sprint at incredible speeds.
e.zh: 灵缇犬能以惊人的速度奔跑。

e.en: We adopted a retired racing {greyhound} last month.
e.zh: 我们上个月领养了一只退役的赛跑灵缇犬。

e.en: His once-dark beard was now {greying} at the edges.
e.zh: 他曾经乌黑的胡须如今边缘已经花白。

e.en: Japan faces challenges from its rapidly {greying} population.
e.zh: 日本正面临人口快速老龄化带来的挑战。

e.en: The cat had soft {greyish} fur and green eyes.
e.zh: 那只猫有着柔软的灰色皮毛和绿色眼睛。

e.en: Clouds turned a {greyish} pink at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时云朵变成了带灰的粉色。

e.en: The endless {greyness} of winter made her feel sad.
e.zh: 冬日无尽的灰暗让她感到忧伤。

e.en: A {greyness} settled over the city after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后,一片灰蒙蒙笼罩了整座城市。

e.en: The painter mixed several {greys} for the stormy sky.
e.zh: 画家调出多种灰色来表现风暴中的天空。

e.en: His hair {greys} a little more each year.
e.zh: 他的头发每年都白一点。

e.en: They bought a beautiful {greystone} townhouse in Chicago.
e.zh: 他们在芝加哥买了一栋漂亮的灰石联排别墅。

e.en: The old church was built from local {greystone}.
e.zh: 这座古老的教堂是用当地灰石建造的。

e.en: The whole {grid} went down during the heatwave.
e.zh: 热浪期间整个电网都瘫痪了。

e.en: Designers arrange elements neatly on a {grid}.
e.zh: 设计师们将元素整齐地排布在网格上。

gridded.t: adj. 带网格的；网格化的

e.en: The map was {gridded} into small numbered squares.
e.zh: 地图被划分成带编号的小方格。

e.en: Engineers use {gridded} paper for precise sketches.
e.zh: 工程师使用方格纸进行精确的草图绘制。

e.en: Pancakes cook best on a hot cast-iron {griddle}.
e.zh: 薄饼在烧热的铸铁煎盘上煎得最好。

e.en: He flipped the bacon on the sizzling {griddle}.
e.zh: 他在嗞嗞作响的煎盘上翻动培根。

gridiron.t: n. 烤架；美式橄榄球场

e.en: The team practiced hard on the {gridiron} every afternoon.
e.zh: 球队每天下午都在橄榄球场上刻苦训练。

e.en: Friday night lights shone over the local {gridiron}.
e.zh: 周五夜晚的灯光照亮了当地的橄榄球场。

e.en: Rush hour {gridlock} made the commute unbearable today.
e.zh: 高峰时段的交通堵塞让今天的通勤难以忍受。

e.en: Political {gridlock} has stalled the new budget bill.
e.zh: 政治僵局已使新预算法案陷入停滞。

gridlocked.t: adj. 严重堵塞的；陷入僵局的

e.en: The highway was completely {gridlocked} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故发生后,高速公路彻底瘫痪堵塞。

e.en: Congress remains {gridlocked} over immigration reform.
e.zh: 国会在移民改革问题上仍陷入僵局。

e.en: Power {grids} across the region need urgent upgrades.
e.zh: 该地区的电网亟需升级。

e.en: The app overlays {grids} on photos for composition.
e.zh: 该应用在照片上叠加网格以辅助构图。

e.en: She struggled with deep {grief} after losing her mother.
e.zh: 母亲去世后,她一直在深深的悲痛中挣扎。

e.en: Time slowly eases the sharpest edges of {grief}.
e.zh: 时间会慢慢抚平最尖锐的悲伤。

e.en: Workers filed a formal {grievance} against their manager.
e.zh: 工人们对经理提出了正式的申诉。

e.en: His main {grievance} was the lack of overtime pay.
e.zh: 他主要的不满是没有加班费。

e.en: Employees aired their {grievances} at the town hall meeting.
e.zh: 员工们在市政厅会议上表达了他们的不满。

e.en: The committee listened carefully to community {grievances}.
e.zh: 委员会认真倾听了社区的各种诉求。

e.en: It takes time to truly {grieve} a loved one.
e.zh: 真正哀悼一位至亲需要时间。

e.en: Don't {grieve} alone—reach out to friends for support.
e.zh: 不要独自悲伤——向朋友寻求支持吧。

grieved.t:
adj. 悲痛的
v. grieve 的过去式

e.en: The whole village {grieved} when their teacher passed away.
e.zh: 老师去世时,整个村庄都陷入悲痛。

e.en: She {grieved} quietly for months after the breakup.
e.zh: 分手后,她默默悲伤了好几个月。

grieves.t: v. grieve 的三单；感到悲痛

e.en: It {grieves} me to see so many homeless families.
e.zh: 看到这么多无家可归的家庭让我心痛。

e.en: He still {grieves} for the dog he lost.
e.zh: 他仍在为失去的那只狗悲伤。

grieving.t:
v. 正在悲痛
adj. 哀伤的

e.en: The {grieving} family asked for privacy during this time.
e.zh: 悲痛中的家属希望此时能有私人空间。

e.en: She is still {grieving} the loss of her father.
e.zh: 她仍在为父亲的离世而悲伤。

grievous.t: adj. 严重的；令人痛苦的

e.en: The accident left him with {grievous} injuries.
e.zh: 那场事故让他身受重伤。

e.en: Ignoring the warning was a {grievous} mistake.
e.zh: 无视那个警告是一个严重的错误。

grievously.t: adv. 严重地；令人痛心地

e.en: Several soldiers were {grievously} wounded in the battle.
e.zh: 几名士兵在战斗中身受重伤。

e.en: The company {grievously} underestimated the new competitor.
e.zh: 公司严重低估了这位新对手。

e.en: He gave me the {griff} on the new boss.
e.zh: 他给我透露了关于新老板的内幕消息。

e.en: Get the {griff} from someone who's worked there.
e.zh: 从在那儿工作过的人那里打听点内情。

griffin.t: n. 狮鹫（神话生物）；格里芬（姓氏）

e.en: A golden {griffin} was carved above the castle gate.
e.zh: 城堡大门上方雕刻着一只金色的狮鹫。

e.en: The fantasy novel features a heroic talking {griffin}.
e.zh: 这部奇幻小说有一只英勇的会说话的狮鹫。

griffon.t:
n. 狮鹫（神话生物）
n. 格里芬犬

e.en: A {griffon} guards the temple gates in the old legend.
e.zh: 古老传说中，一只狮鹫守护着神庙大门。

e.en: She adopted a {griffon} puppy from the local shelter.
e.zh: 她从当地收容所领养了一只布鲁塞尔格里芬幼犬。

e.en: The {grifter} sold fake watches to tourists downtown.
e.zh: 那个骗子在市中心向游客兜售假手表。

e.en: Police arrested a {grifter} running a phony charity scam.
e.zh: 警方逮捕了一名经营假慈善骗局的诈骗犯。

grill.t:
n. 烤架；烧烤店
v. 烧烤；盘问

e.en: We {grill} burgers on the patio every Sunday afternoon.
e.zh: 我们每个周日下午都在院子里烤汉堡。

e.en: Reporters tried to {grill} the senator about the leaked emails.
e.zh: 记者们试图就泄露的邮件盘问那位参议员。

grille.t: n. 格栅（汽车前脸、窗户等）

e.en: The car's chrome {grille} sparkled under the showroom lights.
e.zh: 那辆车的镀铬进气格栅在展厅灯光下闪闪发亮。

e.en: An iron {grille} covered the basement window for security.
e.zh: 地下室窗户上装着铁栅栏以保安全。

grilled.t:
adj. 烤制的
v. 被盘问

e.en: She ordered a {grilled} cheese sandwich with tomato soup.
e.zh: 她点了一份烤奶酪三明治配番茄汤。

e.en: The lawyer {grilled} the witness for nearly three hours.
e.zh: 律师对证人盘问了将近三个小时。

grilling.t:
n. 盘问；炙烤
v. 烧烤；追问

e.en: He's {grilling} salmon for dinner on the back deck.
e.zh: 他正在后院平台上烤三文鱼当晚餐。

e.en: The candidate faced a tough {grilling} from the press.
e.zh: 那位候选人遭到了媒体的严厉盘问。

grills.t:
n. 烤架（复数）
v. 烧烤；盘问

e.en: The restaurant {grills} its steaks over real charcoal.
e.zh: 这家餐厅用真正的木炭烤牛排。

e.en: Modern gas {grills} heat up in just a few minutes.
e.zh: 现代燃气烤架只需几分钟就能加热好。

grillwork.t: n. 格栅装饰；铁艺花格

e.en: Ornate iron {grillwork} decorates the balcony of the old mansion.
e.zh: 华丽的铁艺格栅装点着老宅的阳台。

e.en: The vintage radio's brass {grillwork} had tarnished over decades.
e.zh: 那台老式收音机的黄铜花格已经氧化了几十年。

grim.t: adj. 严峻的；冷酷的；阴森的

e.en: The doctor's expression was {grim} as he entered the room.
e.zh: 医生走进房间时表情十分凝重。

e.en: Sales figures painted a {grim} picture of the company's future.
e.zh: 销售数据为公司前景描绘了一幅严峻的图景。

grimace.t:
n. 鬼脸；扭曲的表情
v. 做鬼脸

e.en: She gave a small {grimace} when she tasted the bitter coffee.
e.zh: 她尝到苦咖啡时微微皱了一下脸。

e.en: He couldn't hide the {grimace} of pain from his sprained ankle.
e.zh: 他无法掩饰扭伤脚踝时痛苦的表情。

e.en: The runner crossed the finish line {grimacing} in agony.
e.zh: 那位跑者痛苦地皱着脸冲过了终点线。

e.en: She was {grimacing} at the awful smell from the fridge.
e.zh: 她对着冰箱里难闻的味道皱起了脸。

grime.t:
n. 污垢
n. 英国 Grime 音乐流派

e.en: Years of {grime} had darkened the kitchen ceiling.
e.zh: 多年的污垢已经让厨房天花板变暗了。

e.en: He scrubbed the {grime} off his hands after fixing the bike.
e.zh: 修完自行车后他把手上的油污搓洗干净。

e.en: She {grimly} accepted the news of the layoffs.
e.zh: 她神色凝重地接受了裁员的消息。

e.en: The team {grimly} prepared for another long night of debugging.
e.zh: 团队沉着脸准备又一个漫长的调试之夜。

grimm.t: n. 格林（姓氏，如格林兄弟）

e.en: The Brothers {Grimm} collected fairy tales across nineteenth-century Germany.
e.zh: 格林兄弟收集了十九世纪德国各地的童话故事。

e.en: Many Disney films draw on {Grimm} stories like Cinderella.
e.zh: 许多迪士尼电影取材自格林童话，比如《灰姑娘》。

e.en: The {grimness} of the photos shocked the entire newsroom.
e.zh: 那些照片的残酷震惊了整个新闻编辑室。

e.en: There was a quiet {grimness} in his voice on the phone.
e.zh: 电话里他的声音中透着一种压抑的沉重。

grimsby.t: n. 格里姆斯比（英国港口城市）

e.en: {Grimsby} was once England's busiest fishing port.
e.zh: 格里姆斯比曾经是英国最繁忙的渔港。

e.en: The train from London to {Grimsby} takes about four hours.
e.zh: 从伦敦到格里姆斯比的火车大约要四小时。

grimy.t: adj. 满是污垢的；脏兮兮的

e.en: His {grimy} hands left smudges on the white doorframe.
e.zh: 他脏兮兮的手在白色门框上留下了污渍。

e.en: They walked through a {grimy} alley behind the warehouse.
e.zh: 他们穿过仓库后面那条肮脏的小巷。

grin.t:
v. 咧嘴笑
n. 露齿一笑

e.en: She flashed a wide {grin} when she saw the surprise cake.
e.zh: 看到惊喜蛋糕时她咧嘴笑了起来。

e.en: He couldn't help but {grin} at his daughter's joke.
e.zh: 他忍不住对女儿的笑话咧嘴一笑。

grinch.t: n. 扫兴的人；圣诞坏蛋

e.en: Don't be such a {grinch} about the office holiday party.
e.zh: 别这么扫兴，公司圣诞派对没那么糟。

e.en: The {Grinch} famously tried to steal Christmas from Whoville.
e.zh: 格林奇曾试图从呼呼镇偷走圣诞节，这故事很出名。

grind.t:
v. 研磨；碾碎
n. 苦差事；刷经验

e.en: I {grind} fresh coffee beans every morning before work.
e.zh: 我每天上班前都磨新鲜咖啡豆。

e.en: The daily {grind} of commuting was wearing him down.
e.zh: 日复一日的通勤让他疲惫不堪。

e.en: My new burr {grinder} produces much more consistent coffee grounds.
e.zh: 我的新锥刀磨豆机磨出的咖啡粉均匀多了。

e.en: He used an angle {grinder} to cut through the rusty bolt.
e.zh: 他用角磨机切断了那颗生锈的螺栓。

grinding.t:
v. 研磨
adj. 折磨人的；刷经验

e.en: The {grinding} noise from the engine worried the mechanic.
e.zh: 发动机发出的刮擦声让技师感到担心。

e.en: Many families live in {grinding} poverty in that region.
e.zh: 那个地区许多家庭生活在赤贫之中。

grinds.t: v. 研磨（第三人称单数）

e.en: Used coffee {grinds} make excellent fertilizer for your garden.
e.zh: 用过的咖啡渣是花园里很棒的肥料。

e.en: He {grinds} away at his thesis late into the night.
e.zh: 他熬夜苦干自己的毕业论文。

e.en: It's time to put your nose to the {grindstone} before finals.
e.zh: 期末考试前是时候埋头苦干了。

e.en: The blacksmith sharpened the blade on a spinning {grindstone}.
e.zh: 铁匠在转动的磨刀石上磨利刀刃。

gringa.t: n. （西语区俚语）外国女子，多指白人女性

e.en: The vendor smiled and called her {gringa} as she bargained.
e.zh: 摊主笑着叫她外国妹子，她则在讨价还价。

e.en: As a {gringa} in Mexico City, she stood out in the market.
e.zh: 作为墨西哥城里的外国女子，她在市场里十分显眼。

gringo.t: n. （西语区俚语）外国人，多指美国白人男性

e.en: The bartender chuckled and poured the {gringo} another margarita.
e.zh: 酒保笑着又给那个老外倒了一杯玛格丽特。

e.en: He learned Spanish quickly to shed his {gringo} accent.
e.zh: 他迅速学会了西班牙语，以摆脱外国佬的口音。

e.en: She {grinned} broadly when her name was called for the prize.
e.zh: 听到自己名字获奖时，她咧嘴笑得很开心。

e.en: He {grinned} at the camera and gave a thumbs up.
e.zh: 他对着镜头咧嘴一笑，竖起了大拇指。

e.en: The kids came home {grinning} from ear to ear after the trip.
e.zh: 孩子们旅行回来时一个个笑得合不拢嘴。

e.en: Stop {grinning} and tell me what you're up to.
e.zh: 别笑了，快告诉我你在搞什么名堂。

grins.t:
v. 咧嘴笑（第三人称单数）
n. 笑容（复数）

e.en: He {grins} every time someone mentions his new puppy.
e.zh: 每当有人提起他的新小狗，他都会咧嘴笑。

e.en: Their faces broke into wide {grins} at the announcement.
e.zh: 听到通知时，他们的脸上绽放出大大的笑容。

griot.t: n. 西非游吟诗人；口述史者

e.en: The village {griot} sang the history of their ancestors.
e.zh: 村里的格里奥说唱艺人吟唱着他们祖先的历史。

e.en: A {griot} preserves oral traditions across many West African cultures.
e.zh: 格里奥艺人在许多西非文化中传承口述传统。

grip.t:
v. 紧握；抓牢
n. 握力；掌控

e.en: Make sure you have a firm {grip} on the railing.
e.zh: 一定要紧紧抓住栏杆。

e.en: The novel really takes {grip} of you from page one.
e.zh: 这本小说从第一页起就紧紧抓住了你。

gripe.t:
v. 发牢骚
n. 怨言

e.en: My main {gripe} with the app is its slow startup time.
e.zh: 我对这个应用最大的不满是启动太慢。

e.en: Customers continue to {gripe} about the new checkout process.
e.zh: 顾客们一直在抱怨新的结账流程。

e.en: Stop {griping} about the weather and grab an umbrella.
e.zh: 别再抱怨天气了，拿把伞就是了。

e.en: His constant {griping} during meetings annoyed everyone on the team.
e.zh: 他在会上不停抱怨，惹恼了团队里的每个人。

gripped.t: v. 紧握；吸引住（过去式）

e.en: She {gripped} the steering wheel tightly during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中她紧紧握着方向盘。

e.en: The whole nation was {gripped} by the championship final.
e.zh: 整个国家都被这场冠军决赛深深吸引。

gripper.t: n. 夹爪；机械手抓取器

e.en: The robot's {gripper} carefully picked up the fragile glass.
e.zh: 机器人的夹具小心翼翼地夹起了易碎的玻璃。

e.en: This rubber {gripper} helps me open stubborn jar lids.
e.zh: 这个橡胶开瓶器帮我打开顽固的罐盖。

gripping.t:
adj. 扣人心弦的
v. 紧握

e.en: That documentary about the Everest climb was absolutely {gripping}.
e.zh: 那部关于攀登珠峰的纪录片真是扣人心弦。

e.en: She was {gripping} her phone tightly as the verdict came in.
e.zh: 判决宣布时，她紧紧攥着手机。

grippy.t: adj. 抓地力强的；防滑的

e.en: These trail shoes are super {grippy} on wet rocks.
e.zh: 这双越野鞋在湿滑岩石上抓地力非常强。

e.en: The phone case has a {grippy} texture that prevents drops.
e.zh: 这款手机壳表面防滑，不容易掉落。

grips.t:
n. 握把（复数）
v. 紧握

e.en: He finally {grips} the concept after watching three tutorials.
e.zh: 看了三个教程后他终于掌握了这个概念。

e.en: Replace the worn {grips} on your bike handlebars for safety.
e.zh: 为了安全，请更换自行车把手上磨损的握把。

gris.t:
n. 灰色（西/法语借词）
n. 格里斯（姓氏）

e.en: Juan {Gris} was a key figure in the Cubist movement.
e.zh: 胡安·格里斯是立体主义运动的重要人物。

e.en: The painter mixed a soft {gris} tone for the background.
e.zh: 画家调出柔和的灰色调用作背景。

e.en: The artist painted the panel entirely in {grisaille} for dramatic effect.
e.zh: 艺术家用灰色单色画法绘制整幅画板，以营造戏剧效果。

e.en: Medieval cathedrals often featured {grisaille} stained glass windows.
e.zh: 中世纪大教堂常装有灰色单色彩绘玻璃窗。

e.en: Investigators discovered the {grisly} crime scene early Sunday morning.
e.zh: 调查人员在周日清晨发现了那处恐怖的犯罪现场。

e.en: She spared us the {grisly} details of the surgery.
e.zh: 她省去了手术中那些令人毛骨悚然的细节。

grist.t: n. 待磨的谷物；可利用的素材

e.en: The political scandal was perfect {grist} for the late-night comedians.
e.zh: 这桩政治丑闻成了深夜脱口秀的绝佳素材。

e.en: Farmers brought their {grist} to the local mill for processing.
e.zh: 农民们把要磨的谷物送到当地磨坊加工。

e.en: He pushed a piece of {gristle} to the side of his plate.
e.zh: 他把一块软骨拨到了盘子边上。

e.en: Cheap cuts of meat tend to contain more {gristle}.
e.zh: 便宜的肉块往往含有更多软骨。

e.en: The old {gristmill} by the river still grinds flour for tourists.
e.zh: 河边那座老磨坊至今仍为游客磨制面粉。

e.en: A working {gristmill} stood at the heart of every colonial village.
e.zh: 每个殖民地村庄的中心都有一座运转的磨坊。

grit.t:
n. 砂砾；毅力
v. 咬紧（牙关）

e.en: Success in startups requires real {grit} and persistence.
e.zh: 创业成功需要真正的毅力和坚持。

e.en: She got a piece of {grit} stuck in her eye.
e.zh: 她眼睛里进了一粒沙子。

e.en: Climbers love the rough texture of Peak District {gritstone}.
e.zh: 攀岩者喜爱峰区粗砂岩的粗糙质感。

e.en: The cottage was built from local {gritstone} blocks.
e.zh: 这座小屋是用当地的粗砂岩石块砌成的。

gritted.t: v. 咬紧（牙关）（grit 过去式）

e.en: She {gritted} her teeth and pushed through the final mile.
e.zh: 她咬紧牙关坚持跑完了最后一英里。

e.en: Workers {gritted} the icy roads before morning rush hour.
e.zh: 工人们在早高峰之前给结冰的道路撒上了砂粒。

e.en: The film's {grittiness} reminded me of seventies New York cinema.
e.zh: 这部电影的粗粝质感让我想起七十年代的纽约电影。

e.en: There's a slight {grittiness} in this sauce that needs straining.
e.zh: 这酱汁里有点沙感，需要过滤一下。

gritty.t:
adj. 含砂的；粗糙的
adj. 坚毅的

e.en: The new detective series has a refreshingly {gritty} tone.
e.zh: 这部新侦探剧的粗砺写实风格令人耳目一新。

e.en: My shoes were full of {gritty} sand after the beach walk.
e.zh: 在海滩散步后，我的鞋里满是粗糙的沙子。

grizzle.t:
v. 抱怨；啜泣
n. 灰色

e.en: The puppies started to {grizzle} when their mother left the room.
e.zh: 妈妈一离开房间，小狗们就开始呜咽起来。

e.en: Don't {grizzle} about the rain — just put on a jacket.
e.zh: 别再为下雨发牢骚了，穿上外套就行。

e.en: A {grizzled} veteran sat at the bar telling stories.
e.zh: 一位头发花白的老兵坐在吧台讲故事。

e.en: The {grizzled} dog still wagged his tail at every visitor.
e.zh: 那只毛色斑白的狗见到来客还是会摇尾巴。

grizzly.t:
n. 灰熊
adj. 灰色的

e.en: A {grizzly} bear was spotted near the campsite this morning.
e.zh: 今早在营地附近发现了一只灰熊。

e.en: Tourists are warned not to approach any {grizzly} in the park.
e.zh: 游客被警告不要靠近公园里的任何灰熊。

e.en: The label simply read "{gro}" as an abbreviation for gross.
e.zh: 标签上简写为"gro"，意思是"罗"（一罗等于十二打）。

e.en: Old shipping forms still use {gro} when listing bulk quantities.
e.zh: 旧的运货单上列大宗数量时仍然使用 gro 这个缩写。

groan.t:
v. 呻吟；抱怨
n. 呻吟声

e.en: He let out a loud {groan} when he saw the bill.
e.zh: 他看到账单时发出一声响亮的呻吟。

e.en: The students {groan} every time homework is announced.
e.zh: 每次宣布作业时学生们都会哀叫连连。

groaning.t:
n. 呻吟声
adj. 呻吟的

e.en: The old wooden floor was {groaning} under their footsteps.
e.zh: 旧木地板在他们脚下吱呀作响。

e.en: She was {groaning} about the traffic the whole drive home.
e.zh: 回家路上她一直在抱怨堵车。

groat.t: n. 格罗特（旧英国银币）

e.en: The shopkeeper accepted a single {groat} for the bread.
e.zh: 店主收下一枚四便士银币就把面包卖给他了。

e.en: He didn't have a {groat} left in his pocket.
e.zh: 他口袋里连一个小钱都没剩下。

groats.t: n. 去壳的谷粒；粗麦粉

e.en: Breakfast was a warm bowl of buckwheat {groats} with honey.
e.zh: 早餐是一碗加了蜂蜜的温热荞麦米。

e.en: Oat {groats} take longer to cook than rolled oats.
e.zh: 燕麦粒比燕麦片需要更长时间煮熟。

grocer.t: n. 杂货商；食品店老板

e.en: The local {grocer} knows every customer by name.
e.zh: 当地的杂货店老板认识每位顾客的名字。

e.en: My {grocer} always saves the freshest tomatoes for me.
e.zh: 我常去的杂货商总是给我留最新鲜的西红柿。

e.en: I'll pick up the {groceries} on my way home.
e.zh: 我回家的路上去买点日用百货。

e.en: The app delivers your {groceries} within an hour.
e.zh: 这款应用一小时内就能把你的日用品送到家。

e.en: There's a small {grocery} store on the corner.
e.zh: 街角有一家小杂货店。

e.en: Online {grocery} shopping has become really popular.
e.zh: 网上买菜已经变得非常流行。

grog.t: n. 格罗格酒（掺水烈酒）

e.en: The sailors were given a ration of {grog} each evening.
e.zh: 水手们每晚都会分到一份兑水朗姆酒。

e.en: He poured himself another mug of warm {grog}.
e.zh: 他又给自己倒了一杯热朗姆酒。

e.en: She reached {groggily} for her phone to silence the alarm.
e.zh: 她迷迷糊糊地伸手摸手机关掉闹钟。

e.en: He stumbled {groggily} into the kitchen for coffee.
e.zh: 他昏昏沉沉地踱进厨房去倒咖啡。

e.en: The medication causes some {grogginess} the next morning.
e.zh: 这种药会让人第二天早上有些昏沉。

e.en: A cup of strong tea cleared her {grogginess}.
e.zh: 一杯浓茶让她的昏昏欲睡一扫而空。

groggy.t: adj. 昏昏沉沉的；脚步不稳的

e.en: I felt {groggy} after only four hours of sleep.
e.zh: 只睡了四个小时，我感觉头昏脑胀。

e.en: The patient was still {groggy} from the anesthesia.
e.zh: 病人仍因麻醉而神志不清。

e.en: The athlete pulled a muscle in his {groin} during practice.
e.zh: 那名运动员在训练时拉伤了腹股沟肌肉。

e.en: He felt a sharp pain in his {groin} after the fall.
e.zh: 摔倒后他感到腹股沟一阵剧痛。

e.en: Thread the cable through the rubber {grommet} in the desk.
e.zh: 把线缆从桌子上的橡胶护线圈里穿过去。

e.en: Each curtain has a metal {grommet} for the rod.
e.zh: 每幅窗帘都有一个金属圆环用来穿杆。

groningen.t: n. 格罗宁根（荷兰城市）

e.en: She's studying biology at a university in {Groningen}.
e.zh: 她在格罗宁根的一所大学学习生物学。

e.en: {Groningen} is known for its lively student population.
e.zh: 格罗宁根以其活跃的学生群体而闻名。

groom.t:
n. 新郎；马夫
v. 梳理；培养

e.en: The {groom} smiled nervously as the bride walked in.
e.zh: 新娘走进来时新郎紧张地笑了。

e.en: She likes to {groom} her cat every weekend.
e.zh: 她喜欢每个周末给她的猫梳毛。

groomed.t:
adj. 打理整洁的
v. 梳理（过去式）

e.en: He was always immaculately {groomed} for client meetings.
e.zh: 他每次见客户都打扮得一丝不苟。

e.en: The young manager was {groomed} for the CEO role.
e.zh: 那位年轻经理被培养成接任 CEO 的人选。

e.en: I take my poodle to the {groomer} once a month.
e.zh: 我每个月带我的贵宾犬去宠物美容师那里一次。

e.en: The dog {groomer} trimmed his fur perfectly.
e.zh: 宠物美容师把他的毛修剪得非常完美。

grooming.t:
n. 梳理；仪容打理
n. 诱骗（未成年人）

e.en: Cats spend hours {grooming} themselves each day.
e.zh: 猫每天会花好几个小时梳理自己的毛。

e.en: Personal {grooming} is important for job interviews.
e.zh: 面试时个人仪容是很重要的。

grooms.t:
n. 新郎（复数）
v. 梳理（第三人称单数）

e.en: The stable {grooms} care for the horses every morning.
e.zh: 马厩管理员每天早上都会照料这些马。

e.en: Many {grooms} were nervous before walking down the aisle.
e.zh: 许多新郎在走上婚礼红毯前都很紧张。

e.en: My brother asked me to be his {groomsman}.
e.zh: 我哥哥邀请我做他的伴郎。

e.en: Each {groomsman} wore a matching navy suit.
e.zh: 每位伴郎都穿着同款的海军蓝西装。

groove.t:
n. 凹槽；沟
v. 开槽

e.en: The needle slipped into the {groove} of the vinyl record.
e.zh: 唱针滑进了黑胶唱片的纹槽里。

e.en: After a week off, I'm finally back in my {groove}.
e.zh: 休息了一周，我终于又找回了状态。

e.en: The road has {grooved} surfaces to improve drainage.
e.zh: 路面有凹槽以便更好地排水。

e.en: He ran his finger along the {grooved} edge of the coin.
e.zh: 他用手指顺着硬币带槽的边缘划过。

e.en: That's a really {groovy} jacket you're wearing.
e.zh: 你穿的这件夹克真酷。

e.en: The band played a {groovy} bassline all night.
e.zh: 乐队整晚都在弹奏一段很带感的贝斯旋律。

e.en: I had to {grope} for the light switch in the dark.
e.zh: 我只能在黑暗中摸索着找电灯开关。

e.en: Politicians {grope} for answers when caught off guard.
e.zh: 政客被问到措手不及时只能勉强搜寻答案。

groping.t:
n. 摸索
v. 摸索（现在分词）

e.en: She was {groping} around in her bag for her keys.
e.zh: 她在包里摸索着找钥匙。

e.en: He was {groping} for the right words to apologize.
e.zh: 他在努力寻找合适的话来道歉。

e.en: The fabric label said "{gros} de Londres" in elegant script.
e.zh: 面料标签上用优雅的字体写着"伦敦罗缎"。

e.en: She chose a heavy {gros} silk for the curtains.
e.zh: 她为窗帘选了一种厚重的罗缎丝绸。

e.en: A bright red {grosbeak} landed on the bird feeder.
e.zh: 一只鲜红色的腊嘴雀落在了喂鸟器上。

e.en: The {grosbeak} cracked the sunflower seed easily.
e.zh: 那只腊嘴雀轻松地咬开了葵花籽。

e.en: She tied the gift with a black {grosgrain} ribbon.
e.zh: 她用黑色罗纹缎带把礼物系起来。

e.en: The hat had a wide {grosgrain} band around it.
e.zh: 那顶帽子上缠着一圈宽宽的罗纹丝带。

gross.t:
adj. 总的；恶心的
n. 总额

e.en: The company's {gross} revenue doubled last year.
e.zh: 公司的总收入去年翻了一番。

e.en: That moldy bread looks absolutely {gross}.
e.zh: 那块发霉的面包看起来真恶心。

e.en: The project was {grossly} underfunded from the start.
e.zh: 这个项目从一开始资金就严重不足。

e.en: His abilities have been {grossly} exaggerated by the press.
e.zh: 他的能力被媒体严重夸大了。

e.en: The kids laughed at the sheer {grossness} of the prank.
e.zh: 孩子们对这个恶作剧的恶心程度笑得不行。

e.en: She couldn't get past the {grossness} of the smell.
e.zh: 她无法忍受那股令人作呕的气味。

grosvenor.t: n. 格罗夫纳（人名/地名）

e.en: They booked a suite at the {Grosvenor} hotel in London.
e.zh: 他们在伦敦格罗夫纳酒店订了一间套房。

e.en: {Grosvenor} Square has long been associated with diplomats.
e.zh: 格罗夫纳广场长期以来都与外交人士联系紧密。

e.en: A loaf of bread cost just a few {grosz} back then.
e.zh: 那时候一个面包只要几个格罗希。

e.en: He dropped a single {grosz} into the busker's hat.
e.zh: 他把一枚格罗希丢进街头艺人的帽子里。

grotesque.t: adj. 怪诞的；奇形怪状的

e.en: The mask had a {grotesque} grin that scared the children.
e.zh: 那张面具有着怪诞的笑容，把孩子们吓到了。

e.en: The level of waste was simply {grotesque}.
e.zh: 浪费的程度简直离谱得可怕。

e.en: The tree had grown {grotesquely} twisted by the wind.
e.zh: 那棵树被风吹得扭曲得奇形怪状。

e.en: Executive bonuses were {grotesquely} out of proportion.
e.zh: 高管奖金的数额离谱得不成比例。

e.en: The film was praised for its dark humor and {grotesquerie}.
e.zh: 这部电影因其黑色幽默和怪诞风格而受到好评。

e.en: Gothic novels often dwell on {grotesquerie} and decay.
e.zh: 哥特小说常常着墨于怪诞与腐朽。

e.en: They swam into a hidden {grotto} along the coastline.
e.zh: 他们游进了海岸边一处隐蔽的岩洞。

e.en: The garden featured a small stone {grotto} with a fountain.
e.zh: 花园里有一个带喷泉的小石洞。

e.en: The hostel was cheap but a bit {grotty}.
e.zh: 那家青旅虽然便宜，但有点脏乱差。

e.en: I felt {grotty} after the long overnight flight.
e.zh: 坐了一夜的长途飞机后我感觉浑身难受。

grouch.t:
n. 爱抱怨的人
v. 抱怨

e.en: Don't be such a {grouch} at the birthday party.
e.zh: 在生日派对上别那么爱发牢骚嘛。

e.en: My uncle is a lovable {grouch} who complains about everything.
e.zh: 我叔叔是个什么都要抱怨但人很可爱的怪老头。

grouchy.t: adj. 脾气坏的；爱发牢骚的

e.en: He gets {grouchy} when he hasn't had his morning coffee.
e.zh: 他没喝早晨那杯咖啡就会变得脾气暴躁。

e.en: The kids were {grouchy} after a long car ride.
e.zh: 孩子们坐了很久的车后变得烦躁不安。

ground.t:
n. 地面；土地
v. 使搁浅；禁足

e.en: The plane finally touched the {ground} after a bumpy flight.
e.zh: 经历了一段颠簸的飞行后，飞机终于着陆了。

e.en: There are good {grounds} to question his decision.
e.zh: 有充分的理由质疑他的决定。

groundbreaking.t: adj. 开创性的；突破性的

e.en: The team published a {groundbreaking} paper on quantum computing.
e.zh: 该团队发表了一篇关于量子计算的开创性论文。

e.en: Her novel was {groundbreaking} in how it portrayed grief.
e.zh: 她的小说在描绘悲伤方面具有开创性意义。

grounded.t: adj. 脚踏实地的；被禁足的

e.en: All flights were {grounded} due to the snowstorm.
e.zh: 由于暴风雪，所有航班都被停飞了。

e.en: She's a smart and emotionally {grounded} person.
e.zh: 她是个聪明且情绪稳定的人。

e.en: The shortstop fielded the {grounder} cleanly.
e.zh: 游击手干净利落地接住了那个滚地球。

e.en: He hit a slow {grounder} to first base.
e.zh: 他把一个慢速滚地球打向了一垒。

e.en: Cod and haddock are common {groundfish} in the Atlantic.
e.zh: 鳕鱼和黑线鳕是大西洋常见的底栖鱼类。

e.en: Quotas were set to protect declining {groundfish} populations.
e.zh: 为保护数量下降的底栖鱼种群设立了配额。

e.en: A {groundhog} popped out of its burrow near the fence.
e.zh: 一只土拨鼠从围栏旁的洞里钻了出来。

e.en: The {groundhog} saw its shadow on February second.
e.zh: 那只土拨鼠在二月二日看到了自己的影子。

e.en: The course gives students a solid {grounding} in statistics.
e.zh: 这门课程让学生在统计学方面打下扎实的基础。

e.en: Meditation helps with emotional {grounding} during stressful days.
e.zh: 在紧张的日子里冥想有助于稳定情绪。

e.en: Her fears about the new policy turned out to be {groundless}.
e.zh: 她对新政策的担忧最终被证明是毫无根据的。

e.en: The lawyer dismissed the accusation as completely {groundless}.
e.zh: 律师驳斥这项指控完全没有根据。

groundling.t: n. 池座观众；底栖动物

e.en: In Shakespeare's day, a {groundling} stood near the stage to watch plays.
e.zh: 在莎士比亚时代,普通观众站在舞台附近看戏。

e.en: The director refused to pander to the {groundling} crowd.
e.zh: 导演拒绝迎合普通低端观众。

e.en: Farmers in this region grow {groundnut} as their main cash crop.
e.zh: 这个地区的农民以花生作为主要经济作物。

e.en: She spread {groundnut} butter thickly on her toast.
e.zh: 她在吐司上厚厚地涂了一层花生酱。

e.en: The batter ended the inning with a weak {groundout} to shortstop.
e.zh: 打者以一记软弱的滚地球出局结束了这一局。

e.en: He hit a routine {groundout} to second base.
e.zh: 他击出一记普通的滚地球被二垒接杀。

e.en: There are no {grounds} for firing her based on this report.
e.zh: 根据这份报告,没有理由解雇她。

e.en: Visitors can wander freely around the palace {grounds}.
e.zh: 游客可以在宫殿的庭园里自由漫步。

e.en: Spread the {groundsheet} under the tent to keep moisture out.
e.zh: 在帐篷下铺一张防潮垫以隔绝湿气。

e.en: Our old {groundsheet} finally tore on the rocky campsite.
e.zh: 我们那块旧防潮布终于在多石的营地上撕破了。

e.en: The {groundskeeper} mows the baseball field every morning.
e.zh: 场地管理员每天早上修剪棒球场草坪。

e.en: She works as a {groundskeeper} at the local golf club.
e.zh: 她在当地高尔夫俱乐部担任场地管理员。

e.en: The {groundsman} prepared the cricket pitch before the match.
e.zh: 场地管理员在比赛前整理好了板球场地。

e.en: Our school {groundsman} knows every blade of grass on the field.
e.zh: 我们学校的场地管理员熟悉场上每一根草。

e.en: Her powerful {groundstroke} from the baseline won the point.
e.zh: 她从底线打出的强力底线抽球赢得了这一分。

e.en: He has worked hard to improve his backhand {groundstroke}.
e.zh: 他一直在努力改进自己的反手底线击球。

e.en: There is a {groundswell} of support for stricter privacy laws.
e.zh: 民众对更严格的隐私法律产生了强烈的支持浪潮。

e.en: The campaign sparked a {groundswell} of public anger.
e.zh: 这场运动激起了公众愤怒的浪潮。

e.en: Pesticides from farms can contaminate the local {groundwater}.
e.zh: 农场使用的农药可能污染当地的地下水。

e.en: Many villages depend on {groundwater} for drinking and irrigation.
e.zh: 许多村庄依靠地下水来饮用和灌溉。

e.en: This study lays the {groundwork} for future climate research.
e.zh: 这项研究为未来的气候研究奠定了基础。

e.en: They did the {groundwork} months before launching the startup.
e.zh: 他们在创办公司前几个月就做好了前期准备。

group.t:
n. 组；群体
v. 分组

e.en: Our study {group} meets at the library every Wednesday.
e.zh: 我们的学习小组每周三在图书馆碰面。

e.en: Please {group} the survey responses by age range.
e.zh: 请按年龄段对调查结果进行分组。

grouped.t: adj. 已分组的；聚在一起的

e.en: The students {grouped} themselves around the teacher's desk.
e.zh: 学生们围在老师的讲桌旁聚成一团。

e.en: Files are {grouped} by date in the new app.
e.zh: 在新应用中文件是按日期分组的。

e.en: The chef recommended the grilled {grouper} with lemon butter.
e.zh: 主厨推荐了配柠檬黄油的烤石斑鱼。

e.en: Divers spotted a huge {grouper} hiding in the coral reef.
e.zh: 潜水员发现一条巨大的石斑鱼藏在珊瑚礁中。

e.en: As a teenager she was a total {groupie} for that band.
e.zh: 她少女时期完全是那支乐队的狂热粉丝。

e.en: He jokingly called himself a tech-conference {groupie}.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说自己是科技大会的铁杆迷弟。

e.en: This {grouping} of countries shares similar trade policies.
e.zh: 这一国家组合有着相似的贸易政策。

e.en: The teacher changed the seating {grouping} for the new term.
e.zh: 老师为新学期重新调整了座位分组。

e.en: The report breaks the data into three age {groupings}.
e.zh: 报告将数据分成三个年龄组别。

e.en: Various political {groupings} emerged after the election.
e.zh: 选举后涌现出各种政治派别。

e.en: Several {groups} of tourists gathered outside the museum.
e.zh: 几群游客聚集在博物馆外面。

e.en: The app automatically {groups} your photos by location.
e.zh: 这款应用会自动按地点对你的照片进行分组。

groupthink.t: n. 群体盲思；集体思维

e.en: The team's failure was caused by {groupthink} and poor debate.
e.zh: 团队的失败源于群体思维和缺乏争论。

e.en: Good leaders actively guard against {groupthink} in meetings.
e.zh: 优秀的领导者会主动防止会议陷入群体思维。

e.en: Our company adopted new {groupware} to coordinate remote teams.
e.zh: 我们公司采用了新的群组协作软件来协调远程团队。

e.en: This {groupware} integrates calendars, chat, and shared documents.
e.zh: 这款协作软件整合了日历、聊天和共享文档功能。

e.en: She became a total {groupy} after attending the concert tour.
e.zh: 参加完巡回演唱会后她变成了一个十足的追星迷妹。

e.en: Don't dismiss him as just another {groupy} fan.
e.zh: 别把他当成又一个普通的追星粉丝。

grouse.t:
n. 松鸡
v. 抱怨

e.en: Employees often {grouse} about long hours over lunch.
e.zh: 员工们常在午餐时抱怨工时太长。

e.en: Hunters spotted a {grouse} hiding in the heather.
e.zh: 猎人们发现一只松鸡藏在石南丛中。

e.en: Stop {grousing} about the weather and grab an umbrella.
e.zh: 别再抱怨天气了,拿把伞就是了。

e.en: His constant {grousing} annoyed everyone in the office.
e.zh: 他没完没了的牢骚惹恼了办公室里的每个人。

grout.t:
n. 填缝剂
v. 勾缝

e.en: Apply fresh {grout} between the bathroom tiles to seal them.
e.zh: 在浴室瓷砖之间填上新的填缝剂以密封。

e.en: The mouldy {grout} needed scrubbing with a stiff brush.
e.zh: 发霉的瓷砖填缝需要用硬毛刷用力刷洗。

e.en: He spent the weekend {grouting} the new kitchen tiles.
e.zh: 他花了整个周末给新厨房瓷砖填缝。

e.en: The {grouting} between the tiles has cracked over time.
e.zh: 瓷砖之间的填缝剂随着时间已经开裂了。

e.en: They picnicked in a small olive {grove} above the village.
e.zh: 他们在村子上方的一片小橄榄林里野餐。

e.en: A peaceful {grove} of birch trees lined the path.
e.zh: 一片宁静的桦树林沿着小径排列。

e.en: He had to {grovel} to his boss after missing the deadline.
e.zh: 错过截止日期后他不得不向老板低声下气地认错。

e.en: I refuse to {grovel} for an apology I deserve.
e.zh: 我不会为了一个本就该得到的道歉而卑躬屈膝。

e.en: His {grovelling} apology email made the situation worse.
e.zh: 他那封卑躬屈膝的道歉邮件让事情更糟糕了。

e.en: Stop {grovelling} and just admit you made a mistake.
e.zh: 别再点头哈腰了,直接承认你犯了错。

e.en: The valley is famous for its lemon {groves} and sunny weather.
e.zh: 这片山谷以柠檬林和晴朗的天气而闻名。

e.en: Ancient olive {groves} cover the hills of the island.
e.zh: 古老的橄榄林覆盖着这座岛屿的山丘。

e.en: Tomatoes {grow} best in warm, sunny weather.
e.zh: 番茄在温暖、阳光充足的天气里长得最好。

e.en: Startups need to {grow} their user base steadily.
e.zh: 创业公司需要稳步扩大用户基础。

e.en: My grandfather is a passionate rose {grower} in retirement.
e.zh: 我祖父退休后成了一个热衷于种玫瑰的人。

e.en: This region has the largest coffee {grower} in the country.
e.zh: 这个地区有全国最大的咖啡种植户。

growing.t: adj. 不断增长的；生长中的

e.en: There is {growing} concern about online privacy among users.
e.zh: 用户对网络隐私的担忧日益增长。

e.en: My niece is {growing} so fast I barely recognize her.
e.zh: 我侄女长得太快了,我都快认不出她了。

growl.t:
v. 低吼
n. 咆哮声

e.en: The dog began to {growl} when the stranger approached.
e.zh: 陌生人走近时那只狗开始低声咆哮。

e.en: My stomach started to {growl} during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会的时候我的肚子开始咕咕叫。

e.en: The bear stood {growling} at the edge of the forest.
e.zh: 那只熊站在森林边缘咆哮着。

e.en: My stomach was {growling} loudly throughout the lecture.
e.zh: 整堂课我的肚子都在大声咕咕叫。

e.en: My son has {grown} three inches since last summer.
e.zh: 我儿子从去年夏天以来长高了三英寸。

e.en: The startup has {grown} into a major tech company.
e.zh: 那家创业公司已经发展成一家大型科技公司。

grown-up.t:
n. 成年人
adj. 成熟的

e.en: My daughter wants to be a doctor when she's {grown-up}.
e.zh: 我女儿想长大后当一名医生。

e.en: Please ask a {grown-up} to help you cross the street.
e.zh: 请找一位成年人帮你过马路。

e.en: The {grown-ups} chatted in the kitchen while kids played outside.
e.zh: 大人们在厨房聊天,孩子们在外面玩。

e.en: Sometimes {grown-ups} forget what it feels like to be young.
e.zh: 有时候大人们会忘记年轻时的感受。

grownup.t:
n. 成年人
adj. 成熟的

e.en: Acting like a {grownup} means taking responsibility for choices.
e.zh: 像个成年人一样意味着为自己的选择承担责任。

e.en: Every {grownup} at the party gathered around the fireplace.
e.zh: 派对上的每个大人都聚集在壁炉旁。

grows.t: v. 生长；增长（第三人称单数）

e.en: This plant {grows} quickly in tropical climates.
e.zh: 这种植物在热带气候下生长得很快。

e.en: His confidence {grows} with every successful presentation.
e.zh: 每次成功的演讲都让他的自信心增长。

growth.t:
n. 增长；成长
n. (医) 赘生物

e.en: The company reported strong revenue {growth} this quarter.
e.zh: 公司本季度报告了强劲的营收增长。

e.en: Personal {growth} requires stepping outside your comfort zone.
e.zh: 个人成长需要走出舒适区。

growths.t: n. growth 的复数；增长、生长

e.en: The doctor examined two small {growths} on her arm.
e.zh: 医生检查了她手臂上的两个小肿块。

e.en: Strange fungal {growths} appeared on the damp basement walls.
e.zh: 潮湿的地下室墙壁上长出了奇怪的真菌。

e.en: The wooden {groyne} helps prevent the beach from eroding.
e.zh: 这道木制防波堤有助于防止海滩被侵蚀。

e.en: Children climbed onto the old {groyne} to watch the waves.
e.zh: 孩子们爬上旧防波堤观看海浪。

grp.t: n. 玻璃纤维增强塑料（glass-reinforced plastic）

e.en: The chat {grp} for our project has over fifty members.
e.zh: 我们项目的聊天群有五十多个成员。

e.en: Please add me to the WhatsApp {grp} for the event.
e.zh: 请把我加到这次活动的WhatsApp群里。

grub.t:
n. (口语) 食物；蛆
v. 刨挖；翻找

e.en: After the hike, we were ready for some hot {grub}.
e.zh: 徒步之后我们都迫不及待想吃点热乎的饭菜。

e.en: A fat {grub} wriggled out from under the rotting log.
e.zh: 一只肥胖的幼虫从腐烂的木头下蠕动出来。

e.en: The kids came home with {grubby} hands after playing outside.
e.zh: 孩子们在外面玩耍后回家时手都脏兮兮的。

e.en: He wiped his {grubby} fingers on his jeans.
e.zh: 他把脏兮兮的手指在牛仔裤上擦了擦。

grudge.t:
n. 怨恨；积怨
v. 不情愿给予

e.en: She still holds a {grudge} against her former business partner.
e.zh: 她至今仍对前生意伙伴心怀怨恨。

e.en: Don't let a small mistake turn into a lasting {grudge}.
e.zh: 别让一个小错误变成长久的怨恨。

e.en: He gave a {grudging} nod when forced to admit she was right.
e.zh: 被迫承认她是对的时候他勉强地点了点头。

e.en: The critics offered {grudging} praise for the new film.
e.zh: 影评人们对这部新片给予了勉强的赞扬。

e.en: She {grudgingly} agreed to share credit for the project.
e.zh: 她勉强同意分享这个项目的功劳。

e.en: He {grudgingly} admitted that his rival had played better.
e.zh: 他不情愿地承认对手发挥得更好。

gruel.t: n. 稀粥；(燕麦) 薄粥

e.en: The orphans were served thin {gruel} for breakfast every day.
e.zh: 孤儿们每天早餐都喝稀薄的麦片粥。

e.en: In the novel, prisoners survived on watery {gruel} and bread.
e.zh: 小说中囚犯们靠稀粥和面包维生。

grueling.t: adj. 令人精疲力竭的；折磨人的

e.en: The marathon was a {grueling} test of endurance.
e.zh: 那场马拉松是对耐力的严酷考验。

e.en: She survived a {grueling} week of back-to-back interviews.
e.zh: 她熬过了连续一周令人精疲力竭的面试。

gruelling.t: adj. 令人精疲力竭的（grueling 英式拼法）

e.en: The team faced a {gruelling} schedule on tour.
e.zh: 巡演期间球队面临极其辛苦的赛程。

e.en: He completed a {gruelling} twelve-hour shift at the hospital.
e.zh: 他在医院完成了累人的十二小时班次。

gruesome.t: adj. 可怕的；令人毛骨悚然的

e.en: The film contains some genuinely {gruesome} scenes.
e.zh: 这部电影里有一些非常血腥恐怖的镜头。

e.en: Police uncovered {gruesome} details during the investigation.
e.zh: 警方在调查中发现了一些令人毛骨悚然的细节。

e.en: The injury was {gruesomely} displayed on the broadcast.
e.zh: 那处伤势在转播中被血淋淋地展示出来。

e.en: The novel describes the battle {gruesomely} but honestly.
e.zh: 小说血腥而真实地描写了那场战斗。

gruff.t: adj. (声音) 粗哑的；粗鲁的

e.en: The old sailor had a {gruff} but kind manner.
e.zh: 那位老水手嗓音粗哑但人很善良。

e.en: He gave a {gruff} reply and walked away.
e.zh: 他粗声粗气地回了一句就走开了。

gruffly.t: adv. 声音粗哑地；生硬地

e.en: "Sit down," he said {gruffly}, pointing to the chair.
e.zh: "坐下,"他粗声说道,指了指椅子。

e.en: The coach spoke {gruffly} but cared about every player.
e.zh: 教练说话粗声粗气,但关心每一位队员。

gruffness.t: n. 声音粗哑；态度生硬

e.en: His {gruffness} hid a surprisingly tender heart.
e.zh: 他粗鲁的外表下藏着一颗格外温柔的心。

e.en: She was put off by the receptionist's {gruffness}.
e.zh: 她对前台的粗声粗气感到很不舒服。

grumble.t:
v. 抱怨；发牢骚
n. 怨言；隆隆声

e.en: Workers began to {grumble} about the new policy.
e.zh: 员工们开始抱怨这项新政策。

e.en: My stomach started to {grumble} during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时我的肚子开始咕咕叫了。

grumbled.t: v. grumble 的过去式；抱怨

e.en: He {grumbled} about the rising cost of groceries.
e.zh: 他抱怨杂货越来越贵。

e.en: The passengers {grumbled} as the flight was delayed again.
e.zh: 航班再次延误,乘客们怨声载道。

grumbles.t: v./n. grumble 的三单/复数；抱怨

e.en: There were quiet {grumbles} from the back of the room.
e.zh: 屋子后面传来低声的抱怨。

e.en: She always {grumbles} when asked to work weekends.
e.zh: 每次被叫去周末加班她都会发牢骚。

grumbling.t:
n. 抱怨
adj. 爱发牢骚的

e.en: I could hear him {grumbling} about the Wi-Fi again.
e.zh: 我又听到他在抱怨 Wi-Fi 不好了。

e.en: Despite the {grumbling}, the team finished the project on time.
e.zh: 尽管怨声不断,团队还是按时完成了项目。

grumman.t: n. 格鲁曼（美国飞机制造商）

e.en: The museum displays a vintage {Grumman} fighter plane.
e.zh: 博物馆陈列着一架老式的格鲁曼战斗机。

e.en: Northrop {Grumman} won the contract for the new satellite.
e.zh: 诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司拿下了这颗新卫星的合同。

grump.t:
n. 爱生气的人
v. 发牢骚

e.en: Don't be such a {grump} on your birthday!
e.zh: 过生日别这么爱发脾气嘛!

e.en: He's a lovable old {grump} once you get to know him.
e.zh: 熟了之后你会发现他是个可爱的老牢骚鬼。

grumpily.t: adv. 脾气暴躁地；闷闷不乐地

e.en: She {grumpily} closed the laptop and went to bed.
e.zh: 她没好气地合上笔记本,上床睡觉了。

e.en: The cat stared {grumpily} at the empty food bowl.
e.zh: 猫不爽地盯着空空的食盆。

e.en: His morning {grumpiness} usually disappears after coffee.
e.zh: 他早上的坏脾气通常喝完咖啡就没了。

e.en: Lack of sleep explains a lot of her {grumpiness}.
e.zh: 她那么爱发脾气,很大程度上是因为没睡好。

grumpy.t: adj. 脾气坏的；闷闷不乐的

e.en: I get {grumpy} when I skip breakfast.
e.zh: 我不吃早饭就会变得脾气暴躁。

e.en: The {grumpy} barista barely looked up from his phone.
e.zh: 那个臭脸咖啡师几乎没从手机上抬起头来。

grundy.t: n. 人名/姓氏 Grundy（罕用）

e.en: Mrs. {Grundy} would never approve of such fashion.
e.zh: 格朗迪太太那种卫道士绝不会赞同这种穿着。

e.en: Solomon {Grundy} is a classic Batman villain.
e.zh: 所罗门·格伦迪是蝙蝠侠故事里的经典反派。

grunge.t: n. 垃圾摇滚（音乐风格）；脏污

e.en: Nirvana defined the {grunge} era of the early 90s.
e.zh: 涅槃乐队定义了九十年代初的垃圾摇滚时代。

e.en: Flannel shirts came back as part of {grunge} revival fashion.
e.zh: 格子衬衫随着垃圾摇滚复古风潮再度流行。

e.en: The bathroom was {grungy} and clearly hadn't been cleaned.
e.zh: 那间浴室又脏又乱,一看就没打扫过。

e.en: He wore a {grungy} t-shirt and ripped jeans.
e.zh: 他穿着一件脏兮兮的 T 恤和破洞牛仔裤。

grunt.t:
v. (人/猪) 哼哼；咕哝
n. 咕哝声

e.en: He gave a {grunt} of approval and kept reading.
e.zh: 他哼了一声表示认可,继续看书。

e.en: The new hire handles all the {grunt} work this month.
e.zh: 这个月所有的杂活都由新来的员工干。

grunting.t:
n. 咕哝声
adj. 发哼声的

e.en: You could hear him {grunting} as he lifted the weights.
e.zh: 能听到他举重时哼哼的喘息声。

e.en: The pigs were {grunting} loudly near the feeder.
e.zh: 猪在食槽旁大声地哼哼叫着。

e.en: A golden {gryphon} guarded the entrance to the castle.
e.zh: 一只金色的狮鹫守卫着城堡的入口。

e.en: The team's logo features a fierce {gryphon} with spread wings.
e.zh: 球队队徽上是一只张开翅膀的凶猛狮鹫。

gstaad.t: n. 格施塔德（瑞士滑雪胜地）

e.en: They spend every January skiing in {Gstaad}.
e.zh: 他们每年一月都去格施塔德滑雪。

e.en: {Gstaad} is famous for its luxury chalets and celebrities.
e.zh: 格施塔德以豪华小木屋和名流云集而闻名。

gti.t: n. 高性能运动版车型（Gran Turismo Injection）

e.en: He drives a black Volkswagen Golf {GTI}.
e.zh: 他开一辆黑色的大众高尔夫 GTI。

e.en: The {GTI} is known for being a fun hot hatch.
e.zh: GTI 以好玩的小钢炮形象著称。

e.en: I made fresh {guacamole} to go with the chips.
e.zh: 我做了新鲜的牛油果酱配薯片。

e.en: This restaurant prepares {guacamole} right at your table.
e.zh: 这家餐厅会在你桌边现场调制牛油果酱。

guadeloupe.t: n. 瓜德罗普（加勒比海法属岛屿）

e.en: We honeymooned on the beaches of {Guadeloupe}.
e.zh: 我们在瓜德罗普岛的海滩上度的蜜月。

e.en: {Guadeloupe} is an overseas region of France in the Caribbean.
e.zh: 瓜德罗普是法国位于加勒比海的海外大区。

guam.t: n. 关岛（美国海外领地）

e.en: Her cousin is stationed at a navy base on {Guam}.
e.zh: 她表哥被派驻在关岛的一个海军基地。

e.en: {Guam} is a U.S. territory in the western Pacific.
e.zh: 关岛是美国在西太平洋的领地。

guan.t: n. 冠雉（中南美洲鸟类）

e.en: The {guan} is a large bird native to South American forests.
e.zh: 冠雉是一种原产于南美森林的大型鸟类。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a rare {guan} in the canopy.
e.zh: 观鸟者在树冠层发现了一只稀有的冠雉。

guanaco.t: n. 原驼（南美洲骆驼科动物）

e.en: A wild {guanaco} grazed on the Patagonian plains.
e.zh: 一只野生原驼在巴塔哥尼亚草原上吃草。

e.en: The {guanaco} is a close relative of the llama.
e.zh: 原驼是美洲驼的近亲。

e.en: {Guangdong} province is a major manufacturing hub in China.
e.zh: 广东省是中国重要的制造业中心。

e.en: She grew up speaking Cantonese in {Guangdong}.
e.zh: 她在广东长大,从小说粤语。

guanine.t: n. 鸟嘌呤（DNA 碱基之一）

e.en: {Guanine} pairs with cytosine in the DNA double helix.
e.zh: 在 DNA 双螺旋中,鸟嘌呤与胞嘧啶配对。

e.en: Scientists detected traces of {guanine} in the meteorite sample.
e.zh: 科学家在陨石样本中检测到了鸟嘌呤的痕迹。

guano.t: n. 海鸟/蝙蝠粪便（天然肥料）

e.en: The cave floor was thick with bat {guano}.
e.zh: 洞底厚厚地堆着一层蝙蝠粪。

e.en: Farmers once prized {guano} as a powerful fertilizer.
e.zh: 农民曾把鸟粪视为效力强大的肥料。

guar.t: n. 瓜尔豆（产瓜尔胶的豆科作物）

e.en: {Guar} gum is used to thicken sauces and ice cream.
e.zh: 瓜尔豆胶常用来给酱汁和冰淇淋增稠。

e.en: India is the world's largest producer of {guar} beans.
e.zh: 印度是世界上最大的瓜尔豆生产国。

guarana.t: n. 瓜拿纳（含咖啡因的南美植物）

e.en: Many energy drinks contain {guarana} for an extra caffeine kick.
e.zh: 很多能量饮料添加瓜拉那以增加咖啡因含量。

e.en: {Guarana} berries grow on a vine native to the Amazon.
e.zh: 瓜拉那浆果生长在亚马逊地区的一种藤本植物上。

guarantee.t:
n. 保证；担保
v. 保证；担保

e.en: The laptop comes with a two-year {guarantee}.
e.zh: 这台笔记本电脑提供两年的质保。

e.en: I can't {guarantee} that we'll arrive on time.
e.zh: 我没法保证我们能准时到达。

guaranteed.t:
adj. 有保证的
v. guarantee 的过去式

e.en: All purchases are {guaranteed} for thirty days.
e.zh: 所有商品均享有三十天的保修。

e.en: A sunny weekend is not {guaranteed} this time of year.
e.zh: 这个时节可没法保证周末一定是晴天。

guaranteeing.t: v. guarantee 的现在分词；保证、担保

e.en: The contract includes a clause {guaranteeing} on-time delivery.
e.zh: 合同里有一条保证按时交货的条款。

e.en: They published the source code, {guaranteeing} full transparency.
e.zh: 他们公开了源代码,确保完全透明。

e.en: Follow this {guideline} when submitting your pull request.
e.zh: 提交合并请求时请遵循这条准则。

e.en: The new safety {guideline} takes effect next month.
e.zh: 新的安全准则将在下个月生效。

guidelines.t: n. 指导方针；准则（复数）

e.en: Please read the community {guidelines} before posting.
e.zh: 发帖前请先阅读社区准则。

e.en: Our brand {guidelines} cover colors, fonts, and tone.
e.zh: 我们的品牌规范涵盖颜色、字体和语气。

e.en: Customer feedback is our main {guidepost} for new features.
e.zh: 用户反馈是我们做新功能的主要风向标。

e.en: A weathered {guidepost} pointed toward the mountain trail.
e.zh: 一根斑驳的路标指向山间小道。

e.en: She works as a {guider} for a youth scouting troop.
e.zh: 她在一个少年童军团担任领队。

e.en: A skilled {guider} keeps the whole group moving safely.
e.zh: 一个熟练的领队能让整支队伍安全前行。

guides.t:
n. 向导；指南（复数）
v. 引导（第三人称单数）

e.en: Our online {guides} walk beginners through every step.
e.zh: 我们的在线指南会带新手完成每一步。

e.en: The mountain {guides} carried extra ropes and oxygen.
e.zh: 登山向导带了额外的绳索和氧气。

e.en: The monorail glides smoothly along its elevated {guideway}.
e.zh: 单轨列车沿着高架导轨平稳滑行。

e.en: Engineers inspect the {guideway} for cracks every month.
e.zh: 工程师每月都会检查导轨是否有裂缝。

guiding.t:
adj. 指导的；引导的
v. 引导（现在分词）

e.en: Curiosity has been her {guiding} principle throughout life.
e.zh: 好奇心一直是她人生的指导原则。

e.en: The coach is {guiding} the team through a tough season.
e.zh: 教练正带领球队度过一个艰难的赛季。

guild.t: n. 公会；行会（游戏中的组织）

e.en: The writers' {guild} negotiated a new streaming contract.
e.zh: 作家协会谈成了新的流媒体合同。

e.en: Players formed a {guild} to tackle the hardest raids together.
e.zh: 玩家们组建了一个公会一起挑战最难的副本。

e.en: My grandfather still keeps an old Dutch {guilder} as a souvenir.
e.zh: 我祖父还留着一枚旧的荷兰盾作纪念。

e.en: The {guilder} was replaced by the euro in 2002.
e.zh: 荷兰盾在2002年被欧元取代。

guildford.t: n. 吉尔福德（英国地名）

e.en: We took the train down to {Guildford} for the weekend.
e.zh: 我们坐火车去吉尔福德过周末。

e.en: {Guildford} has a charming high street and a ruined castle.
e.zh: 吉尔福德有迷人的主街和一座古堡遗址。

e.en: The mayor's reception was held at the historic {guildhall}.
e.zh: 市长的招待会在历史悠久的市政厅举行。

e.en: Tourists snapped photos of the medieval {guildhall} façade.
e.zh: 游客们拍着这座中世纪行会会馆的外立面。

e.en: She won the negotiation through patience, not {guile}.
e.zh: 她靠耐心而不是诡计赢下了那场谈判。

e.en: The con artist used pure {guile} to fool investors.
e.zh: 那个骗子完全靠狡诈手段骗了投资人。

e.en: Her {guileless} smile won over even the toughest critics.
e.zh: 她真诚无邪的笑容连最严厉的评论家都被打动了。

e.en: The child gave a {guileless} answer that made everyone laugh.
e.zh: 那个孩子给出一个天真直白的答案,把大家都逗笑了。

guilelessly.t: adv. 坦率地；不施诡计地

e.en: She {guilelessly} admitted she had never used the app before.
e.zh: 她坦率地承认自己从未用过这款应用。

e.en: The child smiled {guilelessly} at the stranger on the bus.
e.zh: 那孩子天真无邪地朝公交车上的陌生人微笑。

guilford.t: n. 吉尔福德（地名/姓氏）

e.en: We drove through {Guilford} on our way to the coast.
e.zh: 我们在去海岸的路上开车经过吉尔福德。

e.en: She studies medicine at a university near {Guilford}.
e.zh: 她在吉尔福德附近的一所大学读医学。

e.en: A {guillemot} dived for fish near the rocky cliffs.
e.zh: 一只海鸠在岩崖附近俯冲捕鱼。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a {guillemot} nesting on the ledge.
e.zh: 观鸟者发现一只海鸠在岩架上筑巢。

e.en: The watch dial features a delicate {guilloche} pattern.
e.zh: 这块手表的表盘饰有精致的扭索纹。

e.en: Banknotes use {guilloche} engraving to prevent counterfeiting.
e.zh: 纸币使用扭索花纹雕刻来防伪。

guillotine.t:
n. 断头台
v. 用断头台处决

e.en: The office {guillotine} cuts a hundred sheets at once.
e.zh: 办公室的切纸机一次能裁一百张纸。

e.en: During the revolution, the {guillotine} became a symbol of terror.
e.zh: 革命期间,断头台成为恐怖的象征。

e.en: She felt overwhelming {guilt} after lying to her parents.
e.zh: 对父母撒谎之后,她感到巨大的内疚。

e.en: The jury debated his {guilt} for nearly three days.
e.zh: 陪审团就他是否有罪辩论了将近三天。

e.en: He {guiltily} closed the fridge with cake on his lips.
e.zh: 他嘴角沾着蛋糕,内疚地关上了冰箱。

e.en: She glanced {guiltily} at the unread messages on her phone.
e.zh: 她内疚地瞥了一眼手机上未读的消息。

e.en: The judge declared the suspect entirely {guiltless} of the charges.
e.zh: 法官宣布嫌疑人对所有指控完全无罪。

e.en: Sparkling water is a {guiltless} alternative to soda.
e.zh: 气泡水是替代汽水的无负担选择。

e.en: The jury found the defendant {guilty} of fraud.
e.zh: 陪审团裁定被告犯有欺诈罪。

e.en: I feel {guilty} about skipping the gym again.
e.zh: 我又没去健身房,觉得很愧疚。

guinea.t: n. 几内亚（国家）；几尼（旧金币）

e.en: My grandmother still keeps an old gold {guinea} as a keepsake.
e.zh: 我奶奶还留着一枚旧的金几尼作为纪念。
