e.en: They flew to {Guinea} to volunteer at a rural clinic.
e.zh: 他们飞到几内亚的乡村诊所做志愿者。

guinean.t:
adj. 几内亚的
n. 几内亚人

e.en: The chef prepared a traditional {Guinean} stew with peanuts.
e.zh: 厨师做了一道传统的几内亚花生炖菜。

e.en: She married a {Guinean} diplomat she met in Paris.
e.zh: 她嫁给了在巴黎认识的一位几内亚外交官。

guinness.t: n. 健力士（啤酒品牌）；吉尼斯

e.en: He ordered a pint of {Guinness} at the Irish pub.
e.zh: 他在那家爱尔兰酒吧点了一品脱健力士。

e.en: Her record was officially recognized by {Guinness} World Records.
e.zh: 她的纪录被吉尼斯世界纪录正式认证。

e.en: Scammers contacted her under the {guise} of bank security.
e.zh: 骗子以银行安全部门的名义联系了她。

e.en: The app collects data under the {guise} of personalization.
e.zh: 这款应用以个性化为幌子收集数据。

e.en: He plays {guitar} in a local indie band.
e.zh: 他在本地一支独立乐队里弹吉他。

e.en: She bought her first acoustic {guitar} online last week.
e.zh: 她上周在网上买了第一把木吉他。

e.en: The lead {guitarist} delivered an unforgettable solo last night.
e.zh: 昨晚主音吉他手献上了一段难忘的独奏。

e.en: She's a self-taught {guitarist} with millions of followers online.
e.zh: 她是自学成才的吉他手,网上拥有数百万粉丝。

e.en: Two {guitarists} traded riffs throughout the entire show.
e.zh: 两位吉他手在整场演出中轮流即兴弹奏。

e.en: Many {guitarists} learn their first chords from YouTube tutorials.
e.zh: 许多吉他手是通过YouTube教程学会第一组和弦的。

e.en: He owns a small collection of vintage {guitars}.
e.zh: 他收藏了几把老式吉他。

e.en: The shop displays handmade {guitars} along the back wall.
e.zh: 店里把手工吉他陈列在后墙上。

gujarat.t: n. 古吉拉特（印度邦名）

e.en: They flew to {Gujarat} to visit her grandmother's village.
e.zh: 他们飞往古吉拉特邦去看望她奶奶的村子。

e.en: {Gujarat} is famous for its textile industry and street food.
e.zh: 古吉拉特邦以纺织业和街头小吃闻名。

gulag.t: n. 古拉格（苏联劳改营）

e.en: His grandfather survived years in a Soviet {gulag}.
e.zh: 他的祖父在苏联古拉格里熬过了好几年。

e.en: The novel describes daily life inside a remote {gulag}.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了偏远古拉格里的日常生活。

e.en: The {Gulbenkian} museum in Lisbon houses an incredible art collection.
e.zh: 里斯本的古本江博物馆收藏了大量精彩的艺术品。

e.en: Her research was funded by a {Gulbenkian} foundation grant.
e.zh: 她的研究由古本江基金会的资助支持。

e.en: The hikers descended into a narrow desert {gulch}.
e.zh: 徒步者走下一条狭窄的沙漠峡谷。

e.en: Heavy rain turned the dry {gulch} into a rushing stream.
e.zh: 大雨把干涸的峡谷变成了一条奔流的小河。

e.en: There's a widening {gulf} between rich and poor in the city.
e.zh: 这座城市的贫富差距正在不断拉大。

e.en: Oil tankers crossed the {Gulf} on their way to refineries.
e.zh: 油轮穿越海湾驶往各家炼油厂。

gull.t:
n. 海鸥
v. 欺骗

e.en: A noisy {gull} stole a chip right off my plate.
e.zh: 一只吵闹的海鸥从我盘子里抢走了一根薯条。

e.en: Don't let online ads {gull} you into buying junk.
e.zh: 别让网络广告把你骗去买垃圾东西。

e.en: The pill stuck halfway down his {gullet} for a moment.
e.zh: 那粒药片在他喉咙里卡了一下。

e.en: He poured the cold beer straight down his {gullet}.
e.zh: 他把冰啤酒直接灌进了喉咙。

e.en: Rainwater rushed down the steep {gulley} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴雨过后雨水从陡峭的小沟里冲下来。

e.en: A small bridge spans the rocky {gulley} behind the farm.
e.zh: 农场后面有一座小桥横跨那条多石的沟壑。

e.en: Phishing scams prey on the {gullibility} of busy users.
e.zh: 钓鱼诈骗利用了忙碌用户的轻信心理。

e.en: His {gullibility} cost him thousands in crypto investments.
e.zh: 他的轻信让他在加密货币投资上损失了好几千。

e.en: Don't be so {gullible} — that email is obviously a scam.
e.zh: 别那么轻信,那封邮件明显是诈骗。

e.en: Young children are naturally {gullible} about online ads.
e.zh: 小孩子对网络广告天生就容易轻信。

gulliver.t: n. 格列佛（《格列佛游记》主角）

e.en: As a kid, I loved the story of {Gulliver} and the tiny people.
e.zh: 小时候我很喜欢格列佛和小人国的故事。

e.en: The new film is a modern retelling of {Gulliver}'s adventures.
e.zh: 这部新电影是格列佛历险记的现代改编。

e.en: The trail follows a deep {gully} carved by spring floods.
e.zh: 小径沿着一条被春汛冲刷出的深沟而行。

e.en: Their ball rolled into the muddy {gully} beside the road.
e.zh: 他们的球滚进了路边泥泞的小水沟里。

gulp.t:
v. 大口吞咽
n. 一大口

e.en: She took a big {gulp} of water before her speech.
e.zh: 演讲前她大大地喝了一口水。

e.en: He {gulped} down breakfast and ran out the door.
e.zh: 他狼吞虎咽地吃完早餐就冲出了门。

gulping.t: v. 大口吞咽（现在分词）

e.en: He kept {gulping} air after running up six flights of stairs.
e.zh: 爬完六层楼梯后,他一直大口喘着气。

e.en: The kids were {gulping} milkshakes too quickly and got brain freeze.
e.zh: 孩子们奶昔喝太急,冻得头疼。

gulps.t:
v. 大口吞咽（第三人称单数）
n. 一大口（复数）

e.en: She finished the smoothie in three quick {gulps}.
e.zh: 她三大口就把那杯奶昔喝完了。

e.en: He {gulps} his coffee on the way to the office.
e.zh: 他在去办公室的路上大口灌着咖啡。

e.en: She offered me a piece of mint {gum} after lunch.
e.zh: 午饭后她给了我一块薄荷口香糖。

e.en: My dentist warned me about bleeding along my {gum} line.
e.zh: 牙医提醒我牙龈边缘有出血。

guarantees.t:
n. 保证；担保（复数）
v. 保证（第三人称单数）

e.en: Hard work {guarantees} progress, even if not instant success.
e.zh: 努力虽不能立刻带来成功,但一定会带来进步。

e.en: The company offers strong {guarantees} on all its products.
e.zh: 该公司对所有产品提供有力的保证。

e.en: My father agreed to be the {guarantor} on the lease.
e.zh: 我父亲同意做这份租约的担保人。

e.en: International students often need a {guarantor} to rent apartments.
e.zh: 留学生租房通常需要找一位担保人。

e.en: He signed a personal {guaranty} to secure the loan.
e.zh: 他签了一份个人担保书来获得这笔贷款。

e.en: The bank requires a written {guaranty} for the credit line.
e.zh: 银行要求为这条信用额度提供书面担保。

guard.t:
n. 警卫；护卫
v. 守卫；防范

e.en: A security {guard} checked our IDs at the entrance.
e.zh: 一名保安在入口处查验了我们的证件。

e.en: You need to {guard} your password carefully online.
e.zh: 你需要在网上小心保管自己的密码。

guarded.t:
adj. 谨慎的；有戒心的
v. 守卫（过去式）

e.en: She gave a {guarded} response to the reporter's question.
e.zh: 她对记者的问题给出了谨慎的回答。

e.en: The vault is heavily {guarded} around the clock.
e.zh: 金库全天候被严密守卫。

e.en: He spoke {guardedly} about his plans for next year.
e.zh: 他对明年的计划说得很含蓄。

e.en: Investors reacted {guardedly} to the earnings report.
e.zh: 投资者对财报反应谨慎。

e.en: The soldier reported to the {guardhouse} at dawn.
e.zh: 那名士兵黎明时分到警卫室报到。

e.en: Visitors must sign in at the {guardhouse} before entering.
e.zh: 访客进入前必须在岗哨亭登记。

guardia.t: n. 警卫队（西班牙语借词）

e.en: My flight landed at La {Guardia} airport last night.
e.zh: 我的航班昨晚降落在拉瓜迪亚机场。

e.en: The Spanish Civil {Guardia} patrols rural highways.
e.zh: 西班牙国民警卫队在乡间公路上巡逻。

e.en: Her aunt became her legal {guardian} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故之后,姑姑成了她的法定监护人。

e.en: I read an article about it in The {Guardian} today.
e.zh: 我今天在《卫报》上读到一篇相关文章。

guardianship.t: n. 监护权；监护人身份

e.en: The court awarded {guardianship} of the child to her grandmother.
e.zh: 法院将孩子的监护权判给了她的外婆。

e.en: He filed for {guardianship} of his elderly father.
e.zh: 他申请成为年迈父亲的监护人。

guarding.t:
v. 守卫（进行时）
n. 防护

e.en: Two dogs were {guarding} the entrance to the farm.
e.zh: 两只狗守卫着农场的入口。

e.en: She is fiercely {guarding} her privacy from the press.
e.zh: 她极力守护自己的隐私不让媒体打扰。

e.en: The car skidded and hit the highway {guardrail}.
e.zh: 那辆车打滑撞上了高速公路的护栏。

e.en: We added a safety {guardrail} to prevent harmful AI outputs.
e.zh: 我们加了一道安全护栏以防止 AI 产生有害输出。

e.en: The detainee was held overnight in the {guardroom}.
e.zh: 被拘留者在卫兵室里关了一晚。

e.en: Soldiers off duty relaxed in the {guardroom} playing cards.
e.zh: 下了岗的士兵在卫兵室里打牌休息。

guards.t:
n. 卫兵；警卫（复数）
v. 守卫（第三人称单数）

e.en: Two {guards} stood quietly outside the palace gate.
e.zh: 两名卫兵静静地站在宫门外。

e.en: This app {guards} your passwords with strong encryption.
e.zh: 这款应用用强加密保护你的密码。

e.en: The young {guardsman} saluted as the queen walked past.
e.zh: 年轻的卫兵在女王走过时敬礼。

e.en: He served as a {guardsman} for nearly twenty years.
e.zh: 他做了近二十年的卫兵。

guatemala.t: n. 危地马拉（中美洲国家）

e.en: We spent two weeks hiking volcanoes in {Guatemala}.
e.zh: 我们在危地马拉徒步火山待了两周。

e.en: {Guatemala} is famous for its rich, smooth coffee beans.
e.zh: 危地马拉以其浓郁顺滑的咖啡豆闻名。

guatemalan.t:
adj. 危地马拉的
n. 危地马拉人

e.en: She ordered a {Guatemalan} pour-over at the new café.
e.zh: 她在新开的咖啡馆点了一杯危地马拉手冲。

e.en: The festival celebrated traditional {Guatemalan} music and dance.
e.zh: 这个节日庆祝传统的危地马拉音乐和舞蹈。

e.en: I blended frozen {guava} into my morning smoothie.
e.zh: 我把冷冻番石榴打进了早晨的奶昔里。

e.en: The bakery sells flaky pastries filled with {guava} jam.
e.zh: 这家面包店卖夹着番石榴酱的酥皮点心。

guayabera.t: n. 古巴传统男式衬衫

e.en: He wore a white {guayabera} to the beach wedding.
e.zh: 他穿着白色的古巴衬衫参加海滩婚礼。

e.en: A linen {guayabera} keeps you cool in tropical heat.
e.zh: 亚麻古巴衬衫在热带酷暑中能让人保持凉爽。

e.en: The {gubernatorial} race tightened in the final week.
e.zh: 州长选战在最后一周变得胶着。

e.en: She announced her {gubernatorial} campaign at a downtown rally.
e.zh: 她在市中心的集会上宣布参选州长。

e.en: She splurged on a vintage {Gucci} handbag online.
e.zh: 她在网上狠心买了一个古驰复古手袋。

e.en: The window display featured the latest {Gucci} runway looks.
e.zh: 橱窗里展示着古驰最新的秀场造型。

guerilla.t: n. 游击队员（guerrilla 的变体）

e.en: The startup ran a clever {guerilla} marketing stunt downtown.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在市中心搞了一场巧妙的游击式营销。

e.en: Rebel {guerilla} fighters retreated into the dense jungle.
e.zh: 反叛的游击战士撤进了茂密的丛林。

guerlain.t: n. 娇兰（法国化妆品牌）

e.en: She sprayed a touch of {Guerlain} perfume before leaving.
e.zh: 她出门前喷了一点娇兰香水。

e.en: The {Guerlain} counter offered free skincare consultations today.
e.zh: 娇兰柜台今天提供免费的护肤咨询。

guernica.t: n. 格尔尼卡（毕加索名画/西班牙城市）

e.en: Picasso's {Guernica} hangs in a museum in Madrid.
e.zh: 毕加索的《格尔尼卡》挂在马德里的一家博物馆里。

e.en: We studied {Guernica} as a powerful anti-war statement.
e.zh: 我们把《格尔尼卡》作为有力的反战宣言来学习。

e.en: The dairy farm raises {Guernsey} cows for richer milk.
e.zh: 这家奶牛场养根西牛以产出更浓郁的牛奶。

e.en: We took the ferry from England to {Guernsey}.
e.zh: 我们坐渡轮从英格兰前往根西岛。

guerrilla.t:
n. 游击队员
adj. 游击式的

e.en: Brands love cheap {guerrilla} marketing on social media.
e.zh: 品牌喜欢在社交媒体上做廉价的游击式营销。

e.en: The {guerrilla} fighters ambushed the convoy at dawn.
e.zh: 游击队员在黎明伏击了车队。

e.en: The {guerrillas} controlled the mountain passes for months.
e.zh: 游击队员控制山口长达数月。

e.en: Government troops clashed with {guerrillas} near the border.
e.zh: 政府军在边境附近与游击队员发生冲突。

guess.t:
v. 猜测；估计
n. 猜测

e.en: Can you {guess} how much this concert ticket cost?
e.zh: 你猜得出这张演唱会门票多少钱吗?

e.en: My first {guess} on the password was actually correct.
e.zh: 我第一次猜的密码居然是对的。

e.en: She {guessed} the answer correctly without even reading it.
e.zh: 她连题都没看就猜对了答案。

e.en: I {guessed} the ending of the movie within ten minutes.
e.zh: 我十分钟内就猜到了电影的结局。

e.en: My little brother is a surprisingly good {guesser} at trivia.
e.zh: 我弟弟在猜谜上意外地很厉害。

e.en: The app picks a winning {guesser} from the comments.
e.zh: 这个应用会从评论里挑出一个猜中的赢家。

guesses.t:
n. 猜测（复数）
v. 猜（第三人称单数）

e.en: You only get three {guesses} before the game ends.
e.zh: 游戏结束前你只有三次猜测机会。

e.en: Most of his {guesses} on the quiz were wrong.
e.zh: 他在测验里的猜测大多是错的。

guessing.t:
v. 猜测（进行时）
n. 猜测

e.en: Stop {guessing} and just check the documentation.
e.zh: 别瞎猜了,直接去查文档吧。

e.en: I'm {guessing} the meeting will be canceled again.
e.zh: 我估计这次会议又会被取消。

guesstimate.t:
n. 凭感觉估算
v. 粗略估计

e.en: My rough {guesstimate} for the project is two weeks.
e.zh: 我对这个项目的粗略估算是两周。

e.en: Can you {guesstimate} how many users we'll have?
e.zh: 你能大概估一下我们会有多少用户吗?

e.en: Good analytics removes most of the {guesswork} from marketing.
e.zh: 好的数据分析能把营销中的大部分猜测去掉。

e.en: His diagnosis was based on pure {guesswork}, not evidence.
e.zh: 他的诊断完全是凭猜测,而不是证据。

guest.t:
n. 客人；嘉宾
adj. 客串的

e.en: We're expecting a special {guest} on the podcast tonight.
e.zh: 今晚的播客我们会迎来一位特别嘉宾。

e.en: Please sign in at the front desk as a {guest}.
e.zh: 请以访客身份在前台登记。

e.en: We booked a cozy {guesthouse} just outside the village.
e.zh: 我们订了村外一家温馨的客栈。

e.en: Their backyard {guesthouse} doubles as a home office.
e.zh: 他们后院的客房兼作家庭办公室。

e.en: The {guestroom} has a queen bed and a tiny desk.
e.zh: 客房里有一张大床和一张小书桌。

e.en: We turned the spare {guestroom} into a nursery.
e.zh: 我们把闲置的客房改成了婴儿房。

e.en: The hotel welcomes {guests} with a glass of champagne.
e.zh: 酒店用一杯香槟迎接客人。

e.en: Our wedding {guests} traveled from six different countries.
e.zh: 我们的婚礼宾客来自六个不同的国家。

e.en: That iconic photo of {Guevara} is printed on millions of t-shirts.
e.zh: 切·格瓦拉那张标志性的照片被印在几百万件T恤上。

e.en: Students debated {Guevara}'s legacy in the history seminar.
e.zh: 学生们在历史研讨课上讨论格瓦拉的遗产。

e.en: I'm not putting up with any more of his {guff}.
e.zh: 我不会再忍他那些废话了。

e.en: Don't give me that {guff} about being too busy.
e.zh: 别跟我扯什么太忙的鬼话。

guffaw.t:
n. 哄笑
v. 哄堂大笑

e.en: His loud {guffaw} echoed across the quiet library.
e.zh: 他响亮的大笑在安静的图书馆里回荡。

e.en: The audience burst into a collective {guffaw} at the joke.
e.zh: 听众听到那个笑话齐声哄堂大笑。

guggenheim.t: n. 古根海姆（博物馆/基金会）

e.en: We spent the afternoon at the {Guggenheim} in New York.
e.zh: 我们下午在纽约的古根海姆博物馆度过。

e.en: She won a prestigious {Guggenheim} fellowship for her research.
e.zh: 她凭研究获得了著名的古根海姆奖学金。

gui.t: n. 图形用户界面（Graphical User Interface）

e.en: The new {GUI} makes the software much easier to use.
e.zh: 新的图形界面让这款软件用起来容易多了。

e.en: Developers built a clean {GUI} on top of the API.
e.zh: 开发者在API之上做了一个简洁的图形界面。

e.en: French {Guiana} is home to Europe's main spaceport.
e.zh: 法属圭亚那拥有欧洲主要的航天发射场。

e.en: We hiked through dense rainforest in {Guiana} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在圭亚那的茂密雨林徒步。

e.en: The teacher offered gentle {guidance} on her essay draft.
e.zh: 老师对她的论文草稿给出了温和的指导。

e.en: I'm looking for some career {guidance} from a mentor.
e.zh: 我希望从一位导师那里得到一些职业指导。

e.en: The agency issued multiple {guidances} on data privacy.
e.zh: 该机构就数据隐私发布了多份指导意见。

e.en: Regulatory {guidances} keep evolving as the technology matures.
e.zh: 随着技术成熟,监管指导意见在不断更新。

guide.t:
n. 指南；向导
v. 引导；指导

e.en: Our local {guide} showed us hidden corners of the city.
e.zh: 我们的当地导游带我们看了城市里隐秘的角落。

e.en: This article will {guide} you through setting up the app.
e.zh: 这篇文章会指导你完成应用的设置。

e.en: I always travel with a paper {guidebook} as backup.
e.zh: 我旅行时总会带一本纸质旅行指南作备用。

e.en: The {guidebook} recommends the small museum near the harbor.
e.zh: 这本旅游指南推荐了港口附近的那家小博物馆。

e.en: Travel {guidebooks} are slowly being replaced by mobile apps.
e.zh: 旅游指南正慢慢被手机应用取代。

e.en: She collects vintage {guidebooks} from cities she's visited.
e.zh: 她收集去过的城市的老旅游指南。

guided.t:
adj. 有导游的；制导的
v. 引导（过去式）

e.en: We took a {guided} tour through the ancient ruins.
e.zh: 我们参加了一个有导游的古迹游览。

e.en: The app offers {guided} meditations for better sleep.
e.zh: 这款应用提供帮助入睡的引导式冥想。

guru.t:
n. 权威专家；大师
n. (印度教) 宗师

e.en: She's become the office {guru} for spreadsheet tricks.
e.zh: 她成了办公室里的电子表格高手。

e.en: The startup hired a marketing {guru} to boost sales.
e.zh: 这家初创公司聘请了一位营销大师来提升销量。

gurus.t: n. guru 的复数；大师们

e.en: Tech {gurus} predict AI will transform every industry.
e.zh: 科技大咖们预测人工智能将变革每个行业。

e.en: Self-help {gurus} dominate the bestseller lists these days.
e.zh: 励志大师们如今霸占着畅销书排行榜。

gush.t:
v. 喷涌；滔滔不绝地说
n. 迸发

e.en: Fans always {gush} about the singer's amazing voice.
e.zh: 粉丝们总是滔滔不绝地夸赞这位歌手的好嗓音。

e.en: Water began to {gush} from the broken pipe.
e.zh: 水开始从破裂的水管里喷涌而出。

gushed.t: v. gush 的过去式；涌出；大加赞美

e.en: Blood {gushed} from the wound before paramedics arrived.
e.zh: 急救员到达前,血从伤口里涌了出来。

e.en: She {gushed} about her new boyfriend all evening.
e.zh: 她整晚滔滔不绝地夸她的新男友。

gusher.t:
n. 自喷油井
n. 感情外露的人

e.en: The drillers struck a massive oil {gusher} in Texas.
e.zh: 钻井工人在德州打出了一口巨大的喷油井。

e.en: That cut on his hand is a real {gusher}.
e.zh: 他手上那道口子血流得真凶。

gushes.t: v. gush 的三单；喷涌；夸赞

e.en: Water {gushes} out whenever you turn that tap on.
e.zh: 一打开那个水龙头水就会喷涌而出。

e.en: She always {gushes} over puppies whenever she sees one.
e.zh: 她每次看到小狗都会激动地大呼小叫。

gushing.t: adj. 喷涌的；过分热情的

e.en: The reviews were absolutely {gushing} about her performance.
e.zh: 评论对她的表演赞不绝口。

e.en: Blood was {gushing} from the cut on his arm.
e.zh: 血正从他胳膊的伤口里涌出来。

gushingly.t: adv. 滔滔不绝地；过分热情地

e.en: She thanked him {gushingly} for the surprise gift.
e.zh: 她为这份惊喜礼物对他热情洋溢地道谢。

e.en: The host introduced the guest {gushingly} to the audience.
e.zh: 主持人极力赞美地把嘉宾介绍给观众。

gushy.t: adj. 过分夸赞的；感情外露的

e.en: His Valentine's card was a bit too {gushy} for me.
e.zh: 他的情人节卡片对我来说有点太肉麻了。

e.en: I hate {gushy} romance novels with predictable endings.
e.zh: 我讨厌那种结局可预料、肉麻兮兮的言情小说。

gusset.t: n. 三角衬布；加固角片

e.en: The tailor added a {gusset} for extra arm movement.
e.zh: 裁缝加了一块插角布以便手臂活动更自如。

e.en: These jeans have a stretchy {gusset} for comfort.
e.zh: 这条牛仔裤有弹性插角布,穿着更舒服。

gust.t:
n. 一阵强风
n. (情绪的) 突发

e.en: A sudden {gust} of wind blew my hat off.
e.zh: 一阵突如其来的狂风把我的帽子吹跑了。

e.en: The flag flapped wildly with each {gust}.
e.zh: 每一阵狂风袭来,旗帜都剧烈飘动。

e.en: The study explored how {gustation} differs between cultures.
e.zh: 该研究探讨了不同文化间味觉的差异。

e.en: Aging can dull a person's sense of {gustation}.
e.zh: 衰老会使人的味觉变得迟钝。

gustatory.t: adj. 味觉的；与尝味有关的

e.en: The restaurant offers a unique {gustatory} experience.
e.zh: 这家餐厅提供独一无二的味觉体验。

e.en: Coffee triggers strong {gustatory} memories for many people.
e.zh: 咖啡能勾起许多人强烈的味觉记忆。

gustavian.t: adj. 古斯塔夫式的（瑞典家具风格）

e.en: Her living room features elegant {Gustavian} furniture from Sweden.
e.zh: 她的客厅摆放着典雅的瑞典古斯塔夫风格家具。

e.en: The museum displays a beautiful {Gustavian} cabinet.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件精美的古斯塔夫式柜子。

gusting.t: v. gust 的进行式；刮阵风

e.en: Winds were {gusting} up to sixty miles per hour.
e.zh: 阵风时速高达六十英里。

e.en: The storm kept {gusting} all through the night.
e.zh: 风暴整夜都在阵阵刮个不停。

gusto.t: n. 兴致勃勃；极大的热情

e.en: He attacked the steak with great {gusto}.
e.zh: 他兴致勃勃地大快朵颐那块牛排。

e.en: She sang the chorus with surprising {gusto}.
e.zh: 她唱副歌时的劲头让人惊喜。

e.en: The chefs brought their own {gustoes} to the cooking show.
e.zh: 厨师们各带着自己的热情上了烹饪节目。

e.en: Different {gustoes} make every dinner party unique.
e.zh: 各种各样的热情劲头让每场晚宴都独具特色。

gusty.t: adj. 刮阵风的；风势强劲的

e.en: It was a cold and {gusty} afternoon at the beach.
e.zh: 那是一个海边又冷又刮大风的下午。

e.en: Pilots avoid landing in {gusty} crosswind conditions.
e.zh: 飞行员会避免在阵阵侧风的天气下降落。

gut.t:
n. 肠；内脏
v. 摧毁内部；取出内脏

e.en: My {gut} tells me this deal is too risky.
e.zh: 我的直觉告诉我这笔交易风险太大。

e.en: He took a hard punch to the {gut}.
e.zh: 他肚子上挨了重重一拳。

gutenberg.t: n. 古腾堡（活字印刷发明人）

e.en: {Gutenberg} revolutionized printing with his movable type press.
e.zh: 古腾堡用他的活字印刷机彻底变革了印刷业。

e.en: Project {Gutenberg} offers thousands of free ebooks online.
e.zh: 古腾堡计划在网上提供了数千本免费电子书。

e.en: Woody {Guthrie} wrote some of America's most famous folk songs.
e.zh: 伍迪·古思里创作了一些美国最著名的民谣。

e.en: The {Guthrie} Theater in Minneapolis hosts world-class plays.
e.zh: 明尼阿波利斯的古思里剧院上演世界级剧目。

e.en: His {gutless} response disappointed everyone on the team.
e.zh: 他懦弱的回应让团队里每个人都很失望。

e.en: Don't be {gutless} — stand up for what you believe.
e.zh: 别那么没骨气——为你所相信的事挺身而出。

guts.t:
n. 内脏；胆量
n. (机器) 内部构造

e.en: It takes real {guts} to speak up in that meeting.
e.zh: 在那种会议上敢发言需要真正的勇气。

e.en: The mechanic showed me the {guts} of the engine.
e.zh: 修车师傅给我看了发动机的内部结构。

gutsiest.t: adj. gutsy 的最高级；最有胆量的

e.en: That was the {gutsiest} performance of her career.
e.zh: 那是她职业生涯中最大胆的一次表演。

e.en: He made the {gutsiest} call any coach could make.
e.zh: 他做出了任何教练都难以做出的最果敢决定。

e.en: Critics praised the film for its raw {gutsiness}.
e.zh: 影评人称赞这部电影的粗犷胆识。

e.en: Her {gutsiness} on stage won over the entire crowd.
e.zh: 她在舞台上的胆魄征服了全场观众。

e.en: She made a {gutsy} decision to quit her stable job.
e.zh: 她做出了辞掉稳定工作的大胆决定。

e.en: The startup launched a {gutsy} ad campaign last week.
e.zh: 那家初创公司上周发起了一场大胆的广告宣传。

gutta.t: n. (建筑) 圆锥形滴状装饰

e.en: Artists use {gutta} to outline patterns on silk scarves.
e.zh: 艺术家用胶水在丝巾上勾勒图案轮廓。

e.en: Apply the {gutta} carefully before painting the silk.
e.zh: 在丝绸上色前要小心涂上防染胶。

gutted.t:
v. gut 的过去式；掏空
adj. 极度失望的

e.en: He was absolutely {gutted} when his team lost the final.
e.zh: 球队输掉决赛时他彻底崩溃了。

e.en: The fire {gutted} the entire warehouse overnight.
e.zh: 大火一夜之间烧毁了整个仓库内部。

gutter.t:
n. 排水沟；檐槽
n. 社会底层

e.en: Leaves clogged the {gutter} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨后落叶堵住了排水沟。

e.en: The bowling ball rolled straight into the {gutter}.
e.zh: 保龄球径直滚进了边沟。

guttering.t: n. 檐槽 / 排水沟材料

e.en: We need to clean the {guttering} before winter arrives.
e.zh: 冬天来临前我们得清理一下排水槽。

e.en: The candle was {guttering} in the draft from the window.
e.zh: 蜡烛在窗户的穿堂风中摇曳欲灭。

gutting.t: v. gut 的进行式；掏内脏；摧毁内部

e.en: The chef is {gutting} the fish in the back kitchen.
e.zh: 厨师正在后厨清理那条鱼的内脏。

e.en: Losing that contract was {gutting} for the whole team.
e.zh: 丢掉那份合同对整个团队都是沉重打击。

e.en: The kids would {guttle} pizza after every soccer game.
e.zh: 孩子们每场足球赛后都会狼吞虎咽地吃披萨。

e.en: Don't {guttle} your food so quickly at the table.
e.zh: 在餐桌上别那么狼吞虎咽地吃东西。

guttural.t: adj. 喉音的；低沉粗哑的

e.en: He let out a {guttural} growl when he saw the score.
e.zh: 看到比分时他发出一声低沉的吼声。

e.en: German has many {guttural} sounds that learners struggle with.
e.zh: 德语有许多让学习者头疼的喉音。

e.en: Right you are, {guv}, I'll get on it straight away.
e.zh: 好的老板,我马上去办。

e.en: The cabbie called me {guv} as I climbed in.
e.zh: 我上车时出租车司机叫我先生。

e.en: The {guvnor} wants to see you in his office now.
e.zh: 老板让你现在去他办公室。

e.en: Ask the {guvnor} if we can leave early on Friday.
e.zh: 问问老板我们周五能不能早走。

guy.t:
n. 男人；家伙
n. (复数) 各位

e.en: That {guy} at the coffee shop always remembers my order.
e.zh: 咖啡店那个小伙子总能记住我点的东西。

e.en: He's a really nice {guy} once you get to know him.
e.zh: 你了解他之后会发现他人非常好。

e.en: {Guyana} is the only English-speaking country in South America.
e.zh: 圭亚那是南美洲唯一以英语为官方语言的国家。

e.en: Recent oil discoveries have transformed {Guyana}'s economy.
e.zh: 近期发现的石油彻底改变了圭亚那的经济。

guyanese.t:
n. 圭亚那人
adj. 圭亚那的

e.en: My neighbor cooks amazing {Guyanese} curry every Sunday.
e.zh: 我的邻居每个周日都会做美味的圭亚那咖喱。

e.en: The {Guyanese} community in Toronto hosts a yearly festival.
e.zh: 多伦多的圭亚那社区每年都举办节日活动。

e.en: Hey {guys}, the meeting starts in five minutes.
e.zh: 各位,会议五分钟后开始。

e.en: Those {guys} from accounting helped us fix the spreadsheet.
e.zh: 会计部那几个人帮我们修好了表格。

guzzle.t: v. 狂饮；大吃；(车) 耗油

e.en: Old SUVs tend to {guzzle} fuel on the highway.
e.zh: 老款越野车在高速上往往特别费油。

e.en: Don't {guzzle} that energy drink so fast before practice.
e.zh: 训练前别这么猛灌那罐能量饮料。

guzzler.t:
n. 油老虎
n. 暴饮暴食者

e.en: That truck is a real gas {guzzler} in city traffic.
e.zh: 那辆卡车在市区里真是个耗油大户。

e.en: My old fridge was an electricity {guzzler} all summer.
e.zh: 我那台旧冰箱整个夏天都在疯狂耗电。

gweilo.t: n. 鬼佬（粤语对西方人的俗称）

e.en: Some Hong Kong locals still casually call foreigners {gweilo}.
e.zh: 一些香港本地人仍会随口称外国人为鬼佬。

e.en: He laughed when the kids called him a friendly {gweilo}.
e.zh: 孩子们友好地叫他鬼佬时他笑了起来。

gumball.t: n. 口香糖球（糖衣包裹的球形口香糖）

e.en: He fed a quarter into the {gumball} machine at the diner.
e.zh: 他在小餐馆的扭蛋糖机里投了一枚硬币。

e.en: The kid picked the bright red {gumball} from the bowl.
e.zh: 那孩子从碗里挑了一颗鲜红的口香糖。

gumbo.t: n. 秋葵浓汤（美国南方菜肴）

e.en: The restaurant serves authentic shrimp {gumbo} every Friday.
e.zh: 那家餐厅每周五都供应正宗的虾肉秋葵浓汤。

e.en: She learned to cook {gumbo} from her grandmother in Louisiana.
e.zh: 她跟住在路易斯安那的奶奶学会了做秋葵浓汤。

e.en: He pulled on a {gumboot} before stepping into the muddy field.
e.zh: 他穿上一只胶靴才走进泥泞的田地。

e.en: Every farmer here owns at least one pair of {gumboot} shoes.
e.zh: 这里的每个农民至少都有一双胶靴。

e.en: She placed a single {gumdrop} on top of the cupcake.
e.zh: 她在纸杯蛋糕上放了一颗软糖。

e.en: The candy jar was full of colorful {gumdrop} sweets.
e.zh: 糖果罐里装满了五颜六色的橡皮糖。

gummed.t:
v. 粘住；涂胶于（gum 的过去式）
adj. 涂胶的

e.en: Dust had {gummed} up the laptop fan over the years.
e.zh: 多年下来灰尘把笔记本电脑的风扇堵住了。

e.en: She {gummed} the envelope shut and dropped it in the mailbox.
e.zh: 她把信封粘好,投进了邮筒。

gummer.t: n. 磨齿机；锯齿磨锐器

e.en: The old dog had become a {gummer} after losing his teeth.
e.zh: 那只老狗掉了牙后,只能靠牙龈嚼食。

e.en: Grandpa joked he was a {gummer} now without his dentures.
e.zh: 爷爷开玩笑说没了假牙,他现在只能用牙龈吃东西了。

gummy.t:
adj. 黏糊的；胶状的
n. 软糖（口语）

e.en: Kids love these vitamin {gummy} candies shaped like bears.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢这些做成小熊形状的维生素软糖。

e.en: The overcooked rice turned soft and {gummy} in the pot.
e.zh: 米饭煮过头了,在锅里变得又软又黏。

e.en: She had the {gumption} to start her own company at twenty.
e.zh: 她二十岁就有胆量自己创办公司。

e.en: It takes real {gumption} to admit a mistake in public.
e.zh: 在公开场合承认错误需要真正的勇气。

e.en: Brushing too hard can damage your {gums} over time.
e.zh: 刷牙太用力时间长了会损伤牙龈。

e.en: The baby {gums} her teething ring all afternoon.
e.zh: 宝宝整个下午都在啃她的磨牙环。

e.en: The novel features a hard-boiled {gumshoe} solving cold cases.
e.zh: 这本小说讲的是一个老练的私家侦探破解陈年悬案。

e.en: He played a {gumshoe} in three classic noir films.
e.zh: 他在三部经典黑色电影中饰演私家侦探。

gun.t:
n. 枪；炮
v. 开枪；加大油门

e.en: Police recovered the {gun} used in the robbery.
e.zh: 警方找到了抢劫案中使用的那把枪。

e.en: He used a glue {gun} to repair the broken vase.
e.zh: 他用胶枪修好了那只破花瓶。

e.en: A {gunbattle} broke out between police and the suspects downtown.
e.zh: 警方与嫌犯在市中心爆发了一场枪战。

e.en: Several civilians were injured during the brief {gunbattle}.
e.zh: 短暂的枪战中有几名平民受伤。

e.en: A small {gunboat} patrolled the river near the border.
e.zh: 一艘小型炮艇在边境附近的河上巡逻。

e.en: Critics accused the country of practicing old-fashioned {gunboat} diplomacy.
e.zh: 批评者指责该国仍在搞老式的炮舰外交。

e.en: A brief {gunfight} erupted outside the convenience store last night.
e.zh: 昨晚便利店外爆发了一场短暂的枪战。

e.en: The film opens with a tense {gunfight} in the desert.
e.zh: 这部电影以沙漠中一场紧张的枪战开场。

e.en: The legendary {gunfighter} retired to a small ranch out west.
e.zh: 那位传奇枪手退休后住到了西部一个小牧场。

e.en: In the movie, a young {gunfighter} challenges the aging sheriff.
e.zh: 电影里,一名年轻枪手向年迈的警长发起挑战。

e.en: Residents heard {gunfire} coming from the abandoned warehouse.
e.zh: 居民们听到从废弃仓库传来的枪声。

e.en: The reporter ducked as {gunfire} echoed through the streets.
e.zh: 枪声在街道上回荡,记者赶忙蹲下。

gunge.t: n. 黏稠脏污之物（英式口语）

e.en: Sticky {gunge} had clogged the drain under the sink.
e.zh: 水槽下的下水道被黏糊糊的污垢堵住了。

e.en: He scraped weeks of {gunge} off the kitchen stovetop.
e.zh: 他把厨房灶台上积了几周的油垢刮掉了。

e.en: There's some sticky {gunk} stuck inside the keyboard.
e.zh: 键盘里粘了一些黏糊糊的脏东西。

e.en: He scraped the black {gunk} off the engine parts.
e.zh: 他把发动机零件上的黑色油垢刮掉了。

e.en: The kitchen sink drain is really {gunky} today.
e.zh: 今天厨房水槽的下水道特别油腻脏。

e.en: Don't touch that {gunky} mess on the counter.
e.zh: 别碰台面上那一坨黏糊糊的脏东西。

e.en: The {gunmaker} announced a new line of hunting rifles.
e.zh: 这家枪械制造商发布了一系列新款猎枪。

e.en: Smith & Wesson is a famous American {gunmaker}.
e.zh: 史密斯威森是著名的美国枪械制造商。

gunman.t: n. 持枪歹徒；武装分子

e.en: Police are searching for the {gunman} who fled the scene.
e.zh: 警方正在追捕逃离现场的持枪歹徒。

e.en: A masked {gunman} robbed the convenience store last night.
e.zh: 昨晚一名蒙面持枪歹徒抢劫了便利店。

gunmetal.t: n. 青铜色；炮铜（铜锡合金）

e.en: She bought a watch with a sleek {gunmetal} finish.
e.zh: 她买了一块表面是青灰色金属漆的手表。

e.en: The car comes in a beautiful {gunmetal} gray color.
e.zh: 这款车有一种漂亮的枪灰色可选。

gunnel.t:
n. 船舷上缘（同 gunwale）
n. 锦鳚鱼

e.en: He gripped the {gunnel} as the boat rocked violently.
e.zh: 小船剧烈摇晃时,他紧紧抓住船舷。

e.en: Water splashed over the {gunnel} during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中海水溅过了船舷。

e.en: The tail {gunner} spotted enemy aircraft approaching fast.
e.zh: 尾炮手发现敌机正在快速逼近。

e.en: He served as a {gunner} during the war.
e.zh: 战争期间他担任炮手。

gunnery.t: n. 炮术；枪炮操作技术

e.en: The {gunnery} sergeant ran a tough training program.
e.zh: 那位炮兵军士长主持着一项严格的训练课程。

e.en: Naval {gunnery} accuracy improved greatly during the war.
e.zh: 战争期间海军炮术的准确度大大提高了。

e.en: The rice was stored in a rough {gunny} bag.
e.zh: 大米装在一只粗糙的麻布袋里。

e.en: She found old potatoes in a torn {gunny} sack.
e.zh: 她在一个破麻袋里发现了一些旧土豆。

e.en: He hauled the potatoes home in a heavy {gunnysack}.
e.zh: 他用一个沉甸甸的麻袋把土豆扛回了家。

e.en: The farmer filled the {gunnysack} with freshly picked corn.
e.zh: 农夫把刚摘的玉米装满了麻袋。

e.en: The movie has way too much {gunplay} for kids.
e.zh: 这部电影里的枪战场面对小孩来说太多了。

e.en: Witnesses reported {gunplay} outside the nightclub last night.
e.zh: 目击者称昨晚夜店外发生了枪战。

gunpoint.t: n. 枪口（常用 at gunpoint 被枪指着）

e.en: The clerk was robbed at {gunpoint} early this morning.
e.zh: 今天清晨店员遭人持枪抢劫。

e.en: Hostages were held at {gunpoint} for several hours.
e.zh: 人质被持枪挟持了数小时。

e.en: The Chinese invented {gunpowder} over a thousand years ago.
e.zh: 中国人在一千多年前就发明了火药。

e.en: Keep the {gunpowder} away from any open flames.
e.zh: 火药要远离任何明火。

e.en: Authorities arrested a notorious {gunrunner} at the border.
e.zh: 当局在边境逮捕了一名臭名昭著的军火走私贩。

e.en: The {gunrunner} smuggled rifles across three countries.
e.zh: 这名军火走私贩把步枪偷运过了三个国家。

e.en: Many countries have strict laws regulating {guns}.
e.zh: 许多国家对枪支有严格的管控法律。

e.en: The soldiers cleaned their {guns} after the long march.
e.zh: 长途行军后,士兵们清理了自己的枪。

gunship.t: n. 武装直升机；武装炮艇

e.en: An attack {gunship} circled overhead during the operation.
e.zh: 行动期间一架武装直升机在上空盘旋。

e.en: The {gunship} provided cover for the ground troops.
e.zh: 这架武装直升机为地面部队提供了火力掩护。

gunshot.t:
n. 枪声；射击
n. 射程

e.en: Neighbors heard a single {gunshot} around midnight.
e.zh: 邻居们在午夜前后听到一声枪响。

e.en: He died from a {gunshot} wound to the chest.
e.zh: 他死于胸部中枪造成的伤口。

e.en: Several {gunshots} rang out near the train station.
e.zh: 火车站附近响起了好几声枪响。

e.en: Residents reported hearing {gunshots} late last night.
e.zh: 居民称昨晚深夜听到了枪声。

e.en: He carefully aligned the target in his {gunsight}.
e.zh: 他小心地把目标对准在瞄准镜中。

e.en: The {gunsight} fogged up in the cold rain.
e.zh: 瞄准器在冷雨中起了雾。

gunslinger.t: n. 神枪手；持枪斗士（美西部）

e.en: The old western stars a fearless {gunslinger} hero.
e.zh: 这部老西部片的主角是一位无畏的快枪手。

e.en: He walked into the saloon like a classic {gunslinger}.
e.zh: 他像个典型的快枪手一样走进了酒馆。

e.en: The local {gunsmith} repaired the antique rifle beautifully.
e.zh: 当地的枪械师把那把古董步枪修得漂漂亮亮。

e.en: He apprenticed with a master {gunsmith} for years.
e.zh: 他跟随一位枪械大师当了好多年学徒。

e.en: She leaned against the {gunwale} to watch the dolphins.
e.zh: 她倚靠在船舷上观看海豚。

e.en: The waves crashed right over the {gunwale}.
e.zh: 海浪直接打过了船舷。

e.en: My daughter keeps a tiny {guppy} in her fish tank.
e.zh: 我女儿在鱼缸里养了一条小孔雀鱼。

e.en: The colorful {guppy} darted around the aquarium plants.
e.zh: 那条彩色的孔雀鱼在水草间穿梭。

gupta.t: n. 笈多（印度姓氏；笈多王朝）

e.en: The {Gupta} empire was a golden age in Indian history.
e.zh: 笈多王朝是印度历史上的黄金时代。

e.en: Dr. {Gupta} will see you in the next room.
e.zh: 古普塔医生会在隔壁房间为您看诊。

gurgle.t:
v. 发出汩汩声
n. 潺潺水声

e.en: I could hear the stream {gurgle} through the rocks.
e.zh: 我能听见小溪在岩石间汩汩流过。

e.en: The baby gave a happy {gurgle} after her bottle.
e.zh: 宝宝喝完奶后开心地发出咯咯声。

gurgling.t:
adj. 汩汩作响的
n. 潺潺流水声

e.en: The {gurgling} fountain made the garden feel peaceful.
e.zh: 汩汩作响的喷泉让花园显得宁静。

e.en: He heard a {gurgling} sound coming from the pipes.
e.zh: 他听见水管里传出咕嘟咕嘟的声音。

gurkha.t: n. 廓尔喀人（尼泊尔雇佣兵）

e.en: A {Gurkha} soldier guarded the entrance to the embassy.
e.zh: 一名廓尔喀士兵守卫着使馆入口。

e.en: The {Gurkha} regiments are famous for their bravery.
e.zh: 廓尔喀兵团以英勇善战而闻名。

e.en: Paramedics wheeled the patient in on a {gurney}.
e.zh: 急救员推着担架车把病人送了进来。

e.en: The hospital {gurney} squeaked as they pushed it down the hall.
e.zh: 医院的轮床推过走廊时吱吱作响。

gwent.t: n. 圭内特（英国威尔士郡名）

e.en: My grandparents grew up in a small village in {Gwent}.
e.zh: 我祖父母在格温特郡的一个小村庄长大。

e.en: The hills of {Gwent} are stunning during early autumn.
e.zh: 格温特郡的山丘在初秋时分美得惊人。

gwr.t: n. 大西部铁路（Great Western Railway 缩写）

e.en: The {GWR} train to Bristol was delayed by an hour.
e.zh: 开往布里斯托的大西部铁路列车晚点了一小时。

e.en: {GWR} announced new direct services to Cornwall this summer.
e.zh: 大西部铁路公司宣布今夏开通直达康沃尔的新线路。

gwynedd.t: n. 圭内斯（威尔士郡名）

e.en: We hiked through {Gwynedd} during our trip to North Wales.
e.zh: 我们去北威尔士旅行时徒步穿越了圭内斯郡。

e.en: {Gwynedd} has some of the most dramatic coastline in Britain.
e.zh: 圭内斯郡拥有英国最壮观的海岸线之一。

e.en: The crew had to {gybe} quickly as the wind shifted.
e.zh: 风向突变时船员们不得不迅速转帆。

e.en: Watch your head when we {gybe} the mainsail.
e.zh: 我们调转主帆时小心你的头。

e.en: The brewer tasted the fresh {gyle} before bottling.
e.zh: 酿酒师在装瓶前品尝了这批新酿的酒液。

e.en: Each {gyle} produces about two hundred barrels of ale.
e.zh: 每一缸酿造可生产约两百桶麦芽啤酒。

gym.t:
n. 健身房
n. 体育课

e.en: I go to the {gym} three times a week after work.
e.zh: 我每周下班后去三次健身房。

e.en: The school's new {gym} opens next Monday morning.
e.zh: 学校的新体育馆下周一早上开放。

e.en: My daughter won a ribbon at the local pony {gymkhana}.
e.zh: 我女儿在当地的小马术比赛中赢了一条丝带。

e.en: The car {gymkhana} videos on YouTube get millions of views.
e.zh: YouTube 上的汽车竞技表演视频获得数百万次播放。

e.en: The university built three new {gymnasia} on the south campus.
e.zh: 这所大学在南校区新建了三座体育馆。

e.en: Ancient Greek {gymnasia} were centers of both sport and learning.
e.zh: 古希腊的体育馆既是运动场所也是学习中心。

e.en: The basketball team practices in the main {gymnasium} each evening.
e.zh: 篮球队每天晚上在主体育馆训练。

e.en: Our high school {gymnasium} doubles as the assembly hall.
e.zh: 我们高中的体育馆同时也是大礼堂。

e.en: The young {gymnast} stuck her landing perfectly.
e.zh: 那位年轻的体操运动员落地动作完美无瑕。

e.en: He trained as a {gymnast} from the age of six.
e.zh: 他从六岁起就开始接受体操训练。

e.en: She performed an impressive {gymnastic} routine on the beam.
e.zh: 她在平衡木上做了一套精彩的体操动作。

e.en: The cat made a {gymnastic} leap onto the high shelf.
e.zh: 那只猫做出体操般的一跃,跳上了高架。

e.en: My niece practices {gymnastics} at the studio downtown.
e.zh: 我侄女在市中心的训练馆练习体操。

e.en: Olympic {gymnastics} attracts huge audiences every four years.
e.zh: 奥运体操比赛每四年都会吸引大批观众。

gyms.t: n. gym 的复数，健身房

e.en: Many {gyms} reopened slowly after the lockdown ended.
e.zh: 封锁结束后许多健身房才慢慢重新开放。

e.en: Boutique {gyms} have become popular among young professionals.
e.zh: 精品健身房在年轻白领中越来越受欢迎。

e.en: My mother kept her old {gymslip} from boarding school days.
e.zh: 我母亲一直保留着她寄宿学校时期的旧运动罩衫。

e.en: Girls in the 1950s wore a {gymslip} for PE class.
e.zh: 二十世纪五十年代的女生上体育课要穿运动罩衫。

e.en: The novel imagines a future {gynaecocracy} ruling the planet.
e.zh: 这部小说设想了一个由女性统治世界的未来。

e.en: Historians debate whether any true {gynaecocracy} ever existed.
e.zh: 历史学家争论真正的女权统治是否曾存在过。

e.en: She booked a routine {gynaecological} check-up for next week.
e.zh: 她预约了下周的常规妇科检查。

e.en: The hospital expanded its {gynaecological} department last year.
e.zh: 这家医院去年扩建了妇科部门。

e.en: My {gynaecologist} recommended an ultrasound just to be safe.
e.zh: 我的妇科医生建议为了安全做个超声检查。

e.en: Finding a good {gynaecologist} took her several months.
e.zh: 她花了好几个月才找到一位好的妇科医生。

e.en: She specialized in {gynaecology} after finishing medical school.
e.zh: 她医学院毕业后专攻妇科学。

e.en: The clinic offers both obstetrics and {gynaecology} services.
e.zh: 这家诊所提供产科和妇科双项服务。

e.en: Annual {gynecologic} exams help catch problems early.
e.zh: 每年做妇科检查有助于早期发现问题。

e.en: The hospital opened a new {gynecologic} oncology unit.
e.zh: 医院新开设了一个妇科肿瘤科。

e.en: Many women delay {gynecological} appointments due to embarrassment.
e.zh: 许多女性因为尴尬而推迟妇科预约。

e.en: The app sends gentle reminders about {gynecological} screenings.
e.zh: 这款应用会温馨提醒用户进行妇科筛查。

gynecologist.t: n. 妇科医生（美式拼写）

e.en: Her {gynecologist} explained the test results clearly and patiently.
e.zh: 她的妇科医生清楚耐心地解释了化验结果。

e.en: Pregnant women should visit a {gynecologist} regularly.
e.zh: 孕妇应当定期去看妇科医生。

e.en: He's pursuing a residency in obstetrics and {gynecology}.
e.zh: 他正在攻读妇产科住院医生培训。

e.en: Modern {gynecology} relies heavily on advanced imaging technology.
e.zh: 现代妇科学非常依赖先进的影像技术。

gyp.t:
v. 欺骗；敲竹杠
n. 骗局

e.en: That street vendor tried to {gyp} me out of twenty bucks.
e.zh: 那个街边小贩想骗我二十块钱。

e.en: My old knee injury still gives me {gyp} on cold mornings.
e.zh: 我的旧膝伤在寒冷的早晨还是会让我难受。

gypsies.t: n. gypsy 的复数，吉普赛人

e.en: Traveling {gypsies} once camped in the meadow each summer.
e.zh: 流浪的吉普赛人过去每年夏天都在那片草地上扎营。

e.en: The film romanticizes the lives of European {gypsies}.
e.zh: 这部电影将欧洲吉普赛人的生活浪漫化了。

e.en: Drywall is made primarily from compressed {gypsum} board.
e.zh: 石膏板主要由压制的石膏制成。

e.en: Workers mined {gypsum} from the cliffs for over a century.
e.zh: 工人们从那些悬崖开采石膏已超过一个世纪。

gypsy.t:
n. 吉普赛人
adj. 吉普赛的

e.en: She has a {gypsy} spirit and never stays in one city.
e.zh: 她有颗漂泊的心,从不在一个城市久留。

e.en: The shop sells colorful {gypsy} skirts and silver bracelets.
e.zh: 这家店出售色彩鲜艳的吉普赛长裙和银手镯。

e.en: The dancers {gyrate} wildly to the pounding bass beat.
e.zh: 舞者们随着震耳的低音节拍狂热地扭动。

e.en: Stock prices began to {gyrate} after the surprise announcement.
e.zh: 出人意料的公告发布后股价开始剧烈波动。

e.en: The hula hoop's {gyration} kept the children entertained for hours.
e.zh: 呼啦圈的旋转让孩子们玩了好几个小时。

e.en: Market {gyration} this week made traders nervous.
e.zh: 本周市场的剧烈波动让交易员们紧张不安。

gyre.t:
n. 环流；大洋环流
v. 旋转

e.en: Plastic waste accumulates in the great Pacific {gyre}.
e.zh: 塑料垃圾在太平洋大环流中不断堆积。

e.en: The hawk traced a wide {gyre} above the cornfield.
e.zh: 那只鹰在玉米地上空划出一道宽阔的盘旋轨迹。

gyrfalcon.t: n. 矛隼（一种大型猎鹰）

e.en: The {gyrfalcon} is the largest falcon species in the world.
e.zh: 矛隼是世界上体型最大的隼类。

e.en: Birdwatchers travel to Iceland hoping to spot a {gyrfalcon}.
e.zh: 观鸟者前往冰岛,希望能见到一只矛隼。

gyro.t:
n. 陀螺仪
n. 希腊肉卷（食物）

e.en: I ordered a lamb {gyro} with extra tzatziki sauce.
e.zh: 我点了一份羊肉旋转烤肉卷，多加酸奶酱。

e.en: The drone's {gyro} keeps it stable in strong wind.
e.zh: 无人机的陀螺仪让它在强风中保持稳定。

e.en: The {gyroplane} took off from a short grass runway.
e.zh: 那架旋翼机从一条短草跑道上起飞了。

e.en: He built a kit {gyroplane} in his garage.
e.zh: 他在车库里组装了一架自旋翼飞机套件。

e.en: Every smartphone contains a tiny {gyroscope} for motion sensing.
e.zh: 每部智能手机都装有一个微型陀螺仪用于运动感测。

e.en: The spinning {gyroscope} stays upright on the string.
e.zh: 旋转的陀螺仪在细绳上保持直立不倒。

e.en: The bike's stability comes from {gyroscopic} forces in the wheels.
e.zh: 自行车的稳定性来自车轮的陀螺效应。

e.en: The camera uses {gyroscopic} stabilization to reduce shake.
e.zh: 这款相机使用陀螺稳定技术来减少抖动。

gyrus.t: n. 脑回（大脑表面隆起）

e.en: Damage to this {gyrus} can affect language processing.
e.zh: 这条脑回受损可能影响语言处理能力。

e.en: The brain's surface folds into ridges called each {gyrus}.
e.zh: 大脑表面折叠成被称为脑回的隆起。

gemma.t: n. 芽体；Google 开源模型名

gainsaid.t: vt. 否定, 反驳\nn. 否认, 反驳, 反对

ganglia.t: n. 神经节, 腱鞘囊肿\n[医] 神经节, 腱鞘囊肿

gaudiest.t: a. 俗丽的, 华而不实的\nn. 盛大宴会

gawkier.t: a. 愚笨的, 腼腆的, 粗笨的, 笨拙的

geest.t: n. 马, 家伙\ninterj. 向右, 前进, 哎呀(惊讶时所发声音)\nv. (使)向右转

gentlewomen.t: n. 良家妇女, 淑女, 贵妇人

genera.t: n. 种, 类\n[医] 属(分类)

giddier.t: a. 眼花的, 头晕的\nv. (使)眼花, (使)眩晕

gloomier.t: a. 抑沉的, 忧闷的, 黑暗的, 悲观的

gloomiest.t: a. 抑沉的, 忧闷的, 黑暗的, 悲观的

gloried.t: n. 光荣, 荣耀, 荣誉, 壮丽, 繁荣\nvi. 自豪

glummest.t: a. 愁闷的, 阴沉的

gorier.t: a. 血淋淋的, 满是血的, 血污的

grandest.t: a. 庄重的, 壮观的, 显赫的, 重大的, 最高的, 雄伟的, 宏大的, 豪华的, 傲慢的\n[法] 重大的, 主要的, 伟大的

grassiest.t: a. 草绿色的, 象草的, 长满草的

grassier.t: a. 草绿色的, 象草的, 长满草的

gravest.t: n. 墓穴, 坟墓, 终结, 死亡\na. 庄重的, 严肃的, 重大的, 低沉的\nvt. 雕刻

greasiest.t: a. 油腻的, 含脂肪多的

greasier.t: a. 油腻的, 含脂肪多的

greedier.t: a. 贪婪的, 贪得的, 贪吃的

greediest.t: a. 贪婪的, 贪得的, 贪吃的

greenest.t: n. 绿色, 绿色颜料\na. 绿色的, 未成熟的, 新鲜的, 青春的, 无经验的, 脸色发青的

grimmest.t: a. 冷酷的, 坚强的, 残忍的, 可怕的, 讨厌的

grittier.t: a. 有砂砾的, 坚韧不拔的

grittiest.t: a. 有砂砾的, 坚韧不拔的

grossest.t: n. 总数, 总量\na. 总共的, 未打折扣的, 恶劣的, 粗野的\nvt. 总共收入

groundsmen.t: n. 球场管理员, 大花园的园丁

grubbier.t: a. 污秽的, 肮脏的, 生蛆的

grubbied.t: a. 污秽的, 肮脏的, 生蛆的

grubbiest.t: a. 污秽的, 肮脏的, 生蛆的

grumpier.t: a. 性情乖戾的, 脾气暴躁的, 生气的

guardsmen.t: n. 卫兵, (英)近卫兵, (美)国民警卫队士兵

gullied.t: n. 小峡谷, 排水沟

gunmen.t: n. 枪手, 持枪的歹徒, 制造枪械者\n[法] 持枪歹徒, 持枪抢劫或杀人者, 枪炮工人

e.en: The satellite link used the {g-band} during the test.
e.zh: 卫星链路在测试中使用了 G 频段。

e.en: The lab compared the chromosome {g-band} patterns.
e.zh: 实验室比较了染色体的 G 显带图样。

g-display.t: 重力数据显示；过载显示器

e.en: The pilot checked the {g-display} during the sharp turn.
e.zh: 飞行员在急转弯时查看过载显示器。

e.en: A faulty {g-display} made the simulator harder to trust.
e.zh: 故障的重力数据显示让模拟器不太可信。

e.en: The physicist marked the {g-line} on the spectrum chart.
e.zh: 物理学家在光谱图上标出了 G 线。

e.en: The lens was tested with the mercury {g-line}.
e.zh: 这枚镜头用汞光谱的 G 线进行了测试。

e.en: The receptor activates a {g-protein} inside the cell.
e.zh: 受体会激活细胞内的 G 蛋白。

e.en: Researchers studied how the {g-protein} carried the signal.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了 G 蛋白如何传递信号。

e.en: The technician ran a {g-scan} before approving the device.
e.zh: 技术员在批准设备前进行了 G 扫描。

e.en: Her doctor ordered a {g-scan} to check the tissue.
e.zh: 医生安排她做 G 扫描来检查组织。

e.en: The engineer watched the {g-scope} during vibration testing.
e.zh: 工程师在振动测试中观察 G 示波器。

e.en: A bright trace appeared on the {g-scope} screen.
e.zh: G 示波器屏幕上出现了一条明亮的轨迹。

e.en: The article discussed the {g-spot} in careful medical language.
e.zh: 那篇文章用谨慎的医学语言讨论了 G 点。

e.en: Many guides mention the {g-spot} but oversimplify anatomy.
e.zh: 许多指南提到 G 点，却把解剖结构说得过于简单。

e.en: My uncle gets {gabbier} after dinner.
e.zh: 我叔叔晚饭后会变得更爱闲聊。

e.en: The host sounded {gabbier} than usual on the podcast.
e.zh: 这位主持人在播客里听起来比平时更饶舌。

gabblement.t: 含混急促的话语；胡言乱语

e.en: The witness's {gabblement} confused the jury.
e.zh: 证人含混急促的话让陪审团很困惑。

e.en: He dismissed the rumor as drunken {gabblement}.
e.zh: 他把那条谣言斥为醉后的胡言乱语。

e.en: The cliff was made of dark {gabbro}.
e.zh: 那处悬崖由深色辉长岩构成。

e.en: Geologists found {gabbro} beneath the old lava flow.
e.zh: 地质学家在旧熔岩流下发现了辉长岩。

e.en: The sample had a coarse {gabbroic} texture.
e.zh: 这个样品具有粗粒的辉长岩质结构。

e.en: They mapped several {gabbroic} intrusions in the valley.
e.zh: 他们测绘了山谷中几处辉长岩质侵入体。

e.en: The quarry exposed a {gabbroid} body near the fault.
e.zh: 采石场在断层附近露出了一处似辉长岩岩体。

e.en: She classified the dark rock as {gabbroid}.
e.zh: 她把这块深色岩石归为似辉长岩类。

e.en: The peasants hated the royal {gabelle}.
e.zh: 农民痛恨王室征收的盐税。

e.en: Writers used {gabelle} to symbolize oppressive taxation.
e.zh: 作家用盐税来象征压迫性的苛捐杂税。

e.en: A tired {gaberlunzie} slept by the gate.
e.zh: 一个疲惫的乞丐睡在大门旁。

e.en: The old ballad tells of a wandering {gaberlunzie}.
e.zh: 那首古老民谣讲的是一个四处漂泊的流浪汉。

e.en: The meeting turned into a political {gabfest}.
e.zh: 那场会议变成了一场政治闲聊会。

e.en: We had a late-night {gabfest} in the kitchen.
e.zh: 我们深夜在厨房里聊了很久。

e.en: Workers placed a {gabion} along the riverbank.
e.zh: 工人们沿河岸放置了一个石笼。

e.en: The wall uses {gabion} baskets filled with local stone.
e.zh: 这道墙使用装满当地石料的石笼网箱。

e.en: The engineers built a {gabionade} before the siege.
e.zh: 工程兵在围城前修建了石笼防御工事。

e.en: Floodwater broke through the old {gabionade}.
e.zh: 洪水冲破了旧的石笼防护墙。

e.en: The {gabioned} bank survived the flood.
e.zh: 用石笼加固的河岸经受住了洪水。

e.en: A {gabioned} wall protected the road below.
e.zh: 一道石笼加固墙保护着下方的道路。

e.en: A tiny {gablet} decorated the dormer window.
e.zh: 一面小山墙装饰着那扇老虎窗。

e.en: The chapel roof ends in a carved {gablet}.
e.zh: 小教堂屋顶尽头有一处雕刻的小三角墙。

gachupin.t: 西班牙本土移民；西班牙佬

e.en: The novel uses {gachupin} for a Spaniard in colonial Mexico.
e.zh: 这部小说用“西班牙佬”指殖民时期墨西哥的西班牙人。

e.en: He knew {gachupin} could sound insulting in that context.
e.zh: 他知道在那种语境里这个词可能带有侮辱意味。

gadabout.t: 游手好闲到处闲逛的人；社交游荡者

e.en: The retired actor became a cheerful {gadabout} in the village.
e.zh: 那位退休演员成了村里爱到处串门的快活闲人。

e.en: Her uncle was known as a {gadabout} who never stayed home.
e.zh: 她叔叔出了名地爱四处闲逛，从不安分待在家里。

gadarene.t: 盲目而急促的；失控冲向灾难的

e.en: The company made a {gadarene} rush into risky investments.
e.zh: 那家公司盲目而急促地冲进高风险投资。

e.en: His {gadarene} enthusiasm soon led the project into trouble.
e.zh: 他失控般的热情很快把项目带入麻烦。

e.en: A {gadbee} kept circling the horses in the field.
e.zh: 一只牛虻不停地围着田里的马打转。

e.en: The old farmer brushed away a biting {gadbee}.
e.zh: 老农赶走了一只叮人的牛虻。

gaddingly.t: 游荡地；轻浮地四处闲逛地

e.en: She moved {gaddingly} from party to party all summer.
e.zh: 整个夏天她轻浮地从一个聚会跑到另一个聚会。

e.en: He spent the afternoon {gaddingly} visiting every shop on the street.
e.zh: 他下午一路闲逛，把街上的店都逛了一遍。

gadgeteer.t: 小发明爱好者；鼓捣小器械的人

e.en: The young {gadgeteer} built a timer from spare parts.
e.zh: 那个年轻的小发明爱好者用零件做了个计时器。

e.en: Every office needs a {gadgeteer} who can fix odd devices.
e.zh: 每个办公室都需要一个会修各种小装置的人。

gadgeteering.t: 发明小器械；鼓捣小玩意儿

e.en: His weekend {gadgeteering} produced a clever door alarm.
e.zh: 他周末鼓捣小玩意儿，做出了一个巧妙的门警报器。

e.en: The course encourages practical {gadgeteering} with cheap materials.
e.zh: 这门课鼓励学生用廉价材料动手发明小器械。

gadgetize.t: 给……加装小装置；使器械化

e.en: The startup tried to {gadgetize} every ordinary kitchen tool.
e.zh: 这家初创公司试图给每件普通厨具都加上小装置。

e.en: Do not {gadgetize} the process when a simple form will work.
e.zh: 一个简单表格能解决时，就不要把流程搞得器械化。

gadgety.t: 小器械多的；像小玩意儿的

e.en: The camera felt too {gadgety} for serious field work.
e.zh: 这台相机小机关太多，不太适合严肃的野外工作。

e.en: He likes {gadgety} gifts with buttons and tiny screens.
e.zh: 他喜欢带按钮和小屏幕的那种小玩意儿礼物。

e.en: The biologist identified the fish as a {gadid}.
e.zh: 生物学家认出这条鱼属于鳕科鱼。

e.en: Several {gadid} species support cold-water fisheries.
e.zh: 几种鳕科鱼支撑着冷水海域的渔业。

gado-gado.t: 印尼花生酱拌蔬菜沙拉

e.en: We ordered {gado-gado} with extra peanut sauce.
e.zh: 我们点了印尼花生酱拌蔬菜沙拉，还多加了花生酱。

e.en: Her lunch was {gado-gado}, rice, and iced tea.
e.zh: 她的午餐是加多加多、米饭和冰茶。

e.en: The museum displayed a fossil {gadoid} from deep water.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一条来自深水环境的鳕形鱼化石。

e.en: A {gadoid} body shape helps the fish move efficiently near the seabed.
e.zh: 鳕鱼样的体形有助于这种鱼在海底附近高效游动。

e.en: The sample showed traces of {gadolinic} compounds.
e.zh: 样品中显示出微量含钆化合物。

e.en: Early chemists studied {gadolinic} minerals for rare elements.
e.zh: 早期化学家研究含钆矿物以寻找稀有元素。

e.en: The collector bought a dark piece of {gadolinite}.
e.zh: 收藏者买了一块深色的硅铍钇矿。

e.en: Rare earth elements were first isolated from {gadolinite}.
e.zh: 稀土元素最早是从钆石中分离出来的。

e.en: A silver {gadroon} ran around the edge of the bowl.
e.zh: 碗边绕着一圈银色凸槽装饰。

e.en: The craftsman chose to {gadroon} the frame by hand.
e.zh: 工匠选择手工给框架做凸槽装饰。

gadrooning.t: 凸槽纹饰；凸槽装饰工艺

e.en: The antique tray has fine {gadrooning} along the rim.
e.zh: 这只古董托盘边缘有精细的凸槽纹饰。

e.en: She learned {gadrooning} while restoring old silverware.
e.zh: 她在修复旧银器时学会了凸槽装饰工艺。

gadzookery.t: 故作古雅的措辞；仿古腔调

e.en: The novel's fake medieval dialogue sank into {gadzookery}.
e.zh: 这部小说假装中世纪口吻的对白滑成了故作古雅的腔调。

e.en: Editors removed the worst {gadzookery} from the historical script.
e.zh: 编辑删掉了历史剧本里最严重的仿古措辞。

e.en: In the song, the sailor will {gae} home at dawn.
e.zh: 歌里唱道，水手将在黎明回家去。

e.en: She told him to {gae} softly through the snow.
e.zh: 她叫他轻轻地穿过雪地走。

e.en: The crew raised the {gaff-topsail} before the wind freshened.
e.zh: 风力增强前，船员升起了斜桁中桅帆。

e.en: A torn {gaff-topsail} slowed the old schooner.
e.zh: 一面撕裂的斜桁上帆拖慢了那艘老纵帆船。

e.en: The boat carried a broad {gaffsail} on its main mast.
e.zh: 那条船的主桅上挂着一面宽大的斜桁帆。

e.en: They repaired the {gaffsail} after a hard race.
e.zh: 一场艰苦比赛后，他们修补了斜桁帆。

e.en: The trainer fitted a {gag-bit} for the strong horse.
e.zh: 驯马师给那匹力气大的马装上了制动马衔。

e.en: A {gag-bit} should be used only by skilled riders.
e.zh: 制动马衔只应由熟练骑手使用。

e.en: The ceremony opened with slow, solemn {gagaku}.
e.zh: 典礼以缓慢庄严的日本雅乐开场。

e.en: She studied {gagaku} instruments during her year in Kyoto.
e.zh: 她在京都那一年研究了日本雅乐乐器。

e.en: The old perfume contained {galbanum} for a green, resinous note.
e.zh: 这款老香水加入了格蓬香树脂，带来清绿的树脂气息。

e.en: Ancient recipes sometimes used {galbanum} as incense.
e.zh: 古代配方有时把格蓬香树脂用作熏香。

e.en: A juniper berry is technically a {galbulus}.
e.zh: 杜松子从技术上说是一种球果状果实。

e.en: The botanist described the small cone as a {galbulus}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这个小球果描述为球果状果实。

e.en: The ferry was cancelled because of {gale-force} winds.
e.zh: 由于出现烈风级大风，渡轮被取消了。

e.en: Rain hit the windows with {gale-force} intensity.
e.zh: 雨点以强风般的力度打在窗户上。

e.en: The flower has a curved {galea} above the opening.
e.zh: 这朵花在开口上方有一个弯曲的盔状结构。

e.en: A Roman soldier's {galea} protected his head in battle.
e.zh: 罗马士兵的头盔在战斗中保护他的头部。

e.en: The rare diagnosis of {galeamaurosis} appeared in an old medical text.
e.zh: 颅骨性黑蒙这个罕见诊断出现在一本旧医学书中。

e.en: Few modern doctors would use the term {galeamaurosis}.
e.zh: 如今很少有医生会使用颅骨性黑蒙这个术语。

e.en: The orchid has a {galeate} upper petal.
e.zh: 这株兰花有一片盔状的上花瓣。

e.en: A {galeate} figure stood carved above the gate.
e.zh: 门上方雕着一个戴盔的人像。

e.en: The bird's {galeated} head gives it a striking profile.
e.zh: 这只鸟戴盔般的头部让它轮廓很醒目。

e.en: The blossom is {galeated} and pale yellow.
e.zh: 这朵花呈盔状，颜色是淡黄色。

e.en: Researchers studied {galegine} because it lowers blood sugar.
e.zh: 研究人员研究山羊豆碱，因为它能降低血糖。

e.en: The plant contains {galegine} in small amounts.
e.zh: 这种植物含有少量山羊豆碱。

e.en: The shell has a {galeiform} curve near the top.
e.zh: 这个贝壳顶部附近有一处盔形弯曲。

e.en: Botanists call the petal {galeiform} because it resembles a helmet.
e.zh: 植物学家称这片花瓣为盔形，因为它像头盔。

e.en: The lecture covered {Galenic} ideas about the body.
e.zh: 这场讲座介绍了盖伦医学对人体的看法。

e.en: Pharmacists discussed the {galenic} form of the medicine.
e.zh: 药剂师讨论了这种药的制剂形式。

e.en: The pharmacy prepared a {galenical} from herbal extracts.
e.zh: 药房用草药提取物配制了一种药用制剂。

e.en: The book lists several {galenical} preparations.
e.zh: 这本书列出了几种盖伦式药物制剂。

e.en: The museum displayed a bright cube of {galenite}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一块明亮的立方体方铅矿。

e.en: Miners once extracted lead from {galenite}.
e.zh: 矿工过去曾从方铅矿中提取铅。

e.en: The specimen was identified as {galenobismutite} under the microscope.
e.zh: 这件标本在显微镜下被鉴定为铋方铅矿。

e.en: Collectors value {galenobismutite} because it is uncommon.
e.zh: 收藏者看重铋方铅矿，因为它并不常见。

e.en: The mineral showed a {galenoid} shine on its broken surface.
e.zh: 这种矿物的断面呈现出似方铅矿的光泽。

e.en: Geologists noted the {galenoid} texture of the sample.
e.zh: 地质学家注意到样品具有似方铅矿的质地。

e.en: The fossil was classified as a {galeoid} shark.
e.zh: 这块化石被归为鼬鲨类鲨鱼。

e.en: Its {galeoid} body shape suggests fast swimming.
e.zh: 它似鲨的体形表明它游动很快。

e.en: The cardinal's {galero} hung above his tomb.
e.zh: 红衣主教的宽檐帽悬挂在他的墓上方。

e.en: A red {galero} appears on the church coat of arms.
e.zh: 教会纹章上有一顶红色的主教宽檐帽。

e.en: The manuscript used {galery} where modern English writes gallery.
e.zh: 这份手稿用了galery这个旧拼法，现代英语写作gallery。

e.en: The old romance mentions a {galery} crossing the sea.
e.zh: 这部古老传奇提到一艘桨帆船横渡大海。

e.en: He stood {gainst} the wind on the hill.
e.zh: 他在山坡上迎风站着。

e.en: The old rule ran {gainst} common sense.
e.zh: 那条旧规矩与常识相抵触。

gairish.t: 略显俗艳的；花哨刺眼的

e.en: The room looked {gairish} in the afternoon light.
e.zh: 房间在午后光线下显得有些俗艳。

e.en: She disliked the {gairish} trim on the costume.
e.zh: 她不喜欢那套服装上花哨刺眼的镶边。

e.en: A musician played the {gaita} during the village procession.
e.zh: 游行队伍经过村子时，一名乐手吹奏着盖塔风笛。

e.en: The song begins with a bright {gaita} melody.
e.zh: 这首歌以一段明亮的盖塔风笛旋律开头。

e.en: The child would {gaize} at the stars for hours.
e.zh: 那个孩子会一连几个小时凝望星星。

e.en: Do not simply {gaize} when someone needs help.
e.zh: 有人需要帮助时，不要只是呆呆地看着。

e.en: He wore a white {galabia} in the summer heat.
e.zh: 盛夏酷热中，他穿着一件白色的加拉比亚长袍。

e.en: The tailor repaired the old {galabia} before the festival.
e.zh: 节日前，裁缝修补了那件旧加拉比亚长袍。

e.en: The cotton {galabieh} kept him cool in Cairo.
e.zh: 那件棉质加拉比亚长袍让他在开罗保持凉爽。

e.en: She folded the embroidered {galabieh} with care.
e.zh: 她小心地折好那件刺绣的加拉比亚长袍。

e.en: A blue {galabiya} hung beside the market stall.
e.zh: 市场摊位旁挂着一件蓝色加拉比亚长袍。

e.en: He changed into a loose {galabiya} after work.
e.zh: 下班后，他换上了一件宽松的加拉比亚长袍。

galactagogue.t: 促进乳汁分泌的药物或食物

e.en: Fenugreek is sometimes used as a {galactagogue}.
e.zh: 胡芦巴有时被用作促进乳汁分泌的食物。

e.en: The doctor warned that no {galactagogue} works for everyone.
e.zh: 医生提醒说，没有哪种催乳剂对所有人都有效。

e.en: The seaweed extract contains a soluble {galactan}.
e.zh: 这种海藻提取物含有一种可溶性半乳聚糖。

e.en: Researchers measured {galactan} levels in the plant cell walls.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了植物细胞壁中的半乳聚糖含量。

galactin.t: 半乳糖相关蛋白；凝集素

e.en: The paper described a {galactin} found in animal tissue.
e.zh: 论文描述了一种在动物组织中发现的半乳糖相关蛋白。

e.en: They tested whether {galactin} could bind to the sugar molecule.
e.zh: 他们测试这种凝集素能否与该糖分子结合。

e.en: Excess {galactitol} can accumulate in certain metabolic disorders.
e.zh: 在某些代谢疾病中，过量半乳糖醇可能会积累。

e.en: The lab identified {galactitol} in the urine sample.
e.zh: 实验室在尿样中检出了半乳糖醇。

galactoannan.t: 半乳甘露聚糖，植物多糖

e.en: The gum contains {galactoannan}, which thickens the sauce.
e.zh: 这种胶含有半乳甘露聚糖，能让酱汁变稠。

e.en: Scientists studied {galactoannan} from several seed extracts.
e.zh: 科学家研究了几种种子提取物中的半乳甘露聚糖。

galactoglucomannan.t: 半乳葡甘露聚糖，木材多糖

e.en: Softwood hemicellulose often includes {galactoglucomannan}.
e.zh: 软木的半纤维素中常含有半乳葡甘露聚糖。

e.en: The team extracted {galactoglucomannan} for use in films.
e.zh: 团队提取了半乳葡甘露聚糖，用于制作薄膜。

galactogogue.t: 促进乳汁分泌的药物或食物

e.en: The nurse discussed safe use of a {galactogogue}.
e.zh: 护士讲解了催乳剂的安全使用方法。

e.en: Oats are promoted as a mild {galactogogue} by some parents.
e.zh: 一些父母认为燕麦是一种温和的催乳食物。

e.en: The sample formed a pale {galactoid} liquid.
e.zh: 样品形成了一种淡色的乳状液体。

e.en: A {galactoid} appearance can indicate suspended particles.
e.zh: 呈乳状外观可能说明其中有悬浮颗粒。

e.en: A defect in {galactokinase} can affect sugar metabolism.
e.zh: 半乳糖激酶缺陷会影响糖代谢。

e.en: The assay measures {galactokinase} activity in blood cells.
e.zh: 该检测会测量血细胞中的半乳糖激酶活性。

galactolipid.t: 半乳糖脂，含半乳糖的脂质

e.en: Chloroplast membranes are rich in {galactolipid}.
e.zh: 叶绿体膜富含半乳糖脂。

e.en: The study traced {galactolipid} synthesis in young leaves.
e.zh: 这项研究追踪了嫩叶中的半乳糖脂合成。

e.en: The dairy used a {galactometer} to check milk density.
e.zh: 乳品厂用乳比重计检查牛奶密度。

e.en: A cracked {galactometer} gave unreliable readings.
e.zh: 破裂的乳比重计给出了不可靠的读数。

e.en: The surgeon located the affected {galactophore} during the exam.
e.zh: 外科医生在检查中找到了受影响的输乳管。

e.en: Inflammation may block a {galactophore} and cause pain.
e.zh: 炎症可能堵塞输乳管并引起疼痛。

e.en: The diagram labels the {galactophorous} ducts of the breast.
e.zh: 图中标出了乳房的输乳管。

e.en: Swelling appeared around the {galactophorous} tissue.
e.zh: 肿胀出现在泌乳组织周围。

e.en: The physician prescribed a {galactophyga} after weaning.
e.zh: 断奶后，医生开了一种抑制乳汁分泌的药物。

e.en: Patients should not take a {galactophyga} without advice.
e.zh: 患者不应在没有医嘱的情况下服用退乳药。

e.en: Hormones regulate {galactopoiesis} after childbirth.
e.zh: 分娩后，激素会调节乳汁生成过程。

e.en: Poor nutrition can interfere with normal {galactopoiesis}.
e.zh: 营养不良可能干扰正常泌乳。

galactopoietic.t: 促进乳汁生成的；泌乳相关的

e.en: The herb was studied for possible {galactopoietic} effects.
e.zh: 研究人员考察了这种草药可能的促泌乳作用。

e.en: Prolactin has an important {galactopoietic} role.
e.zh: 催乳素具有重要的促进乳汁生成作用。

e.en: The chemist identified {galactopyranose} in the sample.
e.zh: 化学家在样品中鉴定出了半乳吡喃糖。

e.en: A {galactopyranose} ring appears in many carbohydrate structures.
e.zh: 许多碳水化合物结构中都有半乳吡喃糖环。

e.en: The assay measured {galactosamine} in the tissue extract.
e.zh: 这项检测测量了组织提取物中的半乳糖胺。

e.en: Researchers linked {galactosamine} to changes in liver metabolism.
e.zh: 研究人员把半乳糖胺与肝脏代谢变化联系起来。

e.en: The seaweed contains a natural {galactosan}.
e.zh: 这种海藻含有一种天然半乳聚糖。

e.en: Heating changed the viscosity of the {galactosan} solution.
e.zh: 加热改变了半乳聚糖溶液的黏度。

e.en: The old dairy manual described a {galactoscope}.
e.zh: 那本旧乳品手册介绍了一种乳汁检测镜。

e.en: A {galactoscope} helped estimate the richness of milk.
e.zh: 乳汁检测镜可用来估计牛奶的浓度。

e.en: Milk sugar breaks down into glucose and {galactose}.
e.zh: 乳糖会分解成葡萄糖和半乳糖。

e.en: The baby could not process {galactose} properly.
e.zh: 这个婴儿无法正常代谢半乳糖。

e.en: The doctor treated a {galactosemic} infant.
e.zh: 医生治疗了一名患半乳糖血症的婴儿。

e.en: A {galactosemic} patient must avoid certain milk products.
e.zh: 半乳糖血症患者必须避免某些乳制品。

e.en: The bacteria produce {galactosidase} during fermentation.
e.zh: 这些细菌在发酵过程中会产生半乳糖苷酶。

e.en: Low {galactosidase} activity affected the test result.
e.zh: 半乳糖苷酶活性偏低影响了检测结果。

e.en: The textbook used {galactosis} to describe milk secretion.
e.zh: 教材用galactosis一词来描述乳汁分泌。

e.en: Some older papers mention {galactosis} in metabolic disorders.
e.zh: 一些旧论文在代谢紊乱中提到半乳糖病。

e.en: The nerve membrane contained a complex {galactosphingolipid}.
e.zh: 神经膜中含有一种复杂的半乳糖鞘脂。

e.en: Scientists analyzed {galactosphingolipid} levels in brain tissue.
e.zh: 科学家分析了脑组织中的半乳糖鞘脂水平。

e.en: The enzyme transfers a {galactosyl} group to the molecule.
e.zh: 这种酶把一个半乳糖基转移到该分子上。

e.en: Several {galactosyl} residues were found on the protein.
e.zh: 该蛋白上发现了几个半乳糖基残基。

e.en: Lactose is a common form of {galactosylglucose}.
e.zh: 乳糖是半乳糖基葡萄糖的一种常见形式。

e.en: The lab synthesized {galactosylglucose} for the experiment.
e.zh: 实验室为这项实验合成了半乳糖基葡萄糖。

e.en: The disorder involved abnormal {galactosylsphingenine} accumulation.
e.zh: 这种疾病涉及半乳糖基鞘氨醇异常积累。

e.en: Researchers measured {galactosylsphingenine} in the patient's cells.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了患者细胞中的半乳糖基鞘氨醇。

e.en: A {galago} leaped between the branches at night.
e.zh: 一只丛猴夜里在树枝间跳跃。

e.en: The keeper fed the young {galago} after sunset.
e.zh: 饲养员在日落后喂了那只小婴猴。

e.en: Several {galagos} called from the dark trees.
e.zh: 几只丛猴在昏暗的树上叫着。

e.en: The sanctuary protects injured {galagos} from local forests.
e.zh: 保护中心救护来自当地森林的受伤婴猴。

e.en: A pink {galah} perched on the fence.
e.zh: 一只粉红凤头鹦鹉停在篱笆上。

e.en: Don't act like a {galah} in the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时别像个傻瓜一样。

e.en: The soup was flavored with fresh {galangal}.
e.zh: 这道汤用了新鲜南姜调味。

e.en: Slice the {galangal} thinly before adding it.
e.zh: 加入前先把高良姜切成薄片。

e.en: The sonata has a light {galant} style.
e.zh: 这首奏鸣曲带有轻快的galant风格。

e.en: Composers used {galant} phrases to sound elegant.
e.zh: 作曲家用galant式乐句来显得优雅。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {galanthamine} for memory symptoms.
e.zh: 医生为记忆症状开了加兰他敏。

e.en: {Galanthamine} can affect certain nerve signals in the brain.
e.zh: 加兰他敏会影响大脑中的某些神经信号。

e.en: The chef served chicken {galantine} with pickles.
e.zh: 厨师端上了配泡菜的鸡肉冷肉冻卷。

e.en: A traditional {galantine} is cooked, pressed, and chilled.
e.zh: 传统冷肉冻卷要煮熟、压制定型后冷藏。

e.en: The village fair advertised a {galanty} performance.
e.zh: 村里的集市宣传了一场皮影戏表演。

e.en: Children watched the {galanty} shadows move across the screen.
e.zh: 孩子们看着皮影戏影子在幕布上移动。

e.en: They staged a {galantyshow} in the old hall.
e.zh: 他们在旧大厅里上演了一场皮影戏。

e.en: The {galantyshow} used lamps and cut figures.
e.zh: 这场皮影戏使用灯光和剪制人物。

e.en: The recipe called for {galatine} to set the jelly.
e.zh: 这份食谱需要用明胶让果冻凝固。

e.en: Old cookbooks sometimes spell gelatin as {galatine}.
e.zh: 旧食谱有时把gelatin拼作galatine。

e.en: They planned to {galavant} around Europe all summer.
e.zh: 他们计划整个夏天在欧洲到处游玩。

e.en: Stop {galavanting} and finish your work.
e.zh: 别到处闲逛了，把你的工作做完。

e.en: Florists use {galax} leaves in simple bouquets.
e.zh: 花艺师会在简单花束中使用加莱克斯叶。

e.en: The shaded slope was covered with {galax}.
e.zh: 阴凉的坡地上长满了加莱克斯草。

galimatias.t: 胡言乱语；乱七八糟的话

e.en: The report was full of {galimatias} and empty claims.
e.zh: 这份报告满是胡言乱语和空洞的说法。

e.en: He dismissed the speech as political {galimatias}.
e.zh: 他把那场演讲斥为政治上的乱七八糟之词。

e.en: The cook flavored the broth with dried {galingale}.
e.zh: 厨师用干高良姜给汤调味。

e.en: Medieval recipes often mention {galingale} among the spices.
e.zh: 中世纪食谱常把高良姜列在香料之中。

e.en: A narrow {galiot} moved slowly along the coast.
e.zh: 一艘狭窄的小型桨帆船沿着海岸缓缓前行。

e.en: The museum displays a model of an old Dutch {galiot}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一艘古荷兰小帆船的模型。

e.en: The chemist isolated {galipoidine} from the resin sample.
e.zh: 化学家从树脂样品中分离出松脂碱样物质。

e.en: Old pharmaceutical texts list {galipoidine} as a resin derivative.
e.zh: 旧药学文献把松脂碱样物质列为树脂衍生物。

e.en: The barrel contained sticky {galipot} from pine trees.
e.zh: 桶里装着来自松树的黏稠粗松脂。

e.en: Workers heated the {galipot} before refining it.
e.zh: 工人在精炼前先加热粗松脂。

e.en: The scan showed a small {gall-stone} near the duct.
e.zh: 扫描显示胆管附近有一颗小胆结石。

e.en: Severe pain after meals can be caused by a {gall-stone}.
e.zh: 饭后剧痛可能是胆结石引起的。

e.en: The laboratory ordered {gallacetophenone} for the dye experiment.
e.zh: 实验室为染料实验订购了没食子酰苯乙酮。

e.en: Older chemistry manuals describe {gallacetophenone} in technical detail.
e.zh: 较早的化学手册详细描述了没食子酰苯乙酮。

e.en: The formula included {gallal} as a medicinal ingredient.
e.zh: 这个配方把没食子酸铝盐列为药用成分。

e.en: Pharmacists once used {gallal} in topical preparations.
e.zh: 药剂师曾在外用制剂中使用没食子酸铝盐。

e.en: The reaction produced a small amount of {gallamide}.
e.zh: 这次反应生成了少量没食子酰胺。

e.en: The paper compares {gallamide} with related phenolic compounds.
e.zh: 论文将没食子酰胺与相关酚类化合物作比较。

e.en: The sample of {gallanilide} was stored in a brown bottle.
e.zh: 没食子酰苯胺样品被存放在棕色瓶中。

e.en: Few modern students encounter {gallanilide} outside specialist chemistry.
e.zh: 现代学生很少在专业化学之外遇到没食子酰苯胺这个词。

e.en: The assay detected traces of {gallanol} in the solution.
e.zh: 检测在溶液中发现了微量没食子醇类化合物。

e.en: The old patent mentions {gallanol} as an antiseptic compound.
e.zh: 那份旧专利把没食子醇类化合物称为一种防腐化合物。

gallate.t: 没食子酸盐；没食子酸酯

e.en: Propyl {gallate} is used as an antioxidant in some foods.
e.zh: 没食子酸丙酯在一些食品中用作抗氧化剂。

e.en: The chemist measured the {gallate} concentration in the extract.
e.zh: 化学家测量了提取物中的没食子酸盐浓度。

e.en: Bees gathered nectar from the blooming {gallberry}.
e.zh: 蜜蜂从开花的冬青属灌木上采集花蜜。

e.en: The trail was lined with {gallberry} and pine scrub.
e.zh: 小路两旁长着冬青属灌木和松树灌丛。

e.en: The Venetian {galleass} carried both sails and heavy guns.
e.zh: 威尼斯大型桨帆战船既有帆，也装有重炮。

e.en: A restored {galleass} appears in the naval history exhibit.
e.zh: 海军史展览中有一艘修复的大型桨帆战船。

e.en: The fabric was stained with {gallein} during the test.
e.zh: 测试中织物被棓因这种红色染料染上了色。

e.en: Chemists studied {gallein} because of its vivid color reaction.
e.zh: 化学家研究棓因，是因为它有鲜明的显色反应。

galleryful.t: 满满一画廊的；满座观众

e.en: A {galleryful} of visitors waited for the exhibition to open.
e.zh: 满满一画廊的参观者等着展览开门。

e.en: The comedian faced a {galleryful} of restless spectators.
e.zh: 喜剧演员面对着一整厅坐不住的观众。

e.en: Every {gallerygoer} stopped before the large blue canvas.
e.zh: 每位画廊参观者都在那幅蓝色大画布前停下。

e.en: A regular {gallerygoer} may notice changes in the curator's taste.
e.zh: 常去画廊的人可能会注意到策展人口味的变化。

e.en: The critic wrote like a seasoned {galleryite}.
e.zh: 那位评论家写得像个经验老到的常逛画廊者。

e.en: A noisy {galleryite} shouted down to the stage.
e.zh: 楼座上一名吵闹的观众朝舞台喊话。

e.en: The mason pressed a {gallet} into the wet mortar.
e.zh: 石匠把一片填缝小石片压进湿灰浆里。

e.en: Old walls often contain a {gallet} between larger stones.
e.zh: 老墙的大石块之间常夹着填缝小石片。

e.en: The old sailors called the ship's kitchen a {galleting} in their log.
e.zh: 老水手在航海日志里把船上的厨房称作galleting。

e.en: A narrow {galleting} moved quietly along the canal.
e.zh: 一只狭长的小船沿着运河静静前行。

e.en: The storm knocked the garden {galley-west} overnight.
e.zh: 暴风雨一夜之间把花园弄得一片狼藉。

e.en: One bad decision sent the whole plan {galley-west}.
e.zh: 一个错误决定就让整个计划彻底泡汤。

e.en: A {galleyworm} curled under the damp stone.
e.zh: 一只马陆蜷缩在潮湿的石头下面。

e.en: The child mistook the {galleyworm} for a tiny snake.
e.zh: 孩子把那只千足虫误认为一条小蛇。

e.en: The oak leaves were damaged by {gallflies} in early summer.
e.zh: 初夏时橡树叶受到瘿蝇侵害。

e.en: Several {gallflies} emerged from the swollen plant tissue.
e.zh: 几只瘿蜂从肿胀的植物组织里钻了出来。

e.en: A {gallfly} lays its eggs inside tender plant tissue.
e.zh: 瘿蝇会把卵产在柔嫩的植物组织里。

e.en: The round swelling on the stem was caused by a {gallfly}.
e.zh: 茎上的圆形肿块是由瘿蜂造成的。

e.en: The scholar identified a {galliambic} rhythm in the ancient hymn.
e.zh: 学者在那首古代颂歌中辨认出加利安比格诗律。

e.en: Her paper compares {galliambic} verse with ordinary iambic lines.
e.zh: 她的论文比较加利安比格诗行和普通抑扬格诗行。

e.en: The court musicians played a lively {galliard}.
e.zh: 宫廷乐师演奏了一支轻快的加利亚德舞曲。

e.en: He answered with a {galliard} confidence that amused the crowd.
e.zh: 他以一种活泼自信的样子回答，引得众人发笑。

e.en: Her {galliardise} made the formal dance feel playful.
e.zh: 她欢快的舞姿让正式舞会显得活泼起来。

e.en: The memoir describes his youthful {galliardise} with gentle irony.
e.zh: 回忆录用温和的讽刺描写了他年轻时的轻快做派。

e.en: The Venetian {galliass} carried both sails and heavy guns.
e.zh: 威尼斯的大型划帆战船既有帆，也装有重炮。

e.en: A damaged {galliass} drifted toward the harbor after the battle.
e.zh: 战后一艘受损的大型划帆战船漂向港口。

e.en: The phrase was written {gallice} in the margin.
e.zh: 这个短语用法语写在页边。

e.en: He pronounced the family name {gallice}, not in the local style.
e.zh: 他按法国方式读这个姓氏，而不是按当地读法。

e.en: The chemist tested {gallicin} as a dye component.
e.zh: 化学家测试了没食子素作为染料成分的效果。

e.en: Old manuals mention {gallicin} in recipes for dark stains.
e.zh: 旧手册在深色染料配方中提到没食子素。

e.en: The editor removed a clear {gallicism} from the translation.
e.zh: 编辑从译文中删掉了一个明显的法语式表达。

e.en: His prose keeps a faint {gallicism} in its sentence order.
e.zh: 他的散文在语序上保留着淡淡的法国风格。

e.en: The town's records show the gradual {gallicization} of local surnames.
e.zh: 镇上的记录显示当地姓氏逐渐法语化。

e.en: Cultural {gallicization} changed the court's manners and vocabulary.
e.zh: 文化上的法国化改变了宫廷礼仪和词汇。

e.en: The clerk tried to {gallicize} every foreign surname.
e.zh: 办事员试图把每个外国姓氏都法语化。

e.en: Writers sometimes {gallicize} English phrases for comic effect.
e.zh: 作家有时把英语短语写得像法语，以制造喜剧效果。

gallicized.t: 已法国化的；已法语化的

e.en: The village used a {gallicized} version of its old name.
e.zh: 这个村庄使用了旧名称的法语化形式。

e.en: His manners seemed thoroughly {gallicized} after years in Paris.
e.zh: 在巴黎多年后，他的举止显得完全法国化了。

e.en: The administration was {gallicizing} place names across the region.
e.zh: 政府当时正在把该地区的地名法语化。

e.en: Her translator avoided {gallicizing} the dialogue too heavily.
e.zh: 她的译者避免把对话处理得过于法国化。

e.en: The sudden shout left the horse {gallied}.
e.zh: 突如其来的喊声把那匹马吓坏了。

e.en: He looked {gallied} by the endless questions.
e.zh: 没完没了的问题让他显得十分烦扰。

e.en: The actor wore striped {galligaskins} for the comic role.
e.zh: 演员为这个喜剧角色穿上了条纹灯笼裤。

e.en: His old {galligaskins} looked absurd beside modern trousers.
e.zh: 他的旧式宽松短裤放在现代长裤旁显得很滑稽。

e.en: The shelves held {gallimaufries} of tools, toys, and papers.
e.zh: 架子上堆着工具、玩具和文件等各种杂物。

e.en: Her essays became {gallimaufries} of gossip and philosophy.
e.zh: 她的文章成了闲话和哲思混在一起的大杂烩。

e.en: The report was a {gallimaufry} of statistics and anecdotes.
e.zh: 这份报告是统计数据和轶事混成的大杂烩。

e.en: Dinner turned into a cheerful {gallimaufry} of leftovers.
e.zh: 晚餐变成了一顿用剩菜拼成的欢乐杂烩。

e.en: The paper described a {gallin} protein found in egg white.
e.zh: 论文描述了蛋清中发现的一种鸡血蛋白。

e.en: The keeper separated the {gallin} birds from the ducks.
e.zh: 饲养员把鸡类禽鸟和鸭子分开。

e.en: The farm kept several {gallinacean} birds near the orchard.
e.zh: 农场在果园旁养了几种鸡形目鸟类。

e.en: A pheasant is a familiar {gallinacean} species.
e.zh: 雉鸡是一种常见的鸡形目鸟类。

e.en: The bird had a heavy, {gallinaceous} body.
e.zh: 那只鸟身形厚重，像鸡一样。

e.en: Quails belong to the {gallinaceous} group of birds.
e.zh: 鹌鹑属于鸡形目这一类鸟。

e.en: A {gallinipper} bit his ankle at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时一只大蚊子叮了他的脚踝。

e.en: Locals used {gallinipper} for any unusually large mosquito.
e.zh: 当地人把特别大的蚊子都叫作gallinipper。

e.en: The chemist tested {gallinol} in a small sample.
e.zh: 化学师在一份小样中测试了没食子酚。

e.en: Old dye formulas sometimes mentioned {gallinol}.
e.zh: 旧染料配方有时会提到没食子酚。

e.en: A {gallinule} walked across the reeds.
e.zh: 一只水鸡穿过芦苇丛。

e.en: The purple {gallinule} flashed bright colors in the marsh.
e.zh: 紫水鸡在沼泽中显出鲜亮的颜色。

e.en: The old {galliot} carried cargo along the coast.
e.zh: 那艘旧小帆船沿海运送货物。

e.en: Sailors rowed the {galliot} into the narrow harbor.
e.zh: 水手们把那艘划桨船划进狭窄的港口。

e.en: The apothecary filled a {gallipot} with ointment.
e.zh: 药剂师把药膏装进一个小药罐。

e.en: A cracked {gallipot} sat on the museum shelf.
e.zh: 博物馆架子上放着一个裂了的药剂罐。

e.en: Some vintners would {gallisize} weak wine after a poor harvest.
e.zh: 收成不好后，有些酒商会给淡酒加糖水增量。

e.en: The law restricted attempts to {gallisize} commercial wine.
e.zh: 法律限制对商品酒进行加糖水增量的做法。

e.en: The {gallivorous} larvae fed inside the oak swelling.
e.zh: 这些食虫瘿幼虫在橡树瘿内取食。

e.en: Researchers studied a {gallivorous} insect population.
e.zh: 研究人员考察了一种食虫瘿昆虫种群。

e.en: The {galliwasp} hid beneath a warm stone.
e.zh: 那只加勒比蜥蜴躲在温热的石头下。

e.en: Islanders once feared the bite of a {galliwasp}.
e.zh: 岛民过去曾害怕蛇蜥的咬伤。

e.en: The handbook explained {gallization} for acidic wines.
e.zh: 手册解释了酸味葡萄酒的加糖水增量法。

e.en: Critics said {gallization} could mask poor grapes.
e.zh: 批评者说这种加糖水增量法会掩盖葡萄品质差的问题。

e.en: They planned to {gallize} the thin vintage.
e.zh: 他们打算给这批寡淡的葡萄酒加糖水。

e.en: Regulations define when producers may {gallize} wine.
e.zh: 法规规定生产者何时可以给葡萄酒加糖水。

e.en: The collection included a tiny piece of {gallizinite}.
e.zh: 这批藏品中有一小块稀有矿物gallizinite。

e.en: Few students had ever heard of {gallizinite}.
e.zh: 很少有学生听说过gallizinite这种矿物。

e.en: The ink was made from crushed {gallnut}.
e.zh: 这种墨水是用压碎的没食子制成的。

e.en: A {gallnut} forms when insects irritate the oak tissue.
e.zh: 昆虫刺激橡树组织时会形成虫瘿。

e.en: The museum displayed a {Gallo-Roman} mosaic.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一幅高卢罗马时期的马赛克。

e.en: Archaeologists found {Gallo-Roman} baths under the town.
e.zh: 考古学家在城镇地下发现了高卢罗马浴场。

e.en: French belongs to the {Gallo-Romance} branch.
e.zh: 法语属于高卢罗曼语支。

e.en: The paper compared several {Gallo-Romance} dialects.
e.zh: 论文比较了几种高卢罗曼方言。

e.en: The old pharmacy text listed {gallobromol} as a sedative.
e.zh: 那本旧药学书把没食子溴酚列为镇静剂。

e.en: Modern doctors rarely prescribe {gallobromol}.
e.zh: 现代医生很少开没食子溴酚。

e.en: The lab used {gallocyanin} to stain the tissue sample.
e.zh: 实验室用没食子蓝给组织样本染色。

e.en: A bottle of {gallocyanin} stood beside the microscope.
e.zh: 一瓶没食子蓝放在显微镜旁。

e.en: The researchers measured how {galloflavin} affected the enzyme.
e.zh: 研究人员测量没食子黄素对该酶的影响。

e.en: A paper described {galloflavin} as a metabolic inhibitor.
e.zh: 一篇论文把没食子黄素描述为代谢抑制剂。

e.en: The formula contained a small amount of {galloformin}.
e.zh: 这个配方含有少量没食子福尔明。

e.en: Old chemical catalogs sometimes included {galloformin}.
e.zh: 旧化学品目录有时会收录没食子福尔明。

e.en: A {galloglass} fought with a heavy axe.
e.zh: 一名爱尔兰重装雇佣兵手持重斧作战。

e.en: The lord hired {galloglass} soldiers from the islands.
e.zh: 那位领主从群岛雇用了爱尔兰重装兵。

e.en: The report listed the tank's total {gallonage}.
e.zh: 报告列出了油罐的总加仑容量。

e.en: Fuel taxes were calculated by {gallonage}.
e.zh: 燃油税按加仑数计算。

e.en: The uniform was trimmed with gold {galloon}.
e.zh: 制服上镶着金色金银线饰带。

e.en: She repaired the old curtain's faded {galloon}.
e.zh: 她修补了旧窗帘上褪色的饰带。

e.en: He wore a {gallooned} coat at the ceremony.
e.zh: 他在典礼上穿着一件饰有金银线带的外套。

e.en: The hat was heavily {gallooned} and embroidered.
e.zh: 那顶帽子缀满饰带，并绣有花纹。

e.en: That clumsy {galloot} spilled tea on the map.
e.zh: 那个笨家伙把茶洒在地图上。

e.en: He called the rude guard a {galloot}.
e.zh: 他把那个粗鲁的卫兵叫作莽汉。

e.en: The orchestra began a lively {gallopade} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐后，乐队奏起了一支欢快的加洛帕德快舞。

e.en: They ended the ball with a noisy {gallopade}.
e.zh: 他们用一场热闹的加洛帕德快舞结束了舞会。

e.en: The guests {gallopaded} across the polished floor.
e.zh: 宾客们在光亮的地板上跳起了加洛帕德快舞。

e.en: They {gallopaded} until the candles burned low.
e.zh: 他们一直跳加洛帕德快舞，直到蜡烛快燃尽。

e.en: Several couples were {gallopading} through the hall.
e.zh: 几对舞伴正在大厅里跳加洛帕德快舞。

e.en: She remembered {gallopading} at old village festivals.
e.zh: 她记得自己曾在旧时的乡村节庆上跳加洛帕德快舞。

e.en: Oak galls contain much {gallotannin}.
e.zh: 橡树虫瘿中含有大量没食子鞣酸。

e.en: The chemist isolated {gallotannin} from plant material.
e.zh: 化学家从植物材料中分离出没食子鞣酸。

e.en: The paper described a rare {gallous} compound.
e.zh: 论文描述了一种罕见的亚镓化合物。

e.en: A {gallous} salt formed during the reaction.
e.zh: 反应过程中生成了一种低价镓盐。

e.en: The sudden cry did {gallow} the horses.
e.zh: 那声突如其来的喊叫确实惊吓了马群。

e.en: Old tales could {gallow} a child at night.
e.zh: 古老的故事夜里会把孩子吓住。

gallowglass.t: 中世纪爱尔兰重装雇佣兵

e.en: The chief hired a {gallowglass} for protection.
e.zh: 那位首领雇了一名爱尔兰重装雇佣兵来保护自己。

e.en: A {gallowglass} often carried a heavy axe.
e.zh: 爱尔兰重装雇佣兵常携带沉重的战斧。

gallows-ripe.t: 该上绞架的；罪大恶极的

e.en: The judge called him a {gallows-ripe} villain.
e.zh: 法官称他是个罪大恶极、该上绞架的恶棍。

e.en: That {gallows-ripe} thief laughed at every warning.
e.zh: 那个该上绞架的小偷对所有警告都一笑置之。

e.en: The sample showed traces of {galloxanthin}.
e.zh: 样品中显示出少量没食子黄素。

e.en: Researchers measured {galloxanthin} in the extract.
e.zh: 研究人员测定了提取物中的没食子黄素含量。

e.en: The molecule contains one {galloyl} group.
e.zh: 该分子含有一个没食子酰基。

e.en: Scientists compared several {galloyl} derivatives.
e.zh: 科学家比较了几种没食子酰基衍生物。

e.en: One {gallus} slipped from his shoulder.
e.zh: 一根吊裤带从他的肩上滑了下来。

e.en: He wore old trousers held by {galluses}.
e.zh: 他穿着一条用背带吊着的旧裤子。

e.en: The farmer wore {gallused} trousers to work.
e.zh: 农夫穿着用背带吊着的裤子去干活。

e.en: A {gallused} old man stood by the gate.
e.zh: 一位穿着背带裤的老人站在门旁。

e.en: His {galluses} snapped during the dance.
e.zh: 跳舞时他的吊裤带啪的一声断了。

e.en: Grandpa preferred {galluses} to a belt.
e.zh: 爷爷更喜欢用背带，而不是皮带。

e.en: The actor wore striped {gallygaskins} on stage.
e.zh: 演员在台上穿着条纹旧式宽松短裤。

e.en: His {gallygaskins} looked absurdly large.
e.zh: 他的旧式马裤看起来大得滑稽。

e.en: Miners once sold {galmey} to brass makers.
e.zh: 矿工过去把菱锌矿卖给黄铜制造商。

e.en: The old text mentions {galmey} as calamine ore.
e.zh: 那本旧书把galmey称作炉甘石矿。

e.en: She left one muddy {galoche} by the door.
e.zh: 她把一只沾满泥的套鞋留在门边。

e.en: The cobbler repaired a cracked {galoche}.
e.zh: 鞋匠修好了一只裂开的木底鞋。

e.en: Move aside, you clumsy {galoot}.
e.zh: 让开，你这个笨手笨脚的家伙。

e.en: The big {galoot} meant no harm.
e.zh: 那个大块头笨汉并没有恶意。

e.en: The band played a brisk {galop}.
e.zh: 乐队演奏了一支轻快的加洛普快舞曲。

e.en: They danced the {galop} after midnight.
e.zh: 午夜之后，他们跳起了加洛普快舞。

e.en: The program listed three lively {galops}.
e.zh: 节目单上列着三支活泼的加洛普快舞曲。

e.en: Old ballroom manuals describe several {galops}.
e.zh: 旧式舞厅手册介绍了好几种加洛普快舞。

e.en: The case was covered in pale {galuchat}.
e.zh: 盒子外面包着浅色的鲨鱼皮革。

e.en: Collectors prize antique boxes made with {galuchat}.
e.zh: 收藏家珍视用鳐鱼皮革制成的古董盒。

e.en: The device produced a small {galvanical} shock.
e.zh: 这个装置产生了一次轻微的电流刺激。

e.en: Early doctors tried {galvanical} treatment on patients.
e.zh: 早期医生曾对病人尝试伽伐尼电疗法。

galvanically.t: 以电流方式；用伽伐尼电

e.en: The metal was protected {galvanically} from corrosion.
e.zh: 这种金属通过电化学方式受到防腐保护。

e.en: The nerves were stimulated {galvanically} in the experiment.
e.zh: 实验中，神经受到伽伐尼电刺激。

e.en: Early doctors used {galvanism} to stimulate muscles.
e.zh: 早期医生用流电疗法刺激肌肉。

e.en: The lecture described {galvanism} in old batteries.
e.zh: 讲座介绍了旧式电池中的流电现象。

e.en: The {galvanist} adjusted the current carefully.
e.zh: 那位电疗师小心调节电流。

e.en: A nineteenth-century {galvanist} demonstrated muscle movement.
e.zh: 一位十九世纪的流电学研究者演示了肌肉运动。

e.en: The paper discussed {galvanistical} experiments on nerves.
e.zh: 论文讨论了针对神经的流电实验。

e.en: He collected old {galvanistical} instruments.
e.zh: 他收藏旧式流电仪器。

e.en: The factory uses {galvannealing} for automotive steel.
e.zh: 工厂用镀锌退火处理汽车钢板。

e.en: {Galvannealing} improves paint adhesion on sheet metal.
e.zh: 镀锌退火能提高金属板的油漆附着力。

e.en: The surgeon performed {galvanocauterization} to stop bleeding.
e.zh: 外科医生实施电灼术来止血。

e.en: Older texts describe {galvanocauterization} for nasal lesions.
e.zh: 旧医学文献记载用电灼术处理鼻部病灶。

e.en: The clinic kept a {galvanocautery} for minor procedures.
e.zh: 诊所备有电灼器用于小手术。

e.en: {Galvanocautery} sealed the small blood vessel quickly.
e.zh: 电灼术迅速封闭了那条小血管。

e.en: The museum displayed a rare {galvanograph}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件罕见的电版印刷品。

e.en: An old {galvanograph} preserved the artist's fine lines.
e.zh: 一块旧电镀版保留了画家的细腻线条。

e.en: {Galvanography} allowed printers to copy engraved plates.
e.zh: 电版术让印刷工能够复制雕版。

e.en: She researched {galvanography} in Victorian publishing.
e.zh: 她研究维多利亚时代出版业中的电镀制版。

e.en: The crystal showed {galvanoluminescence} under a weak current.
e.zh: 这块晶体在弱电流下出现电流致发光。

e.en: Researchers measured {galvanoluminescence} in the new material.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了新材料的电流致发光现象。

e.en: The team studied {galvanomagnetic} effects in semiconductors.
e.zh: 团队研究半导体中的电流磁效应。

e.en: A {galvanomagnetic} sensor can detect tiny field changes.
e.zh: 电流磁效应传感器能检测微小磁场变化。

e.en: The needle of the {galvanometer} moved slightly.
e.zh: 检流计的指针轻微移动。

e.en: Students used a {galvanometer} to detect weak currents.
e.zh: 学生用检流计检测微弱电流。

e.en: The lab recorded {galvanometric} responses during the test.
e.zh: 实验室记录了测试中的电流测量反应。

e.en: A {galvanometric} mirror reflected the light beam.
e.zh: 检流计镜面反射了那束光。

e.en: {Galvanometry} is useful for measuring small currents.
e.zh: 电流测量法适合测量微小电流。

e.en: The manual explains {galvanometry} with simple circuits.
e.zh: 手册用简单电路解释检流术。

e.en: The statue had a thin {galvanoplastic} shell.
e.zh: 这座雕像有一层薄薄的电铸外壳。

e.en: They repaired the medal with a {galvanoplastic} process.
e.zh: 他们用电镀成型工艺修复了奖章。

e.en: {Galvanoplastics} helped reproduce delicate metal objects.
e.zh: 电铸术有助于复制精细金属物件。

e.en: The workshop teaches {galvanoplastics} to art restorers.
e.zh: 工作坊向艺术修复师教授电镀成型。

e.en: The jeweler used {galvanoplasty} to form a hollow piece.
e.zh: 珠宝匠用电铸术制作中空部件。

e.en: {Galvanoplasty} can reproduce a mold in metal.
e.zh: 电镀成型可以用金属复制模具。

e.en: The old {galvanoscope} detected the current's direction.
e.zh: 这台旧验电流器检测出电流方向。

e.en: He built a simple {galvanoscope} from a coil and needle.
e.zh: 他用线圈和指针做了一个简单检电器。

e.en: The article described a {galvanoscopic} test for current.
e.zh: 文章描述了一种检电流测试。

e.en: Her {galvanoscopic} apparatus was surprisingly sensitive.
e.zh: 她的验电流装置出奇地灵敏。

e.en: {Galvanoscopy} revealed a weak current in the circuit.
e.zh: 电流检测法发现电路中有微弱电流。

e.en: The course covered early methods of {galvanoscopy}.
e.zh: 课程讲到早期的检电方法。

e.en: The cells showed a strong {galvanotactic} response.
e.zh: 这些细胞表现出强烈的趋电反应。

e.en: A {galvanotactic} organism moves toward an electric field.
e.zh: 趋电性生物会向电场方向移动。

e.en: Wound healing may involve {galvanotaxis} of skin cells.
e.zh: 伤口愈合可能涉及皮肤细胞的趋电性。

e.en: Scientists observed {galvanotaxis} in the microorganisms.
e.zh: 科学家观察到这些微生物的电趋向运动。

e.en: The clinic once offered {galvanothermy} for chronic pain.
e.zh: 这家诊所曾提供电热疗法治疗慢性疼痛。

e.en: {Galvanothermy} uses electric current to produce heat.
e.zh: 电热疗法利用电流产生热量。

galvanotropic.t: 向电性的；受电刺激取向的

e.en: The roots showed {galvanotropic} growth in the experiment.
e.zh: 实验中根部表现出向电性生长。

e.en: A {galvanotropic} response can guide cell migration.
e.zh: 向电性反应能引导细胞迁移。

e.en: Researchers studied {galvanotropism} in plant roots.
e.zh: 研究人员研究植物根部的向电性。

e.en: {Galvanotropism} changes the direction of cell growth.
e.zh: 向电性会改变细胞生长方向。

e.en: The {game-keeper} checked the fences at dawn.
e.zh: 猎场看守人清晨检查了围栏。

e.en: A strict {game-keeper} guarded the estate's pheasants.
e.zh: 一名严厉的护猎员守着庄园里的雉鸡。

game-tying.t: 扳平比赛的；追平比分的

e.en: She hit the {game-tying} shot with seconds left.
e.zh: 她在只剩几秒时投中了扳平比分的一球。

e.en: The crowd roared after his {game-tying} goal.
e.zh: 他打进追平比分的进球后，全场欢呼起来。

e.en: He slung the {gamebag} over his shoulder.
e.zh: 他把猎物袋挎在肩上。

e.en: Their {gamebag} included two rabbits and a pheasant.
e.zh: 他们当天的猎获物包括两只兔子和一只雉鸡。

e.en: The old {gamebook} let readers choose each path.
e.zh: 那本旧游戏书让读者自己选择每条路线。

e.en: He collected every fantasy {gamebook} in the series.
e.zh: 他收集了那个系列的每一本奇幻互动冒险书。

e.en: The valley was rich {gameland} before the farms expanded.
e.zh: 在农田扩张以前，这个山谷是猎物丰富的地区。

e.en: Children explored a bright {gameland} on the tablet.
e.zh: 孩子们在平板上探索一个明亮的游戏世界。

e.en: After the harsh winter, the woods seemed {gameless}.
e.zh: 严冬过后，树林里似乎没有猎物了。

e.en: They planned a quiet, {gameless} evening at home.
e.zh: 他们打算在家过一个安静、没有游戏的夜晚。

e.en: Connect the {gamepad} before launching the racing game.
e.zh: 启动赛车游戏前先连接游戏手柄。

e.en: This {gamepad} feels better for long sessions.
e.zh: 这个游戏控制器长时间玩起来手感更好。

e.en: Our {gameplan} is to finish the report today.
e.zh: 我们的行动计划是今天完成报告。

e.en: The coach changed the {gameplan} after halftime.
e.zh: 教练在中场休息后改变了比赛策略。

e.en: The {games-master} explained the rules before dinner.
e.zh: 游戏主持人在晚餐前讲解了规则。

e.en: A fair {games-master} kept the tournament moving.
e.zh: 一位公正的竞赛主管让锦标赛顺利进行。

gamesman.t: 善用策略的人；老练选手

e.en: He was a clever {gamesman} in every negotiation.
e.zh: 他在每次谈判中都是善用策略的人。

e.en: The veteran {gamesman} waited for his opponent's mistake.
e.zh: 那位老练选手等待对手犯错。

e.en: The puppy grew {gamesome} after a short nap.
e.zh: 小狗小睡一会儿后变得爱玩起来。

e.en: Her {gamesome} mood made the long trip easier.
e.zh: 她那种嬉戏轻松的心情让漫长旅程好过些。

e.en: The children ran {gamesomely} through the garden.
e.zh: 孩子们嬉戏地跑过花园。

e.en: He smiled {gamesomely} and hid the card.
e.zh: 他顽皮地一笑，把那张牌藏了起来。

e.en: The kitten's {gamesomeness} delighted everyone in the room.
e.zh: 小猫的爱玩劲儿让屋里每个人都很开心。

e.en: Her speech had a light {gamesomeness} that relaxed the audience.
e.zh: 她的讲话带着轻松的嬉戏感，让听众放松下来。

e.en: Even the {gamest} climber feared the storm.
e.zh: 即使是最有胆量的登山者也害怕那场风暴。

e.en: She was the {gamest} player on the injured team.
e.zh: 她是那支伤病缠身的队里最勇敢的球员。

e.en: The old {gamester} lost his fortune at cards.
e.zh: 那个老赌徒在牌桌上输光了财产。

e.en: A skilled {gamester} studies every opponent carefully.
e.zh: 熟练的玩家会仔细研究每一个对手。

e.en: The fungus forms a {gametangium} before fertilization.
e.zh: 这种真菌在受精前会形成配子囊。

e.en: Students identified the {gametangium} under the microscope.
e.zh: 学生们在显微镜下辨认出了生殖囊。

gametically.t: 以配子方式；配子层面上

e.en: The trait is transmitted {gametically} in this species.
e.zh: 这种性状在该物种中以配子方式传递。

e.en: Researchers compared cells that differed {gametically}.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了在配子层面上不同的细胞。

e.en: The laboratory tested a new {gametocide} on mosquito cells.
e.zh: 实验室在蚊子细胞上测试了一种新的杀配子剂。

e.en: This {gametocide} blocks reproduction in the parasite.
e.zh: 这种灭配子物质会阻断寄生虫的繁殖。

e.en: A thick wall surrounded the {gametocyst}.
e.zh: 配子囊外包着一层厚壁。

e.en: The parasite's {gametocyst} developed inside the host.
e.zh: 寄生虫的配子包囊在宿主体内发育。

e.en: The blood smear showed a mature {gametocyte}.
e.zh: 血涂片显示出一个成熟的配子母细胞。

e.en: A malaria {gametocyte} can infect a mosquito.
e.zh: 疟原虫的配子细胞可以感染蚊子。

e.en: Hormones regulate {gametogenesis} in many animals.
e.zh: 激素调节许多动物的配子发生过程。

e.en: The course covered meiosis and {gametogenesis}.
e.zh: 这门课讲到了减数分裂和配子形成。

gametogenous.t: 产生配子的；配子形成的

e.en: The tissue contains {gametogenous} cells.
e.zh: 这种组织含有产生配子的细胞。

e.en: A {gametogenous} stage appears before fertilization.
e.zh: 受精前会出现一个配子形成阶段。

gametogeny.t: 配子发生过程；配子形成学

e.en: The paper describes {gametogeny} in marine algae.
e.zh: 这篇论文描述了海藻的配子发生过程。

e.en: Students found {gametogeny} difficult but important.
e.zh: 学生们觉得配子形成学很难但很重要。

gametogonium.t: 配子母细胞或配子囊原细胞；产生配子的细胞结构

e.en: A {gametogonium} develops before mature gametes appear.
e.zh: 成熟配子出现之前，会先形成配子母细胞。

e.en: The biologist identified the {gametogonium} under the microscope.
e.zh: 生物学家在显微镜下辨认出了配子母细胞。

gametogony.t: 配子形成过程；配子发生

e.en: The parasite enters {gametogony} inside the host.
e.zh: 这种寄生虫在宿主体内进入配子形成阶段。

e.en: Researchers compared {gametogony} across several related species.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了几种近缘物种的配子发生过程。

e.en: The cell showed a {gametoid} shape after division.
e.zh: 分裂后，这个细胞呈现出类似配子的形态。

e.en: Scientists described the structure as {gametoid} but not fully mature.
e.zh: 科学家称该结构具有配子样特征，但尚未完全成熟。

gametophore.t: 配子体枝；承载生殖器官的枝状体

e.en: The moss {gametophore} carries the reproductive organs.
e.zh: 苔藓的配子体枝承载着生殖器官。

e.en: A damaged {gametophore} can reduce the plant's fertility.
e.zh: 受损的配子体枝可能降低植物的繁殖能力。

gamey.t: 有野味味道的；带腥膻味的
