e.en: She served biscuits with {gauffered} edges.
e.zh: 她端上了边缘压出花纹的饼干。

e.en: The pressure was {gaugeable} with a simple meter.
e.zh: 用一个简单仪表就能测出压力。

e.en: Public anger is not always {gaugeable} from online comments.
e.zh: 民众的愤怒并不总能从网上评论中估量出来。

e.en: The worker lowered a {gauging-rod} into the tank.
e.zh: 工人把量尺放进了储罐里。

e.en: A marked {gauging-rod} showed the river's depth.
e.zh: 一根带刻度的测深杆显示了河水深度。

e.en: Do not {gaum} the handle with wet paint.
e.zh: 别把湿油漆弄到把手上。

e.en: The child managed to {gaum} jam across the table.
e.zh: 那个孩子把果酱抹得满桌都是。

e.en: He gave a {gaumless} stare when asked to help.
e.zh: 别人请他帮忙时，他只是一脸呆相地望着。

e.en: It was a {gaumless} mistake, but not a cruel one.
e.zh: 那是个愚笨的错误，但并非出于恶意。

e.en: The barrels rested on a wooden {gauntry}.
e.zh: 那些桶放在一个木制桶架上。

e.en: He repaired the old {gauntry} behind the brewery.
e.zh: 他修好了酿酒厂后面的旧木架。

e.en: The children began to {gaup} at the fireworks.
e.zh: 孩子们开始张着嘴呆看烟花。

e.en: Do not just {gaup}; answer the question.
e.zh: 别光傻盯着，回答问题。

e.en: A wild {gaur} stepped out of the forest.
e.zh: 一头印度野牛从森林里走了出来。

e.en: The reserve protects the {gaur} and its habitat.
e.zh: 保护区保护印度野牛及其栖息地。

e.en: The engineer checked the magnet's {gaussage} before installation.
e.zh: 工程师在安装前检查了磁体的高斯量值。

e.en: Higher {gaussage} can affect nearby instruments.
e.zh: 较高的磁通密度可能影响附近仪器。

gaussistor.t: 磁敏电阻器；高斯电阻器

e.en: The circuit used a {gaussistor} to detect magnetic fields.
e.zh: 该电路使用磁敏电阻器来探测磁场。

e.en: A damaged {gaussistor} made the sensor unreliable.
e.zh: 损坏的磁敏电阻器使传感器变得不可靠。

e.en: The curtains hung {gauzily} over the open window.
e.zh: 窗帘像薄纱一样垂在敞开的窗前。

e.en: The memory returned {gauzily}, without clear details.
e.zh: 那段记忆朦胧地浮现，没有清晰细节。

e.en: The scarf's {gauziness} made it almost transparent.
e.zh: 这条围巾的薄纱感让它几乎透明。

e.en: The painting has a dreamy {gauziness}.
e.zh: 这幅画带着梦一般的朦胧感。

e.en: The patient received {gavage} after refusing food.
e.zh: 病人拒绝进食后接受了管饲。

e.en: Animal rights groups criticized the practice of {gavage}.
e.zh: 动物权益组织批评强制灌食的做法。

e.en: The channel provided {gavel-to-gavel} coverage of the hearing.
e.zh: 该频道对听证会进行了从头到尾的报道。

e.en: Reporters stayed for the {gavel-to-gavel} session.
e.zh: 记者们留到了整场会议结束。

e.en: Under {gavelkind}, the land was divided among all sons.
e.zh: 按照诸子均分继承制，土地分给了所有儿子。

e.en: The lawyer explained {gavelkind} as an old inheritance custom.
e.zh: 律师把诸子均分继承制解释为一种古老继承习俗。

e.en: He lifted the stone with a heavy {gavelock}.
e.zh: 他用一根沉重的铁撬棍撬起石头。

e.en: The old tale mentions a warrior's {gavelock}.
e.zh: 这个古老故事提到了一名武士的长矛。

e.en: The {gavial} has a long, narrow snout.
e.zh: 恒河鳄有又长又窄的吻部。

e.en: Conservationists monitor the {gavial} along the river.
e.zh: 保护人员在河边监测恒河鳄。

e.en: The old law called the clan leader a {genearch}.
e.zh: 旧法把氏族首领称为族长。

e.en: In the legend, the {genearch} guarded the family records.
e.zh: 在传说中，那位族长守护着家族记录。

e.en: Her thesis used {genecology} to compare plants across climates.
e.zh: 她的论文用遗传生态学比较不同气候下的植物。

e.en: Modern {genecology} links local adaptation with inherited traits.
e.zh: 现代遗传生态学把本地适应与遗传性状联系起来。

e.en: The old spelling {geneology} appears in several nineteenth-century records.
e.zh: 这种旧拼法geneology出现在几份十九世纪记录中。

e.en: He meant genealogy, but wrote {geneology} in his notes.
e.zh: 他想写家谱学，却在笔记里写成了geneology。

e.en: The counselor explained {genepenetrance} in simple terms.
e.zh: 遗传顾问用简单的话解释了基因外显率。

e.en: Low {genepenetrance} can hide a harmful mutation for generations.
e.zh: 低基因外显率可能让有害突变隐藏好几代。

e.en: The model's {generability} depends on clean training data.
e.zh: 这个模型的可生成性取决于干净的训练数据。

e.en: Philosophers debated the {generability} of moral rules from experience.
e.zh: 哲学家讨论道德规则能否从经验中生成。

e.en: We bought a {general-purpose} printer for the office.
e.zh: 我们给办公室买了一台通用打印机。

e.en: This is a {general-purpose} tool, not a specialist instrument.
e.zh: 这是多用途工具，不是专用仪器。

e.en: The room serves several {general-purposes} during the week.
e.zh: 这个房间一周里有几种一般用途。

e.en: They listed storage and meetings as {general-purposes}.
e.zh: 他们把储物和开会列为通用目的。

e.en: He accepted the {generalcy} during a dangerous campaign.
e.zh: 他在一次危险战役中接受了将军职位。

e.en: The council disputed her claim to the {generalcy}.
e.zh: 委员会质疑她对统帅权的主张。

e.en: The study produced {generalizable} findings about sleep.
e.zh: 这项研究得出了关于睡眠的可推广结论。

e.en: A single case is rarely {generalizable} to every patient.
e.zh: 单个病例很少能概括到每位患者。

e.en: The catalog used {generalpurpose} to describe the cheaper machine.
e.zh: 目录用generalpurpose来描述那台较便宜的机器。

e.en: A {generalpurpose} version can handle many small tasks.
e.zh: 通用版本可以处理许多小任务。

e.en: In geometry, a {generant} can produce a surface by motion.
e.zh: 在几何中，生成线可通过运动形成曲面。

e.en: The theory treats desire as a {generant} of action.
e.zh: 该理论把欲望视为行动的产生因素。

e.en: A {generativist} would analyze the sentence through abstract rules.
e.zh: 生成语法派学者会用抽象规则分析这个句子。

e.en: She became a {generativist} after studying Chomsky's early work.
e.zh: 她研究乔姆斯基早期著作后成了生成语法派学者。

e.en: The diagram marks the cone's {generatrices} in blue.
e.zh: 图中用蓝色标出圆锥的多条母线。

e.en: Engineers traced the {generatrices} to describe the curved shell.
e.zh: 工程师描出生成线来描述这个曲面壳体。

e.en: Rotate this {generatrix} to form the surface of a cone.
e.zh: 旋转这条母线即可形成圆锥表面。

e.en: The lecturer called the moving line a {generatrix}.
e.zh: 讲师把这条运动的线称为生成线。

e.en: The software displays several {generatrixes} on the model.
e.zh: 软件在模型上显示了几条生成线。

e.en: Older textbooks sometimes prefer {generatrixes} over generatrices.
e.zh: 旧教材有时更喜欢用generatrixes而不是generatrices。

e.en: The curator checked the {generitype} before revising the genus.
e.zh: 馆长在修订该属前核对了属模式标本。

e.en: A missing {generitype} can complicate taxonomic decisions.
e.zh: 属型缺失会使分类决定变得复杂。

e.en: The score asks the violinist to play {generoso}.
e.zh: 乐谱要求小提琴手以宽厚的情感演奏。

e.en: He gave {generoso}, expecting nothing in return.
e.zh: 他慷慨地给予，不期待任何回报。

e.en: Taxonomists identified the {generotype} from the original description.
e.zh: 分类学家根据原始描述确定了属模式种。

e.en: Changing the {generotype} would affect several species names.
e.zh: 改变属型会影响多个物种名称。

e.en: The paper discussed {geneserine} as an older name for eserine.
e.zh: 论文把geneserine作为依色林的旧名称来讨论。

e.en: Doctors no longer mention {geneserine} in ordinary prescriptions.
e.zh: 医生在普通处方中已不再提到毒扁豆碱这个旧名。

e.en: The essay explores the {genesic} force of myth.
e.zh: 这篇文章探讨神话的起源性力量。

e.en: He used {genesic} to mean connected with creation.
e.zh: 他用genesic表示与创造或发生有关。

e.en: The poet wrote a {genethliac} ode for the prince.
e.zh: 诗人为王子写了一首生日颂诗。

e.en: Ancient astrologers drew a {genethliac} chart at birth.
e.zh: 古代占星师会在出生时绘制本命星盘。

e.en: The horoscope was interpreted {genethliacally}, not politically.
e.zh: 这份星盘是按生日占星来解释的，不是按政治来解释。

e.en: He described the poem {genethliacally} as a birth celebration.
e.zh: 他从生日颂诗的角度描述了这首诗。

e.en: The scholar found {genethliacs} in a medieval manuscript.
e.zh: 那位学者在一份中世纪手稿里发现了生日占星术的内容。

e.en: Ancient {genethliacs} linked character to the hour of birth.
e.zh: 古代生日占星术把人的性格同出生时辰联系起来。

e.en: He studied {genethlialogy} as part of astrology's history.
e.zh: 他把生日占星学作为占星史的一部分来研究。

e.en: The book treats {genethlialogy} as a learned ancient art.
e.zh: 这本书把生辰推命视为一种古代学问。

e.en: The paper used the older term {genetical} variation.
e.zh: 论文使用了“遗传变异”这一较旧的说法。

e.en: His account gave a {genetical} explanation of the custom.
e.zh: 他的叙述从起源上解释了这种习俗。

e.en: Critics saw his argument as crude {geneticism}.
e.zh: 批评者认为他的论点是一种粗糙的遗传决定论。

e.en: Modern biology rejects simple {geneticism} about behavior.
e.zh: 现代生物学反对用简单的遗传决定论解释行为。

e.en: A little wine seemed to {genialise} the conversation.
e.zh: 一点酒似乎让谈话变得更亲切愉快。

e.en: The warm host tried to {genialise} the formal dinner.
e.zh: 热情的主人试图让这场正式晚宴轻松起来。

e.en: Music helped {genialize} the stiff reception.
e.zh: 音乐让那场拘谨的招待会变得亲切些。

e.en: She tried to {genialize} the debate with a joke.
e.zh: 她想用一个笑话让辩论气氛缓和下来。

e.en: The disorder may have a {genic} cause.
e.zh: 这种疾病可能有基因方面的原因。

e.en: Researchers compared several {genic} effects in the trial.
e.zh: 研究人员在试验中比较了几种基因效应。

e.en: The surgeon avoided the {genicular} artery during the operation.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术中避开了膝部动脉。

e.en: A {genicular} bend was visible in the small stem.
e.zh: 那根小茎上可以看到一个膝状弯曲。

e.en: The insect has {geniculate} antennae with sharp bends.
e.zh: 这种昆虫有带明显弯折的膝状触角。

e.en: Some grasses {geniculate} near the base after rain.
e.zh: 有些草在雨后会在基部呈膝状弯曲。

e.en: The {geniculating} stem bent sharply above the soil.
e.zh: 那根正在作膝状弯曲的茎在土面上方急转。

e.en: Botanists noted the {geniculating} joints of the plant.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这种植物呈膝状弯曲的节部。

e.en: The stem's {geniculation} helped identify the species.
e.zh: 茎部的膝状弯曲帮助辨认了这个物种。

e.en: A clear {geniculation} marked the insect's antenna.
e.zh: 昆虫触角上有一个清楚的弯折处。

e.en: The nerve bends at the facial {geniculum}.
e.zh: 这条神经在面神经膝状部发生弯曲。

e.en: The tiny {geniculum} was visible under magnification.
e.zh: 在放大观察下可以看到那个细小的膝状结构。

e.en: Roman households honored their {genii} with small offerings.
e.zh: 罗马家庭会用小供品祭拜自己的守护神。

e.en: The tale fills the desert with hidden {genii}.
e.zh: 这个故事让沙漠里充满了隐藏的精灵。

e.en: The market sold {genipap} beside mangoes and limes.
e.zh: 市场上把美洲热带果和芒果、青柠摆在一起卖。

e.en: Traditional dye can be made from {genipap} fruit.
e.zh: 传统染料可以用这种美洲热带果的果实制成。

genistin.t: 染料木苷；大豆异黄酮苷

e.en: Soybeans contain {genistin} and related isoflavones.
e.zh: 大豆含有染料木苷以及相关的异黄酮。

e.en: The lab measured {genistin} levels in each sample.
e.zh: 实验室测量了每个样品中的染料木苷含量。

e.en: The old text used {genitalic} terms freely.
e.zh: 那部旧著作随意使用了生殖器相关术语。

e.en: Doctors recorded the {genitalic} features with care.
e.zh: 医生仔细记录了生殖器方面的特征。

e.en: The phrase has a clear {genitival} meaning.
e.zh: 这个短语有明显的属格含义。

e.en: Latin poetry often moves {genitival} phrases for emphasis.
e.zh: 拉丁诗歌常移动属格短语以加强语气。

genitivally.t: 以属格方式；作所有格地

e.en: The noun is used {genitivally} in this line.
e.zh: 这个名词在这一行中以属格方式使用。

e.en: Old English could mark possession {genitivally}.
e.zh: 古英语可以用属格形式来标示所属关系。

e.en: The {genitive} case often shows possession.
e.zh: 属格常用来表示所属关系。

e.en: In "the boy's book," "boy's" is {genitive}.
e.zh: 在“the boy's book”中，“boy's”是所有格形式。

e.en: The law named the child's {genitor} as responsible.
e.zh: 法律认定孩子的生身父母负有责任。

e.en: Poets called the ancient king their noble {genitor}.
e.zh: 诗人称那位古代国王为他们高贵的祖先。

e.en: The astrologer drew up the prince's {geniture}.
e.zh: 占星师为王子绘制了生辰命盘。

e.en: Old chronicles sometimes recorded a hero's {geniture}.
e.zh: 旧编年史有时会记下英雄的出生情况。

e.en: The engineers tested the {genlocking} before opening the new rail signal system.
e.zh: 工程师在启用新的铁路信号系统前测试了联锁机制。

e.en: A fault in the {genlocking} stopped the machines from running together.
e.zh: 联锁装置出现故障，使这些机器无法同时运转。

e.en: The crew raised the {gennaker} as the wind moved behind them.
e.zh: 风转到船后方时，船员升起了三角球帆。

e.en: A bright red {gennaker} carried the yacht down the coast.
e.zh: 一面鲜红的三角球帆带着游艇沿海岸前行。

e.en: She arrived fully {genned-up} on the legal risks.
e.zh: 她到场时已充分了解相关法律风险。

e.en: The reporter was {genned-up} before the minister entered the room.
e.zh: 部长进屋前，记者已经掌握了充分情况。

e.en: We used a {genny} to keep the lights on during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨期间，我们用一台小型发电机维持照明。

e.en: The old price was listed as one {genny} in the auction notes.
e.zh: 拍卖说明中旧价格写作一枚几尼币。

e.en: The paper described a {genoblast} as an early reproductive cell.
e.zh: 论文把生殖细胞描述为一种早期的繁殖细胞。

e.en: Under the microscope, the {genoblast} looked different from nearby tissue cells.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，这个胚原细胞看起来不同于周围的组织细胞。

genocidist.t: 种族灭绝者；鼓吹灭绝的人

e.en: The court heard testimony against the accused {genocidist}.
e.zh: 法庭听取了针对被控种族灭绝者的证词。

e.en: Historians rejected the {genocidist} rhetoric in the pamphlet.
e.zh: 历史学家驳斥了那本小册子里鼓吹种族灭绝的言论。

e.en: The mutation produced a {genocopy} of a disorder usually caused by another gene.
e.zh: 这种突变产生了一个通常由另一基因导致的疾病遗传拟表型。

e.en: Researchers distinguished the {genocopy} from an environmentally induced phenocopy.
e.zh: 研究人员把这种遗传拟表型与环境诱发的拟表型区分开来。

e.en: Therapists use {genograms} to map patterns across several generations.
e.zh: 治疗师用家系图梳理几代人之间的模式。

e.en: The medical file included {genograms} showing inherited heart disease.
e.zh: 病历中包含显示遗传性心脏病的家系图。

e.en: The old anthropological text used {genoid} categories that are now rejected.
e.zh: 那本旧人类学著作用了如今已被否定的种族型分类。

e.en: Some biologists once applied {genoid} labels to broad inherited traits.
e.zh: 一些生物学家曾用类属标签描述广泛的遗传特征。

e.en: She filled the {genoise} with berries and whipped cream.
e.zh: 她在热那亚海绵蛋糕里夹入浆果和鲜奶油。

e.en: A good {genoise} depends on carefully beaten eggs.
e.zh: 好的热那亚海绵蛋糕取决于打发得恰到好处的鸡蛋。

e.en: The article used {genom}, an older spelling of genome.
e.zh: 那篇文章使用了genom，这是genome的旧拼法。

e.en: In early genetics, {genom} sometimes referred to the full hereditary set.
e.zh: 在早期遗传学中，genom有时指完整的遗传集合。

e.en: The biologist used {genonema} for the threadlike material in the chromosome.
e.zh: 这位生物学家用genonema指染色体中的丝状物质。

e.en: Older textbooks described the {genonema} as carrying hereditary information.
e.zh: 旧教材把染色体丝描述为携带遗传信息的结构。

e.en: The bacteria were grouped as one {genospecies} after DNA comparison.
e.zh: 经过DNA比较，这些细菌被归为同一个遗传种。

e.en: A {genospecies} may not match the species name used in older field guides.
e.zh: 遗传种未必对应旧野外手册中使用的物种名称。

genotoxic.t: 遗传毒性的；损伤基因的

e.en: The lab tested whether the chemical was {genotoxic}.
e.zh: 实验室检测这种化学物质是否具有遗传毒性。

e.en: Long exposure to {genotoxic} agents can damage DNA.
e.zh: 长期接触遗传毒性物质可能损伤DNA。

e.en: The twins were {genotypically} identical but grew up in different environments.
e.zh: 这对双胞胎从基因型上看完全相同，但成长环境不同。

e.en: The strains differ {genotypically} even when they look similar.
e.zh: 这些菌株即使外观相似，从基因型上看也不同。

e.en: A powerful {genro} advised the emperor behind the scenes.
e.zh: 一位有权势的日本元老在幕后向天皇进言。

e.en: The historian traced how each {genro} shaped modern Japanese politics.
e.zh: 历史学家追溯了每位政界元老如何影响近代日本政治。

e.en: The recipe called the root {genseng} in its old spelling.
e.zh: 这个配方用旧拼法genseng称呼人参根。

e.en: Merchants once sold dried {genseng} as a costly medicine.
e.zh: 商人过去把干人参作为昂贵药材出售。

genteelism.t: 装文雅的说法；矫饰文雅

e.en: Calling poverty reduced circumstances was a typical {genteelism}.
e.zh: 把贫困说成境况拮据，是一种典型的装文雅说法。

e.en: Her speech was full of {genteelism} and careful avoidance of plain words.
e.zh: 她的讲话充满矫饰文雅，并刻意回避直白用词。

gentel.t: 高贵的；优雅的；异教的；外邦的

e.en: The old poem calls him a {gentel} knight.
e.zh: 那首古诗称他为一位高贵的骑士。

e.en: In medieval texts, {gentel} may also mean pagan or non-Jewish.
e.zh: 在中古文本中，gentel也可能指异教的或非犹太的。

e.en: The register listed him as a {gentelmancommoner} at Oxford.
e.zh: 名册把他列为牛津的一名自费贵族学生。

e.en: A {gentelmancommoner} enjoyed privileges beyond ordinary students.
e.zh: 自费贵族学生享有普通学生没有的特权。

e.en: The botanist identified several {gentianaceous} plants on the hillside.
e.zh: 植物学家在山坡上认出了几种龙胆科植物。

e.en: Its {gentianaceous} flowers were small but intensely blue.
e.zh: 它的龙胆科花朵很小，却呈现浓烈的蓝色。

e.en: A purple {gentianella} grew beside the mountain path.
e.zh: 山路旁长着一株紫色的小龙胆属植物。

e.en: The guide pointed out {gentianella} among the alpine flowers.
e.zh: 向导在高山花丛中指出了小龙胆属植物。

e.en: Chaucer often used {gentil} for noble conduct, not merely rank.
e.zh: 乔叟常用gentil指高尚的行为，而不只是身份。

e.en: Her {gentil} manners impressed the visiting court.
e.zh: 她优雅有礼的举止给来访宫廷留下了印象。

e.en: The preacher spoke of missions across {gentiledom}.
e.zh: 传教士谈到在整个外邦人世界中的布道。

e.en: To the chronicler, {gentiledom} stood outside the chosen faith.
e.zh: 在编年史作者看来，异教世界处在被拣选的信仰之外。

e.en: The romance praises her {gentilesse} more than her wealth.
e.zh: 那部传奇赞美她的高贵风度多过财富。

e.en: True {gentilesse}, the poet argues, comes from virtue.
e.zh: 诗人认为，真正的高贵来自德行。

e.en: The bishop condemned {gentilism} in the countryside.
e.zh: 主教谴责乡间的异教信仰。

e.en: Scholars use {gentilism} to describe non-Christian rites in old texts.
e.zh: 学者用gentilism描述古文献中的非基督教仪式。

e.en: The inscription preserves a {gentilitial} name from ancient Rome.
e.zh: 这段铭文保留了一个古罗马氏族名。

e.en: A {gentilitial} adjective can mark descent or family association.
e.zh: 氏族形容词可以表示血统或家族关联。

e.en: The extract contains {gentiopicrin}, a bitter plant compound.
e.zh: 这种提取物含有龙胆苦苷，一种苦味植物化合物。

e.en: Researchers measured {gentiopicrin} levels in the dried roots.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了干根中的龙胆苦苷含量。

e.en: The reaction produced traces of {gentisaldehyde}.
e.zh: 这次反应产生了微量龙胆醛。

e.en: Chemists identified {gentisaldehyde} by its spectral pattern.
e.zh: 化学家通过光谱特征鉴定出龙胆醛。

e.en: The sample contained sodium {gentisate}.
e.zh: 样品中含有龙胆酸钠。

e.en: Bacteria can metabolize {gentisate} through a known pathway.
e.zh: 细菌可以通过已知途径代谢龙胆酸盐。

e.en: The yellow pigment was identified as {gentisin}.
e.zh: 这种黄色色素被鉴定为龙胆黄素。

e.en: Analysts detected {gentisin} in the gentian root extract.
e.zh: 分析人员在龙胆根提取物中检测到龙胆黄素。

e.en: The {gentlehearted} nurse comforted every frightened child.
e.zh: 那位心地温和善良的护士安慰每个受惊的孩子。

e.en: He looked stern, but he was {gentlehearted} in private.
e.zh: 他看起来严厉，但私下里心地很温和。

e.en: The essay questions whether {gentlehood} depends on birth.
e.zh: 这篇文章质疑绅士身份是否取决于出身。

e.en: His quiet generosity showed real {gentlehood}.
e.zh: 他低调的慷慨显示出真正的温和品格。

e.en: He served as a {gentleman-at-arms} during the ceremony.
e.zh: 他在典礼中担任英国王室卫士。

e.en: A {gentleman-at-arms} wore formal dress at state occasions.
e.zh: 英国王室卫士在国事场合穿正式礼服。

e.en: The young lord entered college as a {gentleman-commoner}.
e.zh: 那位年轻贵族以自费贵族学生身份入学。

e.en: A {gentleman-commoner} paid higher fees and had special status.
e.zh: 牛津自费贵族学生缴更高费用，并有特殊身份。

e.en: The old record spells the office {gentlemanatarms}.
e.zh: 旧记录把这个职位拼作gentlemanatarms。

e.en: He was appointed {gentlemanatarms} to the royal household.
e.zh: 他被任命为王室内廷的卫士。

gentlemanlike.t: 像绅士的；有绅士风度的

e.en: His apology was calm and {gentlemanlike}.
e.zh: 他的道歉冷静而有绅士风度。

e.en: The coach expected {gentlemanlike} behavior after the match.
e.zh: 教练期待赛后表现出绅士般的举止。

e.en: He became a {gentlemanpensioner} under the Tudor court.
e.zh: 他在都铎王朝宫廷中成为王室近卫绅士。

e.en: A {gentlemanpensioner} attended the monarch on formal occasions.
e.zh: 王室近卫绅士在正式场合侍从君主。

e.en: The school tried to teach {gentlemanship} through discipline.
e.zh: 学校试图通过纪律来培养绅士风度。

e.en: His claim to {gentlemanship} rested on conduct, not title.
e.zh: 他对绅士身份的主张建立在品行上，而非头衔上。

e.en: The hall was filled with {gentlepeople} from nearby estates.
e.zh: 大厅里满是来自附近庄园的贵族们。

e.en: The host addressed the guests as {gentlepeople}.
e.zh: 主人把客人们称作有教养的人们。

e.en: A {gentleperson} keeps calm during disagreement.
e.zh: 有礼貌的人在意见不合时仍能保持冷静。

e.en: The invitation welcomed every {gentleperson} and guest.
e.zh: 邀请函欢迎每位绅士淑女和来宾。

e.en: She gave the baby the {gentlest} touch.
e.zh: 她用最轻柔的动作触碰宝宝。

e.en: Even the {gentlest} criticism upset him.
e.zh: 哪怕是最温和的批评也让他难过。

e.en: The {gentlevoiced} teacher read the story aloud.
e.zh: 那位声音温柔的老师朗读了这个故事。

e.en: A {gentlevoiced} announcer guided passengers through the delay.
e.zh: 一位声音温和的播音员引导乘客应对延误。

e.en: Medieval astronomy often accepted {geocentrism} as obvious truth.
e.zh: 中世纪天文学常把地心说视为显而易见的真理。

e.en: The lesson compared {geocentrism} with the heliocentric model.
e.zh: 这节课把地心说和日心模型作了比较。

e.en: The team reviewed the {geochronologic} evidence from the lava flows.
e.zh: 团队审查了熔岩流中的地质年代学证据。

e.en: A {geochronologic} chart helped date the ancient rocks.
e.zh: 一张地质年代学图表帮助确定了这些古老岩石的年代。

e.en: The report included a {geochronological} analysis of the sediment layers.
e.zh: 报告包含了对沉积层的地质年代学分析。

e.en: They arranged the fossils in {geochronological} order.
e.zh: 他们按地质年代顺序排列了这些化石。

e.en: The rocks were {geochronologically} older than expected.
e.zh: 这些岩石按地质年代来看比预期更古老。

e.en: She grouped the samples {geochronologically} before comparing their chemistry.
e.zh: 她先按地质年代给样本分组，再比较其化学成分。

e.en: A {geochronologist} dated the volcanic ash above the bones.
e.zh: 一位地质年代学家测定了骨骼上方火山灰的年代。

e.en: The museum invited a {geochronologist} to explain the rock samples.
e.zh: 博物馆邀请了一位地质年代学家讲解这些岩石样本。

e.en: {Geochronology} helps scientists determine when rocks formed.
e.zh: 地质年代学帮助科学家判断岩石形成的时间。

e.en: The discovery changed the {geochronology} of the mountain range.
e.zh: 这一发现改变了人们对该山脉地质年代的认识。

e.en: The lab used {geochronometric} methods to date the mineral grains.
e.zh: 实验室用地质年代测定方法确定矿物颗粒的年代。

e.en: Their {geochronometric} results narrowed the age of the eruption.
e.zh: 他们的地质年代测定结果缩小了火山喷发年代的范围。

e.en: Uranium-lead {geochronometry} can date very old crystals.
e.zh: 铀铅地质年代测定法可以测定非常古老晶体的年代。

e.en: The paper explains the limits of {geochronometry} in altered rocks.
e.zh: 这篇论文说明了地质年代测定法在蚀变岩石中的局限。

e.en: The activist called unchecked pollution a form of {geocide}.
e.zh: 这位活动人士称不受控制的污染是一种毁灭地球生态的行为。

e.en: Some writers use {geocide} to describe deliberate planetary destruction.
e.zh: 一些作者用geocide来描述有意造成的地球毁灭。

e.en: The species shows a clear {geocline} in shell color.
e.zh: 这个物种的贝壳颜色呈现明显的地理渐变差异。

e.en: Researchers mapped the {geocline} across several coastal populations.
e.zh: 研究人员绘制了几个沿海种群之间的地理渐变差异。

e.en: The tiny {geocole} survives in damp soil under stones.
e.zh: 这种微小的土栖生物生活在石头下潮湿的土壤里。

e.en: Biologists found a rare {geocole} during the soil survey.
e.zh: 生物学家在土壤调查中发现了一种罕见的土栖生物。

e.en: The spacecraft detected hydrogen in Earth's {geocorona}.
e.zh: 航天器在地球的地冕中探测到了氢。

e.en: Scientists study the {geocorona} to understand atmospheric escape.
e.zh: 科学家研究地冕，以了解大气逃逸过程。

e.en: Ancient myths often offered a poetic {geocosmogony}.
e.zh: 古代神话常以诗意方式讲述地球起源。

e.en: The lecture traced {geocosmogony} from myth to modern science.
e.zh: 讲座追溯了地球起源论从神话到现代科学的发展。

e.en: The app uses {geodata} to show nearby bus stops.
e.zh: 这个应用利用地理空间数据显示附近的公交站。

e.en: Researchers combined census records with {geodata} from satellites.
e.zh: 研究人员把人口普查记录与卫星地理空间数据结合起来。

e.en: Retailers use {geodemographics} to choose store locations.
e.zh: 零售商利用地理人口统计学选择门店位置。

e.en: The campaign analyzed {geodemographics} before buying local ads.
e.zh: 竞选团队在购买本地广告前分析了地理人口统计数据。

e.en: A {geodesist} measured tiny shifts in the island's position.
e.zh: 一位大地测量学家测量了该岛位置的微小变化。

e.en: The bridge project hired a {geodesist} for precise surveying.
e.zh: 这项桥梁工程聘请了一位大地测量学家进行精密测量。

e.en: {Geodesy} studies Earth's shape and gravitational field.
e.zh: 大地测量学研究地球的形状和重力场。

e.en: Modern {geodesy} relies heavily on satellite measurements.
e.zh: 现代大地测量学在很大程度上依赖卫星测量。

e.en: The survey used {geodetical} instruments for high accuracy.
e.zh: 这次测量使用大地测量仪器以获得高精度。

e.en: A {geodetical} network links reference points across the country.
e.zh: 一个大地测量网络连接了全国各地的参考点。

e.en: The crew used a {geodimeter} to measure the valley width.
e.zh: 测量队用光电测距仪测量山谷宽度。

e.en: An old {geodimeter} sits in the surveying museum.
e.zh: 测量博物馆里陈列着一台旧光电测距仪。

e.en: The restaurant served fresh {geoduck} with a light sauce.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应配清淡酱汁的新鲜象拔蚌。

e.en: A {geoduck} can live buried deep in coastal sand.
e.zh: 象拔蚌可以深埋在海岸沙地中生活。

e.en: The model explains the region's {geodynamic} evolution.
e.zh: 这个模型解释了该地区的地球动力学演化。

e.en: Volcanoes reveal important {geodynamic} processes beneath the crust.
e.zh: 火山揭示了地壳下重要的地球动力学过程。

e.en: They built a {geodynamical} simulation of mantle flow.
e.zh: 他们建立了一个地幔流动的地球动力学模拟。

e.en: The paper discusses {geodynamical} forces behind mountain building.
e.zh: 论文讨论了造山运动背后的地球动力学力量。

e.en: {Geodynamics} examines how Earth's interior drives surface change.
e.zh: 地球动力学研究地球内部如何推动地表变化。

e.en: Plate tectonics is central to modern {geodynamics}.
e.zh: 板块构造是现代地球动力学的核心内容。

geoeconomy.t: 地缘经济；地理经济体系

e.en: Energy routes shape the region's {geoeconomy}.
e.zh: 能源通道塑造了该地区的地缘经济格局。

e.en: The report links climate risk to the global {geoeconomy}.
e.zh: 报告把气候风险与全球地理经济体系联系起来。

gentlewomanlike.t: 像淑女的；有贵妇风度的

e.en: Her {gentlewomanlike} manners impressed the old guests.
e.zh: 她那种淑女般的举止给老客人留下了深刻印象。

e.en: The novelist gave the maid a surprisingly {gentlewomanlike} voice.
e.zh: 小说家把这个女仆写得出奇地有贵妇般的口吻。

e.en: The hostess answered in a {gentrice} and measured tone.
e.zh: 女主人用温和而克制的语气回答。

e.en: His old letters reveal a rather {gentrice} style of courtesy.
e.zh: 他的旧信显出一种颇为有礼的客套风格。

e.en: The new cafe owner was called a {gentrifier} by longtime residents.
e.zh: 老居民把那家新咖啡馆的老板称为推动社区贵族化的人。

e.en: A {gentrifier} may raise rents without intending harm.
e.zh: 推动社区贵族化的人即使无意伤害，也可能抬高租金。

genty.t: 出身高贵的；有绅士派头的

e.en: He wore a {genty} coat to impress the villagers.
e.zh: 他穿着一件显得有绅士派头的外套，好让村民刮目相看。

e.en: The word {genty} sounds old-fashioned in modern English.
e.zh: genty 这个词在现代英语里听起来很古旧。

e.en: The surgeon examined the patient's {genu} after the fall.
e.zh: 病人摔倒后，外科医生检查了他的膝部。

e.en: Anatomists call this bend of the nerve the {genu}.
e.zh: 解剖学家把这段神经的弯曲处称为膝状部。

e.en: The report mentioned a small {genual} injury.
e.zh: 报告提到一处轻微的膝部损伤。

e.en: The doctor pointed to the {genual} region on the scan.
e.zh: 医生指着扫描图上的膝状部区域。

e.en: Each {genuflector} paused before entering the chapel.
e.zh: 每个屈膝跪拜的人在进入小礼拜堂前都停了一下。

e.en: The painting shows a lonely {genuflector} beside the altar.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘了祭坛旁一个孤独的跪拜者。

e.en: The priest made a slow {genuflexion} before the altar.
e.zh: 神父在祭坛前缓慢地行了屈膝礼。

e.en: Her awkward {genuflexion} revealed that she was new to the ritual.
e.zh: 她笨拙的跪拜动作说明她对这个仪式还很陌生。

e.en: The patient was placed in a {genupectoral} position for the examination.
e.zh: 检查时，病人被安置成膝胸位。

e.en: A {genupectoral} posture can relieve pressure in some cases.
e.zh: 在某些情况下，膝胸姿势可以减轻压力。

e.en: The survey mapped a broad {geoanticline} beneath the basin.
e.zh: 勘测绘出了盆地下方一个宽阔的大型地背斜。

e.en: Oil companies studied the {geoanticline} for possible traps.
e.zh: 石油公司研究这个地背斜，以寻找可能的圈闭构造。

e.en: Her thesis connected seismology with {geoastrophysics}.
e.zh: 她的论文把地震学与地球天体物理学联系起来。

e.en: The course in {geoastrophysics} covered planets and their interiors.
e.zh: 这门地球天体物理学课程讲授行星及其内部结构。

e.en: Researchers used {geobarometry} to estimate the rock's formation depth.
e.zh: 研究人员用地质压力测定法估算这块岩石的形成深度。

e.en: Accurate {geobarometry} helps reconstruct ancient mountain belts.
e.zh: 准确的地质压力测定有助于重建古代山脉带。

e.en: The team drilled a test well in the {geobasin}.
e.zh: 团队在这个地质盆地里钻了一口试验井。

e.en: Sediments filled the {geobasin} over millions of years.
e.zh: 数百万年来，沉积物逐渐填满了这个盆地。

e.en: She studies how microbes shape rocks through {geobiology}.
e.zh: 她通过地球生物学研究微生物如何影响岩石形成。

e.en: The museum opened a new exhibit on {geobiology}.
e.zh: 博物馆开设了一个关于地球生物学的新展览。

e.en: A worm is a common {geobiont} in garden soil.
e.zh: 蚯蚓是花园土壤里常见的土壤生物。

e.en: The ecologist classified the beetle as a {geobiont}.
e.zh: 生态学家把这种甲虫归为土壤生物。

e.en: The expedition collected {geobotanic} data in the valley.
e.zh: 考察队在山谷中收集了地植物学数据。

e.en: A {geobotanic} map can hint at hidden mineral deposits.
e.zh: 地植物学地图可能提示隐藏的矿藏。

e.en: The {geobotanist} studied plants growing above copper ore.
e.zh: 这位地植物学家研究生长在铜矿上方的植物。

e.en: As a {geobotanist}, she reads landscapes through vegetation.
e.zh: 作为地植物学家，她通过植被来解读地貌。

e.en: He used {geobotany} to locate signs of buried minerals.
e.zh: 他利用地植物学寻找地下矿物的迹象。

e.en: Modern {geobotany} links plant distribution with geology.
e.zh: 现代地植物学把植物分布与地质条件联系起来。

e.en: A {geocacher} found the box under a loose stone.
e.zh: 一名地理藏宝玩家在一块松动的石头下找到了盒子。

e.en: Every careful {geocacher} logs the find without spoiling the location.
e.zh: 每个细心的地理藏宝玩家都会记录发现，但不泄露地点。

e.en: Peanuts are a familiar example of {geocarpy}.
e.zh: 花生是地下结果现象的一个常见例子。

e.en: The botanist explained {geocarpy} to the students in the greenhouse.
e.zh: 植物学家在温室里向学生解释地下结果现象。

geocentrical.t: 地心说的；以地球为中心的

e.en: The old chart followed a {geocentrical} model of the heavens.
e.zh: 这张旧图采用了地心说的天体模型。

e.en: His argument was more theological than {geocentrical}.
e.zh: 他的论证更多是神学性的，而不是以地球为中心的。

geocentrically.t: 按地心说；以地球为中心地

e.en: The planets were arranged {geocentrically} in the medieval diagram.
e.zh: 在那幅中世纪图表中，行星按地心说排列。

e.en: He described the universe {geocentrically}, with Earth at the center.
e.zh: 他以地球为中心来描述宇宙，把地球放在中心位置。

e.en: The lecture traced the decline of {geocentricism} in Europe.
e.zh: 讲座追溯了地心说在欧洲的衰落。

e.en: Some writers use {geocentricism} as a metaphor for human arrogance.
e.zh: 有些作家把地心主义用作人类傲慢的隐喻。

e.en: The model's {geocentricity} made planetary motion hard to explain.
e.zh: 这个模型的地心性使行星运动难以解释。

e.en: Ancient astronomy often assumed the {geocentricity} of the cosmos.
e.zh: 古代天文学常常假定宇宙以地球为中心。

e.en: The survey mapped {geoelectric} layers beneath the valley.
e.zh: 这次勘测绘出了山谷下方的地电层。

e.en: Engineers compared {geoelectric} readings after the rainfall.
e.zh: 工程师比较了降雨后的地电读数。

e.en: The lab studies {geoelectricity} in volcanic regions.
e.zh: 这个实验室研究火山区的地电现象。

e.en: Changes in {geoelectricity} may reveal underground water movement.
e.zh: 地电变化可能显示地下水的流动。

geoethnic.t: 地缘民族的；地域族群的

e.en: The report used {geoethnic} categories to compare communities.
e.zh: 报告用地域族群类别来比较各个社区。

e.en: A {geoethnic} identity can cross modern national borders.
e.zh: 一种地缘民族身份可能跨越现代国界。

e.en: The chemist isolated {geoffrayin} from the plant extract.
e.zh: 化学家从植物提取物中分离出若弗鲁瓦因。

e.en: Old pharmacology texts mention {geoffrayin} as a bitter compound.
e.zh: 旧药理学文献把若弗鲁瓦因称为一种苦味化合物。

e.en: Researchers detected {geoffroyine} in the bark sample.
e.zh: 研究人员在树皮样本中检测到若弗鲁瓦碱。

e.en: The paper described {geoffroyine} as a toxic alkaloid.
e.zh: 论文把若弗鲁瓦碱描述为一种有毒生物碱。

e.en: The tunnel followed a major {geofracture} in the rock.
e.zh: 隧道沿着岩体中的一条主要地质裂缝延伸。

e.en: Water often moves quickly through a {geofracture}.
e.zh: 水常常会沿地质裂缝快速流动。

geogenic.t: 地质成因的；天然地源的

e.en: The arsenic was traced to {geogenic} sources.
e.zh: 砷污染被追溯到天然地质来源。

e.en: Some soils release {geogenic} carbon dioxide into basements.
e.zh: 有些土壤会向地下室释放地质成因的二氧化碳。

e.en: Early theories of {geogeny} mixed science with myth.
e.zh: 早期的地球成因理论把科学和神话混在一起。

e.en: The lecture introduced {geogeny} as an old geological term.
e.zh: 讲座把地质发生学介绍为一个古老地质术语。

e.en: The desert {geoglyph} is visible from the air.
e.zh: 这幅沙漠大地画从空中可以看见。

e.en: Archaeologists measured the ancient {geoglyph} with drones.
e.zh: 考古学家用无人机测量了这处古代地面巨型图案。

geognost.t: 地质构造学者；旧称地质学家

e.en: A nineteenth-century {geognost} described the mountain strata.
e.zh: 一位十九世纪的地质构造学者描述了山体地层。

e.en: The {geognost} kept detailed notes on local rocks.
e.zh: 这位旧称地质学家详细记录了当地岩石。

geognostic.t: 地质构造学的；岩层研究的

e.en: The museum owns several {geognostic} maps from 1820.
e.zh: 博物馆收藏着几张1820年的地质构造图。

e.en: His {geognostic} notes focused on coal seams.
e.zh: 他的岩层研究笔记主要关注煤层。

geognostical.t: 地质构造学的；岩层学的

e.en: She translated a {geognostical} essay from German.
e.zh: 她翻译了一篇德语的地质构造学论文。

e.en: The archive preserves {geognostical} observations from early miners.
e.zh: 档案保存了早期矿工的岩层学观察记录。

e.en: In older books, {geognosy} covered the study of rock formations.
e.zh: 在旧书中，地质构造学涵盖对岩层构造的研究。

e.en: The course treated {geognosy} as a precursor to modern geology.
e.zh: 这门课把地质构造学视为现代地质学的前身。

geogonic.t: 地球起源的；地球生成论的

e.en: The philosopher proposed a {geogonic} explanation of mountains.
e.zh: 这位哲学家提出了关于山脉的地球生成论解释。

e.en: Ancient myths often contain {geogonic} stories.
e.zh: 古代神话常含有关于地球起源的故事。

geogony.t: 地球生成论；地球起源说

e.en: His book on {geogony} tried to explain Earth's formation.
e.zh: 他关于地球生成论的书试图解释地球的形成。

e.en: Greek writers linked {geogony} with the birth of the gods.
e.zh: 希腊作家把地球起源说同众神诞生联系起来。

e.en: The editor marked {geographicical} as an awkward form.
e.zh: 编辑把geographicical标为一个别扭的非标准形式。

e.en: Older notes sometimes used {geographicical} where geographical is expected.
e.zh: 旧笔记有时在应写geographical的地方使用geographicical。

e.en: The mine requires a {geohydrologic} risk assessment.
e.zh: 这座矿山需要进行地质水文学风险评估。

e.en: They built a {geohydrologic} model of the aquifer.
e.zh: 他们建立了含水层的地质水文学模型。

e.en: The report includes {geohydrological} data from five wells.
e.zh: 报告包括五口井的地质水文学数据。

e.en: A {geohydrological} study can guide groundwater protection.
e.zh: 地质水文学研究可以指导地下水保护。

e.en: A {geohydrologist} inspected the contaminated well field.
e.zh: 一名地质水文学家检查了受污染的井区。

e.en: The {geohydrologist} advised drilling farther from the river.
e.zh: 地质水文学家建议在离河更远的地方钻井。

e.en: She studies {geohydrology} at the university.
e.zh: 她在大学研究地质水文学。

e.en: Knowledge of {geohydrology} helps manage groundwater resources.
e.zh: 地质水文学知识有助于管理地下水资源。

e.en: Satellites help scientists refine the {geoid}.
e.zh: 卫星帮助科学家修正大地水准面模型。

e.en: The {geoid} differs slightly from a perfect sphere.
e.zh: 地球体与完美球体略有不同。

geoidal.t: 大地水准面的；地球体的

e.en: The team calculated {geoidal} height for each station.
e.zh: 团队计算了每个测站的大地水准面高。

e.en: Small {geoidal} variations affect precise surveying.
e.zh: 细小的大地水准面变化会影响精密测量。

e.en: The map marked a {geoisotherm} beneath the plateau.
e.zh: 地图标出了高原下方的一条地等温线。

e.en: Engineers traced the {geoisotherm} before drilling deeper.
e.zh: 工程师在继续深钻前追踪了那条等地温线。

e.en: The surveyor drew a {geoline} across the fault zone.
e.zh: 测量员在断层带上画出一条地质线。

e.en: Each {geoline} helped compare the old coastal layers.
e.zh: 每条地质线都有助于比较古老的海岸地层。

e.en: The exposed {geolith} dominated the barren ridge.
e.zh: 裸露的巨石占据了荒凉的山脊。

e.en: Researchers sampled the {geolith} for mineral analysis.
e.zh: 研究人员采集了这块地质岩体样本做矿物分析。

e.en: The {geologician} described the valley's ancient seabed.
e.zh: 这位地质学家描述了山谷古老的海床。

e.en: A careful {geologician} checked every rock sample twice.
e.zh: 一位严谨的地质学家把每块岩石样本都复查了两遍。

e.en: The lecturer tried to {geologize} every landscape feature.
e.zh: 讲师试图从地质角度解释每一种地貌特征。

e.en: Writers sometimes {geologize} history as layers of pressure.
e.zh: 作家有时把历史地质化，写成层层压力的沉积。

e.en: The report {geologized} the city's repeated floods.
e.zh: 报告从地质角度解释了这座城市反复发生的洪水。

e.en: Her essay {geologized} memory into strata of loss.
e.zh: 她的文章把记忆地质化，写成一层层失落的沉积。

e.en: He kept {geologizing} the coastline during the hike.
e.zh: 徒步时他一直从地质角度解释那片海岸。

e.en: The poet's {geologizing} language made grief feel sedimentary.
e.zh: 诗人地质化的语言让悲伤显得像沉积层一样。

e.en: The archive preserved a rare {geolograph} of the basin.
e.zh: 档案馆保存着一幅罕见的盆地地质图。

e.en: A clear {geolograph} can reveal buried structures.
e.zh: 清晰的地质记录图能显示地下构造。

e.en: The course introduces {geomagnetism} and plate movement.
e.zh: 这门课介绍地磁学和板块运动。

e.en: Changes in {geomagnetism} can affect compass readings.
e.zh: 地磁现象的变化会影响指南针读数。

e.en: The old paper used {geomalism} to explain root direction.
e.zh: 那篇旧论文用趋地性来解释根的生长方向。

e.en: His theory of {geomalism} is rarely cited today.
e.zh: 他关于受地球影响性的理论如今很少被引用。

e.en: The village {geomancer} chose the burial site.
e.zh: 村里的风水师选定了墓地。

e.en: A medieval {geomancer} read patterns in scattered earth.
e.zh: 中世纪的占地术士会解读撒落泥土中的图案。

e.en: The temple layout followed principles of {geomancy}.
e.zh: 寺庙布局遵循了风水术的原则。

e.en: In old Europe, {geomancy} was a form of divination.
e.zh: 在古代欧洲，占地术是一种占卜方式。

e.en: The house was placed for {geomantic} harmony.
e.zh: 这座房子按风水上的和谐来选址。

e.en: Scholars studied the text's {geomantic} diagrams.
e.zh: 学者研究了文本中的占地术图表。

e.en: Her thesis applied {geomathematics} to erosion models.
e.zh: 她的论文把地数学应用于侵蚀模型。

e.en: Modern {geomathematics} supports precise mapping systems.
e.zh: 现代地学数学支撑着精确的测绘系统。

e.en: The team built a {geomatical} model of the basin.
e.zh: 团队建立了一个盆地的地数学模型。

e.en: His {geomatical} approach improved the survey data.
e.zh: 他的地学数学方法改进了测量数据。

e.en: The tunnel design depends heavily on {geomechanics}.
e.zh: 隧道设计很大程度上依赖岩土力学。

e.en: Students used {geomechanics} to predict slope failure.
e.zh: 学生们用地质力学预测边坡失稳。

e.en: The study examined {geomedical} patterns in rural disease.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了农村疾病的地理医学模式。

e.en: A {geomedical} survey linked minerals to local health.
e.zh: 一项地医学调查把矿物质与当地健康联系起来。

e.en: She studies {geomedicine} in mountain communities.
e.zh: 她研究山区社区中的地理医学。

e.en: {Geomedicine} connects soil chemistry with public health.
e.zh: 地医学把土壤化学与公共健康联系起来。

e.en: The ancient {geometer} proved the theorem elegantly.
e.zh: 那位古代几何学家优雅地证明了这个定理。

e.en: A pale {geometer} rested on the window frame.
e.zh: 一只浅色尺蠖蛾停在窗框上。

e.en: The architect embraced {geometricism} in every facade.
e.zh: 这位建筑师在每个立面上都采用几何主义风格。

e.en: Critics saw cold {geometricism} in the painting.
e.zh: 评论家在这幅画中看到了冷峻的几何化倾向。

e.en: The child found a green {geometrid} on the leaf.
e.zh: 孩子在叶子上发现了一只绿色尺蠖蛾。

e.en: A {geometrid} larva moved in looping steps.
e.zh: 一条尺蛾科幼虫以拱起身体的方式移动。

e.en: The artist liked to {geometrise} human figures.
e.zh: 这位艺术家喜欢把人物形象几何化。

e.en: British writers may {geometrise} space in abstract prose.
e.zh: 英国作家可能在抽象散文中按几何方式处理空间。

e.en: His early sculptures show a strict {geometrism}.
e.zh: 他早期的雕塑呈现出严格的几何主义。

e.en: The philosopher defended {geometrism} as a method of truth.
e.zh: 这位哲学家把几何学说辩护为求真的方法。

e.en: The {geometrist} solved the problem with a diagram.
e.zh: 这位几何学家用一张图解出了问题。

e.en: As a {geometrist}, she cared about exact proportions.
e.zh: 作为几何学家，她很在意精确的比例。

e.en: The designer tried to {geometrize} the flower pattern.
e.zh: 设计师试图把花卉图案几何化。

e.en: Physicists sometimes {geometrize} gravity in modern theory.
e.zh: 物理学家有时在现代理论中按几何方式解释引力。

e.en: The artist {geometrized} the landscape into sharp planes.
e.zh: 艺术家把风景处理成锐利的几何平面。

e.en: The model {geometrized} the pattern for easier calculation.
e.zh: 这个模型把图案几何化，以便计算。

e.en: She is {geometrizing} the sketch into simple forms.
e.zh: 她正把草图几何化成简单形体。

e.en: The software helps with {geometrizing} complex surfaces.
e.zh: 这款软件有助于把复杂曲面几何化。

e.en: The paper used {geometronics} to describe spatial circuits.
e.zh: 论文用几何电子学来描述空间电路。

e.en: Few students had heard of {geometronics} before the seminar.
e.zh: 研讨会前，很少有学生听说过几何电子学。

e.en: Her thesis focused on {geomorphography} of coastal cliffs.
e.zh: 她的论文聚焦于海岸峭壁的地貌描述学。

e.en: Accurate {geomorphography} can support regional mapping.
e.zh: 准确的地貌描述学可以支持区域制图。

e.en: The valley shows clear {geomorphologic} evidence of glaciation.
e.zh: 这个山谷显示出明显的冰川作用地貌证据。

e.en: They compared the {geomorphologic} features of two river basins.
e.zh: 他们比较了两个流域的地貌学特征。

e.en: The island's {geomorphy} reflects repeated volcanic activity.
e.zh: 这座岛的地貌反映了反复的火山活动。

e.en: Local {geomorphy} affects where roads can be built.
e.zh: 当地地形形态会影响道路能够修建的位置。

e.en: The lab tested {geomycin} against several bacterial strains.
e.zh: 实验室用土霉素类抗生素测试了几种细菌菌株。

e.en: Old records mention {geomycin} as a veterinary treatment.
e.zh: 旧记录提到土霉素类抗生素曾用于兽医治疗。

e.en: The fossil may belong to a {geomyid} rodent.
e.zh: 这块化石可能属于一种囊鼠科啮齿动物。

e.en: Researchers mapped the {geomyid} burrows across the field.
e.zh: 研究人员绘制了田野中囊鼠科动物的洞穴分布。

geon.t: 地质年代单元；几何基元

e.en: The geologist used {geon} for a vast span of time.
e.zh: 地质学家用地质年代单元表示一段极长的时间。

e.en: In vision theory, a {geon} is a simple shape component.
e.zh: 在视觉理论中，几何基元是一种简单的形状组成部分。

e.en: Modern ships rely on {geonavigation} systems at sea.
e.zh: 现代船舶在海上依靠地理导航系统。

e.en: The course introduces {geonavigation} with maps and satellites.
e.zh: 这门课程用地图和卫星介绍地理导航。

e.en: The lecture treated {geonomy} as a study of land resources.
e.zh: 这场讲座把地球经济学视为土地资源研究。

e.en: His book on {geonomy} linked geography with public policy.
e.zh: 他关于地理经济的书把地理与公共政策联系起来。

e.en: The rock contains {geopetal} structures useful for orientation.
e.zh: 这块岩石含有可用于判断方向的古水平面指示构造。

e.en: A {geopetal} fabric can reveal which way was originally up.
e.zh: 指示古水平面的组构能显示原来的上方位置。

e.en: Doctors discussed {geophagy} during the nutrition assessment.
e.zh: 医生在营养评估中讨论了食土癖。

e.en: Some animals practice {geophagy} to obtain minerals.
e.zh: 有些动物会通过食土行为获取矿物质。

e.en: The botanist identified a {geophilous} plant near the quarry.
e.zh: 植物学家在采石场附近发现了一种喜土生长的植物。

e.en: Certain {geophilous} insects spend most of life underground.
e.zh: 某些喜土性的昆虫一生大多在地下度过。

e.en: They placed a {geophone} beside the test well.
e.zh: 他们在试验井旁放置了一台地震检波器。

e.en: The {geophone} detected vibrations from distant drilling.
e.zh: 地震检波器探测到了远处钻探产生的振动。

e.en: The survey team used {geophotogrammetry} to map the slope.
e.zh: 测量队用地面摄影测量学绘制了斜坡地图。

e.en: Advances in {geophotogrammetry} improved landslide monitoring.
e.zh: 地面摄影测量学的进展改善了滑坡监测。

e.en: A tulip is a familiar {geophyte} in spring gardens.
e.zh: 郁金香是春季花园里常见的地下芽植物。

e.en: The {geophyte} survives drought through its underground bulb.
e.zh: 这种地下芽植物靠地下鳞茎熬过干旱。

e.en: The meadow supports many {geophytic} species after winter.
e.zh: 这片草地在冬后生长着许多地下芽植物种类。

e.en: Their {geophytic} habit protects buds beneath the soil.
e.zh: 它们的地下芽植物习性保护芽体藏在土壤下。

e.en: The treaty had a strong {geopolitic} purpose.
e.zh: 这项条约带有强烈的地缘政治目的。

e.en: Analysts debated the {geopolitic} meaning of the port deal.
e.zh: 分析人士讨论了这项港口交易的地缘政治意义。

e.en: The {geopolitician} warned that borders could shift again.
e.zh: 这位地缘政治学者警告边界可能再次变化。

e.en: As a {geopolitician}, she studies power and territory.
e.zh: 作为地缘政治学者，她研究权力与领土。

e.en: The {geopolitist} wrote about sea routes and empire.
e.zh: 这位地缘政治研究者撰写海上航线与帝国的关系。

e.en: A careful {geopolitist} avoids simple maps of influence.
e.zh: 谨慎的地缘政治研究者会避免简单化的势力地图。

e.en: The manuscript preserves ancient {geoponic} advice for farmers.
e.zh: 这份手稿保存了给农民的古代农艺建议。

e.en: His {geoponic} interests included soil, vines, and irrigation.
e.zh: 他的农业兴趣包括土壤、葡萄藤和灌溉。

e.en: Classical {geoponics} covered planting, pruning, and harvests.
e.zh: 古典农业学涵盖播种、修剪和收获。

e.en: She studied {geoponics} through old Greek agricultural texts.
e.zh: 她通过古希腊农业文献研究农艺。

e.en: Meteorologists use {geopotential} to describe pressure surfaces.
e.zh: 气象学家用重力位来描述气压面。

e.en: The map shows {geopotential} height over the continent.
e.zh: 这张图显示了大陆上空的位势高度。

e.en: The chemist identified {gerallol} in the fragrance sample.
e.zh: 化学家在香料样品中鉴定出了香叶醇异构醇。

e.en: Synthetic {gerallol} can alter a perfume's floral note.
e.zh: 合成香叶醇异构醇会改变香水的花香调。

e.en: The paper describes {geramine} as a volatile amine.
e.zh: 论文把香叶胺描述为一种挥发性胺。

e.en: They tested {geramine} during the compound screening.
e.zh: 他们在化合物筛选中测试了香叶胺。

e.en: The botanist noted the plant's {geraniaceous} features.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这种植物具有牻牛儿苗科特征。

e.en: Its {geraniaceous} relatives often have scented leaves.
e.zh: 它的牻牛儿苗科近缘植物常有带香味的叶子。

e.en: {Geranial} gives lemon oil its sharp aroma.
e.zh: 香叶醛赋予柠檬油清冽的香气。

e.en: The sample contained both neral and {geranial}.
e.zh: 这个样品同时含有橙花醛和香叶醛。

e.en: Rose oil naturally contains {geraniol}.
e.zh: 玫瑰油天然含有香叶醇。

e.en: Some people react badly to {geraniol} in cosmetics.
e.zh: 有些人会对化妆品中的香叶醇产生不良反应。

e.en: The hotel {gerant} greeted every guest personally.
e.zh: 酒店经理亲自迎接每位客人。

e.en: A careful {gerant} kept the accounts balanced.
e.zh: 一位谨慎的管理者让账目保持平衡。

e.en: The clinic offered experimental {gerantotherapy} for frail patients.
e.zh: 诊所为体弱患者提供实验性老年病疗法。

e.en: Modern {gerantotherapy} focuses on function as well as disease.
e.zh: 现代老年病疗法不仅关注疾病，也关注身体功能。

e.en: The molecule contains a {geranyl} side chain.
e.zh: 这个分子含有一个香叶基侧链。

e.en: Researchers measured several {geranyl} esters in the oil.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了油中的几种香叶基酯。

e.en: The plant produces {geranyllinalool} under stress.
e.zh: 这种植物在受胁迫时会产生香叶基芳樟醇。

e.en: {Geranyllinalool} is a precursor of some defense compounds.
e.zh: 香叶基芳樟醇是某些防御性化合物的前体。

e.en: The lecture introduced several {geratologous} theories.
e.zh: 讲座介绍了几种关于衰老学的理论。

e.en: Her {geratologous} research examined aging cells.
e.zh: 她的衰老学研究考察了老化细胞。

e.en: He studied {geratology} before becoming a physician.
e.zh: 他成为医生前学习过衰老学。

e.en: {Geratology} examines how organisms change with age.
e.zh: 衰老学研究生物体如何随年龄变化。

e.en: She placed a red {gerbera} on the desk.
e.zh: 她把一朵红色非洲菊放在桌上。

e.en: The florist mixed {gerberas} with white lilies.
e.zh: 花艺师把非洲菊和白百合搭配在一起。

e.en: The {gerefa} collected dues for the lord.
e.zh: 这名郡长为领主征收应缴款项。

e.en: In old records, a {gerefa} appears as a local official.
e.zh: 在旧记录中，郡长是地方官员。

e.en: The estate's {gerent} signed the contract.
e.zh: 庄园的管理者签署了合同。

e.en: She acted as {gerent} during the owner's absence.
e.zh: 主人不在时，她担任管理者。

e.en: Critics called the council {gerentocratic}.
e.zh: 批评者称这个委员会是老人统治式的。

e.en: The party's {gerentocratic} culture discouraged younger leaders.
e.zh: 该党的老人统治文化压制了年轻领导者。

e.en: A {gerenuk} stood upright to reach the leaves.
e.zh: 一只长颈羚直立起来够树叶。

e.en: The guide spotted a {gerenuk} near the dry riverbed.
e.zh: 向导在干河床附近发现了一只长颈羚。

e.en: The falconer trained a young {gerfalcon}.
e.zh: 驯鹰人训练了一只年轻的矛隼。

e.en: A white {gerfalcon} swept across the tundra.
e.zh: 一只白色矛隼掠过苔原。

e.en: The cloak was made of rough {gerget}.
e.zh: 这件斗篷是用粗糙的粗布做成的。

e.en: Merchants sold {gerget} beside finer wool cloth.
e.zh: 商人在较精细的毛布旁出售粗布。

e.en: A {geriatrist} reviewed her medication list.
e.zh: 一位老年病医生审核了她的用药清单。

e.en: The hospital hired a {geriatrist} for its aging patients.
e.zh: 医院为老年患者聘请了一名老年病医生。

e.en: The old theory described a {geosyncline} filled with sediments.
e.zh: 旧理论描述了一个被沉积物填满的地槽。

e.en: A deep {geosyncline} once bordered the ancient continent.
e.zh: 一个深地槽曾经位于古大陆边缘。

e.en: Several {geosynclines} developed along the continental margin.
e.zh: 大陆边缘形成了几个地槽。

e.en: Textbooks once explained mountain belts through {geosynclines}.
e.zh: 教科书曾用地槽来解释山脉带的形成。

geotactic.t: 趋地性的；向重力移动的

e.en: The larvae showed a {geotactic} response in the tube.
e.zh: 幼虫在试管中表现出趋地性反应。

e.en: Researchers measured the cells' {geotactic} movement after stimulation.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了细胞受刺激后的趋地性运动。

e.en: The experiment tested {geotaxis} in tiny aquatic animals.
e.zh: 实验测试了微小水生动物的趋地性。

e.en: Negative {geotaxis} helps some insects climb upward after landing.
e.zh: 负趋地性帮助一些昆虫落地后向上爬。

geotechnical.t: 岩土工程的；土工技术的

e.en: The bridge project required a {geotechnical} survey first.
e.zh: 这座桥梁项目首先需要岩土工程勘察。

e.en: A {geotechnical} engineer assessed the slope's stability.
e.zh: 一名岩土工程师评估了边坡的稳定性。

e.en: Modern {geotechnics} combines soil mechanics and geology.
e.zh: 现代岩土工程学结合了土力学和地质学。

e.en: She studied {geotechnics} before working on tunnel design.
e.zh: 她先学习岩土工程学，后来从事隧道设计。

geotectonic.t: 大地构造的；地质构造的

e.en: The paper discussed the region's {geotectonic} history.
e.zh: 论文讨论了该地区的大地构造历史。

e.en: A {geotectonic} boundary can influence earthquake patterns.
e.zh: 大地构造边界会影响地震分布模式。

e.en: The islands are {geotectonically} linked to an active margin.
e.zh: 从大地构造上看，这些岛屿与活动大陆边缘相连。

e.en: The basin is {geotectonically} more complex than it appears.
e.zh: 从大地构造上看，这个盆地比表面上更复杂。

e.en: Plate theory transformed the study of {geotectonics}.
e.zh: 板块理论改变了大地构造学研究。

e.en: Regional {geotectonics} explains many of the area's faults.
e.zh: 区域地质构造解释了该地区许多断层。

e.en: The model used a {geotherm} to estimate mantle temperature.
e.zh: 该模型用地温曲线估算地幔温度。

e.en: A hotter {geotherm} can change the depth of melting.
e.zh: 更高温的地温曲线会改变熔融发生的深度。

e.en: The valley has strong {geothermic} activity beneath it.
e.zh: 这个山谷地下有强烈的地热活动。

e.en: Engineers studied the site's {geothermic} potential for heating.
e.zh: 工程师研究了该地点用于供暖的地热潜力。

e.en: Quartz can act as a {geothermometer} in some rocks.
e.zh: 石英在某些岩石中可作为地质温度计。

e.en: The mineral pair served as a reliable {geothermometer}.
e.zh: 这对矿物充当了可靠的地质温度计。

e.en: They used {geothermometry} to reconstruct ancient burial temperatures.
e.zh: 他们用地质温度测定法重建古代埋藏温度。

e.en: Isotope {geothermometry} helped estimate the fluid's origin.
e.zh: 同位素地质温度测定法帮助估算了流体来源。

e.en: The course introduced students to {geothermy} and heat flow.
e.zh: 这门课向学生介绍地热学和热流。

e.en: Local {geothermy} supports several natural hot springs.
e.zh: 当地地热现象支撑着几处天然温泉。

geotropic.t: 向地性的；受重力影响生长的

e.en: Roots usually show a positive {geotropic} response.
e.zh: 根通常表现出正向地性反应。

e.en: The seedling's {geotropic} growth changed after it was rotated.
e.zh: 幼苗被旋转后，其向地性生长发生了变化。

e.en: The roots bent {geotropically} toward the pull of gravity.
e.zh: 根以向地性方式朝重力方向弯曲。

e.en: Shoots and roots respond {geotropically} in opposite directions.
e.zh: 茎和根以相反方向作向地性反应。

e.en: Plant roots demonstrate {geotropism} as they grow downward.
e.zh: 植物根向下生长时表现出向地性。

e.en: The lesson compared {geotropism} with plants' response to light.
e.zh: 这节课把向地性与植物对光的反应作了比较。

e.en: The geologist described the strange swelling as a {geotumor}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这个奇特隆起描述为地质肿瘤样构造。

e.en: A {geotumor} may resemble a tumor in rock layers.
e.zh: 地质肿瘤样构造可能看起来像岩层中的肿瘤。

e.en: Her {gephyrophobia} made long road trips difficult.
e.zh: 她的桥梁恐惧症让长途自驾变得困难。

e.en: Therapy helped him manage {gephyrophobia} on highway bridges.
e.zh: 治疗帮助他应对高速公路桥上的桥梁恐惧症。

e.en: The physician wrote about {geracomia} in an old medical text.
e.zh: 这位医生在一本文字古旧的医学书中写到老年护理。

e.en: Modern care homes practice a form of {geracomia}.
e.zh: 现代养老院实践着一种老年照护。

e.en: The charity founded a {geracomium} for poor elders.
e.zh: 这家慈善机构为贫困老人建立了一所养老院。

e.en: An ancient {geracomium} offered shelter and basic care.
e.zh: 古代的老人收容所提供住所和基本照护。

gerah.t: 季拉；古希伯来小重量单位

e.en: A {gerah} was a small ancient Hebrew weight.
e.zh: 季拉是一种古希伯来小重量单位。

e.en: The text valued the silver at one {gerah}.
e.zh: 文中把这块银子的重量记为一季拉。

e.en: The specimen contained visible crystals of {gersdorffite}.
e.zh: 这个标本含有肉眼可见的辉砷镍矿晶体。

e.en: Miners identified {gersdorffite} in the nickel-rich vein.
e.zh: 矿工在富含镍的矿脉中发现了辉砷镍矿。

e.en: He shouted, "{Gertcha}!" at the noisy kids outside.
e.zh: 他冲外面吵闹的孩子喊道：“滚开！”

e.en: The old song repeats {gertcha} in a comic chorus.
e.zh: 那首老歌在滑稽的副歌里反复唱着“走开”。

e.en: The editor was a notorious {gerund-grinder} at meetings.
e.zh: 那位编辑在会上是出了名的死抠语法的人。

e.en: Only a {gerund-grinder} would object to that casual phrase.
e.zh: 只有死抠语法的人才会反对那个随口说的短语。

e.en: My teacher sounded like a {gerundgrinder} today.
e.zh: 我的老师今天听起来像个死抠语法的人。

e.en: The review mocked him as a {gerundgrinder}.
e.zh: 那篇评论嘲笑他是个死抠语法的人。

e.en: The phrase has a {gerundial} function in the sentence.
e.zh: 这个短语在句子中起动名词作用。

e.en: Students practiced several {gerundial} constructions after class.
e.zh: 学生们课后练习了几种动名词结构。

gerundival.t: 动形词的；动名词性形容词的

e.en: Latin grammar gives special rules for {gerundival} phrases.
e.zh: 拉丁语语法对动形词短语有专门规则。

e.en: The translator missed the {gerundival} force of the clause.
e.zh: 译者没有把握住这个从句的动形词意味。

e.en: The Latin {gerundive} often implies obligation.
e.zh: 拉丁语动形词常常含有义务的意思。

e.en: She explained the {gerundive} form with several examples.
e.zh: 她用几个例子解释了动形词形式。

e.en: The verb is used {gerundively} in this rare construction.
e.zh: 这个动词在这种罕见结构中以动形词方式使用。

e.en: He analyzed the phrase {gerundively}, not as a simple adjective.
e.zh: 他把这个短语按动形词方式分析，而不是当作普通形容词。

e.en: English {gerunds} often end in -ing.
e.zh: 英语动名词通常以 -ing 结尾。

e.en: She listed three {gerunds} in her grammar notes.
e.zh: 她在语法笔记里列出了三个动名词。

e.en: The monk earned the title of {geshe} after years of study.
e.zh: 那位僧人经过多年学习获得了格西称号。

e.en: A {geshe} explained the debate tradition to visitors.
e.zh: 一位格西向访客解释了辩经传统。

e.en: The greenhouse kept a rare {gesneria} in bloom.
e.zh: 温室里养着一株正在开花的珍稀苦苣苔类植物。

e.en: She painted the red flowers of the {gesneria}.
e.zh: 她画下了那株苦苣苔类植物的红色花朵。

e.en: The medieval {gest} celebrated a warrior's deeds.
e.zh: 这首中世纪故事诗歌颂了一位武士的事迹。

e.en: He studied an old {gest} preserved in manuscript form.
e.zh: 他研究了一篇以手稿形式保存下来的古老英雄故事。

e.en: The drug acts like a synthetic {gestagen}.
e.zh: 这种药物的作用类似合成孕激素类物质。

e.en: Researchers measured {gestagen} levels during the trial.
e.zh: 研究人员在试验期间测量了孕激素类物质水平。

e.en: A {gestaltist} would focus on the whole pattern.
e.zh: 格式塔心理学家会关注整体模式。

e.en: The therapist described herself as a {gestaltist}.
e.zh: 那位治疗师称自己是格式塔取向的心理学家。

e.en: The lab used {germproof} packaging for the samples.
e.zh: 实验室用防菌包装保存这些样本。

e.en: No kitchen surface is completely {germproof}.
e.zh: 没有哪种厨房表面能完全抗菌。

e.en: The botanist examined the tiny {germule} under a lens.
e.zh: 植物学家在放大镜下观察那枚细小的胚芽。

e.en: A damaged {germule} may stop the seed from sprouting.
e.zh: 胚芽受损可能会使种子无法发芽。

e.en: Wash your hands after touching that {germy} rail.
e.zh: 碰过那根沾满细菌的扶手后要洗手。

e.en: The children joked about the {germy} old sponge.
e.zh: 孩子们拿那块不卫生的旧海绵开玩笑。

e.en: The paper described a new {germyl} compound.
e.zh: 论文描述了一种新的锗烷基化合物。

e.en: They measured how the {germyl} group affected stability.
e.zh: 他们测量了锗烷基基团对稳定性的影响。

e.en: I would {gern} help, if time allowed.
e.zh: 如果时间允许，我很愿意帮忙。

e.en: The old poem says he did it {gern}.
e.zh: 那首古诗说他是欣然做这件事的。

e.en: The charity opened a small {gerocomium} near the church.
e.zh: 慈善机构在教堂附近开了一家小型养老院。

e.en: Records from the {gerocomium} mention daily medical visits.
e.zh: 那家老人照护所的记录提到每天都有医生探访。

e.en: Her lecture focused on {gerocomy} in rural communities.
e.zh: 她的讲座重点讨论农村社区的老人护理。

e.en: Good {gerocomy} requires patience as well as training.
e.zh: 良好的养老照护既需要培训，也需要耐心。

e.en: The dermatologist diagnosed mild {gerodermia} in the patient.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生诊断患者有轻度老年性皮肤萎缩。

e.en: Sun exposure can worsen symptoms of {gerodermia}.
e.zh: 日晒可能会加重老年性皮肤萎缩的症状。

e.en: She chose {gerodontics} as her dental specialty.
e.zh: 她选择老年牙科学作为自己的牙科专业方向。

e.en: Modern {gerodontics} considers nutrition and medication use.
e.zh: 现代老年牙科学会考虑营养和用药情况。

e.en: The manual treats {gerokomy} as a serious medical duty.
e.zh: 这本手册把老人护理视为严肃的医疗职责。

e.en: In ancient texts, {gerokomy} included diet and comfort.
e.zh: 在古代文献中，养老照料包括饮食和安适照护。

e.en: The fossil showed signs of {geromorphism}.
e.zh: 这块化石显示出老年形态的迹象。

e.en: Biologists debated whether the trait was true {geromorphism}.
e.zh: 生物学家争论这种特征是否是真正的衰老样形态。

e.en: The clinic added a {gerontic} care unit.
e.zh: 这家诊所增设了老年护理科室。

e.en: Her research examines {gerontic} changes in memory.
e.zh: 她的研究考察记忆方面的老年变化。

e.en: He published several essays on {gerontics}.
e.zh: 他发表了几篇关于老年学的文章。

e.en: The course in {gerontics} covers health and housing.
e.zh: 这门老人问题研究课程涵盖健康和住房。

e.en: The novel gives the king a {gerontine} dignity.
e.zh: 小说赋予国王一种老者般的威严。

e.en: His {gerontine} face still carried a sharp smile.
e.zh: 他衰老的脸上仍带着敏锐的笑意。

e.en: The young activists criticized the ruling {gerontocrat}.
e.zh: 年轻活动人士批评那位掌权的老人政治人物。

e.en: A careful {gerontocrat} may still resist needed reform.
e.zh: 谨慎的老人政治掌权者仍可能抵制必要改革。

e.en: The party had a deeply {gerontocratic} leadership.
e.zh: 该党的领导层带有浓厚的老人政治色彩。

e.en: Critics called the council {gerontocratic} and unresponsive.
e.zh: 批评者称这个委员会老人政治化且反应迟钝。

gerontogeic.t: 老年发生的；晚年形成的

e.en: The doctor described the condition as {gerontogeic}.
e.zh: 医生把这种状况描述为老年发生的。

e.en: Some {gerontogeic} traits appear only late in life.
e.zh: 有些晚年形成的特征只在人生后期出现。

gerontogeous.t: 老年发生的；源于老年的

e.en: The report noted several {gerontogeous} symptoms.
e.zh: 报告记录了几种源于老年的症状。

e.en: Researchers separated inherited defects from {gerontogeous} changes.
e.zh: 研究人员把遗传缺陷与老年发生的变化区分开来。

e.en: The hospital expanded its {gerontologic} research program.
e.zh: 医院扩大了老年学研究项目。

e.en: Her {gerontologic} work influenced public health policy.
e.zh: 她的老年学工作影响了公共卫生政策。

e.en: The article discusses {gerontomorphosis} in several species.
e.zh: 文章讨论了几个物种中的老年形态变化。

e.en: They mistook normal wear for {gerontomorphosis}.
e.zh: 他们把正常磨损误认为老年形态变化。

e.en: The case study described the patient as a {gerontophil}.
e.zh: 病例研究把这名患者描述为爱慕老年者的人。

e.en: A {gerontophil} may seek relationships with much older partners.
e.zh: 爱慕老年者的人可能会寻找年长许多的伴侣。

e.en: The psychiatrist wrote cautiously about {gerontophilia}.
e.zh: 精神科医生谨慎地写到了恋老癖。

e.en: Public discussion of {gerontophilia} is often confused.
e.zh: 公众对爱慕老人倾向的讨论常常很混乱。

e.en: The campaign challenged everyday {gerontophobia}.
e.zh: 这场宣传活动挑战日常生活中的恐老症。

e.en: Her {gerontophobia} made nursing-home visits difficult.
e.zh: 她对老人的恐惧使养老院探访变得困难。

e.en: The old doorway was hung with a {gerland} of flowers.
e.zh: 那扇旧门上挂着一串花环。

e.en: She painted a bright {gerland} around the mirror.
e.zh: 她在镜子周围画了一圈明亮的花冠装饰。

german-american.t: 德裔美国的；德裔美国人

e.en: Her {German-American} family kept several old holiday traditions.
e.zh: 她的德裔美国家庭保留了几项旧节日传统。

e.en: A {German-American} spoke about migration history at the museum.
e.zh: 一位德裔美国人在博物馆谈了移民历史。

e.en: Many {German-Americans} settled in the Midwest during the nineteenth century.
e.zh: 许多德裔美国人在十九世纪定居于美国中西部。

e.en: The exhibit explores how {German-Americans} shaped local music.
e.zh: 这个展览探讨德裔美国人如何影响当地音乐。

e.en: The gardener planted {germander} along the sunny path.
e.zh: 园丁在阳光充足的小路旁种了石蚕草。

e.en: Dried {germander} was once used in bitter herbal remedies.
e.zh: 干石蚕草过去曾用于味苦的草药方中。

e.en: The lab tested a new {germanide} for electronic applications.
e.zh: 实验室测试了一种用于电子应用的新锗化物。

e.en: This {germanide} remains stable at high temperatures.
e.zh: 这种锗化物在高温下仍保持稳定。

e.en: The collection includes a small specimen of {germanite}.
e.zh: 这批收藏里有一小块硫锗铜矿标本。

e.en: Miners valued {germanite} as a source of germanium.
e.zh: 矿工把硫锗铜矿视为锗的一种来源。

e.en: The family name was {Germanized} after they moved north.
e.zh: 他们搬到北方后，家族姓氏被德语化了。

e.en: Some villages became heavily {Germanized} under the empire.
e.zh: 一些村庄在帝国统治下变得高度德国化。

e.en: Officials were accused of {Germanizing} local school instruction.
e.zh: 官员被指责在当地学校教育中推行德语化。

e.en: The editor was {Germanizing} foreign names for the old atlas.
e.zh: 编辑正在为那本旧地图集把外国名字德语化。

e.en: The chemist prepared a {germanous} compound in the hood.
e.zh: 化学家在通风橱中制备了一种亚锗化合物。

e.en: Older papers describe {germanous} salts in careful detail.
e.zh: 早期论文细致描述了二价锗盐。

e.en: The botanist examined the {germen} under a small lens.
e.zh: 植物学家用小透镜观察胚芽。

e.en: A healthy {germen} soon pushed through the seed coat.
e.zh: 健康的胚芽很快顶破了种皮。

e.en: Several {germens} were visible inside the soaked seeds.
e.zh: 浸泡后的种子里可以看到几个胚芽。

e.en: The study compared {germens} from two wheat varieties.
e.zh: 这项研究比较了两个小麦品种的胚芽。

e.en: The mice were raised in a {germfree} environment.
e.zh: 这些小鼠是在无菌环境中饲养的。

e.en: A {germfree} surface is essential for this experiment.
e.zh: 这个实验必须使用无菌表面。

e.en: The clinic uses {germicidal} lamps after closing.
e.zh: 诊所关门后会使用杀菌灯。

e.en: This cleaner has a strong {germicidal} effect on surfaces.
e.zh: 这种清洁剂对物体表面有很强的杀菌作用。

e.en: The course introduced basic {germiculture} techniques to nurses.
e.zh: 这门课向护士介绍了基础的细菌培养技术。

e.en: Careless {germiculture} can contaminate the whole sample tray.
e.zh: 粗心的微生物培养会污染整盘样本。

e.en: Storage temperature affected the seeds' {germinability}.
e.zh: 储存温度影响了这些种子的发芽能力。

e.en: The report measured {germinability} after six months of drought.
e.zh: 报告测量了六个月干旱后的可萌发性。

e.en: Only the {germinable} seeds were kept for planting.
e.zh: 只有能发芽的种子被留下来播种。

e.en: The cold treatment made more spores {germinable}.
e.zh: 低温处理使更多孢子具备萌发能力。

e.en: The {germinant} seedling bent toward the window.
e.zh: 正在发芽的幼苗朝窗户弯去。

e.en: The solution acted as a {germinant} for dormant spores.
e.zh: 这种溶液充当了休眠孢子的促萌发物。

e.en: The seeds showed strong {germinative} power in spring.
e.zh: 这些种子在春天表现出很强的发芽能力。

e.en: Moisture triggers the grain's {germinative} process.
e.zh: 水分会启动谷粒的萌发过程。

e.en: The farm bought a small {germinator} for barley tests.
e.zh: 农场买了一台小型发芽器来测试大麦。

e.en: She cleaned the {germinator} before starting a new batch.
e.zh: 她在开始新一批种子前清洁了催芽装置。

e.en: The textbook describes {germiparity} in certain simple organisms.
e.zh: 教材描述了某些简单生物中的芽生繁殖。

e.en: Researchers debated whether the process was true {germiparity}.
e.zh: 研究人员争论这一过程是否是真正的萌芽生殖。

e.en: The mill produced {germless} flour for longer storage.
e.zh: 磨坊生产无胚芽面粉以便更久保存。

e.en: They tried to keep the chamber completely {germless}.
e.zh: 他们试图让这个舱室保持完全无菌。

e.en: A tiny {germling} emerged from the fungal spore.
e.zh: 一个微小的幼体从真菌孢子中长出。

e.en: Each {germling} was transferred to fresh soil.
e.zh: 每株幼芽都被移到新土里。

gestatory.t: 与怀孕或孕育有关的动作性

e.en: The old textbook used {gestatory} to describe movements related to pregnancy.
e.zh: 那本旧教材用gestatory来描述与怀孕有关的动作。

e.en: A specialist might call the response {gestatory} in a very technical report.
e.zh: 专家可能会在非常专业的报告中把这种反应称为孕育相关的。

e.en: The actor relied on {gestic} expression rather than dialogue.
e.zh: 那位演员依靠手势性的表达，而不是台词。

e.en: Her performance had a sharp, almost {gestic} rhythm.
e.zh: 她的表演节奏鲜明，几乎带有强烈的姿态感。

gesticulant.t: 做手势的人；手势丰富的

e.en: The {gesticulant} speaker drew attention before saying a word.
e.zh: 那位手势丰富的演讲者还没开口就吸引了注意。

e.en: In the sketch, a {gesticulant} stands beside a silent judge.
e.zh: 在那幅速写里，一个做手势的人站在沉默的法官旁边。

e.en: The dancer developed a {gesticular} language for the piece.
e.zh: 舞者为这部作品发展出一种手势化的语言。

e.en: His {gesticular} habits made every explanation seem dramatic.
e.zh: 他的手势习惯让每次解释都显得很戏剧化。

e.en: She became more {gesticulative} as the debate grew heated.
e.zh: 辩论越激烈，她就越爱打手势。

e.en: The director wanted a {gesticulative} style, full of visible emotion.
e.zh: 导演想要一种手势感很强、情绪外露的风格。

gesticulator.t: 打手势的人；手舞足蹈者

e.en: A loud {gesticulator} blocked the doorway during the argument.
e.zh: 争吵时，一个大声打手势的人挡住了门口。

e.en: The teacher was a born {gesticulator}, turning grammar into theater.
e.zh: 那位老师天生爱打手势，把语法课讲得像戏剧。

e.en: His {gesticulatory} style made the lecture surprisingly lively.
e.zh: 他打手势式的讲课风格让讲座意外地生动。

e.en: The paper analyzes {gesticulatory} signals in political speeches.
e.zh: 这篇论文分析政治演讲中的手势信号。

e.en: The report criticized the poor {gestion} of public funds.
e.zh: 报告批评了公共资金管理不善。

e.en: In French business writing, {gestion} often refers to management.
e.zh: 在法语商务写作中，gestion常指管理。

gestodene.t: 孕二烯酮；避孕用孕激素

e.en: The pill contains {gestodene} as one of its hormones.
e.zh: 这种药丸含有孕二烯酮作为其中一种激素。

e.en: A doctor explained the possible side effects of {gestodene}.
e.zh: 医生解释了孕二烯酮可能产生的副作用。

e.en: The clinic monitored her carefully for signs of {gestosis}.
e.zh: 诊所仔细监测她是否有妊娠中毒症的迹象。

e.en: Older medical books may use {gestosis} for pregnancy complications.
e.zh: 较旧的医学书可能用gestosis指妊娠并发症。

e.en: The specialist prescribed {gestrinone} for severe endometriosis.
e.zh: 专科医生开了孕三烯酮来治疗严重的子宫内膜异位症。

e.en: Athletes are tested for {gestrinone} because it can be misused.
e.zh: 运动员会接受孕三烯酮检测，因为它可能被滥用。

gestureless.t: 没有手势的；毫无姿态的

e.en: He gave a flat, {gestureless} apology to the room.
e.zh: 他毫无手势、语气平淡地向全屋人道歉。

e.en: The statue's {gestureless} pose makes it feel strangely distant.
e.zh: 雕像没有姿态变化的姿势让它显得异常疏离。

gesundheit.t: 打喷嚏后说的祝你健康

e.en: When I sneezed, Maria said {gesundheit} from across the room.
e.zh: 我打喷嚏时，玛丽亚在房间另一头说了声祝你健康。

e.en: He muttered {gesundheit} automatically and kept reading.
e.zh: 他下意识嘟囔了一句祝你健康，然后继续读书。

e.en: Keep the documents {get-at-able} during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时把文件放在随手够得着的地方。

e.en: The truth was barely {get-at-able} through all the legal language.
e.zh: 透过那些法律措辞，真相几乎难以触及。

e.en: The thief tried to {get-away} through the back door.
e.zh: 小偷试图从后门逃走。

e.en: We planned a quiet {get-away} by the lake.
e.zh: 我们计划去湖边安静地度个短假。

e.en: The rules were clear from the {get-go}.
e.zh: 规则从一开始就很清楚。

e.en: She questioned the project at the {get-go}.
e.zh: 她在项目一开始就提出了质疑。

e.en: We should {get-off} at the next stop.
e.zh: 我们应该在下一站下车。

e.en: The lawyer helped him {get-off} with a warning.
e.zh: 律师帮他只受到警告就免于更重处罚。

e.en: Please {get-out} of the kitchen while I clean.
e.zh: 我打扫时请你离开厨房。

e.en: He used work as a {get-out} from dinner.
e.zh: 他拿工作当借口不去吃晚饭。

get-rich-quick.t: 快速致富的；暴富骗局式的

e.en: They lost money in a {get-rich-quick} scheme.
e.zh: 他们在一个快速致富骗局里亏了钱。

e.en: Ignore any {get-rich-quick} advice that promises no risk.
e.zh: 别理那些声称毫无风险的暴富建议。

e.en: We're having a family {get-together} on Sunday.
e.zh: 我们星期天有个家庭聚会。

e.en: Let's {get-together} next week to discuss the contract.
e.zh: 我们下周碰个头讨论合同吧。

e.en: Their monthly {get-togethers} always include homemade food.
e.zh: 他们每月的聚会总会有自家做的食物。

e.en: Small {get-togethers} helped the new students make friends.
e.zh: 小型聚会帮助新生结交朋友。

e.en: I usually {get-up} before seven on weekdays.
e.zh: 工作日我通常七点前起床。

e.en: Her bright festival {get-up} caught everyone's eye.
e.zh: 她鲜艳的节日装束吸引了所有人的目光。

e.en: His {get-up-and-get} impressed the hiring manager.
e.zh: 他的干劲给招聘经理留下了深刻印象。

e.en: After the illness, she slowly recovered her {get-up-and-get}.
e.zh: 病后，她慢慢恢复了原来的精力和冲劲。

e.en: You need real {get-up-and-go} to start a company.
e.zh: 创业需要真正的精力和干劲。

e.en: By Friday afternoon, my {get-up-and-go} had disappeared.
e.zh: 到星期五下午，我的干劲已经消失了。

e.en: The performers wore ridiculous {get-ups} for the comedy show.
e.zh: 表演者为喜剧节目穿了滑稽的装束。

e.en: Old photos show the strange {get-ups} people wore then.
e.zh: 老照片展示了当时人们穿的奇特打扮。

e.en: The travelers hired a {gharry} outside the station.
e.zh: 旅客们在车站外雇了一辆印度马车。

e.en: An old {gharry} rattled through the dusty street.
e.zh: 一辆旧式轻便马车哐当作响地穿过尘土飞扬的街道。

ghast.t: 可怕的人或物；恐怖形象

e.en: The tale described a {ghast} haunting the ruined chapel.
e.zh: 故事描写了一个恐怖形象在废弃礼拜堂出没。

e.en: To the children, the masked actor seemed a real {ghast}.
e.zh: 在孩子们看来，那个戴面具的演员像个真正的可怕怪物。

ghastful.t: 可怕的；令人毛骨悚然的

e.en: A {ghastful} silence followed the scream.
e.zh: 尖叫过后是一阵令人毛骨悚然的寂静。

e.en: The old report gave a {ghastful} account of the accident.
e.zh: 那份旧报告对事故作了可怕的描述。

e.en: The {ghastliness} of the scene shocked even the police.
e.zh: 现场的恐怖程度连警察都感到震惊。

e.en: She tried to describe the {ghastliness} of waiting for news.
e.zh: 她试着描述等待消息时那种可怕的煎熬。

e.en: The caravan crossed the {ghaut} before sunset.
e.zh: 商队在日落前穿过了山口。

e.en: Pilgrims gathered on the {ghaut} beside the river.
e.zh: 朝圣者聚集在河边的阶梯码头上。

e.en: She translated a Persian {ghazal} for the poetry class.
e.zh: 她为诗歌课翻译了一首波斯加扎勒抒情诗。

e.en: His new song borrows the structure of a {ghazal}.
e.zh: 他的新歌借用了加扎勒诗的结构。

e.en: The chronicle praised him as a fearless {ghazi}.
e.zh: 编年史称赞他是一位无畏的伊斯兰勇士。

e.en: In that region, {ghazi} became an honorific title.
e.zh: 在那个地区，ghazi 成了一种荣誉称号。

e.en: The workers staged a {gherao} outside the manager's office.
e.zh: 工人们在经理办公室外发起围堵抗议。

e.en: Officials feared the meeting would end in a {gherao}.
e.zh: 官员们担心会议会以围困施压收场。

ghettoise.t: 使隔离成贫民区；边缘化

e.en: The policy may {ghettoise} poorer families in one district.
e.zh: 这项政策可能把较贫困家庭隔离在一个地区。

e.en: Critics say the label can {ghettoise} minority writers.
e.zh: 批评者说这个标签可能会边缘化少数族裔作家。

e.en: The {ghettologist} interviewed residents for his urban study.
e.zh: 这位贫民区研究者为城市研究采访了居民。

e.en: A careful {ghettologist} avoids treating poverty as spectacle.
e.zh: 严谨的贫民区研究者会避免把贫困当成奇观。

ghettorize.t: 使隔离成贫民区；使边缘化

e.en: Bad planning can {ghettorize} entire communities.
e.zh: 糟糕的规划可能使整个社区被隔离成贫民区。

e.en: The debate asked whether schools {ghettorize} immigrant children.
e.zh: 这场辩论讨论学校是否会边缘化移民儿童。

ghey.t: 同性恋的戏谑拼法；娘气的

e.en: He used {ghey} online as a joking spelling of gay.
e.zh: 他在网上把 ghey 当作 gay 的玩笑拼法。

e.en: The insult {ghey} is childish and offensive in that forum.
e.zh: 在那个论坛里，用 ghey 侮辱人既幼稚又冒犯。

e.en: The cook warmed the spices in {ghi}.
e.zh: 厨师用印度酥油加热香料。

e.en: A spoonful of {ghi} made the rice richer.
e.zh: 一勺印度酥油让米饭更香更浓郁。

ghibli.t: 利比亚热风；撒哈拉热风

e.en: A hot {ghibli} swept across the desert camp.
e.zh: 一阵利比亚热风掠过沙漠营地。

e.en: The sailors blamed the dust on the {ghibli}.
e.zh: 水手们把尘土归咎于那阵撒哈拉热风。

e.en: The {ghillie} showed us where salmon often rested.
e.zh: 钓猎向导带我们看鲑鱼常停留的地方。

e.en: The sniper wore a {ghillie} suit in the grass.
e.zh: 狙击手在草丛里穿着吉利伪装服。

e.en: She agreed to {ghost-write} the athlete's memoir.
e.zh: 她同意为那名运动员的回忆录代笔。

e.en: Some consultants {ghost-write} speeches for busy executives.
e.zh: 一些顾问会为忙碌的高管代写演讲稿。

e.en: The celebrity hired a {ghost-writer} for her autobiography.
e.zh: 那位名人请了一名代笔作者写自传。

e.en: A good {ghost-writer} captures the client's natural voice.
e.zh: 优秀的影子写手能把握客户自然的表达方式。

e.en: Many politicians rely on {ghost-writers} for campaign books.
e.zh: 许多政治人物依靠代笔作者撰写竞选书籍。

e.en: The agency matches {ghost-writers} with business leaders.
e.zh: 这家机构为商界领袖匹配影子写手。

e.en: He made a living from {ghost-writing} celebrity memoirs.
e.zh: 他靠为名人回忆录代笔写作为生。

e.en: The university treats undisclosed {ghost-writing} as misconduct.
e.zh: 大学把未披露的影子写作视为不当行为。

e.en: Farmers used {gibberellin} to improve grape growth.
e.zh: 农民使用赤霉素来促进葡萄生长。

e.en: The biology class tested how {gibberellin} affects seedlings.
e.zh: 生物课测试了赤霉素对幼苗的影响。

e.en: The paper described {gibberene} as a plant compound.
e.zh: 论文把赤霉烯描述为一种植物化合物。

e.en: Few students had heard of {gibberene} before the lecture.
e.zh: 讲座之前很少有学生听说过赤霉烯。

e.en: He carried a {gibbie} for catching fish in shallow water.
e.zh: 他带着鱼叉在浅水里捕鱼。

e.en: The old {gibbie} hung beside the boat shed.
e.zh: 那把旧小钩挂在船棚旁边。

e.en: Stop that {gibble-gabble} and answer clearly.

e.en: The crew set a {gillnet} before sunrise.
e.zh: 船员们在日出前布下了一张刺网。

e.en: Conservationists warned that the {gillnet} could trap dolphins.
e.zh: 环保人士警告说，流刺网可能会困住海豚。

e.en: The archive contains prints made by {gillotage}.
e.zh: 档案馆里收藏着用雕版印刷法制作的版画。

e.en: Few modern artists still practice {gillotage} by hand.
e.zh: 如今很少有艺术家还手工使用这种雕版印刷法。

e.en: She planted {gillyflowers} along the cottage wall.
e.zh: 她沿着小屋墙边种了一排紫罗兰。

e.en: The old recipe was scented with {gillyflower} petals.
e.zh: 这个老配方用康乃馨类花瓣来增香。

e.en: She opened a {gilt-edged} invitation from the palace.
e.zh: 她打开了一封来自宫里的镀金边请柬。

e.en: The pension fund prefers {gilt-edged} investments.
e.zh: 这家养老基金偏好一流可靠的投资。

e.en: The restaurant served grilled {gilthead} with lemon.
e.zh: 餐厅供应配柠檬的烤金头鲷。

e.en: A fresh {gilthead} lay on the fishmonger's counter.
e.zh: 鱼贩的柜台上摆着一条新鲜的金头鲷。

e.en: The mirror had an ornate {giltwood} frame.
e.zh: 那面镜子有一个华丽的镀金木框。

e.en: Collectors paid highly for the antique {giltwood}.
e.zh: 收藏家们为那件古董镀金木器出了高价。

e.en: The compass hung inside a {gimbalsring} on the boat.
e.zh: 船上的罗盘悬在一个万向环里。

e.en: A damaged {gimbalsring} made the instrument tilt badly.
e.zh: 损坏的平衡环让仪器严重倾斜。

e.en: The shelf was crowded with cheap {gimcrackery}.
e.zh: 架子上挤满了廉价又华而不实的小玩意。

e.en: He dismissed the new feature as digital {gimcrackery}.
e.zh: 他把那个新功能贬作华而不实的数字噱头。

gimcracky.t: 华而不实的；劣质花哨的

e.en: The hotel lobby had a {gimcracky} fountain.
e.zh: 酒店大堂里有个花哨却廉价的喷泉。

e.en: She avoided {gimcracky} souvenirs at the airport.
e.zh: 她没有买机场里那些华而不实的纪念品。

e.en: The child wrote {gimel} beside the other Hebrew letters.
e.zh: 孩子把希伯来字母gimel写在其他字母旁边。

e.en: In the lesson, {gimel} came after beth.
e.zh: 在那堂课上，gimel排在beth后面。

e.en: The {gimlet-eyed} editor found every inconsistency.
e.zh: 那位目光锐利的编辑发现了每一个前后不一致处。

e.en: A {gimlet-eyed} guard watched the crowd closely.
e.zh: 一名目光锐利的警卫密切注视着人群。

e.en: The museum displayed a medieval {gimmal} ring.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一枚中世纪连环戒指。

e.en: A tiny {gimmal} joined the two metal parts.
e.zh: 一个小小的铰接环把两个金属部件连在一起。

e.en: {Gimme} a minute to find my keys.
e.zh: 给我一分钟找钥匙。

e.en: That short putt should be a {gimme}.
e.zh: 那记短推杆应该是很容易进的球。

e.en: The campaign relied on {gimmickery} instead of policy.
e.zh: 这场竞选靠的是噱头花招，而不是政策。

e.en: Good design should solve problems, not hide behind {gimmickery}.
e.zh: 好的设计应当解决问题，而不是躲在花招伎俩后面。

e.en: The final question was a complete {gimmie}.
e.zh: 最后一道题完全是送分题。

e.en: He missed a {gimmie} from two feet away.
e.zh: 他在两英尺外错失了一个稳进球。

e.en: She ordered a {gin-and-tonic} at the bar.
e.zh: 她在酒吧点了一杯金汤力鸡尾酒。

e.en: A cold {gin-and-tonic} suited the summer evening.
e.zh: 一杯冰凉的金汤力很适合这个夏夜。

gin-palace.t: 豪华酒馆；老式杜松子酒馆

e.en: The Victorian {gin-palace} glittered with mirrors and brass.
e.zh: 那家维多利亚时代的豪华酒馆里镜子和黄铜闪闪发亮。

e.en: Tourists photographed the old {gin-palace} on the corner.
e.zh: 游客们拍下了街角那家老式杜松子酒馆。

e.en: The capoeira teacher showed us the basic {ginga}.
e.zh: 卡波耶拉老师给我们示范了基本的摇摆步法。

e.en: Her {ginga} kept her balanced during the sparring drill.
e.zh: 她的摇摆步法让她在对练中保持了平衡。

e.en: The cook flavored the stew with {gingelli} oil.
e.zh: 厨师用芝麻油给炖菜调味。

e.en: Old trade records mention {gingelli} among the imported seeds.
e.zh: 旧贸易记录把芝麻列在进口种子之中。

e.en: The children played {ginger-race} after tea.
e.zh: 孩子们喝完茶后玩起了追逐姜饼人的游戏。

e.en: A village fair once included a lively {ginger-race}.
e.zh: 过去有个乡村集市曾安排过热闹的追姜饼人游戏。

e.en: She poured cold {gingerade} into two glasses.
e.zh: 她把冰姜味饮料倒进两个杯子里。

e.en: The recipe says {gingerade} should be sharp but sweet.
e.zh: 食谱说姜味饮料应该有辛辣感但也要甜。

e.en: The kitchen smelled warm and {gingerbready}.
e.zh: 厨房里有一股温暖的姜饼香气。

e.en: He chose a dark, {gingerbready} shade for the holiday icing.
e.zh: 他给节日糖霜选了一种深色、像姜饼的色调。

e.en: The sauce had a pleasant {gingerliness}.
e.zh: 这款酱汁带着宜人的姜味。

e.en: Her hair's bright {gingerliness} stood out in the crowd.
e.zh: 她头发鲜明的姜黄色在人群中很显眼。

e.en: Fresh ginger contains {gingerol}, which gives it heat.
e.zh: 鲜姜含有姜辣素，因此会有辛辣感。

e.en: Scientists measured {gingerol} levels in several ginger extracts.
e.zh: 科学家测量了几种姜提取物中的姜辣素含量。

e.en: The vendor sold {gingili} oil in small bottles.
e.zh: 小贩用小瓶出售芝麻油。

e.en: Some older cookbooks call sesame {gingili}.
e.zh: 一些老菜谱把芝麻称作gingili。

e.en: The dentist examined the swollen {gingiva}.
e.zh: 牙医检查了肿胀的牙龈。

e.en: Healthy {gingiva} should not bleed when brushed gently.
e.zh: 健康的牙龈在轻轻刷牙时不应出血。

e.en: The patient showed signs of {gingival} inflammation.
e.zh: 这名患者出现了牙龈发炎的迹象。

e.en: Good brushing can reduce {gingival} bleeding.
e.zh: 认真刷牙可以减少牙龈出血。

e.en: The dentist recommended a minor {gingivectomy}.
e.zh: 牙医建议做一次小型牙龈切除术。

e.en: Recovery after a {gingivectomy} usually takes several days.
e.zh: 牙龈切除术后的恢复通常需要几天。

e.en: The label misspelled ginkgo as {gingkgo}.
e.zh: 标签把ginkgo误拼成了gingkgo。

e.en: Search results for {gingkgo} usually point to ginkgo supplements.
e.zh: 搜索gingkgo的结果通常会指向银杏补充剂。

e.en: The elbow is often classed among {ginglymi}.
e.zh: 肘关节常被归为铰链关节。

e.en: Anatomy texts use {ginglymi} for hinge-like joints.
e.zh: 解剖学教材用ginglymi指铰链状关节。

e.en: The surgeon described the joint as {ginglymodi}.
e.zh: 外科医生把这个关节描述为铰链状的。

e.en: Older anatomy books mention {ginglymodi} movements of the knee.
e.zh: 较早的解剖书会提到膝部的铰链状运动。

e.en: The knee functions partly as a {ginglymus}.
e.zh: 膝关节在一定程度上像铰链关节一样活动。

e.en: A {ginglymus} allows motion mainly in one plane.
e.zh: 铰链关节主要允许在一个平面内运动。

e.en: Sailors crowded the old {ginhouse} near the docks.
e.zh: 水手们挤满了码头附近那家旧杜松子酒馆。

e.en: The novel opens in a smoky London {ginhouse}.
e.zh: 这部小说开篇写的是伦敦一家烟雾缭绕的杜松子酒馆。

e.en: Some old films call a foolish man a {gink}.
e.zh: 一些老电影会把愚蠢的男人叫作怪人或傻瓜。

e.en: He felt like a {gink} after missing the obvious clue.
e.zh: 错过那个明显线索后，他觉得自己像个傻瓜。

e.en: Researchers isolated {ginkgetin} from ginkgo leaves.
e.zh: 研究人员从银杏叶中分离出了银杏黄素。

e.en: The paper discusses possible effects of {ginkgetin}.
e.zh: 论文讨论了银杏黄素可能产生的作用。

e.en: The extract contains a small amount of {ginkgolide}.
e.zh: 这种提取物含有少量银杏内酯。

e.en: Scientists studied how {ginkgolide} affects blood platelets.
e.zh: 科学家研究了银杏内酯对血小板的影响。

e.en: The shop advertised {ginko} tea beside herbal capsules.
e.zh: 商店在草本胶囊旁边宣传银杏茶。

e.en: Most dictionaries prefer ginkgo over {ginko}.
e.zh: 多数词典更推荐ginkgo而不是ginko这种拼法。

e.en: A stone wall {girt} the old garden on three sides.
e.zh: 一道石墙从三面围住了那座老花园。

e.en: The knight was {girt} with a ceremonial sword.
e.zh: 那名骑士佩着一把礼仪用剑。

e.en: The town was {girted} by low green hills.
e.zh: 小镇被低矮的青山环绕着。

e.en: He stood {girted} with a heavy leather belt.
e.zh: 他站在那里，腰间系着一条厚皮带。

e.en: Mist was {girting} the mountain before sunrise.
e.zh: 日出前，雾气正环绕着那座山。

e.en: She finished {girting} the saddle before the ride.
e.zh: 出发骑马前，她把马鞍带系好了。

e.en: The sailor checked the {girtline} before hoisting the load.
e.zh: 水手在吊起货物前检查了那根吊索。

e.en: A frayed {girtline} can make the work dangerous.
e.zh: 磨损的吊索会让这项工作变得危险。

e.en: The guard carried a {gisarme} at the castle gate.
e.zh: 卫兵在城堡门口拿着一把长柄战斧。

e.en: A rusty {gisarme} hung above the museum case.
e.zh: 一把生锈的中世纪长柄战斧挂在博物馆展柜上方。

e.en: This little {gismo} measures the room temperature.
e.zh: 这个小玩意儿可以测量室内温度。

e.en: He bought a kitchen {gismo} he hardly ever uses.
e.zh: 他买了个厨房小装置，却几乎从来不用。

e.en: The plan was flawed from the {git-go}.
e.zh: 这个计划从一开始就有缺陷。

e.en: She supported the project from the {git-go}.
e.zh: 她从一开始就支持这个项目。

e.en: What is that ridiculous {git-up} you are wearing?
e.zh: 你穿的那身可笑打扮是什么？

e.en: His cowboy {git-up} made everyone laugh at the party.
e.zh: 他的牛仔装扮让派对上的每个人都笑了。

e.en: We knew from the {gitgo} that funding would be tight.
e.zh: 我们从一开始就知道资金会很紧张。

e.en: The rules were clear from the {gitgo}.
e.zh: 规则从一开始就很清楚。

e.en: The extract contained traces of {gitogenin}.
e.zh: 这种提取物中含有微量的植物甾体苷元。

e.en: Researchers measured {gitogenin} in the plant sample.
e.zh: 研究人员测定了植物样本中的吉托皂苷元含量。

e.en: The chemist isolated {gitonin} from the dried leaves.
e.zh: 化学家从干叶中分离出一种植物皂苷。

e.en: Old pharmacology papers mention {gitonin} in foxglove studies.
e.zh: 早期药理学论文在毛地黄研究中提到过吉托宁。

e.en: The lab compared {gitoxigenin} with related cardiac compounds.
e.zh: 实验室把吉托辛苷元与相关强心化合物进行了比较。

e.en: Pure {gitoxigenin} requires careful handling in research.
e.zh: 纯吉托辛苷元在研究中需要谨慎处理。

e.en: The plant sample tested positive for {gitoxin}.
e.zh: 这份植物样本检测出含有吉托辛。

e.en: Doctors no longer prescribe {gitoxin} in routine treatment.
e.zh: 医生如今已不在常规治疗中开吉托辛。

e.en: The musician played a {gittern} during the medieval fair.
e.zh: 那位乐师在中世纪集市上弹奏小型弦乐器。

e.en: A carved {gittern} appears in the old manuscript illustration.
e.zh: 那幅古手稿插图里出现了一把雕花的吉特琴。

e.en: The geologist identified {giumarrite} in the volcanic rock.
e.zh: 地质学家在火山岩中鉴定出一种稀有矿物。

e.en: Few museums have a specimen of {giumarrite}.
e.zh: 很少有博物馆收藏这种叫吉乌马尔石的矿物标本。

gipsywort.t: 欧地笋，一种湿地草本植物

e.en: The herbalist pointed out {gipsywort} near the stream.
e.zh: 草药师指出溪边长着欧地笋。

e.en: Old manuals sometimes list {gipsywort} as a dye plant.
e.zh: 旧手册有时把欧地笋列为染料植物。

giraffine.t: 像长颈鹿的；长颈鹿般的

e.en: Her {giraffine} posture made her easy to spot.
e.zh: 她那像长颈鹿般的姿态让人很容易认出。

e.en: The sculpture has a strange, {giraffine} elegance.
e.zh: 这座雕塑有一种奇特的长颈鹿般优雅。

e.en: The foal looked oddly {giraffish} on its long legs.
e.zh: 那匹小马腿很长，看起来有点像长颈鹿。

e.en: He drew a {giraffish} creature with spots and horns.
e.zh: 他画了一个有斑点和角、像长颈鹿的生物。

e.en: A bright {girandola} spun above the square.
e.zh: 一枚明亮的旋转烟火在广场上空转动。

e.en: The antique {girandola} held three small candles.
e.zh: 那件古董枝形烛台插着三支小蜡烛。

girandole.t: 旋转烟火；华丽枝形烛台

e.en: The festival ended with a fiery {girandole}.
e.zh: 节日以一轮火光四射的旋转烟火结束。

e.en: A silver {girandole} glittered on the mantelpiece.
e.zh: 一座银质枝形烛台在壁炉台上闪闪发亮。

e.en: The ring was set with a pale {girasol}.
e.zh: 这枚戒指镶着一颗浅色火蛋白石。

e.en: In older poetry, {girasol} may simply mean sunflower.
e.zh: 在较旧的诗歌里，girasol 可能只是指向日葵。

e.en: The painter used {girasole} as a poetic word for sunflower.
e.zh: 画家用 girasole 这个诗意词来指向日葵。

e.en: A polished {girasole} flashed softly in the light.
e.zh: 一颗抛光的火蛋白石在光下柔和闪亮。

e.en: She served a warm {girdlecake} with butter.
e.zh: 她端上一块热腾腾的铁板烙饼，配着黄油。

e.en: A Scottish {girdlecake} is cooked on a flat griddle.
e.zh: 苏格兰煎饼是在平铁板上烙熟的。

e.en: The hawk began to {gire} above the hill.
e.zh: 鹰开始在山丘上方盘旋。

e.en: Old maps show currents that {gire} around the island.
e.zh: 旧地图显示洋流会绕着这座岛回旋。

e.en: He brought his {girl-friend} to dinner.
e.zh: 他带女朋友来吃晚饭。

e.en: She spent the weekend with an old {girl-friend}.
e.zh: 她和一位老女性朋友一起过周末。

girlcott.t: 女性抵制；由女性发起的抵制

e.en: The students organized a {girlcott} of the sexist magazine.
e.zh: 学生们组织了一场女性抵制，反对那本性别歧视杂志。

e.en: Their {girlcott} drew attention to unfair hiring practices.
e.zh: 她们发起的女性抵制让不公平招聘做法受到关注。

e.en: The movie included a staged {girlfight} in the hallway.
e.zh: 电影里有一场在走廊上安排好的女孩打架戏。

e.en: Tabloids framed the debate as a petty {girlfight}.
e.zh: 小报把这场辩论描述成一场低级的女性争斗。

e.en: Come here, {girlo}, and tell me what happened.
e.zh: 过来，姑娘，告诉我发生了什么。

e.en: The old sailor called every young woman {girlo}.
e.zh: 那个老水手把每个年轻女子都叫作姑娘。

girlygirly.t: 过分少女气的；娇滴滴的

e.en: She rejected the {girlygirly} dress and chose a suit.
e.zh: 她拒绝了那条过分少女气的裙子，选了一套西装。

e.en: The room looked deliberately {girlygirly}, all ribbons and pink walls.
e.zh: 房间被刻意布置得娇滴滴的，到处是缎带和粉色墙面。

e.en: The child began to {girn} when the game ended.
e.zh: 游戏结束时，孩子开始撅嘴抱怨。

e.en: He would {girn} at every small inconvenience.
e.zh: 他遇到一点小不便就会龇牙咧嘴地发牢骚。

e.en: The baby {girned} before bursting into tears.
e.zh: 婴儿先皱脸咧嘴，然后大哭起来。

e.en: The workers {girned} about the cold tea.
e.zh: 工人们抱怨茶已经凉了。

giroback.t: 银行转账退款； giro 返款

e.en: The council promised a {giroback} for the overpaid fee.
e.zh: 委员会承诺把多付的费用通过银行转账退回。

e.en: Her benefit office issued a {giroback} after the error.
e.zh: 福利办公室发现错误后给她办理了转账返款。

e.en: The bank lowered the {girocap} for new accounts.
e.zh: 银行降低了新账户的转账支付上限。

e.en: A temporary {girocap} limited daily electronic payments.
e.zh: 临时转账上限限制了每日电子支付金额。

e.en: The shield displayed a red {giron} in one corner.
e.zh: 盾徽一角有一个红色三角区块。

e.en: Heraldic artists divided the field with a narrow {giron}.
e.zh: 纹章画师用一个狭长的三角区块分割盾面。

gironny.t: 由三角区块组成的盾徽纹样

e.en: The old banner was {gironny} of blue and gold.
e.zh: 那面旧旗呈蓝金相间的三角分割纹样。

e.en: A {gironny} shield appears in the family arms.
e.zh: 家族纹章里有一面三角分割的盾徽。

e.en: The jeweler called the glowing stone a {girosol}.
e.zh: 珠宝商把那颗发光的石头称作火蛋白石。

e.en: Some old dictionaries use {girosol} for sunflower.
e.zh: 一些旧词典用 girosol 表示向日葵。

e.en: The price was only one {girsh} in the old market.
e.zh: 在旧市场里，价格只有一个格什。

e.en: He found a worn {girsh} among the coins.
e.zh: 他在硬币中发现了一枚磨旧的格什。

e.en: A healthy friendship needs some {give-and-take}.
e.zh: 健康的友谊需要彼此让步。

e.en: The meeting involved honest {give-and-take} between both teams.
e.zh: 会议中两个团队进行了坦诚的意见交流。

e.en: The shop offered a free {give-away} with every purchase.
e.zh: 这家店每笔消费都附送一件赠品。

e.en: His nervous smile was a clear {give-away}.
e.zh: 他紧张的笑容明显露了馅。

e.en: The conference bags were full of cheap {give-aways}.
e.zh: 会议袋里装满了廉价赠品。

e.en: There were several {give-aways} in her story.
e.zh: 她的说法里有好几处露馅的地方。

e.en: The mattress felt soft and {givey} under my back.
e.zh: 这张床垫在我背下感觉柔软而有弹性。

e.en: He has a {givey} attitude during negotiations.
e.zh: 他在谈判中态度比较容易让步。

e.en: After the ride, she felt {gizzy} and sat down.
e.zh: 玩完那趟设施后，她觉得头晕，便坐了下来。

e.en: The old sailor used {gizzy} to describe a dizzy spell.
e.zh: 那位老水手用gizzy来形容一阵眩晕。

e.en: The doctor touched the patient's {glabella} during the reflex test.
e.zh: 医生在反射测试中触碰了病人的眉间部位。

e.en: A deep line had formed across his {glabella}.
e.zh: 他的眉间已经形成了一道深纹。
