e.en: The plant's stem becomes {glabrate} as it matures.
e.zh: 这种植物的茎成熟后会逐渐变得无毛。

e.en: A {glabrate} surface can still show a few tiny hairs.
e.zh: 近无毛的表面仍可能有少量细小绒毛。

e.en: The leaves are {glabrescent} on the upper surface.
e.zh: 这些叶子的上表面会逐渐变得无毛。

e.en: Botanists described the young shoot as {glabrescent}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这根嫩枝描述为渐变无毛。

e.en: The insect has a shiny, {glabrous} body.
e.zh: 这种昆虫有光亮无毛的身体。

e.en: The surgeon examined the {glabrous} skin of the palm.
e.zh: 外科医生检查了手掌上光滑无毛的皮肤。

e.en: She decorated the cake with {glace} cherries.
e.zh: 她用糖渍樱桃装饰蛋糕。

e.en: The menu listed a pear {glace} for dessert.
e.zh: 菜单上把冰冻梨甜点列为餐后甜品。

e.en: The {glacialist} measured the retreating ice field.
e.zh: 这位冰川学者测量了正在后退的冰原。

e.en: As a {glacialist}, she studied ancient climate records.
e.zh: 作为冰川学者，她研究古代气候记录。

e.en: The Victorian {glaciarium} attracted crowds in summer.
e.zh: 这座维多利亚时代的人工冰场在夏天吸引了很多人。

e.en: They built a small {glaciarium} beside the hotel.
e.zh: 他们在酒店旁建了一座小型人工滑冰场。

e.en: Cold conditions can {glaciate} high mountain valleys.
e.zh: 寒冷条件会使高山山谷被冰川覆盖。

e.en: The surface may {glaciate} after repeated freezing.
e.zh: 表面反复冻结后可能会结成冰层。

e.en: The region {glaciates} during long cold periods.
e.zh: 这个地区在漫长寒冷期会被冰川覆盖。

e.en: Moist air sometimes {glaciates} on the exposed metal.
e.zh: 潮湿空气有时会在裸露金属上结冰。

e.en: Scientists mapped the {glaciating} landscape from the air.
e.zh: 科学家从空中绘制了正在冰川化的地貌。

e.en: The {glaciating} spray formed a hard crust on the rail.
e.zh: 正在结冰的水雾在栏杆上形成了一层硬壳。

e.en: A small {glacieret} survived below the shaded ridge.
e.zh: 一条小冰川留存在阴影覆盖的山脊下方。

e.en: The map marks each {glacieret} separately from larger glaciers.
e.zh: 地图把每条小冰川都与较大的冰川分开标注。

e.en: The valley contains {glacioaqueous} deposits from meltwater streams.
e.zh: 这个山谷含有融水溪流形成的冰水沉积物。

e.en: Geologists identified a {glacioaqueous} layer beneath the gravel.
e.zh: 地质学家在砾石下识别出一层冰水作用层。

e.en: The team published a {glaciological} survey of the region.
e.zh: 团队发表了该地区的冰川学调查。

e.en: Her {glaciological} data helped predict sea-level changes.
e.zh: 她的冰川学数据有助于预测海平面变化。

e.en: He studied {glaciology} at a university in Iceland.
e.zh: 他在冰岛的一所大学学习冰川学。

e.en: Modern {glaciology} combines fieldwork with satellite data.
e.zh: 现代冰川学把实地考察与卫星数据结合起来。

glad-hand.t: 热情握手寒暄；假意迎合

e.en: The candidate tried to {glad-hand} every voter in the room.
e.zh: 候选人试图和房间里的每位选民热情握手寒暄。

e.en: He would {glad-hand} investors but ignore their concerns later.
e.zh: 他会假意迎合投资者，之后却无视他们的担忧。

glad-handed.t: 热情寒暄的；假意迎合的

e.en: The mayor {glad-handed} guests at the charity dinner.
e.zh: 市长在慈善晚宴上同宾客热情寒暄。

e.en: She disliked his {glad-handed} manner with wealthy donors.
e.zh: 她不喜欢他对富有捐助者那种假意迎合的样子。

glad-hander.t: 热情拉关系的人；逢迎者

e.en: The mayor worked the room like a seasoned {glad-hander}.
e.zh: 市长像个老练的拉关系高手一样在会场周旋。

e.en: Voters distrusted him as a shallow {glad-hander}.
e.zh: 选民把他看成肤浅的逢迎者，因此不信任他。

glad-handing.t: 热情寒暄拉关系；逢迎应酬

e.en: The candidate spent the afternoon {glad-handing} donors.
e.zh: 候选人整个下午都在和捐助者热情寒暄、拉关系。

e.en: Her promotion depended less on work than on {glad-handing}.
e.zh: 她的晋升与其说靠工作，不如说靠逢迎应酬。

e.en: She was the {gladdest} person at the reunion.
e.zh: 在重聚会上，她是最高兴的人。

e.en: I am {gladdest} when the house is full of music.
e.zh: 屋里充满音乐时，我最感到欣慰。

e.en: A quiet {gladfulness} filled the room after the news.
e.zh: 消息传来后，房间里充满了安静的喜悦。

e.en: The poem speaks of {gladfulness} after long sorrow.
e.zh: 这首诗写的是长久悲伤之后的欢欣。

e.en: The plant had narrow, {gladiate} leaves along the stem.
e.zh: 这种植物的茎上长着狭长的剑形叶。

e.en: A {gladiate} shadow crossed the old stone floor.
e.zh: 一道像剑一样的影子掠过旧石地面。

e.en: The museum displayed several Roman {gladii} in glass cases.
e.zh: 博物馆把几把古罗马短剑陈列在玻璃柜里。

e.en: Reenactors carried wooden {gladii} during the parade.
e.zh: 历史重演者在游行中拿着木制的罗马短剑。

e.en: She placed a pink {gladiola} beside the window.
e.zh: 她把一枝粉色剑兰放在窗边。

e.en: The florist recommended {gladiola} for the tall arrangement.
e.zh: 花艺师建议用剑兰来做这组高挑的插花。

e.en: The soldier drew his {gladius} before entering the arena.
e.zh: 士兵进入竞技场前拔出了古罗马短剑。

e.en: A replica {gladius} hung on the study wall.
e.zh: 书房墙上挂着一把仿制的罗马短剑。

e.en: They heard {gladsome} music from the village square.
e.zh: 他们听见村庄广场上传来欢快的音乐。

e.en: It was a {gladsome} sight after weeks of rain.
e.zh: 连下几周雨之后，那是令人高兴的景象。

e.en: The children sang {gladsomely} on the way home.
e.zh: 孩子们在回家的路上欢快地唱着歌。

e.en: She smiled {gladsomely} when the letter arrived.
e.zh: 信到时，她喜悦地笑了。

e.en: The festival restored a sense of {gladsomeness} to the town.
e.zh: 节日让小镇重新有了欢快的气氛。

e.en: There was real {gladsomeness} in his tired face.
e.zh: 他疲惫的脸上流露出真正的喜悦。

e.en: They walked through a wet, {glady} meadow at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时，他们走过一片潮湿、长满鸢尾的草地。

e.en: The painter used {glady} shapes along the riverbank.
e.zh: 画家在河岸边画出了像鸢尾一样的形状。

e.en: He gave a {glaiket} grin and forgot the question.
e.zh: 他傻乎乎地咧嘴一笑，把问题忘了。

e.en: The old aunt called him a {glaiket} young fool.
e.zh: 老姨妈说他是个轻浮糊涂的年轻傻瓜。

e.en: Do not stand there looking {glaikit}; answer me.
e.zh: 别站在那里一副呆头呆脑的样子，回答我。

e.en: His {glaikit} expression made everyone laugh.
e.zh: 他那副傻乎乎的表情把大家都逗笑了。

e.en: The restorer mixed pigment with {glair} for the manuscript.
e.zh: 修复师用蛋清调和颜料来修复手稿。

e.en: A thin {glair} covered the fish after cleaning.
e.zh: 鱼洗净后表面覆着一层薄薄的黏液。

glaired.t: 涂了蛋清的；覆有黏液的

e.en: The gilded letter was {glaired} before the gold was applied.
e.zh: 贴金前，那个装饰字母先涂了蛋清。

e.en: The stones were {glaired} with slime after the tide fell.
e.zh: 退潮后，石头上覆着一层黏液。

e.en: The pond had a {glaireous} film near the reeds.
e.zh: 池塘芦苇旁有一层黏滑透明的薄膜。

e.en: He noticed a {glaireous} substance on the old jar.
e.zh: 他注意到旧罐子上有一种像蛋清的黏物。

e.en: The artist was {glairing} the page before adding gold leaf.
e.zh: 艺术家在贴金箔前正给纸页涂蛋清。

e.en: The wet weed was {glairing} the rocks with slime.
e.zh: 湿海草正在石头上留下一层黏液。

e.en: A {glairy} liquid seeped from the broken seed pod.
e.zh: 破裂的种荚里渗出黏滑透明的液体。

e.en: The old recipe called for a {glairy} coating on the paper.
e.zh: 这份老配方要求在纸上涂一层像蛋清的涂层。

e.en: The guard carried a ceremonial {glaive} at the gate.
e.zh: 卫兵在门口拿着一把礼仪用长柄刀。

e.en: In the poem, the hero lifts a shining {glaive}.
e.zh: 在诗中，英雄举起一把闪亮的阔刃剑。

e.en: The band revived {glam-rock} with glitter and heavy guitars.
e.zh: 这支乐队用亮片和厚重吉他声复兴了华丽摇滚。

e.en: Her jacket looked straight out of a {glam-rock} concert.
e.zh: 她那件夹克看起来像是直接来自华丽摇滚演唱会。

e.en: The film was criticized for the {glamorisation} of violence.
e.zh: 这部电影因美化暴力而受到批评。

e.en: Advertising often depends on the {glamorisation} of ordinary habits.
e.zh: 广告常常依靠把普通习惯包装得很有魅力。

e.en: The show tends to {glamourize} dangerous lifestyles.
e.zh: 这个节目往往把危险的生活方式美化得很迷人。

e.en: Do not {glamourize} the job; it is exhausting.
e.zh: 别把这份工作说得太光鲜，它其实很累人。

e.en: The film {glamourized} the life of crime.
e.zh: 这部电影美化了犯罪生活。

e.en: Her memories had {glamourized} the old village.
e.zh: 她的回忆把那个老村庄变得格外迷人。

e.en: Advertising often {glamourizes} expensive lifestyles.
e.zh: 广告常常美化昂贵的生活方式。

e.en: The novel {glamourizes} loneliness as artistic freedom.
e.zh: 这部小说把孤独美化成艺术自由。

e.en: The show was accused of {glamourizing} violence.
e.zh: 这档节目被指责美化暴力。

e.en: She avoided {glamourizing} poverty in her photos.
e.zh: 她在照片中避免把贫困拍得过于浪漫。

e.en: She arrived looking like a real {glamourpuss}.
e.zh: 她到场时打扮得艳丽迷人。

e.en: The old magazine called every film star a {glamourpuss}.
e.zh: 那本老杂志把每位电影明星都称作艳光四射的人。

e.en: The {glandered} horse was kept away from the stable.
e.zh: 那匹患鼻疽病的马被隔离在马厩外。

e.en: A vet examined the {glandered} mule before sunrise.
e.zh: 兽医在日出前检查了那头患鼻疽病的骡子。

e.en: The report described a {glanderous} infection in the herd.
e.zh: 报告描述了畜群中的鼻疽样感染。

e.en: They burned bedding touched by {glanderous} discharge.
e.zh: 他们焚烧了沾有鼻疽分泌物的垫草。

e.en: The horse tested positive for {glanders}.
e.zh: 这匹马的鼻疽病检测呈阳性。

e.en: Historically, {glanders} could spread from horses to people.
e.zh: 历史上，鼻疽病可能从马传染给人。

e.en: The botanist noted the plant's {glandiferous} hairs.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这种植物带有腺体的细毛。

e.en: A {glandiferous} surface can secrete sticky fluid.
e.zh: 具腺的表面能分泌黏性液体。

e.en: The tissue formed a small {glandiform} mass.
e.zh: 这块组织形成了一个小的腺状团块。

e.en: Under the lens, the swelling looked {glandiform}.
e.zh: 在镜下看，这处肿胀像腺体一样。

e.en: This insect has a {glandless} abdominal segment.
e.zh: 这种昆虫有一个没有腺体的腹部节段。

e.en: The leaf is smooth and {glandless} on both sides.
e.zh: 这片叶子两面都光滑且无腺体。

e.en: A tiny {glandule} lay beneath the skin.
e.zh: 皮肤下面有一个很小的腺体。

e.en: The specimen showed a dark {glandule} near the base.
e.zh: 标本在基部附近显示出一个深色腺粒。

e.en: The stem was covered with {glanduliferous} hairs.
e.zh: 茎上覆盖着带小腺的细毛。

e.en: She identified the species by its {glanduliferous} bracts.
e.zh: 她根据其具腺粒的苞片鉴定了这个物种。

e.en: The underside of the leaf is {glandulose}.
e.zh: 叶片背面布满小腺。

e.en: A {glandulose} texture made the herb feel slightly sticky.
e.zh: 多腺的质地让这种草本摸起来有点黏。

e.en: The surgeon removed the {glandulous} tissue carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生小心切除了腺质组织。

e.en: Some plants have {glandulous} hairs that trap insects.
e.zh: 有些植物长有能困住昆虫的腺毛。

e.en: The doctor explained that the {glans} is sensitive tissue.
e.zh: 医生解释说，龟头是敏感组织。

e.en: Medical diagrams label the {glans} clearly.
e.zh: 医学图解会清楚标出龟头部位。

e.en: The path crossed a {glareous} slope above the river.
e.zh: 小路穿过河上方一片多砾的斜坡。

e.en: Few crops grow well in {glareous} soil.
e.zh: 很少有作物能在砾石质土壤里长得好。

e.en: He bought {glareproof} lenses for night driving.
e.zh: 他买了防眩光镜片用于夜间驾驶。

e.en: The monitor has a {glareproof} coating.
e.zh: 这台显示器有防眩光涂层。

e.en: The engineer calibrated the {glarimeter} before testing headlights.
e.zh: 工程师在测试车灯前校准了眩光测量仪。

e.en: A {glarimeter} can measure uncomfortable brightness.
e.zh: 眩光测量仪可以测量令人不适的亮度。

e.en: The {glariness} of the snow hurt my eyes.
e.zh: 雪地的刺眼亮光让我眼睛疼。

e.en: She lowered the screen's {glariness} in the settings.
e.zh: 她在设置里降低了屏幕的眩目感。

e.en: The room was filled with {glary} white light.
e.zh: 房间里充满了刺眼的白光。

e.en: He disliked the {glary} finish on the poster.
e.zh: 他不喜欢海报上那种眩目的亮面效果。

e.en: The old text used {glas} to mean glass.
e.zh: 那篇古旧文本用glas表示玻璃。

e.en: A layer of {glas} gave the pottery a shine.
e.zh: 一层釉状物让陶器泛出光泽。

e.en: The sample contained small crystals of {glaserite}.
e.zh: 样品中含有少量钾钠复硫酸盐矿物晶体。

e.en: Miners rarely encounter {glaserite} in large masses.
e.zh: 矿工很少遇到大块的钾钠复硫酸盐矿物。

e.en: The {glass-blower} shaped the vase with steady breath.
e.zh: 吹玻璃工匠用平稳的气息塑造花瓶。

e.en: A skilled {glass-blower} can make delicate ornaments.
e.zh: 熟练的吹玻璃工匠能制作精巧的装饰品。

e.en: She learned {glass-blowing} at a small studio.
e.zh: 她在一家小工作室学习玻璃吹制工艺。

e.en: {Glass-blowing} requires heat, timing, and control.
e.zh: 玻璃吹制工艺需要高温、时机和控制力。

glass-cutter.t: 玻璃刀；切玻璃的人或工具

e.en: She used a {glass-cutter} to score the mirror.
e.zh: 她用玻璃刀在镜子上划线。

e.en: The {glass-cutter} measured each pane carefully.
e.zh: 那位切玻璃的工匠仔细量了每块窗玻璃。

e.en: Workers wore masks to avoid breathing {glass-dust}.
e.zh: 工人戴着口罩，避免吸入玻璃粉尘。

e.en: Fine {glass-dust} covered the bench after sanding.
e.zh: 打磨后，细细的玻璃粉末铺满了工作台。

glass-eyed.t: 目光呆滞的；装玻璃眼的

e.en: He sat {glass-eyed} through the long lecture.
e.zh: 他目光呆滞地坐着听完了那场长讲座。

e.en: The old doll looked oddly {glass-eyed}.
e.zh: 那个旧娃娃看起来像装着玻璃眼，有点怪异。

glass-faced.t: 玻璃正面的；面无表情的

e.en: The new tower is a {glass-faced} office block.
e.zh: 那座新楼是一栋玻璃外墙的办公楼。

e.en: She gave him a {glass-faced} stare.
e.zh: 她面无表情地盯着他。

glass-glazed.t: 覆玻璃釉的；眼神呆滞的

e.en: The pottery had a smooth {glass-glazed} surface.
e.zh: 这件陶器表面有一层光滑的玻璃釉。

e.en: After hours of waiting, his eyes looked {glass-glazed}.
e.zh: 等了几个小时后，他的眼神显得呆滞发亮。

e.en: The resin dried into a {glass-hard} shell.
e.zh: 树脂干后变成了像玻璃一样坚硬的外壳。

e.en: A {glass-hard} crust formed on the frozen snow.
e.zh: 冰雪表面结成了一层玻璃般坚硬的硬壳。

e.en: Tomatoes grow well in a warm {glass-house}.
e.zh: 西红柿在温暖的温室里长得很好。

e.en: They built a small {glass-house} beside the garden.
e.zh: 他们在花园旁建了一间小玻璃房。

e.en: The {glass-maker} shaped the vase by hand.
e.zh: 玻璃工匠亲手塑造了那只花瓶。

e.en: A skilled {glass-maker} can control the heat precisely.
e.zh: 熟练的玻璃制造者能精确控制温度。

e.en: We ate at a {glass-topped} table.
e.zh: 我们在一张玻璃面的桌子旁吃饭。

e.en: The {glass-topped} case protected the fossils.
e.zh: 带玻璃顶的展柜保护着那些化石。

e.en: Her delicate {glass-work} was displayed in the gallery.
e.zh: 她精致的玻璃制品在画廊展出。

e.en: Traditional {glass-work} requires patience and steady hands.
e.zh: 传统玻璃工艺需要耐心和稳定的双手。

e.en: The old {glass-works} closed in 1982.
e.zh: 那家老玻璃工厂在1982年关闭。

e.en: The museum keeps several Venetian {glass-works}.
e.zh: 博物馆收藏了几件威尼斯玻璃制品。

e.en: She learned {glassblowing} during a summer course.
e.zh: 她在暑期课程中学习了吹制玻璃工艺。

e.en: {Glassblowing} looks graceful but requires intense heat.
e.zh: 吹制玻璃看起来优雅，却需要极高的温度。

e.en: The balcony was {glassed-in} for winter use.
e.zh: 阳台用玻璃围了起来，方便冬天使用。

e.en: They waited inside a {glassed-in} bus shelter.
e.zh: 他们在一个玻璃围成的公交候车亭里等车。

e.en: He kept a blue {glassie} in his pocket.
e.zh: 他口袋里放着一颗蓝色小玻璃弹珠。

e.en: The child traded one {glassie} for two clay marbles.
e.zh: 那孩子用一颗玻璃弹珠换了两颗泥弹珠。

e.en: Extreme heat can {glassify} the surface of sand.
e.zh: 极高的热量能使沙子表面玻璃化。

e.en: The material may {glassify} as it cools rapidly.
e.zh: 这种材料快速冷却时可能变成玻璃状。

glassily.t: 呆滞发亮地；像玻璃般地

e.en: He stared {glassily} at the television screen.
e.zh: 他眼神呆滞发亮地盯着电视屏幕。

e.en: The lake shone {glassily} under the moon.
e.zh: 湖面在月光下像玻璃一样闪亮。

e.en: The glaze gave the bowl a soft {glassiness}.
e.zh: 釉层让碗呈现出柔和的玻璃般光泽。

e.en: There was a strange {glassiness} in his eyes.
e.zh: 他的眼里有一种奇怪的呆滞光泽。

e.en: The abandoned window stood {glassless} in the wall.
e.zh: 那扇废弃的窗户嵌在墙上，已经没有玻璃。

e.en: He felt oddly {glassless} after breaking his spectacles.
e.zh: 眼镜摔坏后，他觉得没有眼镜很不习惯。

e.en: Venice has a long history of {glassmaking}.
e.zh: 威尼斯有悠久的玻璃制造历史。

e.en: Modern {glassmaking} combines chemistry and precise machinery.
e.zh: 现代制玻璃工艺结合了化学和精密机械。

e.en: The {glassman} replaced the cracked shop window.
e.zh: 玻璃工更换了商店破裂的橱窗玻璃。

e.en: A local {glassman} repaired the greenhouse roof.
e.zh: 当地一名装玻璃的人修好了温室屋顶。

e.en: Smooth the edge with fine {glasspaper}.
e.zh: 用细玻璃砂纸把边缘磨平。

e.en: The carpenter kept several grades of {glasspaper}.
e.zh: 木匠备着几种粗细不同的砂纸。

glassteel.t: 玻璃钢；玻璃与钢复合材料

e.en: The architect proposed {glassteel} panels for the facade.
e.zh: 建筑师建议外立面采用玻璃钢板。

e.en: {Glassteel} can combine transparency with structural strength.
e.zh: 玻璃与钢复合材料能兼具透明性和结构强度。

e.en: The church is famous for its stained {glasswork}.
e.zh: 这座教堂以彩色玻璃制品闻名。

e.en: Her {glasswork} combines old methods with modern design.
e.zh: 她的玻璃工艺结合了传统方法和现代设计。

e.en: The {glassworker} heated the tube until it softened.
e.zh: 玻璃工人把管子加热到变软。

e.en: Each {glassworker} signed the finished piece discreetly.
e.zh: 每位玻璃艺人都在成品上低调地签了名。

e.en: A {glassworm} drifted almost invisibly in the pond water.
e.zh: 一条透明小蠕虫在池水中漂动，几乎看不见。

e.en: The biology guide described the {glassworm} as a transparent larva.
e.zh: 生物指南把玻璃虫描述为一种透明幼虫。

glasswort.t: 盐角草；海蓬子属植物火碱草类植物盐地碱蓬

e.en: The chef scattered pickled {glasswort} over the fish.
e.zh: 厨师把腌制的盐角草撒在鱼上。

e.en: {Glasswort} grows well in salty coastal marshes.
e.zh: 盐角草在含盐的海岸沼泽中长得很好。

glassy-eyed.t: 眼神呆滞的；目光茫然的

e.en: After the long flight, she looked {glassy-eyed}.
e.zh: 长途飞行后，她看起来眼神呆滞。

e.en: The crowd sat {glassy-eyed} through the lecture.
e.zh: 人群在讲座中目光茫然地坐着。

e.en: The geologist identified {glauberite} in the evaporite layer.
e.zh: 地质学家在蒸发岩层中鉴定出了钙芒硝。

e.en: Crystals of {glauberite} formed as the brine dried.
e.zh: 卤水干涸时形成了钙芒硝晶体。

e.en: The museum displayed a rare piece of {glaucochroite}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一块罕见的硅锰钙石。

e.en: Miners found {glaucochroite} beside the manganese ore.
e.zh: 矿工在锰矿旁发现了硅锰钙石。

e.en: The doctor noted {glaucomatous} damage to the optic nerve.
e.zh: 医生注意到视神经有青光眼性损伤。

e.en: Her {glaucomatous} eye required regular pressure checks.
e.zh: 她患青光眼的那只眼睛需要定期测眼压。

glauconite.t: 海绿石；绿色含铁钾矿物

e.en: The sandstone contains small grains of {glauconite}.
e.zh: 这块砂岩含有细小的海绿石颗粒。

e.en: Farmers once used {glauconite} as a slow fertilizer.
e.zh: 农民曾把海绿石用作缓效肥料。

glauconitic.t: 含海绿石的；海绿石质的

e.en: The core sample showed a {glauconitic} sand layer.
e.zh: 岩芯样本显示出一层含海绿石的砂层。

e.en: A {glauconitic} clay often has a greenish color.
e.zh: 海绿石质黏土通常带有绿色。

glaucosis.t: 青光眼；眼内压异常病变

e.en: Older medical texts sometimes call glaucoma {glaucosis}.
e.zh: 较早的医学文献有时把青光眼称为glaucosis。

e.en: The patient was treated for {glaucosis} at the clinic.
e.zh: 这名患者在诊所接受了青光眼治疗。

e.en: The old dye book mentioned {glaude} among blue plants.
e.zh: 那本旧染料书把菘蓝列在蓝色染料植物中。

e.en: Villagers once grew {glaude} for making dye.
e.zh: 村民过去种植菘蓝来制作染料。

e.en: He tried to {glaum} the coins from the table.
e.zh: 他想从桌上贪婪地抓走那些硬币。

e.en: The child would {glaum} at every sweet in reach.
e.zh: 那个孩子会伸手猛抢够得到的每一颗糖。

e.en: The paper described {glaunine} in a coastal plant extract.
e.zh: 论文描述了海岸植物提取物中的海罂粟碱。

e.en: Chemists isolated {glaunine} during the alkaloid study.
e.zh: 化学家在生物碱研究中分离出了海罂粟碱。

glave.t: 阔刃长柄刀；旧式长兵器

e.en: The guard carried a polished {glave} at the gate.
e.zh: 卫兵在门口持着一柄擦亮的阔刃长柄刀。

e.en: In the poem, a knight raises his {glave}.
e.zh: 在诗中，一名骑士举起了他的旧式长兵器。

e.en: The ditch was filled with heavy {glay}.
e.zh: 沟里满是厚重的黏土。

e.en: Old maps marked the field as wet {glay}.
e.zh: 旧地图把这块田标为潮湿泥土。

e.en: His family worked in {glaziery} for three generations.
e.zh: 他家三代人都从事玻璃安装业。

e.en: The church repairs required expert {glaziery}.
e.zh: 教堂修缮需要专业的玻璃工艺。

gleaman.t: 巡游艺人；旧时吟游乐师

e.en: A wandering {gleaman} sang in the market square.
e.zh: 一名巡游艺人在集市广场上歌唱。

e.en: The tale follows a {gleaman} seeking a noble patron.
e.zh: 这个故事讲述一位旧时吟游乐师寻找贵族赞助人的经历。

e.en: The river looked {gleamy} under the moon.
e.zh: 月光下的河水显得微微发亮。

e.en: She noticed a {gleamy} thread in the dark cloth.
e.zh: 她注意到深色布料里有一根闪光的线。

e.en: Only a few facts were {gleanable} from the report.
e.zh: 从报告中只能搜集到少量事实。

e.en: The remaining grain was still {gleanable} after harvest.
e.zh: 收割后剩下的谷粒仍可拾取。

e.en: The mature puffball released spores from its {gleba}.
e.zh: 成熟的马勃从菌腹组织中释放孢子。

e.en: A truffle's {gleba} shows marbled veins when cut.
e.zh: 松露切开后，其孢体内层会显出大理石般的纹理。

glebeless.t: 无土地的；无教区田产的

e.en: The {glebeless} parish struggled to support its priest.
e.zh: 这个没有教区田产的堂区难以供养牧师。

e.en: A {glebeless} farmer depended entirely on rented fields.
e.zh: 一个无土地的农民完全依靠租来的田地。

e.en: The botanist described the root surface as {glebulose}.
e.zh: 植物学家把根部表面描述为小块状。

e.en: Rain left the path {glebulose} and uneven.
e.zh: 雨后小路布满小土块，变得高低不平。

e.en: A {glede} circled above the field.
e.zh: 一只鸢在田野上空盘旋。

e.en: The old poem mentions a hungry {glede}.
e.zh: 那首古诗提到一只饥饿的鸢。

e.en: The boy tried to {gleek} between his teeth.
e.zh: 那个男孩想从牙缝里喷出口水。

e.en: They played {gleek} by candlelight.
e.zh: 他们在烛光下玩一种叫gleek的旧纸牌游戏。

e.en: The {gleeman} sang for coins in the hall.
e.zh: 那名游吟艺人在大厅里唱歌讨赏钱。

e.en: A wandering {gleeman} carried news between villages.
e.zh: 一个四处漂泊的艺人把消息带到各个村庄。

e.en: The {gleemen} entertained the guests after supper.
e.zh: 晚饭后，游吟艺人们为客人表演助兴。

e.en: Several {gleemen} arrived with drums and stories.
e.zh: 几名游吟艺人带着鼓和故事来了。

e.en: Stars seemed to {gleen} through the mist.
e.zh: 星星似乎透过雾气闪烁。

e.en: A faint smile began to {gleen} on her face.
e.zh: 她脸上渐渐露出一丝微光般的笑意。

e.en: The children made a {gleesome} noise outside.
e.zh: 孩子们在外面发出欢快的声音。

e.en: His {gleesome} manner softened the formal dinner.
e.zh: 他愉快的举止让正式晚宴轻松了些。

e.en: The physician recorded {gleet} in the old case notes.
e.zh: 医生在旧病历中记录了慢性尿道分泌物。

e.en: Victorian manuals described {gleet} as a lingering discharge.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的手册把gleet描述为久拖不愈的分泌物。

e.en: The surgeon noted a {gleety} discharge after infection.
e.zh: 外科医生注意到感染后有慢性分泌物。

e.en: Old medical texts used {gleety} for such symptoms.
e.zh: 旧医学文献用gleety来描述这类症状。

e.en: Her {gleg} eye caught the mistake immediately.
e.zh: 她敏锐的眼睛立刻发现了错误。

e.en: The old trader was still {gleg} and quick.
e.zh: 那位老商人仍然机灵敏捷。

e.en: The survey marked the valley floor as {gleisoil}.
e.zh: 调查把谷底标为灰黏土区域。

e.en: Poor drainage often creates {gleisoil} in low fields.
e.zh: 排水不良常会在低洼田地形成潜育土。

e.en: Waterlogging can cause {gleization} in heavy soils.
e.zh: 积水会使黏重土壤发生潜育化。

e.en: The profile showed clear signs of {gleization}.
e.zh: 这个土壤剖面显示出明显的潜育化迹象。

e.en: He wore a {glengarry} with his uniform.
e.zh: 他配着制服戴了一顶苏格兰船形帽。

e.en: The piper adjusted his {glengarry} before marching.
e.zh: 风笛手行进前整理了一下他的苏格兰帽。

e.en: The scan showed damage to the {glenoid} cavity.
e.zh: 扫描显示关节盂有损伤。

e.en: A {glenoid} surface helps the shoulder move smoothly.
e.zh: 关节盂面有助于肩部顺畅活动。

e.en: The mycologist identified a {gleocystidium} under the microscope.
e.zh: 真菌学家在显微镜下识别出一个胶囊状菌丝细胞。

e.en: A stained {gleocystidium} can help classify the fungus.
e.zh: 染色后的胶囊状菌丝细胞有助于给真菌分类。

e.en: The specimen contained a small piece of {glessite}.
e.zh: 标本里含有一小块格莱斯琥珀树脂。

e.en: Collectors distinguish {glessite} from ordinary amber.
e.zh: 收藏者会把格莱斯琥珀树脂同普通琥珀区分开。

e.en: The ditch exposed a band of blue-gray {gley}.
e.zh: 沟渠露出了一层蓝灰色的潜育土。

e.en: Farmers avoid planting early on wet {gley}.
e.zh: 农民会避免过早在潮湿的潜育土上播种。

e.en: The study examined how {glia} support neurons.
e.zh: 这项研究考察神经胶质细胞如何支持神经元。

e.en: Damage to {glia} can affect brain function.
e.zh: 神经胶质细胞受损会影响脑功能。

e.en: Each {gliacyte} helps maintain the neural environment.
e.zh: 每个神经胶质细胞都有助于维持神经环境。

e.en: The stain made the {gliacyte} easier to see.
e.zh: 染色让这个神经胶质细胞更容易看清。

e.en: The {glib-tongued} salesman avoided every hard question.
e.zh: 那个油嘴滑舌的推销员避开了每个尖锐问题。

e.en: She distrusted his {glib-tongued} promises.
e.zh: 她不相信他那些油嘴滑舌的承诺。

glibbest.t: 最油嘴滑舌的；最圆滑的

e.en: He was the {glibbest} speaker in the room.
e.zh: 他是房间里最油嘴滑舌的发言者。

e.en: Even her {glibbest} excuse sounded empty.
e.zh: 就连她最圆滑的借口听起来也很空洞。

glide-bomb.t: 滑翔轰炸；滑翔炸弹攻击

e.en: The pilot practiced a {glide-bomb} attack over the range.
e.zh: 飞行员在靶场上空练习滑翔轰炸。

e.en: A {glide-bomb} could approach with little engine noise.
e.zh: 滑翔炸弹攻击时可能几乎没有发动机声。

e.en: The lake seemed to {gliltter} under the moon.
e.zh: 湖面在月光下似乎闪闪发亮。

e.en: Tiny stones {gliltter} along the path after rain.
e.zh: 雨后小石子在路边闪着光。

e.en: A faint {glim} showed through the curtains.
e.zh: 窗帘后透出一丝微弱的灯光。

e.en: The sailor followed the {glim} on the shore.
e.zh: 水手循着岸上的微光前行。

e.en: She chose a {glimmery} dress for the party.
e.zh: 她为聚会选了一条微微发亮的裙子。

e.en: The street looked {glimmery} after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后的街道看起来闪闪发亮。

e.en: The scan showed several {gliomata} in the brain.
e.zh: 扫描显示脑部有几处神经胶质瘤。

e.en: Doctors classified the {gliomata} by their growth pattern.
e.zh: 医生按生长方式对这些神经胶质瘤分类。

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with cerebral {gliomatosis}.
e.zh: 患者被诊断为脑部神经胶质瘤病。

e.en: Research on {gliomatosis} remains highly specialized.
e.zh: 关于神经胶质瘤病的研究仍然非常专门。

e.en: The fungus produced {gliorosein} in the culture dish.
e.zh: 这种真菌在培养皿中产生了胶质玫瑰素。

e.en: Chemists analyzed {gliorosein} as a red pigment.
e.zh: 化学家把胶质玫瑰素作为一种红色色素来分析。

e.en: The injury left an area of {gliosis}.
e.zh: 这次损伤留下了一片神经胶质增生区域。

e.en: MRI findings suggested chronic {gliosis}.
e.zh: 核磁共振结果提示有慢性神经胶质增生。

e.en: The mold can release {gliotoxin} during growth.
e.zh: 这种霉菌在生长过程中会释放胶霉毒素。

e.en: Scientists measured {gliotoxin} levels in the sample.
e.zh: 科学家测量了样本中的胶霉毒素水平。

e.en: The pianist added bright {glissandi} between chords.
e.zh: 钢琴家在和弦之间加入了明亮的滑奏。

e.en: Her harp {glissandi} shimmered through the hall.
e.zh: 她的竖琴滑奏在大厅里闪亮回荡。

e.en: The dancer finished with a smooth {glisse}.
e.zh: 舞者以一个流畅的滑步收尾。

e.en: Skiers practiced the {glisse} on gentle snow.
e.zh: 滑雪者在缓坡雪地上练习滑行动作。

e.en: Dew made the grass {glist} at sunrise.
e.zh: 日出时露水让草地闪闪发光。

e.en: I saw a {glist} of metal in the sand.
e.zh: 我看见沙里有一点金属的闪光。

e.en: The wet roofs began to {glister} in the sun.
e.zh: 湿漉漉的屋顶开始在阳光下闪耀。

e.en: All that {glisters} is not gold.
e.zh: 闪光的东西并不都是金子。

e.en: The river {glistered} under the winter moon.
e.zh: 河水在冬夜月光下闪闪发亮。

e.en: Her eyes {glistered} with unshed tears.
e.zh: 她眼里含着泪光，闪闪发亮。

e.en: A {glistering} frost covered the fields.
e.zh: 田野上覆盖着闪闪发亮的霜。

e.en: He admired the {glistering} jewels in silence.
e.zh: 他默默欣赏那些闪耀的珠宝。

e.en: The sea shone {glisteringly} after dawn.
e.zh: 黎明后海面闪耀着光。

e.en: Her brooch caught the light {glisteringly}.
e.zh: 她的胸针耀眼地反射着光。

glitchy.t: 故障频出的；有小毛病的

e.en: The app felt {glitchy} after the update.
e.zh: 更新后这个应用用起来故障频出。

e.en: A {glitchy} video kept freezing during class.
e.zh: 一段有问题的视频在课堂上不停卡住。

e.en: She sealed the card with {glitterwax}.
e.zh: 她用闪粉蜡封住了卡片。

e.en: The craft shop sells {glitterwax} for decorations.
e.zh: 手工店出售用于装饰的闪粉蜡。

e.en: The hotel lobby had too much {glitziness}.
e.zh: 酒店大堂的浮华感太重了。

e.en: She liked the show's cheerful {glitziness}.
e.zh: 她喜欢这场演出那种欢快的耀眼气派。

e.en: They walked home through the {gloam}.
e.zh: 他们穿过暮色走回家。

e.en: The hills softened in the evening {gloam}.
e.zh: 群山在傍晚暮色中显得柔和。

e.en: The company hopes to {globalise} its brand.
e.zh: 这家公司希望把品牌推向全球。

e.en: Digital platforms can {globalise} small businesses quickly.
e.zh: 数字平台能让小企业迅速走向全球。

globalist.t: 全球主义者；全球化支持者

e.en: He argued from a {globalist} point of view.
e.zh: 他从全球主义者的角度进行论证。

e.en: Critics called the minister a {globalist}.
e.zh: 批评者称这位部长是全球化支持者。

e.en: The crisis revealed the {globality} of supply chains.
e.zh: 这场危机揭示了供应链的全球性。

e.en: Writers debated the {globality} of modern culture.
e.zh: 作家们讨论现代文化的全球范围特征。

e.en: The botanist noted the {globate} seed capsule.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到那个球形的种荚。

e.en: A {globate} swelling formed near the joint.
e.zh: 关节附近形成了一个近球状的肿块。

e.en: After retirement, they planned to {globe-trot} together.
e.zh: 退休后，他们计划一起周游世界。

e.en: He loves to {globe-trot} for food festivals.
e.zh: 他喜欢为了美食节到世界各地旅行。

e.en: She {globe-trots} whenever work gives her a break.
e.zh: 工作一有空，她就去周游世界。

e.en: The photographer {globe-trots} to capture remote landscapes.
e.zh: 这位摄影师四处环球旅行，拍摄偏远风景。

globe-trotted.t: 周游过世界；环球旅行过

e.en: They {globe-trotted} for years before settling down.
e.zh: 他们在安定下来之前周游世界多年。

e.en: She {globe-trotted} as a journalist covering elections.
e.zh: 她作为报道选举的记者曾到世界各地奔走。

e.en: A seasoned {globe-trotter} packed only one small bag.
e.zh: 一位老练的环球旅行者只带了一个小包。

e.en: The magazine interviewed a famous {globe-trotter}.
e.zh: 那本杂志采访了一位著名的世界旅行者。

e.en: Her {globe-trotting} career kept her rarely at home.
e.zh: 她周游世界的职业让她很少待在家里。

e.en: The film follows his {globe-trotting} adventures.
e.zh: 这部电影讲述了他的环球冒险经历。

e.en: The chef prepared {globefish} with extreme care.
e.zh: 厨师极其谨慎地处理河豚。

e.en: A startled {globefish} puffed itself into a ball.
e.zh: 受惊的河豚把自己鼓成了一个球。

e.en: Yellow {globeflower} brightened the damp meadow.
e.zh: 黄色的金莲花照亮了潮湿的草地。

e.en: She planted {globeflower} beside the garden pond.
e.zh: 她在花园池塘旁种了金莲花。

e.en: They hope to {globetrot} after selling the business.
e.zh: 卖掉公司后，他们希望去周游世界。

e.en: Young athletes often {globetrot} for international tournaments.
e.zh: 年轻运动员常为国际赛事奔走世界各地。

e.en: The {globetrotter} knew every major airport lounge.
e.zh: 这位环球旅行者熟悉各大机场休息室。

e.en: As a {globetrotter}, she collected stories instead of souvenirs.
e.zh: 作为环球旅行者，她收集的是故事而不是纪念品。

e.en: The hostel was full of young {globetrotters}.
e.zh: 那家旅舍住满了年轻的环球旅行者。

e.en: Experienced {globetrotters} avoid overpacking.
e.zh: 有经验的世界旅行者会避免带太多行李。

globigerinaooze.t: 抱球虫软泥；深海钙质泥

e.en: The core sample contained pale {globigerinaooze}.
e.zh: 岩芯样本中含有浅色的抱球虫软泥。

e.en: Scientists mapped {globigerinaooze} across the ocean floor.
e.zh: 科学家绘制了海底抱球虫软泥的分布图。

e.en: The mineral appeared as a tiny {globoid}.
e.zh: 这种矿物呈现为一个微小的球状体。

e.en: Each {globoid} cell reflected light differently.
e.zh: 每个近球形细胞反射光线的方式都不同。

e.en: The fungus had a {globose} fruiting body.
e.zh: 这种真菌有一个球形的子实体。

e.en: A {globose} vase stood on the shelf.
e.zh: 架子上摆着一个圆球状花瓶。

e.en: The berries clustered {globosely} at the stem tips.
e.zh: 浆果在茎端呈球状聚集。

e.en: The clay expanded {globosely} as it spun.
e.zh: 陶泥在旋转时圆鼓鼓地膨起。

e.en: The sculpture's {globosity} made it feel playful.
e.zh: 这件雕塑的球状感让它显得很有趣。

e.en: Engineers measured the droplet's {globosity} under magnification.
e.zh: 工程师在放大条件下测量液滴的圆球度。

e.en: A {globous} lamp hung above the table.
e.zh: 一盏球形灯挂在桌子上方。

e.en: The specimen showed several {globous} growths.
e.zh: 标本上出现了几个球状突起。

e.en: The extract contained traces of {globularin}.
e.zh: 提取物中含有微量球花苷。

e.en: Researchers isolated {globularin} from the plant sample.
e.zh: 研究人员从植物样本中分离出球花苷。

e.en: The droplet's {globularity} increased in low gravity.
e.zh: 在低重力下，液滴的球形性增强了。

e.en: Artists exaggerated the figure's {globularity}.
e.zh: 艺术家夸张了这个形体的球状特征。

e.en: The process is {globularizing} the metal particles.
e.zh: 这个过程正在使金属颗粒球化。

e.en: Heat treatment was {globularizing} the internal structure.
e.zh: 热处理正在使内部结构变成球状。

e.en: A clear {globulet} of resin formed on the bark.
e.zh: 树皮上形成了一颗透明的小树脂球。

e.en: The slide showed one bright {globulet}.
e.zh: 载玻片上显示出一个明亮的小球状物。

e.en: The {globuliferous} tissue was examined under a microscope.
e.zh: 含小球体的组织在显微镜下接受检查。

e.en: A {globuliferous} surface covered the fossil shell.
e.zh: 化石贝壳表面布满了小球状突起。

e.en: The old lab kept a {globulimeter} for counting blood cells.
e.zh: 那间旧实验室保存着一台用于计数血细胞的血球计。

e.en: A {globulimeter} appears in the nineteenth-century medical catalogue.
e.zh: 这台血球计出现在一份十九世纪医学器械目录中。

e.en: The geologist described each {globulite} in the volcanic glass.
e.zh: 地质学家描述了火山玻璃中的每个微小球粒。

e.en: Under the microscope, a {globulite} looked like a tiny bead.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，一个微小球状体看起来像小珠子。

e.en: The plant had {globulose} seed pods after flowering.
e.zh: 开花后，这种植物长出了近球形的种荚。

e.en: Several {globulose} particles settled at the bottom of the vial.
e.zh: 几个小球状颗粒沉到了小瓶底部。

e.en: A {globulous} drop of resin hung from the branch.
e.zh: 一滴圆鼓鼓的树脂挂在树枝上。

e.en: The artist painted {globulous} clouds above the hills.
e.zh: 画家在山丘上方画了团团球状的云。

e.en: The factory was {globurizing} the powder into uniform pellets.
e.zh: 工厂正在把粉末球化成大小一致的小颗粒。

e.en: Careful {globurizing} improved the texture of the material.
e.zh: 仔细的球化处理改善了这种材料的质地。

e.en: The campaign used {glocalization} to fit each regional market.
e.zh: 这场宣传采用全球本土化策略，以适应各地区市场。

e.en: Successful {glocalization} keeps a global brand locally relevant.
e.zh: 成功的在地化能让全球品牌在本地仍然贴近消费者。

e.en: A tiny {glochid} stuck painfully in her finger.
e.zh: 一根细小的倒钩刺扎进她的手指，疼得很。

e.en: The cactus sheds each {glochid} more easily than a long spine.
e.zh: 这种仙人掌的细刺比长刺更容易脱落。

e.en: The {glochideous} fruit caught on the sleeve.
e.zh: 这个带倒钩刺毛的果实勾住了袖子。

e.en: Botanists noted the {glochideous} surface of the cactus pad.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到仙人掌垫片表面有倒钩刺毛。

glochidia.t: 倒钩幼虫；倒钩刺毛复数

e.en: The mussel releases {glochidia} that attach to fish gills.
e.zh: 这种蚌释放会附着在鱼鳃上的倒钩幼虫。

e.en: Fine {glochidia} on the cactus irritated his skin.
e.zh: 仙人掌上的细小倒钩刺毛刺激了他的皮肤。

e.en: The fungus produced a sticky {gloeospore} in damp conditions.
e.zh: 这种真菌在潮湿环境下产生黏性的胶质孢子。

e.en: She identified the {gloeospore} by its gelatinous coat.
e.zh: 她根据其胶质外层辨认出了黏孢子。

e.en: They served warm {glogg} at the winter market.
e.zh: 他们在冬季集市上供应热乎乎的北欧香料酒。

e.en: A cup of {glogg} smelled of cinnamon and cloves.
e.zh: 一杯北欧热香料酒散发着肉桂和丁香的香味。

e.en: The children tried to {glomb} onto the last few balloons.
e.zh: 孩子们试图抓住最后几个气球不放。

e.en: Dust can {glomb} together when the air is damp.
e.zh: 空气潮湿时，灰尘会聚成一团。

e.en: The roots formed a dense {glome} under the soil.
e.zh: 根系在土壤下形成了一个致密的球状团块。

e.en: Loose fibers began to {glome} around the wet brush.
e.zh: 松散的纤维开始在湿刷子周围聚成团。

e.en: Several {glomera} were visible in the tissue sample.
e.zh: 组织样本中可以看到几个球状团块。

e.en: The botanist compared the floral {glomera} under magnification.
e.zh: 植物学家在放大后比较了这些花部团块。

e.en: The crystals began to {glomerate} as the solution cooled.
e.zh: 溶液冷却时，晶体开始聚成球团。

e.en: The plant bears {glomerate} flower heads near the stem.
e.zh: 这种植物在茎旁长有球簇状花序。

e.en: The powder had {glomerated} into hard lumps overnight.
e.zh: 粉末一夜之间聚成了硬块。

e.en: A {glomerated} mass of cells blocked the narrow channel.
e.zh: 一团聚集的细胞堵住了狭窄通道。

e.en: The particles were {glomerating} near the bottom of the tank.
e.zh: 颗粒正在水槽底部附近聚成团。

e.en: She watched the {glomerating} cells through the microscope.
e.zh: 她通过显微镜观察正在聚集成簇的细胞。

e.en: Moisture caused {glomeration} of the fine powder.
e.zh: 潮气导致细粉聚成了团块。

e.en: The report described urban {glomeration} around the port.
e.zh: 报告描述了港口周边城市区域的聚集。

e.en: The thin section showed a {glomeroclastic} texture.
e.zh: 这块岩石薄片显示出破碎球晶状结构。

e.en: Geologists use {glomeroclastic} to describe broken crystal clusters.
e.zh: 地质学家用破碎球晶状来描述破裂的晶体团簇。

e.en: A dark {glomerocryst} stood out in the basalt sample.
e.zh: 玄武岩样本中有一个深色晶体团格外明显。

e.en: The {glomerocryst} contained several intergrown mineral grains.
e.zh: 这个球晶集合体含有几粒共生的矿物晶粒。

e.en: The lava had a {glomerophyric} texture with clustered crystals.
e.zh: 这块熔岩具有晶体成簇的球晶斑状结构。

e.en: A {glomerophyric} rock can reveal changes in cooling conditions.
e.zh: 具球晶斑状结构的岩石能显示冷却条件的变化。

e.en: The herb has {glomerulate} flowers at the leaf axils.
e.zh: 这种草本植物在叶腋处长有小球簇状花。

e.en: Cells became {glomerulate} after the reagent was added.
e.zh: 加入试剂后，细胞变成小团状。

e.en: Each {glomerule} contained a tight cluster of tiny flowers.
e.zh: 每个小球簇都含有一团紧密的小花。

e.en: The pathologist marked one abnormal {glomerule} in the sample.
e.zh: 病理学家在样本中标出了一个异常小球状团。

e.en: Healthy {glomeruli} filter waste from the blood.
e.zh: 健康的肾小球会从血液中过滤废物。

e.en: The slide showed several damaged {glomeruli}.
e.zh: 这张切片显示出几个受损的肾小球。

glossematic.t: 语符学的；形式语言学的

e.en: The paper used a {glossematic} analysis of Danish grammar.
e.zh: 这篇论文用语符学方法分析丹麦语语法。

e.en: Her argument was too {glossematic} for most readers.
e.zh: 她的论证对多数读者来说太偏形式语言学了。

e.en: He studied {glossematics} under a specialist in linguistic theory.
e.zh: 他在一位语言理论专家门下学习语符学。

e.en: {Glossematics} treats language as a system of relations.
e.zh: 语符学把语言视为一种关系系统。

e.en: The linguist treated the suffix as a separate {glosseme}.
e.zh: 那位语言学家把这个后缀视为一个独立语符。

e.en: A {glosseme} may be defined by its place in the system.
e.zh: 一个语符可以由它在系统中的位置来界定。

e.en: The brochure was {glossily} printed on thick paper.
e.zh: 这本宣传册用厚纸印得很有光泽。

e.en: The scandal was {glossily} repackaged as a success story.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻被粉饰成了一段成功故事。

e.en: The technician checked the tile with a {glossimeter}.
e.zh: 技术员用光泽计检测了那块瓷砖。

e.en: An old {glossimeter} appeared in the medical museum.
e.zh: 医学博物馆里展出了一台旧式舌测量器。

e.en: The varnish gave the table a deep {glossiness}.
e.zh: 清漆让这张桌子呈现出很深的光泽。

e.en: The film's {glossiness} sometimes hides its weak story.
e.zh: 这部电影的华丽感有时掩盖了剧情的薄弱。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed her painful tongue as {glossitis}.
e.zh: 医生把她舌头疼痛诊断为舌炎。

e.en: Vitamin deficiency can sometimes cause {glossitis}.
e.zh: 维生素缺乏有时会引起舌炎。

e.en: A {glossmeter} measured the shine of the painted surface.
e.zh: 一台光泽计测量了漆面亮度。

e.en: The antique {glossmeter} was used for anatomical measurement.
e.zh: 这台古董舌测量器曾用于解剖测量。

e.en: The surgeon examined the child's {glossodesmus} before treatment.
e.zh: 外科医生在治疗前检查了孩子的舌系带。

e.en: A tight {glossodesmus} can affect early speech.
e.zh: 过紧的舌系带可能影响早期说话。

e.en: The medieval {glossographer} explained difficult Latin words.
e.zh: 那位中世纪注释者解释了艰深的拉丁词。

e.en: A careful {glossographer} records regional meanings.
e.zh: 细心的词汇编纂者会记录地域性含义。

e.en: The edition includes extensive {glossographical} notes.
e.zh: 这个版本附有大量注释学说明。

e.en: Her {glossographical} work focused on dialect words.
e.zh: 她的词汇编纂工作集中在方言词上。

e.en: His research in {glossography} clarified many rare terms.
e.zh: 他的注释学研究厘清了许多罕见术语。

e.en: Early {glossography} often mixed translation with commentary.
e.zh: 早期词汇编纂常把翻译和评注混在一起。

e.en: The congregation described her speech as {glossolalia}.
e.zh: 会众把她的发声描述为宗教性的异语。

e.en: Researchers studied {glossolalia} as a social and linguistic event.
e.zh: 研究者把说方言现象作为社会和语言事件来研究。

e.en: The {glossolalist} spoke rapidly during the service.
e.zh: 那位说异语者在礼拜中说得很快。

e.en: A trained observer interviewed each {glossolalist} afterward.
e.zh: 一名受过训练的观察者事后采访了每位说异语者。

e.en: The report described a rare {glossolaryngeal} disorder.
e.zh: 报告描述了一种罕见的舌喉相关疾病。

e.en: Speech therapists assessed his {glossolaryngeal} coordination.
e.zh: 言语治疗师评估了他的舌喉协调能力。

e.en: The lecture offered a {glossological} view of ancient scripts.
e.zh: 这场讲座从语言学角度讨论古文字。

e.en: Doctors debated the {glossological} symptoms in the case.
e.zh: 医生们讨论了病例中的舌部症状。

e.en: Nineteenth-century scholars sometimes used {glossology} for linguistics.
e.zh: 十九世纪学者有时用glossology指语言学。

e.en: The clinic kept old texts on {glossology} and mouth disease.
e.zh: 诊所保存着关于舌科学和口腔疾病的旧书。

e.en: The {glossopharyngeal} nerve helps control swallowing.
e.zh: 舌咽神经有助于控制吞咽。

e.en: She felt sharp {glossopharyngeal} pain near her throat.
e.zh: 她在喉咙附近感到尖锐的舌咽部疼痛。

e.en: The biologist labeled the specimen's {glossopodium} in the diagram.
e.zh: 生物学家在图中标出了标本的舌足结构。

e.en: A damaged {glossopodium} made the larva difficult to identify.
e.zh: 受损的舌状足部结构使幼体难以鉴定。

e.en: The entomologist examined the insect's {glossotheca} under magnification.
e.zh: 昆虫学家在放大镜下检查了昆虫的舌鞘。

e.en: A broken {glossotheca} can reveal how the pupa developed.
e.zh: 破损的舌状器官鞘能显示蛹的发育情况。

e.en: The surgeon performed a limited {glossotomy} to remove the lesion.
e.zh: 外科医生进行了有限的舌切开术以切除病灶。

e.en: Older manuals described {glossotomy} in alarming detail.
e.zh: 旧手册以令人不安的细节描述了舌切除术。

e.en: The pottery entered the {glost} kiln after decoration.
e.zh: 陶器装饰后进入釉烧窑。

e.en: A flaw appeared during the {glost} stage of firing.
e.zh: 烧制的釉烧阶段出现了一个缺陷。

e.en: The {glost-fired} plates had a smooth white surface.
e.zh: 这些经釉烧的盘子表面洁白光滑。

e.en: Only {glost-fired} samples were sent for final inspection.
e.zh: 只有经釉烧的样品被送去做最终检查。

e.en: The language has several {glottalic} consonants.
e.zh: 这种语言有几个声门化辅音。

e.en: Her thesis compared {glottalic} sounds across Caucasian languages.
e.zh: 她的论文比较了高加索诸语言中的声门音。

e.en: Researchers measured {glomerulotropin} in the blood samples.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了血样中的促肾小球素。

e.en: The paper linked {glomerulotropin} to kidney function.
e.zh: 论文把促肾小球素与肾功能联系起来。

e.en: Each kidney contains many filtering units called a {glomerulus}.
e.zh: 每个肾脏都含有许多称为肾小球的过滤单位。

e.en: The damaged {glomerulus} leaked protein into the urine.
e.zh: 受损的肾小球把蛋白质漏到了尿液中。

e.en: A {glomus} tumor can cause severe fingertip pain.
e.zh: 血管球瘤可能导致指尖剧烈疼痛。

e.en: The carotid {glomus} helps sense changes in blood oxygen.
e.zh: 颈动脉球有助于感知血氧变化。

e.en: The old remedy listed {glonoin} among its ingredients.
e.zh: 这种旧药方把硝酸甘油列为成分之一。

e.en: Homeopathic books sometimes mention {glonoin} for headaches.
e.zh: 顺势疗法书籍有时提到用格洛宁治头痛。

e.en: A {gloomful} silence filled the room after the news.
e.zh: 消息传来后，房间里充满了阴郁的沉默。

e.en: The poet described a {gloomful} winter evening.
e.zh: 诗人描写了一个忧愁的冬夜。

e.en: Don't be such a {gloomster} before the trip begins.
e.zh: 旅行还没开始，别这么悲观扫兴。

e.en: The office {gloomster} predicted another bad quarter.
e.zh: 办公室里那个悲观的人预测下一季度又会很糟。

e.en: The children mixed flour and water into sticky {gloop}.
e.zh: 孩子们把面粉和水搅成了黏糊糊的东西。

e.en: Some strange green {gloop} was dripping from the pipe.
e.zh: 一些奇怪的绿色黏液正从管子里滴下来。

e.en: A white {gloriette} stood at the end of the garden path.
e.zh: 花园小径尽头立着一座白色观景亭。

e.en: Tourists climbed the hill to photograph the old {gloriette}.
e.zh: 游客爬上山去拍那座古老的小亭。

e.en: The saint was painted with a golden {gloriole}.
e.zh: 画中的圣人带着金色光环。

e.en: Mist formed a faint {gloriole} around the streetlamp.
e.zh: 雾气在路灯周围形成了淡淡的光圈。

e.en: She kept embroidered sheets in her {glory-box}.
e.zh: 她把绣花床单放在自己的嫁妆箱里。

e.en: The old {glory-box} held letters, linen, and family photographs.
e.zh: 那个旧希望箱里装着信件、亚麻布和家庭照片。

e.en: He searched the {glory-hole} for a spare cable.
e.zh: 他在杂物间里找一根备用电缆。

e.en: The wall had a crude {glory-hole} cut through it.
e.zh: 墙上粗糙地凿出了一个窥洞。

e.en: Blue {glory-of-the-snow} appeared before the tulips opened.
e.zh: 郁金香开放前，蓝色的雪光花先冒了出来。

e.en: She planted {glory-of-the-snow} along the front path.
e.zh: 她在前院小路旁种了雪光花。

e.en: The editor added a brief {glose} to the difficult line.
e.zh: 编辑给那句难懂的文字加了一条简短注释。

e.en: His {glose} turned a plain verse into a sharp criticism.
e.zh: 他的评注把一首平淡的诗变成了尖锐批评。

e.en: The report tried to {gloss-over} the safety failures.
e.zh: 报告试图掩饰那些安全失误。

e.en: She chose to {gloss-over} the awkward details.
e.zh: 她选择把那些尴尬细节草草带过。

e.en: The insect's {glossa} helps it take up nectar.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的舌状器官帮助它吸取花蜜。

e.en: Medical students learned the term {glossa} in anatomy class.
e.zh: 医学生在解剖课上学到了glossa这个表示舌的术语。

e.en: The surgeon checked the patient's {glossal} movement after treatment.
e.zh: 治疗后，外科医生检查了患者的舌部运动。

e.en: A {glossal} injury can affect speech and swallowing.
e.zh: 舌部损伤会影响说话和吞咽。

e.en: The appendix contains {glossarial} notes for rare terms.
e.zh: 附录中有针对生僻术语的词汇表注释。

e.en: Her {glossarial} work made the medieval text easier to read.
e.zh: 她的术语表整理让这部中世纪文本更容易阅读。

e.en: The manuscript was arranged {glossarially} by subject and term.
e.zh: 这份手稿按主题和术语以词汇表方式编排。

e.en: He explained the dialect words {glossarially} in the notes.
e.zh: 他在注释中按词汇表方式解释了方言词。

e.en: The {glossarist} defined every technical term in the volume.
e.zh: 这位词汇表编者解释了书中每个技术术语。

e.en: A careful {glossarist} can save readers much confusion.
e.zh: 细心的词汇表编者能让读者少许多困惑。

e.en: The medieval {glossarium} explained words from church Latin.
e.zh: 这部中世纪词汇表解释了教会拉丁语中的词。

e.en: Students used the {glossarium} to check unfamiliar legal terms.
e.zh: 学生用这本术语汇编查不熟悉的法律术语。

e.en: The {glossator} wrote comments in the margin.
e.zh: 那位注释者在页边写下评论。

e.en: A later {glossator} misunderstood the original phrase.
e.zh: 后来的评注者误解了原来的短语。

e.en: The patient needed a partial {glossectomy} after the cancer spread.
e.zh: 癌症扩散后，患者需要做部分舌切除术。

e.en: Speech therapy often follows a major {glossectomy}.
e.zh: 大型舌切除术后通常需要进行言语治疗。

glottalize.t: 使声门化；发成喉塞音或声门音

e.en: Some speakers {glottalize} the final consonant in this word.
e.zh: 有些说话者会把这个词的末尾辅音发成声门化。

e.en: The dialect tends to {glottalize} vowels before a pause.
e.zh: 这种方言常在停顿前把元音发成声门化。

e.en: The doctor examined the {glottidean} opening with a small mirror.
e.zh: 医生用小镜子检查了声门开口。

e.en: The paper describes a rare {glottidean} feature in the language.
e.zh: 论文描述了该语言中一种罕见的声门特征。

e.en: The diagram compared the {glottides} of several animals.
e.zh: 这张图比较了几种动物的声门。

e.en: Inflamed {glottides} can make breathing dangerously difficult.
e.zh: 发炎的声门可能让呼吸变得十分困难。

e.en: The singer was treated for {glottiditis} after the tour.
e.zh: 巡演结束后，这名歌手接受了声门炎治疗。

e.en: Severe {glottiditis} may cause hoarseness and pain.
e.zh: 严重的声门炎可能导致声音嘶哑和疼痛。

glottocentrism.t: 语言中心主义；以语言为中心的观念

e.en: The essay criticizes {glottocentrism} in theories of culture.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评文化理论中的语言中心主义。

e.en: His {glottocentrism} made him overlook gesture and image.
e.zh: 他的语言中心主义让他忽视了手势和图像。

glottochronological.t: 词源年代学的；语言年代测定的

e.en: The team rejected the old {glottochronological} estimate.
e.zh: 团队否定了旧的语言年代测定估算。

e.en: She used {glottochronological} data to compare related languages.
e.zh: 她用词源年代学数据比较相关语言。

glottochronology.t: 词源年代学；语言年代测定法

e.en: {Glottochronology} estimates when related languages separated.
e.zh: 词源年代学估算相关语言分化的时间。

e.en: Many linguists treat {glottochronology} with caution.
e.zh: 许多语言学家对语言年代测定法持谨慎态度。

glottogonic.t: 语言起源的；语言生成的

e.en: The scholar proposed a {glottogonic} theory of myth.
e.zh: 这位学者提出了一种关于神话的语言起源理论。

e.en: Ancient writers offered many {glottogonic} explanations.
e.zh: 古代作者提出过许多语言起源方面的解释。

glottogony.t: 语言起源论；语言生成学

e.en: The book treats {glottogony} as a philosophical problem.
e.zh: 这本书把语言起源论视为一个哲学问题。

e.en: Early theories of {glottogony} often mixed myth with observation.
e.zh: 早期语言起源论常把神话和观察混在一起。

e.en: He studied {glottology} before turning to anthropology.
e.zh: 他转向人类学之前研究过语言学。

e.en: Nineteenth-century {glottology} relied heavily on comparison.
e.zh: 十九世纪的语文学研究非常依赖比较方法。

glottomania.t: 语言狂热；过度迷恋语言

e.en: Her friends joked about her {glottomania} after she learned Finnish.
e.zh: 她学会芬兰语后，朋友们拿她的语言狂热开玩笑。

e.en: The review calls the novel a portrait of academic {glottomania}.
e.zh: 评论称这部小说描绘了学术界对语言的狂热迷恋。

glottopolitics.t: 语言政治；语言政策中的权力关系

e.en: The course examines {glottopolitics} in multilingual states.
e.zh: 这门课研究多语言国家中的语言政治。

e.en: Debates over spelling often reveal deeper {glottopolitics}.
e.zh: 关于拼写的争论常显露更深层的语言政治。

e.en: The drain made a wet {gloup} in the silence.
e.zh: 寂静中，排水口发出一声湿漉漉的咕噜声。

e.en: The mud seemed to {gloup} under his boots.
e.zh: 泥巴在他的靴子底下像是咕噜作响。

e.en: The old man began to {glout} at the noisy children.
e.zh: 老人开始阴沉地瞪着吵闹的孩子们。

e.en: She answered with a {glout} instead of a smile.
e.zh: 她没有微笑回应，而是皱着眉头。

e.en: The crowd gathered for a brutal {glove-fight} at noon.
e.zh: 人群中午聚在一起观看一场激烈的戴手套拳斗。

e.en: A formal {glove-fight} replaced the old bare-knuckle match.
e.zh: 正式的拳击比赛取代了旧式徒手拳赛。

e.en: The servant expected {glove-money} after delivering the letter.
e.zh: 仆人送完信后指望得到一笔小费。

e.en: Officials sometimes used {glove-money} as a polite name for bribes.
e.zh: 官员有时用手套钱这个委婉说法指贿赂。

e.en: Keep the registration papers in the {glovebox}.
e.zh: 把车辆登记文件放在汽车杂物箱里。

e.en: The chemist handled the sample inside a sealed {glovebox}.
e.zh: 化学家在密封手套箱内处理样品。

e.en: The village {gloveman} repaired leather gloves by hand.
e.zh: 村里的手套匠手工修补皮手套。

e.en: A silent {gloveman} stood beside the winter carriage.
e.zh: 一个戴手套的沉默男子站在冬日马车旁。

e.en: A faulty {glow-plug} made the diesel engine hard to start.
e.zh: 一个故障预热塞让柴油发动机很难启动。

e.en: The mechanic replaced each {glow-plug} before winter.
e.zh: 技师在入冬前更换了每个电热塞。

e.en: A single {glow-worm} shone beside the path.
e.zh: 一只萤火虫在小路旁发着光。

e.en: The children searched the bank for a {glow-worm}.
e.zh: 孩子们在河岸边寻找发光的幼虫。

glow-worms.t: 萤火虫；发光幼虫的复数

e.en: Tiny {glow-worms} lit the grass after sunset.
e.zh: 日落后，小小的萤火虫照亮了草地。

e.en: The cave is famous for its blue {glow-worms}.
e.zh: 这个洞穴因蓝色发光幼虫而闻名。

e.en: A young {glowboy} shouted headlines outside the station.
e.zh: 一个年轻报童在车站外大声喊着新闻标题。

e.en: The novel follows a {glowboy} through the city streets.
e.zh: 这部小说跟随一个街头卖报男孩穿过城市街道。

e.en: The old radio had a small orange {glowlamp}.
e.zh: 那台旧收音机有一盏小小的橙色辉光灯。

e.en: A {glowlamp} can indicate voltage in simple equipment.
e.zh: 辉光灯可以在简单设备中指示电压。

glowpotential.t: 辉光电位；放电发光电势

e.en: The experiment measured the {glowpotential} of the gas discharge.
e.zh: 实验测量了气体放电的辉光电位。

e.en: Changes in {glowpotential} affected the brightness of the tube.
e.zh: 辉光电位的变化影响了管子的亮度。

e.en: A purple {gloxinia} bloomed on the windowsill.
e.zh: 一盆紫色大岩桐在窗台上开花。

e.en: She watered the {gloxinia} carefully every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早晨都小心地给那株大岩桐浇水。

e.en: The report tried to {gloze} over the failure.
e.zh: 这份报告试图粉饰那次失败。

e.en: He would {gloze} difficult passages for his students.
e.zh: 他会为学生巧妙解释难懂的段落。

e.en: The minister {glozed} over the scandal in public.
e.zh: 部长在公开场合粉饰了那桩丑闻。

e.en: The scholar {glozed} the old phrase in a note.
e.zh: 那位学者在注释中解释了这个古老短语。

e.en: She kept {glozing} over the obvious contradiction.
e.zh: 她一直在粉饰那个明显的矛盾。

e.en: His lecture was mainly {glozing} difficult legal terms.
e.zh: 他的讲座主要是在解释难懂的法律术语。

e.en: The pancreas releases {glucagon} when blood sugar falls.
e.zh: 血糖下降时，胰腺会释放胰高血糖素。

e.en: Doctors gave him {glucagon} during the emergency.
e.zh: 医生在急救时给他用了胰高血糖素。

e.en: The chemist used {glucal} in the synthesis.
e.zh: 化学家在合成过程中使用了葡萄糖烯。

e.en: This {glucal} derivative reacts under mild conditions.
e.zh: 这种葡萄糖烯衍生物在温和条件下反应。

e.en: Oats contain a soluble {glucan} that may lower cholesterol.
e.zh: 燕麦含有一种可溶性葡聚糖，可能有助于降低胆固醇。

e.en: The fungal cell wall includes {glucan}.
e.zh: 真菌细胞壁中含有葡聚糖。

e.en: The brewery added {glucanase} to improve filtration.
e.zh: 啤酒厂加入葡聚糖酶来改善过滤效果。

e.en: This {glucanase} breaks down plant cell walls.
e.zh: 这种葡聚糖酶会分解植物细胞壁。

e.en: Researchers monitored {glucatonia} after the meal.
e.zh: 研究人员监测了餐后的血糖调节状态。

e.en: Abnormal {glucatonia} may signal metabolic disease.
e.zh: 异常的血糖调节状态可能提示代谢性疾病。

e.en: The nurse checked his {glucemia} before breakfast.
e.zh: 护士在早餐前检查了他的血糖水平。

e.en: Persistent high {glucemia} requires medical attention.
e.zh: 持续的高血糖需要医生处理。

e.en: Starch is a common {glucide} in many diets.
e.zh: 淀粉是许多饮食中常见的糖类。

e.en: The label lists each {glucide} separately.
e.zh: 标签把每种碳水化合物都单独列出。

e.en: Old recipes sometimes mention {glucidine} as a sweetener.
e.zh: 旧食谱有时会把糖精列为甜味剂。

e.en: The sample contained traces of {glucidine}.
e.zh: 样品中含有微量糖精。

e.en: Early chemists called beryllium {glucin}.
e.zh: 早期化学家把铍称为glucin。

e.en: The text described {glucin} as a rare compound.
e.zh: 文中把glucin描述为一种少见化合物。

e.en: The old paper used the term {glucinic} acid.
e.zh: 那篇旧论文使用了“glucinic acid”这个说法。

e.en: A {glucinic} compound was listed in the catalogue.
e.zh: 目录中列出了一种glucinic化合物。

e.en: The mineral was once said to contain {glucinum}.
e.zh: 这种矿物曾被说成含有铍。

e.en: Older textbooks used {glucinum} for beryllium.
e.zh: 较旧的教科书用glucinum来指铍。

e.en: The factory uses {glucoamylase} to convert starch into sugar.
e.zh: 工厂用葡糖淀粉酶把淀粉转化为糖。

e.en: This {glucoamylase} works best at low pH.
e.zh: 这种葡糖淀粉酶在低pH值下效果最好。

e.en: A lack of {glucocerebrosidase} causes Gaucher disease.
e.zh: 缺乏葡糖脑苷脂酶会导致戈谢病。

e.en: The test measured {glucocerebrosidase} activity in cells.
e.zh: 这项检测测量了细胞中的葡糖脑苷脂酶活性。

e.en: Cells can accumulate {glucocerebroside} in Gaucher disease.
e.zh: 在戈谢病中，细胞会积累葡糖脑苷脂。

e.en: The enzyme breaks down {glucocerebroside} inside lysosomes.
e.zh: 这种酶在溶酶体内分解葡糖脑苷脂。

e.en: The experiment used {glucochloralose} as an anesthetic.
e.zh: 实验中使用葡氯醛糖作为麻醉剂。

e.en: Handling {glucochloralose} requires careful laboratory controls.
e.zh: 处理葡氯醛糖需要严格的实验室控制。

e.en: The supplement contained {glucocyamine} and other compounds.
e.zh: 这种补剂含有胍乙酸和其他化合物。

e.en: Researchers studied {glucocyamine} as a creatine precursor.
e.zh: 研究人员把胍乙酸作为肌酸前体来研究。

e.en: Buckthorn bark contains {glucofrangulin} with laxative effects.
e.zh: 鼠李树皮含有具有通便作用的葡糖鼠李皮苷。

e.en: The analyst detected {glucofrangulin} in the plant extract.
e.zh: 分析人员在植物提取物中检测到葡糖鼠李皮苷。

e.en: The molecule can exist as {glucofuranose} in solution.
e.zh: 这种分子在溶液中可以以呋喃型葡萄糖形式存在。

e.en: The diagram shows the ring form of {glucofuranose}.
e.zh: 图示展示了呋喃型葡萄糖的环状结构。

e.en: Some older treatments included {glucofurone}.
e.zh: 一些较早的治疗方案包含葡糖醛酸内酯类药物。

e.en: The physician reviewed the dosage of {glucofurone}.
e.zh: 医生复核了glucofurone的剂量。

e.en: Older biology texts sometimes call glycogen {glucogen}.
e.zh: 较旧的生物学教材有时把糖原称为glucogen。

e.en: The liver stores {glucogen} after a meal.
e.zh: 饭后肝脏会储存糖原。

glucogenesis.t: 糖生成作用；葡萄糖生成过程

e.en: The paper described {glucogenesis} in liver cells.
e.zh: 这篇论文描述了肝细胞中的糖生成作用。

e.en: Some hormones can increase {glucogenesis} during fasting.
e.zh: 禁食期间，一些激素会增强葡萄糖生成过程。

glucogenic.t: 能生糖的；促葡萄糖生成的

e.en: Alanine is a {glucogenic} amino acid.
e.zh: 丙氨酸是一种能生糖的氨基酸。

e.en: The doctor discussed {glucogenic} pathways in metabolism.
e.zh: 医生讨论了代谢中促葡萄糖生成的途径。

glucoheptose.t: 葡庚糖；七碳葡萄糖类糖

e.en: The chemist identified a rare {glucoheptose} in the sample.
e.zh: 化学家在样品中鉴定出一种罕见的葡庚糖。

e.en: A {glucoheptose} molecule contains seven carbon atoms.
e.zh: 一个葡庚糖分子含有七个碳原子。

e.en: {Glucokinase} helps regulate blood sugar in the liver.
e.zh: 葡萄糖激酶有助于调节肝脏中的血糖。

e.en: A mutation in {glucokinase} can affect insulin release.
e.zh: 葡萄糖激酶发生突变可能影响胰岛素释放。

glucokinin.t: 葡萄糖激素样物质；降糖素

e.en: Early researchers called the extract {glucokinin}.
e.zh: 早期研究人员把这种提取物称为降糖素。

e.en: The term {glucokinin} appears mostly in older medical texts.
e.zh: glucokinin这个术语主要见于较早的医学文献。

e.en: Konjac is rich in {glucomannan} fiber.
e.zh: 魔芋富含葡甘露聚糖纤维。

e.en: Some supplements use {glucomannan} to promote fullness.
e.zh: 一些膳食补充剂用葡甘露聚糖来增加饱腹感。

e.en: The tablet contains zinc {gluconate}.
e.zh: 这片药含有葡萄糖酸锌。

e.en: Calcium {gluconate} is sometimes given by injection.
e.zh: 葡萄糖酸钙有时会通过注射给药。

e.en: During fasting, {gluconeogenesis} helps maintain blood glucose.
e.zh: 禁食时，糖异生有助于维持血糖。

e.en: Insulin normally suppresses {gluconeogenesis} in the liver.
e.zh: 胰岛素通常会抑制肝脏中的葡萄糖新生。

e.en: The student misspelled {gluconeogensis} in the report.
e.zh: 学生在报告中把糖异生这个词拼错了。

e.en: Search results for {gluconeogensis} usually point to gluconeogenesis.
e.zh: 搜索gluconeogensis时，结果通常会指向gluconeogenesis。

e.en: Tofu can be set with {gluconolactone}.
e.zh: 豆腐可以用葡萄糖酸内酯凝固。

e.en: Cosmetic formulas may include {gluconolactone} as a mild acid.
e.zh: 化妆品配方中可能加入葡萄糖酸内酯作为温和酸。

e.en: The model proposed a {glucophore} for sweet taste.
e.zh: 该模型提出了一种产生甜味的甜味基团。

e.en: Chemists compared each {glucophore} in the series.
e.zh: 化学家比较了这一系列中的每个糖载体基团。

e.en: The membrane contains a protective {glucoprotein}.
e.zh: 这层膜含有一种保护性糖蛋白。

e.en: Researchers measured {glucoprotein} levels in the serum.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了血清中的糖蛋白水平。

e.en: Most glucose in water exists as {glucopyranose}.
e.zh: 水中的葡萄糖大多以吡喃葡萄糖形式存在。

e.en: The diagram shows the ring form of {glucopyranose}.
e.zh: 图中显示了吡喃葡萄糖的环状结构。

e.en: The plant compound is a {glucopyranoside}.
e.zh: 这种植物化合物是一种吡喃葡萄糖苷。

e.en: They synthesized a new {glucopyranoside} in the lab.
e.zh: 他们在实验室合成了一种新的吡喃葡萄糖苷。

e.en: A {glucoreceptor} can detect changes in glucose concentration.
e.zh: 葡萄糖感受器能够检测葡萄糖浓度的变化。

e.en: The brain may use each {glucoreceptor} to monitor energy status.
e.zh: 大脑可能利用每个葡萄糖感受器来监测能量状态。

e.en: The label printed {glucorprotein} instead of glycoprotein.
e.zh: 标签把glycoprotein误印成了glucorprotein。

e.en: A search for {glucorprotein} may return results about glucoprotein.
e.zh: 搜索glucorprotein时，可能会出现关于糖蛋白的结果。

glucosan.t: 葡聚糖；葡萄糖脱水聚合物

e.en: Cellulose is sometimes described as a {glucosan}.
e.zh: 纤维素有时被描述为一种葡聚糖。

e.en: The old chemistry text mentions {glucosan} compounds.
e.zh: 这本旧化学教材提到了葡萄糖脱水聚合物。

e.en: The enzyme {glucosidase} breaks down certain sugars.
e.zh: 葡萄糖苷酶能分解某些糖类。

e.en: Doctors tested {glucosidase} activity in the patient's cells.
e.zh: 医生检测了患者细胞中的葡萄糖苷酶活性。

e.en: Many gut bacteria produce {glucosidases}.
e.zh: 许多肠道细菌会产生葡萄糖苷酶类。

e.en: The inhibitor blocks several {glucosidases} at once.
e.zh: 这种抑制剂会同时阻断几种葡萄糖苷酶。

e.en: Salicin is a natural {glucoside}.
e.zh: 水杨苷是一种天然葡萄糖苷。

e.en: The bitter {glucoside} was isolated from the leaves.
e.zh: 这种苦味葡萄糖苷是从叶子中分离出来的。

e.en: The enzyme cleaves the {glucosidic} bond.
e.zh: 这种酶会切断糖苷键。

e.en: Chemists studied the {glucosidic} structure of the compound.
e.zh: 化学家研究了该化合物的葡萄糖苷结构。

e.en: {Glucosinase} releases pungent compounds from mustard seeds.
e.zh: 硫代葡糖苷酶会从芥菜籽中释放辛辣化合物。

e.en: The activity of {glucosinase} changes after the plant is crushed.
e.zh: 植物被压碎后，硫代葡糖苷酶的活性会发生变化。

e.en: Broccoli contains the {glucosinolate} glucoraphanin.
e.zh: 西兰花含有硫代葡萄糖苷萝卜硫苷。

e.en: Cooking can reduce {glucosinolate} levels in vegetables.
e.zh: 烹调可能降低蔬菜中的硫代葡萄糖苷含量。

e.en: The reaction produced {glucosone} as an intermediate.
e.zh: 该反应生成了葡萄糖酮作为中间体。

e.en: Researchers detected {glucosone} in the oxidized sugar mixture.
e.zh: 研究人员在氧化后的糖混合物中检测到葡萄糖酮。

e.en: A {glucosphingolipid} accumulates in Gaucher disease.
e.zh: 戈谢病中会积累一种葡萄糖鞘脂。

e.en: The membrane sample contained a minor {glucosphingolipid}.
e.zh: 这份膜样品中含有少量葡萄糖鞘脂。

e.en: The doctor found {glucosuria} during a routine urine test.
e.zh: 医生在常规尿检中发现了糖尿。

e.en: Persistent {glucosuria} can suggest poor blood sugar control.
e.zh: 持续糖尿可能提示血糖控制不佳。

e.en: {Glucosylceramide} accumulates in certain inherited storage diseases.
e.zh: 葡糖基神经酰胺会在某些遗传性贮积病中积累。

e.en: Researchers measured {glucosylceramide} levels in the cell membrane.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了细胞膜中的葡糖基神经酰胺水平。

e.en: A {glucosyltransferase} helps attach glucose to other molecules.
e.zh: 葡糖基转移酶有助于把葡萄糖连接到其他分子上。

e.en: The bacterial {glucosyltransferase} contributes to dental plaque formation.
e.zh: 这种细菌葡糖基转移酶会促进牙菌斑形成。

e.en: Vanilla beans contain {glucovanillin} before curing begins.
e.zh: 香草豆在开始熟化前含有葡糖香兰素。

e.en: Enzymes break down {glucovanillin} to release vanillin aroma.
e.zh: 酶会分解葡糖香兰素，释放香兰素香气。

glucurone.t: 葡糖醛酸内酯类化合物

e.en: The chemist identified a {glucurone} derivative in the sample.
e.zh: 化学家在样品中鉴定出一种葡糖醛酸内酯衍生物。

e.en: Older papers sometimes use {glucurone} in carbohydrate chemistry.
e.zh: 较早的论文有时在碳水化合物化学中使用glucurone这个词。

e.en: The lab tested {glucuronidase} activity in the tissue sample.
e.zh: 实验室检测了组织样本中的葡糖醛酸苷酶活性。

e.en: Bacterial {glucuronidase} can affect how some drugs are recycled.
e.zh: 细菌葡糖醛酸苷酶会影响某些药物在体内的再循环。

glucuronide.t: 葡糖醛酸苷；葡糖醛酸结合物

e.en: The drug is excreted mainly as a {glucuronide}.
e.zh: 这种药物主要以葡糖醛酸结合物的形式排出。

e.en: Bilirubin {glucuronide} is formed in the liver.
e.zh: 胆红素葡糖醛酸苷在肝脏中形成。

e.en: Some energy drinks list {glucuronolactone} among their ingredients.
e.zh: 一些能量饮料把葡糖醛酸内酯列在配料中。

e.en: The study examined whether {glucuronolactone} affected fatigue.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了葡糖醛酸内酯是否会影响疲劳感。

e.en: The campaign warned teenagers about {glue-sniffing}.
e.zh: 这场宣传活动警告青少年不要嗅胶滥用。

e.en: Long-term {glue-sniffing} can seriously damage the brain.
e.zh: 长期吸胶毒会严重损害大脑。

e.en: The carpenter brushed {glue-water} onto the loose veneer.
e.zh: 木匠把胶水溶液刷在松动的贴面上。

e.en: Old recipes used {glue-water} to stiffen delicate fabric.
e.zh: 旧配方会用胶液让细薄织物变挺。

e.en: The bookbinder kept warm paste in a small {gluepot}.
e.zh: 装订工把温热的浆糊放在一个小胶锅里。

e.en: A cracked {gluepot} leaked onto the workbench.
e.zh: 裂开的盛胶容器漏到了工作台上。

e.en: She thinned the adhesive into {gluewater} for the paper repair.
e.zh: 她把黏合剂稀释成胶液，用来修补纸张。

e.en: The conservator applied {gluewater} with a fine brush.
e.zh: 文物修复师用细刷涂上胶水溶液。

e.en: The rice became {gluey} after too much stirring.
e.zh: 米饭搅拌过多后变得黏糊糊的。

e.en: A {gluey} film covered the old label.
e.zh: 旧标签上覆盖着一层像胶一样的薄膜。

e.en: The chef disliked the {glueyness} of the overcooked noodles.
e.zh: 厨师不喜欢煮过头面条的黏糊感。

e.en: Extra starch increased the sauce's {glueyness}.
e.zh: 额外的淀粉增加了酱汁的胶黏感。

e.en: The melted candy stretched {gluily} between his fingers.
e.zh: 融化的糖黏糊糊地在他手指间拉开。

e.en: Paint dripped {gluily} down the side of the can.
e.zh: 油漆像胶一样黏稠地顺着罐边滴下。

e.en: The roof beams were made from {glulam}.
e.zh: 屋顶梁采用胶合层压木材制成。

e.en: Architects often choose {glulam} for strong curved structures.
e.zh: 建筑师常选用胶合层压木材来建造坚固的弧形结构。

e.en: The botanist described the grass flower as {glumaceous}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种禾草花描述为有颖片的。

e.en: Its {glumaceous} bracts protected the tiny seed.
e.zh: 它的颖片状苞片保护着细小的种子。

e.en: Each wheat spikelet has a protective {glume}.
e.zh: 每个小麦小穗都有保护性的颖片。

e.en: The dry {glume} fell away during threshing.
e.zh: 干燥的颖片在脱粒时脱落了。

e.en: The specimen had a distinctly {glumose} base.
e.zh: 这个标本的基部明显呈颖片状。

e.en: A {glumose} covering surrounded the young grain.
e.zh: 幼小谷粒周围有一层似颖片的包被。

glumpy.t: 阴沉别扭的；笨拙成块的

e.en: He gave a {glumpy} reply and stared at the floor.
e.zh: 他阴沉别扭地回答了一句，然后盯着地板。

e.en: The batter turned {glumpy} when she added cold milk.
e.zh: 她加入冷牛奶后，面糊变得结块又黏重。

e.en: She gave him a sharp {glunch} across the table.
e.zh: 她隔着桌子狠狠地瞪了他一眼。

e.en: His silent {glunch} made the room feel colder.
e.zh: 他沉默而阴郁的神色让房间气氛更冷。

e.en: The old text classified the compound as a {gluside}.
e.zh: 那本旧教材把这种化合物归为糖苷。

e.en: Chemists later replaced {gluside} with the term glycoside.
e.zh: 化学家后来用glycoside这个术语取代了gluside。

e.en: {Glutamic} acid is an important amino acid.
e.zh: 谷氨酸是一种重要的氨基酸。

e.en: The label mentioned {glutamic} acid as a flavor component.
e.zh: 标签提到谷氨酸是一种风味成分。

e.en: Cancer cells may rely heavily on {glutaminase}.
e.zh: 癌细胞可能高度依赖谷氨酰胺酶。

e.en: The inhibitor reduced {glutaminase} activity in the experiment.
e.zh: 这种抑制剂在实验中降低了谷氨酰胺酶活性。

glutaraldehyde.t: 戊二醛消毒剂或固定剂

e.en: The lab used {glutaraldehyde} to preserve the tissue sample.
e.zh: 实验室用戊二醛保存组织样本。

e.en: Hospitals handle {glutaraldehyde} carefully because it can irritate skin.
e.zh: 医院会小心处理戊二醛，因为它会刺激皮肤。

glutaramide.t: 戊二酰胺；谷酰胺类物质

e.en: The chemist identified {glutaramide} in the reaction mixture.
e.zh: 化学家在反应混合物中鉴定出戊二酰胺。

e.en: A derivative of {glutaramide} was tested for biological activity.
e.zh: 一种戊二酰胺衍生物被用于测试生物活性。

e.en: The old paper described {glutazine} as a nitrogen-containing compound.
e.zh: 那篇旧论文把谷嗪描述为一种含氮化合物。

e.en: Few modern textbooks mention {glutazine} by name.
e.zh: 现代教材很少直接提到谷嗪这个名称。

e.en: The exercise strengthens the {glutei} and lower back.
e.zh: 这项练习能强化臀肌群和下背部。

e.en: Anatomy students learned how the {glutei} support hip movement.
e.zh: 解剖课学生学习臀肌群如何支撑髋部运动。

e.en: Rice contains {glutelin} as one of its main storage proteins.
e.zh: 大米含有谷蛋白，这是其主要贮藏蛋白之一。

e.en: The researcher measured {glutelin} levels in different grains.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了不同谷物中的谷蛋白含量。

e.en: The dough became sticky and {glutenous} after kneading.
e.zh: 面团揉过后变得黏稠，带有面筋质感。

e.en: People with celiac disease avoid {glutenous} foods.
e.zh: 乳糜泻患者会避免含麸质的食物。

e.en: Doctors once prescribed {glutethimide} as a sleeping pill.
e.zh: 医生过去曾把格鲁米特作为安眠药开给病人。

e.en: An overdose of {glutethimide} can be dangerous.
e.zh: 格鲁米特过量服用可能很危险。

e.en: The broth cooled into a soft {glutin}.
e.zh: 肉汤冷却后凝成柔软的胶质物。

e.en: Old recipes sometimes used {glutin} to thicken sauces.
e.zh: 旧食谱有时用明胶来增稠酱汁。

e.en: The analyst separated {glutinosin} from the seed extract.
e.zh: 分析员从种子提取物中分离出谷黏素。

e.en: Very little is known about {glutinosin} outside specialist literature.
e.zh: 除专业文献外，人们对谷黏素了解很少。

e.en: The chef liked the rice for its gentle {glutinosity}.
e.zh: 厨师喜欢这种米温和的黏性。

e.en: Excess {glutinosity} made the paste hard to spread.
e.zh: 过强的黏性让这种糊状物很难抹开。

e.en: The sample formed a {glutoid} mass in water.
e.zh: 样品在水中形成了胶样团块。

e.en: A {glutoid} coating protected the tablet until digestion.
e.zh: 一层胶样包衣保护药片直到消化时才释放。

e.en: The formula for {glutol} appeared in an early chemistry handbook.
e.zh: 谷醇的化学式出现在一本早期化学手册中。

e.en: The technician labeled the vial as {glutol}.
e.zh: 技术员把小瓶标记为谷醇。

e.en: The article listed {glutose} among unusual sugars.
e.zh: 那篇文章把胶糖列入少见糖类之中。

e.en: They tested whether {glutose} changed the solution's viscosity.
e.zh: 他们测试胶糖是否会改变溶液黏度。

e.en: The old analysis reported {glutrin} in the plant material.
e.zh: 旧分析报告称植物材料中含有胶素。

e.en: Modern writers rarely use the term {glutrin}.
e.zh: 现代作者很少使用胶素这个术语。

e.en: He would {gluttonise} at every holiday feast.
e.zh: 每逢节日宴席，他都会暴食一番。

e.en: The satire shows nobles who {gluttonise} while others starve.
e.zh: 这部讽刺作品描写贵族在别人挨饿时贪吃享乐。

e.en: They warned him not to {gluttonize} before the race.
e.zh: 他们提醒他比赛前不要暴食。

e.en: The novel mocks people who {gluttonize} without shame.
e.zh: 这部小说嘲讽那些毫无羞耻地贪吃的人。

e.en: He had {gluttonized} all afternoon and felt ill.
e.zh: 他整个下午都在暴食，结果感到不舒服。

e.en: The guests {gluttonized} until the table was bare.
e.zh: 客人们贪吃到桌上的食物一扫而空。

e.en: She regretted {gluttonizing} at the buffet.
e.zh: 她后悔在自助餐上暴食。

e.en: The sermon condemned {gluttonizing} as a moral weakness.
e.zh: 布道把贪吃斥为一种道德弱点。

glycal.t: 糖烯；糖类不饱和衍生物

e.en: The chemist synthesized a new {glycal} for the study.
e.zh: 化学家为这项研究合成了一种新的糖烯。

e.en: A {glycal} can serve as a building block in carbohydrate chemistry.
e.zh: 糖烯可作为碳水化合物化学中的构件。

e.en: Each protein carried a different {glycan} on its surface.
e.zh: 每种蛋白质表面都带有不同的聚糖。

e.en: Scientists mapped the {glycan} structures involved in infection.
e.zh: 科学家绘制了参与感染的聚糖结构。

glycate.t: 使糖化；发生糖基化反应

e.en: High blood sugar can {glycate} proteins in the body.
e.zh: 高血糖会使体内蛋白质发生糖化。

e.en: Heat may {glycate} the milk proteins during processing.
e.zh: 加工时的加热可能使乳蛋白糖化。

e.en: The doctor checked his {glycated} hemoglobin level.
e.zh: 医生检查了他的糖化血红蛋白水平。

e.en: Researchers studied how {glycated} proteins affect aging tissues.
e.zh: 研究人员研究糖化蛋白如何影响老化组织。

glyceleum.t: 甘油类制剂；罕见药剂名

e.en: The pharmacist prepared {glyceleum} for the prescription.
e.zh: 药剂师按处方配制了甘油类制剂。

e.en: An old medical text recommended {glyceleum} for topical use.
e.zh: 一本旧医学书建议将甘油类制剂用于外用。

e.en: Exercise can help control {glycemia} after meals.
e.zh: 运动有助于控制餐后的血糖水平。

e.en: The study compared fasting {glycemia} in two groups.
e.zh: 这项研究比较了两组人的空腹血糖状态。

e.en: The old formulary listed {glycemin} as a sweet medicinal preparation.
e.zh: 旧药方把糖精列为一种带甜味的药用制剂。

e.en: Researchers tested whether {glycemin} affected blood sugar levels.
e.zh: 研究人员测试糖精是否会影响血糖水平。

e.en: {Glyceraldehyde} is a simple sugar used in biochemistry classes.
e.zh: 甘油醛是生物化学课上使用的一种简单糖。

e.en: The experiment measured how {glyceraldehyde} reacted with the enzyme.
e.zh: 实验测量了甘油醛与这种酶反应的情况。

e.en: The chemist prepared {glyceramine} under controlled laboratory conditions.
e.zh: 化学家在受控的实验室条件下制备了甘油胺。

e.en: {Glyceramine} derivatives appeared in the synthesis pathway.
e.zh: 甘油胺衍生物出现在这条合成途径中。

e.en: The sample contained calcium {glycerate} after neutralization.
e.zh: 中和后，样品中含有甘油酸钙。

e.en: Cells convert some sugars into {glycerate} during metabolism.
e.zh: 细胞在代谢过程中会把一些糖转化为甘油酸盐。

e.en: The lab ordered {glyceric} acid for the reaction.
e.zh: 实验室为这次反应订购了甘油酸。

e.en: A {glyceric} compound was detected in the solution.
e.zh: 溶液中检测到一种甘油酸类化合物。

e.en: A triglyceride is a common type of {glyceride}.
e.zh: 甘油三酯是一种常见的甘油酯。

e.en: The oil sample had a high {glyceride} content.
e.zh: 这份油样的甘油酯含量很高。

e.en: The study focused on {glyceridic} bonds in natural fats.
e.zh: 这项研究关注天然脂肪中的甘油酯键。

e.en: Enzymes can break down {glyceridic} compounds during digestion.
e.zh: 酶能在消化过程中分解甘油酯类化合物。

e.en: The reaction produced sodium {glycerinate} as a by-product.
e.zh: 该反应生成了甘油酸钠作为副产物。

e.en: They used a {glycerinate} to stabilize the mixture.
e.zh: 他们使用一种甘油酸盐来稳定混合物。

e.en: The pharmacist prepared a herbal {glycerite} for the patient.
e.zh: 药剂师为病人配制了一种草药甘油浸剂。

e.en: A {glycerite} can taste sweeter than an alcohol tincture.
e.zh: 甘油浸剂的味道可能比酒精酊剂更甜。

e.en: The bacterium produced {glycerolinase} under anaerobic conditions.
e.zh: 这种细菌在厌氧条件下产生甘油裂解酶。

e.en: Scientists studied {glycerolinase} activity in the culture.
e.zh: 科学家研究了培养物中的甘油裂解酶活性。

e.en: The supplement contained several {glycerophosphates}.
e.zh: 这种补充剂含有几种甘油磷酸盐。

e.en: Some {glycerophosphates} are important in cell metabolism.
e.zh: 一些甘油磷酸盐在细胞代谢中很重要。

e.en: {Glycerophosphomutase} helps rearrange phosphate groups in metabolism.
e.zh: 甘油磷酸变位酶有助于在代谢中重排磷酸基团。

e.en: The mutation reduced {glycerophosphomutase} activity in the cells.
e.zh: 该突变降低了细胞中的甘油磷酸变位酶活性。

e.en: The analysis detected {glycerophosphorylethanolamine} in brain tissue.
e.zh: 分析在脑组织中检测到了甘油磷酰乙醇胺。

e.en: {Glycerophosphorylethanolamine} may appear during phospholipid breakdown.
e.zh: 甘油磷酰乙醇胺可能在磷脂分解过程中出现。

e.en: Older chemistry texts sometimes use {glycerose} for glyceraldehyde.
e.zh: 较早的化学教材有时用甘油糖指甘油醛。

e.en: The students compared {glycerose} with other simple sugars.
e.zh: 学生们把甘油糖与其他简单糖作了比较。

e.en: The molecule contains a {glyceroyl} group attached to nitrogen.
e.zh: 该分子含有一个连接在氮上的甘油酰基。

e.en: Chemists identified the {glyceroyl} fragment by spectroscopy.
e.zh: 化学家通过光谱法鉴定出这个甘油酰基片段。

e.en: The resin was made from a reactive {glycide}.
e.zh: 这种树脂由一种活性缩水甘油醚类化合物制成。

e.en: Workers handled the {glycide} under a fume hood.
e.zh: 工人在通风橱内处理这种缩水甘油醚类化合物。

e.en: {Glycidol} is used as an intermediate in chemical synthesis.
e.zh: 缩水甘油可作为化学合成中的中间体。

e.en: The safety report warned that {glycidol} can be hazardous.
e.zh: 安全报告警告说缩水甘油可能有危险。

e.en: Older papers sometimes call glycine {glycin}.
e.zh: 较早的论文有时把甘氨酸称为glycin。

e.en: Photographers once used {glycin} in certain developers.
e.zh: 摄影师过去曾在某些显影液中使用甘氨。

e.en: {Glycobiarsol} was discussed as an antiprotozoal drug.
e.zh: 甘糖双胂醇曾被作为抗原虫药物讨论。

e.en: The physician avoided {glycobiarsol} because of toxicity concerns.
e.zh: 医生因担心毒性而避免使用甘糖双胂醇。

e.en: The cell surface is covered by a protective {glycocalyx}.
e.zh: 细胞表面覆盖着一层保护性的糖萼。

e.en: Bacteria use the {glycocalyx} to attach to surfaces.
e.zh: 细菌利用糖萼附着在物体表面。

e.en: {Glycocoll} is an older name for glycine.
e.zh: glycocoll是甘氨酸的旧称。

e.en: The nineteenth-century text described {glycocoll} as sweet-tasting.
e.zh: 这本十九世纪文献把甘氨酸旧称描述为有甜味。

e.en: The pathway included {glycocyamidine} as a minor product.
e.zh: 这条途径包含胍基乙内酰脲作为少量产物。

e.en: Researchers quantified {glycocyamidine} in the urine samples.
e.zh: 研究人员测定了尿样中的胍基乙内酰脲含量。

e.en: {Glycocyamine} is also known as guanidinoacetic acid.
e.zh: 胍基乙酸也称为guanidinoacetic acid。

e.en: The supplement label listed {glycocyamine} among its ingredients.
e.zh: 补充剂标签把胍基乙酸列为成分之一。

e.en: The assay measured {glycogenase} activity in liver extracts.
e.zh: 该测定检测了肝脏提取物中的糖原酶活性。

e.en: A lack of {glycogenase} can disrupt glycogen breakdown.
e.zh: 缺乏糖原酶会干扰糖原分解。

e.en: Insulin promotes {glycogenesis} after a meal.
e.zh: 饭后胰岛素会促进糖原生成作用。

e.en: The textbook explains {glycogenesis} before glycogen breakdown.
e.zh: 教材先解释糖原生成作用，再讲糖原分解。

e.en: Insulin promotes {glycogenic} activity in liver cells.
e.zh: 胰岛素会促进肝细胞中生成糖原的活动。

e.en: The enzyme has a mainly {glycogenic} role after meals.
e.zh: 饭后这种酶主要起合成糖原的作用。

e.en: Exercise can increase {glycogenolysis} in muscle tissue.
e.zh: 运动会增加肌肉组织中的糖原分解。

e.en: The hormone triggers {glycogenolysis} during fasting.
e.zh: 禁食时这种激素会触发糖原分解。

e.en: The child was diagnosed with {glycogenosis} early.
e.zh: 这个孩子很早就被诊断出糖原贮积病。

e.en: Some forms of {glycogenosis} affect the liver.
e.zh: 有些类型的糖原贮积病会影响肝脏。

e.en: The study measured {glycogeusia} in several patients.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了几名患者的甜味觉。

e.en: Loss of {glycogeusia} made desserts seem bland.
e.zh: 甜味觉丧失让甜点吃起来索然无味。

e.en: The report mentioned {glycohistechia} in damaged tissue.
e.zh: 报告提到受损组织中存在含糖量异常。

e.en: Doctors rarely use {glycohistechia} outside specialist writing.
e.zh: 医生很少在专业文章之外使用组织含糖量异常这个词。

e.en: The chemist prepared {glycolamide} in the laboratory.
e.zh: 化学师在实验室制备了乙醇酰胺。

e.en: Pure {glycolamide} was stored in a sealed vial.
e.zh: 纯乙醇酰胺被保存在密封小瓶中。

e.en: Plants produce {glycolate} during photorespiration.
e.zh: 植物在光呼吸过程中会产生乙醇酸盐。

e.en: The sample contained a small amount of {glycolate}.
e.zh: 样品中含有少量乙醇酸盐。

e.en: The peptide included {glycoleucine} as a modified residue.
e.zh: 这种肽含有羟基亮氨酸作为修饰残基。

e.en: Researchers detected {glycoleucine} in the analyzed protein.
e.zh: 研究人员在分析的蛋白质中检测到羟基亮氨酸。

e.en: Many skin products contain {glycolic} acid.
e.zh: 许多护肤品含有乙醇酸。

e.en: The lab tested a {glycolic} solution for purity.
e.zh: 实验室检测了一种乙醇酸溶液的纯度。

e.en: A {glycolipid} helps stabilize the cell membrane.
e.zh: 一种糖脂有助于稳定细胞膜。

e.en: The disease alters {glycolipid} metabolism in nerves.
e.zh: 这种疾病会改变神经中的糖脂代谢。

e.en: Older papers sometimes spell {glycolipide} with a final e.
e.zh: 较早的论文有时把糖脂一词拼作带末尾 e 的形式。

e.en: The extract contained a rare {glycolipide}.
e.zh: 提取物中含有一种罕见的糖脂。

e.en: The fraction was labeled {glycolipin} in the old text.
e.zh: 旧文献中把这个组分称为糖脂类物质。

e.en: Few modern articles use {glycolipin} for these compounds.
e.zh: 现代文章很少用糖脂类物质这个词称呼这些化合物。

e.en: The parasite stores enzymes inside a {glycolisome}.
e.zh: 这种寄生虫把酶储存在糖酵解体内。

e.en: A damaged {glycolisome} can disrupt energy production.
e.zh: 受损的糖酵解体可能扰乱能量产生。

e.en: The reaction produced sodium {glycollate}.
e.zh: 该反应生成了乙醇酸钠。

e.en: British texts may use {glycollate} for glycolate.
e.zh: 英国文献可能用 glycollate 表示乙醇酸盐。

e.en: The polymer was made from {glycollide} monomers.
e.zh: 这种聚合物由乙交酯单体制成。

e.en: Stored {glycollide} must be kept dry.
e.zh: 储存的乙交酯必须保持干燥。

e.en: The paper compared {glycolyses} in two organisms.
e.zh: 论文比较了两种生物中的糖酵解过程。

e.en: Several abnormal {glycolyses} were reported in the study.
e.zh: 研究报告了几种异常的糖酵解情况。

e.en: Cells use {glycolysis} to break down glucose.
e.zh: 细胞利用糖酵解来分解葡萄糖。

e.en: Cancer cells often show increased {glycolysis}.
e.zh: 癌细胞常常表现出增强的糖酵解。

e.en: The tumor showed high {glycolytic} activity.
e.zh: 这个肿瘤表现出很高的糖酵解活性。

e.en: Several {glycolytic} enzymes were missing from the sample.
e.zh: 样品中缺少几种糖酵解酶。

e.en: The synthesis yielded a small amount of {glycolyurea}.
e.zh: 这次合成得到少量乙醇酰脲。

e.en: Old chemical catalogs list {glycolyurea} under urea derivatives.
e.zh: 旧化学目录把乙醇酰脲列在脲衍生物下。

e.en: The compound was described as a {glycomide}.
e.zh: 该化合物被描述为一种糖酰胺。

e.en: This {glycomide} reacts slowly in water.
e.zh: 这种糖酰胺在水中反应缓慢。

e.en: The liver increases {glyconeogenesis} during starvation.
e.zh: 饥饿时肝脏会增加糖异生。

e.en: Hormones regulate {glyconeogenesis} after a long fast.
e.zh: 长时间禁食后，激素会调节糖异生。

e.en: The bottle contained a {glyconic} acid solution.
e.zh: 瓶中装有葡萄糖酸溶液。

e.en: Some texts use {glyconic} where gluconic is expected.
e.zh: 有些文献在本应写葡萄糖酸的地方使用 glyconic。

e.en: Severe {glycopenia} can impair brain function.
e.zh: 严重低糖状态会损害脑功能。

e.en: The symptoms suggested temporary {glycopenia}.
e.zh: 这些症状提示可能是一过性糖缺乏。

e.en: The author used {glycopexis} for carbohydrate fixation.
e.zh: 作者用糖固定一词表示碳水化合物的固定。

e.en: Early physiology texts discuss {glycopexis} after meals.
e.zh: 早期生理学文献讨论饭后的糖原固定。

e.en: The plant extract contained {glycophymine}.
e.zh: 这种植物提取物中含有糖苷类生物碱。

e.en: Chemists identified {glycophymine} as a minor constituent.
e.zh: 化学家将糖苷类生物碱鉴定为一种微量成分。

e.en: Rice is generally a {glycophyte} rather than a salt-loving plant.
e.zh: 水稻通常是淡土植物，而不是喜盐植物。

e.en: The botanist classified the seedling as a {glycophyte}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这株幼苗归为不耐盐植物。

e.en: Heparin is a well-known {glycosaminoglycan} used in medicine.
e.zh: 肝素是一种医学上常用的糖胺聚糖。

e.en: The tissue sample contained a complex {glycosaminoglycan}.
e.zh: 这份组织样本含有一种复杂的糖胺聚糖。

e.en: Cartilage contains many {glycosaminoglycans} that help it retain water.
e.zh: 软骨含有许多糖胺聚糖，帮助它保持水分。

e.en: The researchers measured {glycosaminoglycans} in the joint fluid.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了关节液中的糖胺聚糖类物质。

e.en: Older chemistry texts sometimes used {glycose} for glucose.
e.zh: 较早的化学文献有时用glycose表示葡萄糖。

e.en: The solution was tested for {glycose} after fermentation.
e.zh: 发酵后，人们检测了溶液中的糖类。

e.en: The enzyme {glycosidase} helps break specific sugar bonds.
e.zh: 糖苷酶有助于分解特定的糖键。

e.en: A defective {glycosidase} can disrupt normal metabolism.
e.zh: 有缺陷的糖苷酶会扰乱正常代谢。

e.en: Starch contains many {glycosidic} bonds between glucose units.
e.zh: 淀粉含有许多连接葡萄糖单元的糖苷键。

e.en: The chemist studied the compound's {glycosidic} structure.
e.zh: 化学家研究了该化合物的糖苷结构。

e.en: The sugars are {glycosidically} linked in the molecule.
e.zh: 这些糖在分子中以糖苷键方式相连。

e.en: Two residues were {glycosidically} attached to the core structure.
e.zh: 两个残基以糖苷键方式连接到核心结构上。

e.en: A {glycosphingolipid} can influence how cells recognize each other.
e.zh: 糖鞘脂会影响细胞彼此识别的方式。

e.en: The disease involves abnormal {glycosphingolipid} storage in tissues.
e.zh: 这种疾病涉及组织中糖鞘脂的异常贮积。

e.en: The urine test showed mild {glycosuria}.
e.zh: 尿检显示有轻度糖尿。

e.en: Persistent {glycosuria} may suggest problems with glucose control.
e.zh: 持续性尿糖可能提示血糖控制有问题。

e.en: The doctor reviewed the patient's {glycosuric} symptoms.
e.zh: 医生查看了患者的糖尿症状。

e.en: A {glycosuric} urine sample requires further testing.
e.zh: 含糖的尿液样本需要进一步检测。

e.en: The molecule includes a reactive {glycosyl} group.
e.zh: 该分子含有一个活性的糖基。

e.en: A {glycosyl} donor is used in this synthesis.
e.zh: 这种合成中会使用糖基供体。

e.en: Cells can {glycosylate} proteins after they are made.
e.zh: 细胞能在蛋白质生成后使其糖基化。

e.en: The team tried to {glycosylate} the compound in the laboratory.
e.zh: 团队试图在实验室给该化合物加上糖基。

e.en: Protein {glycosylation} affects folding and stability.
e.zh: 蛋白质糖基化会影响折叠和稳定性。

e.en: The mutation changed the pattern of {glycosylation}.
e.zh: 这一突变改变了糖基化的模式。

e.en: The bacteria showed {glycotaxis} toward the sugar source.
e.zh: 这些细菌表现出朝向糖源的趋糖性。

e.en: Researchers modeled {glycotaxis} in a simple microbial system.
e.zh: 研究人员在一个简单的微生物系统中模拟了糖趋化性。

e.en: The paper described {glycuronogenesis} in liver metabolism.
e.zh: 论文描述了肝脏代谢中的葡萄糖醛酸生成。

e.en: Defects in {glycuronogenesis} may affect detoxification pathways.
e.zh: 葡萄糖醛酸生成异常可能影响解毒途径。

e.en: The peptide begins with a {glycyl} residue.
e.zh: 这条肽链以一个甘氨酰基残基开头。

e.en: They synthesized a {glycyl} derivative for testing.
e.zh: 他们合成了一种甘氨酰基衍生物用于测试。

e.en: The extract came from {glycyrrhiza} root.
e.zh: 这种提取物来自甘草根。

e.en: Some herbal formulas include {glycyrrhiza} for flavor.
e.zh: 一些草药配方会加入甘草来调味。

e.en: Licorice owes much of its sweetness to {glycyrrhizin}.
e.zh: 甘草的甜味很大程度上来自甘草甜素。

e.en: High intake of {glycyrrhizin} can affect blood pressure.
e.zh: 大量摄入甘草甜素可能影响血压。

e.en: The report misspelled {glyhosate} in the chemical list.
e.zh: 报告在化学品清单中把草甘膦拼错了。

e.en: Some readers may recognize {glyhosate} as a variant spelling of glyphosate.
e.zh: 有些读者可能会把glyhosate看作glyphosate的变体拼写。

e.en: The old article used {glykophyte} for a salt-sensitive plant.
e.zh: 这篇旧文章用glykophyte表示不耐盐植物。

e.en: A {glykophyte} struggles in highly saline soil.
e.zh: 淡土植物在高盐土壤中难以生长。

e.en: The resin was treated with {glyoxal} to improve durability.
e.zh: 这种树脂用乙二醛处理以提高耐久性。

e.en: Laboratory workers handled {glyoxal} under a fume hood.
e.zh: 实验人员在通风橱中操作乙二醛。

e.en: The {glyoxalase} system protects cells from toxic aldehydes.
e.zh: 乙二醛酶系统保护细胞免受有毒醛类伤害。

e.en: They measured {glyoxalase} activity in the cultured cells.
e.zh: 他们测量了培养细胞中的乙二醛酶活性。

e.en: Older texts may call imidazole {glyoxaline}.
e.zh: 较早的文献可能把咪唑称为glyoxaline。

e.en: The chemist found {glyoxaline} listed under an outdated name.
e.zh: 化学家发现glyoxaline被列在一个旧名称下面。

e.en: The chemist used {glyoxime} to test for nickel ions.
e.zh: 化学师用乙二肟检测镍离子。

e.en: A {glyoxime} derivative formed bright crystals in the flask.
e.zh: 一种乙二肟衍生物在烧瓶中形成了亮晶体。

glyphograph.t: 象形文字记录；刻写图符

e.en: The tablet carried a damaged {glyphograph} near the edge.
e.zh: 那块泥板边缘有一处受损的图符刻写。

e.en: Scholars compared each {glyphograph} with older temple inscriptions.
e.zh: 学者把每个象形文字记录与更早的神庙铭文比较。

glyphographic.t: 象形文字的；图符书写的

e.en: The museum displayed several {glyphographic} symbols from the site.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了该遗址的几个象形文字符号。

e.en: Her paper analyzed the {glyphographic} style of the carving.
e.zh: 她的论文分析了这件雕刻的图符书写风格。

glyphography.t: 象形文字学；图符书写法

e.en: He studied {glyphography} to read ancient stone records.
e.zh: 他研究象形文字学，以解读古代石刻记录。

e.en: The course treats {glyphography} as both art and writing.
e.zh: 这门课把图符书写法同时视为艺术和文字。

glyptic.t: 宝石雕刻的；雕刻艺术的

e.en: The ring shows fine {glyptic} work on its seal.
e.zh: 这枚戒指的印章面上有精细的宝石雕刻。

e.en: Ancient {glyptic} art often used tiny mythological scenes.
e.zh: 古代雕刻艺术常使用微小的神话场景。

e.en: She specialized in {glyptics} at the archaeology institute.
e.zh: 她在考古研究所专攻宝石雕刻术。

e.en: The exhibition explains how {glyptics} shaped official seals.
e.zh: 展览说明了印章雕刻如何塑造官方印信。

e.en: A fossil {glyptodon} shell was found in the valley.
e.zh: 山谷里发现了一具雕齿兽壳化石。

e.en: The {glyptodon} resembled a huge armored armadillo.
e.zh: 雕齿兽像一只披甲的巨大犰狳。

e.en: The museum mounted a complete {glyptodont} skeleton.
e.zh: 博物馆装架了一副完整的雕齿兽骨架。

e.en: Researchers studied {glyptodont} armor for clues about predators.
e.zh: 研究人员研究雕齿兽的甲壳，以寻找捕食者线索。

e.en: The collector bought a Roman {glyptograph} at auction.
e.zh: 收藏家在拍卖会上买下一件罗马宝石雕刻品。

e.en: Each {glyptograph} preserved a tiny portrait in stone.
e.zh: 每件雕刻图像都在石头中保存了一幅微型肖像。

glyptographic.t: 宝石雕刻的；雕刻图像的

e.en: The catalogue notes the seal's {glyptographic} details.
e.zh: 目录记录了这枚印章的宝石雕刻细节。

e.en: Her {glyptographic} study focused on miniature portraits.
e.zh: 她的雕刻图像研究聚焦于微型肖像。

e.en: Ancient {glyptography} required patience and excellent eyesight.
e.zh: 古代宝石雕刻术需要耐心和极好的视力。

e.en: The book traces {glyptography} from seals to decorative gems.
e.zh: 这本书追溯了宝石雕刻从印章到装饰宝石的发展。

e.en: The archaeologist identified the object as a {glyptolith}.
e.zh: 考古学家确认这件物品是一块雕刻宝石。

e.en: A small {glyptolith} lay hidden inside the tomb.
e.zh: 墓中藏着一块小小的刻纹石。

e.en: The label says the cereal is {GM-free}.
e.zh: 标签上写着这种麦片不含转基因成分。

e.en: Some shoppers prefer {GM-free} vegetables.
e.zh: 有些顾客更喜欢非转基因蔬菜。

e.en: A dark {gnar} marked the old oak plank.
e.zh: 那块老橡木板上有一个深色木节。

e.en: The craftsman sanded around each {gnar} carefully.
e.zh: 工匠小心地打磨每个粗糙的木节周围。

e.en: A deep {gnarl} twisted through the tree trunk.
e.zh: 一道深深的木节扭曲地穿过树干。

e.en: Cold wind seemed to {gnarl} the exposed branches.
e.zh: 寒风似乎把裸露的树枝吹得扭曲粗糙。

gnarliest.t: 最扭曲粗糙的；最棘手的

e.en: That was the {gnarliest} root in the whole garden.
e.zh: 那是整个花园里最扭曲粗糙的树根。

e.en: The team solved the {gnarliest} bug before launch.
e.zh: 团队在发布前解决了最棘手的漏洞。

e.en: The old branches were {gnarling} in the dry wind.
e.zh: 老树枝在干风中逐渐扭曲变粗糙。

e.en: Years of pressure were {gnarling} the roots underground.
e.zh: 多年的挤压让地下树根形成扭曲木节。

e.en: The chair legs had polished {gnarls} in the wood.
e.zh: 椅腿木料上有被磨亮的木节。

e.en: Age {gnarls} the bark of exposed trees.
e.zh: 岁月会让暴露在外的树皮变得扭曲粗糙。

e.en: The engine gave a harsh {gnarr} before starting.
e.zh: 发动机启动前发出一声刺耳的低吼。

e.en: He heard a {gnarr} from behind the locked door.
e.zh: 他听见锁着的门后传来一声低沉吼叫。

gnarred.t: 扭曲粗糙的；多节的；咬过的；折磨的

e.en: The old tree had {gnarred} branches reaching over the path.
e.zh: 那棵老树扭曲多节的枝条伸到了小路上方。

e.en: His {gnarred} hands showed years of hard work.
e.zh: 他粗糙变形的双手显出多年劳作的痕迹。

e.en: Age was {gnarring} the roots into strange shapes.
e.zh: 岁月正把树根扭成奇异的形状。

e.en: The dog kept {gnarring} at the bone by the door.
e.zh: 那只狗一直在门边啃那根骨头。

e.en: The board was covered with dark {gnars}.
e.zh: 那块木板上布满了深色的节疤。

e.en: The puppy {gnars} at anything left on the floor.
e.zh: 小狗会啃咬任何落在地上的东西。

e.en: The surgeon examined the patient's {gnathal} structure carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生仔细检查了病人的颌部结构。

e.en: The fossil shows unusual {gnathal} development for its age.
e.zh: 这块化石显示出与年代不太相称的颌部发育。

e.en: The report described several {gnathic} abnormalities.
e.zh: 报告描述了几处颌部异常。

e.en: These insects have strong {gnathic} parts for biting.
e.zh: 这些昆虫有强壮的颚部结构用于咬合。

e.en: The anthropologist marked the {gnathion} on the skull.
e.zh: 人类学家在头骨上标出了颏下点。

e.en: The distance to the {gnathion} helped compare the faces.
e.zh: 到颏下点的距离有助于比较这些面部形态。

e.en: The study compared {gnathism} among several ancient populations.
e.zh: 这项研究比较了几个古代人群的颌部形态。

e.en: Pronounced {gnathism} can affect the profile of the face.
e.zh: 明显的颌突会影响面部侧影。
