e.zh: 她在防水布的每个孔里装上索环。

e.en: Wild {gromwell} grew along the dry path.
e.zh: 野生田紫草长在干燥的小路旁。

e.en: The herbalist collected {gromwell} for its hard seeds.
e.zh: 草药师采集紫草科植物，因为它的种子很硬。

e.en: Don't be a {gronk} about a simple mistake.
e.zh: 别为一个简单错误表现得像个讨厌鬼。

e.en: Australian slang sometimes uses {gronk} for a foolish person.
e.zh: 澳大利亚俚语有时用“gronk”指笨人。

e.en: The {groomsmen} wore navy suits at the wedding.
e.zh: 婚礼上伴郎们穿着海军蓝西装。

e.en: He asked three old friends to be his {groomsmen}.
e.zh: 他请三位老朋友担任他的伴郎。

e.en: The fossil had a {groovelike} mark along its side.
e.zh: 那块化石侧面有一道像凹槽的痕迹。

e.en: Water collected in the {groovelike} channels of the rock.
e.zh: 水积在岩石上那些槽状通道里。

e.en: The carpenter kept several {groovers} in his tool chest.
e.zh: 木匠在工具箱里放着几把开槽工具。

e.en: The best {groovers} stayed on the dance floor until midnight.
e.zh: 最会跳舞的人一直在舞池里待到午夜。

e.en: We spread a {ground-sheet} under the tent.
e.zh: 我们在帐篷下面铺了一块防潮地布。

e.en: The old {ground-sheet} kept our bags dry.
e.zh: 那块旧地布让我们的包没有受潮。

e.en: The base tested a {ground-to-air} missile system.
e.zh: 基地测试了一套地对空导弹系统。

e.en: They used {ground-to-air} signals during the rescue.
e.zh: 救援中他们使用了地对空信号。

e.en: The army deployed {ground-to-ground} rockets near the border.
e.zh: 军方在边境附近部署了地对地火箭。

e.en: The exercise focused on {ground-to-ground} communication.
e.zh: 这次演练重点是地面之间的通信。

e.en: The harbor charged {groundage} for each vessel overnight.
e.zh: 港口对每艘过夜船只收取停泊费。

e.en: The warehouse rent depends partly on its {groundage}.
e.zh: 仓库租金部分取决于它的占地面积。

e.en: He mixed {groundbait} before casting his line.
e.zh: 他抛竿前先调好了打窝饵料。

e.en: Too much {groundbait} can make fish stop biting.
e.zh: 打窝饵料太多会让鱼不再咬钩。

e.en: She was a {groundbreaker} in modern nursing.
e.zh: 她是现代护理领域的开创者。

e.en: The crew used a heavy {groundbreaker} on the frozen soil.
e.zh: 施工队用重型破土工具处理冻土。

e.en: A waterproof {groundcloth} protects the tent floor.
e.zh: 防水地布能保护帐篷底部。

e.en: They sat on a {groundcloth} during the picnic.
e.zh: 野餐时他们坐在一块铺地布上。

e.en: The gardener planted {groundcover} under the trees.
e.zh: 园丁在树下种了地被植物。

e.en: Mulch provides {groundcover} and keeps weeds down.
e.zh: 覆盖物能遮住地面并抑制杂草。

groundcrews.t: 地勤人员；地面工作人员

e.en: The {groundcrews} prepared the plane for departure.
e.zh: 地勤人员为飞机起飞做准备。

e.en: Several {groundcrews} cleared snow from the runway.
e.zh: 几个地面小组清除了跑道上的积雪。

e.en: The helicopter took heavy {groundfire} near the valley.
e.zh: 直升机在山谷附近遭到猛烈地面火力攻击。

e.en: Dry leaves helped the {groundfire} spread quickly.
e.zh: 干树叶让地火迅速蔓延。

groundkeeper.t: 场地管理员；园地看管人

e.en: The {groundkeeper} mowed the football pitch early.
e.zh: 场地管理员一早就修剪了足球场草坪。

e.en: A careful {groundkeeper} keeps the gardens tidy.
e.zh: 细心的园地看管人会保持花园整洁。

e.en: Crystals are suspended in the volcanic {groundmass}.
e.zh: 晶体悬浮在火山岩的基质中。

e.en: The thin section showed a dark {groundmass}.
e.zh: 薄片显示出深色的岩石细粒部分。

e.en: The electrician checked the rod with a {groundmeter}.
e.zh: 电工用接地测量仪检查了接地棒。

e.en: A faulty {groundmeter} gave unstable readings.
e.zh: 有故障的接地测量仪读数不稳定。

e.en: The antenna needs a metal {groundplate}.
e.zh: 这根天线需要一块金属接地板。

e.en: Bolt the motor firmly to the {groundplate}.
e.zh: 把电机牢牢固定到底板上。

e.en: The lease requires annual {groundrent} payments.
e.zh: 这份租约要求每年支付土地租金。

e.en: Their apartment has a low {groundrent}.
e.zh: 他们那套公寓的地租很低。

e.en: The path was lined with yellow {groundsel}.
e.zh: 小路两旁长着黄色的千里光。

e.en: She pulled {groundsel} from the vegetable bed.
e.zh: 她从菜畦里拔掉了千里光这种野草。

e.en: Several {groundsels} grew beside the wall.
e.zh: 墙边长着几株千里光类植物。

e.en: The guide compared two common {groundsels}.
e.zh: 向导比较了两种常见的千里光类植物。

e.en: The carpenter replaced the rotten {groundsill}.
e.zh: 木匠更换了腐烂的地梁。

e.en: Moisture had damaged the cabin's {groundsill}.
e.zh: 潮气损坏了小屋的底槛。

e.en: He works in {groundskeeping} at the university.
e.zh: 他在大学负责场地养护工作。

e.en: Good {groundskeeping} keeps the park safe and clean.
e.zh: 良好的园地维护能让公园安全整洁。

e.en: Strong tailwinds increased the plane's {groundspeed}.
e.zh: 强顺风提高了飞机的对地速度。

e.en: The pilot checked {groundspeed} on the display.
e.zh: 飞行员在显示屏上查看地速。

e.en: The mill produces {groundwood} for cheap newsprint.
e.zh: 这家纸厂生产用于廉价新闻纸的磨木浆。

e.en: Books printed on {groundwood} paper yellow quickly.
e.zh: 用磨木浆纸印的书很快会发黄。

e.en: The report misspelled {grounwater} in one heading.
e.zh: 报告有个标题把地下水这个词拼错了。

e.en: They searched for {grounwater} beneath the dry field.
e.zh: 他们在干旱田地下面寻找地下水。

e.en: The software uses {group-indicate} flags in the table.
e.zh: 该软件在表格中使用群组指示标记。

e.en: A {group-indicate} field separates adults from children.
e.zh: 组别标示字段把成人和儿童区分开。

e.en: These files are {groupable} by date or topic.
e.zh: 这些文件可以按日期或主题分组。

e.en: The survey answers were not easily {groupable}.
e.zh: 这些问卷答案不太容易归类。

e.en: The artists formed a small {groupement} in Paris.
e.zh: 这些艺术家在巴黎组成了一个小团体。

e.en: Each {groupement} had its own rules and officers.
e.zh: 每个组织都有自己的规则和负责人。

e.en: A tiny {grouplet} of students stayed after class.
e.zh: 一小群学生下课后留了下来。

e.en: The data formed a separate {grouplet} on the chart.
e.zh: 这些数据在图表上形成了一个独立的小组。

e.en: Please send a {groupmail} to the whole team.
e.zh: 请给整个团队发一封群发邮件。

e.en: Her {groupmail} included the meeting agenda.
e.zh: 她的群发邮件里包含了会议议程。

e.en: The newspaper mocked the radical {groupuscule}.
e.zh: 那家报纸嘲笑了这个激进小派别。

e.en: A forgotten {groupuscule} claimed responsibility for the protest.
e.zh: 一个被人遗忘的小团体声称对抗议负责。

e.en: The old sink had a {grouty} smell.
e.zh: 那个旧水槽有一股浆泥似的味道。

e.en: His boots were covered in {grouty} dust.
e.zh: 他的靴子上沾满了像灌浆灰一样的尘土。

e.en: They crossed a {groveless} stretch of farmland.
e.zh: 他们穿过一片没有小树林的农田。

e.en: The {groveless} hill looked bare in winter.
e.zh: 那座没有树丛的小山在冬天显得光秃秃的。

e.en: He apologized {grovelingly} to the manager.
e.zh: 他卑躬屈膝地向经理道歉。

e.en: The letter praised the prince {grovelingly}.
e.zh: 那封信谄媚地赞美了王子。

e.en: The old board felt {grovy} under my fingers.
e.zh: 那块旧木板摸起来有一道道沟槽。

e.en: A {grovy} path ran between the fields.
e.zh: 一条凹凸不平的小路穿过田地之间。

e.en: Tomatoes are {growable} in containers on a balcony.
e.zh: 番茄可以在阳台的容器里种植。

e.en: The company wanted a {growable} customer base.
e.zh: 公司想要一个能够增长的客户群。

e.en: She planted the peppers in a {growbag}.
e.zh: 她把辣椒种在一个栽培袋里。

e.en: A {growbag} is useful when you lack garden soil.
e.zh: 没有花园土壤时，栽培袋很有用。

e.en: He retreated to his {growlery} after lunch.
e.zh: 午饭后他躲进自己发牢骚的独处房间。

e.en: The study became her private {growlery}.
e.zh: 书房成了她私下生闷气的地方。

e.en: There was a comic {growliness} in his voice.
e.zh: 他的声音里带着一种滑稽的低吼感。

e.en: The dog's {growliness} warned us to step back.
e.zh: 那只狗的低吼让我们知道该退后。

growthful.t: 促进生长的；富有成长性的

e.en: Spring brought a {growthful} warmth to the fields.
e.zh: 春天给田野带来了促发生长的暖意。

e.en: The mentor created a {growthful} environment for young writers.
e.zh: 这位导师为年轻作家营造了有利成长的环境。

growthman.t: 鼓吹增长的人；增长派人士

e.en: The mayor was known as a relentless {growthman}.
e.zh: 这位市长以不断鼓吹增长而闻名。

e.en: As a {growthman}, he valued expansion over caution.
e.zh: 作为增长派人士，他更看重扩张而不是谨慎。

growthmanship.t: 增长至上策略；增长鼓吹术

e.en: The speech was full of bold {growthmanship}.
e.zh: 这场演讲充满了大胆的增长鼓吹。

e.en: Critics said his {growthmanship} ignored social costs.
e.zh: 批评者说他的增长至上策略忽视了社会成本。

e.en: The artisan was {grozing} the edge of the glass.
e.zh: 工匠正在磨修玻璃的边缘。

e.en: Careful {grozing} made the pane fit the frame.
e.zh: 仔细修边后，玻璃片正好装进框里。

e.en: The dog went {grrr} when I reached for its toy.
e.zh: 我伸手去拿它的玩具时，那只狗发出咆哮声。

e.en: {Grrr}, I forgot my password again.
e.zh: 真烦，我又忘了密码。

e.en: The engine made a low {grrrr} before starting.
e.zh: 发动机启动前发出低沉的轰鸣声。

e.en: {Grrrr}, this computer froze again.
e.zh: 气死了，这台电脑又卡住了。

e.en: The room's {grubbiness} made guests uncomfortable.
e.zh: 房间的肮脏让客人感到不舒服。

e.en: She disliked the moral {grubbiness} of the deal.
e.zh: 她不喜欢这笔交易在道德上的龌龊。

e.en: The old merchant offered a {grubstake} to the young prospector.
e.zh: 那位老商人给年轻探矿者提供了一笔启动资助。

e.en: Her savings became the {grubstake} for a tiny bookstore.
e.zh: 她的积蓄成了一家小书店的创业本钱。

e.en: A local banker {grubstaked} his first mining trip.
e.zh: 当地一位银行家资助了他的第一次采矿之旅。

e.en: Friends {grubstaked} the team until sales improved.
e.zh: 朋友们在销售好转前给这个团队提供启动资金。

grubstaker.t: 资助探矿者的人；出资人

e.en: The {grubstaker} demanded a share of any gold found.
e.zh: 那位资助人要求分得找到的任何黄金。

e.en: Every startup needs a patient {grubstaker} at first.
e.zh: 每家初创公司起初都需要一个有耐心的出资人。

e.en: Several small {grubstakes} kept the prospectors alive through winter.
e.zh: 几笔小额资助让探矿者们熬过了冬天。

e.en: She {grubstakes} artists who cannot yet pay rent.
e.zh: 她资助那些暂时还付不起房租的艺术家。

e.en: He made money by {grubstaking} hopeful miners.
e.zh: 他靠资助满怀希望的矿工赚钱。

e.en: The fund specializes in {grubstaking} risky early projects.
e.zh: 这只基金专门资助风险较高的早期项目。

e.en: He began his career in {grubstreet} journalism.
e.zh: 他的职业生涯始于低端报刊写作。

e.en: The novel mocks the hunger and vanity of {grubstreet}.
e.zh: 这部小说嘲讽了潦倒文人圈的饥寒与虚荣。

grue.t: 因恐惧而发抖；毛骨悚然

e.en: I {grue} whenever that door creaks at night.
e.zh: 每当那扇门夜里吱呀作响，我就毛骨悚然。

e.en: The old tale made the children {grue}.
e.zh: 那个古老故事吓得孩子们直发抖。

e.en: She {grued} at the sound from the cellar.
e.zh: 听到地窖里的声音，她吓得发抖。

e.en: The soldiers {grued} when the fog swallowed the road.
e.zh: 雾气吞没道路时，士兵们感到毛骨悚然。

e.en: He stood {grueing} in the silent hallway.
e.zh: 他站在寂静的走廊里，害怕得发抖。

e.en: The audience was {grueing} before the monster appeared.
e.zh: 怪物还没出现，观众已经毛骨悚然。

e.en: The villagers gathered fruit from the {grugru} palm.
e.zh: 村民们从格鲁格鲁棕榈上采集果实。

e.en: A roasted {grugru} was served as a local delicacy.
e.zh: 烤格鲁格鲁幼虫被当作当地美味端上桌。

e.en: His {grum} reply ended the cheerful discussion.
e.zh: 他阴沉的回答让愉快的讨论戛然而止。

e.en: The captain looked {grum} after reading the report.
e.zh: 船长读完报告后显得很阴郁。

e.en: A dark {grume} clung to the bandage.
e.zh: 一块深色血凝块粘在绷带上。

e.en: The doctor noticed a small {grume} in the sample.
e.zh: 医生注意到样本里有一小块凝块。

e.en: The sailor replaced a worn {grummet} on the sail.
e.zh: 水手更换了帆上一个磨损的索环。

e.en: Run the cable through the rubber {grummet}.
e.zh: 把电缆穿过那个橡胶护圈。

e.en: The wound released a {grumous} fluid.
e.zh: 伤口流出一种黏稠带凝块的液体。

e.en: The painter mixed a {grumous} red pigment.
e.zh: 画家调出了一种浓稠结块的红色颜料。

e.en: The nurse recorded the {grumousness} of the sample.
e.zh: 护士记录了样本的黏稠凝块状态。

e.en: Its unpleasant {grumousness} made the sauce look spoiled.
e.zh: 那种令人不快的黏稠结块感让酱汁看起来坏了。

e.en: Dad is the {grumpiest} person before coffee.
e.zh: 爸爸喝咖啡前是最暴躁的人。

e.en: Even the {grumpiest} reviewer praised the ending.
e.zh: 连最挑剔暴躁的评论人也称赞了结尾。

e.en: She gave a {grumpish} answer but helped anyway.
e.zh: 她回答得有点不耐烦，但还是帮了忙。

e.en: His {grumpish} humor suited the old detective.
e.zh: 他那种带点暴躁的幽默很适合老侦探。

e.en: The club was packed with {grungers} in torn jeans.
e.zh: 俱乐部里挤满了穿破牛仔裤的垃圾摇滚迷。

e.en: Local {grungers} still meet at that record shop.
e.zh: 当地的垃圾摇滚迷仍在那家唱片店聚会。

e.en: A {grunion} flopped on the moonlit beach.
e.zh: 一条银汉鱼在月光下的海滩上扑腾。

e.en: Tourists came to watch the {grunion} run.
e.zh: 游客们来观看银汉鱼上岸产卵的景象。

e.en: A sincere apology may {gruntle} the angry customer.
e.zh: 真诚道歉也许能让愤怒的顾客满意。

e.en: The bonus seemed to {gruntle} the tired staff.
e.zh: 奖金似乎让疲惫的员工高兴起来。

e.en: After lunch, the team looked oddly {gruntled}.
e.zh: 午饭后，团队看起来出奇地满意。

e.en: She left the meeting more {gruntled} than expected.
e.zh: 她离开会议时比预想中更满意。

e.en: The manager was {gruntling} guests with free desserts.
e.zh: 经理正用免费甜点安抚客人，让他们满意。

e.en: His careful reply was {gruntling} the committee.
e.zh: 他谨慎的答复正在让委员会感到满意。

gruppetto.t: 自行车赛落后集团；回音装饰音

e.en: The sprinters formed a {gruppetto} on the mountain stage.
e.zh: 冲刺型车手在山地赛段组成了落后集团。

e.en: The pianist played the {gruppetto} with delicate timing.
e.zh: 钢琴家以细腻的节奏弹出了回音装饰音。

e.en: Small fish hid in the {gruss} near the shore.
e.zh: 小鱼躲在近岸的海草丛里。

e.en: The boat drifted over patches of {gruss}.
e.zh: 小船漂过一片片浅海草丛。

e.en: He would {grutch} about every small delay.
e.zh: 他会为每一次小小的耽搁发牢骚。

e.en: There is no need to {grutch} over the bill.
e.zh: 没必要为了账单抱怨个不停。

e.en: The chef melted {gruyere} over the onions.
e.zh: 厨师把格鲁耶尔奶酪融在洋葱上。

e.en: A little {gruyere} gives the soup a nutty flavor.
e.zh: 加一点格鲁耶尔奶酪会让汤带有坚果香。

e.en: Rainwater disappeared into a deep {gryke}.
e.zh: 雨水消失在一道很深的石灰岩裂缝里。

e.en: Ferns grew inside the shaded {gryke}.
e.zh: 蕨类植物长在阴暗的石灰岩裂缝中。

e.en: A {grysbok} slipped through the dry grass.
e.zh: 一只非洲小羚羊从干草中悄悄穿过。

e.en: The guide pointed out a shy {grysbok} near the bushes.
e.zh: 向导指出灌木旁有一只胆怯的非洲小羚羊。

e.en: The {guacharo} nests deep inside dark caves.
e.zh: 油鸱在幽暗洞穴深处筑巢。

e.en: Local people heard the {guacharo} calling at night.
e.zh: 当地人在夜里听见油鸱的叫声。

e.en: The old spelling {guage} appears in the manuscript.
e.zh: 手稿中出现了guage这个旧式拼写。

e.en: Use a proper {guage} before cutting the wire.
e.zh: 剪线之前要用合适的量规测一下。

e.en: The test used {guaiac} to detect hidden blood.
e.zh: 这项检测用愈创木树脂来发现隐血。

e.en: Historically, {guaiac} was sold as a medicinal resin.
e.zh: 历史上，愈创木树脂曾作为药用树脂出售。

e.en: The chemist isolated {guaiacin} from the resin.
e.zh: 化学家从树脂中分离出愈创木脂成分。

e.en: Older manuals mention {guaiacin} in color tests.
e.zh: 旧手册在显色试验中提到愈创木脂成分。

e.en: Smoke contains {guaiacol}, which adds a smoky aroma.
e.zh: 烟雾中含有愈创木酚，会带来烟熏香气。

e.en: The lab measured {guaiacol} in the sample.
e.zh: 实验室测定了样品中的愈创木酚含量。

e.en: The cabinet was made from hard {guaiacum}.
e.zh: 这个柜子是用坚硬的愈创木制成的。

e.en: Doctors once prescribed {guaiacum} for various illnesses.
e.zh: 医生过去曾用愈创木树脂治疗多种疾病。

e.en: The essential oil contained traces of {guaiene}.
e.zh: 这种精油中含有微量愈创木烯。

e.en: Researchers identified {guaiene} among the wood compounds.
e.zh: 研究人员在木材化合物中鉴定出愈创木烯。

e.en: The label spelled the herb as {guaiocum}.
e.zh: 标签上把这种草药拼作guaiocum。

e.en: In old texts, {guaiocum} often means guaiacum.
e.zh: 在旧文献中，guaiocum通常指愈创木。

e.en: The cough syrup contains {guaiphenesin}.
e.zh: 这种止咳糖浆含有愈创甘油醚。

e.en: Ask a pharmacist before taking {guaiphenesin} with other medicines.
e.zh: 把愈创甘油醚和其他药同服前，应先咨询药剂师。

e.en: The band played a lively {guajira}.
e.zh: 乐队演奏了一首活泼的瓜希拉舞曲。

e.en: She learned the rhythm of the {guajira} in Havana.
e.zh: 她在哈瓦那学会了瓜希拉舞曲的节奏。

e.en: The form mistakenly said he was {gualified}.
e.zh: 表格误写成他是gualified。

e.en: Editors corrected {gualified} to qualified in the article.
e.zh: 编辑把文章里的gualified改成了qualified。

e.en: The traveler described a large {guana} on the rock.
e.zh: 旅行者描述岩石上有一只大鬣蜥。

e.en: Older books sometimes call an iguana a {guana}.
e.zh: 旧书有时把iguana称作guana。

e.en: The enzyme {guanase} breaks down guanine.
e.zh: 鸟嘌呤脱氨酶会分解鸟嘌呤。

e.en: The assay measured {guanase} activity in the tissue.
e.zh: 这项测定检测了组织中的鸟嘌呤脱氨酶活性。

guardant.t: 面向观察者的；警觉守卫的

e.en: The heraldic lion stood {guardant} on the shield.
e.zh: 盾牌上的纹章狮面向观者站立。

e.en: A {guardant} figure watched from the gate.
e.zh: 一个警觉守卫的人影在门口注视着。

e.en: The bodyguard moved only when his {guardee} moved.
e.zh: 保镖只在受保护的人移动时才跟着移动。

e.en: Every {guardee} received a numbered badge.
e.zh: 每位被守护者都拿到了一枚编号徽章。

guardless.t: 无人守卫的；没有防护的

e.en: The old bridge remained {guardless} at night.
e.zh: 那座旧桥夜里仍然无人看守。

e.en: A {guardless} secret soon becomes public.
e.zh: 没有保护的秘密很快就会公开。

e.en: He accepted the {guardship} of the northern gate.
e.zh: 他接受了北门的守卫职务。

e.en: The court placed the child under her {guardship}.
e.zh: 法院把孩子交由她监护。

e.en: Farmers planted {guayule} for natural rubber.
e.zh: 农民种植银胶菊来生产天然橡胶。

e.en: The desert climate suits {guayule} very well.
e.zh: 沙漠气候非常适合银胶菊生长。

guck.t: 黏糊脏东西；令人讨厌的污物

e.en: There was green {guck} on the kitchen floor.
e.zh: 厨房地板上有一摊绿色的黏糊脏东西。

e.en: Wash that sticky {guck} off your hands.
e.zh: 把你手上那种黏乎乎的脏东西洗掉。

e.en: She began to {guddle} through the drawer for keys.
e.zh: 她开始在抽屉里乱翻找钥匙。

e.en: The boy tried to {guddle} trout in the stream.
e.zh: 男孩试着在溪水里徒手摸鳟鱼。

e.en: A small {gudgeon} darted under the stone.
e.zh: 一条小鰕虎鱼般的小鱼钻到了石头下面。

e.en: The mechanic replaced the worn {gudgeon} pin.
e.zh: 机械师更换了磨损的活塞销。

e.en: A {guelder-rose} bloomed beside the path.
e.zh: 一株欧洲荚蒾在小路旁开花。

e.en: The gardener pruned the {guelder-rose} after flowering.
e.zh: 花期过后，园丁修剪了那株雪球花灌木。

e.en: A {guenon} watched us from the branches.
e.zh: 一只非洲长尾猴在树枝上看着我们。

e.en: The zoo keeps the {guenon} in a warm enclosure.
e.zh: 动物园把这只非洲长尾猴养在温暖的围栏里。

e.en: Fame was his only {guerdon} for years of work.
e.zh: 多年辛劳换来的唯一奖赏就是名声。

e.en: The king promised a rich {guerdon} to the messenger.
e.zh: 国王答应给信使丰厚的报酬。

e.en: The pamphlet praised {guerrillaism} as a rural strategy.
e.zh: 那本小册子把游击主义称赞为一种乡村战略。

e.en: Modern politics sometimes borrows the tactics of {guerrillaism}.
e.zh: 现代政治有时会借用游击战做法。

e.en: The old {guerrillero} described life in the mountains.
e.zh: 那位老游击队员讲述了山里的生活。

e.en: A {guerrillero} needs support from local villagers.
e.zh: 游击队员需要当地村民的支持。

e.en: The password was too {guessable} to be safe.
e.zh: 这个密码太容易猜出，不够安全。

e.en: Her answer was {guessable} from her expression.
e.zh: 从她的表情就能推测出她的回答。

e.en: We stayed in a small {guest-house} near the lake.
e.zh: 我们住在湖边一家小旅馆里。

e.en: The family runs a {guest-house} for hikers.
e.zh: 这家人为徒步旅行者经营一家宾馆。

e.en: The {guanay} nests on rocky islands off Peru.
e.zh: 这种鸬鹚在秘鲁外海的岩岛上筑巢。

e.en: Old reports linked the {guanay} to the guano trade.
e.zh: 早期报告把这种鸬鹚与鸟粪贸易联系起来。

e.en: The chemist compared {guancidine} with related bases.
e.zh: 化学家把胍西定与相关碱性物质作比较。

e.en: A trace of {guancidine} appeared in the sample.
e.zh: 样品中出现了微量胍西定。

e.en: The old label spelled the compound {guancydine}.
e.zh: 旧标签把这种化合物拼作胍西定。

e.en: Few modern papers use {guancydine} as a spelling.
e.zh: 现代论文很少使用guancydine这个拼法。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {guanethidine} for severe hypertension.
e.zh: 医生给重度高血压患者开了胍乙啶。

e.en: Older textbooks discuss {guanethidine} as an adrenergic blocker.
e.zh: 较早的教材把胍乙啶作为肾上腺素能阻滞药来讨论。

e.en: {Guanidine} is a strong organic base.
e.zh: 胍是一种强有机碱。

e.en: The protein unfolded in concentrated {guanidine} solution.
e.zh: 蛋白质在浓胍溶液中发生了变性。

e.en: The molecule contains a {guanidyl} group.
e.zh: 这个分子含有一个胍基。

e.en: Researchers measured the {guanidyl} signal in the spectrum.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了光谱中的胍基信号。

e.en: The scales shimmer because they contain {guanin}.
e.zh: 这些鳞片因含有鸟粪素而闪光。

e.en: Older chemistry books sometimes call guanine {guanin}.
e.zh: 较旧的化学书有时把鸟嘌呤称作guanin。

e.en: A {guanophore} can reflect light from fish skin.
e.zh: 含鸟粪素色素细胞能反射鱼皮上的光。

e.en: The biologist identified a {guanophore} under the microscope.
e.zh: 生物学家在显微镜下辨认出一个鸟粪素细胞。

e.en: {Guanosine} is found in RNA molecules.
e.zh: 鸟苷存在于RNA分子中。

e.en: The enzyme modifies {guanosine} during the reaction.
e.zh: 这种酶在反应过程中修饰鸟苷。

e.en: The band played a lively {guaracha}.
e.zh: 乐队演奏了一首欢快的瓜拉查舞曲。

e.en: She learned the {guaracha} from a Cuban teacher.
e.zh: 她跟一位古巴老师学会了瓜拉查舞。

guaranies.t: 瓜拉尼，巴拉圭货币复数

e.en: The meal cost fifty thousand {guaranies}.
e.zh: 这顿饭花了五万瓜拉尼。

e.en: He exchanged dollars for {guaranies} at the bank.
e.zh: 他在银行把美元兑换成瓜拉尼。

e.en: Early chemists called the stimulant {guaranine}.
e.zh: 早期化学家把这种兴奋剂称为瓜拉那碱。

e.en: The drink was advertised as containing {guaranine}.
e.zh: 这款饮料被宣传为含有瓜拉那碱。

e.en: The loan was {guarantied} by his uncle.
e.zh: 这笔贷款由他的叔叔作了担保。

e.en: A {guarantied} bond offered investors extra security.
e.zh: 有担保债券为投资者提供了额外保障。

e.en: A {guard-boat} circled the harbor at night.
e.zh: 一艘警戒船夜间在港口巡航。

e.en: The prisoners were watched from a small {guard-boat}.
e.zh: 看守人员从一艘小护卫艇上监视囚犯。

e.en: Their {guard-dog} barked at every stranger.
e.zh: 他们的看门狗对每个陌生人都叫。

e.en: The warehouse uses a trained {guard-dog} at night.
e.zh: 仓库夜里使用一只受训护卫犬看守。

e.en: The truck hit the {guard-rails} on the bridge.
e.zh: 卡车撞上了桥上的护栏。

e.en: The policy adds {guard-rails} against risky spending.
e.zh: 这项政策为高风险支出增加了防护限制。

e.en: The visitor waited inside the {guard-room}.
e.zh: 访客在警卫室里等候。

e.en: A lamp burned all night in the {guard-room}.
e.zh: 卫兵室里的灯整夜亮着。

e.en: The narrow gate was easily {guardable}.
e.zh: 那道狭窄的门很容易防守。

e.en: Only one entrance made the building {guardable}.
e.zh: 只有一个入口使这栋建筑便于看守。

e.en: The {guild-master} settled the dispute between the apprentices.
e.zh: 行会会长调解了学徒之间的争端。

e.en: In the game, the {guild-master} assigns missions to new members.
e.zh: 在游戏里，公会领袖会给新成员分配任务。

guildship.t: 行会成员身份；行会制度

e.en: His {guildship} gave him access to better workshops.
e.zh: 他的行会成员身份让他能使用更好的作坊。

e.en: The town's old economy depended heavily on {guildship}.
e.zh: 这座城镇旧时的经济很依赖行会制度。

guildsman.t: 行会会员；同业公会成员

e.en: The {guildsman} marked his tools with a personal stamp.
e.zh: 这名行会会员在工具上刻了自己的印记。

e.en: A skilled {guildsman} could train several apprentices at once.
e.zh: 熟练的同业公会成员可以同时带几个学徒。

e.en: Her {guileful} smile made everyone uneasy.
e.zh: 她狡黠的微笑让每个人都不安。

e.en: The story follows a {guileful} adviser who manipulates the king.
e.zh: 故事讲述一个诡计多端的顾问操纵国王。

e.en: He {guilefully} avoided answering the direct question.
e.zh: 他狡猾地避开了那个直接的问题。

e.en: The merchant {guilefully} praised the flawed jewel.
e.zh: 商人用诡计般的口吻称赞那颗有瑕疵的宝石。

e.en: His {guilefulness} was hidden behind polite manners.
e.zh: 他的狡诈藏在彬彬有礼的举止后面。

e.en: The novel treats {guilefulness} as a dangerous political skill.
e.zh: 这部小说把诡计多端描写成一种危险的政治手腕。

e.en: French dialogue is often enclosed in {guillemets}.
e.zh: 法语对话常常放在法式引号里。

e.en: The designer chose a {guillemet} instead of a standard quote mark.
e.zh: 设计师选择了尖角引号，而不是普通引号。

guilt-ridden.t: 深感内疚的；负罪感重的

e.en: She felt {guilt-ridden} after missing her father's call.
e.zh: 错过父亲的电话后，她深感内疚。

e.en: The {guilt-ridden} confession came years after the accident.
e.zh: 那份充满负罪感的坦白是在事故多年后才出现的。

e.en: Don't {guilt-trip} me into changing my plans.
e.zh: 别用内疚感逼我改变计划。

e.en: Her speech felt like a long {guilt-trip}.
e.zh: 她那番话听起来像一场漫长的内疚操控。

e.en: He looked {guiltier} when the teacher found the note.
e.zh: 老师发现那张纸条时，他显得更加心虚。

e.en: The new evidence made the suspect seem {guiltier}.
e.zh: 新证据让嫌疑人看起来罪责更重。

e.en: She was the {guiltiest} about leaving early.
e.zh: 对于提前离开，她是最内疚的那个人。

e.en: The court found him the {guiltiest} of the three defendants.
e.zh: 法院认定他是三名被告中罪责最重的。

e.en: The jury had to decide his {guiltiness} beyond doubt.
e.zh: 陪审团必须毫无疑问地判定他是否有罪。

e.en: Her {guiltiness} showed in every nervous gesture.
e.zh: 她的内疚感从每一个紧张动作中都显露出来。

e.en: The costume included a white {guimpe} under the dark dress.
e.zh: 这套服装在深色裙子下面配了一块白色胸肩布。

e.en: The nun adjusted her {guimpe} before entering the chapel.
e.zh: 修女进入小礼拜堂前整理了一下领布。

e.en: The children kept a {guinea-pig} in a small cage.
e.zh: 孩子们把一只豚鼠养在小笼子里。

e.en: I don't want to be your {guinea-pig} for this recipe.
e.zh: 我不想当你这道菜谱的试验对象。

e.en: A {guineafowl} ran across the dusty road.
e.zh: 一只珠鸡跑过尘土飞扬的道路。

e.en: The restaurant served roasted {guineafowl} with herbs.
e.zh: 餐厅供应加香草烤制的珍珠鸡。

e.en: The hotel recorded one {guest-night} for each person staying overnight.
e.zh: 酒店按每位过夜住客计算一个住客夜数。

e.en: Tourism officials use {guest-nights} to measure seasonal demand.
e.zh: 旅游部门用住客夜数来衡量季节性需求。

e.en: The {guest-room} is ready for your parents.
e.zh: 给你父母住的客房已经准备好了。

e.en: She booked a small {guest-room} near the station.
e.zh: 她在车站附近订了一间小客房。

e.en: Please sign the {guestbook} before you leave.
e.zh: 离开前请在留言簿上签名。

e.en: Their wedding {guestbook} was full of warm wishes.
e.zh: 他们婚礼的访客签名册里写满了祝福。

e.en: The servant prepared the {guestchamber} before sunset.
e.zh: 仆人在日落前准备好了客房。

e.en: In the old manor, the {guestchamber} faced the garden.
e.zh: 在那座老庄园里，客人卧室朝向花园。

e.en: Can you {guestimate} the repair cost for me?
e.zh: 你能帮我粗略估计一下维修费用吗？

e.en: Her {guestimate} was surprisingly close to the final number.
e.zh: 她凭感觉估算的数字竟然和最终结果很接近。

e.en: His {guestship} at the college lasted only a term.
e.zh: 他在学院的客居身份只持续了一个学期。

e.en: The rules of {guestship} required politeness and restraint.
e.zh: 作为宾客的规矩要求礼貌和克制。

e.en: Many factories relied on {guestworkers} during the boom.
e.zh: 经济繁荣时期，许多工厂依赖外来劳工。

e.en: The novel follows a {guestworker} adjusting to life abroad.
e.zh: 这部小说描写一名客籍工人适应海外生活。

e.en: Water began to {guggle} through the narrow pipe.
e.zh: 水开始从细管里汩汩作响地流过。

e.en: The baby gave a soft {guggle} of delight.
e.zh: 婴儿高兴地发出轻轻的咯咯声。

e.en: The stream {guggled} under the little bridge.
e.zh: 小溪在小桥下汩汩作响。

e.en: He {guggled} with laughter after the joke.
e.zh: 听完笑话后，他咯咯地笑了起来。

e.en: The kettle {guggles} when it starts to boil.
e.zh: 水壶开始烧开时会发出汩汩声。

e.en: She heard happy {guggles} from the nursery.
e.zh: 她听见婴儿房里传来快乐的咯咯声。

e.en: A {guggling} sound came from the drain.
e.zh: 排水口传来汩汩作响的声音。

e.en: The child ran in, {guggling} with excitement.
e.zh: 孩子兴奋地咯咯笑着跑了进来。

e.en: Buy your ticket at the {guichet} near the entrance.
e.zh: 请在入口附近的售票窗口买票。

e.en: The bank kept one {guichet} open for late customers.
e.zh: 银行为晚到的顾客保留了一个柜台窗口。

e.en: Only two {guichets} were open that morning.
e.zh: 那天早上只有两个售票窗口开放。

e.en: Passengers queued at the {guichets} for refunds.
e.zh: 乘客在柜台窗口前排队办理退款。

e.en: The young team is talented and {guidable}.
e.zh: 这支年轻团队有天赋，也愿意接受指导。

e.en: A {guidable} missile can change course in flight.
e.zh: 可制导导弹能在飞行中改变航向。

e.en: She carried a {guide-book} through the old city.
e.zh: 她带着一本旅游指南游览老城。

e.en: This {guide-book} explains the museum's main collections.
e.zh: 这本指南书介绍了博物馆的主要藏品。

e.en: His {guide-dog} led him safely across the road.
e.zh: 他的导盲犬安全地带他过了马路。

e.en: The cafe welcomes every trained {guide-dog}.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆欢迎每一只受过训练的导盲犬。

e.en: The editor gave us a clear {guide-line} for citations.
e.zh: 编辑给了我们清楚的引用指导方针。

e.en: Draw a faint {guide-line} before cutting the paper.
e.zh: 裁纸前先画一条淡淡的参考线。

e.en: A wooden {guide-post} pointed toward the village.
e.zh: 一块木制路标指向村庄。

e.en: Use the first result as a {guide-post} for later work.
e.zh: 把第一个结果作为后续工作的参照标志。

e.en: The hikers checked the {guideboard} at the trailhead.
e.zh: 徒步者在小径入口查看了导览板。

e.en: A large {guideboard} shows every floor of the station.
e.zh: 一块大型指示牌显示车站每一层的位置。

e.en: They felt {guideless} in the unfamiliar city.
e.zh: 他们在陌生城市里感到无人指引。

e.en: A {guideless} tour lets visitors move at their own pace.
e.zh: 无向导游览让游客按自己的节奏行动。

e.en: Follow each red {guidemark} along the forest path.
e.zh: 沿着林间小路跟随每个红色指引标记。

e.en: The old map used a star as a {guidemark}.
e.zh: 那张旧地图用星号作为导向标志。

e.en: The dictionary prints a {guideword} at the top of each page.
e.zh: 这本词典在每页顶部印有页首提示词。

e.en: Choose a simple {guideword} to introduce the lesson.
e.zh: 选一个简单的引导词来引入这节课。

e.en: The cavalry unit carried a blue {guidon}.
e.zh: 那支骑兵部队举着一面蓝色小军旗。

e.en: The {guidon} stood at the front of the formation.
e.zh: 旗手站在队列的最前方。

guipure.t: 凸花花边；网眼蕾丝花边

e.en: The bride chose {guipure} for the sleeves.
e.zh: 新娘为袖子选了凸花花边。

e.zh: 歌手用巴尔干单弦琴为那首史诗伴奏。

e.en: A carved {gusla} hung on the wall of the village museum.
e.zh: 村庄博物馆的墙上挂着一把雕刻过的巴尔干单弦琴。

e.en: She {gussied} herself up for the party.
e.zh: 她为参加聚会把自己打扮得漂漂亮亮。

e.en: They {gussied} up the old cafe with fresh paint.
e.zh: 他们用新油漆把那家旧咖啡馆装饰一新。

e.en: He {gussies} up before every interview.
e.zh: 他每次面试前都会精心打扮。

e.en: The shop {gussies} its windows up each December.
e.zh: 那家店每年十二月都会装饰橱窗。

e.en: Let's {gussy} up the room before guests arrive.
e.zh: 客人到来前，我们把房间装饰得漂亮些吧。

e.en: He tried to {gussy} himself up with a silk tie.
e.zh: 他想用一条丝领带把自己打扮得体面些。

e.en: She is {gussying} up for the wedding.
e.zh: 她正在为婚礼精心打扮。

e.en: Workers were {gussying} up the lobby with flowers.
e.zh: 工人们正用鲜花装点大厅。

e.en: Only the dissolved part is {gustable} on the tongue.
e.zh: 只有溶解的部分能在舌头上被尝到。

e.en: The chef tested whether the spice was still {gustable}.
e.zh: 厨师试了试这种香料是否还能尝出味道。

e.en: The study measured each child's {gustative} response.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了每个孩子的味觉反应。

e.en: Wine training can sharpen {gustative} memory.
e.zh: 葡萄酒训练可以增强味觉记忆。

e.en: A damaged {gustatoreceptor} may reduce sensitivity to sweetness.
e.zh: 受损的味觉受体可能会降低对甜味的敏感度。

e.en: The paper described how each {gustatoreceptor} detects chemicals.
e.zh: 论文说明了每个味觉受体如何检测化学物质。

e.en: The experiment focused on {gustatorial} perception.
e.zh: 这项实验关注味觉感知。

e.en: Her {gustatorial} vocabulary grew after months of tasting tea.
e.zh: 经过几个月品茶，她描述味觉的词汇丰富了许多。

e.en: The samples differed {gustatorily}, though they looked identical.
e.zh: 这些样品看起来一样，但在味觉上不同。

e.en: Infants respond {gustatorily} to bitter substances.
e.zh: 婴儿会通过味觉对苦味物质作出反应。

e.en: A {gustful} wind rattled the windows all night.
e.zh: 一阵阵大风整夜把窗户吹得作响。

e.en: His {gustful} anger faded after a minute.
e.zh: 他那阵猛烈的怒气一分钟后就消退了。

e.en: The wind blew {gustily} across the harbor.
e.zh: 风一阵阵猛烈地吹过港口。

e.en: She laughed {gustily} at the old joke.
e.zh: 听到那个老笑话，她爽朗地大笑起来。

e.en: The forecast warned of increasing {gustiness} after noon.
e.zh: 天气预报警告中午后阵风会越来越强。

e.en: The poem's {gustiness} comes from its abrupt rhythms.
e.zh: 这首诗的猛烈感来自它突兀的节奏。

e.en: The lake lay {gustless} under a gray sky.
e.zh: 灰色天空下，湖面无风而平静。

e.en: His {gustless} speech failed to move the crowd.
e.zh: 他那毫无劲头的演讲没能打动人群。

e.en: The old factory employed a skilled {gut-man}.
e.zh: 那家老工厂雇了一名熟练的肠线工。

e.en: He played the {gut-man} in a rough comedy.
e.zh: 他在一部粗俗喜剧里扮演了一个粗汉。

e.en: It was a {gut-wrenching} decision for the family.
e.zh: 这对全家来说是一个极其痛苦的决定。

e.en: The film ends with a {gut-wrenching} scene of loss.
e.zh: 电影以一场令人揪心的失去亲人的戏收尾。

e.en: The band played raw {gutbucket} blues.
e.zh: 乐队演奏了粗犷原始的低俗蓝调。

e.en: Critics dismissed the show as {gutbucket} comedy.
e.zh: 评论家把这场表演贬为粗俗喜剧。

e.en: The old boxer was a fearless {gutfighter}.
e.zh: 那位老拳击手是个无所畏惧的硬汉斗士。

e.en: She proved a {gutfighter} during the long campaign.
e.zh: 在漫长的竞选中，她证明自己是个顽强斗士。

e.en: The hunter trained his {gundog} to retrieve ducks.
e.zh: 猎人训练他的猎犬去衔回野鸭。

e.en: A good {gundog} stays calm near gunfire.
e.zh: 好的枪猎犬在枪声附近也能保持镇定。

e.en: The estate keeps several {gundogs} for autumn shoots.
e.zh: 这座庄园养了几只枪猎犬，用于秋季狩猎。

e.en: Well-trained {gundogs} can follow hand signals silently.
e.zh: 训练有素的猎犬能安静地听从手势指令。

e.en: The outlaw tried to {gundown} his pursuer.
e.zh: 那个歹徒企图用枪击倒追赶他的人。

e.en: Reporters said soldiers had {gundown} civilians in the street.
e.zh: 记者称士兵在街上枪杀了平民。

e.en: The typo {gunfignt} likely meant gunfight in the report.
e.zh: 报告里的拼写错误gunfignt很可能指的是枪战。

e.en: Readers stumbled over {gunfignt} because the word was misspelled.
e.zh: 读者看到gunfignt时卡住了，因为这个词拼错了。

e.en: The old musket needed a new {gunflint}.
e.zh: 那支旧火枪需要一块新的枪用燧石。

e.en: Collectors prize a sharp {gunflint} from the battlefield.
e.zh: 收藏者很看重战场上留下的锋利火枪燧石。

e.en: The sink was clogged with black {gung}.
e.zh: 水槽被黑色黏糊污物堵住了。

e.en: Wipe that sticky {gung} off the handle.
e.zh: 把把手上那层黏糊糊的脏东西擦掉。

gung-ho.t: 狂热积极的；过分热心的

e.en: The new manager was {gung-ho} about cutting costs.
e.zh: 新经理对削减成本表现得特别积极。

e.en: Some volunteers grew less {gung-ho} after the first week.
e.zh: 第一周过后，一些志愿者就没那么热心了。

e.en: His boots were covered in {gungy} mud.
e.zh: 他的靴子上沾满了黏糊糊的泥。

e.en: The old machine left a {gungy} residue on my hands.
e.zh: 那台旧机器在我手上留下了脏兮兮的黏渍。

e.en: The rifles were locked inside the {gunhouse}.
e.zh: 步枪被锁在枪械库里。

e.en: A small {gunhouse} stood beside the shooting range.
e.zh: 射击场旁边有一间放枪的小屋。

e.en: The {gunlayer} adjusted the cannon before firing.
e.zh: 开火前，火炮瞄准员调整了大炮。

e.en: A skilled {gunlayer} could hit targets in rough seas.
e.zh: 熟练的瞄准炮手能在风浪中击中目标。

e.en: The guard felt exposed and {gunless}.
e.zh: 那名守卫没有带枪，觉得自己很容易受攻击。

e.en: They wanted a {gunless} patrol in the park.
e.zh: 他们希望公园里进行不带枪的巡逻。

e.en: The antique pistol had a damaged {gunlock}.
e.zh: 那把古董手枪的枪机坏了。

e.en: He studied how the {gunlock} sparked the powder.
e.zh: 他研究火枪击发装置如何点燃火药。

gunnage.t: 船底垫货材料；货物垫料

e.en: The crew packed {gunnage} beneath the cargo.
e.zh: 船员在货物下面铺了垫料。

e.en: Wet {gunnage} can damage sacks during a voyage.
e.zh: 潮湿的船底垫料会在航行中损坏麻袋。

gunneryship.t: 炮术训练舰；炮兵训练船

e.en: Cadets practiced aboard the {gunneryship} each summer.
e.zh: 学员们每年夏天都在炮术训练舰上练习。

e.en: The navy converted an old cruiser into a {gunneryship}.
e.zh: 海军把一艘旧巡洋舰改成了炮兵训练船。

e.en: He carried potatoes in a {gunny-bag}.
e.zh: 他用一个粗麻袋装土豆。

e.en: The farmer patched the torn {gunny-bag} with string.
e.zh: 农夫用绳子补好了破了的黄麻袋。

e.en: The cartridge was wrapped in thin {gunpaper}.
e.zh: 弹药筒外包着一层薄薄的火药纸。

e.en: Old manuals describe how {gunpaper} was prepared.
e.zh: 旧手册说明了火药纸的制作方法。

e.en: Smoke poured from the ship's {gunport}.
e.zh: 烟从船侧的炮门里涌出。

e.en: The sailor closed the {gunport} before the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨来临前，水手关上了舰侧炮孔。

e.en: The rifles were stored in the {gunroom}.
e.zh: 步枪存放在枪械室里。

e.en: Young officers ate together in the ship's {gunroom}.
e.zh: 年轻军官们在船上的军官餐室一起用餐。

gunrunning.t: 走私军火；非法贩运武器

e.en: The gang made money from {gunrunning}.
e.zh: 这个团伙靠走私军火赚钱。

e.en: Police uncovered a {gunrunning} route across the border.
e.zh: 警方查出了一条跨境非法贩运武器的路线。

e.en: The detective watched the nervous {gunsel} in the alley.
e.zh: 侦探盯着巷子里那个紧张的年轻枪手。

e.en: In old crime fiction, a {gunsel} often follows a tougher boss.
e.zh: 在老式犯罪小说里，小混混常常跟着更狠的老大。

e.en: The film celebrates a {gunslinging} hero from the frontier.
e.zh: 这部电影赞颂了一位来自边疆的枪手式英雄。

e.en: His {gunslinging} rhetoric made the debate feel like a duel.
e.zh: 他那种咄咄逼人的言辞让辩论像一场决斗。

e.en: The carved {gunstock} was made of walnut.
e.zh: 雕花枪托是胡桃木做的。

e.en: He pressed the {gunstock} firmly against his shoulder.
e.zh: 他把枪托稳稳抵在肩上。

e.en: The survey mapped a large {guyot} beneath the Pacific.
e.zh: 这次勘测绘出了太平洋下的一座大型平顶海山。

e.en: A {guyot} was once an island before erosion flattened it.
e.zh: 平顶海山在被侵蚀削平以前曾经是一座岛。

e.en: Several {guyots} rise from the deep ocean floor.
e.zh: 几座平顶海山从深海海底隆起。

e.en: Geologists study {guyots} to reconstruct ancient sea levels.
e.zh: 地质学家研究平顶海山，以重建古代海平面。

e.en: I am {gwine} down the road before sunset.
e.zh: 我打算在日落前沿路走下去。

e.en: She said she was {gwine} to tell the truth.
e.zh: 她说她要把真相讲出来。

e.en: The {gwyniad} is found in a few Welsh lakes.
e.zh: 威尔士白鲑生活在少数几个威尔士湖泊中。

e.en: Conservationists monitor the {gwyniad} population each spring.
e.zh: 自然保护人员每年春天监测威尔士白鲑的种群数量。

e.en: The soap contains {gylcerol} to keep skin moist.
e.zh: 这种肥皂含有甘油，可以帮助皮肤保湿。

e.en: Chemists heated {gylcerol} during the laboratory demonstration.
e.zh: 化学家在实验演示中加热了甘油。

e.en: The explosive mixture contained {gylcoldinitrate} as an energetic ingredient.
e.zh: 这种爆炸混合物含有乙二醇二硝酸酯作为高能成分。

e.en: Safety manuals describe {gylcoldinitrate} as highly hazardous.
e.zh: 安全手册将乙二醇二硝酸酯描述为高度危险物质。

e.en: The school required a white {gym-slip} for exercise class.
e.zh: 学校要求上体育课时穿白色体育用无袖衬裙。

e.en: Her old {gym-slip} hung in the costume room.
e.zh: 她那件旧的体育课无袖衬裙挂在服装室里。

e.en: The reform changed the {gymnasial} curriculum across the region.
e.zh: 这项改革改变了该地区文科中学的课程设置。

e.en: He completed his {gymnasial} studies before entering university.
e.zh: 他完成中学阶段的学习后进入大学。

e.en: The {gymnasiarch} organized athletic training for young citizens.
e.zh: 古希腊体操学校长官为年轻公民组织体育训练。

e.en: Inscriptions mention a wealthy {gymnasiarch} who funded the games.
e.zh: 碑文提到一位出资举办赛事的富有体操学校长官。

e.en: The young {gymnasiast} studied Latin every afternoon.
e.zh: 这名年轻的文科中学学生每天下午学习拉丁语。

e.en: A {gymnasiast} from Vienna won the mathematics prize.
e.zh: 一名来自维也纳的中学生获得了数学奖。

e.en: The coach praised her {gymnastical} skill on the bars.
e.zh: 教练称赞她在高低杠上的体操技巧。

e.en: Old manuals described {gymnastical} exercises for schoolboys.
e.zh: 旧手册描述了给男学生做的体育训练动作。

e.en: She moved {gymnastically} across the narrow beam.
e.zh: 她以体操般的动作穿过那根窄梁。

e.en: The dancer leapt {gymnastically} during the final scene.
e.zh: 舞者在最后一幕中像体操运动员一样跃起。

e.en: The botanist identified a {gymnocarpic} fruiting structure.
e.zh: 植物学家识别出一种裸果状的结果结构。

e.en: Some fungi develop {gymnocarpic} forms under dry conditions.
e.zh: 有些真菌在干燥条件下会形成裸露子实体形态。

e.en: The detective found the {gutshot} victim behind the warehouse.
e.zh: 侦探在仓库后面发现了腹部中弹的受害者。

e.en: He called the bet with only a {gutshot} draw.
e.zh: 他只有内听顺子的牌，却还是跟了注。

e.en: Her second proposal was {gutsier} than the first.
e.zh: 她的第二个方案比第一个更大胆。

e.en: The team made a {gutsier} decision under pressure.
e.zh: 团队在压力下做出了更有胆量的决定。

e.en: She {gutsily} challenged the unfair rule.
e.zh: 她勇敢地挑战了那条不公平的规定。

e.en: The young boxer fought {gutsily} until the final bell.
e.zh: 那位年轻拳手一直勇敢地打到终场铃响。

e.en: The old cable was insulated with {gutta-percha}.
e.zh: 那条旧电缆用古塔胶作绝缘材料。

e.en: The dentist filled the canal with {gutta-percha}.
e.zh: 牙医用牙科古塔胶填充了根管。

e.en: Early telegraph wires often used {guttapercha} for insulation.
e.zh: 早期电报线常用古塔胶来绝缘。

e.en: The root canal was sealed with {guttapercha}.
e.zh: 根管用牙科古塔胶封住了。

e.en: The rash appeared in small {guttate} spots.
e.zh: 皮疹呈现为小小的滴状斑点。

e.en: The beetle had {guttate} markings on its wings.
e.zh: 这只甲虫的翅膀上有斑点状花纹。

e.en: Morning droplets on the leaf came from {guttation}.
e.zh: 叶片早晨出现的水珠来自植物吐水现象。

e.en: High soil moisture can increase {guttation} in grasses.
e.zh: 土壤水分高会增加禾草的吐水现象。

e.en: He answered in a deep {gutteral} voice.
e.zh: 他用低沉粗哑的声音回答。

e.en: The dialect includes several {gutteral} sounds.
e.zh: 这种方言包含几个喉音。

e.en: The novel follows a hungry {gutterbird} through London.
e.zh: 小说讲述一个饥饿的街头流浪儿在伦敦漂泊。

e.en: He dismissed the heckler as a common {gutterbird}.
e.zh: 他把那个起哄者斥为粗鄙的下层人。

e.en: A {gutterman} cleared leaves after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨后，一名清沟工清理了落叶。

e.en: The insult painted him as a drunken {gutterman}.
e.zh: 这句侮辱把他说成了醉醺醺的粗俗之人。

guttersnipe.t: 街头流浪儿；粗俗小混混

e.en: The orphan survived as a {guttersnipe} near the docks.
e.zh: 那个孤儿在码头附近像街头流浪儿一样活了下来。

e.en: She called the rude boy a little {guttersnipe}.
e.zh: 她把那个无礼的男孩叫作粗俗的小混混。

guttersnipish.t: 像街头流浪儿的；粗俗的

e.en: His {guttersnipish} jokes embarrassed the guests.
e.zh: 他那些粗俗的玩笑让客人们很尴尬。

e.en: The actor gave the prince a {guttersnipish} swagger.
e.zh: 演员把王子演出了一种街头流浪儿般的摇摆劲儿。

e.en: The botanist identified the tree as a {guttifer}.
e.zh: 植物学家认出这棵树是分泌树胶的植物。

e.en: A tropical {guttifer} produced the resin used locally.
e.zh: 一种热带分泌树胶的植物产出了当地使用的树脂。

e.en: The {guttiferous} bark yielded a sticky resin.
e.zh: 这种分泌胶质的树皮渗出了黏性树脂。

e.en: Several {guttiferous} plants grow in the humid forest.
e.zh: 潮湿森林里生长着几种产树脂的植物。

e.en: A clear {guttula} formed on the specimen.
e.zh: 标本上形成了一颗透明小滴。

e.en: The slide showed a dark {guttula} inside each cell.
e.zh: 载玻片显示每个细胞里都有一个深色小斑点。

guttulate.t: 有小滴的；具滴状斑点的

e.en: The fungus had {guttulate} spores under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下，这种真菌有带小滴的孢子。

e.en: Its wings were {guttulate} with pale marks.
e.zh: 它的翅膀带有浅色滴状斑点。

e.en: The teacher corrected his heavy {gutturalism}.
e.zh: 老师纠正了他明显的喉音特征。

e.en: The poem uses {gutturalism} for a harsh effect.
e.zh: 这首诗用喉音效果营造出刺耳的感觉。

e.en: The singer added {gutturality} to the final note.
e.zh: 歌手在最后一个音里加入了粗哑低沉感。

e.en: Linguists discussed the {gutturality} of the consonant.
e.zh: 语言学家讨论了这个辅音的喉音性。

e.en: The dialect shows {gutturalization} of several consonants.
e.zh: 这种方言显示出几个辅音的喉音化。

e.en: Excessive {gutturalization} made his speech hard to follow.
e.zh: 过度喉音化让他的话很难听懂。

e.en: Some speakers {gutturalize} the sound in rapid speech.
e.zh: 有些说话者在语速快时会把这个音喉音化。

e.en: The actor tried to {gutturalize} his lines for menace.
e.zh: 演员试图用喉音念台词来制造威胁感。

e.en: The old grammar described a {gutturonasal} consonant.
e.zh: 那本旧语法书描述了一个喉鼻音辅音。

e.en: His chant had a strange {gutturonasal} quality.
e.zh: 他的吟唱带有奇特的喉鼻共鸣感。

e.en: It was a {gutty} performance by the injured runner.
e.zh: 那名受伤跑者的表现很有胆量。

e.en: The stew had a strong, {gutty} smell.
e.zh: 这锅炖菜有一股浓重的内脏味。

e.en: The butterfly was a rare {gynandromorph} with different wings.
e.zh: 那只蝴蝶是罕见的雌雄嵌体，两边翅膀不同。

e.en: Scientists photographed a {gynandromorph} bee in the lab.
e.zh: 科学家在实验室拍到了一只雌雄嵌体蜜蜂。

e.en: The insect showed {gynandromorphic} traits on opposite sides.
e.zh: 这只昆虫在身体两侧表现出雌雄嵌体特征。

e.en: A {gynandromorphic} bird drew attention from researchers.
e.zh: 一只具有雌雄嵌体现象的鸟引起了研究人员注意。

e.en: {Gynandromorphism} can make one side male and the other female.
e.zh: 雌雄嵌体现象会让一侧呈雄性，另一侧呈雌性。

e.en: The paper explains {gynandromorphism} in certain butterflies.
e.zh: 这篇论文解释了某些蝴蝶中的雌雄嵌体现象。

e.en: The specimen's {gynandromorphy} was visible under magnification.
e.zh: 在放大观察下，标本的雌雄嵌体状态清晰可见。

e.en: Researchers discussed {gynandromorphy} in insects and birds.
e.zh: 研究人员讨论了昆虫和鸟类中的雌雄嵌体状态。

e.en: The orchid has a {gynandrous} reproductive column.
e.zh: 这种兰花具有雄蕊和雌蕊合生的生殖柱。

e.en: Botanists described the flower as {gynandrous}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种花描述为雄蕊雌蕊合生。

e.en: Older medical texts used {gynanthropia} for male feminization.
e.zh: 旧医学文献用gynanthropia指男性女性化。

e.en: The diagnosis of {gynanthropia} is now obsolete.
e.zh: gynanthropia这一诊断如今已经过时。

e.en: The novel imagines a society ruled by {gynarchy}.
e.zh: 这部小说设想了一个由女性统治的社会。

e.en: Critics used {gynarchy} to describe the queen's court.
e.zh: 评论者用女性掌权来形容女王的宫廷。

e.en: The old {gynasium} served local girls for decades.
e.zh: 这所旧女子体育馆几十年来服务当地女孩。

e.en: A historical map marks the building as a {gynasium}.
e.zh: 一张历史地图把这栋建筑标为女子学校。

e.en: Women gathered in the {gyneceum} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐后，妇女们聚集在内室里。

e.en: The historian described the house's {gyneceum} carefully.
e.zh: 历史学家仔细描述了那所房子的妇女内室。

e.en: The article discusses {gynecic} roles in ancient ritual.
e.zh: 文章讨论了古代仪式中的女性角色。

e.en: Some insects have distinct {gynecic} forms.
e.zh: 有些昆虫具有明显的雌性形态。

e.en: The flower's {gynecium} was examined under a microscope.
e.zh: 研究人员在显微镜下检查了这朵花的雌蕊群。

e.en: In Greek houses, the {gynecium} was reserved for women.
e.zh: 在古希腊住宅中，妇女内室是女性使用的空间。

e.en: The philosopher criticized what he called {gynecocracy}.
e.zh: 那位哲学家批评了他所谓的女性统治政体。

e.en: Her essay reexamines myths of {gynecocracy}.
e.zh: 她的文章重新审视了关于女性统治的神话。

e.en: Early manuals of {gynecoiatry} mixed medicine with superstition.
e.zh: 早期妇科医学手册把医学和迷信混在一起。

e.en: The library owns a rare book on {gynecoiatry}.
e.zh: 图书馆藏有一本罕见的妇科医学著作。

e.en: Doctors described the pelvis as {gynecoid} in shape.
e.zh: 医生描述这个骨盆形状为女性型。

e.en: The sculpture has a distinctly {gynecoid} form.
e.zh: 这座雕塑有明显的女性化形态。

e.en: The medication can sometimes cause {gynecomastia}.
e.zh: 这种药物有时会导致男性乳房发育症。

e.en: He saw a doctor about painful {gynecomastia}.
e.zh: 他因疼痛的男性乳房发育症去看医生。

e.en: The figure is {gynecomorphous} rather than strictly female.
e.zh: 这个形象近似女性，但并非严格意义上的女性。

e.en: Some myths describe {gynecomorphous} spirits with mixed traits.
e.zh: 一些神话描写了兼具混合特征的女性形态精灵。

e.en: The old doctor specialized in {gynecopathy}.
e.zh: 那位老医生专治妇科疾病。

e.en: The lecture traced changing ideas about {gynecopathy}.
e.zh: 讲座梳理了人们对妇科疾病认识的变化。

e.en: The satire presents {gyneocracy} as social disorder.
e.zh: 这部讽刺作品把女性统治描写成社会失序。

e.en: Modern scholars read {gyneocracy} in the tale differently.
e.zh: 现代学者对故事中的女性统治有不同解读。

e.en: The cult was accused of {gyneolatry} by its opponents.
e.zh: 反对者指责这个教派崇拜女性。

e.en: His poems often border on {gyneolatry}.
e.zh: 他的诗歌常常近乎女性崇拜。

e.en: His {gynephobia} made close relationships difficult.
e.zh: 他的恐女症让亲密关系变得困难。

e.en: The essay treats {gynephobia} as a cultural anxiety.
e.zh: 这篇文章把恐女症视为一种文化焦虑。

e.en: The course covered the history of {gyniatrics}.
e.zh: 这门课讲授了妇科医学的发展史。

e.en: She found an antique treatise on {gyniatrics}.
e.zh: 她找到了一本关于妇科医学的古旧论著。

e.en: Ancient {gyniatry} often relied on herbal remedies.
e.zh: 古代妇科治疗常依赖草药。

e.en: The museum displayed instruments used in {gyniatry}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了妇科治疗中使用过的器具。

e.en: The ritual had a strongly {gynic} character.
e.zh: 这项仪式带有很强的女性特征。

e.en: The scholar analyzed {gynic} imagery in the poem.
e.zh: 这位学者分析了诗中的女性意象。

e.en: The botanist measured the flower's {gynobase} carefully.
e.zh: 植物学家仔细测量了这朵花的雌蕊基部。

e.en: A raised {gynobase} helps identify the species.
e.zh: 隆起的雌蕊基部有助于识别这个物种。

gymnocarpous.t: 裸果的；果实外露的；子实体外露的，果实或孢子体不被包被覆盖的

e.en: The botanist described the specimen as {gymnocarpous} because its fruit was exposed.
e.zh: 植物学家把这个标本描述为裸果的，因为它的果实外露。

e.en: Some lichens have {gymnocarpous} fruiting bodies visible on the surface.
e.zh: 有些地衣具有表面可见的外露子实体。

gymnogenous.t: 裸生的；无包被产生的，指生物结构在外露状态下形成

e.en: The old flora used {gymnogenous} to describe spores formed without a covering.
e.zh: 这本旧植物志用裸生的来描述没有包被而形成的孢子。

e.en: A {gymnogenous} structure develops exposed rather than enclosed in tissue.
e.zh: 裸生结构是在外露状态下发育，而不是被组织包围。

gymnoplast.t: 裸质体；无细胞壁的原生质体，尤指除去外壁后的细胞内容物

e.en: The experiment isolated a {gymnoplast} from the algal cell.
e.zh: 这项实验从藻类细胞中分离出了一个裸质体。

e.en: A {gymnoplast} can be studied to observe the living protoplasm directly.
e.zh: 研究裸质体可以直接观察活的原生质。

gymnorhinal.t: 鼻孔外露的，指鸟类等鼻孔无遮盖或无羽毛覆盖

e.en: The bird was classified as {gymnorhinal} because its nostrils were bare.
e.zh: 这种鸟因鼻孔裸露而被归为鼻孔外露型。

e.en: A {gymnorhinal} bill lacks feathers around the nasal openings.
e.zh: 鼻孔外露的鸟喙在鼻孔周围没有羽毛。

gymnosophist.t: 古印度裸体哲人；苦行智者

e.en: Greek writers imagined the {gymnosophist} as a naked Indian sage.
e.zh: 希腊作家把古印度裸体哲人想象成赤身的印度圣贤。

e.en: The traveler compared the ascetic to a {gymnosophist} from ancient accounts.
e.zh: 旅行者把这位苦行者比作古代记载中的裸体哲人。

gymnosperm.t: 裸子植物，种子不包在果实中的植物

e.en: A pine tree is a common {gymnosperm}.
e.zh: 松树是一种常见的裸子植物。

e.en: Unlike flowering plants, a {gymnosperm} does not enclose its seeds in fruit.
e.zh: 与开花植物不同，裸子植物不会把种子包在果实里。

gymnospermism.t: 裸子植物性；裸子状态，具有种子裸露的特征

e.en: The fossil showed signs of {gymnospermism} in its exposed seed structures.
e.zh: 这块化石的种子结构外露，显示出裸子植物性。

e.en: Botanists discussed {gymnospermism} as a stage in seed-plant evolution.
e.zh: 植物学家把裸子状态作为种子植物演化中的一个阶段来讨论。

gymnospermous.t: 裸子植物的；种子裸露的

e.en: The cone belongs to a {gymnospermous} plant.
e.zh: 这个球果属于一种裸子植物。

e.en: A {gymnospermous} species bears seeds without a protective fruit.
e.zh: 裸子植物物种结出没有果实保护的种子。

e.en: The textbook defines {gymnospermy} as the condition of having naked seeds.
e.zh: 教材把裸子性定义为具有裸露种子的状态。

e.en: Evidence of {gymnospermy} helped identify the ancient plant group.
e.zh: 裸子性证据有助于识别这个古老植物类群。

gymnotremoid.t: 似裸孔类的；具裸孔类特征的

e.en: The shell was described as {gymnotremoid} in the specialist monograph.
e.zh: 这枚壳体在专业专著中被描述为似裸孔类的。

e.en: A {gymnotremoid} form may show an uncovered aperture in the fossil record.
e.zh: 似裸孔类形态在化石记录中可能表现出无遮盖的孔口。

gymnures.t: 猬鼠；毛猬，像刺猬但多无硬刺的小型哺乳动物

e.en: The zoo keeps several {gymnures} in a nocturnal enclosure.
e.zh: 动物园在夜行动物展区饲养了几只猬鼠。

e.en: Unlike hedgehogs, {gymnures} usually have hair instead of sharp spines.
e.zh: 与刺猬不同，猬鼠通常长毛而不是尖刺。

e.en: The costume was trimmed with gold {gymp}.
e.zh: 这套戏服用金色编结花边作装饰。

e.en: She bought black {gymp} to edge the velvet cushion.
e.zh: 她买了黑色金银丝饰带来给天鹅绒靠垫镶边。

gynaecea.t: 妇女内室；雌蕊群，gynaeceum的复数

e.en: The ancient house had separate {gynaecea} for the women of the family.
e.zh: 这座古宅为家中的女性设有单独的妇女内室。

e.en: The paper compared the {gynaecea} of several related flowers.
e.zh: 这篇论文比较了几种近缘花的雌蕊群。

e.en: Visitors were not allowed into the {gynaeceum} of the Greek household.
e.zh: 访客不得进入这个希腊家庭的妇女内室。

e.en: The botanist examined the flower's {gynaeceum} under a lens.
e.zh: 植物学家在放大镜下检查这朵花的雌蕊群。

e.en: The article used {gynaecic} language that now sounds old-fashioned.
e.zh: 这篇文章使用了如今听来过时的女性相关用语。

e.en: A {gynaecic} ward was listed in the hospital's nineteenth-century records.
e.zh: 这家医院十九世纪的记录中列有妇科病房。

gynaecium.t: 雌蕊群；古希腊妇女内室

e.en: The flower's {gynaecium} contains three fused carpels.
e.zh: 这朵花的雌蕊群包含三个合生心皮。

e.en: In the old villa, the {gynaecium} was set apart from the men's rooms.
e.zh: 在这座古别墅里，妇女内室与男子房间分开设置。

gynaecoid.t: 女性型的；似女性的，常指骨盆形态

e.en: A {gynaecoid} pelvis is generally broader and rounder.
e.zh: 女性型骨盆通常更宽、更圆。

e.en: The sculpture has a {gynaecoid} outline despite its abstract style.
e.zh: 这座雕塑虽是抽象风格，却有女性型轮廓。

e.en: She scheduled a {gynaecologic} examination for next week.
e.zh: 她预约了下周的妇科检查。

e.en: The clinic specializes in {gynaecologic} surgery and reproductive care.
e.zh: 这家诊所专门做妇科手术和生殖健康护理。

gynaecomastia.t: 男性乳房发育症；男子乳房增大

e.en: The medication can sometimes cause {gynaecomastia} in adolescent boys.
e.zh: 这种药有时会导致青春期男孩出现男性乳房发育症。

e.en: He saw a doctor because his {gynaecomastia} had become painful.
e.zh: 由于男性乳房发育症开始疼痛，他去看了医生。

gynaecomorphous.t: 形似女性的；具雌性形态的

e.en: The insect has a {gynaecomorphous} male that resembles the female.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的雄性形似雌性，具有雌性形态。

e.en: A {gynaecomorphous} figure appears in the margins of the medieval manuscript.
e.zh: 这份中世纪手稿的页边出现了一个形似女性的人物。

e.en: The essay treats courtly love as a kind of {gynaeolatry}.
e.zh: 这篇文章把宫廷爱情视为一种女性崇拜。

e.en: Archaeologists debated whether the figurines proved ancient {gynaeolatry}.
e.zh: 考古学家争论这些小塑像是否证明了古代女神崇拜。

gynander.t: 雌雄同体者；具雌雄特征的生物

e.en: The butterfly was a rare {gynander} with male and female markings.
e.zh: 这只蝴蝶是罕见的雌雄同体个体，同时带有雄性和雌性斑纹。

e.en: Early naturalists used {gynander} for organisms showing both sexual forms.
e.zh: 早期博物学家用雌雄同体者来指同时呈现两性形态的生物。

e.en: The clinic used {gypsoplast} to make a firm cast.
e.zh: 诊所用熟石膏做了一个结实的石膏固定。

e.en: Old surgical manuals often mention {gypsoplast} for splints.
e.zh: 旧外科手册常提到用石膏材料制作夹板。

e.en: The fair attracted every {gypster} looking for easy money.
e.zh: 集市吸引了各种想轻松骗钱的小骗子。

e.en: He spoke like a street {gypster}, all charm and tricks.
e.zh: 他说话像街头骗子，满是魅力和花招。

gypsyhead.t: 流浪者头目；吉普赛式头像

e.en: The old print showed a dark {gypsyhead} in profile.
e.zh: 那幅旧版画画着一个侧面的吉普赛式头像。

e.en: Villagers said the {gypsyhead} settled disputes inside the camp.
e.zh: 村民说那个流浪者头目负责调解营地里的纠纷。

e.en: The essay discusses {gypsyism} in nineteenth-century literature.
e.zh: 这篇文章讨论十九世纪文学中的吉普赛风俗。

e.en: Critics accused the novel of romanticizing {gypsyism}.
e.zh: 批评者指责这部小说把流浪生活习气浪漫化。

e.en: The scan showed abnormal {gyral} development in the cortex.
e.zh: 扫描显示大脑皮层的脑回发育异常。

e.en: The dancer traced a slow {gyral} path across the floor.
e.zh: 舞者在地板上划出一条缓慢旋转的路线。

e.en: The antibiotic blocks bacterial {gyrase} during DNA replication.
e.zh: 这种抗生素会在DNA复制时阻断细菌旋转酶。

e.en: Researchers measured {gyrase} activity in the resistant strain.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了耐药菌株中的DNA旋转酶活性。

e.en: The engineer modeled the wheel's {gyrational} motion.
e.zh: 工程师为车轮的回转运动建立了模型。

e.en: A {gyrational} force kept the device stable.
e.zh: 一种旋转力使这个装置保持稳定。

e.en: The circuit used a {gyrator} to simulate an inductor.
e.zh: 该电路用回转器来模拟电感。

e.en: A small {gyrator} kept the platform turning smoothly.
e.zh: 一个小型旋转装置让平台平稳转动。

e.en: The machine works with a {gyratory} crushing motion.
e.zh: 这台机器通过旋转挤压动作运转。

e.en: Traffic slowed near the {gyratory} outside the station.
e.zh: 车站外环形交叉路口附近的交通慢了下来。

e.en: The surgeon considered {gyrectomy} only after other treatments failed.
e.zh: 其他治疗失败后，外科医生才考虑脑回切除术。

e.en: Postoperative scans confirmed the limited {gyrectomy} area.
e.zh: 术后扫描确认了脑回切除的范围很有限。

e.en: The old {gyrene} told stories from the Pacific campaign.
e.zh: 那位老海军陆战队员讲述了太平洋战役的经历。

e.en: In wartime slang, a {gyrene} meant a Marine.
e.zh: 在战时俚语里，gyrene指一名海军陆战队员。

e.en: The MRI clearly showed the brain's {gyri}.
e.zh: 核磁共振清楚显示了大脑的脑回。

e.en: Some cortical {gyri} mature later in childhood.
e.zh: 一些大脑皮层脑回在童年后期才成熟。

e.en: The instrument keeps its {gyroaxis} aligned with true north.
e.zh: 该仪器让陀螺轴与真北保持一致。

e.en: Engineers adjusted the {gyroaxis} before the test flight.
e.zh: 工程师在试飞前调整了旋转轴。

gyrobearing.t: 陀螺方位；陀螺罗经方位

e.en: The navigator checked the {gyrobearing} every hour.
e.zh: 领航员每小时检查一次陀螺方位。

e.en: A wrong {gyrobearing} sent the ship off course.
e.zh: 错误的陀螺罗经方位使船偏离了航线。

e.en: The museum restored a rare {gyrobus} from the 1950s.
e.zh: 博物馆修复了一辆罕见的二十世纪五十年代陀螺蓄能公交车。

e.en: A {gyrobus} stored energy in a spinning flywheel.
e.zh: 陀螺蓄能公交车把能量储存在旋转飞轮中。

e.en: The ship's {gyrocompass} stayed accurate in rough seas.
e.zh: 船上的陀螺罗经在恶劣海况中仍保持准确。

e.en: Pilots compared the magnetic compass with the {gyrocompass}.
e.zh: 飞行员把磁罗盘和陀螺罗盘进行了对照。

gyrocon.t: 陀螺控向装置；电子束管

e.en: The transmitter used a {gyrocon} for high-power amplification.
e.zh: 这台发射机使用电子束管进行高功率放大。

e.en: A damaged {gyrocon} caused instability in the guidance system.
e.zh: 损坏的陀螺控向装置导致制导系统不稳定。

gyrocontrol.t: 陀螺控制；陀螺稳定控制

e.en: The drone relies on {gyrocontrol} during sudden gusts.
e.zh: 无人机在突遇强风时依靠陀螺控制。

e.en: Early rockets used simple {gyrocontrol} to maintain attitude.
e.zh: 早期火箭使用简单的陀螺稳定控制来保持姿态。

e.en: He learned to fly a {gyrocopter} over the desert.
e.zh: 他学会了驾驶旋翼机飞越沙漠。

e.en: A {gyrocopter} uses an unpowered rotor for lift.
e.zh: 自转旋翼飞机利用无动力旋翼产生升力。

e.en: The prototype {gyrodine} could take off almost vertically.
e.zh: 这架原型复合式旋翼机几乎可以垂直起飞。

e.en: A {gyrodine} combines helicopter lift with airplane thrust.
e.zh: 复合式旋翼机结合了直升机升力和飞机推力。

e.en: The experimental {gyrodozer} stayed level on steep ground.
e.zh: 这台实验性陀螺稳定推土机在陡坡上保持水平。

e.en: Engineers tested the {gyrodozer} in rough construction terrain.
e.zh: 工程师在崎岖工地地形中测试了陀螺稳定推土机。

gyrodynamics.t: 陀螺动力学；旋转动力学

e.en: The course introduces {gyrodynamics} through spinning tops.
e.zh: 这门课通过旋转陀螺介绍陀螺动力学。

e.en: Satellite engineers must understand {gyrodynamics}.
e.zh: 卫星工程师必须理解旋转动力学。

e.en: The {gyrodyne} switched modes during forward flight.
e.zh: 这架复合式旋翼机在向前飞行时切换了模式。

e.en: Unlike a simple autogyro, a {gyrodyne} can power its rotor.
e.zh: 不同于简单的自转旋翼机，复合式旋翼机可以驱动其旋翼。

gyrofinishing.t: 离心滚磨光整；旋转抛光

e.en: The factory used {gyrofinishing} to polish small metal parts.
e.zh: 工厂用离心滚磨光整来抛光小金属件。

e.en: After {gyrofinishing}, the components had smoother edges.
e.zh: 经过旋转抛光后，这些零件的边缘更光滑了。

e.en: The plasma's {gyrofrequency} depends on the magnetic field.
e.zh: 等离子体的回旋频率取决于磁场。

e.en: Scientists calculated the electron {gyrofrequency} for the experiment.
e.zh: 科学家为实验计算了电子回旋频率。

gynocentric.t: 以女性为中心的视角或观念

e.en: The essay offers a {gynocentric} reading of ancient myths.
e.zh: 这篇文章从以女性为中心的视角解读古代神话。

e.en: Her research challenges male-centered history with a {gynocentric} framework.
e.zh: 她的研究用女性中心框架挑战以男性为中心的历史叙述。

gynocracy.t: 女性统治；女性掌权社会

e.en: The novel imagines a peaceful {gynocracy} after the war.
e.zh: 这部小说想象战后出现了一个和平的女性掌权社会。

e.en: Critics used {gynocracy} as a fearful label for women's political power.
e.zh: 批评者把女性统治这个词当作对女性政治权力的恐惧标签。

e.en: This {gynodioecious} species has both female and hermaphrodite plants.
e.zh: 这种雌株与两性株异株的物种同时有雌株和两性株。

e.en: Botanists studied the {gynodioecious} population near the coast.
e.zh: 植物学家研究了海岸附近这个雌株与两性株异株的种群。

e.en: The botanist compared the {gynoecia} of several related flowers.
e.zh: 植物学家比较了几种近缘花卉的雌蕊群。

e.en: Damaged {gynoecia} can reduce seed production in the crop.
e.zh: 雌蕊群受损会降低这种作物的结籽量。

gynoecium.t: 雌蕊群；花的雌性生殖部分

e.en: The flower's {gynoecium} sits at the center of the bloom.
e.zh: 这朵花的雌蕊群位于花朵中央。

e.en: Students dissected the {gynoecium} to identify each carpel.
e.zh: 学生们解剖雌蕊群，以辨认每一个心皮。

gynogamon.t: 雌配子释放的性诱引物质

e.en: The egg releases a {gynogamon} that attracts sperm cells.
e.zh: 卵细胞释放一种雌配子性诱引物质来吸引精细胞。

e.en: Researchers measured the {gynogamon} during fertilization experiments.
e.zh: 研究人员在受精实验中测量了这种雌配子诱引物质。

e.en: Some fish reproduce by {gynogenesis} without paternal genes.
e.zh: 有些鱼通过雌核发育繁殖，不带父本基因。

e.en: The laboratory induced {gynogenesis} to produce uniform offspring.
e.zh: 实验室诱导雌核发育，以产生遗传一致的后代。

gynomerogony.t: 由卵核与精子片段发育

e.en: The paper described {gynomerogony} in an unusual embryo.
e.zh: 论文描述了一个异常胚胎中的卵核与精子片段发育现象。

e.en: Few students had heard of {gynomerogony} before the genetics lecture.
e.zh: 在遗传学讲座前，很少有学生听过卵核与精子片段发育。

gynomonoecious.t: 同株具雌花和两性花的

e.en: A {gynomonoecious} plant bears female and bisexual flowers.
e.zh: 同株具雌花和两性花的植物会长出雌花和两性花。

e.en: The team recorded {gynomonoecious} flowering in the greenhouse population.
e.zh: 团队记录了温室种群中同株具雌花和两性花的开花现象。

gynomonoecism.t: 同株雌花和两性花现象

e.en: The species shows {gynomonoecism} under dry conditions.
e.zh: 该物种在干旱条件下表现出同株雌花和两性花现象。

e.en: Her thesis examined the evolution of {gynomonoecism} in daisies.
e.zh: 她的论文研究了雏菊中同株雌花和两性花现象的演化。

e.en: The peanut's {gynophore} pushes the ovary into the soil.
e.zh: 花生的雌蕊柄会把子房推入土中。

e.en: A long {gynophore} lifts the ovary above the petals.
e.zh: 细长的雌蕊柄把子房托到花瓣上方。

e.en: The orchid's {gynostemium} combines male and female organs.
e.zh: 兰花的合蕊柱把雄性和雌性器官结合在一起。

e.en: She photographed the {gynostemium} under a microscope.
e.zh: 她在显微镜下拍摄了兰科花的合蕊柱。

e.en: We ordered crispy {gyoza} before the ramen arrived.
e.zh: 拉面上桌前，我们点了外皮酥脆的日式煎饺。

e.en: She learned to fold {gyoza} at a cooking class.
e.zh: 她在烹饪课上学会了包日式饺子。

e.en: Foresters used {gyplure} to monitor moth populations.
e.zh: 林业人员使用舞毒蛾性诱剂监测蛾类种群。

e.en: The trap contained {gyplure} to attract male moths.
e.zh: 诱捕器里含有舞毒蛾性诱剂，用来吸引雄蛾。

e.en: The teacher explained that {gypo} is an offensive slur.
e.zh: 老师解释说，这个词是冒犯吉卜赛人的蔑称。

e.en: He apologized after using {gypo} in a joke.
e.zh: 他在玩笑中用了这个蔑称后道了歉。

e.en: Editors removed {gyppo} because it was insulting.
e.zh: 编辑删掉了这个词，因为它带有侮辱性。

e.en: The article quoted {gyppo} only to discuss racist language.
e.zh: 文章引用这个蔑称只是为了讨论种族歧视语言。

e.en: The word {gyppy} is considered offensive today.
e.zh: 如今这个词被认为是冒犯性的蔑称。

e.en: She warned him not to call anyone {gyppy}.
e.zh: 她警告他不要用这个蔑称称呼任何人。

e.en: The builder patched the {gyprock} after moving the outlet.
e.zh: 工人移动插座后修补了那块石膏板。

e.en: In Australia, many people call plasterboard {gyprock}.
e.zh: 在澳大利亚，很多人把石膏板叫作gyprock。

e.en: The old text refers to gypsum as {gypse}.
e.zh: 这本旧书把石膏称作gypse。

e.en: Artists once mixed {gypse} into certain grounds for painting.
e.zh: 艺术家过去会把石膏质材料混入某些绘画底料中。

e.en: The valley has pale, {gypseous} soil.
e.zh: 这个山谷有颜色发白的石膏质土壤。

e.en: Few crops grow well on {gypseous} ground.
e.zh: 很少有作物能在含石膏的土地上长得好。

e.en: The map marks several {gypsiferous} rock layers.
e.zh: 地图标出了几个含石膏的岩层。

e.en: Plants adapted to {gypsiferous} soils often tolerate high minerals.
e.zh: 适应含石膏土壤的植物通常能耐受高矿物质环境。

e.en: Miners found a bed of soft {gypsite} near the lake.
e.zh: 矿工在湖边发现了一层松软的土状石膏。

e.en: The farmer spread powdered {gypsite} on the field.
e.zh: 农民把粉碎的石膏土撒在田里。

gypsography.t: 石膏雕刻术；石膏制图法

e.en: The museum displayed Victorian examples of {gypsography}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了维多利亚时代的石膏雕刻作品。

e.en: He studied {gypsography} as an old method of relief printing.
e.zh: 他研究石膏制图法这种旧式浮雕印刷方法。

e.en: The florist added white {gypsophila} to the bouquet.
e.zh: 花艺师在花束中加入了白色满天星。

e.en: Dried {gypsophila} can soften a simple table arrangement.
e.zh: 干燥的满天星能让简单的桌面花艺显得更柔和。

gypsophilous.t: 喜石膏土的；适生石膏地的

e.en: Several {gypsophilous} plants grow only on gypsum hills.
e.zh: 几种喜石膏土的植物只生长在石膏山丘上。

e.en: The survey mapped {gypsophilous} communities across the desert.
e.zh: 调查绘制了沙漠中喜石膏土植物群落的分布图。

gyrogonite.t: 轮藻卵石；轮藻化石果实

e.en: The limestone sample contained a tiny {gyrogonite}.
e.zh: 这块石灰岩样本里含有一颗微小的轮藻卵石。

e.en: Researchers used the {gyrogonite} to date the lake deposit.
e.zh: 研究人员利用这枚轮藻化石果实来判定湖相沉积的年代。

gyrograph.t: 陀螺记录仪；旋转绘图器

e.en: The engineer checked the old {gyrograph} before the test flight.
e.zh: 工程师在试飞前检查了那台旧陀螺记录仪。

e.en: A simple {gyrograph} drew looping patterns on the paper.
e.zh: 一个简单的旋转绘图器在纸上画出环形图案。

gyrohorizon.t: 陀螺水平仪；人工地平仪

e.en: The pilot trusted the {gyrohorizon} in thick cloud.
e.zh: 飞行员在浓云中依靠陀螺水平仪判断姿态。

e.en: A faulty {gyrohorizon} can give a dangerous attitude reading.
e.zh: 故障的人工地平仪可能给出危险的姿态读数。

e.en: The shell had a {gyroidal} curve near its tip.
e.zh: 这枚贝壳靠近尖端处有螺旋状弧线。

e.en: Engineers studied the {gyroidal} surface for lightweight materials.
e.zh: 工程师研究这种螺旋状曲面，用于轻质材料。

gyrolevel.t: 陀螺水平仪；陀螺水准器

e.en: The survey team calibrated the {gyrolevel} at dawn.
e.zh: 测量队在清晨校准了陀螺水准器。

e.en: A marine {gyrolevel} helped stabilize the instrument platform.
e.zh: 一台船用陀螺水平仪帮助稳定仪器平台。

e.en: The shield displayed a red {gyron} in one corner.
e.zh: 盾徽的一角有一个红色三角纹章图形。

e.en: Heraldic artists divided the field with a narrow {gyron}.
e.zh: 纹章画师用一个狭长的三角图形分割盾面。

e.en: The old banner was painted in a {gyronny} pattern.
e.zh: 那面旧旗绘成了三角分割纹样。

e.en: A {gyronny} shield often alternates two contrasting colors.
e.zh: 饰有三角分割纹的盾徽常交替使用两种对比色。

e.en: The aircraft's {gyropilot} held a steady course.
e.zh: 飞机的陀螺自动驾驶仪保持了稳定航向。

e.en: Sailors installed a {gyropilot} to reduce hand steering.
e.zh: 水手安装了陀螺自动驾驶仪，以减少人工掌舵。

gyropter.t: 旋翼飞行器；扑翼设想机

e.en: The inventor sketched a strange {gyropter} with rotating wings.
e.zh: 发明家画了一架带旋转机翼的奇特旋翼飞行器。

e.en: Early aviation journals described the {gyropter} as experimental.
e.zh: 早期航空期刊把这种旋翼飞行器描述为实验性装置。

e.en: The farmer repaired the {gyrorake} before cutting hay.
e.zh: 农民在割草制干草前修好了旋转搂草机。

e.en: A {gyrorake} gathers loose straw into even rows.
e.zh: 旋转搂草机能把散落的秸秆聚成整齐的行。

e.en: The plasma emitted radiation through {gyroresonance}.
e.zh: 等离子体通过回旋共振发出辐射。

e.en: Engineers avoided {gyroresonance} in the spinning assembly.
e.zh: 工程师避免旋转组件中出现陀螺共振。

e.en: The torpedo used a {gyrorudder} to maintain direction.
e.zh: 鱼雷使用陀螺舵来保持方向。

e.en: A damaged {gyrorudder} made the model boat turn sharply.
e.zh: 受损的回转舵使模型船猛地转向。

gyroscopically.t: 以陀螺方式；靠陀螺效应

e.en: The camera was {gyroscopically} stabilized during the chase.
e.zh: 追逐拍摄时，摄像机靠陀螺效应保持稳定。

e.en: A spinning wheel can behave {gyroscopically} under force.
e.zh: 旋转的轮子受力时会表现出陀螺效应。

e.en: The fossil showed a {gyrose} pattern under magnification.
e.zh: 这块化石在放大后呈现出回旋状纹理。

e.en: Botanists noted the leaf's unusual {gyrose} surface.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这片叶子异常的环卷状表面。

e.en: The fighter's {gyrosight} helped the pilot aim accurately.
e.zh: 战斗机的陀螺瞄准具帮助飞行员准确瞄准。

e.en: Museum visitors examined a wartime {gyrosight} behind glass.
e.zh: 博物馆参观者隔着玻璃查看一具战时陀螺瞄准具。

e.en: The exhibit let children balance inside a clear {gyrosphere}.
e.zh: 展览让孩子们在透明陀螺球里体验平衡。

e.en: The robot used a small {gyrosphere} for orientation control.
e.zh: 机器人用一个小型旋转球体装置控制方向。

e.en: The drone relies on {gyrostabilization} in strong wind.
e.zh: 无人机在强风中依靠陀螺稳定保持姿态。

e.en: Modern binoculars use {gyrostabilization} to reduce shaking.
e.zh: 现代双筒望远镜利用陀螺稳像来减少抖动。

e.en: The helicopter carried a {gyrostabilized} camera mount.
e.zh: 直升机搭载了经陀螺稳定的摄像机支架。

e.en: A {gyrostabilized} platform kept the sensor level at sea.
e.zh: 经陀螺稳定的平台在海上让传感器保持水平。

e.en: The yacht's {gyrostabilizer} reduced rolling in rough water.
e.zh: 游艇的陀螺稳定器减轻了恶劣海况下的横摇。

e.en: Technicians replaced the worn bearing inside the {gyrostabilizer}.
e.zh: 技术人员更换了陀螺稳定器内部磨损的轴承。

e.en: The classroom {gyrostat} demonstrated angular momentum clearly.
e.zh: 课堂上的陀螺仪清楚展示了角动量。

e.en: The vessel used a heavy {gyrostat} to resist rolling.
e.zh: 这艘船用一个重型陀螺稳定装置来抵抗横摇。

gyrostatic.t: 陀螺静力的；陀螺稳定的

e.en: The paper analyzed {gyrostatic} forces in the rotor.
e.zh: 论文分析了转子中的陀螺静力作用。

e.en: A {gyrostatic} compass remains useful when visibility is poor.
e.zh: 能靠陀螺保持稳定的罗盘在能见度差时仍很有用。

e.en: The course introduced {gyrostatics} after basic mechanics.
e.zh: 这门课在基础力学之后介绍陀螺静力学。

e.en: Problems in {gyrostatics} often involve spinning rigid bodies.
e.zh: 陀螺静力学问题常涉及旋转刚体。

gyrosyn.t: 陀螺同步器；陀螺同步系统

e.en: The radar antenna used a {gyrosyn} for stable pointing.
e.zh: 雷达天线使用陀螺同步器来保持稳定指向。

e.en: Technicians tested the {gyrosyn} before installing the compass unit.
e.zh: 技术人员在安装罗盘组件前测试了陀螺同步系统。

e.en: The spacecraft's {gyrosystem} monitored small attitude changes.
e.zh: 航天器的陀螺系统监测细微的姿态变化。

e.en: A backup {gyrosystem} kept the ship's instruments aligned.
e.zh: 备用陀螺系统使船上的仪器保持校准。

e.en: The laboratory used a {gyrotron} to generate intense microwave radiation.
e.zh: 实验室用回旋管产生强烈的微波辐射。

e.en: Engineers repaired the {gyrotron} before the plasma experiment began.
e.zh: 等离子体实验开始前，工程师修好了那台回旋管。

e.en: The physicist described the crystal as a {gyrotrope} in the lecture.
e.zh: 物理学家在讲座中把这种晶体称为旋性物质。

e.en: A {gyrotrope} can rotate the polarization of passing light.
e.zh: 旋光体能够使通过的光发生偏振旋转。

e.en: The aircraft's {gyrounit} helped stabilize the navigation system.
e.zh: 飞机的陀螺组件帮助稳定导航系统。

e.en: A faulty {gyrounit} caused the instrument readings to drift.
e.zh: 有故障的陀螺装置导致仪表读数发生漂移。

e.en: The moth followed a {gyrovague} path around the lamp.
e.zh: 飞蛾绕着灯走出一条回旋不定的路线。

e.en: His {gyrovague} wandering through the city lasted all afternoon.
e.zh: 他在城里漫无定向地绕来绕去，走了整整一下午。

e.en: The old tale calls the hermit a {gyte} who shouted at storms.
e.zh: 这个古老故事把那位隐士称作会对风暴大喊的疯子。

e.en: After three sleepless nights, he looked almost {gyte}.
e.zh: 三晚没睡之后，他看起来几乎像疯了一样。

e.en: The core sample contained dark {gyttja} from the ancient lake bed.
e.zh: 岩芯样本中含有来自古湖床的深色湖底腐殖泥。

e.en: Researchers analyzed the {gyttja} to reconstruct past climate changes.
e.zh: 研究人员分析这些淤泥沉积，以重建过去的气候变化。

e.en: The prisoner dragged a heavy {gyve} across the stone floor.
e.zh: 囚犯拖着沉重的脚镣走过石地面。

e.en: The tyrant tried to {gyve} every voice that opposed him.
e.zh: 暴君试图给每一个反对他的声音套上枷锁。

e.en: The {geosphere} interacts constantly with the atmosphere and oceans.
e.zh: 地圈不断与大气和海洋相互作用。

e.en: Volcanic activity is one process within the {geosphere}.
e.zh: 火山活动是地球固体部分中的一种过程。

e.en: Engineers measured the {geostatic} pressure before drilling deeper.
e.zh: 工程师在继续深钻前测量了地静压力。

e.en: The model assumes a stable {geostatic} stress field.
e.zh: 该模型假定存在稳定的地静力应力场。

e.en: The course introduced {geostatics} for analyzing underground stress.
e.zh: 这门课介绍了用于分析地下应力的地静力学。

e.en: Modern {geostatics} helps estimate ore quality between samples.
e.zh: 现代地质统计学有助于估算样本之间的矿石品位。

e.en: The researcher found an old {geostenogram} in the survey archive.
e.zh: 研究人员在勘测档案中发现了一份旧的地质速记记录图。

e.en: Each {geostenogram} summarized field observations from the expedition.
e.zh: 每份地质速记记录图都概括了考察中的现场观察。

e.en: The {geostrategist} warned that the port had military importance.
e.zh: 这位地缘战略家警告说该港口具有军事重要性。

e.en: As a {geostrategist}, she studied borders, resources, and trade routes.
e.zh: 作为地缘战略家，她研究边界、资源和贸易路线。

e.en: Energy security shaped the country's new {geostrategy}.
e.zh: 能源安全塑造了该国新的地缘战略。

e.en: His book links naval power with long-term {geostrategy}.
e.zh: 他的书把海军力量与长期地缘战略联系起来。

e.en: A {geostrophic} wind flows parallel to pressure contours.
e.zh: 地转风沿着等压线平行流动。

e.en: The forecast used a {geostrophic} approximation for upper-air motion.
e.zh: 预报对高空运动采用了地转近似。

e.en: The current moved {geostrophically} along the continental shelf.
e.zh: 洋流按地转方式沿大陆架流动。

e.en: Air parcels can balance {geostrophically} in the free atmosphere.
e.zh: 空气团在自由大气中可以按地转方式达到平衡。

e.en: The lecture explained {geostrophy} in rotating weather systems.
e.zh: 讲座解释了旋转天气系统中的地转平衡。

e.en: Oceanographers use {geostrophy} to infer deep currents.
e.zh: 海洋学家利用地转状态来推断深层洋流。

geosuture.t: 地缝合带；大地构造缝合线

e.en: The mountain belt marks an ancient {geosuture}.
e.zh: 这条山带标志着一条古老的地缝合带。

e.en: Mapping the {geosuture} helped reconstruct the vanished ocean basin.
e.zh: 绘制这条大地构造缝合线有助于重建已消失的洋盆。

e.en: Several {geosutures} cross the old continental margin.
e.zh: 几条地缝合带横穿古老的大陆边缘。

e.en: These {geosutures} reveal where plates once collided.
e.zh: 这些构造缝合线显示了板块曾经碰撞的位置。

e.en: The basin preserved thick {geosynclinal} sediments.
e.zh: 该盆地保存了厚厚的地槽沉积物。

e.en: Older textbooks described mountain building as a {geosynclinal} process.
e.zh: 早期教材把造山运动描述为一种地槽过程。

e.en: In English, a {gerund} often ends in ing.
e.zh: 在英语中，动名词通常以 ing 结尾。

e.en: The {gerund} in this sentence functions as the subject.
e.zh: 这个句子里的动名词充当主语。

e.en: She wore {geta} with her summer kimono.
e.zh: 她穿夏季和服时配了日本木屐。

e.en: The old {geta} clicked loudly on the stone path.
e.zh: 那双旧木屐在石板路上咔嗒作响。

e.en: Tickets are still {getable} at the station.
e.zh: 车票在车站仍然可以买到。

e.en: The joke is {getable} only if you know the local slang.
e.zh: 只有懂当地俚语，才听得懂这个笑话。

e.en: Fresh water was barely {getatable} on the island.
e.zh: 岛上几乎弄不到淡水。

e.en: The rare edition is {getatable} through a few specialist dealers.
e.zh: 这个珍本可通过少数专业书商买到。

e.en: Go {getch} your coat before we leave.
e.zh: 我们走之前，你去把外套拿来。

e.en: The farmhand shouted that he would {getch} the runaway calf.
e.zh: 农工喊道他会去抓住那头跑掉的小牛。

e.en: The medicine is {gettable} without a prescription.
e.zh: 这种药不用处方也能买到。

e.en: Her point was {gettable}, even through the noise.
e.zh: 尽管有噪音，她的意思还是能听懂。

e.en: His pirate {getup} made everyone laugh at the party.
e.zh: 他的海盗装束让聚会上的每个人都笑了。

e.en: She arrived in a formal {getup} that seemed too grand for lunch.
e.zh: 她穿着正式打扮到场，对午餐来说显得太隆重。

e.en: A bright orange {geum} bloomed near the garden path.
e.zh: 一株橙色的水杨梅属植物在花园小径旁开花。

e.en: The nursery sells {geum} for borders and cottage gardens.
e.zh: 苗圃出售适合花境和乡村花园的水杨梅属植物。

e.en: {Gevalt}, I forgot the tickets at home!
e.zh: 天哪，我把票忘在家里了！

e.en: He muttered {gevalt} when he saw the repair bill.
e.zh: 他看到维修账单时低声说了句哎呀。

e.en: The shelf was crowded with every shiny {gewgaw} imaginable.
e.zh: 架子上摆满了各种闪亮却华而不实的小玩意。

e.en: She preferred one useful tool to another decorative {gewgaw}.
e.zh: 比起又一个装饰性小摆设，她更喜欢一件实用工具。

e.en: The costume was {gewgawed} with beads and fake jewels.
e.zh: 这套服装缀满了珠子和假宝石等廉价饰物。

e.en: A {gewgawed} shop window caught the children's attention.
e.zh: 一个装饰得花里胡哨的橱窗吸引了孩子们的注意。

e.en: The lobby had a {gewgawish} charm that tourists loved.
e.zh: 大厅有种花哨廉价的魅力，游客很喜欢。

e.en: He rejected the {gewgawish} design and asked for something simpler.
e.zh: 他否定了那个花哨廉价的设计，要求换成更简洁的方案。

e.en: We ordered a chilled {gewurztraminer} with the spicy food.
e.zh: 我们点了一瓶冰镇琼瑶浆白葡萄酒来配辛辣菜肴。

e.en: This {gewurztraminer} smells of lychee and rose petals.
e.zh: 这款琼瑶浆白葡萄酒带有荔枝和玫瑰花瓣的香气。

e.en: The brooch was carved from polished {gagate}.
e.zh: 这枚胸针是用抛光黑玉雕成的。

e.en: Victorian mourners often wore jewelry made of {gagate}.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的哀悼者常佩戴煤玉首饰。

e.en: The fossil showed signs of slow {gagatisation}.
e.zh: 这块化石显示出缓慢煤玉化的迹象。

e.en: Geologists discussed {gagatisation} in ancient buried wood.
e.zh: 地质学家讨论了古代埋藏木材的煤玉化过程。

e.en: The rider adjusted the {gagbit} before the race.
e.zh: 骑手在比赛前调整了马嚼子。

e.en: A harsh {gagbit} can hurt a sensitive horse.
e.zh: 过硬的马嚼子会伤到敏感的马。

e.en: Only land with clear title was {gageable}.
e.zh: 只有产权清楚的土地才可抵押。

e.en: The lawyer asked whether the goods were {gageable} assets.
e.zh: 律师询问这些货物是否属于可担保资产。

e.en: The play relied too much on cheap {gaggery}.
e.zh: 这出戏过分依赖廉价的插科打诨。

e.en: His early radio scripts were full of lively {gaggery}.
e.zh: 他早期的广播剧本充满活泼的笑料。

gaggy.t: 令人作呕的；笑话过多的

e.en: The medicine left a {gaggy} taste in my mouth.
e.zh: 这药在我嘴里留下令人作呕的味道。

e.en: The sitcom became too {gaggy} for serious viewers.
e.zh: 这部情景喜剧对严肃观众来说笑料塞得太多。

e.en: Journalists protested the new {gaglaw}.
e.zh: 记者们抗议这项新的限制言论法律。

e.en: Critics said the {gaglaw} would silence public debate.
e.zh: 批评者说这项限制言论的法律会压制公共讨论。

e.en: A veteran {gagman} wrote jokes for the host.
e.zh: 一位资深笑话作者为主持人写段子。

e.en: The film hired a {gagman} to sharpen the comic scenes.
e.zh: 这部电影请来喜剧编剧加强喜剧场面。

gagster.t: 爱讲笑话的人；喜剧作者

e.en: The office {gagster} kept everyone laughing at lunch.
e.zh: 办公室里那个爱讲笑话的人让大家午餐时笑个不停。

e.en: A quick {gagster} can save a dull variety show.
e.zh: 反应快的喜剧作者能拯救沉闷的综艺节目。

gagwriter.t: 笑话撰稿人；喜剧段子作者

e.en: The comedian hired a new {gagwriter} for the tour.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员为巡演聘请了一名新的段子作者。

e.en: A good {gagwriter} understands rhythm as well as punch lines.
e.zh: 优秀的笑话撰稿人既懂节奏，也懂包袱。

e.en: {Gah}, I forgot my keys again.
e.zh: 啊呀，我又忘带钥匙了。

e.en: She muttered {gah} when the file crashed.
e.zh: 文件崩溃时，她低声嘟囔了一句真烦。

e.en: The mineral sample contained dark green {gahnite}.
e.zh: 这份矿物样本含有深绿色锌尖晶石。

e.en: Collectors prize clear crystals of {gahnite}.
e.zh: 收藏者很看重清澈的锌尖晶石晶体。

gaian.t: 盖亚理论的；地球整体观的

e.en: Her essay took a strongly {gaian} view of climate.
e.zh: 她的文章对气候持有强烈的盖亚式整体观。

e.en: Some environmental groups use {gaian} language about Earth.
e.zh: 一些环保组织用盖亚理论式的语言谈论地球。

e.en: Bright {gaillardia} bloomed along the dry path.
e.zh: 鲜艳的天人菊开在干燥的小路旁。

e.en: The gardener planted {gaillardia} because it tolerates heat.
e.zh: 园丁种下天人菊，因为它耐热。

e.en: The prize was still {gainable} with one match left.
e.zh: 还剩一场比赛时，奖项仍然有机会赢得。

e.en: They focused on small, {gainable} improvements first.
e.zh: 他们先专注于小而可实现的改进。

e.en: A sudden {gaingiving} made him stop at the door.
e.zh: 一阵突如其来的不祥预感让他在门口停住。

e.en: She felt {gaingiving} before signing the old agreement.
e.zh: 签那份旧协议前，她心里感到疑惧。

e.en: The argument was noisy and {gainless}.
e.zh: 这场争论吵闹却毫无结果。

e.en: Years of {gainless} labor left the farm in debt.
e.zh: 多年无收益的劳作让农场背上债务。

e.en: The laser scanner uses a fast {galvo}.
e.zh: 这台激光扫描仪使用高速振镜。

e.en: Engineers replaced the faulty {galvo} in the projector.
e.zh: 工程师更换了投影仪里故障的振镜。

e.en: The bistro served a light {gamay} with dinner.
e.zh: 小餐馆晚餐配了一款清淡的佳美红酒。

e.en: Many Beaujolais wines are made from {gamay} grapes.
e.zh: 许多博若莱葡萄酒都是用佳美葡萄酿成的。

e.en: She learned the {gamba} for early music concerts.
e.zh: 她为演奏早期音乐会学习了古低音提琴。

e.en: The old shield showed a {gamba} in silver.
e.zh: 那面旧盾徽上有一条银色腿形图案。

e.en: The colt made a sudden {gambade} in the field.
e.zh: 小马在田里突然欢跳了一下。

e.en: His speech ended with a verbal {gambade}.
e.zh: 他的演讲最后来了一段俏皮的跳跃式发挥。

e.en: The rider fastened a {gambado} before mounting.
e.zh: 骑手上马前系好了一只皮绑腿。

e.en: The horse gave a comic {gambado} near the gate.
e.zh: 那匹马在门边滑稽地跳了一下。

e.en: The museum displayed old riding {gambadoes} beside the saddle.
e.zh: 博物馆把旧式骑马皮绑腿陈列在马鞍旁。

e.en: The pony's little {gambadoes} amused the children.
e.zh: 小马那几下欢跳逗乐了孩子们。

e.en: The sonata was written for {gambe} and harpsichord.
e.zh: 这首奏鸣曲是为古提琴和羽管键琴而写的。

e.en: He restored a cracked {gambe} from the seventeenth century.
e.zh: 他修复了一把十七世纪有裂纹的古提琴。

e.en: The soldier wore a thick {gambeson} under his mail.
e.zh: 士兵在锁子甲下面穿着厚厚的软垫甲。

e.en: Her costume included a quilted {gambeson}.
e.zh: 她的戏服里有一件绗缝的中世纪棉甲。

e.en: The dyer used {gambir} to tan the cloth.
e.zh: 染工用儿茶膏给布料鞣染。

e.en: Some betel mixtures include a little {gambir}.
e.zh: 有些槟榔配料里会加入少量儿茶膏。

e.en: His {gamblesome} friends urged him to bet again.
e.zh: 他那些爱赌博的朋友怂恿他再下注。

e.en: A {gamblesome} investor bought the failing company.
e.zh: 一位好冒险的投资者买下了那家衰败的公司。

e.en: Police raided a hidden {gambling-den} downtown.
e.zh: 警方突袭了市中心一处隐蔽的地下赌场。

e.en: The novel describes a smoky {gambling-den} by the docks.
e.zh: 小说描写了码头旁一间烟雾缭绕的赌窝。

e.en: The painter chose a {gambogian} wash for the sunset.
e.zh: 画家用藤黄色淡彩来表现夕阳。

e.en: A {gambogian} stain marked the old manuscript.
e.zh: 那份旧手稿上有一块藤黄色污迹。

e.en: The chemist studied {gambogic} acid in the resin.
e.zh: 化学家研究树脂中的藤黄酸。

e.en: A {gambogic} pigment brightened the border.
e.zh: 一种藤黄色颜料让边框更明亮。

e.en: The barn had a steep {gambrel} roof.
e.zh: 那座谷仓有一个陡峭的折线屋顶。

e.en: The butcher hung the carcass from a {gambrel}.
e.zh: 屠夫把胴体挂在一根屠宰吊钩上。

e.en: The pond was stocked with {gambusia} to control mosquitoes.
e.zh: 池塘里投放了食蚊鱼来控制蚊虫。

e.en: Biologists tracked how {gambusia} spread through the stream.
e.zh: 生物学家追踪食蚊鱼如何在溪流中扩散。

e.en: He put the pheasant in his {game-bag}.
e.zh: 他把那只野鸡放进猎物袋里。

e.en: Her old {game-bag} smelled of wet leather.
e.zh: 她的旧猎物袋有股湿皮革味。

e.en: Pheasant is a common {game-bird} in Britain.
e.zh: 雉鸡是英国常见的猎禽。

e.en: The reserve protects each {game-bird} during breeding season.
e.zh: 保护区在繁殖季保护每一种猎禽。

e.en: The engineers tested a {geopressured} reservoir for energy production.
e.zh: 工程师测试了一个受地压作用的储层用于能源生产。

e.en: Hot brine rose from the {geopressured} zone.
e.zh: 热盐水从受地压作用的地层带涌出。

e.en: Visitors entered a painted {georama} of the world.
e.zh: 游客走进一幅绘制的世界地球全景图。

e.en: The exhibition used a {georama} to teach geography.
e.zh: 展览用地理展景来教授地理知识。

e.en: The poem has a calm {georgic} mood.
e.zh: 这首诗带有平静的田园诗情调。

e.en: He wrote a {georgic} essay on pruning vines.
e.zh: 他写了一篇关于修剪葡萄藤的农事散文。

e.en: Her research in {georheology} explains slow crustal flow.
e.zh: 她在地质流变学方面的研究解释了地壳的缓慢流动。

e.en: The model uses {georheology} to predict glacier movement.
e.zh: 这个模型利用地质流变学来预测冰川运动。

e.en: The valley shows a complete {geosere} from bare rock to forest.
e.zh: 这个山谷呈现了从裸岩到森林的完整地质演替系列。

e.en: Students mapped the {geosere} along the old lava flow.
e.zh: 学生们绘制了旧熔岩流沿线的地质演替系列。

e.en: Satellites monitor storms in {geospace}.
e.zh: 卫星监测地球空间中的风暴活动。

e.en: The mission studied charged particles in {geospace}.
e.zh: 这次任务研究了近地空间中的带电粒子。

e.en: The city released {geospatial} data for planners.
e.zh: 市政府向规划人员发布了地理空间数据。

e.en: Rescuers used {geospatial} maps after the flood.
e.zh: 洪水过后，救援人员使用了地理空间地图。

e.en: It was {gey} cold on the moor.
e.zh: 荒原上相当冷。

e.en: She looked {gey} pleased with herself.
e.zh: 她看起来对自己很满意。

e.en: The pool edge was coated with white {geyserite}.
e.zh: 池边覆盖着白色的间歇泉沉积硅华。

e.en: Scientists sampled the {geyserite} around the vent.
e.zh: 科学家采集了喷口周围的间歇泉硅华样本。

e.en: She wore a red {ghagra} at the wedding.
e.zh: 她在婚礼上穿了一条红色印度长裙。

e.en: The dancer's {ghagra} spun in bright circles.
e.zh: 舞者的印度长裙旋转出鲜艳的圆影。

e.en: Her embroidered {gharara} matched the silk scarf.
e.zh: 她的刺绣南亚阔腿礼裤和丝巾很配。

e.en: The bride chose a traditional {gharara} for the ceremony.
e.zh: 新娘为仪式选了一套传统的南亚阔腿礼裤。

e.en: A {gharial} rested on the riverbank.
e.zh: 一条恒河鳄趴在河岸上休息。

e.en: The zoo protects the rare {gharial} from extinction.
e.zh: 动物园保护这种稀有的长吻鳄免于灭绝。

e.en: They hired a {gharri} outside the station.
e.zh: 他们在车站外雇了一辆出租马车。

e.en: The old {gharri} rattled through the market.
e.zh: 那辆旧马车咯吱咯吱地穿过市场。

e.en: He spent the evening in a smoky {ginmill}.
e.zh: 他在一家烟雾弥漫的廉价酒吧过了一晚。

e.en: The novel opens in a noisy {ginmill} near the docks.
e.zh: 小说开篇写的是码头附近一家嘈杂的廉价酒吧。

e.en: We slipped through a dark {ginnel} behind the shops.
e.zh: 我们从商店后面一条昏暗的狭窄小巷穿过去。

e.en: The children played football in the {ginnel}.
e.zh: 孩子们在那条小巷里踢足球。

e.en: The {ginnery} processed cotton from nearby farms.
e.zh: 这家轧棉厂加工附近农场送来的棉花。

e.en: Dust filled the old {ginnery} during harvest season.
e.zh: 收获季节里，旧轧棉厂满是尘土。

e.en: This year's {ginnings} were higher than expected.
e.zh: 今年的轧棉量高于预期。

e.en: The report compared weekly {ginnings} across the region.
e.zh: 报告比较了该地区每周的轧棉量。

e.en: A {ginnywink} called from the barn roof.
e.zh: 一只小猫头鹰在谷仓屋顶上叫。

e.en: Local children called the tiny owl a {ginnywink}.
e.zh: 当地孩子把这种小猫头鹰叫作ginnywink。

e.en: They ordered a {ginormous} pizza for everyone.
e.zh: 他们给大家点了一个超大的披萨。

e.en: The project became a {ginormous} headache.
e.zh: 这个项目变成了一个巨大的麻烦。

e.en: The sailors crowded into a cheap {ginshop}.
e.zh: 水手们挤进一家廉价的杜松子酒小店。

e.en: A faded sign marked the old {ginshop}.
e.zh: 一块褪色的招牌标出了那家旧酒铺。

e.en: The fox was caught in a rusty {gintrap}.
e.zh: 狐狸被一个生锈的夹捕兽器夹住了。

e.en: Campaigners demanded a ban on the cruel {gintrap}.
e.zh: 活动人士要求禁止这种残忍的夹捕兽器。

e.en: He regretted using the slur {ginzo} in anger.
e.zh: 他后悔自己气头上用了ginzo这个侮辱词。

e.en: The film includes the word {ginzo} to show prejudice.
e.zh: 电影使用ginzo这个词来表现偏见。

e.en: The passage should be played {giocoso}, not solemnly.
e.zh: 这一段应当活泼诙谐地演奏，而不是庄重地演奏。

e.en: The score marks the finale as {giocoso}.
e.zh: 乐谱把终曲标为活泼诙谐的风格。

e.en: The dealer tried to {gip} tourists with fake tickets.
e.zh: 那个商贩试图用假票欺骗游客。

e.en: I felt the fee was a complete {gip}.
e.zh: 我觉得这笔费用完全是在坑人。

e.en: The knight wore a padded {gipon} under his armor.
e.zh: 骑士在盔甲下面穿了一件带衬垫的中世纪短上衣。

e.en: The museum displayed a torn {gipon} from the battle.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件战场上留下的破损短上衣。

e.en: He was reprimanded for saying {gippo} at work.
e.zh: 他因在工作场合说出gippo这个侮辱词而受到训斥。

e.en: The dialogue uses {gippo} to expose casual racism.
e.zh: 这段对白用gippo一词揭示随口而出的种族歧视。

e.en: My stomach felt {gippy} after the seafood.
e.zh: 吃完海鲜后，我的胃有点不舒服。

e.en: He skipped lunch because he was feeling {gippy}.
e.zh: 他因为胃不舒服就没吃午饭。

e.en: The essay romanticized {gipsydom} in a dated way.
e.zh: 这篇文章以过时的方式浪漫化了吉卜赛人群体。

e.en: Victorian writers often treated {gipsydom} as exotic.
e.zh: 维多利亚时期的作家常把吉卜赛人群体写得很异域化。

e.en: The scholar warned against reducing the culture to {gipsyism}.
e.zh: 学者警告不要把这种文化简化为所谓吉卜赛特征。

e.en: Old travel books used {gipsyism} in vague romantic descriptions.
e.zh: 旧旅行书常在含糊浪漫的描述中使用吉卜赛习俗这一说法。

e.en: The self-styled {gourment} praised every rare cheese.
e.zh: 那位自称美食家的人称赞每一种稀有奶酪。

e.en: A true {gourment} notices the balance of flavors.
e.zh: 真正讲究饮食的人会注意味道的平衡。

e.en: Researchers measured {guvacine} in the betel nut sample.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了槟榔样本中的guvacine生物碱含量。

e.en: The paper discusses how {guvacine} affects nerve signaling.
e.zh: 论文讨论了guvacine这种生物碱如何影响神经信号传递。

e.en: The dancers performed a lively {gaillarde} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐后，舞者们跳了一支活泼的古法国快舞曲。

e.en: The manuscript includes music for a {gaillarde}.
e.zh: 这份手稿里收有一首古代法国快舞曲的乐谱。

e.en: The cable was protected by a rubber {gaine}.
e.zh: 这根电缆由一层橡胶护套保护。

e.en: The old text describes a narrow {gaine} around the stem.
e.zh: 那部旧文献描述了茎部周围的一层狭窄鞘状包层。
